verses.sa:
ॐ अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् ।
होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
verses.rom:
om agnimile purohitam yajnasya devamritvijam |
hotaram ratnadhatamam ||
verses.en:
I laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice,
The Hotar, lavishest of wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्निः पूर्वेभिरृषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत ।
स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
agnih purvebhirrishibhiridyo nutanairuta |
sa devan eha vakshati ||
verses.en:
Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers:
He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa:
अग्निना रयिमश्नवत् पोषमेव दिवेदिवे ।
यशसं वीरवत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnina rayimashnavat poshameva divedive |
yashasam viravattamam ||
verses.en:
Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing by day,
Most rich in heroes, glorious.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि ।
स इद्देवेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
agne yam yajnamadhvaram vishvatah paribhurasi |
sa iddeveshu gachchhati ||
verses.en:
Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about
Verily goeth to the Gods.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः ।
देवो देवेभिरा गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhota kavikratuh satyashchitrashravastamah |
devo devebhira gamat ||
verses.en:
May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great,
The God, come hither with the Gods.

verses.sa:
यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि ।
तवेत् तत् सत्यमङ्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
yadanga dashushe tvamagne bhadram karishyasi |
tavet tat satyamangirah ||
verses.en:
Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper,
That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.

verses.sa:
उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् ।
नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥
verses.rom:
upa tvagne divedive doshavastardhiya vayam |
namo bharanta emasi ||
verses.en:
To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer
Bringing thee reverence, we come;

verses.sa:
राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम् ।
वर्धमानं स्वे दमे ॥
verses.rom:
rajantamadhvaranam gopamritasya didivim |
vardhamanam sve dame ||
verses.en:
Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One,
Increasing in thine own abode.

verses.sa:
स नः पितेव सूनवेऽग्ने सूपायनो भव ।
सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah piteva sunave'gne supayano bhava |
sachasva nah svastaye ||
verses.en:
Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son:
Agni, be with us for our weal.

verses.sa:
वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः ।
तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayava yahi darshateme soma aramkritah |
tesham pahi shrudhi havam ||
verses.en:
BEAUTIFUL Vayu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared:
Drink of them, hearken to our call.

verses.sa:
वाय उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते त्वामच्छा जरितारः ।
सुतसोमा अहर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
vaya ukthebhirjarante tvamachchha jaritarah |
sutasoma aharvidah ||
verses.en:
Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify
Thee, Vayu, with their hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
वायो तव प्रपृञ्चती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे ।
उरूची सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vayo tava praprinchati dhena jigati dashushe |
uruchi somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Vayu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper,
Far-spreading for the Soma draught.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम् ।
इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu ime suta upa prayobhira gatam |
indavo vamushanti hi ||
verses.en:
These, Indra-Vayu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake:
The drops are yearning for you both.

verses.sa:
वायविन्द्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू ।
तावा यातमुप द्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
vayavindrashcha chetathah sutanam vajinivasu |
tava yatamupa dravat ||
verses.en:
Well do ye mark libations, ye Vayu and Indra, rich in spoil
So come ye swiftly hitherward.

verses.sa:
वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्कृतम् ।
मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा ॥
verses.rom:
vayavindrashcha sunvata a yatamupa nishkritam |
makshvittha dhiya nara ||
verses.en:
Vayu and Indra, come to what the Soma. presser hath prepared:
Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.

verses.sa:
मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् ।
धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
mitram huve putadaksham varunam cha rishadasam |
dhiyam ghritachim sadhanta ||
verses.en:
Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuna,
Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा ।
क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे ॥
verses.rom:
ritena mitravarunavritavridhavritasprisha |
kratum brihantamashathe ||
verses.en:
Mitra and Varuna, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law,
Have ye obtained your might power.

verses.sa:
कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया ।
दक्षं दधाते अपसम् ॥
verses.rom:
kavi no mitravaruna tuvijata urukshaya |
daksham dadhate apasam ||
verses.en:
Our Sages, Mitra-Varuna, wide dominion, strong by birth,
Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.

verses.sa:
अश्विना यज्वरीरिषो द्रवत्पाणी शुभस्पती ।
पुरुभुजा चनस्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina yajvaririsho dravatpani shubhaspati |
purubhuja chanasyatam ||
verses.en:
YE Asvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands,
Accept the sacrificial food.

verses.sa:
अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया ।
धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina purudamsasa nara shaviraya dhiya |
dhishnya vanatam girah ||
verses.en:
Ye Asvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise,
Accept our songs with mighty thought.

verses.sa:
दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी ॥
verses.rom:
dasra yuvakavah suta nasatya vriktabarhishah |
a yatam rudravartani ||
verses.en:
Nasatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass:
Come ye whose paths are red with flame.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः ।
अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi chitrabhano suta ime tvayavah |
anvibhistana putasah ||
verses.en:
O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee,
Thus by fine fingers purified.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः ।
उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi dhiyeshito viprajutah sutavatah |
upa brahmani vaghatah ||
verses.en:
Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers,
Of the libation-pouring priest.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः ।
सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi tutujana upa brahmani harivah |
sute dadhishva nashchanah ||
verses.en:
Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers.
In our libation take delight.

verses.sa:
ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आ गत ।
दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
omasashcharshanidhrito vishve devasa a gata |
dashvamso dashushah sutam ||
verses.en:
Ye Visvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach
Your worshipper's drink-offering.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमा गन्त तूर्णयः ।
उस्रा इव स्वसराणि ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devaso apturah sutama ganta turnayah |
usra iva svasarani ||
verses.en:
Ye Visvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught,
As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः ।
मेधं जुषन्त वह्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devaso asridha ehimayaso adruhah |
medham jushanta vahnayah ||
verses.en:
The Visvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile,
Bearers, accept the sacred draught

verses.sa:
पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती ।
यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
pavaka nah sarasvati vajebhirvajinivati |
yajnam vashtu dhiyavasuh ||
verses.en:
Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarasvati desire,
With eager love, our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम् ।
यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ॥
verses.rom:
chodayitri sunritanam chetanti sumatinam |
yajnam dadhe sarasvati ||
verses.en:
Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer o all gracious thought,
Sarasvati accept our rite

verses.sa:
महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना ।
धियो विश्वा वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
maho arnah sarasvati pra chetayati ketuna |
dhiyo vishva vi rajati ||
verses.en:
Sarasvati, the mighty flood,--she with be light illuminates,
She brightens every pious thought.

verses.sa:
सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे ।
जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
verses.rom:
surupakritnumutaye sudughamiva goduhe |
juhumasi dyavidyavi ||
verses.en:
As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds,
To our assistance day by day.

verses.sa:
उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब ।
गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah savana gahi somasya somapah piba |
goda idrevato madah ||
verses.en:
Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou!
The rich One's rapture giveth kine.

verses.sa:
अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम् ।
मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
atha te antamanam vidyama sumatinam |
ma no ati khya a gahi ||
verses.en:
So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence:
Neglect us not, come hitherward.

verses.sa:
परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिन्द्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितम् ।
यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
parehi vigramastritamindram prichchha vipashchitam |
yaste sakhibhya a varam ||
verses.en:
Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song,
Him who is better than thy friends.

verses.sa:
उत ब्रुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत ।
दधाना इन्द्र इद्दुवः ॥
verses.rom:
uta bruvantu no nido niranyatashchidarata |
dadhana indra idduvah ||
verses.en:
Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place,
Ye who serve Indra and none else;

verses.sa:
उत नः सुभगाँ अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः ।
स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah subhagan arirvocheyurdasma krishtayah |
syamedindrasya sharmani ||
verses.en:
Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest,
Still may we dwell in Indra's care.

verses.sa:
एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनम् ।
पतयन्मन्दयत्सखम् ॥
verses.rom:
emashumashave bhara yajnashriyam nrimadanam |
patayanmandayatsakham ||
verses.en:
Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice,
That to the Friend gives wings and joy.

verses.sa:
अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः ।
प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya pitva shatakrato ghano vritranamabhavah |
pravo vajeshu vajinam ||
verses.en:
Thou, Satakratu, drankest this and wast the Vrtras' slayer; thou
Helpest the warrior in the fray.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो ।
धनानामिन्द्र सातये ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vajeshu vajinam vajayamah shatakrato |
dhananamindra sataye ||
verses.en:
We strengthen, Satakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight,
That, Indra, we may win us wealth.

verses.sa:
यो रायोऽवनिर्महान्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा ।
तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
verses.rom:
yo rayo'vanirmahansuparah sunvatah sakha |
tasma indraya gayata ||
verses.en:
To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice,
yea, to this Indra sing your song.

verses.sa:
आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
सखाय स्तोमवाहसः ॥
verses.rom:
a tveta ni shidatendramabhi pra gayata |
sakhaya stomavahasah ||
verses.en:
O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song,
companions, bringing hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम् ।
इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
verses.rom:
purutamam purunamishanam varyanam |
indram some sacha sute ||
verses.en:
To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent,
Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.

verses.sa:
स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरंध्याम् ।
गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha no yoga a bhuvatsa raye sa puramdhyam |
gamadvajebhira sa nah ||
verses.en:
May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth:
May he come nigh us with his strength.

verses.sa:
यस्य संस्थे न वृण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः ।
तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
verses.rom:
yasya samsthe na vrinvate hari samatsu shatravah |
tasma indraya gayata ||
verses.en:
Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not:
To him, to Indra sing your song.

verses.sa:
सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यन्ति वीतये ।
सोमासो दध्याशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
sutapavne suta ime shuchayo yanti vitaye |
somaso dadhyashirah ||
verses.en:
Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops,
The Somas mingled with the curd.

verses.sa:
त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः ।
इन्द्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sutasya pitaye sadyo vriddho ajayathah |
indra jyaishthyaya sukrato ||
verses.en:
Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice,
Strong Indra, for preëminence.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्त्वाशवः सोमास इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
शं ते सन्तु प्रचेतसे ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vishantvashavah somasa indra girvanah |
sham te santu prachetase ||
verses.en:
O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee:
May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.

verses.sa:
त्वां स्तोमा अवीवृधन्त्वामुक्था शतक्रतो ।
त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam stoma avivridhantvamuktha shatakrato |
tvam vardhantu no girah ||
verses.en:
Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Satakratu, and our lauds
So strengthen thee the songs we sing.

verses.sa:
अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिन्द्रः सहस्रिणम् ।
यस्मिन्विश्वानि पौंस्या ॥
verses.rom:
akshitotih sanedimam vajamindrah sahasrinam |
yasminvishvani paumsya ||
verses.en:
Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold,
Wherein all manly powers abide.

verses.sa:
मा नो मर्ता अभि द्रुहन्तनूनामिन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
ईशानो यवया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma no marta abhi druhantanunamindra girvanah |
ishano yavaya vadham ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep
Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः ।
रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
yunjanti bradhnamarusham charantam pari tasthushah |
rochante rochana divi ||
verses.en:
They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed
The lights are shining in the sky.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे ।
शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
yunjantyasya kamya hari vipakshasa rathe |
shona dhrishnu nrivahasa ||
verses.en:
On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him,
Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

verses.sa:
केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे ।
समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥
verses.rom:
ketum krinvannaketave pesho marya apeshase |
samushadbhirajayathah ||
verses.en:
Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not,
Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sa:
आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे ।
दधाना नाम यज्ञियम् ॥
verses.rom:
adaha svadhamanu punargarbhatvamerire |
dadhana nama yajniyam ||
verses.en:
Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn,
Assuming sacrificial names.

verses.sa:
वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः ।
अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ॥
verses.rom:
vilu chidarujatnubhirguha chidindra vahnibhih |
avinda usriya anu ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm,
Foundest the kine even in the cave.

verses.sa:
देवयन्तो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद्वसुं गिरः ।
महामनूषत श्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
devayanto yatha matimachchha vidadvasum girah |
mahamanushata shrutam ||
verses.en:
Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth,
The far-renowned, the mighty One.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा ।
मन्दू समानवर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
indrena sam hi drikshase samjagmano abibhyusha |
mandu samanavarchasa ||
verses.en:
Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side:
Both joyous, equal in your sheen.

verses.sa:
अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति ।
गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः ॥
verses.rom:
anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhah sahasvadarchati |
ganairindrasya kamyaih ||
verses.en:
With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven,
The sacrificer cries aloud.

verses.sa:
अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि ।
समस्मिन्नृञ्जते गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
atah parijmanna gahi divo va rochanadadhi |
samasminnrinjate girah ||
verses.en:
Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven:
Our songs of praise all yearn for this.

verses.sa:
इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि ।
इन्द्रं महो वा रजसः ॥
verses.rom:
ito va satimimahe divo va parthivadadhi |
indram maho va rajasah ||
verses.en:
Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth,
Or from the spacious firmament.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः ।
इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
indramidgathino brihadindramarkebhirarkinah |
indram vaniranushata ||
verses.en:
INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds,
Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा ।
इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
indra iddharyoh sacha sammishla a vachoyuja |
indro vajri hiranyayah ||
verses.en:
Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car,
Indra the golden, thunder-armed.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि ।
वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥
verses.rom:
indro dirghaya chakshasa a suryam rohayaddivi |
vi gobhiradrimairayat ||
verses.en:
Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar:
He burst the mountain for the kine.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च ।
उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra vajeshu no'va sahasrapradhaneshu cha |
ugra ugrabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained,
With awful aids, O awful One.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे ।
युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
indram vayam mahadhana indramarbhe havamahe |
yujam vritreshu vajrinam ||
verses.en:
In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight,
The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

verses.sa:
स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि ।
अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vrishannamum charum satradavannapa vridhi |
asmabhyamapratishkutah ||
verses.en:
Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud,
For us, thou irresistible.

verses.sa:
तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः ।
न विन्धे अस्य सुष्टुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tunjetunje ya uttare stoma indrasya vajrinah |
na vindhe asya sushtutim ||
verses.en:
Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise:
I find no laud worthy of him.

verses.sa:
वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha yutheva vamsagah krishtiriyartyojasa |
ishano apratishkutah ||
verses.en:
Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might,
The Ruler irresistible:

verses.sa:
य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति ।
इन्द्रः पञ्च क्षितीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ekashcharshaninam vasunamirajyati |
indrah pancha kshitinam ||
verses.en:
Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race
Of those who dwell upon the earth.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः ।
अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
verses.rom:
indram vo vishvataspari havamahe janebhyah |
asmakamastu kevalah ||
verses.en:
For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men:
Ours, and none others', may he be.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम् ।
वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥
verses.rom:
endra sanasim rayim sajitvanam sadasaham |
varshishthamutaye bhara ||
verses.en:
INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth,
Most excellent, to be our aid;

verses.sa:
नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै ।
त्वोतासो न्यर्वता ॥
verses.rom:
ni yena mushtihatyaya ni vritra runadhamahai |
tvotaso nyarvata ||
verses.en:
By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand,
By thee assisted with the car.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि ।
जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
indra tvotasa a vayam vajram ghana dadimahi |
jayema sam yudhi spridhah ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt,
And conquer all our foes in fight.

verses.sa:
वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिन्द्र त्वया युजा वयम् ।
सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam shurebhirastribhirindra tvaya yuja vayam |
sasahyama pritanyatah ||
verses.en:
With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may
We conquer our embattled foes.

verses.sa:
महाँ इन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे ।
द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
verses.rom:
mahan indrah parashcha nu mahitvamastu vajrine |
dyaurna prathina shavah ||
verses.en:
Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer:
Wide as the heaven extends his power

verses.sa:
समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ ।
विप्रासो वा धियायवः ॥
verses.rom:
samohe va ya ashata narastokasya sanitau |
vipraso va dhiyayavah ||
verses.en:
Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight,
Or singers loving holy thoughts.

verses.sa:
यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते ।
उर्वीरापो न काकुदः ॥
verses.rom:
yah kukshih somapatamah samudra iva pinvate |
urvirapo na kakudah ||
verses.en:
His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells,
Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.

verses.sa:
एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही ।
पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
eva hyasya sunrita virapshi gomati mahi |
pakva shakha na dashushe ||
verses.en:
So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like
A ripe branch to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते ।
सद्यश्चित्सन्ति दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
eva hi te vibhutaya utaya indra mavate |
sadyashchitsanti dashushe ||
verses.en:
For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once
Unto a worshipper like me.

verses.sa:
एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या ।
इन्द्राय सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
eva hyasya kamya stoma uktham cha shamsya |
indraya somapitaye ||
verses.en:
So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung,
That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः ।
महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
indrehi matsyandhaso vishvebhih somaparvabhih |
mahan abhishtirojasa ||
verses.en:
COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts,
Protector, mighty in thy strength.

verses.sa:
एमेनं सृजता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने ।
चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये ॥
verses.rom:
emenam srijata sute mandimindraya mandine |
chakrim vishvani chakraye ||
verses.en:
To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him
The gladdening, omnific God.

verses.sa:
मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मन्दिभि स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे ।
सचैषु सवनेष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
matsva sushipra mandibhi stomebhirvishvacharshane |
sachaishu savaneshva ||
verses.en:
O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds,
Present at these drink-offerings.

verses.sa:
असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत ।
अजोषा वृषभं पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asrigramindra te girah prati tvamudahasata |
ajosha vrishabham patim ||
verses.en:
Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord,
And raised themselves unsatisfied.

verses.sa:
सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग्राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम् ।
असदित्ते विभु प्रभु ॥
verses.rom:
sam chodaya chitramarvagradha indra varenyam |
asaditte vibhu prabhu ||
verses.en:
Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of' our wish,
For power supreme is only thine.

verses.sa:
अस्मान्सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः ।
तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
asmansu tatra chodayendra raye rabhasvatah |
tuvidyumna yashasvatah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth,
And glorious, O most splendid One.

verses.sa:
सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत् ।
विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam gomadindra vajavadasme prithu shravo brihat |
vishvayurdhehyakshitam ||
verses.en:
Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength,
Lasting our life-time, failing not.

verses.sa:
अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमम् ।
इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
asme dhehi shravo brihaddyumnam sahasrasatamam |
indra ta rathinirishah ||
verses.en:
Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those
Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.

verses.sa:
वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणन्त ऋग्मियम् ।
होम गन्तारमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
vasorindram vasupatim girbhirgrinanta rigmiyam |
homa gantaramutaye ||
verses.en:
Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call
Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.

verses.sa:
सुतेसुते न्योकसे बृहद्बृहत एदरिः ।
इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति ॥
verses.rom:
sutesute nyokase brihadbrihata edarih |
indraya shushamarchati ||
verses.en:
To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man
Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.

verses.sa:
गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः ।
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
gayanti tva gayatrino'rchantyarkamarkinah |
brahmanastva shatakrata udvamshamiva yemire ||
verses.en:
THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee.
The priests have raised thee up on high, O Satakratu, like a pole.

verses.sa:
यत्सानोः सानुमारुहद्भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम् ।
तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥
verses.rom:
yatsanoh sanumaruhadbhuryaspashta kartvam |
tadindro artham chetati yuthena vrishnirejati ||
verses.en:
As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task,
Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा ।
अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hi keshina hari vrishana kakshyapra |
atha na indra somapa giramupashrutim chara ||
verses.en:
Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths,
And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.

verses.sa:
एहि स्तोमाँ अभि स्वराभि गृणीह्या रुव ।
ब्रह्म च नो वसो सचेन्द्र यज्ञं च वर्धय ॥
verses.rom:
ehi stoman abhi svarabhi grinihya ruva |
brahma cha no vaso sachendra yajnam cha vardhaya ||
verses.en:
Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud.
Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे ।
शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥
verses.rom:
ukthamindraya shamsyam vardhanam purunishshidhe |
shakro yatha suteshu no raranatsakhyeshu cha ||
verses.en:
To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives,
That Sakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.

verses.sa:
तमित्सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये ।
स शक्र उत नः शकदिन्द्रो वसु दयमानः ॥
verses.rom:
tamitsakhitva imahe tam raye tam suvirye |
sa shakra uta nah shakadindro vasu dayamanah ||
verses.en:
Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might.
For Indra, he is Sakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.

verses.sa:
सुविवृतं सुनिरजमिन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः ।
गवामप व्रजं वृधि कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
suvivritam sunirajamindra tvadatamidyashah |
gavamapa vrajam vridhi krinushva radho adrivah ||
verses.en:
Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee.
Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed

verses.sa:
नहि त्वा रोदसी उभे ऋघायमाणमिन्वतः ।
जेषः स्वर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि ॥
verses.rom:
nahi tva rodasi ubhe righayamanaminvatah |
jeshah svarvatirapah sam ga asmabhyam dhunuhi ||
verses.en:
The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood.
Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.

verses.sa:
आश्रुत्कर्ण श्रुधी हवं नू चिद्दधिष्व मे गिरः ।
इन्द्र स्तोममिमं मम कृष्वा युजश्चिदन्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashrutkarna shrudhi havam nu chiddadhishva me girah |
indra stomamimam mama krishva yujashchidantaram ||
verses.en:
Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs
O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि त्वा वृषन्तमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतम् ।
वृषन्तमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi tva vrishantamam vajeshu havanashrutam |
vrishantamasya humaha utim sahasrasatamam ||
verses.en:
We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry.
Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसानः सुतं पिब ।
नव्यमायुः प्र सू तिर कृधी सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra kaushika mandasanah sutam piba |
navyamayuh pra su tira kridhi sahasrasamrishim ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Son of Kusika, drink our libation with delight.
Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः ।
वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
pari tva girvano gira ima bhavantu vishvatah |
vriddhayumanu vriddhayo jushta bhavantu jushtayah ||
verses.en:
Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee:
Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः ।
रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
indram vishva avivridhansamudravyachasam girah |
rathitamam rathinam vajanam satpatim patim ||
verses.en:
ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea,
The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.

verses.sa:
सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते ।
त्वामभि प्र णोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakhye ta indra vajino ma bhema shavasaspate |
tvamabhi pra nonumo jetaramaparajitam ||
verses.en:
Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear.
We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः ।
यदी वाजस्य गोमत स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvirindrasya ratayo na vi dasyantyutayah |
yadi vajasya gomata stotribhyo mamhate magham ||
verses.en:
The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail,
When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.

verses.sa:
पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत ।
इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
puram bhinduryuva kaviramitauja ajayata |
indro vishvasya karmano dharta vajri purushtutah ||
verses.en:
Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born
Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.

verses.sa:
त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् ।
त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam valasya gomato'pavaradrivo bilam |
tvam deva abibhyushastujyamanasa avishuh ||
verses.en:
Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows.
The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,

verses.sa:
तवाहं शूर रातिभिः प्रत्यायं सिन्धुमावदन् ।
उपातिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो विदुष्टे तस्य कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
tavaham shura ratibhih pratyayam sindhumavadan |
upatishthanta girvano vidushte tasya karavah ||
verses.en:
I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee.
Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.

verses.sa:
मायाभिरिन्द्र मायिनं त्वं शुष्णमवातिरः ।
विदुष्टे तस्य मेधिरास्तेषां श्रवांस्युत्तिर ॥
verses.rom:
mayabhirindra mayinam tvam shushnamavatirah |
vidushte tasya medhirastesham shravamsyuttira ||
verses.en:
The wily Susna, Indra! thou o'er-threwest with thy wondrous powers.
The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमा अनूषत ।
सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ॥
verses.rom:
indramishanamojasabhi stoma anushata |
sahasram yasya rataya uta va santi bhuyasih ||
verses.en:
Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might,
Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dutam vrinimahe hotaram vishvavedasam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en:
WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth,
Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् ।
हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnimagnim havimabhih sada havanta vishpatim |
havyavaham purupriyam ||
verses.en:
With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House,
Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

verses.sa:
अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे ।
असि होता न ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agne devan iha vaha jajnano vriktabarhishe |
asi hota na idyah ||
verses.en:
Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass:
Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

verses.sa:
ताँ उशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् ।
देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
tan ushato vi bodhaya yadagne yasi dutyam |
devaira satsi barhishi ||
verses.en:
Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage:
Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.

verses.sa:
घृताहवन दीदिवः प्रति ष्म रिषतो दह ।
अग्ने त्वं रक्षस्विनः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritahavana didivah prati shma rishato daha |
agne tvam rakshasvinah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up
Our enemies whom fiends protect.

verses.sa:
अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ।
हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agninagnih samidhyate kavirgrihapatiryuva |
havyavadjuhvasyah ||
verses.en:
By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears
The gift: the ladle is his mouth.

verses.sa:
कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे ।
देवममीवचातनम् ॥
verses.rom:
kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmanamadhvare |
devamamivachatanam ||
verses.en:
Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true,
The God who driveth grief away.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति ।
तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
yastvamagne havishpatirdutam deva saparyati |
tasya sma pravita bhava ||
verses.en:
God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts,
Worshippeth thee the messenger.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति ।
तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnim devavitaye havishman avivasati |
tasmai pavaka mrilaya ||
verses.en:
Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods,
O Purifier, favour him.

verses.sa:
स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ इहा वह ।
उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pavaka didivo'gne devan iha vaha |
upa yajnam havishcha nah ||
verses.en:
Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice,
To our oblation bring the Gods.

verses.sa:
स न स्तवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा ।
रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa na stavana a bhara gayatrena naviyasa |
rayim viravatimisham ||
verses.en:
So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us,
And food, with heroes for our sons.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः ।
इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व नः ॥
verses.rom:
agne shukrena shochisha vishvabhirdevahutibhih |
imam stomam jushasva nah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods,
Show pleasure in this laud of ours.

verses.sa:
सुसमिद्धो न आ वह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते ।
होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
susamiddho na a vaha devan agne havishmate |
hotah pavaka yakshi cha ||
verses.en:
AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts.
Worship them, Purifier, Priest.

verses.sa:
मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे ।
अद्या कृणुहि वीतये ॥
verses.rom:
madhumantam tanunapadyajnam deveshu nah kave |
adya krinuhi vitaye ||
verses.en:
Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today.
Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.

verses.sa:
नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये ।
मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsamiha priyamasminyajna upa hvaye |
madhujihvam havishkritam ||
verses.en:
Dear Narasamsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I
Invoke to this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईळित आ वह ।
असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥
verses.rom:
agne sukhatame rathe devan ilita a vaha |
asi hota manurhitah ||
verses.en:
Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods:
Manu appointed thee as Priest.

verses.sa:
स्तृणीत बर्हिरानुषग्घृतपृष्ठं मनीषिणः ।
यत्रामृतस्य चक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
strinita barhiranushagghritaprishtham manishinah |
yatramritasya chakshanam ||
verses.en:
Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due,
Where the Immortal is beheld.

verses.sa:
वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः ।
अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे ॥
verses.rom:
vi shrayantamritavridho dvaro devirasashchatah |
adya nunam cha yashtave ||
verses.en:
Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite,
For sacrifice this day and now.

verses.sa:
नक्तोषासा सुपेशसास्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये ।
इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
naktoshasa supeshasasminyajna upa hvaye |
idam no barhirasade ||
verses.en:
I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass
At this our solemn sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ता सुजिह्वा उप ह्वये होतारा दैव्या कवी ।
यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta sujihva upa hvaye hotara daivya kavi |
yajnam no yakshatamimam ||
verses.en:
The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue,
To celebrate this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः ।
बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
ila sarasvati mahi tisro devirmayobhuvah |
barhih sidantvasridhah ||
verses.en:
Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring delight,
Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.

verses.sa:
इह त्वष्टारमग्रियं विश्वरूपमुप ह्वये ।
अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
verses.rom:
iha tvashtaramagriyam vishvarupamupa hvaye |
asmakamastu kevalah ||
verses.en:
Tvastar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will:
May he be ours and curs alone.

verses.sa:
अव सृजा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः ।
प्र दातुरस्तु चेतनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ava srija vanaspate deva devebhyo havih |
pra daturastu chetanam ||
verses.en:
God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods,
And let the giver be renowned.

verses.sa:
स्वाहा यज्ञं कृणोतनेन्द्राय यज्वनो गृहे ।
तत्र देवाँ उप ह्वये ॥
verses.rom:
svaha yajnam krinotanendraya yajvano grihe |
tatra devan upa hvaye ||
verses.en:
With Svaha pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house:
Thither I call the Deities.

verses.sa:
ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ।
देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
aibhiragne duvo giro vishvebhih somapitaye |
devebhiryahi yakshi cha ||
verses.en:
To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs.
With all these Gods; and worship them.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणन्ति विप्र ते धियः ।
देवेभिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
a tva kanva ahushata grinanti vipra te dhiyah |
devebhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
The Kanvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise
Agni, come hither with the Gods;

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम् ।
आदित्यान्मारुतं गणम् ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu brihaspatim mitragnim pushanam bhagam |
adityanmarutam ganam ||
verses.en:
Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pusan, Bhaga,
Adityas, and the Marut host.

verses.sa:
प्र वो भ्रियन्त इन्दवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः ।
द्रप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo bhriyanta indavo matsara madayishnavah |
drapsa madhvashchamushadah ||
verses.en:
For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate,
The meath-drops resting in the cup.

verses.sa:
ईळते त्वामवस्यवः कण्वासो वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः ॥
verses.rom:
ilate tvamavasyavah kanvaso vriktabarhishah |
havishmanto aramkritah ||
verses.en:
The sons of Kanva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass,
With offerings and all things prepared.

verses.sa:
घृतपृष्ठा मनोयुजो ये त्वा वहन्ति वह्नयः ।
आ देवान्सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ghritaprishtha manoyujo ye tva vahanti vahnayah |
a devansomapitaye ||
verses.en:
Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil,
Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.

verses.sa:
तान्यजत्राँ ऋतावृधोऽग्ने पत्नीवतस्कृधि ।
मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय ॥
verses.rom:
tanyajatran ritavridho'gne patnivataskridhi |
madhvah sujihva payaya ||
verses.en:
Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames:
Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.

verses.sa:
ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास्ते ते पिबन्तु जिह्वया ।
मधोरग्ने वषट्कृति ॥
verses.rom:
ye yajatra ya idyaste te pibantu jihvaya |
madhoragne vashatkriti ||
verses.en:
Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue
The meath in solemn sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद्विश्वान्देवाँ उषर्बुधः ।
विप्रो होतेह वक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
akim suryasya rochanadvishvandevan usharbudhah |
vipro hoteha vakshati ||
verses.en:
Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring
All Gods awaking with the dawn.

verses.sa:
विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना ।
पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvebhih somyam madhvagna indrena vayuna |
piba mitrasya dhamabhih ||
verses.en:
With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vayu, and Mitra's splendours, drink,
Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्वं होता मनुर्हितोऽग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि ।
सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hota manurhito'gne yajneshu sidasi |
semam no adhvaram yaja ||
verses.en:
Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite:
Hallow thou this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा ह्यरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः ।
ताभिर्देवाँ इहा वह ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hyarushi rathe harito deva rohitah |
tabhirdevan iha vaha ||
verses.en:
Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones:
With those bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सोमं पिब ऋतुना त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः ।
मत्सरासस्तदोकसः ॥
verses.rom:
indra somam piba rituna tva vishantvindavah |
matsarasastadokasah ||
verses.en:
O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Rtu; let the cheering drops
Sink deep within, which settle there.

verses.sa:
मरुतः पिबत ऋतुना पोत्राद्यज्ञं पुनीतन ।
यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
marutah pibata rituna potradyajnam punitana |
yuyam hi shtha sudanavah ||
verses.en:
Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Rtu; sanctify
The rite, for ye give precious gifts.

verses.sa:
अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना ।
त्वं हि रत्नधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi yajnam grinihi no gnavo neshtah piba rituna |
tvam hi ratnadha asi ||
verses.en:
O Nestar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Rtu drink,
For thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह सादया योनिषु त्रिषु ।
परि भूष पिब ऋतुना ॥
verses.rom:
agne devan iha vaha sadaya yonishu trishu |
pari bhusha piba rituna ||
verses.en:
Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down:
Surround them, and with Rtu drink.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु ।
तवेद्धि सख्यमस्तृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanadindra radhasah piba somamritunranu |
taveddhi sakhyamastritam ||
verses.en:
Drink Soma after the Rtus, from the Brahmana's bounty: undissolved,
O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.

verses.sa:
युवं दक्षं धृतव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभम् ।
ऋतुना यज्ञमाशाथे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam daksham dhritavrata mitravaruna dulabham |
rituna yajnamashathe ||
verses.en:
Mitra, Varuna, ye whose ways are firm--a Power that none deceives--,
With Rtu ye have reached the rite.

verses.sa:
द्रविणोदा द्रविणसो ग्रावहस्तासो अध्वरे ।
यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
verses.rom:
dravinoda dravinaso gravahastaso adhvare |
yajneshu devamilate ||
verses.en:
The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite,
In sacrifices praise the God.

verses.sa:
द्रविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शृण्विरे ।
देवेषु ता वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
dravinoda dadatu no vasuni yani shrinvire |
deveshu ta vanamahe ||
verses.en:
May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned.
These things we gain, among the Gods.

verses.sa:
द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत ।
नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत ॥
verses.rom:
dravinodah pipishati juhota pra cha tishthata |
neshtradritubhirishyata ||
verses.en:
He with the Rtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Nestar's bowl.
Haste, give your offering, and depart.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा तुरीयमृतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे ।
अध स्मा नो ददिर्भव ॥
verses.rom:
yattva turiyamritubhirdravinodo yajamahe |
adha sma no dadirbhava ||
verses.en:
As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Rtus, be
A Giver bountiful to us.

verses.sa:
अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता ।
ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina pibatam madhu didyagni shuchivrata |
rituna yajnavahasa ||
verses.en:
Drink ye the meath, O Asvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with
Rtus accept the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
गार्हपत्येन सन्त्य ऋतुना यज्ञनीरसि ।
देवान्देवयते यज ॥
verses.rom:
garhapatyena santya rituna yajnanirasi |
devandevayate yaja ||
verses.en:
With Rtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice:
Worship the Gods for the pious man.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वृषणं सोमपीतये ।
इन्द्र त्वा सूरचक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vahantu harayo vrishanam somapitaye |
indra tva surachakshasah ||
verses.en:
LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught--
Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.

verses.sa:
इमा धाना घृतस्नुवो हरी इहोप वक्षतः ।
इन्द्रं सुखतमे रथे ॥
verses.rom:
ima dhana ghritasnuvo hari ihopa vakshatah |
indram sukhatame rathe ||
verses.en:
Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring
Indra upon his easiest car.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं प्रातर्हवामह इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
indram pratarhavamaha indram prayatyadhvare |
indram somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice,
Indra to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिन्द्र केशिभिः ।
सुते हि त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah sutama gahi haribhirindra keshibhih |
sute hi tva havamahe ||
verses.en:
Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to the draught we pour
We call thee when the juice is shed.

verses.sa:
सेमं न स्तोममा गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतम् ।
गौरो न तृषितः पिब ॥
verses.rom:
semam na stomama gahyupedam savanam sutam |
gauro na trishitah piba ||
verses.en:
Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee
Drink of it like a stag athirst.

verses.sa:
इमे सोमास इन्दवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि ।
ताँ इन्द्र सहसे पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ime somasa indavah sutaso adhi barhishi |
tan indra sahase piba ||
verses.en:
Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof
Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.

verses.sa:
अयं ते स्तोमो अग्रियो हृदिस्पृगस्तु शंतमः ।
अथा सोमं सुतं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te stomo agriyo hridisprigastu shamtamah |
atha somam sutam piba ||
verses.en:
Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent:
Then drink the Soma juice expressed.

verses.sa:
विश्वमित्सवनं सुतमिन्द्रो मदाय गच्छति ।
वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vishvamitsavanam sutamindro madaya gachchhati |
vritraha somapitaye ||
verses.en:
To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, comes,
To drink the Soma for delight.

verses.sa:
सेमं नः काममा पृण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो ।
स्तवाम त्वा स्वाध्यः ॥
verses.rom:
semam nah kamama prina gobhirashvaih shatakrato |
stavama tva svadhyah ||
verses.en:
Fulfil, O Satakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine:
With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वृणे ।
ता नो मृळात ईदृशे ॥
verses.rom:
indravarunayoraham samrajorava a vrine |
ta no mrilata idrishe ||
verses.en:
I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuna; may they
Both favour one of us like me.

verses.sa:
गन्तारा हि स्थोऽवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः ।
धर्तारा चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
gantara hi stho'vase havam viprasya mavatah |
dhartara charshaninam ||
verses.en:
Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call
Of every singer such as I.

verses.sa:
अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिन्द्रावरुण राय आ ।
ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
anukamam tarpayethamindravaruna raya a |
ta vam nedishthamimahe ||
verses.en:
Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuna, with wealth:
Fain would we have you nearest us.

verses.sa:
युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनाम् ।
भूयाम वाजदाव्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvaku hi shachinam yuvaku sumatinam |
bhuyama vajadavnam ||
verses.en:
May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence
Of you who give strength bounteously.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सहस्रदाव्नां वरुणः शंस्यानाम् ।
क्रतुर्भवत्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sahasradavnam varunah shamsyanam |
kraturbhavatyukthyah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Varuna, among givers of thousands, meet for praise,
Are Powers who merit highest laud.

verses.sa:
तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि ।
स्यादुत प्ररेचनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tayoridavasa vayam sanema ni cha dhimahi |
syaduta prarechanam ||
verses.en:
Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up
Enough and still to spare, be ours.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे ।
अस्मान्सु जिग्युषस्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indravaruna vamaham huve chitraya radhase |
asmansu jigyushaskritam ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Varuna, on you for wealth in many a form I call:
Still keep ye us victorious.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुण नू नु वां सिषासन्तीषु धीष्वा ।
अस्मभ्यं शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indravaruna nu nu vam sishasantishu dhishva |
asmabhyam sharma yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Varuna, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves,
Give us at once your sheltering help.

verses.sa:
प्र वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिन्द्रावरुण यां हुवे ।
यामृधाथे सधस्तुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vamashnotu sushtutirindravaruna yam huve |
yamridhathe sadhastutim ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Varuna, to you may fair praise which I offer come,
Joint eulogy which ye dignify.

verses.sa:
सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते ।
कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥
verses.rom:
somanam svaranam krinuhi brahmanaspate |
kakshivantam ya aushijah ||
verses.en:
O BRAHMANAPSATI, make him who presses Soma glorious,
Even Kaksivan Ausija.

verses.sa:
यो रेवान्यो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः ।
स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः ॥
verses.rom:
yo revanyo amivaha vasuvitpushtivardhanah |
sa nah sishaktu yasturah ||
verses.en:
The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store,
The prompt,--may he be with us still.

verses.sa:
मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य ।
रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah shamso ararusho dhurtih prananmartyasya |
raksha no brahmanaspate ||
verses.en:
Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us
Preserve us, Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha viro na rishyati yamindro brahmanaspatih |
somo hinoti martyam ||
verses.en:
Ne'er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmanaspati,
And Soma graciously inspire.

verses.sa:
त्वं तं ब्रह्मणस्पते सोम इन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् ।
दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tam brahmanaspate soma indrashcha martyam |
dakshina patvamhasah ||
verses.en:
Do, thou, O Brahmanaspati, and Indra, Soma, Daksina,
Preserve that mortal from distress.

verses.sa:
सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् ।
सनिं मेधामयासिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
sadasaspatimadbhutam priyamindrasya kamyam |
sanim medhamayasisham ||
verses.en:
To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives
Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.

verses.sa:
यस्मादृते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन ।
स धीनां योगमिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadrite na sidhyati yajno vipashchitashchana |
sa dhinam yogaminvati ||
verses.en:
He without whom no sacrifice, e'en of the wise man, prospers; he
Stirs up the series of thoughts.

verses.sa:
आदृध्नोति हविष्कृतिं प्राञ्चं कृणोत्यध्वरम् ।
होत्रा देवेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
adridhnoti havishkritim prancham krinotyadhvaram |
hotra deveshu gachchhati ||
verses.en:
He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice:
Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.

verses.sa:
नराशंसं सुधृष्टममपश्यं सप्रथस्तमम् ।
दिवो न सद्ममखसम् ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsam sudhrishtamamapashyam saprathastamam |
divo na sadmamakhasam ||
verses.en:
I have seen Narasamsa, him most resolute, most widely famed,
As 'twere the Household Priest of heaven.

verses.sa:
प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
prati tyam charumadhvaram gopithaya pra huyase |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked:
O Agni, with the Maruts come.

verses.sa:
नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव क्रतुं परः ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
nahi devo na martyo mahastava kratum parah |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one:
O Agni, with the Maruts come:

verses.sa:
ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ye maho rajaso vidurvishve devaso adruhah |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air:
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
य उग्रा अर्कमानृचुरनाधृष्टास ओजसा ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugra arkamanrichuranadhrishtasa ojasa |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might:
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ye shubhra ghoravarpasah sukshatraso rishadasah |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes':
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ye nakasyadhi rochane divi devasa asate |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere:
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
य ईङ्खयन्ति पर्वतान्तिरः समुद्रमर्णवम् ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ya inkhayanti parvatantirah samudramarnavam |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea:
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस्तिरः समुद्रमोजसा ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
a ye tanvanti rashmibhistirah samudramojasa |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might
O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva purvapitaye srijami somyam madhu |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en:
For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath:
O Agni, with the Maruts come.

verses.sa:
अयं देवाय जन्मने स्तोमो विप्रेभिरासया ।
अकारि रत्नधातमः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam devaya janmane stomo viprebhirasaya |
akari ratnadhatamah ||
verses.en:
FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly
Was made by singers with their lips.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी ।
शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
ya indraya vachoyuja tatakshurmanasa hari |
shamibhiryajnamashata ||
verses.en:
They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word,
Attained by works to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तक्षन्नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथम् ।
तक्षन्धेनुं सबर्दुघाम् ॥
verses.rom:
takshannasatyabhyam parijmanam sukham ratham |
takshandhenum sabardugham ||
verses.en:
They for the two Nasatyas wrought a light car moving every way:
They formed a nectar-yielding cow.

verses.sa:
युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमन्त्रा ऋजूयवः ।
ऋभवो विष्ट्यक्रत ॥
verses.rom:
yuvana pitara punah satyamantra rijuyavah |
ribhavo vishtyakrata ||
verses.en:
The Rbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made
Their Sire and Mother young again.

verses.sa:
सं वो मदासो अग्मतेन्द्रेण च मरुत्वता ।
आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam vo madaso agmatendrena cha marutvata |
adityebhishcha rajabhih ||
verses.en:
Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt,
With the Adityas, with the Kings.

verses.sa:
उत त्यं चमसं नवं त्वष्टुर्देवस्य निष्कृतम् ।
अकर्त चतुरः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tyam chamasam navam tvashturdevasya nishkritam |
akarta chaturah punah ||
verses.en:
The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvastar's hand--
Four ladles have ye made thereof.

verses.sa:
ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन त्रिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते ।
एकमेकं सुशस्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
te no ratnani dhattana trira saptani sunvate |
ekamekam sushastibhih ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each
Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.

verses.sa:
अधारयन्त वह्नयोऽभजन्त सुकृत्यया ।
भागं देवेषु यज्ञियम् ॥
verses.rom:
adharayanta vahnayo'bhajanta sukrityaya |
bhagam deveshu yajniyam ||
verses.en:
As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves,
A share in sacrifice with Gods.

verses.sa:
इहेन्द्राग्नी उप ह्वये तयोरित्स्तोममुश्मसि ।
ता सोमं सोमपातमा ॥
verses.rom:
ihendragni upa hvaye tayoritstomamushmasi |
ta somam somapatama ||
verses.en:
INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise:
Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.

verses.sa:
ता यज्ञेषु प्र शंसतेन्द्राग्नी शुम्भता नरः ।
ता गायत्रेषु गायत ॥
verses.rom:
ta yajneshu pra shamsatendragni shumbhata narah |
ta gayatreshu gayata ||
verses.en:
Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites:
Sing praise to them in sacred songs.

verses.sa:
ता मित्रस्य प्रशस्तय इन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे ।
सोमपा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ta mitrasya prashastaya indragni ta havamahe |
somapa somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame
Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa:
उग्रा सन्ता हवामह उपेदं सवनं सुतम् ।
इन्द्राग्नी एह गच्छताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ugra santa havamaha upedam savanam sutam |
indragni eha gachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here:
Indra and Agni, come to us.

verses.sa:
ता महान्ता सदस्पती इन्द्राग्नी रक्ष उब्जतम् ।
अप्रजाः सन्त्वत्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
ta mahanta sadaspati indragni raksha ubjatam |
aprajah santvatrinah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends:
Childless be the devouring ones.

verses.sa:
तेन सत्येन जागृतमधि प्रचेतुने पदे ।
इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tena satyena jagritamadhi prachetune pade |
indragni sharma yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view
Indra and Agni, send us bliss.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्युजा वि बोधयाश्विनावेह गच्छताम् ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
prataryuja vi bodhayashvinaveha gachchhatam |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
WAKEN the Asvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they
Approach to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa:
या सुरथा रथीतमोभा देवा दिविस्पृशा ।
अश्विना ता हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya suratha rathitamobha deva divisprisha |
ashvina ta havamahe ||
verses.en:
We call the Asvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best
Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.

verses.sa:
या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सूनृतावती ।
तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya vam kasha madhumatyashvina sunritavati |
taya yajnam mimikshatam ||
verses.en:
Dropping with honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness
Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नहि वामस्ति दूरके यत्रा रथेन गच्छथः ।
अश्विना सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi vamasti durake yatra rathena gachchhathah |
ashvina somino griham ||
verses.en:
As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Asvins, is the home
Of him who offers Soma juice.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुप ह्वये ।
स चेत्ता देवता पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyapanimutaye savitaramupa hvaye |
sa chetta devata padam ||
verses.en:
For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar.
He knoweth, as a God, the place.

verses.sa:
अपां नपातमवसे सवितारमुप स्तुहि ।
तस्य व्रतान्युश्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
apam napatamavase savitaramupa stuhi |
tasya vratanyushmasi ||
verses.en:
That he may send us succour, praise the Waters' Offspring Savitar:
Fain are we for his holy ways.

verses.sa:
विभक्तारं हवामहे वसोश्चित्रस्य राधसः ।
सवितारं नृचक्षसम् ॥
verses.rom:
vibhaktaram havamahe vasoshchitrasya radhasah |
savitaram nrichakshasam ||
verses.en:
We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth,
On Savitar who looks on men.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ नि षीदत सविता स्तोम्यो नु नः ।
दाता राधांसि शुम्भति ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a ni shidata savita stomyo nu nah |
data radhamsi shumbhati ||
verses.en:
Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us,
Giving good gifts, is beautiful.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पत्नीरिहा वह देवानामुशतीरुप ।
त्वष्टारं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
agne patniriha vaha devanamushatirupa |
tvashtaram somapitaye ||
verses.en:
O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods,
And Tvastar, to the Soma draught.

verses.sa:
आ ग्ना अग्न इहावसे होत्रां यविष्ठ भारतीम् ।
वरूत्रीं धिषणां वह ॥
verses.rom:
a gna agna ihavase hotram yavishtha bharatim |
varutrim dhishanam vaha ||
verses.en:
Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotra, Bharati,
Varutri, Dhisana, for aid.

verses.sa:
अभि नो देवीरवसा महः शर्मणा नृपत्नीः ।
अच्छिन्नपत्राः सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no deviravasa mahah sharmana nripatnih |
achchhinnapatrah sachantam ||
verses.en:
Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us
With great protection and with aid.

verses.sa:
इहेन्द्राणीमुप ह्वये वरुणानीं स्वस्तये ।
अग्नायीं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ihendranimupa hvaye varunanim svastaye |
agnayim somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Indrani, Varunani, and Agnayi hither I invite,
For weal, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम् ।
पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi dyauh prithivi cha na imam yajnam mimikshatam |
pipritam no bharimabhih ||
verses.en:
May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice,
And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sa:
तयोरिद्घृतवत्पयो विप्रा रिहन्ति धीतिभिः ।
गन्धर्वस्य ध्रुवे पदे ॥
verses.rom:
tayoridghritavatpayo vipra rihanti dhitibhih |
gandharvasya dhruve pade ||
verses.en:
Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place,
The singers taste through sacred songs.

verses.sa:
स्योना पृथिवि भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी ।
यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
syona prithivi bhavanrikshara niveshani |
yachchha nah sharma saprathah ||
verses.en:
Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place:
Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.

verses.sa:
अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे ।
पृथिव्याः सप्त धामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ato deva avantu no yato vishnurvichakrame |
prithivyah sapta dhamabhih ||
verses.en:
The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Visnu strode
Through the seven regions of the earth!

verses.sa:
इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् ।
समूळ्हमस्य पांसुरे ॥
verses.rom:
idam vishnurvi chakrame tredha ni dadhe padam |
samulhamasya pamsure ||
verses.en:
Through all this world strode Visnu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole
Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः ।
अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥
verses.rom:
trini pada vi chakrame vishnurgopa adabhyah |
ato dharmani dharayan ||
verses.en:
Visnu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth
Establishing his high decrees.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे ।
इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh karmani pashyata yato vratani paspashe |
indrasya yujyah sakha ||
verses.en:
Look ye on Visnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied,
Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sa:
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः ।
दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvishnoh paramam padam sada pashyanti surayah |
diviva chakshuratatam ||
verses.en:
The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Visnu is,
Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

verses.sa:
तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते ।
विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvipraso vipanyavo jagrivamsah samindhate |
vishnoryatparamam padam ||
verses.en:
This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant,
Lovers of holy song, light up.

verses.sa:
तीव्राः सोमास आ गह्याशीर्वन्तः सुता इमे ।
वायो तान्प्रस्थितान्पिब ॥
verses.rom:
tivrah somasa a gahyashirvantah suta ime |
vayo tanprasthitanpiba ||
verses.en:
STRONG are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk:
Drink, Vayu, the presented draughts.

verses.sa:
उभा देवा दिविस्पृशेन्द्रवायू हवामहे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ubha deva divisprishendravayu havamahe |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vayu we invoke
To drink of this our soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू मनोजुवा विप्रा हवन्त ऊतये ।
सहस्राक्षा धियस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu manojuva vipra havanta utaye |
sahasraksha dhiyaspati ||
verses.en:
The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vayu, swift as mind,
The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.

verses.sa:
मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये ।
जज्ञाना पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
mitram vayam havamahe varunam somapitaye |
jajnana putadakshasa ||
verses.en:
Mitra and Varuna, renowned as Gods of consecrated might,
We call to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती ।
ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ritena yavritavridhavritasya jyotishaspati |
ta mitravaruna huve ||
verses.en:
Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law,
Mitra I call, and Varuna.

verses.sa:
वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
करतां नः सुराधसः ॥
verses.rom:
varunah pravita bhuvanmitro vishvabhirutibhih |
karatam nah suradhasah ||
verses.en:
Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids
Both make us rich exceedingly.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वन्तं हवामह इन्द्रमा सोमपीतये ।
सजूर्गणेन तृम्पतु ॥
verses.rom:
marutvantam havamaha indrama somapitaye |
sajurganena trimpatu ||
verses.en:
Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he
Sate him in union with his troop.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः ।
विश्वे मम श्रुता हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrajyeshtha marudgana devasah pusharatayah |
vishve mama shruta havam ||
verses.en:
Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pusan's gifts,
Hearken ye all unto my cry.

verses.sa:
हत वृत्रं सुदानव इन्द्रेण सहसा युजा ।
मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ॥
verses.rom:
hata vritram sudanava indrena sahasa yuja |
ma no duhshamsa ishata ||
verses.en:
With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vrtra down, ye bounteous Gods
Let not the wicked master us.

verses.sa:
विश्वान्देवान्हवामहे मरुतः सोमपीतये ।
उग्रा हि पृश्निमातरः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvandevanhavamahe marutah somapitaye |
ugra hi prishnimatarah ||
verses.en:
We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught,
For passing strong are Prsni's Sons.

verses.sa:
जयतामिव तन्यतुर्मरुतामेति धृष्णुया ।
यच्छुभं याथना नरः ॥
verses.rom:
jayatamiva tanyaturmarutameti dhrishnuya |
yachchhubham yathana narah ||
verses.en:
Fierce comes the Maruts' thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go
Forward to victory, O Men.

verses.sa:
हस्काराद्विद्युतस्पर्यतो जाता अवन्तु नः ।
मरुतो मृळयन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
haskaradvidyutasparyato jata avantu nah |
maruto mrilayantu nah ||
verses.en:
Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere
May they be gracious unto Us.

verses.sa:
आ पूषञ्चित्रबर्हिषमाघृणे धरुणं दिवः ।
आजा नष्टं यथा पशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pushanchitrabarhishamaghrine dharunam divah |
aja nashtam yatha pashum ||
verses.en:
Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pusan, him who bears up heaven,
Resting on many-coloured grass.

verses.sa:
पूषा राजानमाघृणिरपगूळ्हं गुहा हितम् ।
अविन्दच्चित्रबर्हिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
pusha rajanamaghrinirapagulham guha hitam |
avindachchitrabarhisham ||
verses.en:
Pusan the Bright has found the King, concealed and hidden in a cave,
Who rests on grass of many hues.

verses.sa:
उतो स मह्यमिन्दुभिः षड्युक्ताँ अनुसेषिधत् ।
गोभिर्यवं न चर्कृषत् ॥
verses.rom:
uto sa mahyamindubhih shadyuktan anuseshidhat |
gobhiryavam na charkrishat ||
verses.en:
And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops,
As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.

verses.sa:
अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम् ।
पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः ॥
verses.rom:
ambayo yantyadhvabhirjamayo adhvariyatam |
princhatirmadhuna payah ||
verses.en:
Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants,
Mingling their sweetness with the milk.

verses.sa:
अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह ।
ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
amurya upa surye yabhirva suryah saha |
ta no hinvantvadhvaram ||
verses.en:
May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined,
Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.

verses.sa:
अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः ।
सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
apo devirupa hvaye yatra gavah pibanti nah |
sindhubhyah kartvam havih ||
verses.en:
I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst;
Oblations to the Streams be given.

verses.sa:
अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमपामुत प्रशस्तये ।
देवा भवत वाजिनः ॥
verses.rom:
apsvantaramritamapsu bheshajamapamuta prashastaye |
deva bhavata vajinah ||
verses.en:
Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm
Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.

verses.sa:
अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा ।
अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवमापश्च विश्वभेषजीः ॥
verses.rom:
apsu me somo abravidantarvishvani bheshaja |
agnim cha vishvashambhuvamapashcha vishvabheshajih ||
verses.en:
Within the Waters--Soma thus hath told me--dwell all balms that heal,
And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.

verses.sa:
आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम ।
ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
apah prinita bheshajam varutham tanve mama |
jyokcha suryam drishe ||
verses.en:
O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm,
So that I long may see the Sun.

verses.sa:
इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि ।
यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
idamapah pra vahata yatkim cha duritam mayi |
yadvahamabhidudroha yadva shepa utanritam ||
verses.en:
Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought.
If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

verses.sa:
आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि ।
पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
apo adyanvacharisham rasena samagasmahi |
payasvanagna a gahi tam ma sam srija varchasa ||
verses.en:
The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come:
O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

verses.sa:
सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा ।
विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात्सह ऋषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam magne varchasa srija sam prajaya samayusha |
vidyurme asya deva indro vidyatsaha rishibhih ||
verses.en:
Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods
Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the Rsis, know.

verses.sa:
कस्य नूनं कतमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम ।
को नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
verses.rom:
kasya nunam katamasyamritanam manamahe charu devasya nama |
ko no mahya aditaye punardatpitaram cha drisheyam mataram cha ||
verses.en:
WHO now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us?
Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वयं प्रथमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम ।
स नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
verses.rom:
agnervayam prathamasyamritanam manamahe charu devasya nama |
sa no mahya aditaye punardatpitaram cha drisheyam mataram cha ||
verses.en:
Agni the God the first among the Immortals,--of his auspicious name let us bethink us.
He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा देव सवितरीशानं वार्याणाम् ।
सदावन्भागमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva deva savitarishanam varyanam |
sadavanbhagamimahe ||
verses.en:
To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us
Continually, for our share we come-

verses.sa:
यश्चिद्धि त इत्था भगः शशमानः पुरा निदः ।
अद्वेषो हस्तयोर्दधे ॥
verses.rom:
yashchiddhi ta ittha bhagah shashamanah pura nidah |
advesho hastayordadhe ||
verses.en:
Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid,
Free from all hatred, in thy hands

verses.sa:
भगभक्तस्य ते वयमुदशेम तवावसा ।
मूर्धानं राय आरभे ॥
verses.rom:
bhagabhaktasya te vayamudashema tavavasa |
murdhanam raya arabhe ||
verses.en:
Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence
Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.

verses.sa:
नहि ते क्षत्रं न सहो न मन्युं वयश्चनामी पतयन्त आपुः ।
नेमा आपो अनिमिषं चरन्तीर्न ये वातस्य प्रमिनन्त्यभ्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi te kshatram na saho na manyum vayashchanami patayanta apuh |
nema apo animisham charantirna ye vatasya praminantyabhvam ||
verses.en:
Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit;
Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.

verses.sa:
अबुध्ने राजा वरुणो वनस्योर्ध्वं स्तूपं ददते पूतदक्षः ।
नीचीना स्थुरुपरि बुध्न एषामस्मे अन्तर्निहिताः केतवः स्युः ॥
verses.rom:
abudhne raja varuno vanasyordhvam stupam dadate putadakshah |
nichina sthurupari budhna eshamasme antarnihitah ketavah syuh ||
verses.en:
Varuna, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region.
Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.

verses.sa:
उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ ।
अपदे पादा प्रतिधातवेऽकरुतापवक्ता हृदयाविधश्चित् ॥
verses.rom:
urum hi raja varunashchakara suryaya panthamanvetava u |
apade pada pratidhatave'karutapavakta hridayavidhashchit ||
verses.en:
King Varuna hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel.
Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit.

verses.sa:
शतं ते राजन्भिषजः सहस्रमुर्वी गभीरा सुमतिष्टे अस्तु ।
बाधस्व दूरे निरृतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam te rajanbhishajah sahasramurvi gabhira sumatishte astu |
badhasva dure nirritim parachaih kritam chidenah pra mumugdhyasmat ||
verses.en:
A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours.
Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e'en the sin we have committed.

verses.sa:
अमी य ऋक्षा निहितास उच्चा नक्तं ददृश्रे कुह चिद्दिवेयुः ।
अदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्तमेति ॥
verses.rom:
ami ya riksha nihitasa uchcha naktam dadrishre kuha chiddiveyuh |
adabdhani varunasya vratani vichakashachchandrama naktameti ||
verses.en:
Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us?
Varuna's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor

verses.sa:
तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः ।
अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः ॥
verses.rom:
tattva yami brahmana vandamanastada shaste yajamano havirbhih |
ahelamano varuneha bodhyurushamsa ma na ayuh pra moshih ||
verses.en:
I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation.
Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

verses.sa:
तदिन्नक्तं तद्दिवा मह्यमाहुस्तदयं केतो हृद आ वि चष्टे ।
शुनःशेपो यमह्वद्गृभीतः सो अस्मान्राजा वरुणो मुमोक्तु ॥
verses.rom:
tadinnaktam taddiva mahyamahustadayam keto hrida a vi chashte |
shunahshepo yamahvadgribhitah so asmanraja varuno mumoktu ||
verses.en:
Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth.
May he to whom prayed fettered Sunahsepa, may he the Sovran Varuna release us.

verses.sa:
शुनःशेपो ह्यह्वद्गृभीतस्त्रिष्वादित्यं द्रुपदेषु बद्धः ।
अवैनं राजा वरुणः ससृज्याद्विद्वाँ अदब्धो वि मुमोक्तु पाशान् ॥
verses.rom:
shunahshepo hyahvadgribhitastrishvadityam drupadeshu baddhah |
avainam raja varunah sasrijyadvidvan adabdho vi mumoktu pashan ||
verses.en:
Bound to three pillars captured Sunahsepa thus to the Aditya made his supplication.
Him may the Sovran Varuna deliver, wise, ne'er deceived, loosen the bonds that bind him.

verses.sa:
अव ते हेळो वरुण नमोभिरव यज्ञेभिरीमहे हविर्भिः ।
क्षयन्नस्मभ्यमसुर प्रचेता राजन्नेनांसि शिश्रथः कृतानि ॥
verses.rom:
ava te helo varuna namobhirava yajnebhirimahe havirbhih |
kshayannasmabhyamasura pracheta rajannenamsi shishrathah kritani ||
verses.en:
With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuna, we deprecate thine anger:
Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय ।
अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
uduttamam varuna pashamasmadavadhamam vi madhyamam shrathaya |
atha vayamaditya vrate tavanagaso aditaye syama ||
verses.en:
Loosen the bonds, O Varuna, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under.
So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Aditya.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते विशो यथा प्र देव वरुण व्रतम् ।
मिनीमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi te visho yatha pra deva varuna vratam |
minimasi dyavidyavi ||
verses.en:
WHATEVER law of thine, O God, O Varuna, as we are men,
Day after day we violate.

verses.sa:
मा नो वधाय हत्नवे जिहीळानस्य रीरधः ।
मा हृणानस्य मन्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
ma no vadhaya hatnave jihilanasya riradhah |
ma hrinanasya manyave ||
verses.en:
give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath,
To thy fierce anger when displeased.

verses.sa:
वि मृळीकाय ते मनो रथीरश्वं न संदितम् ।
गीर्भिर्वरुण सीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
vi mrilikaya te mano rathirashvam na samditam |
girbhirvaruna simahi ||
verses.en:
To gain thy mercy, Varuna, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds
The charioteer his tethered horse.

verses.sa:
परा हि मे विमन्यवः पतन्ति वस्यइष्टये ।
वयो न वसतीरुप ॥
verses.rom:
para hi me vimanyavah patanti vasyaishtaye |
vayo na vasatirupa ||
verses.en:
They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealths
As to their nests the birds of air.

verses.sa:
कदा क्षत्रश्रियं नरमा वरुणं करामहे ।
मृळीकायोरुचक्षसम् ॥
verses.rom:
kada kshatrashriyam narama varunam karamahe |
mrilikayoruchakshasam ||
verses.en:
When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might,
Him, the far-seeing Varuna?

verses.sa:
तदित्समानमाशाते वेनन्ता न प्र युच्छतः ।
धृतव्रताय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
taditsamanamashate venanta na pra yuchchhatah |
dhritavrataya dashushe ||
verses.en:
This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail
The ever-faithful worshipper.

verses.sa:
वेदा यो वीनां पदमन्तरिक्षेण पतताम् ।
वेद नावः समुद्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
veda yo vinam padamantarikshena patatam |
veda navah samudriyah ||
verses.en:
He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea,
He knows the ships that are thereon.

verses.sa:
वेद मासो धृतव्रतो द्वादश प्रजावतः ।
वेदा य उपजायते ॥
verses.rom:
veda maso dhritavrato dvadasha prajavatah |
veda ya upajayate ||
verses.en:
True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny:
He knows the moon of later birth.

verses.sa:
वेद वातस्य वर्तनिमुरोरृष्वस्य बृहतः ।
वेदा ये अध्यासते ॥
verses.rom:
veda vatasya vartanimurorrishvasya brihatah |
veda ye adhyasate ||
verses.en:
He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind:
He knows the Gods who dwell above.

verses.sa:
नि षसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा ।
साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
ni shasada dhritavrato varunah pastyasva |
samrajyaya sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Varuna, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he,
Most wise, sits there to govern all.

verses.sa:
अतो विश्वान्यद्भुता चिकित्वाँ अभि पश्यति ।
कृतानि या च कर्त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ato vishvanyadbhuta chikitvan abhi pashyati |
kritani ya cha kartva ||
verses.en:
From thence percerving he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been,
And what hereafter will be done.

verses.sa:
स नो विश्वाहा सुक्रतुरादित्यः सुपथा करत् ।
प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vishvaha sukraturadityah supatha karat |
pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en:
May that Aditya, very wise, make fair paths for us all our days:
May he prolong our lives for us.

verses.sa:
बिभ्रद्द्रापिं हिरण्ययं वरुणो वस्त निर्णिजम् ।
परि स्पशो नि षेदिरे ॥
verses.rom:
bibhraddrapim hiranyayam varuno vasta nirnijam |
pari spasho ni shedire ||
verses.en:
Varuna, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe.
His spies are seated found about.

verses.sa:
न यं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो न द्रुह्वाणो जनानाम् ।
न देवमभिमातयः ॥
verses.rom:
na yam dipsanti dipsavo na druhvano jananam |
na devamabhimatayah ||
verses.en:
The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o'er men,
Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.

verses.sa:
उत यो मानुषेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या ।
अस्माकमुदरेष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
uta yo manusheshva yashashchakre asamya |
asmakamudareshva ||
verses.en:
He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete,
To our own bodies giving it.

verses.sa:
परा मे यन्ति धीतयो गावो न गव्यूतीरनु ।
इच्छन्तीरुरुचक्षसम् ॥
verses.rom:
para me yanti dhitayo gavo na gavyutiranu |
ichchhantiruruchakshasam ||
verses.en:
Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him,
As kine unto their pastures move.

verses.sa:
सं नु वोचावहै पुनर्यतो मे मध्वाभृतम् ।
होतेव क्षदसे प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam nu vochavahai punaryato me madhvabhritam |
hoteva kshadase priyam ||
