verses.en:
Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like
Thou eatest what is dear to thee.

verses.sa:
दर्शं नु विश्वदर्शतं दर्शं रथमधि क्षमि ।
एता जुषत मे गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
darsham nu vishvadarshatam darsham rathamadhi kshami |
eta jushata me girah ||
verses.en:
Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth:
He hath accepted these my songs.

verses.sa:
इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृळय ।
त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥
verses.rom:
imam me varuna shrudhi havamadya cha mrilaya |
tvamavasyura chake ||
verses.en:
Varuna, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day
Longing for help I cried to thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वस्य मेधिर दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजसि ।
स यामनि प्रति श्रुधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishvasya medhira divashcha gmashcha rajasi |
sa yamani prati shrudhi ||
verses.en:
Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven
Hear, as thou goest on thy way.

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं मुमुग्धि नो वि पाशं मध्यमं चृत ।
अवाधमानि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
uduttamam mumugdhi no vi pasham madhyamam chrita |
avadhamani jivase ||
verses.en:
Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose
The bonds below, that I may live.

verses.sa:
वसिष्वा हि मियेध्य वस्त्राण्यूर्जां पते ।
सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
verses.rom:
vasishva hi miyedhya vastranyurjam pate |
semam no adhvaram yaja ||
verses.en:
O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes,
And offer this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नि नो होता वरेण्यः सदा यविष्ठ मन्मभिः ।
अग्ने दिवित्मता वचः ॥
verses.rom:
ni no hota varenyah sada yavishtha manmabhih |
agne divitmata vachah ||
verses.en:
Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest, most youthful, through our hymns,
O Agni, through our heavenly word.

verses.sa:
आ हि ष्मा सूनवे पितापिर्यजत्यापये ।
सखा सख्ये वरेण्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a hi shma sunave pitapiryajatyapaye |
sakha sakhye varenyah ||
verses.en:
For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth,
And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.

verses.sa:
आ नो बर्ही रिशादसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
सीदन्तु मनुषो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
a no barhi rishadaso varuno mitro aryama |
sidantu manusho yatha ||
verses.en:
Here let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
Like men, upon our sacred grass.

verses.sa:
पूर्व्य होतरस्य नो मन्दस्व सख्यस्य च ।
इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
purvya hotarasya no mandasva sakhyasya cha |
ima u shu shrudhi girah ||
verses.en:
O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship:
Hearken thou well to these our songs.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि शश्वता तना देवंदेवं यजामहे ।
त्वे इद्धूयते हविः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi shashvata tana devamdevam yajamahe |
tve iddhuyate havih ||
verses.en:
Whate'er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God,
That gift is offered up in thee

verses.sa:
प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः ।
प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
priyo no astu vishpatirhota mandro varenyah |
priyah svagnayo vayam ||
verses.en:
May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may
We, with bright fires, be dear to him.

verses.sa:
स्वग्नयो हि वार्यं देवासो दधिरे च नः ।
स्वग्नयो मनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
svagnayo hi varyam devaso dadhire cha nah |
svagnayo manamahe ||
verses.en:
The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us
So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.

verses.sa:
अथा न उभयेषाममृत मर्त्यानाम् ।
मिथः सन्तु प्रशस्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
atha na ubhayeshamamrita martyanam |
mithah santu prashastayah ||
verses.en:
And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men
Belong to us and thee alike.

verses.sa:
विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः ।
चनो धाः सहसो यहो ॥
verses.rom:
vishvebhiragne agnibhirimam yajnamidam vachah |
chano dhah sahaso yaho ||
verses.en:
With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice,
And this our speech, O Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः ।
सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvam na tva varavantam vandadhya agnim namobhih |
samrajantamadhvaranam ||
verses.en:
WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed,
Imperial Lord of sacred rites.

verses.sa:
स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः ।
मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha nah sunuh shavasa prithupragama sushevah |
midhvan asmakam babhuyat ||
verses.en:
May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity,
Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.

verses.sa:
स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः ।
पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no durachchasachcha ni martyadaghayoh |
pahi sadamidvishvayuh ||
verses.en:
Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore
Protect us from the sinful man.

verses.sa:
इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम् ।
अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
verses.rom:
imamu shu tvamasmakam sanim gayatram navyamsam |
agne deveshu pra vochah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods,
And this our newest song of praise.

verses.sa:
आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु ।
शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhaja parameshva vajeshu madhyameshu |
shiksha vasvo antamasya ||
verses.en:
Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below,
A share of strength that is between.

verses.sa:
विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ ।
सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥
verses.rom:
vibhaktasi chitrabhano sindhorurma upaka a |
sadyo dashushe ksharasi ||
verses.en:
Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou
Swift streamest to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः ।
स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
yamagne pritsu martyamava vajeshu yam junah |
sa yanta shashvatirishah ||
verses.en:
That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight,
Agni, or urgest to the fray.

verses.sa:
नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् ।
वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
nakirasya sahantya paryeta kayasya chit |
vajo asti shravayyah ||
verses.en:
Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One:
Nay, very glorious power is his.

verses.sa:
स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता ।
विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
verses.rom:
sa vajam vishvacharshanirarvadbhirastu taruta |
viprebhirastu sanita ||
verses.en:
May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight,
And with the singers win the spoil.

verses.sa:
जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय ।
स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥
verses.rom:
jarabodha tadvividdhi vishevishe yajniyaya |
stomam rudraya drishikam ||
verses.en:
Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him
Adorable in every house.

verses.sa:
स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः ।
धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
sa no mahan animano dhumaketuh purushchandrah |
dhiye vajaya hinvatu ||
verses.en:
May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright,
Urge us to strength and holy thought.

verses.sa:
स रेवाँ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः ।
उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa revan iva vishpatirdaivyah ketuh shrinotu nah |
ukthairagnirbrihadbhanuh ||
verses.en:
Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods,
Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.

verses.sa:
नमो महद्भ्यो नमो अर्भकेभ्यो नमो युवभ्यो नम आशिनेभ्यः ।
यजाम देवान्यदि शक्नवाम मा ज्यायसः शंसमा वृक्षि देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama ashinebhyah |
yajama devanyadi shaknavama ma jyayasah shamsama vrikshi devah ||
verses.en:
Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder!
Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.

verses.sa:
यत्र ग्रावा पृथुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे ।
उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra grava prithubudhna urdhvo bhavati sotave |
ulukhalasutanamavedvindra jalgulah ||
verses.en:
THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out,
O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa:
यत्र द्वाविव जघनाधिषवण्या कृता ।
उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra dvaviva jaghanadhishavanya krita |
ulukhalasutanamavedvindra jalgulah ||
verses.en:
Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid,
O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa:
यत्र नार्यपच्यवमुपच्यवं च शिक्षते ।
उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra naryapachyavamupachyavam cha shikshate |
ulukhalasutanamavedvindra jalgulah ||
verses.en:
There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall,
O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa:
यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन्यमितवा इव ।
उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra mantham vibadhnate rashminyamitava iva |
ulukhalasutanamavedvindra jalgulah ||
verses.en:
Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords,
O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि त्वं गृहेगृह उलूखलक युज्यसे ।
इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयतामिव दुन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi tvam grihegriha ulukhalaka yujyase |
iha dyumattamam vada jayatamiva dundubhih ||
verses.en:
If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work,
Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.

verses.sa:
उत स्म ते वनस्पते वातो वि वात्यग्रमित् ।
अथो इन्द्राय पातवे सुनु सोममुलूखल ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma te vanaspate vato vi vatyagramit |
atho indraya patave sunu somamulukhala ||
verses.en:
O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee,
Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.

verses.sa:
आयजी वाजसातमा ता ह्युच्चा विजर्भृतः ।
हरी इवान्धांसि बप्सता ॥
verses.rom:
ayaji vajasatama ta hyuchcha vijarbhritah |
hari ivandhamsi bapsata ||
verses.en:
Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements,
Like two bay horses champing herbs.

verses.sa:
ता नो अद्य वनस्पती ऋष्वावृष्वेभिः सोतृभिः ।
इन्द्राय मधुमत्सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta no adya vanaspati rishvavrishvebhih sotribhih |
indraya madhumatsutam ||
verses.en:
Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day
Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.

verses.sa:
उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सृज ।
नि धेहि गोरधि त्वचि ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhishtam chamvorbhara somam pavitra a srija |
ni dhehi goradhi tvachi ||
verses.en:
Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour,
and on the ox-hide set the dregs.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ता इव स्मसि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi satya somapa anashasta iva smasi |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be,
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
शिप्रिन्वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
shiprinvajanam pate shachivastava damsana |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful:
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
नि ष्वापया मिथूदृशा सस्तामबुध्यमाने ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
ni shvapaya mithudrisha sastamabudhyamane |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
ससन्तु त्या अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
sasantu tya aratayo bodhantu shura ratayah |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake:
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र गर्दभं मृण नुवन्तं पापयामुया ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
samindra gardabham mrina nuvantam papayamuya |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee:
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
patati kundrinachya duram vato vanadadhi |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course!
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कृकदाश्वम् ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
verses.rom:
sarvam parikrosham jahi jambhaya krikadashvam |
a tu na indra shamsaya goshvashveshu shubhrishu sahasreshu tuvimagha ||
verses.en:
Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us:
Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine
In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
आ व इन्द्रं क्रिविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् ।
मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a va indram krivim yatha vajayantah shatakratum |
mamhishtham sincha indubhih ||
verses.en:
WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well,
Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,

verses.sa:
शतं वा यः शुचीनां सहस्रं वा समाशिराम् ।
एदु निम्नं न रीयते ॥
verses.rom:
shatam va yah shuchinam sahasram va samashiram |
edu nimnam na riyate ||
verses.en:
Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts
Flow, even as down a depth, to him;

verses.sa:
सं यन्मदाय शुष्मिण एना ह्यस्योदरे ।
समुद्रो न व्यचो दधे ॥
verses.rom:
sam yanmadaya shushmina ena hyasyodare |
samudro na vyacho dadhe ||
verses.en:
When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room
Within his belly, like the sea.

verses.sa:
अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् ।
वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim |
vachastachchinna ohase ||
verses.en:
This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate:
Thou carest too for this our prayer.

verses.sa:
स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते ।
विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥
verses.rom:
stotram radhanam pate girvaho vira yasya te |
vibhutirastu sunrita ||
verses.en:
O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness
Be his who sings the laud to thee.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो ।
समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvastishtha na utaye'sminvaje shatakrato |
samanyeshu bravavahai ||
verses.en:
Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight
In others too let us agree.

verses.sa:
योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yogeyoge tavastaram vajevaje havamahe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en:
In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us
Indra the mightiest of all.

verses.sa:
आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः ।
वाजेभिरुप नो हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a gha gamadyadi shravatsahasrinibhirutibhih |
vajebhirupa no havam ||
verses.en:
If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds,
And all that strengthens, to our call.

verses.sa:
अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् ।
यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratim naram |
yam te purvam pita huve ||
verses.en:
I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home,
Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं विश्ववारा शास्महे पुरुहूत ।
सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vayam vishvavara shasmahe puruhuta |
sakhe vaso jaritribhyah ||
verses.en:
We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all precious gifts, O Friend,
Kind God to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम् ।
सखे वज्रिन्सखीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam shiprininam somapah somapavnam |
sakhe vajrinsakhinam ||
verses.en:
O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames
And of our Soma-drinking friends.

verses.sa:
तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन्तथा कृणु ।
यथा त उश्मसीष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
tatha tadastu somapah sakhe vajrintatha krinu |
yatha ta ushmasishtaye ||
verses.en:
Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act
To aid each wish as we desire.

verses.sa:
रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः ।
क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
revatirnah sadhamada indre santu tuvivajah |
kshumanto yabhirmadema ||
verses.en:
With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith,
Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.

verses.sa:
आ घ त्वावान्त्मनाप्त स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः ।
ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥
verses.rom:
a gha tvavantmanapta stotribhyo dhrishnaviyanah |
rinoraksham na chakryoh ||
verses.en:
Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought,
Bold One, the axle of the car.

verses.sa:
आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् ।
ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a yadduvah shatakratava kamam jaritrinam |
rinoraksham na shachibhih ||
verses.en:
That, Satakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were,
Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

verses.sa:
शश्वदिन्द्रः पोप्रुथद्भिर्जिगाय नानदद्भिः शाश्वसद्भिर्धनानि ।
स नो हिरण्यरथं दंसनावान्स नः सनिता सनये स नोऽदात् ॥
verses.rom:
shashvadindrah popruthadbhirjigaya nanadadbhih shashvasadbhirdhanani |
sa no hiranyaratham damsanavansa nah sanita sanaye sa no'dat ||
verses.en:
With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures
A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.

verses.sa:
आश्विनावश्वावत्येषा यातं शवीरया ।
गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvinavashvavatyesha yatam shaviraya |
gomaddasra hiranyavat ||
verses.en:
Come, Asvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine,
And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
समानयोजनो हि वां रथो दस्रावमर्त्यः ।
समुद्रे अश्विनेयते ॥
verses.rom:
samanayojano hi vam ratho dasravamartyah |
samudre ashvineyate ||
verses.en:
Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts,
Travels, O Asvins, in the sea.

verses.sa:
न्यघ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः ।
परि द्यामन्यदीयते ॥
verses.rom:
nyaghnyasya murdhani chakram rathasya yemathuh |
pari dyamanyadiyate ||
verses.en:
High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep,
The other round the sky revolves.

verses.sa:
कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये ।
कं नक्षसे विभावरि ॥
verses.rom:
kasta ushah kadhapriye bhuje marto amartye |
kam nakshase vibhavari ||
verses.en:
What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou?
To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?

verses.sa:
वयं हि ते अमन्मह्यान्तादा पराकात् ।
अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि ॥
verses.rom:
vayam hi te amanmahyantada parakat |
ashve na chitre arushi ||
verses.en:
For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away,
Red-hued and like a dappled mare.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्येभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः ।
अस्मे रयिं नि धारय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyebhira gahi vajebhirduhitardivah |
asme rayim ni dharaya ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings,
And send thou riches down to us.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा ।
तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prathamo angira rishirdevo devanamabhavah shivah sakha |
tava vrate kavayo vidmanapaso'jayanta maruto bhrajadrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend.
After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरस्तमः कविर्देवानां परि भूषसि व्रतम् ।
विभुर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय मेधिरो द्विमाता शयुः कतिधा चिदायवे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prathamo angirastamah kavirdevanam pari bhushasi vratam |
vibhurvishvasmai bhuvanaya medhiro dvimata shayuh katidha chidayave ||
verses.en:
O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods.
Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो मातरिश्वन आविर्भव सुक्रतूया विवस्वते ।
अरेजेतां रोदसी होतृवूर्येऽसघ्नोर्भारमयजो महो वसो ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prathamo matarishvana avirbhava sukratuya vivasvate |
arejetam rodasi hotrivurye'saghnorbharamayajo maho vaso ||
verses.en:
To Matarisvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power.
Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने मनवे द्यामवाशयः पुरूरवसे सुकृते सुकृत्तरः ।
श्वात्रेण यत्पित्रोर्मुच्यसे पर्या त्वा पूर्वमनयन्नापरं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne manave dyamavashayah pururavase sukrite sukrittarah |
shvatrena yatpitrormuchyase parya tva purvamanayannaparam punah ||
verses.en:
Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Pururavas.
When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वृषभः पुष्टिवर्धन उद्यतस्रुचे भवसि श्रवाय्यः ।
य आहुतिं परि वेदा वषट्कृतिमेकायुरग्रे विश आविवाससि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vrishabhah pushtivardhana udyatasruche bhavasi shravayyah |
ya ahutim pari veda vashatkritimekayuragre visha avivasasi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up.
Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वृजिनवर्तनिं नरं सक्मन्पिपर्षि विदथे विचर्षणे ।
यः शूरसाता परितक्म्ये धने दभ्रेभिश्चित्समृता हंसि भूयसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vrijinavartanim naram sakmanpiparshi vidathe vicharshane |
yah shurasata paritakmye dhane dabhrebhishchitsamrita hamsi bhuyasah ||
verses.en:
Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e'en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways.
Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमग्ने अमृतत्व उत्तमे मर्तं दधासि श्रवसे दिवेदिवे ।
यस्तातृषाण उभयाय जन्मने मयः कृणोषि प्रय आ च सूरये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tamagne amritatva uttame martam dadhasi shravase divedive |
yastatrishana ubhayaya janmane mayah krinoshi praya a cha suraye ||
verses.en:
For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality,
Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने सनये धनानां यशसं कारुं कृणुहि स्तवानः ।
ऋध्याम कर्मापसा नवेन देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne sanaye dhananam yashasam karum krinuhi stavanah |
ridhyama karmapasa navena devairdyavaprithivi pravatam nah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches:
May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने पित्रोरुपस्थ आ देवो देवेष्वनवद्य जागृविः ।
तनूकृद्बोधि प्रमतिश्च कारवे त्वं कल्याण वसु विश्वमोपिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne pitrorupastha a devo deveshvanavadya jagrivih |
tanukridbodhi pramatishcha karave tvam kalyana vasu vishvamopishe ||
verses.en:
O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good.
Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रमतिस्त्वं पितासि नस्त्वं वयस्कृत्तव जामयो वयम् ।
सं त्वा रायः शतिनः सं सहस्रिणः सुवीरं यन्ति व्रतपामदाभ्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne pramatistvam pitasi nastvam vayaskrittava jamayo vayam |
sam tva rayah shatinah sam sahasrinah suviram yanti vratapamadabhya ||
verses.en:
Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou: we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life.
In thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने प्रथममायुमायवे देवा अकृण्वन्नहुषस्य विश्पतिम् ।
इळामकृण्वन्मनुषस्य शासनीं पितुर्यत्पुत्रो ममकस्य जायते ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prathamamayumayave deva akrinvannahushasya vishpatim |
ilamakrinvanmanushasya shasanim pituryatputro mamakasya jayate ||
verses.en:
Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahusa.
Ila they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य ।
त्राता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषं रक्षमाणस्तव व्रते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne tava deva payubhirmaghono raksha tanvashcha vandya |
trata tokasya tanaye gavamasyanimesham rakshamanastava vrate ||
verses.en:
Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves.
Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यज्यवे पायुरन्तरोऽनिषङ्गाय चतुरक्ष इध्यसे ।
यो रातहव्योऽवृकाय धायसे कीरेश्चिन्मन्त्रं मनसा वनोषि तम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne yajyave payurantaro'nishangaya chaturaksha idhyase |
yo ratahavyo'vrikaya dhayase kireshchinmantram manasa vanoshi tam ||
verses.en:
Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmed.
With fond heart thou acceptest e'en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न उरुशंसाय वाघते स्पार्हं यद्रेक्णः परमं वनोषि तत् ।
आध्रस्य चित्प्रमतिरुच्यसे पिता प्र पाकं शास्सि प्र दिशो विदुष्टरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagna urushamsaya vaghate sparham yadreknah paramam vanoshi tat |
adhrasya chitpramatiruchyase pita pra pakam shassi pra disho vidushtarah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni gainest for the loudly-praising priest the highest wealth, the object of a man's desire.
Thou art called Father, caring even for the weak, and wisest, to the simple one thou teachest lore.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रयतदक्षिणं नरं वर्मेव स्यूतं परि पासि विश्वतः ।
स्वादुक्षद्मा यो वसतौ स्योनकृज्जीवयाजं यजते सोपमा दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prayatadakshinam naram varmeva syutam pari pasi vishvatah |
svadukshadma yo vasatau syonakrijjivayajam yajate sopama divah ||
verses.en:
Agni, the man who giveth guerdon to the priests, like well-sewn armour thou guardest on every side.
He who with grateful food shows kindness in his house, an offerer to the living, is the type of heaven.

verses.sa:
इमामग्ने शरणिं मीमृषो न इममध्वानं यमगाम दूरात् ।
आपिः पिता प्रमतिः सोम्यानां भृमिरस्यृषिकृन्मर्त्यानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
imamagne sharanim mimrisho na imamadhvanam yamagama durat |
apih pita pramatih somyanam bhrimirasyrishikrinmartyanam ||
verses.en:
Pardon, we pray, this sin of ours, O Agni,--the path which we have trodden, widely straying,
Dear Friend and Father, caring for the pious, who speedest nigh and who inspirest mortals.

verses.sa:
मनुष्वदग्ने अङ्गिरस्वदङ्गिरो ययातिवत्सदने पूर्ववच्छुचे ।
अच्छ याह्या वहा दैव्यं जनमा सादय बर्हिषि यक्षि च प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
manushvadagne angirasvadangiro yayativatsadane purvavachchhuche |
achchha yahya vaha daivyam janama sadaya barhishi yakshi cha priyam ||
verses.en:
As erst to Manus, to Yayati, Angiras, so Angiras! pure Agni! come thou to our hall
Bring hither the celestial host and seat them here upon the sacred grass, and offer what they love.

verses.sa:
एतेनाग्ने ब्रह्मणा वावृधस्व शक्ती वा यत्ते चकृमा विदा वा ।
उत प्र णेष्यभि वस्यो अस्मान्सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या ॥
verses.rom:
etenagne brahmana vavridhasva shakti va yatte chakrima vida va |
uta pra neshyabhi vasyo asmansam nah srija sumatya vajavatya ||
verses.en:
By this our prayer be thou, O Agni, strengthened, prayer made by us after our power and knowledge.
Lead thou us, therefore, to increasing riches; endow us with thy strength-bestowing favour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री ।
अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत्पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya nu viryani pra vocham yani chakara prathamani vajri |
ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakshana abhinatparvatanam ||
verses.en:
I will declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder.
He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

verses.sa:
अहन्नहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं त्वष्टास्मै वज्रं स्वर्यं ततक्ष ।
वाश्रा इव धेनवः स्यन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः ॥
verses.rom:
ahannahim parvate shishriyanam tvashtasmai vajram svaryam tataksha |
vashra iva dhenavah syandamana anjah samudramava jagmurapah ||
verses.en:
He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashṭar fashioned.
Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.

verses.sa:
वृषायमाणोऽवृणीत सोमं त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत्सुतस्य ।
आ सायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्नेनं प्रथमजामहीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishayamano'vrinita somam trikadrukeshvapibatsutasya |
a sayakam maghavadatta vajramahannenam prathamajamahinam ||
verses.en:
Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma, and in three sacred beakers drank the juices.
Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राहन्प्रथमजामहीनामान्मायिनाममिनाः प्रोत मायाः ।
आत्सूर्यं जनयन्द्यामुषासं तादीत्ना शत्रुं न किला विवित्से ॥
verses.rom:
yadindrahanprathamajamahinamanmayinamaminah prota mayah |
atsuryam janayandyamushasam taditna shatrum na kila vivitse ||
verses.en:
When, Indra, thou hadst slain the dragons’ firstborn, and overcome the charms of the enchanters,
Then, giving life to Sun and Dawn and Heaven, thou foundest not one foe to stand against thee.

verses.sa:
अहन्वृत्रं वृत्रतरं व्यंसमिन्द्रो वज्रेण महता वधेन ।
स्कन्धांसीव कुलिशेना विवृक्णाहिः शयत उपपृक्पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ahanvritram vritrataram vyamsamindro vajrena mahata vadhena |
skandhamsiva kulishena vivriknahih shayata upaprikprithivyah ||
verses.en:
Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras.
As trunks of trees, what time the axe hath felled them, low on the earth so lies the prostrate Dragon.

verses.sa:
अयोद्धेव दुर्मद आ हि जुह्वे महावीरं तुविबाधमृजीषम् ।
नातारीदस्य समृतिं वधानां सं रुजानाः पिपिष इन्द्रशत्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
ayoddheva durmada a hi juhve mahaviram tuvibadhamrijisham |
nataridasya samritim vadhanam sam rujanah pipisha indrashatruh ||
verses.en:
He, like a mad weak warrior, challenged Indra, the great impetuous many-slaying Hero.
He, brooking not the clashing of the weapons, crushed—Indra’s foe—the shattered forts in falling.

verses.sa:
अपादहस्तो अपृतन्यदिन्द्रमास्य वज्रमधि सानौ जघान ।
वृष्णो वध्रिः प्रतिमानं बुभूषन्पुरुत्रा वृत्रो अशयद्व्यस्तः ॥
verses.rom:
apadahasto apritanyadindramasya vajramadhi sanau jaghana |
vrishno vadhrih pratimanam bubhushanpurutra vritro ashayadvyastah ||
verses.en:
Footless and handless still he challenged Indra, who smote him with his bolt between the shoulders.
Emasculate yet claiming manly vigour, thus Vṛitra lay with scattered limbs dissevered.

verses.sa:
नदं न भिन्नममुया शयानं मनो रुहाणा अति यन्त्यापः ।
याश्चिद्वृत्रो महिना पर्यतिष्ठत्तासामहिः पत्सुतःशीर्बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
nadam na bhinnamamuya shayanam mano ruhana ati yantyapah |
yashchidvritro mahina paryatishthattasamahih patsutahshirbabhuva ||
verses.en:
There as he lies like a bank-bursting river, the waters taking courage flow above him.
The Dragon lies beneath the feet of torrents which Vṛitra with his greatness had encompassed.

verses.sa:
नीचावया अभवद्वृत्रपुत्रेन्द्रो अस्या अव वधर्जभार ।
उत्तरा सूरधरः पुत्र आसीद्दानुः शये सहवत्सा न धेनुः ॥
verses.rom:
nichavaya abhavadvritraputrendro asya ava vadharjabhara |
uttara suradharah putra asiddanuh shaye sahavatsa na dhenuh ||
verses.en:
Then humbled was the strength of Vṛitra’s mother: Indra hath cast his deadly bolt against her.
The mother was above, the son was under, and like a cow beside her calf lay Dânu.

verses.sa:
अतिष्ठन्तीनामनिवेशनानां काष्ठानां मध्ये निहितं शरीरम् ।
वृत्रस्य निण्यं वि चरन्त्यापो दीर्घं तम आशयदिन्द्रशत्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
atishthantinamaniveshananam kashthanam madhye nihitam shariram |
vritrasya ninyam vi charantyapo dirgham tama ashayadindrashatruh ||
verses.en:
Rolled in the midst of never-ceasing currents flowing without a rest for ever onward,
The waters bear off Vṛitra’s nameless body: the foe of Indra sank to during darkness.

verses.sa:
दासपत्नीरहिगोपा अतिष्ठन्निरुद्धा आपः पणिनेव गावः ।
अपां बिलमपिहितं यदासीद्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अप तद्ववार ॥
verses.rom:
dasapatnirahigopa atishthanniruddha apah panineva gavah |
apam bilamapihitam yadasidvritram jaghanvan apa tadvavara ||
verses.en:
Guarded by Ahi stood the thralls of Dâsas, the waters stayed like kine held by the robber.
But he, when he had smitten Vṛitra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

verses.sa:
अश्व्यो वारो अभवस्तदिन्द्र सृके यत्त्वा प्रत्यहन्देव एकः ।
अजयो गा अजयः शूर सोममवासृजः सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvyo varo abhavastadindra srike yattva pratyahandeva ekah |
ajayo ga ajayah shura somamavasrijah sartave sapta sindhun ||
verses.en:
A horse's tail wast thou when he, O Indra, smote on thy bolt; thou, God without a second,
Thou hast won back the kine, hast won the Soma; thou hast let loose to flow the Seven Rivers.

verses.sa:
नास्मै विद्युन्न तन्यतुः सिषेध न यां मिहमकिरद्ध्रादुनिं च ।
इन्द्रश्च यद्युयुधाते अहिश्चोतापरीभ्यो मघवा वि जिग्ये ॥
verses.rom:
nasmai vidyunna tanyatuh sishedha na yam mihamakiraddhradunim cha |
indrashcha yadyuyudhate ahishchotaparibhyo maghava vi jigye ||
verses.en:
Nothing availed him lightning, nothing thunder, hailstorm or mist which he had spread around him:
When Indra and the Dragon strove in battle, Maghavan gained the victory for ever.

verses.sa:
अहेर्यातारं कमपश्य इन्द्र हृदि यत्ते जघ्नुषो भीरगच्छत् ।
नव च यन्नवतिं च स्रवन्तीः श्येनो न भीतो अतरो रजांसि ॥
verses.rom:
aheryataram kamapashya indra hridi yatte jaghnusho bhiragachchhat |
nava cha yannavatim cha sravantih shyeno na bhito ataro rajamsi ||
verses.en:
Whom sawest thou to avenge the Dragon, Indra, that fear possessed thy heart when thou hadst slain him;
That, like a hawk affrighted through the regions, thou crossedst nine-and-ninety flowing rivers?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यातोऽवसितस्य राजा शमस्य च शृङ्गिणो वज्रबाहुः ।
सेदु राजा क्षयति चर्षणीनामरान्न नेमिः परि ता बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
indro yato'vasitasya raja shamasya cha shringino vajrabahuh |
sedu raja kshayati charshaninamaranna nemih pari ta babhuva ||
verses.en:
Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.
Over all living men he rules as Sovran, containing all as spokes within the felly.

verses.sa:
एतायामोप गव्यन्त इन्द्रमस्माकं सु प्रमतिं वावृधाति ।
अनामृणः कुविदादस्य रायो गवां केतं परमावर्जते नः ॥
verses.rom:
etayamopa gavyanta indramasmakam su pramatim vavridhati |
anamrinah kuvidadasya rayo gavam ketam paramavarjate nah ||
verses.en:
Come, fain for booty let us seek to Indra: yet more shall he increase his care that guides us.
Will not the Indestructible endow us with perfect knowledge of this wealth, of cattle?

verses.sa:
उपेदहं धनदामप्रतीतं जुष्टां न श्येनो वसतिं पतामि ।
इन्द्रं नमस्यन्नुपमेभिरर्कैर्य स्तोतृभ्यो हव्यो अस्ति यामन् ॥
verses.rom:
upedaham dhanadamapratitam jushtam na shyeno vasatim patami |
indram namasyannupamebhirarkairya stotribhyo havyo asti yaman ||
verses.en:
I fly to him invisible Wealth-giver as flies the falcon to his cherished eyrie,
With fairest hymns of praise adoring Indra, whom those who laud him must invoke in battle.

verses.sa:
नि सर्वसेन इषुधीँरसक्त समर्यो गा अजति यस्य वष्टि ।
चोष्कूयमाण इन्द्र भूरि वामं मा पणिर्भूरस्मदधि प्रवृद्ध ॥
verses.rom:
ni sarvasena ishudhinrasakta samaryo ga ajati yasya vashti |
choshkuyamana indra bhuri vamam ma panirbhurasmadadhi pravriddha ||
verses.en:
Mid all his host, he bindeth on the quiver: he driveth cattle from what foe he pleaseth:
Gathering up great store of riches, Indra. be thou no trafficker with us, most mighty.

verses.sa:
वधीर्हि दस्युं धनिनं घनेनँ एकश्चरन्नुपशाकेभिरिन्द्र ।
धनोरधि विषुणक्ते व्यायन्नयज्वानः सनकाः प्रेतिमीयुः ॥
verses.rom:
vadhirhi dasyum dhaninam ghanenan ekashcharannupashakebhirindra |
dhanoradhi vishunakte vyayannayajvanah sanakah pretimiyuh ||
verses.en:
Thou slewest with thy bolt the wealthy Dasyu, alone, yet going with thy helpers, Indra!
Far from the floor of heaven in all directions, the ancient riteless ones fled to destruction.

verses.sa:
परा चिच्छीर्षा ववृजुस्त इन्द्रायज्वानो यज्वभि स्पर्धमानाः ।
प्र यद्दिवो हरिव स्थातरुग्र निरव्रताँ अधमो रोदस्योः ॥
verses.rom:
para chichchhirsha vavrijusta indrayajvano yajvabhi spardhamanah |
pra yaddivo hariva sthatarugra niravratan adhamo rodasyoh ||
verses.en:
Fighting with pious worshippers, the riteless turned and fled, Indra! with averted faces.
When thou, fierce Lord of the Bay Steeds, the Stayer, blewest from earth and heaven and sky the godless.

verses.sa:
अयुयुत्सन्ननवद्यस्य सेनामयातयन्त क्षितयो नवग्वाः ।
वृषायुधो न वध्रयो निरष्टाः प्रवद्भिरिन्द्राच्चितयन्त आयन् ॥
verses.rom:
ayuyutsannanavadyasya senamayatayanta kshitayo navagvah |
vrishayudho na vadhrayo nirashtah pravadbhirindrachchitayanta ayan ||
verses.en:
They met in fight the army of the blameless: then the Navagvas put forth all their power.
They, like emasculates with men contending, fled, conscious, by steep paths from Indra, scattered.

verses.sa:
त्वमेतान्रुदतो जक्षतश्चायोधयो रजस इन्द्र पारे ।
अवादहो दिव आ दस्युमुच्चा प्र सुन्वत स्तुवतः शंसमावः ॥
verses.rom:
tvametanrudato jakshatashchayodhayo rajasa indra pare |
avadaho diva a dasyumuchcha pra sunvata stuvatah shamsamavah ||
verses.en:
Whether they weep or laugh, thou hast o'erthrown them, O Indra, on the sky's extremest limit.
The Dasyu thou hast burned from heaven, and welcomed the prayer of him who pours the juice and lauds thee.

verses.sa:
चक्राणासः परीणहं पृथिव्या हिरण्येन मणिना शुम्भमानाः ।
न हिन्वानासस्तितिरुस्त इन्द्रं परि स्पशो अदधात्सूर्येण ॥
verses.rom:
chakranasah parinaham prithivya hiranyena manina shumbhamanah |
na hinvanasastitirusta indram pari spasho adadhatsuryena ||
verses.en:
Adorned with their array of gold and jewels, they o'er the earth a covering veil extended.
Although they hastened, they o'ercame not Indra: their spies he compassed with the Sun of morning.

verses.sa:
परि यदिन्द्र रोदसी उभे अबुभोजीर्महिना विश्वतः सीम् ।
अमन्यमानाँ अभि मन्यमानैर्निर्ब्रह्मभिरधमो दस्युमिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
pari yadindra rodasi ubhe abubhojirmahina vishvatah sim |
amanyamanan abhi manyamanairnirbrahmabhiradhamo dasyumindra ||
verses.en:
As thou enjoyest heaven and earth, O Indra, on every side surrounded with thy greatness,
So thou with priests bast blown away the Dasyu, and those who worship not with those who worship.

verses.sa:
न ये दिवः पृथिव्या अन्तमापुर्न मायाभिर्धनदां पर्यभूवन् ।
युजं वज्रं वृषभश्चक्र इन्द्रो निर्ज्योतिषा तमसो गा अदुक्षत् ॥
verses.rom:
na ye divah prithivya antamapurna mayabhirdhanadam paryabhuvan |
yujam vajram vrishabhashchakra indro nirjyotisha tamaso ga adukshat ||
verses.en:
They who pervaded earth's extremest limit subdued not with their charms the Wealth-bestower:
Indra, the Bull, made his ally the thunder, and with its light milked cows from out the darkness.

verses.sa:
अनु स्वधामक्षरन्नापो अस्यावर्धत मध्य आ नाव्यानाम् ।
सध्रीचीनेन मनसा तमिन्द्र ओजिष्ठेन हन्मनाहन्नभि द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
anu svadhamaksharannapo asyavardhata madhya a navyanam |
sadhrichinena manasa tamindra ojishthena hanmanahannabhi dyun ||
verses.en:
The waters flowed according to their nature; he raid the navigable streams waxed mighty.
Then Indra, with his spirit concentrated, smote him for ever with his strongest weapon.

verses.sa:
न्याविध्यदिलीबिशस्य दृळ्हा वि शृङ्गिणमभिनच्छुष्णमिन्द्रः ।
यावत्तरो मघवन्यावदोजो वज्रेण शत्रुमवधीः पृतन्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
nyavidhyadilibishasya drilha vi shringinamabhinachchhushnamindrah |
yavattaro maghavanyavadojo vajrena shatrumavadhih pritanyum ||
verses.en:
Indra broke through Ilibisa's strong castles, and Susna with his horn he cut to pieces:
Thou, Maghavan, for all his might and swiftness, slewest thy fighting foeman with thy thunder

verses.sa:
अभि सिध्मो अजिगादस्य शत्रून्वि तिग्मेन वृषभेणा पुरोऽभेत् ।
सं वज्रेणासृजद्वृत्रमिन्द्रः प्र स्वां मतिमतिरच्छाशदानः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi sidhmo ajigadasya shatrunvi tigmena vrishabhena puro'bhet |
sam vajrenasrijadvritramindrah pra svam matimatirachchhashadanah ||
verses.en:
Fierce on his enemies fell Indra's weapon: with. his sharp bull he rent their forts in pieces.
He with his thunderbolt dealt blows on Vrtra; and conquered, executing all his purpose.

verses.sa:
आवः कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन्प्रावो युध्यन्तं वृषभं दशद्युम् ।
शफच्युतो रेणुर्नक्षत द्यामुच्छ्वैत्रेयो नृषाह्याय तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
avah kutsamindra yasminchakanpravo yudhyantam vrishabham dashadyum |
shaphachyuto renurnakshata dyamuchchhvaitreyo nrishahyaya tasthau ||
verses.en:
Indra, thou helpest Kutsa whom thou lovedst, and guardedst brave Dagadyu when he battled,
The dust of trampling horses rose to heaven, and Svitra's son stood up again for conquest.

verses.sa:
आवः शमं वृषभं तुग्र्यासु क्षेत्रजेषे मघवञ्छ्वित्र्यं गाम् ।
ज्योक्चिदत्र तस्थिवांसो अक्रञ्छत्रूयतामधरा वेदनाकः ॥
verses.rom:
avah shamam vrishabham tugryasu kshetrajeshe maghavanchhvitryam gam |
jyokchidatra tasthivamso akranchhatruyatamadhara vedanakah ||
verses.en:
Svitra's mild steer, O Maghavan thou helpest in combat for the land, mid Tugra's houses.
Long stood they there before the task was ended: thou wast the master of the foemen's treasure.

verses.sa:
त्रिश्चिन्नो अद्या भवतं नवेदसा विभुर्वां याम उत रातिरश्विना ।
युवोर्हि यन्त्रं हिम्येव वाससोऽभ्यायंसेन्या भवतं मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
trishchinno adya bhavatam navedasa vibhurvam yama uta ratirashvina |
yuvorhi yantram himyeva vasaso'bhyayamsenya bhavatam manishibhih ||
verses.en:
Ye who observe this day be with us even thrice: far-stretching is you bounty, Asvins and your course.
To you, as to a cloak in winter, we cleave close: you are to be drawn nigh unto us by the wise.

verses.sa:
त्रयः पवयो मधुवाहने रथे सोमस्य वेनामनु विश्व इद्विदुः ।
त्रय स्कम्भास स्कभितास आरभे त्रिर्नक्तं याथस्त्रिर्वश्विना दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
trayah pavayo madhuvahane rathe somasya venamanu vishva idviduh |
traya skambhasa skabhitasa arabhe trirnaktam yathastrirvashvina diva ||
verses.en:
Three are the fellies in your honey-bearing car, that travels after Soma's loved one, as all know.
Three are the pillars set upon it for support: thrice journey ye by night, O Asvins, thrice by day.

verses.sa:
समाने अहन्त्रिरवद्यगोहना त्रिरद्य यज्ञं मधुना मिमिक्षतम् ।
त्रिर्वाजवतीरिषो अश्विना युवं दोषा अस्मभ्यमुषसश्च पिन्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
samane ahantriravadyagohana triradya yajnam madhuna mimikshatam |
trirvajavatirisho ashvina yuvam dosha asmabhyamushasashcha pinvatam ||
verses.en:
Thrice in the self-same day, ye Gods who banish want, sprinkle ye thrice to-day our sacrifice with meath;
And thrice vouchsafe us store of food with plenteous strength, at evening, O ye Asvins, and at break of day.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातं त्रिरनुव्रते जने त्रिः सुप्राव्ये त्रेधेव शिक्षतम् ।
त्रिर्नान्द्यं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिः पृक्षो अस्मे अक्षरेव पिन्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
trirvartiryatam triranuvrate jane trih supravye tredheva shikshatam |
trirnandyam vahatamashvina yuvam trih priksho asme akshareva pinvatam ||
verses.en:
Thrice come ye to our home, thrice to the righteous folk, thrice triply aid the man who well deserves your help.
Thrice, O ye Asvins, bring us what shall make us glad; thrice send us store of food as nevermore to fail.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो रयिं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिर्देवताता त्रिरुतावतं धियः ।
त्रिः सौभगत्वं त्रिरुत श्रवांसि नस्त्रिष्ठं वां सूरे दुहिता रुहद्रथम् ॥
verses.rom:
trirno rayim vahatamashvina yuvam trirdevatata trirutavatam dhiyah |
trih saubhagatvam triruta shravamsi nastrishtham vam sure duhita ruhadratham ||
verses.en:
Thrice, O ye Asvins, bring to us abundant wealth: thrice in the Gods' assembly, thrice assist our thoughts.
Thrice, grant ye us prosperity, thrice grant us fame; for the Sun's daughter hath mounted your three-wheeled car.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो अश्विना दिव्यानि भेषजा त्रिः पार्थिवानि त्रिरु दत्तमद्भ्यः ।
ओमानं शंयोर्ममकाय सूनवे त्रिधातु शर्म वहतं शुभस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
trirno ashvina divyani bheshaja trih parthivani triru dattamadbhyah |
omanam shamyormamakaya sunave tridhatu sharma vahatam shubhaspati ||
verses.en:
Thrice, Asvins, grant to us the heavenly medicines, thrice those of earth and thrice those that the waters hold,
Favour and health and strength bestow upon my son; triple protection, Lords of Splendour, grant to him.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो अश्विना यजता दिवेदिवे परि त्रिधातु पृथिवीमशायतम् ।
तिस्रो नासत्या रथ्या परावत आत्मेव वातः स्वसराणि गच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
trirno ashvina yajata divedive pari tridhatu prithivimashayatam |
tisro nasatya rathya paravata atmeva vatah svasarani gachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Thrice are ye to be worshipped day by day by us: thrice, O ye Asvins, ye travel around the earth.
Car-borne from far away, O ye Nasatyas, come, like vital air to bodies, come ye to the three.

verses.sa:
त्रिरश्विना सिन्धुभिः सप्तमातृभिस्त्रय आहावास्त्रेधा हविष्कृतम् ।
तिस्रः पृथिवीरुपरि प्रवा दिवो नाकं रक्षेथे द्युभिरक्तुभिर्हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
trirashvina sindhubhih saptamatribhistraya ahavastredha havishkritam |
tisrah prithivirupari prava divo nakam rakshethe dyubhiraktubhirhitam ||
verses.en:
Thrice, O ye Asvins, with the Seven Mother Streams; three are the jars, the triple offering is prepared.
Three are the worlds, and moving on above the sky ye guard the firm-set vault of heaven through days and nights.

verses.sa:
क्व त्री चक्रा त्रिवृतो रथस्य क्व त्रयो वन्धुरो ये सनीळाः ।
कदा योगो वाजिनो रासभस्य येन यज्ञं नासत्योपयाथः ॥
verses.rom:
kva tri chakra trivrito rathasya kva trayo vandhuro ye sanilah |
kada yogo vajino rasabhasya yena yajnam nasatyopayathah ||
verses.en:
Where are the three wheels of your triple chariot, where are the three seats thereto firmly fastened?
When will ye yoke the mighty ass that draws it, to bring you to our sacrifice. Nasatyas?

verses.sa:
आ नासत्या गच्छतं हूयते हविर्मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिः ।
युवोर्हि पूर्वं सवितोषसो रथमृताय चित्रं घृतवन्तमिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
a nasatya gachchhatam huyate havirmadhvah pibatam madhupebhirasabhih |
yuvorhi purvam savitoshaso rathamritaya chitram ghritavantamishyati ||
verses.en:
Nasatyas, come: the sacred gift is offered up; drink the sweet juice with lips that know the sweetness well.
Savitar sends, before the dawn of day, your car, fraught with oil, various-coloured, to our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ नासत्या त्रिभिरेकादशैरिह देवेभिर्यातं मधुपेयमश्विना ।
प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा ॥
verses.rom:
a nasatya tribhirekadashairiha devebhiryatam madhupeyamashvina |
prayustarishtam ni rapamsi mrikshatam sedhatam dvesho bhavatam sachabhuva ||
verses.en:
Come, O Nasatyas, with the thrice-eleven Gods; come, O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath.
Make long our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off our enemies; be with us evermore.

verses.sa:
आ नो अश्विना त्रिवृता रथेनार्वाञ्चं रयिं वहतं सुवीरम् ।
शृण्वन्ता वामवसे जोहवीमि वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
a no ashvina trivrita rathenarvancham rayim vahatam suviram |
shrinvanta vamavase johavimi vridhe cha no bhavatam vajasatau ||
verses.en:
Borne in your triple car, O Asvins, bring us present prosperity with noble offspring.
I cry to you who hear me for protection be ye our helpers where men win the booty.

verses.sa:
ह्वयाम्यग्निं प्रथमं स्वस्तये ह्वयामि मित्रावरुणाविहावसे ।
ह्वयामि रात्रीं जगतो निवेशनीं ह्वयामि देवं सवितारमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
hvayamyagnim prathamam svastaye hvayami mitravarunavihavase |
hvayami ratrim jagato niveshanim hvayami devam savitaramutaye ||
verses.en:
AGNI I first invoke for our prosperity; I call on Mitra, Varuna, to aid us here.
I call on Night who gives rest to all moving life; I call on Savitar the God to lend us help.

verses.sa:
आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च ।
हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
a krishnena rajasa vartamano niveshayannamritam martyam cha |
hiranyayena savita rathena devo yati bhuvanani pashyan ||
verses.en:
Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal,
Borne in his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God who looks on every creature.

verses.sa:
याति देवः प्रवता यात्युद्वता याति शुभ्राभ्यां यजतो हरिभ्याम् ।
आ देवो याति सविता परावतोऽप विश्वा दुरिता बाधमानः ॥
verses.rom:
yati devah pravata yatyudvata yati shubhrabhyam yajato haribhyam |
a devo yati savita paravato'pa vishva durita badhamanah ||
verses.en:
The God moves by the upward path, the downward; with two bright Bays, adorable, he journeys.
Savitar comes, the God from the far distance, and chases from us all distress and sorrow.

verses.sa:
अभीवृतं कृशनैर्विश्वरूपं हिरण्यशम्यं यजतो बृहन्तम् ।
आस्थाद्रथं सविता चित्रभानुः कृष्णा रजांसि तविषीं दधानः ॥
verses.rom:
abhivritam krishanairvishvarupam hiranyashamyam yajato brihantam |
asthadratham savita chitrabhanuh krishna rajamsi tavishim dadhanah ||
verses.en:
His chariot decked with pearl, of various colours, lofty, with golden pole, the God hath mounted,
The many-rayed One, Savitar the holy, bound, bearing power and might, for darksome regions.

verses.sa:
वि जनाञ्छ्यावाः शितिपादो अख्यन्रथं हिरण्यप्रउगं वहन्तः ।
शश्वद्विशः सवितुर्दैव्यस्योपस्थे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
vi jananchhyavah shitipado akhyanratham hiranyapraugam vahantah |
shashvadvishah saviturdaivyasyopasthe vishva bhuvanani tasthuh ||
verses.en:
Drawing the gold-yoked car his Bays, white-footed, have manifested light to all the peoples.
Held in the lap of Savitar, divine One, all men, all beings have their place for ever.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो द्यावः सवितुर्द्वा उपस्थाँ एका यमस्य भुवने विराषाट् ।
आणिं न रथ्यममृताधि तस्थुरिह ब्रवीतु य उ तच्चिकेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro dyavah saviturdva upasthan eka yamasya bhuvane virashat |
anim na rathyamamritadhi tasthuriha bravitu ya u tachchiketat ||
verses.en:
Three heavens there are; two Savitar's, adjacent: in Yama's world is one, the home of heroes,
As on a linch-pin, firm, rest things immortal: he who hath known it let him here declare it.

verses.sa:
वि सुपर्णो अन्तरिक्षाण्यख्यद्गभीरवेपा असुरः सुनीथः ।
क्वेदानीं सूर्यः कश्चिकेत कतमां द्यां रश्मिरस्या ततान ॥
verses.rom:
vi suparno antarikshanyakhyadgabhiravepa asurah sunithah |
kvedanim suryah kashchiketa katamam dyam rashmirasya tatana ||
verses.en:
He, strong of wing, hath lightened up the regions, deep-quivering Asura, the gentle Leader.
Where now is Surya, where is one to tell us to what celestial sphere his ray hath wandered?

verses.sa:
अष्टौ व्यख्यत्ककुभः पृथिव्यास्त्री धन्व योजना सप्त सिन्धून् ।
हिरण्याक्षः सविता देव आगाद्दधद्रत्ना दाशुषे वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
ashtau vyakhyatkakubhah prithivyastri dhanva yojana sapta sindhun |
hiranyakshah savita deva agaddadhadratna dashushe varyani ||
verses.en:
The earth's eight points his brightness hath illumined, three desert regions and the Seven Rivers.
God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving choice treasures unto him who worships.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिः सविता विचर्षणिरुभे द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरीयते ।
अपामीवां बाधते वेति सूर्यमभि कृष्णेन रजसा द्यामृणोति ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyapanih savita vicharshanirubhe dyavaprithivi antariyate |
apamivam badhate veti suryamabhi krishnena rajasa dyamrinoti ||
verses.en:
The golden-handed Savitar, far-seeing, goes on his way between the earth and heaven,
Drives away sickness, bids the Sun approach us, and spreads the bright sky through the darksome region.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यहस्तो असुरः सुनीथः सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् ।
अपसेधन्रक्षसो यातुधानानस्थाद्देवः प्रतिदोषं गृणानः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyahasto asurah sunithah sumrilikah svavan yatvarvan |
apasedhanrakshaso yatudhananasthaddevah pratidosham grinanah ||
verses.en:
May he, gold-handed Asura, kind Leader, come hither to us with his help and favour.
Driving off Raksasas and Yatudhanas, the God is present, praised in hymns at evening.

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्थाः सवितः पूर्व्यासोऽरेणवः सुकृता अन्तरिक्षे ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पथिभिः सुगेभी रक्षा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देव ॥
verses.rom:
ye te panthah savitah purvyaso'renavah sukrita antarikshe |
tebhirno adya pathibhih sugebhi raksha cha no adhi cha bruhi deva ||
verses.en:
O Savitar, thine ancient dustless pathways are well established in the air's mid-region:
O God, come by those paths so fair to travel, preserve thou us from harm this day, and bless us.

verses.sa:
प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् ।
अग्निं सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिरीमहे यं सीमिदन्य ईळते ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo yahvam purunam visham devayatinam |
agnim suktebhirvachobhirimahe yam simidanya ilate ||
verses.en:
WITH words sent forth in holy hymns, Agni we supplicate, the Lord
Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others also praise.

verses.sa:
जनासो अग्निं दधिरे सहोवृधं हविष्मन्तो विधेम ते ।
स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना इहाविता भवा वाजेषु सन्त्य ॥
verses.rom:
janaso agnim dadhire sahovridham havishmanto vidhema te |
sa tvam no adya sumana ihavita bhava vajeshu santya ||
verses.en:
Men have won Agni, him who makes their strength abound: we, with oblations, worship thee.
Our gracious-minded Helper in our deeds of might, be thou, O Excellent, this day.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् ।
महस्ते सतो वि चरन्त्यर्चयो दिवि स्पृशन्ति भानवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra tva dutam vrinimahe hotaram vishvavedasam |
mahaste sato vi charantyarchayo divi sprishanti bhanavah ||
verses.en:
Thee for our messenger we choose, thee, the Omniscient, for our Priest.
The flames of thee the mighty are spread wide around: thy splendour reaches to the sky.

verses.sa:
देवासस्त्वा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा सं दूतं प्रत्नमिन्धते ।
विश्वं सो अग्ने जयति त्वया धनं यस्ते ददाश मर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
devasastva varuno mitro aryama sam dutam pratnamindhate |
vishvam so agne jayati tvaya dhanam yaste dadasha martyah ||
verses.en:
The Gods enkindle thee their ancient messenger,--Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
That mortal man, O Agni, gains through thee all wealth, who hath poured offerings unto thee.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रो होता गृहपतिरग्ने दूतो विशामसि ।
त्वे विश्वा संगतानि व्रता ध्रुवा यानि देवा अकृण्वत ॥
verses.rom:
mandro hota grihapatiragne duto vishamasi |
tve vishva samgatani vrata dhruva yani deva akrinvata ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art a cheering Priest, Lord of the House, men's messenger:
All constant high decrees established by the Gods, gathered together, meet in thee.

verses.sa:
त्वे इदग्ने सुभगे यविष्ठ्य विश्वमा हूयते हविः ।
स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना उतापरं यक्षि देवान्सुवीर्या ॥
verses.rom:
tve idagne subhage yavishthya vishvama huyate havih |
sa tvam no adya sumana utaparam yakshi devansuvirya ||
verses.en:
In thee, the auspicious One, O Agni, youthfullest, each sacred gift is offered up:
This day, and after, gracious, worship thou our Gods, that we may have heroic sons.

verses.sa:
तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते ।
होत्राभिरग्निं मनुषः समिन्धते तितिर्वांसो अति स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
tam ghemittha namasvina upa svarajamasate |
hotrabhiragnim manushah samindhate titirvamso ati sridhah ||
verses.en:
To him in his own splendour bright draw near in worship the devout.
Men kindle Agni with their sacrificial gifts, victorious o'er the enemies.

verses.sa:
घ्नन्तो वृत्रमतरन्रोदसी अप उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे ।
भुवत्कण्वे वृषा द्युम्न्याहुतः क्रन्ददश्वो गविष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
ghnanto vritramataranrodasi apa uru kshayaya chakrire |
bhuvatkanve vrisha dyumnyahutah krandadashvo gavishtishu ||
verses.en:
Vrtra they smote and slew, and made the earth and heaven and firmament a wide abode.
The glorious Bull, invoked, hath stood at Kanva's side: loud neighed the Steed in frays for kine.

verses.sa:
सं सीदस्व महाँ असि शोचस्व देववीतमः ।
वि धूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam sidasva mahan asi shochasva devavitamah |
vi dhumamagne arusham miyedhya srija prashasta darshatam ||
verses.en:
Seat thee, for thou art mighty; shine, best entertainer of the Gods.
Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवासो मनवे दधुरिह यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन ।
यं कण्वो मेध्यातिथिर्धनस्पृतं यं वृषा यमुपस्तुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva devaso manave dadhuriha yajishtham havyavahana |
yam kanvo medhyatithirdhanaspritam yam vrisha yamupastutah ||
verses.en:
Bearer of offerings, whom, best sacrificing Priest, the Gods for Manu's sake ordained;
Whom Kanva, whom Medhyatithi made the source of wealth, and Vrsan and Upastuta.

verses.sa:
यमग्निं मेध्यातिथिः कण्व ईध ऋतादधि ।
तस्य प्रेषो दीदियुस्तमिमा ऋचस्तमग्निं वर्धयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yamagnim medhyatithih kanva idha ritadadhi |
tasya presho didiyustamima richastamagnim vardhayamasi ||
verses.en:
Him, Agni, whom Medhyatithi, whom Kanva kindled for his rite,
Him these our songs of praise, him, Agni, we extol: his powers shine out preeminent.

verses.sa:
रायस्पूर्धि स्वधावोऽस्ति हि तेऽग्ने देवेष्वाप्यम् ।
त्वं वाजस्य श्रुत्यस्य राजसि स नो मृळ महाँ असि ॥
verses.rom:
rayaspurdhi svadhavo'sti hi te'gne deveshvapyam |
tvam vajasya shrutyasya rajasi sa no mrila mahan asi ||
verses.en:
Make our wealth perfect thou, O Agni, Lord divine: for thou hast kinship with the Gods.
Thou rulest as a King o'er widely-famous strength: be good to us, for thou art great.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता ।
ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva u shu na utaye tishtha devo na savita |
urdhvo vajasya sanita yadanjibhirvaghadbhirvihvayamahe ||
verses.en:
Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God:
Erect as strength-bestower we call aloud, with unguents and with priests, on thee.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्यंहसो नि केतुना विश्वं समत्रिणं दह ।
कृधी न ऊर्ध्वाञ्चरथाय जीवसे विदा देवेषु नो दुवः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo nah pahyamhaso ni ketuna vishvam samatrinam daha |
kridhi na urdhvancharathaya jivase vida deveshu no duvah ||
verses.en:
Erect, preserve us from sore trouble; with thy flame burn thou each ravening demon dead.
Raise thou us up that we may walk and live: so thou shalt find our worship mid the Gods.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षसः पाहि धूर्तेरराव्णः ।
पाहि रीषत उत वा जिघांसतो बृहद्भानो यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
pahi no agne rakshasah pahi dhurteraravnah |
pahi rishata uta va jighamsato brihadbhano yavishthya ||
verses.en:
Preserve us, Agni, from the fiend, preserve us from malicious wrong.
Save us from him who fain would injure us or slay, Most Youthful, thou with lofty light.

verses.sa:
घनेव विष्वग्वि जह्यराव्णस्तपुर्जम्भ यो अस्मध्रुक् ।
यो मर्त्यः शिशीते अत्यक्तुभिर्मा नः स रिपुरीशत ॥
verses.rom:
ghaneva vishvagvi jahyaravnastapurjambha yo asmadhruk |
yo martyah shishite atyaktubhirma nah sa ripurishata ||
verses.en:
Smite down as with a club, thou who hast fire for teeth, smite thou the wicked, right and left.
Let not the man who plots against us in the night, nor any foe prevail o'er us.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वव्ने सुवीर्यमग्निः कण्वाय सौभगम् ।
अग्निः प्रावन्मित्रोत मेध्यातिथिमग्निः साता उपस्तुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirvavne suviryamagnih kanvaya saubhagam |
agnih pravanmitrota medhyatithimagnih sata upastutam ||
verses.en:
Agni hath given heroic might to Kanva, and felicity:
Agni hath helped our friends, hath helped Medhyatithi, hath helped Upastuta to win.

verses.sa:
अग्निना तुर्वशं यदुं परावत उग्रादेवं हवामहे ।
अग्निर्नयन्नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं तुर्वीतिं दस्यवे सहः ॥
verses.rom:
agnina turvasham yadum paravata ugradevam havamahe |
agnirnayannavavastvam brihadratham turvitim dasyave sahah ||
verses.en:
We call on Ugradeva, Yadu, Turvasa, by means of Agni, from afar;
Agni, bring Navavastva and Brhadratha, Turviti, to subdue the foe.

verses.sa:
नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते ।
दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ni tvamagne manurdadhe jyotirjanaya shashvate |
didetha kanva ritajata ukshito yam namasyanti krishtayah ||
verses.en:
Manu hath stablished thee a light, Agni, for all the race of men:
Sprung from the Law, oil-fed, for Kanva hast thou blazed, thou whom the people reverence.

verses.sa:
त्वेषासो अग्नेरमवन्तो अर्चयो भीमासो न प्रतीतये ।
रक्षस्विनः सदमिद्यातुमावतो विश्वं समत्रिणं दह ॥
verses.rom:
tveshaso agneramavanto archayo bhimaso na pratitaye |
rakshasvinah sadamidyatumavato vishvam samatrinam daha ||
verses.en:
The flames of Agni full of splendour and of might are fearful, not to be approached.
Consume for ever all demons and sorcerers, consume thou each devouring fiend.

verses.sa:
क्रीळं वः शर्धो मारुतमनर्वाणं रथेशुभम् ।
कण्वा अभि प्र गायत ॥
verses.rom:
krilam vah shardho marutamanarvanam ratheshubham |
kanva abhi pra gayata ||
verses.en:
SING forth, O Kanvas, to your band of Maruts unassailable,
Sporting, resplendent on their car

verses.sa:
ये पृषतीभिरृष्टिभिः साकं वाशीभिरञ्जिभिः ।
अजायन्त स्वभानवः ॥
verses.rom:
ye prishatibhirrishtibhih sakam vashibhiranjibhih |
ajayanta svabhanavah ||
verses.en:
They who, self-luminous, were born together, with the spotted deer,
Spears, swords, and glittering ornaments.

verses.sa:
इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् ।
नि यामञ्चित्रमृञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
iheva shrinva esham kasha hasteshu yadvadan |
ni yamanchitramrinjate ||
verses.en:
One hears, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold
They gather glory on their way.

verses.sa:
प्र वः शर्धाय घृष्वये त्वेषद्युम्नाय शुष्मिणे ।
देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
verses.rom:
pra vah shardhaya ghrishvaye tveshadyumnaya shushmine |
devattam brahma gayata ||
verses.en:
Now sing ye forth the God-given hymn to your exultant Marut host,
The fiercely-vigorous, the strong.

verses.sa:
प्र शंसा गोष्वघ्न्यं क्रीळं यच्छर्धो मारुतम् ।
जम्भे रसस्य वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
pra shamsa goshvaghnyam krilam yachchhardho marutam |
jambhe rasasya vavridhe ||
verses.en:
Praise ye the Bull among the cows; for 'tis the Maruts' sportive band:
It strengthened as it drank the rain.

verses.sa:
को वो वर्षिष्ठ आ नरो दिवश्च ग्मश्च धूतयः ।
यत्सीमन्तं न धूनुथ ॥
verses.rom:
ko vo varshishtha a naro divashcha gmashcha dhutayah |
yatsimantam na dhunutha ||
verses.en:
Who is your mightiest, Heroes, when, O shakers of the earth and heaven,
Ye shake them like a garment's hem?

verses.sa:
नि वो यामाय मानुषो दध्र उग्राय मन्यवे ।
जिहीत पर्वतो गिरिः ॥
verses.rom:
ni vo yamaya manusho dadhra ugraya manyave |
jihita parvato girih ||
verses.en:
At your approach man holds him down before the fury of your wrath:
The rugged-jointed mountain yields.

verses.sa:
येषामज्मेषु पृथिवी जुजुर्वाँ इव विश्पतिः ।
भिया यामेषु रेजते ॥
verses.rom:
yeshamajmeshu prithivi jujurvan iva vishpatih |
bhiya yameshu rejate ||
verses.en:
They at whose racings forth the earth, like an age-weakened lord of men,
Trembles in terror on their ways.

verses.sa:
स्थिरं हि जानमेषां वयो मातुर्निरेतवे ।
यत्सीमनु द्विता शवः ॥
verses.rom:
sthiram hi janamesham vayo maturniretave |
yatsimanu dvita shavah ||
verses.en:
Strong is their birth: vigour have they to issue from their Mother; strength,
Yea, even twice enough, is theirs.

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा अज्मेष्वत्नत ।
वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye sunavo girah kashtha ajmeshvatnata |
vashra abhijnu yatave ||
verses.en:
And these, the Sons, the Singers, in their racings have enlarged the bounds,
So that the kine must walk knee-deep.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिद्घा दीर्घं पृथुं मिहो नपातममृध्रम् ।
प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tyam chidgha dirgham prithum miho napatamamridhram |
pra chyavayanti yamabhih ||
verses.en:
Before them, on the ways they go, they drop this offspring of the cloud,
Long, broad, and inexhaustible.

verses.sa:
मरुतो यद्ध वो बलं जनाँ अचुच्यवीतन ।
गिरीँरचुच्यवीतन ॥
verses.rom:
maruto yaddha vo balam janan achuchyavitana |
girinrachuchyavitana ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, as your strength is great, so have ye cast men down on earth,
So have ye made the mountains fall.

verses.sa:
यद्ध यान्ति मरुतः सं ह ब्रुवतेऽध्वन्ना ।
शृणोति कश्चिदेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha yanti marutah sam ha bruvate'dhvanna |
shrinoti kashchidesham ||
verses.en:
The while the Maruts pass along, they talk together on the way:
Doth any hear them as they speak?

verses.sa:
प्र यात शीभमाशुभिः सन्ति कण्वेषु वो दुवः ।
तत्रो षु मादयाध्वै ॥
verses.rom:
pra yata shibhamashubhih santi kanveshu vo duvah |
tatro shu madayadhvai ||
verses.en:
Come quick with swift steeds, for ye have worshippers among Kanva's sons
May you rejoice among them well.

verses.sa:
अस्ति हि ष्मा मदाय वः स्मसि ष्मा वयमेषाम् ।
विश्वं चिदायुर्जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
asti hi shma madaya vah smasi shma vayamesham |
vishvam chidayurjivase ||
verses.en:
All is prepared for your delight. We are their servants evermore,
To live as long as life may last.

verses.sa:
कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियः पिता पुत्रं न हस्तयोः ।
दधिध्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
verses.rom:
kaddha nunam kadhapriyah pita putram na hastayoh |
dadhidhve vriktabarhishah ||
verses.en:
WHAT now? When will ye take us by both hands, as a dear sire his son,
Gods, for whom sacred grass is clipped?

verses.sa:
क्व नूनं कद्वो अर्थं गन्ता दिवो न पृथिव्याः ।
क्व वो गावो न रण्यन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
kva nunam kadvo artham ganta divo na prithivyah |
kva vo gavo na ranyanti ||
verses.en:
Now whither? To what goal of yours go ye in heaven, and not on earth?
Where do your cows disport themselves?

verses.sa:
क्व वः सुम्ना नव्यांसि मरुतः क्व सुविता ।
क्वो विश्वानि सौभगा ॥
verses.rom:
kva vah sumna navyamsi marutah kva suvita |
kvo vishvani saubhaga ||
verses.en:
Where are your newest favours shown? Where, Maruts, your prosperity?
Where all your high felicities?

verses.sa:
यद्यूयं पृश्निमातरो मर्तासः स्यातन ।
स्तोता वो अमृतः स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyuyam prishnimataro martasah syatana |
stota vo amritah syat ||
verses.en:
If, O ye Maruts, ye the Sons whom Prsni bore, were mortal, and
Immortal he who sings your praise.

verses.sa:
मा वो मृगो न यवसे जरिता भूदजोष्यः ।
पथा यमस्य गादुप ॥
verses.rom:
ma vo mrigo na yavase jarita bhudajoshyah |
patha yamasya gadupa ||
verses.en:
Then never were your praiser loathed like a wild beast in pasture-land,
Nor should he go on Yama's path.

verses.sa:
मो षु णः परापरा निरृतिर्दुर्हणा वधीत् ।
पदीष्ट तृष्णया सह ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu nah parapara nirritirdurhana vadhit |
padishta trishnaya saha ||
verses.en:
Let not destructive plague on plague hard to be conquered, strike its down:
Let each, with drought, depart from us.

verses.sa:
सत्यं त्वेषा अमवन्तो धन्वञ्चिदा रुद्रियासः ।
मिहं कृण्वन्त्यवाताम् ॥
verses.rom:
satyam tvesha amavanto dhanvanchida rudriyasah |
miham krinvantyavatam ||
verses.en:
Truly, they the fierce and mighty Sons of Rudra send their windless
Rain e'en on the desert places.

verses.sa:
वाश्रेव विद्युन्मिमाति वत्सं न माता सिषक्ति ।
यदेषां वृष्टिरसर्जि ॥
verses.rom:
vashreva vidyunmimati vatsam na mata sishakti |
yadesham vrishtirasarji ||
verses.en:
Like a cow the lightning lows and follows, motherlike, her youngling,
When their rain-flood hath been loosened.

verses.sa:
दिवा चित्तमः कृण्वन्ति पर्जन्येनोदवाहेन ।
यत्पृथिवीं व्युन्दन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
diva chittamah krinvanti parjanyenodavahena |
yatprithivim vyundanti ||
verses.en:
When they inundate the earth they spread forth darkness e'en in day time,
With the water-laden rain-cloud.

verses.sa:
अध स्वनान्मरुतां विश्वमा सद्म पार्थिवम् ।
अरेजन्त प्र मानुषाः ॥
verses.rom:
adha svananmarutam vishvama sadma parthivam |
arejanta pra manushah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, at your voice's sound this earthly habitation shakes,
And each man reels who dwells therein.

verses.sa:
मरुतो वीळुपाणिभिश्चित्रा रोधस्वतीरनु ।
यातेमखिद्रयामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
maruto vilupanibhishchitra rodhasvatiranu |
yatemakhidrayamabhih ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, with your strong-hoofed steeds, unhindered in their courses, haste
Along the bright embanked streams.

verses.sa:
स्थिरा वः सन्तु नेमयो रथा अश्वास एषाम् ।
सुसंस्कृता अभीशवः ॥
verses.rom:
sthira vah santu nemayo ratha ashvasa esham |
susamskrita abhishavah ||
verses.en:
Firm be the fellies of your wheels, steady your horses and your cars,
And may your reins be fashioned well.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वदा तना गिरा जरायै ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् ।
अग्निं मित्रं न दर्शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha vada tana gira jarayai brahmanaspatim |
agnim mitram na darshatam ||
verses.en:
Invite thou hither with this song, for praise, Agni the Lord of Prayer,
Him who is fair as Mitra is.

verses.sa:
मिमीहि श्लोकमास्ये पर्जन्य इव ततनः ।
गाय गायत्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
mimihi shlokamasye parjanya iva tatanah |
gaya gayatramukthyam ||
verses.en:
Form in thy mouth the hymn of praise expand thee like, a rainy cloud
Sing forth the measured eulogy.

verses.sa:
वन्दस्व मारुतं गणं त्वेषं पनस्युमर्किणम् ।
अस्मे वृद्धा असन्निह ॥
verses.rom:
vandasva marutam ganam tvesham panasyumarkinam |
asme vriddha asanniha ||
verses.en:
Sing glory to the Marut host, praiseworthy, tuneful, vigorous:
Here let the Strong Ones dwell with us.

verses.sa:
प्र यदित्था परावतः शोचिर्न मानमस्यथ ।
कस्य क्रत्वा मरुतः कस्य वर्पसा कं याथ कं ह धूतयः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadittha paravatah shochirna manamasyatha |
kasya kratva marutah kasya varpasa kam yatha kam ha dhutayah ||
verses.en:
WHEN thus, like flame, from far away, Maruts, ye cast your measure forth,
To whom go Ye, to whom, O shakers of the earth, moved by whose wisdom, whose design?

verses.sa:
स्थिरा वः सन्त्वायुधा पराणुदे वीळू उत प्रतिष्कभे ।
युष्माकमस्तु तविषी पनीयसी मा मर्त्यस्य मायिनः ॥
verses.rom:
sthira vah santvayudha paranude vilu uta pratishkabhe |
yushmakamastu tavishi paniyasi ma martyasya mayinah ||
verses.en:
Strong let your weapons be to drive away your foes, firm for resistance let them be.
Yea, passing glorious must be your warrior might, not as a guileful mortal's strength.

verses.sa:
परा ह यत्स्थिरं हथ नरो वर्तयथा गुरु ।
वि याथन वनिनः पृथिव्या व्याशाः पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
para ha yatsthiram hatha naro vartayatha guru |
vi yathana vaninah prithivya vyashah parvatanam ||
verses.en:
When what is strong ye overthrow, and whirl about each ponderous thing,
Heroes, your course is through the forest trees of earth, and through the fissures of the rocks.

verses.sa:
नहि वः शत्रुर्विविदे अधि द्यवि न भूम्यां रिशादसः ।
युष्माकमस्तु तविषी तना युजा रुद्रासो नू चिदाधृषे ॥
verses.rom:
nahi vah shatrurvivide adhi dyavi na bhumyam rishadasah |
yushmakamastu tavishi tana yuja rudraso nu chidadhrishe ||
verses.en:
Consumers of your foes, no enemy of yours is found in heaven or on the earth:
Ye Rudras, may the strength, held in this bond, be yours, to bid defiance even now.

verses.sa:
प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान्वि विञ्चन्ति वनस्पतीन् ।
प्रो आरत मरुतो दुर्मदा इव देवासः सर्वया विशा ॥
verses.rom:
pra vepayanti parvatanvi vinchanti vanaspatin |
pro arata maruto durmada iva devasah sarvaya visha ||
verses.en:
They make the mountains rock and reel, they rend the forest-kings apart.
Onward, ye Maruts, drive, like creatures drunk with wine, ye, Gods with all your company.

verses.sa:
उपो रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः ।
आ वो यामाय पृथिवी चिदश्रोदबीभयन्त मानुषाः ॥
verses.rom:
upo ratheshu prishatirayugdhvam prashtirvahati rohitah |
a vo yamaya prithivi chidashrodabibhayanta manushah ||
verses.en:
Ye to your chariot have yoked the spotted deer: a red deer, as a leader, draws.
Even the Earth herself listened as ye came near, and men were sorely terrified.

verses.sa:
आ वो मक्षू तनाय कं रुद्रा अवो वृणीमहे ।
गन्ता नूनं नोऽवसा यथा पुरेत्था कण्वाय बिभ्युषे ॥
verses.rom:
a vo makshu tanaya kam rudra avo vrinimahe |
ganta nunam no'vasa yatha purettha kanvaya bibhyushe ||
verses.en:
O Rudras, quickly we desire your succour for this work of ours.
Come to us with your aid as in the days of old, so now for frightened Kanva's sake.

verses.sa:
युष्मेषितो मरुतो मर्त्येषित आ यो नो अभ्व ईषते ।
वि तं युयोत शवसा व्योजसा वि युष्माकाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yushmeshito maruto martyeshita a yo no abhva ishate |
vi tam yuyota shavasa vyojasa vi yushmakabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
Should any monstrous foe, O Maruts, sent by you or sent by mortals threaten us,
Tear ye him from us with your power and with your might, and with the succours that are yours.

verses.sa:
असामि हि प्रयज्यवः कण्वं दद प्रचेतसः ।
असामिभिर्मरुत आ न ऊतिभिर्गन्ता वृष्टिं न विद्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
asami hi prayajyavah kanvam dada prachetasah |
asamibhirmaruta a na utibhirganta vrishtim na vidyutah ||
verses.en:
For ye, the worshipful and wise, have guarded Kanva perfectly.
O Maruts, come to us with full protecting help, as lightning flashes seek the rain.

verses.sa:
असाम्योजो बिभृथा सुदानवोऽसामि धूतयः शवः ।
ऋषिद्विषे मरुतः परिमन्यव इषुं न सृजत द्विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
asamyojo bibhritha sudanavo'sami dhutayah shavah |
rishidvishe marutah parimanyava ishum na srijata dvisham ||
verses.en:
Whole strength have ye, O Bounteous Ones; perfect, earth-shakers, is your might.
Maruts, against the poet's wrathful enemy send ye an enemy like a dart.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवयन्तस्त्वेमहे ।
उप प्र यन्तु मरुतः सुदानव इन्द्र प्राशूर्भवा सचा ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha brahmanaspate devayantastvemahe |
upa pra yantu marutah sudanava indra prashurbhava sacha ||
verses.en:
O BRAMANASPATI, stand up: God-serving men we pray to thee.
May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra, most swift, be thou with them.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि सहसस्पुत्र मर्त्य उपब्रूते धने हिते ।
सुवीर्यं मरुत आ स्वश्व्यं दधीत यो व आचके ॥
verses.rom:
tvamiddhi sahasasputra martya upabrute dhane hite |
suviryam maruta a svashvyam dadhita yo va achake ||
verses.en:
O Son of Strength, each mortal calls to thee for aid when spoil of battle waits for him.
O Maruts, may this man who loves you well obtain wealth of good steeds and hero might.

verses.sa:
प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता ।
अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
praitu brahmanaspatih pra devyetu sunrita |
achchha viram naryam panktiradhasam deva yajnam nayantu nah ||
verses.en:
May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may Sunrta the Goddess come,
And Gods bring to this rite which gives the five-fold gift the Hero, lover of mankind.

verses.sa:
यो वाघते ददाति सूनरं वसु स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः ।
तस्मा इळां सुवीरामा यजामहे सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vaghate dadati sunaram vasu sa dhatte akshiti shravah |
tasma ilam suvirama yajamahe supraturtimanehasam ||
verses.en:
He who bestows a noble guerdon on the priest wins fame that never shall decay.
For him we offer sacred hero-giving food, peerless and conquering easily.

verses.sa:
प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम् ।
यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
pra nunam brahmanaspatirmantram vadatyukthyam |
yasminnindro varuno mitro aryama deva okamsi chakrire ||
verses.en:
Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn of praise,
Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods, have made their dwelling place.

verses.sa:
तमिद्वोचेमा विदथेषु शम्भुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् ।
इमां च वाचं प्रतिहर्यथा नरो विश्वेद्वामा वो अश्नवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamidvochema vidatheshu shambhuvam mantram deva anehasam |
imam cha vacham pratiharyatha naro vishvedvama vo ashnavat ||
verses.en:
May we in holy synods, Gods! recite that hymn, peerless, that brings felicity.
If you, O Heroes, graciously accept this word, may it obtain all bliss from you.

verses.sa:
को देवयन्तमश्नवज्जनं को वृक्तबर्हिषम् ।
प्रप्र दाश्वान्पस्त्याभिरस्थितान्तर्वावत्क्षयं दधे ॥
verses.rom:
ko devayantamashnavajjanam ko vriktabarhisham |
prapra dashvanpastyabhirasthitantarvavatkshayam dadhe ||
verses.en:
Who shall approach the pious? who the man whose sacred grass is trimmed?
The offerer with his folk advances more and more: he fills his house with precious things.

verses.sa:
उप क्षत्रं पृञ्चीत हन्ति राजभिर्भये चित्सुक्षितिं दधे ।
नास्य वर्ता न तरुता महाधने नार्भे अस्ति वज्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
upa kshatram princhita hanti rajabhirbhaye chitsukshitim dadhe |
nasya varta na taruta mahadhane narbhe asti vajrinah ||
verses.en:
He amplifies his lordly might, with kings he slays: e'en mid alarms he dwells secure
In great or lesser fight none checks him, none subdues,--the wielder of the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
यं रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
नू चित्स दभ्यते जनः ॥
verses.rom:
yam rakshanti prachetaso varuno mitro aryama |
nu chitsa dabhyate janah ||
verses.en:
NE'ER is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
The excellently wise, protect.

verses.sa:
यं बाहुतेव पिप्रति पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः ।
अरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
verses.rom:
yam bahuteva piprati panti martyam rishah |
arishtah sarva edhate ||
verses.en:
He prospers ever, free from scathe, whom they, as with full hands, enrich,
Whom they preserve from every foe.

verses.sa:
वि दुर्गा वि द्विषः पुरो घ्नन्ति राजान एषाम् ।
नयन्ति दुरिता तिरः ॥
verses.rom:
vi durga vi dvishah puro ghnanti rajana esham |
nayanti durita tirah ||
verses.en:
The Kings drive far away from him his troubles and his enemies,
And lead him safely o'er distress.

verses.sa:
सुगः पन्था अनृक्षर आदित्यास ऋतं यते ।
नात्रावखादो अस्ति वः ॥
verses.rom:
sugah pantha anrikshara adityasa ritam yate |
natravakhado asti vah ||
verses.en:
Thornless, Adityas, is the path, easy for him who seeks the Law:
With him is naught to anger you.

verses.sa:
यं यज्ञं नयथा नर आदित्या ऋजुना पथा ।
प्र वः स धीतये नशत् ॥
verses.rom:
yam yajnam nayatha nara aditya rijuna patha |
pra vah sa dhitaye nashat ||
verses.en:
What sacrifice, Adityas, ye Heroes guide by the path direct,--
May that come nigh unto your thought.

verses.sa:
स रत्नं मर्त्यो वसु विश्वं तोकमुत त्मना ।
अच्छा गच्छत्यस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa ratnam martyo vasu vishvam tokamuta tmana |
achchha gachchhatyastritah ||
verses.en:
That mortal, ever unsubdued, gains wealth and every precious thing,
And children also of his own.

verses.sa:
कथा राधाम सखाय स्तोमं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः ।
महि प्सरो वरुणस्य ॥
verses.rom:
katha radhama sakhaya stomam mitrasyaryamnah |
mahi psaro varunasya ||
verses.en:
How, my friends, shall we prepare Aryaman's and Mitra's laud,
Glorious food of Varuna?

verses.sa:
मा वो घ्नन्तं मा शपन्तं प्रति वोचे देवयन्तम् ।
सुम्नैरिद्व आ विवासे ॥
verses.rom:
ma vo ghnantam ma shapantam prati voche devayantam |
sumnairidva a vivase ||
verses.en:
I point not out to you a man who strikes the pious, or reviles:
Only with hymns I call you nigh.

verses.sa:
चतुरश्चिद्ददमानाद्बिभीयादा निधातोः ।
न दुरुक्ताय स्पृहयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturashchiddadamanadbibhiyada nidhatoh |
na duruktaya sprihayet ||
verses.en:
Let him not love to speak ill words: but fear the One who holds all four
Within his hand, until they fall.

verses.sa:
सं पूषन्नध्वनस्तिर व्यंहो विमुचो नपात् ।
सक्ष्वा देव प्र णस्पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
sam pushannadhvanastira vyamho vimucho napat |
sakshva deva pra naspurah ||
verses.en:
SHORTEN our ways, O Pusan, move aside obstruction in the path:
Go close before us, cloud-born God.

verses.sa:
यो नः पूषन्नघो वृको दुःशेव आदिदेशति ।
अप स्म तं पथो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah pushannagho vriko duhsheva adideshati |
apa sma tam patho jahi ||
verses.en:
Drive, Pusan, from our road the wolf, the wicked inauspicious wolf,
Who lies in wait to injure us.

verses.sa:
अप त्यं परिपन्थिनं मुषीवाणं हुरश्चितम् ।
दूरमधि स्रुतेरज ॥
verses.rom:
apa tyam paripanthinam mushivanam hurashchitam |
duramadhi sruteraja ||
verses.en:
Who lurks about the path we take, the robber with a guileful heart:
Far from the road chase him away.

verses.sa:
त्वं तस्य द्वयाविनोऽघशंसस्य कस्य चित् ।
पदाभि तिष्ठ तपुषिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tasya dvayavino'ghashamsasya kasya chit |
padabhi tishtha tapushim ||
verses.en:
Tread with thy foot and trample out the firebrand of the wicked one,
The double-tongued, whoe'er he be.

verses.sa:
आ तत्ते दस्र मन्तुमः पूषन्नवो वृणीमहे ।
येन पितॄनचोदयः ॥
verses.rom:
a tatte dasra mantumah pushannavo vrinimahe |
yena pitrinachodayah ||
verses.en:
Wise Pusan, Wonder-Worker, we claim of thee now the aid wherewith
Thou furtheredst our sires of old.

verses.sa:
अधा नो विश्वसौभग हिरण्यवाशीमत्तम ।
