धनानि सुषणा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
adha no vishvasaubhaga hiranyavashimattama |
dhanani sushana kridhi ||
verses.en:
So, Lord of all prosperity, best wielder of the golden sword,
Make riches easy to be won.

verses.sa:
अति नः सश्चतो नय सुगा नः सुपथा कृणु ।
पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
verses.rom:
ati nah sashchato naya suga nah supatha krinu |
pushanniha kratum vidah ||
verses.en:
Past all pursuers lead us, make pleasant our path and fair to tread:
O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa:
अभि सूयवसं नय न नवज्वारो अध्वने ।
पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi suyavasam naya na navajvaro adhvane |
pushanniha kratum vidah ||
verses.en:
Lead us to meadows rich in grass: send on our way no early heat:
O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa:
शग्धि पूर्धि प्र यंसि च शिशीहि प्रास्युदरम् ।
पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhi purdhi pra yamsi cha shishihi prasyudaram |
pushanniha kratum vidah ||
verses.en:
Be gracious to us, fill us full, give, feed us, and invigorate:
O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa:
न पूषणं मेथामसि सूक्तैरभि गृणीमसि ।
वसूनि दस्ममीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
na pushanam methamasi suktairabhi grinimasi |
vasuni dasmamimahe ||
verses.en:
No blame have we for Pusan; him we magnify with songs of praise:
We seek the Mighty One for wealth.

verses.sa:
कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे मीळ्हुष्टमाय तव्यसे ।
वोचेम शंतमं हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
kadrudraya prachetase milhushtamaya tavyase |
vochema shamtamam hride ||
verses.en:
WHAT shall we sing to Rudra, strong, most bounteous, excellently wise,
That shall be dearest to his heart?

verses.sa:
यथा नो अदितिः करत्पश्वे नृभ्यो यथा गवे ।
यथा तोकाय रुद्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha no aditih karatpashve nribhyo yatha gave |
yatha tokaya rudriyam ||
verses.en:
That Aditi may grant the grace of Rudra to our folk, our kine,
Our cattle and our progeny;

verses.sa:
यथा नो मित्रो वरुणो यथा रुद्रश्चिकेतति ।
यथा विश्वे सजोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha no mitro varuno yatha rudrashchiketati |
yatha vishve sajoshasah ||
verses.en:
That Mitra and that Varuna, that Rudra may remember us,
Yea, all the Gods with one accord.

verses.sa:
गाथपतिं मेधपतिं रुद्रं जलाषभेषजम् ।
तच्छंयोः सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
gathapatim medhapatim rudram jalashabheshajam |
tachchhamyoh sumnamimahe ||
verses.en:
To Rudra Lord of sacrifice, of hymns and balmy medicines,
We pray for joy and health and strength.

verses.sa:
यः शुक्र इव सूर्यो हिरण्यमिव रोचते ।
श्रेष्ठो देवानां वसुः ॥
verses.rom:
yah shukra iva suryo hiranyamiva rochate |
shreshtho devanam vasuh ||
verses.en:
He shines in splendour like the Sun, refulgent as bright gold is he,
The good, the best among the Gods.

verses.sa:
शं नः करत्यर्वते सुगं मेषाय मेष्ये ।
नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो गवे ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah karatyarvate sugam meshaya meshye |
nribhyo naribhyo gave ||
verses.en:
May he grant health into our steeds, wellbeing to our rams and ewes,
To men, to women, and to kine.

verses.sa:
अस्मे सोम श्रियमधि नि धेहि शतस्य नृणाम् ।
महि श्रवस्तुविनृम्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
asme soma shriyamadhi ni dhehi shatasya nrinam |
mahi shravastuvinrimnam ||
verses.en:
O Soma, set thou upon us the glory of a hundred men,
The great renown of mighty chiefs.

verses.sa:
मा नः सोमपरिबाधो मारातयो जुहुरन्त ।
आ न इन्दो वाजे भज ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah somaparibadho maratayo juhuranta |
a na indo vaje bhaja ||
verses.en:
Let not malignities, nor those who trouble Soma, hinder us.
Indu, give us a share of strength.

verses.sa:
यास्ते प्रजा अमृतस्य परस्मिन्धामन्नृतस्य ।
मूर्धा नाभा सोम वेन आभूषन्तीः सोम वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste praja amritasya parasmindhamannritasya |
murdha nabha soma vena abhushantih soma vedah ||
verses.en:
Soma! head, central point, love these; Soma! know these as serving thee,
Children of thee Immortal, at the highest place of holy law.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रं राधो अमर्त्य ।
आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाँ उषर्बुधः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vivasvadushasashchitram radho amartya |
a dashushe jatavedo vaha tvamadya devan usharbudhah ||
verses.en:
IMMORTAL Jatavedas, thou many-hued fulgent gift of Dawn,
Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनोऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ।
सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
jushto hi duto asi havyavahano'gne rathiradhvaranam |
sajurashvibhyamushasa suviryamasme dhehi shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
For thou art offering-bearer and loved messenger, the charioteer of sacrifice:
Accordant with the Asvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame.

verses.sa:
अद्या दूतं वृणीमहे वसुमग्निं पुरुप्रियम् ।
धूमकेतुं भाऋजीकं व्युष्टिषु यज्ञानामध्वरश्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
adya dutam vrinimahe vasumagnim purupriyam |
dhumaketum bharijikam vyushtishu yajnanamadhvarashriyam ||
verses.en:
As messenger we choose to-day Agni the good whom many love,
Smoke-bannered spreader of the light, at break of day glory of sacrificial rites.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठमतिथिं स्वाहुतं जुष्टं जनाय दाशुषे ।
देवाँ अच्छा यातवे जातवेदसमग्निमीळे व्युष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
shreshtham yavishthamatithim svahutam jushtam janaya dashushe |
devan achchha yatave jatavedasamagnimile vyushtishu ||
verses.en:
Him noblest and most youthful, richly worshipped guest, dear to the men who offer gifts,
Him, Agni Jatavedas, I beseech at dawn that he may bring the Gods to us.

verses.sa:
स्तविष्यामि त्वामहं विश्वस्यामृत भोजन ।
अग्ने त्रातारममृतं मियेध्य यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन ॥
verses.rom:
stavishyami tvamaham vishvasyamrita bhojana |
agne trataramamritam miyedhya yajishtham havyavahana ||
verses.en:
Thee, Agni, will I glorify, deathless nourisher of the world,
Immortal, offering-bearer, meet for sacred food, preserver, best at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सुशंसो बोधि गृणते यविष्ठ्य मधुजिह्वः स्वाहुतः ।
प्रस्कण्वस्य प्रतिरन्नायुर्जीवसे नमस्या दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sushamso bodhi grinate yavishthya madhujihvah svahutah |
praskanvasya pratirannayurjivase namasya daivyam janam ||
verses.en:
Tell good things to thy praiser, O most youthful God, as richly worshipped, honey-tongued,
And, granting to Praskanva lengthened days of life, show honour to the Heavenly Host.

verses.sa:
होतारं विश्ववेदसं सं हि त्वा विश इन्धते ।
स आ वह पुरुहूत प्रचेतसोऽग्ने देवाँ इह द्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
hotaram vishvavedasam sam hi tva visha indhate |
sa a vaha puruhuta prachetaso'gne devan iha dravat ||
verses.en:
For the men, Agni, kindle thee as all possessor and as Priest;
So Agni, much-invoked, bring hither with all speed the Gods, the excellently wise,

verses.sa:
सवितारमुषसमश्विना भगमग्निं व्युष्टिषु क्षपः ।
कण्वासस्त्वा सुतसोमास इन्धते हव्यवाहं स्वध्वर ॥
verses.rom:
savitaramushasamashvina bhagamagnim vyushtishu kshapah |
kanvasastva sutasomasa indhate havyavaham svadhvara ||
verses.en:
At dawn of day, at night, Usas and Savitar, the Asvins, Bhaga, Agni's self:
Skilled in fair rites, with Soma poured, the Kanvas light thee, the oblation-wafting God.

verses.sa:
पतिर्ह्यध्वराणामग्ने दूतो विशामसि ।
उषर्बुध आ वह सोमपीतये देवाँ अद्य स्वर्दृशः ॥
verses.rom:
patirhyadhvaranamagne duto vishamasi |
usharbudha a vaha somapitaye devan adya svardrishah ||
verses.en:
For, Agni, Lord of sacrifice and messenger of men art thou:
Bring thou the Gods who wake at dawn who see the light, this day to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पूर्वा अनूषसो विभावसो दीदेथ विश्वदर्शतः ।
असि ग्रामेष्वविता पुरोहितोऽसि यज्ञेषु मानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
agne purva anushaso vibhavaso didetha vishvadarshatah |
asi grameshvavita purohito'si yajneshu manushah ||
verses.en:
Thou shonest forth, O Agni, after former dawns, all visible, O rich in light.
Thou art our help in battle-strife, the Friend of man, the great high priest in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा यज्ञस्य साधनमग्ने होतारमृत्विजम् ।
मनुष्वद्देव धीमहि प्रचेतसं जीरं दूतममर्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva yajnasya sadhanamagne hotaramritvijam |
manushvaddeva dhimahi prachetasam jiram dutamamartyam ||
verses.en:
Like Manu, we will stablish thee, Agni, performer of the rite,
Invoker, ministering Priest, exceeding wise, the swift immortal messenger.

verses.sa:
यद्देवानां मित्रमहः पुरोहितोऽन्तरो यासि दूत्यम् ।
सिन्धोरिव प्रस्वनितास ऊर्मयोऽग्नेर्भ्राजन्ते अर्चयः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddevanam mitramahah purohito'ntaro yasi dutyam |
sindhoriva prasvanitasa urmayo'gnerbhrajante archayah ||
verses.en:
When as the Gods' High Priest, by many loved, thou dost their mission as their nearest Friend,
Then, like the far-resounding billows of the flood, thy flames, O Agni, roar aloud.

verses.sa:
श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः ।
आ सीदन्तु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावाणो अध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi shrutkarna vahnibhirdevairagne sayavabhih |
a sidantu barhishi mitro aryama prataryavano adhvaram ||
verses.en:
Hear, Agni, who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods;
Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
शृण्वन्तु स्तोमं मरुतः सुदानवोऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः ।
पिबतु सोमं वरुणो धृतव्रतोऽश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः ॥
verses.rom:
shrinvantu stomam marutah sudanavo'gnijihva ritavridhah |
pibatu somam varuno dhritavrato'shvibhyamushasa sajuh ||
verses.en:
Let those who strengthen Law, who bountifully give, the life-tongued Maruts, hear our praise.
May Law-supporting Varuna with the Asvins twain and Usas, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वसूँरिह रुद्राँ आदित्याँ उत ।
यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vasunriha rudran adityan uta |
yaja svadhvaram janam manujatam ghritaprusham ||
verses.en:
WORSHIP the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras, the Adityas, all
Who spring from Manu, those who know fair rites, who pour their blessings down.

verses.sa:
श्रुष्टीवानो हि दाशुषे देवा अग्ने विचेतसः ।
तान्रोहिदश्व गिर्वणस्त्रयस्त्रिंशतमा वह ॥
verses.rom:
shrushtivano hi dashushe deva agne vichetasah |
tanrohidashva girvanastrayastrimshatama vaha ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Gods who understand give ear unto the worshipper:
Lord of Red Steeds, who lovest song, bring thou those Three-and-Thirty Gods.

verses.sa:
प्रियमेधवदत्रिवज्जातवेदो विरूपवत् ।
अङ्गिरस्वन्महिव्रत प्रस्कण्वस्य श्रुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
priyamedhavadatrivajjatavedo virupavat |
angirasvanmahivrata praskanvasya shrudhi havam ||
verses.en:
O Jatavedas, great in act, hearken thou to Praskanva's call,
As Priyamedha erst was heard, Atri, Virupa, Angiras.

verses.sa:
महिकेरव ऊतये प्रियमेधा अहूषत ।
राजन्तमध्वराणामग्निं शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
mahikerava utaye priyamedha ahushata |
rajantamadhvaranamagnim shukrena shochisha ||
verses.en:
The sons of Priyamedha skilled in lofty praise have called for help
On Agni who with fulgent flame is Ruler of all holy rites.

verses.sa:
घृताहवन सन्त्येमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ।
याभिः कण्वस्य सूनवो हवन्तेऽवसे त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ghritahavana santyema u shu shrudhi girah |
yabhih kanvasya sunavo havante'vase tva ||
verses.en:
Hear thou, invoked with holy oil, bountiful giver of rewards,
These eulogies, whereby the sons of Kanva call thee to their aid.

verses.sa:
त्वां चित्रश्रवस्तम हवन्ते विक्षु जन्तवः ।
शोचिष्केशं पुरुप्रियाग्ने हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam chitrashravastama havante vikshu jantavah |
shochishkesham purupriyagne havyaya volhave ||
verses.en:
O Agni, loved by many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes
Men call on thee whose hair is flame, to be the bearer of their gifts.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा होतारमृत्विजं दधिरे वसुवित्तमम् ।
श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं विप्रा अग्ने दिविष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva hotaramritvijam dadhire vasuvittamam |
shrutkarnam saprathastamam vipra agne divishtishu ||
verses.en:
Thee, Agni, best to find out wealth, most widely famous, quick to hear,
Singers have stablished in their rites Herald and ministering Priest.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विप्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतसोमा अभि प्रयः ।
बृहद्भा बिभ्रतो हविरग्ने मर्ताय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vipra achuchyavuh sutasoma abhi prayah |
brihadbha bibhrato haviragne martaya dashushe ||
verses.en:
Singers with Soma pressed have made thee, Agni, hasten to the feast,
Great light to mortal worshipper, what time they bring the sacred gift.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्याव्णः सहस्कृत सोमपेयाय सन्त्य ।
इहाद्य दैव्यं जनं बर्हिरा सादया वसो ॥
verses.rom:
prataryavnah sahaskrita somapeyaya santya |
ihadya daivyam janam barhira sadaya vaso ||
verses.en:
Good, bounteous, Son of Strength, this day seat here on sacred grass the Gods
Who come at early morn, the host of heaven, to drink the Soma juice

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चं दैव्यं जनमग्ने यक्ष्व सहूतिभिः ।
अयं सोमः सुदानवस्तं पात तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
arvancham daivyam janamagne yakshva sahutibhih |
ayam somah sudanavastam pata tiroahnyam ||
verses.en:
Bring with joint invocations thou, O Agni, the celestial host:
Here stands the Soma, bounteous Gods drink this expressed ere yesterday.

verses.sa:
एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः ।
स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
esho usha apurvya vyuchchhati priya divah |
stushe vamashvina brihat ||
verses.en:
Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear Daughter of the Sky:
High, Asvins, I extol your praise,

verses.sa:
या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् ।
धिया देवा वसुविदा ॥
verses.rom:
ya dasra sindhumatara manotara rayinam |
dhiya deva vasuvida ||
verses.en:
Sons of the Sea, mighty to save discoverers of riches, ye
Gods with deep thought who find out wealth.

verses.sa:
वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि ।
यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
verses.rom:
vachyante vam kakuhaso jurnayamadhi vishtapi |
yadvam ratho vibhishpatat ||
verses.en:
Your giant coursers hasten on over the region all in flames,
When your car flies with winged steeds.

verses.sa:
हविषा जारो अपां पिपर्ति पपुरिर्नरा ।
पिता कुटस्य चर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
havisha jaro apam piparti papurirnara |
pita kutasya charshanih ||
verses.en:
He, liberal, lover of the flood, Lord of the House, the vigilant,
Chiefs! with oblations feeds you full.

verses.sa:
आदारो वां मतीनां नासत्या मतवचसा ।
पातं सोमस्य धृष्णुया ॥
verses.rom:
adaro vam matinam nasatya matavachasa |
patam somasya dhrishnuya ||
verses.en:
Ye have regard unto our hymns, Nasatyas, thinking of our words:
Drink boldly of the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
या नः पीपरदश्विना ज्योतिष्मती तमस्तिरः ।
तामस्मे रासाथामिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya nah piparadashvina jyotishmati tamastirah |
tamasme rasathamisham ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe to us, O Asvin Pair, such strength as, with attendant light,
May through the darkness carry us.

verses.sa:
आ नो नावा मतीनां यातं पाराय गन्तवे ।
युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no nava matinam yatam paraya gantave |
yunjathamashvina ratham ||
verses.en:
Come in the ship of these our hymns to bear you to the hither shore
O Asvins, harness ye the car.

verses.sa:
अरित्रं वां दिवस्पृथु तीर्थे सिन्धूनां रथः ।
धिया युयुज्र इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
aritram vam divasprithu tirthe sindhunam rathah |
dhiya yuyujra indavah ||
verses.en:
The heaven's wide vessel is your own on the flood's shore your chariot waits
Drops, with the hymn, have been prepared.

verses.sa:
दिवस्कण्वास इन्दवो वसु सिन्धूनां पदे ।
स्वं वव्रिं कुह धित्सथः ॥
verses.rom:
divaskanvasa indavo vasu sindhunam pade |
svam vavrim kuha dhitsathah ||
verses.en:
Kanvas, the drops are in the heaven; the wealth is at the waters' place:
Where will ye manifest your form?

verses.sa:
अभूदु भा उ अंशवे हिरण्यं प्रति सूर्यः ।
व्यख्यज्जिह्वयासितः ॥
verses.rom:
abhudu bha u amshave hiranyam prati suryah |
vyakhyajjihvayasitah ||
verses.en:
Light came to lighten up the branch, the Sun appeared as it were gold:
And with its tongue shone forth the dark.

verses.sa:
अभूदु पारमेतवे पन्था ऋतस्य साधुया ।
अदर्शि वि स्रुतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhudu parametave pantha ritasya sadhuya |
adarshi vi srutirdivah ||
verses.en:
The path of sacrifice was made to travel to the farther goal:
The road of heaven was manifest.

verses.sa:
तत्तदिदश्विनोरवो जरिता प्रति भूषति ।
मदे सोमस्य पिप्रतोः ॥
verses.rom:
tattadidashvinoravo jarita prati bhushati |
made somasya pipratoh ||
verses.en:
The singer of their praise awaits whatever grace the Asvins give,
who save when Soma gladdens them.

verses.sa:
वावसाना विवस्वति सोमस्य पीत्या गिरा ।
मनुष्वच्छम्भू आ गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vavasana vivasvati somasya pitya gira |
manushvachchhambhu a gatam ||
verses.en:
Ye dwellers with Vivasvan come, auspicious, as to Manu erst;
come to the Soma and our praise.

verses.sa:
युवोरुषा अनु श्रियं परिज्मनोरुपाचरत् ।
ऋता वनथो अक्तुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvorusha anu shriyam parijmanorupacharat |
rita vanatho aktubhih ||
verses.en:
O circumambient Asvins, Dawn follows the brightness of your way:
Approve with beams our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
उभा पिबतमश्विनोभा नः शर्म यच्छतम् ।
अविद्रियाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ubha pibatamashvinobha nah sharma yachchhatam |
avidriyabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
Drink ye of our libations, grant protection, O ye Asvins Twain,
With aids which none may interrupt.

verses.sa:
अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ।
तमश्विना पिबतं तिरोअह्न्यं धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam madhumattamah sutah soma ritavridha |
tamashvina pibatam tiroahnyam dhattam ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
ASVINS, for you who strengthen Law this sweetest Soma hath been shed.
Drink this expressed ere yesterday and give riches to him who offers it.

verses.sa:
त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता सुपेशसा रथेना यातमश्विना ।
कण्वासो वां ब्रह्म कृण्वन्त्यध्वरे तेषां सु शृणुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
trivandhurena trivrita supeshasa rathena yatamashvina |
kanvaso vam brahma krinvantyadhvare tesham su shrinutam havam ||
verses.en:
Come, O ye Asvins, mounted on your triple car three-seated, beautiful of form
To you at sacrifice the Kanvas send the prayer: graciously listen to their call.

verses.sa:
अश्विना मधुमत्तमं पातं सोममृतावृधा ।
अथाद्य दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina madhumattamam patam somamritavridha |
athadya dasra vasu bibhrata rathe dashvamsamupa gachchhatam ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, ye who strengthen Law, drink ye this sweetest Soma juice.
Borne on your wealth-fraught car come ye this day to him who offers, ye of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
त्रिषधस्थे बर्हिषि विश्ववेदसा मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् ।
कण्वासो वां सुतसोमा अभिद्यवो युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
trishadhasthe barhishi vishvavedasa madhva yajnam mimikshatam |
kanvaso vam sutasoma abhidyavo yuvam havante ashvina ||
verses.en:
Omniscient Asvins, on the thrice-heaped grass bedew with the sweet juice the sacrifice.
The sons of Kanva, striving heavenward, call on you with draughts of Soma juice out-poured.

verses.sa:
याभिः कण्वमभिष्टिभिः प्रावतं युवमश्विना ।
ताभिः ष्वस्माँ अवतं शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih kanvamabhishtibhih pravatam yuvamashvina |
tabhih shvasman avatam shubhaspati patam somamritavridha ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye guarded Kanva carefully,
Keep us, O Lords of Splendour: drink the Soma juice, ye strengtheners of holy law.

verses.sa:
सुदासे दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे पृक्षो वहतमश्विना ।
रयिं समुद्रादुत वा दिवस्पर्यस्मे धत्तं पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
sudase dasra vasu bibhrata rathe priksho vahatamashvina |
rayim samudraduta va divasparyasme dhattam puruspriham ||
verses.en:
O Mighty Ones, ye gave Sudas abundant food, brought on your treasure-laden car;
So now vouchsafe to us the wealth which many crave, either from heaven or from the sea.

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अधि तुर्वशे ।
अतो रथेन सुवृता न आ गतं साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yannasatya paravati yadva stho adhi turvashe |
ato rathena suvrita na a gatam sakam suryasya rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
Nasatyas, whether ye be far away or close to Turvasa,
Borne on your lightly-rolling chariot come to us, together with the sunbeams come.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चा वां सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप ।
इषं पृञ्चन्ता सुकृते सुदानव आ बर्हिः सीदतं नरा ॥
verses.rom:
arvancha vam saptayo'dhvarashriyo vahantu savanedupa |
isham princhanta sukrite sudanava a barhih sidatam nara ||
verses.en:
So let your coursers, ornaments of sacrifice, bring you to our libations here.
Bestowing food on him who acts and gives aright, sit, Chiefs, upon the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
तेन नासत्या गतं रथेन सूर्यत्वचा ।
येन शश्वदूहथुर्दाशुषे वसु मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tena nasatya gatam rathena suryatvacha |
yena shashvaduhathurdashushe vasu madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Come, O Nasatyas, on your car decked with a sunbright canopy,
Whereon ye ever bring wealth to the worshipper, to drink the Soma's pleasant juice.

verses.sa:
उक्थेभिरर्वागवसे पुरूवसू अर्कैश्च नि ह्वयामहे ।
शश्वत्कण्वानां सदसि प्रिये हि कं सोमं पपथुरश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
ukthebhirarvagavase puruvasu arkaishcha ni hvayamahe |
shashvatkanvanam sadasi priye hi kam somam papathurashvina ||
verses.en:
With lauds and songs of praise we call them down to us, that they, most rich, may succour us;
For ye have ever in the Kanvas' well-loved house, O Asvins, drunk the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सह वामेन न उषो व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः ।
सह द्युम्नेन बृहता विभावरि राया देवि दास्वती ॥
verses.rom:
saha vamena na usho vyuchchha duhitardivah |
saha dyumnena brihata vibhavari raya devi dasvati ||
verses.en:
DAWN on us with prosperity, O Usas, Daughter of the Sky,
Dawn with great glory, Goddess, Lady of the Light, dawn thou with riches, Bounteous One.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्वसुविदो भूरि च्यवन्त वस्तवे ।
उदीरय प्रति मा सूनृता उषश्चोद राधो मघोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavatirgomatirvishvasuvido bhuri chyavanta vastave |
udiraya prati ma sunrita ushashchoda radho maghonam ||
verses.en:
They, bringing steeds and kine, boon-givers of all wealth, have oft sped forth to lighten us.
O Usas, waken up for me the sounds of joy: send us the riches of the great.

verses.sa:
उवासोषा उच्छाच्च नु देवी जीरा रथानाम् ।
ये अस्या आचरणेषु दध्रिरे समुद्रे न श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
uvasosha uchchhachcha nu devi jira rathanam |
ye asya acharaneshu dadhrire samudre na shravasyavah ||
verses.en:
Usas hath dawned, and now shall dawn, the Goddess, driver forth of cars
Which, as she cometh nigh, have fixed their thought on her, like glory-seekers on the flood.

verses.sa:
उषो ये ते प्र यामेषु युञ्जते मनो दानाय सूरयः ।
अत्राह तत्कण्व एषां कण्वतमो नाम गृणाति नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
usho ye te pra yameshu yunjate mano danaya surayah |
atraha tatkanva esham kanvatamo nama grinati nrinam ||
verses.en:
Here Kanva, chief of Kanva's race, sings forth aloud the glories of the heroes' names,--
The. princes who, O Usas, as thou comest near, direct their thoughts to liberal gifts.

verses.sa:
आ घा योषेव सूनर्युषा याति प्रभुञ्जती ।
जरयन्ती वृजनं पद्वदीयत उत्पातयति पक्षिणः ॥
verses.rom:
a gha yosheva sunaryusha yati prabhunjati |
jarayanti vrijanam padvadiyata utpatayati pakshinah ||
verses.en:
Like a good matron Usas comes carefully tending everything:
Rousing all life she stirs all creatures that have feet, and makes the birds of air fly up.

verses.sa:
वि या सृजति समनं व्यर्थिनः पदं न वेत्योदती ।
वयो नकिष्टे पप्तिवांस आसते व्युष्टौ वाजिनीवति ॥
verses.rom:
vi ya srijati samanam vyarthinah padam na vetyodati |
vayo nakishte paptivamsa asate vyushtau vajinivati ||
verses.en:
She sends the busy forth, each man to his pursuit: delay she knows not as she springs.
O rich in opulence, after thy dawning birds that have flown forth no longer rest.

verses.sa:
एषायुक्त परावतः सूर्यस्योदयनादधि ।
शतं रथेभिः सुभगोषा इयं वि यात्यभि मानुषान् ॥
verses.rom:
eshayukta paravatah suryasyodayanadadhi |
shatam rathebhih subhagosha iyam vi yatyabhi manushan ||
verses.en:
This Dawn hath yoked her steeds afar, beyond the rising of the Sun:
Borne on a hundred chariots she, auspicious Dawn, advances on her way to Men.

verses.sa:
विश्वमस्या नानाम चक्षसे जगज्ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ।
अप द्वेषो मघोनी दुहिता दिव उषा उच्छदप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvamasya nanama chakshase jagajjyotishkrinoti sunari |
apa dvesho maghoni duhita diva usha uchchhadapa sridhah ||
verses.en:
To meet her glance all living creatures bend them down: Excellent One, she makes the light.
Usas, the Daughter of the Sky, the opulent, shines foes and enmities away.

verses.sa:
उष आ भाहि भानुना चन्द्रेण दुहितर्दिवः ।
आवहन्ती भूर्यस्मभ्यं सौभगं व्युच्छन्ती दिविष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
usha a bhahi bhanuna chandrena duhitardivah |
avahanti bhuryasmabhyam saubhagam vyuchchhanti divishtishu ||
verses.en:
Shine on us with thy radiant light, O Usas, Daughter of the Sky,
Bringing to us great store of high felicity, and beaming on our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि प्राणनं जीवनं त्वे वि यदुच्छसि सूनरि ।
सा नो रथेन बृहता विभावरि श्रुधि चित्रामघे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasya hi prananam jivanam tve vi yaduchchhasi sunari |
sa no rathena brihata vibhavari shrudhi chitramaghe havam ||
verses.en:
For in thee is each living creature's breath and life, when, Excellent! thou dawnest forth.
Borne on thy lofty car, O Lady of the Light, hear, thou of wondrous wealth, our call.

verses.sa:
उषो वाजं हि वंस्व यश्चित्रो मानुषे जने ।
तेना वह सुकृतो अध्वराँ उप ये त्वा गृणन्ति वह्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
usho vajam hi vamsva yashchitro manushe jane |
tena vaha sukrito adhvaran upa ye tva grinanti vahnayah ||
verses.en:
O Usas, win thyself the strength which among men is wonderful.
Bring thou thereby the pious unto holy rites, those who as priests sing praise to thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वान्देवाँ आ वह सोमपीतयेऽन्तरिक्षादुषस्त्वम् ।
सास्मासु धा गोमदश्वावदुक्थ्यमुषो वाजं सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvandevan a vaha somapitaye'ntarikshadushastvam |
sasmasu dha gomadashvavadukthyamusho vajam suviryam ||
verses.en:
Bring from the firmament, O Usas, all the Gods, that they may drink our Soma juice,
And, being what thou art, vouchsafe us kine and steeds, strength meet for praise and hero might.

verses.sa:
यस्या रुशन्तो अर्चयः प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत ।
सा नो रयिं विश्ववारं सुपेशसमुषा ददातु सुग्म्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya rushanto archayah prati bhadra adrikshata |
sa no rayim vishvavaram supeshasamusha dadatu sugmyam ||
verses.en:
May Usas whose auspicious rays are seen resplendent round about,
Grant us great riches, fair in form, of all good things, wealth which light labour may attain.

verses.sa:
ये चिद्धि त्वामृषयः पूर्व ऊतये जुहूरेऽवसे महि ।
सा न स्तोमाँ अभि गृणीहि राधसोषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
ye chiddhi tvamrishayah purva utaye juhure'vase mahi |
sa na stoman abhi grinihi radhasoshah shukrena shochisha ||
verses.en:
Mighty One, whom the Rsis of old time invoked for their protection and their help,
O Usas, graciously answer our songs of praise with bounty and with brilliant light.

verses.sa:
उषो यदद्य भानुना वि द्वारावृणवो दिवः ।
प्र नो यच्छतादवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिः प्र देवि गोमतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
usho yadadya bhanuna vi dvaravrinavo divah |
pra no yachchhatadavrikam prithu chchhardih pra devi gomatirishah ||
verses.en:
Usas, as thou with light to day hast opened the twin doors of heaven,
So grant thou us a dwelling wide and free from foes. O Goddess, give us food with kine.

verses.sa:
सं नो राया बृहता विश्वपेशसा मिमिक्ष्वा समिळाभिरा ।
सं द्युम्नेन विश्वतुरोषो महि सं वाजैर्वाजिनीवति ॥
verses.rom:
sam no raya brihata vishvapeshasa mimikshva samilabhira |
sam dyumnena vishvaturosho mahi sam vajairvajinivati ||
verses.en:
Bring us to wealth abundant, sent in every shape, to plentiful refreshing food,
To all-subduing splendour, Usas, Mighty One, to strength, thou rich in spoil and wealth.

verses.sa:
उषो भद्रेभिरा गहि दिवश्चिद्रोचनादधि ।
वहन्त्वरुणप्सव उप त्वा सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
usho bhadrebhira gahi divashchidrochanadadhi |
vahantvarunapsava upa tva somino griham ||
verses.en:
E'EN from above the sky's bright realm come, Usas, by auspicious ways:
Let red steeds bear thee to the house of him who pours the Soma, juice.

verses.sa:
सुपेशसं सुखं रथं यमध्यस्था उषस्त्वम् ।
तेना सुश्रवसं जनं प्रावाद्य दुहितर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
supeshasam sukham ratham yamadhyastha ushastvam |
tena sushravasam janam pravadya duhitardivah ||
verses.en:
The chariot which thou mountest, fair of shape, O Usas light to move,--
Therewith, O Daughter of the Sky, aid men of noble fame today.

verses.sa:
वयश्चित्ते पतत्रिणो द्विपच्चतुष्पदर्जुनि ।
उषः प्रारन्नृतूँरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
vayashchitte patatrino dvipachchatushpadarjuni |
ushah prarannritunranu divo antebhyaspari ||
verses.en:
Bright Usas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir,
And round about flock winged birds from all the boundaries of heaven.

verses.sa:
व्युच्छन्ती हि रश्मिभिर्विश्वमाभासि रोचनम् ।
तां त्वामुषर्वसूयवो गीर्भिः कण्वा अहूषत ॥
verses.rom:
vyuchchhanti hi rashmibhirvishvamabhasi rochanam |
tam tvamusharvasuyavo girbhih kanva ahushata ||
verses.en:
Thou dawning with thy beams of light illumest all the radiant realm.
Thee, as thou art, the Kanvas, fain for wealth, have called with sacred songs.

verses.sa:
उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः ।
दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
udu tyam jatavedasam devam vahanti ketavah |
drishe vishvaya suryam ||
verses.en:
HIS bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives,
Surya, that all may look on him.

verses.sa:
अप त्ये तायवो यथा नक्षत्रा यन्त्यक्तुभिः ।
सूराय विश्वचक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
apa tye tayavo yatha nakshatra yantyaktubhih |
suraya vishvachakshase ||
verses.en:
The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their beams,
Before the all-beholding Sun.

verses.sa:
अदृश्रमस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ अनु ।
भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
adrishramasya ketavo vi rashmayo janan anu |
bhrajanto agnayo yatha ||
verses.en:
His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men,
Like flames of fire that burn and blaze.

verses.sa:
तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य ।
विश्वमा भासि रोचनम् ॥
verses.rom:
taranirvishvadarshato jyotishkridasi surya |
vishvama bhasi rochanam ||
verses.en:
Swift and all beautiful art thou, O Surya, maker of the light,
Illuming all the radiant realm.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यङ्देवानां विशः प्रत्यङ्ङुदेषि मानुषान् ।
प्रत्यङ्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
pratyandevanam vishah pratyannudeshi manushan |
pratyanvishvam svardrishe ||
verses.en:
Thou goest to the hosts of Gods, thou comest hither to mankind,
Hither all light to be beheld.

verses.sa:
येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनाँ अनु ।
त्वं वरुण पश्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
yena pavaka chakshasa bhuranyantam janan anu |
tvam varuna pashyasi ||
verses.en:
With that same eye of thine wherewith thou lookest brilliant Varuna,
Upon the busy race of men,

verses.sa:
वि द्यामेषि रजस्पृथ्वहा मिमानो अक्तुभिः ।
पश्यञ्जन्मानि सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
vi dyameshi rajasprithvaha mimano aktubhih |
pashyanjanmani surya ||
verses.en:
Traversing sky and wide mid-air, thou metest with thy beams our days,
Sun, seeing all things that have birth.

verses.sa:
सप्त त्वा हरितो रथे वहन्ति देव सूर्य ।
शोचिष्केशं विचक्षण ॥
verses.rom:
sapta tva harito rathe vahanti deva surya |
shochishkesham vichakshana ||
verses.en:
Seven Bay Steeds harnessed to thy car bear thee, O thou farseeing One,
God, Surya, with the radiant hair.

verses.sa:
अयुक्त सप्त शुन्ध्युवः सूरो रथस्य नप्त्यः ।
ताभिर्याति स्वयुक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayukta sapta shundhyuvah suro rathasya naptyah |
tabhiryati svayuktibhih ||
verses.en:
Surya hath yoked the pure bright Seven, the daughters of the car; with these,
His own dear team, he goeth forth.

verses.sa:
उद्वयं तमसस्परि ज्योतिष्पश्यन्त उत्तरम् ।
देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
udvayam tamasaspari jyotishpashyanta uttaram |
devam devatra suryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||
verses.en:
Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come
To Surya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

verses.sa:
उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमह आरोहन्नुत्तरां दिवम् ।
हृद्रोगं मम सूर्य हरिमाणं च नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
udyannadya mitramaha arohannuttaram divam |
hridrogam mama surya harimanam cha nashaya ||
verses.en:
Rising this day, O rich in friends, ascending to the loftier heaven,
Surya remove my heart's disease, take from me this my yellow hue.

verses.sa:
शुकेषु मे हरिमाणं रोपणाकासु दध्मसि ।
अथो हारिद्रवेषु मे हरिमाणं नि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
shukeshu me harimanam ropanakasu dadhmasi |
atho haridraveshu me harimanam ni dadhmasi ||
verses.en:
To parrots and to starlings let us give away my yellowness,
Or this my yellowness let us transfer to Haritala trees.

verses.sa:
उदगादयमादित्यो विश्वेन सहसा सह ।
द्विषन्तं मह्यं रन्धयन्मो अहं द्विषते रधम् ॥
verses.rom:
udagadayamadityo vishvena sahasa saha |
dvishantam mahyam randhayanmo aham dvishate radham ||
verses.en:
With all his conquering vigour this Aditya hath gone up on high,
Giving my foe into mine hand: let me not be my foeman's prey.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवम् ।
यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषा भुजे मंहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam mesham puruhutamrigmiyamindram girbhirmadata vasvo arnavam |
yasya dyavo na vicharanti manusha bhuje mamhishthamabhi vipramarchata ||
verses.en:
MAKE glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy of songs of praise, Indra, the sea of wealth;
Whose gracious deeds for men spread like the heavens abroad: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good.

verses.sa:
अभीमवन्वन्स्वभिष्टिमूतयोऽन्तरिक्षप्रां तविषीभिरावृतम् ।
इन्द्रं दक्षास ऋभवो मदच्युतं शतक्रतुं जवनी सूनृतारुहत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhimavanvansvabhishtimutayo'ntarikshapram tavishibhiravritam |
indram dakshasa ribhavo madachyutam shatakratum javani sunritaruhat ||
verses.en:
As aids the skilful Rbhus yearned to Indra strong to save, who fills mid-air, encompassed round with might,
Rushing in rapture; and o'er Satakratu came the gladdening shout that urged him on to victory.

verses.sa:
त्वं गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरपोतात्रये शतदुरेषु गातुवित् ।
ससेन चिद्विमदायावहो वस्वाजावद्रिं वावसानस्य नर्तयन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam gotramangirobhyo'vrinorapotatraye shatadureshu gatuvit |
sasena chidvimadayavaho vasvajavadrim vavasanasya nartayan ||
verses.en:
Thou hast disclosed the kine's stall for the Angirases, and made a way for Atri by a hundred doors.
On Vimada thou hast bestowed both food and wealth, making thy bolt dance in the sacrificer's fight.

verses.sa:
त्वमपामपिधानावृणोरपाधारयः पर्वते दानुमद्वसु ।
वृत्रं यदिन्द्र शवसावधीरहिमादित्सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयो दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamapamapidhanavrinorapadharayah parvate danumadvasu |
vritram yadindra shavasavadhirahimaditsuryam divyarohayo drishe ||
verses.en:
Thou hast unclosed the prisons of the waters; thou hast in the mountain seized the treasure rich in gifts.
When thou hadst slain with might the dragon Vrtra, thou, Indra, didst raise the Sun in heaven for all to see.

verses.sa:
त्वं मायाभिरप मायिनोऽधमः स्वधाभिर्ये अधि शुप्तावजुह्वत ।
त्वं पिप्रोर्नृमणः प्रारुजः पुरः प्र ऋजिश्वानं दस्युहत्येष्वाविथ ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mayabhirapa mayino'dhamah svadhabhirye adhi shuptavajuhvata |
tvam piprornrimanah prarujah purah pra rijishvanam dasyuhatyeshvavitha ||
verses.en:
With wondrous might thou blewest enchanter fiends away, with powers celestial those who called on thee in jest.
Thou, hero-hearted, hast broken down Pipru's forts, and helped Rjisvan when the Dasyus were struck dead.

verses.sa:
त्वं कुत्सं शुष्णहत्येष्वाविथारन्धयोऽतिथिग्वाय शम्बरम् ।
महान्तं चिदर्बुदं नि क्रमीः पदा सनादेव दस्युहत्याय जज्ञिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kutsam shushnahatyeshvavitharandhayo'tithigvaya shambaram |
mahantam chidarbudam ni kramih pada sanadeva dasyuhatyaya jajnishe ||
verses.en:
Thou savedst Kutsa when Susna was smitten down; to Atithigva gavest Sambara for a prey.
E'en mighty Arbuda thou troddest under foot: thou from of old wast born to strike the Dasyus dead.

verses.sa:
त्वे विश्वा तविषी सध्र्यग्घिता तव राधः सोमपीथाय हर्षते ।
तव वज्रश्चिकिते बाह्वोर्हितो वृश्चा शत्रोरव विश्वानि वृष्ण्या ॥
verses.rom:
tve vishva tavishi sadhryagghita tava radhah somapithaya harshate |
tava vajrashchikite bahvorhito vrishcha shatrorava vishvani vrishnya ||
verses.en:
All power and might is closely gathered up in thee; thy bounteous spirit joys in drinking Soma juice.
Known is the thunderbolt that lies within thine arms: rend off therewith all manly prowess of our foe.

verses.sa:
वि जानीह्यार्यान्ये च दस्यवो बर्हिष्मते रन्धया शासदव्रतान् ।
शाकी भव यजमानस्य चोदिता विश्वेत्ता ते सधमादेषु चाकन ॥
verses.rom:
vi janihyaryanye cha dasyavo barhishmate randhaya shasadavratan |
shaki bhava yajamanasya chodita vishvetta te sadhamadeshu chakana ||
verses.en:
Discern thou well Aryas and Dasyus; punishing the lawless give them up to him whose grass is strewn.
Be thou the sacrificer's strong encourager all these thy deeds are my delight at festivals.

verses.sa:
अनुव्रताय रन्धयन्नपव्रतानाभूभिरिन्द्रः श्नथयन्ननाभुवः ।
वृद्धस्य चिद्वर्धतो द्यामिनक्षत स्तवानो वम्रो वि जघान संदिहः ॥
verses.rom:
anuvrataya randhayannapavratanabhubhirindrah shnathayannanabhuvah |
vriddhasya chidvardhato dyaminakshata stavano vamro vi jaghana samdihah ||
verses.en:
Indra gives up the lawless to the pious man, destroying by the Strong Ones those who have no strength.
Vamra when glorified destroyed the gathered piles of the still waxing great one who would reach the heaven.

verses.sa:
तक्षद्यत्त उशना सहसा सहो वि रोदसी मज्मना बाधते शवः ।
आ त्वा वातस्य नृमणो मनोयुज आ पूर्यमाणमवहन्नभि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
takshadyatta ushana sahasa saho vi rodasi majmana badhate shavah |
a tva vatasya nrimano manoyuja a puryamanamavahannabhi shravah ||
verses.en:
The might which Usana hath formed for thee with might rends in its greatness and with strength both worlds apart.
O Hero-souled, the steeds of Vata, yoked by thought, have carried thee to fame while thou art filled with power.

verses.sa:
मन्दिष्ट यदुशने काव्ये सचाँ इन्द्रो वङ्कू वङ्कुतराधि तिष्ठति ।
उग्रो ययिं निरपः स्रोतसासृजद्वि शुष्णस्य दृंहिता ऐरयत्पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
mandishta yadushane kavye sachan indro vanku vankutaradhi tishthati |
ugro yayim nirapah srotasasrijadvi shushnasya drimhita airayatpurah ||
verses.en:
When Indra hath rejoiced with Kavya Usana, he mounts his steeds who swerve wider and wider yet.
The Strong hath loosed his bolt with the swift rush of rain, and he hath rent in pieces Susna's firm-built forts.

verses.sa:
आ स्मा रथं वृषपाणेषु तिष्ठसि शार्यातस्य प्रभृता येषु मन्दसे ।
इन्द्र यथा सुतसोमेषु चाकनोऽनर्वाणं श्लोकमा रोहसे दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
a sma ratham vrishapaneshu tishthasi sharyatasya prabhrita yeshu mandase |
indra yatha sutasomeshu chakano'narvanam shlokama rohase divi ||
verses.en:
Thou mountest on thy car amid strong Soma draughts: Saryata brought thee those in which thou hast delight.
Indra, when thou art pleased with men whose Soma flows thou risest to unchallenged glory in the sky.

verses.sa:
अददा अर्भां महते वचस्यवे कक्षीवते वृचयामिन्द्र सुन्वते ।
मेनाभवो वृषणश्वस्य सुक्रतो विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ॥
verses.rom:
adada arbham mahate vachasyave kakshivate vrichayamindra sunvate |
menabhavo vrishanashvasya sukrato vishvetta te savaneshu pravachya ||
verses.en:
To old Kaksivan, Soma-presser, skilled in song, O Indra, thou didst give the youthful Vrcaya.
Thou, very wise, wast Mena, Vrsanaiva's child: those deeds of thine must all be told at Soma feasts.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अश्रायि सुध्यो निरेके पज्रेषु स्तोमो दुर्यो न यूपः ।
अश्वयुर्गव्यू रथयुर्वसूयुरिन्द्र इद्रायः क्षयति प्रयन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
indro ashrayi sudhyo nireke pajreshu stomo duryo na yupah |
ashvayurgavyu rathayurvasuyurindra idrayah kshayati prayanta ||
verses.en:
The good man's refuge in his need is Indra, firm as a doorpost, praised among the Pajras.
Indra alone is Lord of wealth, the Giver, lover of riches, chariots, kine, and horses.

verses.sa:
इदं नमो वृषभाय स्वराजे सत्यशुष्माय तवसेऽवाचि ।
अस्मिन्निन्द्र वृजने सर्ववीराः स्मत्सूरिभिस्तव शर्मन्स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
idam namo vrishabhaya svaraje satyashushmaya tavase'vachi |
asminnindra vrijane sarvavirah smatsuribhistava sharmansyama ||
verses.en:
To him the Mighty One, the self-resplendent, verily strong and great, this praise is uttered.
May we and all the heroes, with the princes, be, in this fray, O Indra, in thy keeping.

verses.sa:
त्यं सु मेषं महया स्वर्विदं शतं यस्य सुभ्वः साकमीरते ।
अत्यं न वाजं हवनस्यदं रथमेन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tyam su mesham mahaya svarvidam shatam yasya subhvah sakamirate |
atyam na vajam havanasyadam rathamendram vavrityamavase suvriktibhih ||
verses.en:
I GLORIFY that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred nobly-natured ones go forth with him.
With hymns may I turn hither Indra to mine aid,--the Car which like a strong steed hasteth to the call.

verses.sa:
स पर्वतो न धरुणेष्वच्युतः सहस्रमूतिस्तविषीषु वावृधे ।
इन्द्रो यद्वृत्रमवधीन्नदीवृतमुब्जन्नर्णांसि जर्हृषाणो अन्धसा ॥
verses.rom:
sa parvato na dharuneshvachyutah sahasramutistavishishu vavridhe |
indro yadvritramavadhinnadivritamubjannarnamsi jarhrishano andhasa ||
verses.en:
Like as a mountain on firm basis, unremoved, he, thousandfold protector, waxed in mighty strength,
When Indra, joying in the draughts of Soma juice, forced the clouds, slaying Vrtra stayer of their flow.

verses.sa:
स हि द्वरो द्वरिषु वव्र ऊधनि चन्द्रबुध्नो मदवृद्धो मनीषिभिः ।
इन्द्रं तमह्वे स्वपस्यया धिया मंहिष्ठरातिं स हि पप्रिरन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi dvaro dvarishu vavra udhani chandrabudhno madavriddho manishibhih |
indram tamahve svapasyaya dhiya mamhishtharatim sa hi paprirandhasah ||
verses.en:
For he stays e'en the stayers, spread o'er laden cloud, rooted in light, strengthened in rapture by the wise.
Indra with thought, with skilled activity, I call, most liberal giver, for he sates him with the juice.

verses.sa:
आ यं पृणन्ति दिवि सद्मबर्हिषः समुद्रं न सुभ्वः स्वा अभिष्टयः ।
तं वृत्रहत्ये अनु तस्थुरूतयः शुष्मा इन्द्रमवाता अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
verses.rom:
a yam prinanti divi sadmabarhishah samudram na subhvah sva abhishtayah |
tam vritrahatye anu tasthurutayah shushma indramavata ahrutapsavah ||
verses.en:
Whom those that flow in heaven on sacred grass, his own assistants, nobly-natured, fill full like the sea,--
Beside that Indra when he smote down Vrtra stood his helpers, straight in form, mighty, invincible.

verses.sa:
अभि स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यतो रघ्वीरिव प्रवणे सस्रुरूतयः ।
इन्द्रो यद्वज्री धृषमाणो अन्धसा भिनद्वलस्य परिधीँरिव त्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi svavrishtim made asya yudhyato raghviriva pravane sasrurutayah |
indro yadvajri dhrishamano andhasa bhinadvalasya paridhinriva tritah ||
verses.en:
To him, as in wild joy he fought with him who stayed the rain, his helpers sped like swift streams down a slope,
When Indra, thunder-armed, made bold by Soma draughts, as Trta cleaveth Vala's fences, cleft him through.

verses.sa:
परीं घृणा चरति तित्विषे शवोऽपो वृत्वी रजसो बुध्नमाशयत् ।
वृत्रस्य यत्प्रवणे दुर्गृभिश्वनो निजघन्थ हन्वोरिन्द्र तन्यतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
parim ghrina charati titvishe shavo'po vritvi rajaso budhnamashayat |
vritrasya yatpravane durgribhishvano nijaghantha hanvorindra tanyatum ||
verses.en:
Splendour encompassed thee, forth shone thy warrior might: the rain-obstructer lay in mid-air's lowest deep,
What time, O Indra, thou didst cast thy thunder down upon the jaws of Vritra hard to be restrained.

verses.sa:
ह्रदं न हि त्वा न्यृषन्त्यूर्मयो ब्रह्माणीन्द्र तव यानि वर्धना ।
त्वष्टा चित्ते युज्यं वावृधे शवस्ततक्ष वज्रमभिभूत्योजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
hradam na hi tva nyrishantyurmayo brahmanindra tava yani vardhana |
tvashta chitte yujyam vavridhe shavastataksha vajramabhibhutyojasam ||
verses.en:
The hymns which magnify thee, Indra, reach to thee even as water-brooks flow down and fill the lake.
Tvastar gave yet more force to thine appropriate strength, and forged thy thunderbolt of overpowering might.

verses.sa:
जघन्वाँ उ हरिभिः सम्भृतक्रतविन्द्र वृत्रं मनुषे गातुयन्नपः ।
अयच्छथा बाह्वोर्वज्रमायसमधारयो दिव्या सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
jaghanvan u haribhih sambhritakratavindra vritram manushe gatuyannapah |
ayachchhatha bahvorvajramayasamadharayo divya suryam drishe ||
verses.en:
When, Indra, thou whose power is linked with thy Bay Steeds hadst smitten Vrtra, causing floods to flow for man,
Thou heldst in thine arms the metal thunderbolt, and settest in the heaven the Sun for all to see.

verses.sa:
बृहत्स्वश्चन्द्रममवद्यदुक्थ्यमकृण्वत भियसा रोहणं दिवः ।
यन्मानुषप्रधना इन्द्रमूतयः स्वर्नृषाचो मरुतोऽमदन्ननु ॥
verses.rom:
brihatsvashchandramamavadyadukthyamakrinvata bhiyasa rohanam divah |
yanmanushapradhana indramutayah svarnrishacho maruto'madannanu ||
verses.en:
In fear they raised the lofty self-resplendent hymn, praise giving and effectual, leading up to heaven,
When Indra's helpers fighting for the good of men, the Maruts, faithful to mankind, joyed in the light.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्चिदस्यामवाँ अहेः स्वनादयोयवीद्भियसा वज्र इन्द्र ते ।
वृत्रस्य यद्बद्बधानस्य रोदसी मदे सुतस्य शवसाभिनच्छिरः ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushchidasyamavan aheh svanadayoyavidbhiyasa vajra indra te |
vritrasya yadbadbadhanasya rodasi made sutasya shavasabhinachchhirah ||
verses.en:
Then Heaven himself, the mighty, at that Dragon's roar reeled back in terror when, Indra, thy thunderbolt
In the wild joy of Soma had struck off with might the head of Vrtra, tyrant of the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
यदिन्न्विन्द्र पृथिवी दशभुजिरहानि विश्वा ततनन्त कृष्टयः ।
अत्राह ते मघवन्विश्रुतं सहो द्यामनु शवसा बर्हणा भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadinnvindra prithivi dashabhujirahani vishva tatananta krishtayah |
atraha te maghavanvishrutam saho dyamanu shavasa barhana bhuvat ||
verses.en:
O Indra, were this earth extended forth tenfold, and men who dwell therein multiplied day by day,
Still here thy conquering might, Maghavan, would be famed: it hath waxed vast as heaven in majesty and power.

verses.sa:
त्वमस्य पारे रजसो व्योमनः स्वभूत्योजा अवसे धृषन्मनः ।
चकृषे भूमिं प्रतिमानमोजसोऽपः स्वः परिभूरेष्या दिवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasya pare rajaso vyomanah svabhutyoja avase dhrishanmanah |
chakrishe bhumim pratimanamojaso'pah svah paribhureshya divam ||
verses.en:
Thou, bold of heart, in thine own native might, for help, upon the limit of this mid-air and of heaven,
Hast made the earth to be the pattern of thy strength: embracing flood and light thou reachest to the sky.

verses.sa:
त्वं भुवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या ऋष्ववीरस्य बृहतः पतिर्भूः ।
विश्वमाप्रा अन्तरिक्षं महित्वा सत्यमद्धा नकिरन्यस्त्वावान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam bhuvah pratimanam prithivya rishvavirasya brihatah patirbhuh |
vishvamapra antariksham mahitva satyamaddha nakiranyastvavan ||
verses.en:
Thou art the counterpart of earth, the Master of lofty heaven with all its mighty Heroes:
Thou hast filled all the region with thy greatness: yea, of a truth there is none other like thee.

verses.sa:
न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी अनु व्यचो न सिन्धवो रजसो अन्तमानशुः ।
नोत स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यत एको अन्यच्चकृषे विश्वमानुषक् ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya dyavaprithivi anu vyacho na sindhavo rajaso antamanashuh |
nota svavrishtim made asya yudhyata eko anyachchakrishe vishvamanushak ||
verses.en:
Whose amplitude the heaven and earth have not attained, whose bounds the waters of mid-air have never reached,--
Not, when in joy he fights the stayer of the rain: thou, and none else, hast made all things in order due.

verses.sa:
आर्चन्नत्र मरुतः सस्मिन्नाजौ विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा ।
वृत्रस्य यद्भृष्टिमता वधेन नि त्वमिन्द्र प्रत्यानं जघन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
archannatra marutah sasminnajau vishve devaso amadannanu tva |
vritrasya yadbhrishtimata vadhena ni tvamindra pratyanam jaghantha ||
verses.en:
The Maruts sang thy praise in this encounter, and in thee all the Deities delighted,
What time thou, Indra, with thy spiky weapon, thy deadly bolt, smotest the face of Vrtra.

verses.sa:
न्यू षु वाचं प्र महे भरामहे गिर इन्द्राय सदने विवस्वतः ।
नू चिद्धि रत्नं ससतामिवाविदन्न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
nyu shu vacham pra mahe bharamahe gira indraya sadane vivasvatah |
nu chiddhi ratnam sasatamivavidanna dushtutirdravinodeshu shasyate ||
verses.en:
WE will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvan's dwelling-place;
For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep: those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.

verses.sa:
दुरो अश्वस्य दुर इन्द्र गोरसि दुरो यवस्य वसुन इनस्पतिः ।
शिक्षानरः प्रदिवो अकामकर्शनः सखा सखिभ्यस्तमिदं गृणीमसि ॥
verses.rom:
duro ashvasya dura indra gorasi duro yavasya vasuna inaspatih |
shikshanarah pradivo akamakarshanah sakha sakhibhyastamidam grinimasi ||
verses.en:
Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth:
Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee as such we sing this praise.

verses.sa:
शचीव इन्द्र पुरुकृद्द्युमत्तम तवेदिदमभितश्चेकिते वसु ।
अतः संगृभ्याभिभूत आ भर मा त्वायतो जरितुः काममूनयीः ॥
verses.rom:
shachiva indra purukriddyumattama tavedidamabhitashchekite vasu |
atah samgribhyabhibhuta a bhara ma tvayato jarituh kamamunayih ||
verses.en:
Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own.
Gather therefrom, O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.

verses.sa:
एभिर्द्युभिः सुमना एभिरिन्दुभिर्निरुन्धानो अमतिं गोभिरश्विना ।
इन्द्रेण दस्युं दरयन्त इन्दुभिर्युतद्वेषसः समिषा रभेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirdyubhih sumana ebhirindubhirnirundhano amatim gobhirashvina |
indrena dasyum darayanta indubhiryutadveshasah samisha rabhemahi ||
verses.en:
Well pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with seeds and kine.
With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र राया समिषा रभेमहि सं वाजेभिः पुरुश्चन्द्रैरभिद्युभिः ।
सं देव्या प्रमत्या वीरशुष्मया गोअग्रयाश्वावत्या रभेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
samindra raya samisha rabhemahi sam vajebhih purushchandrairabhidyubhih |
sam devya pramatya virashushmaya goagrayashvavatya rabhemahi ||
verses.en:
Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky:
May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा अमदन्तानि वृष्ण्या ते सोमासो वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पते ।
यत्कारवे दश वृत्राण्यप्रति बर्हिष्मते नि सहस्राणि बर्हयः ॥
verses.rom:
te tva mada amadantani vrishnya te somaso vritrahatyeshu satpate |
yatkarave dasha vritranyaprati barhishmate ni sahasrani barhayah ||
verses.en:
These our libations strength-inspiring, Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vrtra, Hero Lord,
What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vrtras, thou resistless in thy might.

verses.sa:
युधा युधमुप घेदेषि धृष्णुया पुरा पुरं समिदं हंस्योजसा ।
नम्या यदिन्द्र सख्या परावति निबर्हयो नमुचिं नाम मायिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yudha yudhamupa ghedeshi dhrishnuya pura puram samidam hamsyojasa |
namya yadindra sakhya paravati nibarhayo namuchim nama mayinam ||
verses.en:
Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength.
Thou, Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuci.

verses.sa:
त्वं करञ्जमुत पर्णयं वधीस्तेजिष्ठयातिथिग्वस्य वर्तनी ।
त्वं शता वङ्गृदस्याभिनत्पुरोऽनानुदः परिषूता ऋजिश्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam karanjamuta parnayam vadhistejishthayatithigvasya vartani |
tvam shata vangridasyabhinatpuro'nanudah parishuta rijishvana ||
verses.en:
Thou hast struck down in death Karañja, Parnaya, in Atithigva's very glorious going forth.
Unyielding, when Rjisvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred forts of Vangrida.

verses.sa:
त्वमेताञ्जनराज्ञो द्विर्दशाबन्धुना सुश्रवसोपजग्मुषः ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नवतिं नव श्रुतो नि चक्रेण रथ्या दुष्पदावृणक् ॥
verses.rom:
tvametanjanarajno dvirdashabandhuna sushravasopajagmushah |
shashtim sahasra navatim nava shruto ni chakrena rathya dushpadavrinak ||
verses.en:
With all-outstripping chariot-wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten Kings of men,
With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Susravas.

verses.sa:
त्वमाविथ सुश्रवसं तवोतिभिस्तव त्रामभिरिन्द्र तूर्वयाणम् ।
त्वमस्मै कुत्समतिथिग्वमायुं महे राज्ञे यूने अरन्धनायः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamavitha sushravasam tavotibhistava tramabhirindra turvayanam |
tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamayum mahe rajne yune arandhanayah ||
verses.en:
Thou hast protected Susravas with succour, and Turvayana with thine aid, O Indra.
Thou madest Kutsa, Atithigva, Ayu, subject unto this King, the young, the mighty.

verses.sa:
य उदृचीन्द्र देवगोपाः सखायस्ते शिवतमा असाम ।
त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
ya udrichindra devagopah sakhayaste shivatama asama |
tvam stoshama tvaya suvira draghiya ayuh prataram dadhanah ||
verses.en:
May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very prosperous friends, O Indra.
Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life long and joyful and with store of heroes.

verses.sa:
मा नो अस्मिन्मघवन्पृत्स्वंहसि नहि ते अन्तः शवसः परीणशे ।
अक्रन्दयो नद्यो रोरुवद्वना कथा न क्षोणीर्भियसा समारत ॥
verses.rom:
ma no asminmaghavanpritsvamhasi nahi te antah shavasah parinashe |
akrandayo nadyo roruvadvana katha na kshonirbhiyasa samarata ||
verses.en:
URGE us not, Maghavan, to this distressful fight, for none may comprehend the limit of thy strength.
Thou with fierce shout hast made the woods and rivers roar: did not men run in crowds together in their fear?

verses.sa:
अर्चा शक्राय शाकिने शचीवते शृण्वन्तमिन्द्रं महयन्नभि ष्टुहि ।
यो धृष्णुना शवसा रोदसी उभे वृषा वृषत्वा वृषभो न्यृञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
archa shakraya shakine shachivate shrinvantamindram mahayannabhi shtuhi |
yo dhrishnuna shavasa rodasi ubhe vrisha vrishatva vrishabho nyrinjate ||
verses.en:
Sing hymns of praise to Sakra, Lord of power and might; laud thou and magnify Indra who heareth thee,
Who with his daring might, a Bull exceeding strong in strength, maketh him master of the heaven and earth.

verses.sa:
अर्चा दिवे बृहते शूष्यं वचः स्वक्षत्रं यस्य धृषतो धृषन्मनः ।
बृहच्छ्रवा असुरो बर्हणा कृतः पुरो हरिभ्यां वृषभो रथो हि षः ॥
verses.rom:
archa dive brihate shushyam vachah svakshatram yasya dhrishato dhrishanmanah |
brihachchhrava asuro barhana kritah puro haribhyam vrishabho ratho hi shah ||
verses.en:
Sing forth to lofty Dyaus a strength-bestowing song, the Bold, whose resolute mind hath independent sway.
High glory hath the Asura, compact of strength, drawn on by two Bay Steeds: a Bull, a Car is he.

verses.sa:
त्वं दिवो बृहतः सानु कोपयोऽव त्मना धृषता शम्बरं भिनत् ।
यन्मायिनो व्रन्दिनो मन्दिना धृषच्छितां गभस्तिमशनिं पृतन्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam divo brihatah sanu kopayo'va tmana dhrishata shambaram bhinat |
yanmayino vrandino mandina dhrishachchhitam gabhastimashanim pritanyasi ||
verses.en:
The ridges of the lofty heaven thou madest shake; thou, daring, of thyself smotest through Sambara,
When bold with gladdening juice, thou warredst with thy bolt, sharp and two-edged, against the banded sorcerers.

verses.sa:
नि यद्वृणक्षि श्वसनस्य मूर्धनि शुष्णस्य चिद्व्रन्दिनो रोरुवद्वना ।
प्राचीनेन मनसा बर्हणावता यदद्या चित्कृणवः कस्त्वा परि ॥
verses.rom:
ni yadvrinakshi shvasanasya murdhani shushnasya chidvrandino roruvadvana |
prachinena manasa barhanavata yadadya chitkrinavah kastva pari ||
verses.en:
When with a roar that fills the woods, thou forcest down on wind's head the stores which Susna kept confined,
Who shall have power to stay thee firm and eager-souled from doing still this day what thou of old hast done?

verses.sa:
त्वमाविथ नर्यं तुर्वशं यदुं त्वं तुर्वीतिं वय्यं शतक्रतो ।
त्वं रथमेतशं कृत्व्ये धने त्वं पुरो नवतिं दम्भयो नव ॥
verses.rom:
tvamavitha naryam turvasham yadum tvam turvitim vayyam shatakrato |
tvam rathametasham kritvye dhane tvam puro navatim dambhayo nava ||
verses.en:
Thou helpest Narya, Turvasa, and Yadu, and Vayya's son Turviti, Satakratu!
Thou helpest horse and car in final battle thou breakest down the nine-and-ninety castles.

verses.sa:
स घा राजा सत्पतिः शूशुवज्जनो रातहव्यः प्रति यः शासमिन्वति ।
उक्था वा यो अभिगृणाति राधसा दानुरस्मा उपरा पिन्वते दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha raja satpatih shushuvajjano ratahavyah prati yah shasaminvati |
uktha va yo abhigrinati radhasa danurasma upara pinvate divah ||
verses.en:
A hero-lord is he, King of a mighty folk, who offers free oblations and promotes the Law,
Who with a bounteous guerdon welcomes hymns of praise: for him flows down the abundant stream below the sky.

verses.sa:
असमं क्षत्रमसमा मनीषा प्र सोमपा अपसा सन्तु नेमे ।
ये त इन्द्र ददुषो वर्धयन्ति महि क्षत्रं स्थविरं वृष्ण्यं च ॥
verses.rom:
asamam kshatramasama manisha pra somapa apasa santu neme |
ye ta indra dadusho vardhayanti mahi kshatram sthaviram vrishnyam cha ||
verses.en:
His power is matchless, matchless is his wisdom; chief, through their work, be some who drink the Soma,
Those, Indra, who increase the lordly power, the firm heroic strength of thee the Giver.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदेते बहुला अद्रिदुग्धाश्चमूषदश्चमसा इन्द्रपानाः ।
व्यश्नुहि तर्पया काममेषामथा मनो वसुदेयाय कृष्व ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyedete bahula adridugdhashchamushadashchamasa indrapanah |
vyashnuhi tarpaya kamameshamatha mano vasudeyaya krishva ||
verses.en:
Therefore for thee are these abundant beakers Indra's drink, stone-pressed juices held in ladles.
Quaff them and satisfy therewith thy longing; then fix thy mind upon bestowing treasure.

verses.sa:
अपामतिष्ठद्धरुणह्वरं तमोऽन्तर्वृत्रस्य जठरेषु पर्वतः ।
अभीमिन्द्रो नद्यो वव्रिणा हिता विश्वा अनुष्ठाः प्रवणेषु जिघ्नते ॥
verses.rom:
apamatishthaddharunahvaram tamo'ntarvritrasya jathareshu parvatah |
abhimindro nadyo vavrina hita vishva anushthah pravaneshu jighnate ||
verses.en:
There darkness stood, the vault that stayed the waters' flow: in Vrtra's hollow side the rain-cloud lay concealed.
But Indra smote the rivers which the obstructer stayed, flood following after flood, down steep declivities.

verses.sa:
स शेवृधमधि धा द्युम्नमस्मे महि क्षत्रं जनाषाळिन्द्र तव्यम् ।
रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीन्राये च नः स्वपत्या इषे धाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa shevridhamadhi dha dyumnamasme mahi kshatram janashalindra tavyam |
raksha cha no maghonah pahi surinraye cha nah svapatya ishe dhah ||
verses.en:
So give us, Indra, bliss-increasing glory give us great sway and strength that conquers people.
Preserve our wealthy patrons, save our princes; vouchsafe us wealth and food with noble offspring.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदस्य वरिमा वि पप्रथ इन्द्रं न मह्ना पृथिवी चन प्रति ।
भीमस्तुविष्माञ्चर्षणिभ्य आतपः शिशीते वज्रं तेजसे न वंसगः ॥
verses.rom:
divashchidasya varima vi papratha indram na mahna prithivi chana prati |
bhimastuvishmancharshanibhya atapah shishite vajram tejase na vamsagah ||
verses.en:
THOUGH e'en this heaven's wide space and earth have spread them out, nor heaven nor earth may be in greatness Indra's match.
Awful and very mighty, causing woe to men, he whets his thunderbolt for sharpness, as a bull.

verses.sa:
सो अर्णवो न नद्यः समुद्रियः प्रति गृभ्णाति विश्रिता वरीमभिः ।
इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये वृषायते सनात्स युध्म ओजसा पनस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
so arnavo na nadyah samudriyah prati gribhnati vishrita varimabhih |
indrah somasya pitaye vrishayate sanatsa yudhma ojasa panasyate ||
verses.en:
Like as the watery ocean, so doth he receive the rivers spread on all sides in their ample width.
He bears him like a bull to drink of Soma juice, and will, as Warrior from of old, be praised for might.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं न भोजसे महो नृम्णस्य धर्मणामिरज्यसि ।
प्र वीर्येण देवताति चेकिते विश्वस्मा उग्रः कर्मणे पुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tamindra parvatam na bhojase maho nrimnasya dharmanamirajyasi |
pra viryena devatati chekite vishvasma ugrah karmane purohitah ||
verses.en:
Thou swayest, Indra, all kinds of great manly power, so as to bend, as't were, even that famed mountain down.
Foremost among the Gods is he through hero might, set in the van, the Strong One, for each arduous deed.

verses.sa:
स इद्वने नमस्युभिर्वचस्यते चारु जनेषु प्रब्रुवाण इन्द्रियम् ।
वृषा छन्दुर्भवति हर्यतो वृषा क्षेमेण धेनां मघवा यदिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
sa idvane namasyubhirvachasyate charu janeshu prabruvana indriyam |
vrisha chhandurbhavati haryato vrisha kshemena dhenam maghava yadinvati ||
verses.en:
He only in the wood is praised by worshippers, when he shows forth to men his own fair Indra-power.
A friendly Bull is he, a Bull to be desired when Maghavan auspiciously sends forth his voice.

verses.sa:
स इन्महानि समिथानि मज्मना कृणोति युध्म ओजसा जनेभ्यः ।
अधा चन श्रद्दधति त्विषीमत इन्द्राय वज्रं निघनिघ्नते वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa inmahani samithani majmana krinoti yudhma ojasa janebhyah |
adha chana shraddadhati tvishimata indraya vajram nighanighnate vadham ||
verses.en:
Yet verily the Warrior in his vigorous strength stirreth up with his might great battles for mankind;
And men have faith in Indra, the resplendent One, what time he hurleth down his bolt, his dart of death.

verses.sa:
स हि श्रवस्युः सदनानि कृत्रिमा क्ष्मया वृधान ओजसा विनाशयन् ।
ज्योतींषि कृण्वन्नवृकाणि यज्यवेऽव सुक्रतुः सर्तवा अपः सृजत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shravasyuh sadanani kritrima kshmaya vridhana ojasa vinashayan |
jyotimshi krinvannavrikani yajyave'va sukratuh sartava apah srijat ||
verses.en:
Though, fain for glory, and with strength increased on earth, he with great might destroys the dwellings made with art,
He makes the lights of heaven shine forth secure, he bids, exceeding wise, the floods flow for his worshipper.

verses.sa:
दानाय मनः सोमपावन्नस्तु तेऽर्वाञ्चा हरी वन्दनश्रुदा कृधि ।
यमिष्ठासः सारथयो य इन्द्र ते न त्वा केता आ दभ्नुवन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.rom:
danaya manah somapavannastu te'rvancha hari vandanashruda kridhi |
yamishthasah sarathayo ya indra te na tva keta a dabhnuvanti bhurnayah ||
verses.en:
Drinker of Soma, let thy heart incline to give; bring thy Bays hitherward, O thou who hearest praise.
Those charioteers of' thine, best skilled to draw the rein, the rapid sunbeams, Indra, lead thee not astray.

verses.sa:
अप्रक्षितं वसु बिभर्षि हस्तयोरषाळ्हं सहस्तन्वि श्रुतो दधे ।
आवृतासोऽवतासो न कर्तृभिस्तनूषु ते क्रतव इन्द्र भूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
aprakshitam vasu bibharshi hastayorashalham sahastanvi shruto dadhe |
avritaso'vataso na kartribhistanushu te kratava indra bhurayah ||
verses.en:
Thou bearest in both hands treasure that never fails; the famed One in his body holds unvanquished might.
O Indra, in thy members many powers abide, like wells surrounded by the ministering priests.

verses.sa:
एष प्र पूर्वीरव तस्य चम्रिषोऽत्यो न योषामुदयंस्त भुर्वणिः ।
दक्षं महे पाययते हिरण्ययं रथमावृत्या हरियोगमृभ्वसम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha pra purvirava tasya chamrisho'tyo na yoshamudayamsta bhurvanih |
daksham mahe payayate hiranyayam rathamavritya hariyogamribhvasam ||
verses.en:
FOR this man's full libations held in ladles, he hath roused him, eager, as a horse to meet the mare.
He stays his golden car, yoked with Bay Horses, swift, and drinks the Soma juice which strengthens for great deeds.

verses.sa:
तं गूर्तयो नेमन्निषः परीणसः समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवः ।
पतिं दक्षस्य विदथस्य नू सहो गिरिं न वेना अधि रोह तेजसा ॥
verses.rom:
tam gurtayo nemannishah parinasah samudram na samcharane sanishyavah |
patim dakshasya vidathasya nu saho girim na vena adhi roha tejasa ||
verses.en:
To him the guidance-following songs of praise flow full, as those who seek gain go in company to the flood.
To him the Lord of power, the holy synod's might, as to a hill, with speed, ascend the loving ones.

verses.sa:
स तुर्वणिर्महाँ अरेणु पौंस्ये गिरेर्भृष्टिर्न भ्राजते तुजा शवः ।
येन शुष्णं मायिनमायसो मदे दुध्र आभूषु रामयन्नि दामनि ॥
verses.rom:
sa turvanirmahan arenu paumsye girerbhrishtirna bhrajate tuja shavah |
yena shushnam mayinamayaso made dudhra abhushu ramayanni damani ||
verses.en:
Victorious, great is he; in manly battle shines, unstained with dust, his might, as shines a mountain peak;
Wherewith the iron one, fierce e'en against the strong, in rapture, fettered wily Sushna fast in bonds.

verses.sa:
देवी यदि तविषी त्वावृधोतय इन्द्रं सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः ।
यो धृष्णुना शवसा बाधते तम इयर्ति रेणुं बृहदर्हरिष्वणिः ॥
verses.rom:
devi yadi tavishi tvavridhotaya indram sishaktyushasam na suryah |
yo dhrishnuna shavasa badhate tama iyarti renum brihadarharishvanih ||
verses.en:
When Strength the Goddess, made more strong for help by thee, waits upon Indra as the Sun attends the Dawn,
Then. he who with his might unflinching kills the gloom stirs up the dust aloft, with joy and triumphing.

verses.sa:
वि यत्तिरो धरुणमच्युतं रजोऽतिष्ठिपो दिव आतासु बर्हणा ।
स्वर्मीळ्हे यन्मद इन्द्र हर्ष्याहन्वृत्रं निरपामौब्जो अर्णवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi yattiro dharunamachyutam rajo'tishthipo diva atasu barhana |
svarmilhe yanmada indra harshyahanvritram nirapamaubjo arnavam ||
verses.en:
When thou with might, upon the framework of the heaven, didst fix, across, air's region firmly, unremoved,
In the light-winning war, Indra, in rapturous joy, thou smotest Vrtra dead and broughtest floods of rain.

verses.sa:
त्वं दिवो धरुणं धिष ओजसा पृथिव्या इन्द्र सदनेषु माहिनः ।
त्वं सुतस्य मदे अरिणा अपो वि वृत्रस्य समया पाष्यारुजः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam divo dharunam dhisha ojasa prithivya indra sadaneshu mahinah |
tvam sutasya made arina apo vi vritrasya samaya pashyarujah ||
verses.en:
Thou with thy might didst grasp, the holder-up of heaven, thou who art mighty also in the seats of earth.
Thou, gladdened by the juice, hast set the waters free, and broken Vrtra's stony fences through and through.

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय बृहते बृहद्रये सत्यशुष्माय तवसे मतिं भरे ।
अपामिव प्रवणे यस्य दुर्धरं राधो विश्वायु शवसे अपावृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra mamhishthaya brihate brihadraye satyashushmaya tavase matim bhare |
apamiva pravane yasya durdharam radho vishvayu shavase apavritam ||
verses.en:
To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn,--
Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.

verses.sa:
अध ते विश्वमनु हासदिष्टय आपो निम्नेव सवना हविष्मतः ।
यत्पर्वते न समशीत हर्यत इन्द्रस्य वज्रः श्नथिता हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
adha te vishvamanu hasadishtaya apo nimneva savana havishmatah |
yatparvate na samashita haryata indrasya vajrah shnathita hiranyayah ||
verses.en:
Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee--the offerer's libations like floods to the depth,
When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thunderbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of gold.

verses.sa:
अस्मै भीमाय नमसा समध्वर उषो न शुभ्र आ भरा पनीयसे ।
यस्य धाम श्रवसे नामेन्द्रियं ज्योतिरकारि हरितो नायसे ॥
verses.rom:
asmai bhimaya namasa samadhvara usho na shubhra a bhara paniyase |
yasya dhama shravase namendriyam jyotirakari harito nayase ||
verses.en:
To him the terrible, most meet for lofty praise, like bright Dawn, now bring gifts with reverence in this rite,
Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो ।
नहि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत्क्षोणीरिव प्रति नो हर्य तद्वचः ॥
verses.rom:
ime ta indra te vayam purushtuta ye tvarabhya charamasi prabhuvaso |
nahi tvadanyo girvano girah saghatkshoniriva prati no harya tadvachah ||
verses.en:
Thine, Indra, praised by many, excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee.
Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.

verses.sa:
भूरि त इन्द्र वीर्यं तव स्मस्यस्य स्तोतुर्मघवन्काममा पृण ।
अनु ते द्यौर्बृहती वीर्यं मम इयं च ते पृथिवी नेम ओजसे ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri ta indra viryam tava smasyasya stoturmaghavankamama prina |
anu te dyaurbrihati viryam mama iyam cha te prithivi nema ojase ||
verses.en:
Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper.
After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength: to thee and to thy power this earth hath bowed itself.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं महामुरुं वज्रेण वज्रिन्पर्वशश्चकर्तिथ ।
अवासृजो निवृताः सर्तवा अपः सत्रा विश्वं दधिषे केवलं सहः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tamindra parvatam mahamurum vajrena vajrinparvashashchakartitha |
avasrijo nivritah sartava apah satra vishvam dadhishe kevalam sahah ||
verses.en:
Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud.
Thou hast sent down the obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.

verses.sa:
नू चित्सहोजा अमृतो नि तुन्दते होता यद्दूतो अभवद्विवस्वतः ।
वि साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभी रजो मम आ देवताता हविषा विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
nu chitsahoja amrito ni tundate hota yadduto abhavadvivasvatah |
vi sadhishthebhih pathibhi rajo mama a devatata havisha vivasati ||
verses.en:
NE'ER waxeth faint the Immortal, Son of Strength, since he, the Herald, hath become Vivasvan's messenger.
On paths most excellent he measured out mid-air: he with oblation calls to service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
आ स्वमद्म युवमानो अजरस्तृष्वविष्यन्नतसेषु तिष्ठति ।
अत्यो न पृष्ठं प्रुषितस्य रोचते दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
a svamadma yuvamano ajarastrishvavishyannataseshu tishthati |
atyo na prishtham prushitasya rochate divo na sanu stanayannachikradat ||
verses.en:
Never decaying, seizing his appropriate food, rapidly, eagerly through the dry wood he spreads.
His back, as he is sprinkled, glistens like a horse: loud hath he roared and shouted like the heights of heaven?

verses.sa:
क्राणा रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिः पुरोहितो होता निषत्तो रयिषाळमर्त्यः ।
रथो न विक्ष्वृञ्जसान आयुषु व्यानुषग्वार्या देव ऋण्वति ॥
verses.rom:
krana rudrebhirvasubhih purohito hota nishatto rayishalamartyah |
ratho na vikshvrinjasana ayushu vyanushagvarya deva rinvati ||
verses.en:
Set high in place o'er all that Vasus, Rudras do, immortal, Lord of riches, seated as High Priest;
Hastening like a car to men, to those who live, the God without delay gives boons to be desired.

verses.sa:
वि वातजूतो अतसेषु तिष्ठते वृथा जुहूभिः सृण्या तुविष्वणिः ।
तृषु यदग्ने वनिनो वृषायसे कृष्णं त एम रुशदूर्मे अजर ॥
verses.rom:
vi vatajuto ataseshu tishthate vritha juhubhih srinya tuvishvanih |
trishu yadagne vanino vrishayase krishnam ta ema rushadurme ajara ||
verses.en:
Urged by the wind be spreads through dry wood as he lists, armed with his tongues for sickles, with a mighty roar.
Black is thy path, Agni, changeless, with glittering waves! when like a bull thou rushest eager to the trees.

verses.sa:
तपुर्जम्भो वन आ वातचोदितो यूथे न साह्वाँ अव वाति वंसगः ।
अभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाजसा रज स्थातुश्चरथं भयते पतत्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
tapurjambho vana a vatachodito yuthe na sahvan ava vati vamsagah |
abhivrajannakshitam pajasa raja sthatushcharatham bhayate patatrinah ||
verses.en:
With teeth of flame, wind-driven, through the wood he speeds, triumphant like a bull among the herd of cows,
With bright strength roaming to the everlasting air: things fixed, things moving quake before him as he flies.

verses.sa:
दधुष्ट्वा भृगवो मानुषेष्वा रयिं न चारुं सुहवं जनेभ्यः ।
होतारमग्ने अतिथिं वरेण्यं मित्रं न शेवं दिव्याय जन्मने ॥
verses.rom:
dadhushtva bhrigavo manusheshva rayim na charum suhavam janebhyah |
hotaramagne atithim varenyam mitram na shevam divyaya janmane ||
verses.en:
The Bhrgus established thee among mankind for men, like as a treasure, beauteous, easy to invoke;
Thee, Agni, as a herald and choice-worthy guest, as an auspicious Friend to the Celestial Race.

verses.sa:
होतारं सप्त जुह्वो यजिष्ठं यं वाघतो वृणते अध्वरेषु ।
अग्निं विश्वेषामरतिं वसूनां सपर्यामि प्रयसा यामि रत्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
hotaram sapta juhvo yajishtham yam vaghato vrinate adhvareshu |
agnim vishveshamaratim vasunam saparyami prayasa yami ratnam ||
verses.en:
Agni, the seven tongues' deftest Sacrificer, him whom the priests elect at solemn worship,
The Herald, messenger of all the Vasus, I serve with dainty food, I ask for riches.

verses.sa:
अच्छिद्रा सूनो सहसो नो अद्य स्तोतृभ्यो मित्रमहः शर्म यच्छ ।
अग्ने गृणन्तमंहस उरुष्योर्जो नपात्पूर्भिरायसीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
achchhidra suno sahaso no adya stotribhyo mitramahah sharma yachchha |
agne grinantamamhasa urushyorjo napatpurbhirayasibhih ||
verses.en:
Grant, Son of Strength, thou rich in friends, a refuge without a flaw this day to us thy praisers.
O Agni, Son of Strength, with forts of iron preserve thou from distress the man who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
भवा वरूथं गृणते विभावो भवा मघवन्मघवद्भ्यः शर्म ।
उरुष्याग्ने अंहसो गृणन्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
bhava varutham grinate vibhavo bhava maghavanmaghavadbhyah sharma |
urushyagne amhaso grinantam pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Be thou a refuge, Bright One, to the singer, a shelter, Bounteous Lord, to those who worship.
Preserve the singer from distress, O Agni. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
वया इदग्ने अग्नयस्ते अन्ये त्वे विश्वे अमृता मादयन्ते ।
वैश्वानर नाभिरसि क्षितीनां स्थूणेव जनाँ उपमिद्ययन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
vaya idagne agnayaste anye tve vishve amrita madayante |
vaishvanara nabhirasi kshitinam sthuneva janan upamidyayantha ||
verses.en:
THE other fires are, verily, thy branches; the Immortals all rejoice in thee, O Agni.
Centre art thou, Vaisvanara, of the people, sustaining men like a deep-founded pillar.

verses.sa:
मूर्धा दिवो नाभिरग्निः पृथिव्या अथाभवदरती रोदस्योः ।
तं त्वा देवासोऽजनयन्त देवं वैश्वानर ज्योतिरिदार्याय ॥
verses.rom:
murdha divo nabhiragnih prithivya athabhavadarati rodasyoh |
tam tva devaso'janayanta devam vaishvanara jyotiridaryaya ||
verses.en:
The forehead of the sky, earth's centre, Agni became the messenger of earth and heaven.
Vaisvanara, the Deities produced thee, a God, to be a light unto the Arya.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्ये न रश्मयो ध्रुवासो वैश्वानरे दधिरेऽग्ना वसूनि ।
या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु या मानुषेष्वसि तस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
a surye na rashmayo dhruvaso vaishvanare dadhire'gna vasuni |
ya parvateshvoshadhishvapsu ya manusheshvasi tasya raja ||
verses.en:
As in the Sun firm rays are set for ever, treasures are in Vaisvanara, in Agni.
Of all the riches in the hills, the waters, the herbs, among mankind, thou art the Sovran.

verses.sa:
बृहती इव सूनवे रोदसी गिरो होता मनुष्यो न दक्षः ।
स्वर्वते सत्यशुष्माय पूर्वीर्वैश्वानराय नृतमाय यह्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
brihati iva sunave rodasi giro hota manushyo na dakshah |
svarvate satyashushmaya purvirvaishvanaraya nritamaya yahvih ||
verses.en:
As the great World-halves, so are their Son's praises; skilled, as a man, to act, is he the Herald.
Vaisvanara, celestial, truly mighty, most manly One, hath many a youthful consort.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चित्ते बृहतो जातवेदो वैश्वानर प्र रिरिचे महित्वम् ।
राजा कृष्टीनामसि मानुषीणां युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ ॥
verses.rom:
divashchitte brihato jatavedo vaishvanara pra ririche mahitvam |
raja krishtinamasi manushinam yudha devebhyo varivashchakartha ||
verses.en:
Even the lofty heaven, O Jatavedas Vaisvanara, hath not attained thy greatness.
Thou art the King of lands where men are settled, thou hast brought comfort to the Gods in battle.

verses.sa:
प्र नू महित्वं वृषभस्य वोचं यं पूरवो वृत्रहणं सचन्ते ।
वैश्वानरो दस्युमग्निर्जघन्वाँ अधूनोत्काष्ठा अव शम्बरं भेत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra nu mahitvam vrishabhasya vocham yam puravo vritrahanam sachante |
vaishvanaro dasyumagnirjaghanvan adhunotkashtha ava shambaram bhet ||
verses.en:
Now will I tell the greatness of the Hero whom Puru's sons follow as Vrtra's slayer:
Agni Vaisvanara struck down the Dasyu, cleave Sambara through and shattered down his fences.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो महिम्ना विश्वकृष्टिर्भरद्वाजेषु यजतो विभावा ।
शातवनेये शतिनीभिरग्निः पुरुणीथे जरते सूनृतावान् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaro mahimna vishvakrishtirbharadvajeshu yajato vibhava |
shatavaneye shatinibhiragnih purunithe jarate sunritavan ||
verses.en:
Vaisvanara, dwelling by his might with all men, far-shining, holy mid the Bharadvajas,
Is lauded, excellent, with hundred praises by Purunitha, son of Satavani.

verses.sa:
वह्निं यशसं विदथस्य केतुं सुप्राव्यं दूतं सद्योअर्थम् ।
द्विजन्मानं रयिमिव प्रशस्तं रातिं भरद्भृगवे मातरिश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
vahnim yashasam vidathasya ketum supravyam dutam sadyoartham |
dvijanmanam rayimiva prashastam ratim bharadbhrigave matarishva ||
verses.en:
As 'twere Some goodly treasure Matarisvan brought, as a gift, the glorious Priest to Bhrgu,
Banner of sacrifice, the good Protector, child of two births, the swiftly moving envoy.

verses.sa:
अस्य शासुरुभयासः सचन्ते हविष्मन्त उशिजो ये च मर्ताः ।
दिवश्चित्पूर्वो न्यसादि होतापृच्छ्यो विश्पतिर्विक्षु वेधाः ॥
verses.rom:
asya shasurubhayasah sachante havishmanta ushijo ye cha martah |
divashchitpurvo nyasadi hotaprichchhyo vishpatirvikshu vedhah ||
verses.en:
Both Gods and men obey this Ruler's order, Gods who are worshipped, men who yearn and worship.
As Priest he takes his seat ere break of morning, House-Lord, adorable with men, Ordainer.

verses.sa:
तं नव्यसी हृद आ जायमानमस्मत्सुकीर्तिर्मधुजिह्वमश्याः ।
यमृत्विजो वृजने मानुषासः प्रयस्वन्त आयवो जीजनन्त ॥
verses.rom:
tam navyasi hrida a jayamanamasmatsukirtirmadhujihvamashyah |
yamritvijo vrijane manushasah prayasvanta ayavo jijananta ||
verses.en:
May our fair praise, heart-born, most recent, reach him whose tongue, e'en at his birth, is sweet as honey;
Whom mortal priests, men, with their strong endeavour, supplied with dainty viands, have created.

verses.sa:
उशिक्पावको वसुर्मानुषेषु वरेण्यो होताधायि विक्षु ।
दमूना गृहपतिर्दम आँ अग्निर्भुवद्रयिपती रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ushikpavako vasurmanusheshu varenyo hotadhayi vikshu |
damuna grihapatirdama an agnirbhuvadrayipati rayinam ||
verses.en:
Good to mankind, the yearning Purifier hath among men been placed as Priest choice-worthy.
May Agni be our Friend, Lord of the Household, protector of the riches in the dwelling.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं पतिमग्ने रयीणां प्र शंसामो मतिभिर्गोतमासः ।
आशुं न वाजम्भरं मर्जयन्तः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vayam patimagne rayinam pra shamsamo matibhirgotamasah |
ashum na vajambharam marjayantah pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
As such we Gotamas with hymns extol thee, O Agni, as the guardian Lord of riches,
Decking thee like a horse, the swift prizewinner. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र तवसे तुराय प्रयो न हर्मि स्तोमं माहिनाय ।
ऋचीषमायाध्रिगव ओहमिन्द्राय ब्रह्माणि राततमा ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu pra tavase turaya prayo na harmi stomam mahinaya |
richishamayadhrigava ohamindraya brahmani ratatama ||
verses.en:
EVEN to him, swift, strong and high. exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands,
My thought to him resistless, praise-deserving, prayers offered most especially to Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्रय इव प्र यंसि भराम्याङ्गूषं बाधे सुवृक्ति ।
इन्द्राय हृदा मनसा मनीषा प्रत्नाय पत्ये धियो मर्जयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu praya iva pra yamsi bharamyangusham badhe suvrikti |
indraya hrida manasa manisha pratnaya patye dhiyo marjayanta ||
verses.en:
Praise, like oblation, I present, and utter aloud my song, my fair hymn to the Victor.
For Indra, who is Lord of old, the singers have decked their lauds with heart and mind and spirit.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यमुपमं स्वर्षां भराम्याङ्गूषमास्येन ।
मंहिष्ठमच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनां सुवृक्तिभिः सूरिं वावृधध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu tyamupamam svarsham bharamyangushamasyena |
mamhishthamachchhoktibhirmatinam suvriktibhih surim vavridhadhyai ||
verses.en:
To him then with my lips mine adoration, winning heaven's light, most excellent, I offer,
To magnify with songs of invocation and with fair hymns the Lord, most bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु स्तोमं सं हिनोमि रथं न तष्टेव तत्सिनाय ।
गिरश्च गिर्वाहसे सुवृक्तीन्द्राय विश्वमिन्वं मेधिराय ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu stomam sam hinomi ratham na tashteva tatsinaya |
girashcha girvahase suvriktindraya vishvaminvam medhiraya ||
verses.en:
Even for him I frame a laud, as fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it,--
Praises to him who gladly hears our praises, a hymn well-formed, all-moving, to wise Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु सप्तिमिव श्रवस्येन्द्रायार्कं जुह्वा समञ्जे ।
वीरं दानौकसं वन्दध्यै पुरां गूर्तश्रवसं दर्माणम् ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu saptimiva shravasyendrayarkam juhva samanje |
viram danaukasam vandadhyai puram gurtashravasam darmanam ||
verses.en:
So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn, as 'twere a horse, through love of glory,
To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्वष्टा तक्षद्वज्रं स्वपस्तमं स्वर्यं रणाय ।
वृत्रस्य चिद्विदद्येन मर्म तुजन्नीशानस्तुजता कियेधाः ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu tvashta takshadvajram svapastamam svaryam ranaya |
