vritrasya chidvidadyena marma tujannishanastujata kiyedhah ||
verses.en:
Even for him hath Tvastar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle,
Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vrtra, striking-the vast, the mighty with the striker.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु मातुः सवनेषु सद्यो महः पितुं पपिवाञ्चार्वन्ना ।
मुषायद्विष्णुः पचतं सहीयान्विध्यद्वराहं तिरो अद्रिमस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
asyedu matuh savaneshu sadyo mahah pitum papivancharvanna |
mushayadvishnuh pachatam sahiyanvidhyadvaraham tiro adrimasta ||
verses.en:
As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Visnu had drunk up the draught, he plundered.
The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the mountain.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु ग्नाश्चिद्देवपत्नीरिन्द्रायार्कमहिहत्य ऊवुः ।
परि द्यावापृथिवी जभ्र उर्वी नास्य ते महिमानं परि ष्टः ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu gnashchiddevapatnirindrayarkamahihatya uvuh |
pari dyavaprithivi jabhra urvi nasya te mahimanam pari shtah ||
verses.en:
To him, to Indra, when he slew the Dragon, the Dames, too, Consorts of the Gods, wove praises.
The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy greatness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.

verses.sa:
अस्येदेव प्र रिरिचे महित्वं दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात् ।
स्वराळिन्द्रो दम आ विश्वगूर्तः स्वरिरमत्रो ववक्षे रणाय ॥
verses.rom:
asyedeva pra ririche mahitvam divasprithivyah paryantarikshat |
svaralindro dama a vishvagurtah svariramatro vavakshe ranaya ||
verses.en:
Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air, and heaven.
Indra, approved by all men, self-resplendent, waxed in his home, loud-voiced and strong for battle.

verses.sa:
अस्येदेव शवसा शुषन्तं वि वृश्चद्वज्रेण वृत्रमिन्द्रः ।
गा न व्राणा अवनीरमुञ्चदभि श्रवो दावने सचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
asyedeva shavasa shushantam vi vrishchadvajrena vritramindrah |
ga na vrana avaniramunchadabhi shravo davane sachetah ||
verses.en:
Through his own strength Indra with bolt of thunder cut piece-meal Vrtra, drier up of waters.
He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु त्वेषसा रन्त सिन्धवः परि यद्वज्रेण सीमयच्छत् ।
ईशानकृद्दाशुषे दशस्यन्तुर्वीतये गाधं तुर्वणिः कः ॥
verses.rom:
asyedu tveshasa ranta sindhavah pari yadvajrena simayachchhat |
ishanakriddashushe dashasyanturvitaye gadham turvanih kah ||
verses.en:
The rivers played, through his impetuous splendour, since with his bolt he compassed them on all sides.
Using his might and favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turviti.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र भरा तूतुजानो वृत्राय वज्रमीशानः कियेधाः ।
गोर्न पर्व वि रदा तिरश्चेष्यन्नर्णांस्यपां चरध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu pra bhara tutujano vritraya vajramishanah kiyedhah |
gorna parva vi rada tirashcheshyannarnamsyapam charadhyai ||
verses.en:
Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement, against this Vrtra cast thy bolt of thunder.
Rend thou his joints, as of an ox, dissevered, with bolt oblique, that floods of rain may follow.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु प्र ब्रूहि पूर्व्याणि तुरस्य कर्माणि नव्य उक्थैः ।
युधे यदिष्णान आयुधान्यृघायमाणो निरिणाति शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
asyedu pra bruhi purvyani turasya karmani navya ukthaih |
yudhe yadishnana ayudhanyrighayamano nirinati shatrun ||
verses.en:
Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly,
When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु भिया गिरयश्च दृळ्हा द्यावा च भूमा जनुषस्तुजेते ।
उपो वेनस्य जोगुवान ओणिं सद्यो भुवद्वीर्याय नोधाः ॥
verses.rom:
asyedu bhiya girayashcha drilha dyava cha bhuma janushastujete |
upo venasya joguvana onim sadyo bhuvadviryaya nodhah ||
verses.en:
When he, yea, he, comes forth the firm. Set mountains and the whole heaven and earth, tremble for terror.
May Nodhas, ever praising the protection of that dear Friend, gain quickly strength heroic.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यदनु दाय्येषामेको यद्वव्ने भूरेरीशानः ।
प्रैतशं सूर्ये पस्पृधानं सौवश्व्ये सुष्विमावदिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
asma idu tyadanu dayyeshameko yadvavne bhurerishanah |
praitasham surye paspridhanam sauvashvye sushvimavadindrah ||
verses.en:
Now unto him of these things hath been given what he who rules alone o'er much, electeth.
Indra hath helped Etasa, Soma-presser, contending in the race of steeds with Surya.

verses.sa:
एवा ते हारियोजना सुवृक्तीन्द्र ब्रह्माणि गोतमासो अक्रन् ।
ऐषु विश्वपेशसं धियं धाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
eva te hariyojana suvriktindra brahmani gotamaso akran |
aishu vishvapeshasam dhiyam dhah pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of Bay Coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers to please thee.
Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
प्र मन्महे शवसानाय शूषमाङ्गूषं गिर्वणसे अङ्गिरस्वत् ।
सुवृक्तिभि स्तुवत ऋग्मियायार्चामार्कं नरे विश्रुताय ॥
verses.rom:
pra manmahe shavasanaya shushamangusham girvanase angirasvat |
suvriktibhi stuvata rigmiyayarchamarkam nare vishrutaya ||
verses.en:
LIKE Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty.
Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महि नमो भरध्वमाङ्गूष्यं शवसानाय साम ।
येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञा अर्चन्तो अङ्गिरसो गा अविन्दन् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamangushyam shavasanaya sama |
yena nah purve pitarah padajna archanto angiraso ga avindan ||
verses.en:
Unto the great bring ye great adoration, a chant with praise to him exceeding mighty,
Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises and knowing well the places, found the cattle.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्याङ्गिरसां चेष्टौ विदत्सरमा तनयाय धासिम् ।
बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः समुस्रियाभिर्वावशन्त नरः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyangirasam cheshtau vidatsarama tanayaya dhasim |
brihaspatirbhinadadrim vidadgah samusriyabhirvavashanta narah ||
verses.en:
When Indra and the Angirases desired it, Sarama found provision for her offspring.
Brhaspati cleft the mountain, found the cattle: the heroes shouted with the kine in triumph.

verses.sa:
स सुष्टुभा स स्तुभा सप्त विप्रैः स्वरेणाद्रिं स्वर्यो नवग्वैः ।
सरण्युभिः फलिगमिन्द्र शक्र वलं रवेण दरयो दशग्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sushtubha sa stubha sapta vipraih svarenadrim svaryo navagvaih |
saranyubhih phaligamindra shakra valam ravena darayo dashagvaih ||
verses.en:
Mid shout, loud shout, and roar, with the Navagvas, seven singers, hast thou, heavenly, rent the mountain;
Thou hast, with speeders, with Dasagvas, Indra, Sakra, with thunder rent obstructive Vala.

verses.sa:
गृणानो अङ्गिरोभिर्दस्म वि वरुषसा सूर्येण गोभिरन्धः ।
वि भूम्या अप्रथय इन्द्र सानु दिवो रज उपरमस्तभायः ॥
verses.rom:
grinano angirobhirdasma vi varushasa suryena gobhirandhah |
vi bhumya aprathaya indra sanu divo raja uparamastabhayah ||
verses.en:
Praised by Angirases, thou, foe-destroyer, hast, with the Dawn, Sun, rays, dispelled the darkness.
Thou Indra, hast spread out the earth's high ridges, and firmly fixed the region under heaven.

verses.sa:
तदु प्रयक्षतममस्य कर्म दस्मस्य चारुतममस्ति दंसः ।
उपह्वरे यदुपरा अपिन्वन्मध्वर्णसो नद्यश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
tadu prayakshatamamasya karma dasmasya charutamamasti damsah |
upahvare yadupara apinvanmadhvarnaso nadyashchatasrah ||
verses.en:
This is the deed most worthy of all honour, the fairest marvel of the Wonder-Worker,
That, nigh where heaven bends down, he made four rivers flow full with waves that carry down sweet water.

verses.sa:
द्विता वि वव्रे सनजा सनीळे अयास्य स्तवमानेभिरर्कैः ।
भगो न मेने परमे व्योमन्नधारयद्रोदसी सुदंसाः ॥
verses.rom:
dvita vi vavre sanaja sanile ayasya stavamanebhirarkaih |
bhago na mene parame vyomannadharayadrodasi sudamsah ||
verses.en:
Unwearied, won with lauding hymns, he parted of old the ancient Pair, united ever.
In highest sky like Bhaga, he the doer of marvels set both Dames and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
सनाद्दिवं परि भूमा विरूपे पुनर्भुवा युवती स्वेभिरेवैः ।
कृष्णेभिरक्तोषा रुशद्भिर्वपुर्भिरा चरतो अन्यान्या ॥
verses.rom:
sanaddivam pari bhuma virupe punarbhuva yuvati svebhirevaih |
krishnebhiraktosha rushadbhirvapurbhira charato anyanya ||
verses.en:
Still born afresh, young Dames, each in her manner, unlike in hue, the Pair in alternation
Round heaven and earth from ancient time have travelled, Night with her dark limbs, Dawn with limbs of splendour.

verses.sa:
सनेमि सख्यं स्वपस्यमानः सूनुर्दाधार शवसा सुदंसाः ।
आमासु चिद्दधिषे पक्वमन्तः पयः कृष्णासु रुशद्रोहिणीषु ॥
verses.rom:
sanemi sakhyam svapasyamanah sunurdadhara shavasa sudamsah |
amasu chiddadhishe pakvamantah payah krishnasu rushadrohinishu ||
verses.en:
Rich in good actions, skilled in operation, the Son with might maintains his perfect friendship.
Thou in the raw cows, black of hue or ruddy, storest the ripe milk glossy white in colour.

verses.sa:
सनात्सनीळा अवनीरवाता व्रता रक्षन्ते अमृताः सहोभिः ।
पुरू सहस्रा जनयो न पत्नीर्दुवस्यन्ति स्वसारो अह्रयाणम् ॥
verses.rom:
sanatsanila avaniravata vrata rakshante amritah sahobhih |
puru sahasra janayo na patnirduvasyanti svasaro ahrayanam ||
verses.en:
Their paths, of old connected, rest uninjured; they with great might preserve the immortal statutes.
For many thousand holy works the Sisters wait on the haughty Lord like wives and matrons.

verses.sa:
सनायुवो नमसा नव्यो अर्कैर्वसूयवो मतयो दस्म दद्रुः ।
पतिं न पत्नीरुशतीरुशन्तं स्पृशन्ति त्वा शवसावन्मनीषाः ॥
verses.rom:
sanayuvo namasa navyo arkairvasuyavo matayo dasma dadruh |
patim na patnirushatirushantam sprishanti tva shavasavanmanishah ||
verses.en:
Thoughts ancient, seeking wealth, with adoration, with newest lauds have sped to thee, O Mighty.
As yearning wives cleave to their yearning husband, so cleave our hymns to thee, O Lord most potent.

verses.sa:
सनादेव तव रायो गभस्तौ न क्षीयन्ते नोप दस्यन्ति दस्म ।
द्युमाँ असि क्रतुमाँ इन्द्र धीरः शिक्षा शचीवस्तव नः शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sanadeva tava rayo gabhastau na kshiyante nopa dasyanti dasma |
dyuman asi kratuman indra dhirah shiksha shachivastava nah shachibhih ||
verses.en:
Strong God, the riches which thy hands have holden from days of old have perished not nor wasted.
Splendid art thou, O Indra, wise, unbending: strengthen us with might, O Lord of Power.

verses.sa:
सनायते गोतम इन्द्र नव्यमतक्षद्ब्रह्म हरियोजनाय ।
सुनीथाय नः शवसान नोधाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
sanayate gotama indra navyamatakshadbrahma hariyojanaya |
sunithaya nah shavasana nodhah pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
O mighty Indra, Gotama's son Nodhas hath fashioned this new prayer to thee Eternal,
Sure leader, yoker of the Tawny Coursers. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
त्वं महाँ इन्द्र यो ह शुष्मैर्द्यावा जज्ञानः पृथिवी अमे धाः ।
यद्ध ते विश्वा गिरयश्चिदभ्वा भिया दृळ्हासः किरणा नैजन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mahan indra yo ha shushmairdyava jajnanah prithivi ame dhah |
yaddha te vishva girayashchidabhva bhiya drilhasah kirana naijan ||
verses.en:
THOU art the Mighty One; when born, O Indra, with power thou terrifiedst earth and heaven;
When, in their fear of thee, all firm-set mountains and monstrous creatures shook like dust before thee.

verses.sa:
आ यद्धरी इन्द्र विव्रता वेरा ते वज्रं जरिता बाह्वोर्धात् ।
येनाविहर्यतक्रतो अमित्रान्पुर इष्णासि पुरुहूत पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
a yaddhari indra vivrata vera te vajram jarita bahvordhat |
yenaviharyatakrato amitranpura ishnasi puruhuta purvih ||
verses.en:
When thy two wandering Bays thou drawest hither, thy praiser laid within thine arms the thunder,
Wherewith, O Much-invoked, in will resistless, thou smitest foemen down and many a castle.

verses.sa:
त्वं सत्य इन्द्र धृष्णुरेतान्त्वमृभुक्षा नर्यस्त्वं षाट् ।
त्वं शुष्णं वृजने पृक्ष आणौ यूने कुत्साय द्युमते सचाहन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam satya indra dhrishnuretantvamribhuksha naryastvam shat |
tvam shushnam vrijane priksha anau yune kutsaya dyumate sachahan ||
verses.en:
Faithful art thou, these thou defiest, Indra; thou art the Rbhus' Lord, heroic, victor.
Thou, by his side, for young and glorious Kutsa, with steed and car in battle slewest Susna,

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र चोदीः सखा वृत्रं यद्वज्रिन्वृषकर्मन्नुभ्नाः ।
यद्ध शूर वृषमणः पराचैर्वि दस्यूँर्योनावकृतो वृथाषाट् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadindra chodih sakha vritram yadvajrinvrishakarmannubhnah |
yaddha shura vrishamanah parachairvi dasyunryonavakrito vrithashat ||

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्रारिषण्यन्दृळ्हस्य चिन्मर्तानामजुष्टौ ।
व्यस्मदा काष्ठा अर्वते वर्घनेव वज्रिञ्छ्नथिह्यमित्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadindrarishanyandrilhasya chinmartanamajushtau |
vyasmada kashtha arvate varghaneva vajrinchhnathihyamitran ||
verses.en:
This doest thou, and art not harmed, O Indra, e'en in the anger of the strongest mortal.
Lay thou the race-course open for our horses: as with a club, slay, Thunder-armed! our foemen.

verses.sa:
त्वां ह त्यदिन्द्रार्णसातौ स्वर्मीळ्हे नर आजा हवन्ते ।
तव स्वधाव इयमा समर्य ऊतिर्वाजेष्वतसाय्या भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadindrarnasatau svarmilhe nara aja havante |
tava svadhava iyama samarya utirvajeshvatasayya bhut ||
verses.en:
Hence men invoke thee, Indra, in the tumult of battle, in the light-bestowing conflict.
This aid of thine, O Godlike One, was ever to be implored in deeds of might in combat.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र सप्त युध्यन्पुरो वज्रिन्पुरुकुत्साय दर्दः ।
बर्हिर्न यत्सुदासे वृथा वर्गंहो राजन्वरिवः पूरवे कः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadindra sapta yudhyanpuro vajrinpurukutsaya dardah |
barhirna yatsudase vritha vargamho rajanvarivah purave kah ||
verses.en:
Warring for Purukutsa thou, O Indra, Thunder-armed! breakest down the seven castles;
Easily, for Sudas, like grass didst rend them, and out of need, King, broughtest gain to Puru.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यां न इन्द्र देव चित्रामिषमापो न पीपयः परिज्मन् ।
यया शूर प्रत्यस्मभ्यं यंसि त्मनमूर्जं न विश्वध क्षरध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyam na indra deva chitramishamapo na pipayah parijman |
yaya shura pratyasmabhyam yamsi tmanamurjam na vishvadha ksharadhyai ||
verses.en:
O Indra, God who movest round about us, feed us with varied food plenteous as water-
Food wherewithal, O Hero, thou bestowest vigour itself to flow to us for ever.

verses.sa:
अकारि त इन्द्र गोतमेभिर्ब्रह्माण्योक्ता नमसा हरिभ्याम् ।
सुपेशसं वाजमा भरा नः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
akari ta indra gotamebhirbrahmanyokta namasa haribhyam |
supeshasam vajama bhara nah pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Prayers have been made by Gotamas, O Indra, addressed to thee, with laud for thy Bay Horses.
Bring us in noble shape abundant riches. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
वृष्णे शर्धाय सुमखाय वेधसे नोधः सुवृक्तिं प्र भरा मरुद्भ्यः ।
अपो न धीरो मनसा सुहस्त्यो गिरः समञ्जे विदथेष्वाभुवः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishne shardhaya sumakhaya vedhase nodhah suvriktim pra bhara marudbhyah |
apo na dhiro manasa suhastyo girah samanje vidatheshvabhuvah ||
verses.en:
BRING for the manly host, wise and majestical, O Nodhas, for the Maruts bring thou a pure gift.
I deck my songs as one deft-handed, wise in mind prepares the water that hath power in solemn rites.

verses.sa:
ते जज्ञिरे दिव ऋष्वास उक्षणो रुद्रस्य मर्या असुरा अरेपसः ।
पावकासः शुचयः सूर्या इव सत्वानो न द्रप्सिनो घोरवर्पसः ॥
verses.rom:
te jajnire diva rishvasa ukshano rudrasya marya asura arepasah |
pavakasah shuchayah surya iva satvano na drapsino ghoravarpasah ||
verses.en:
They spring to birth, the lofty Ones, the Bulls of Heaven, divine, the youths of Rudra, free from spot and stain;
The purifiers, shining brightly even as suns, awful of form like giants, scattering rain-drops down.

verses.sa:
युवानो रुद्रा अजरा अभोग्घनो ववक्षुरध्रिगावः पर्वता इव ।
दृळ्हा चिद्विश्वा भुवनानि पार्थिवा प्र च्यावयन्ति दिव्यानि मज्मना ॥
verses.rom:
yuvano rudra ajara abhogghano vavakshuradhrigavah parvata iva |
drilha chidvishva bhuvanani parthiva pra chyavayanti divyani majmana ||
verses.en:
Young Rudras, demon-slayers, never growing old, they have waxed, even as mountains, irresistible.
They make all beings tremble with their mighty strength, even the very strongest, both of earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
चित्रैरञ्जिभिर्वपुषे व्यञ्जते वक्षस्सु रुक्माँ अधि येतिरे शुभे ।
अंसेष्वेषां नि मिमृक्षुरृष्टयः साकं जज्ञिरे स्वधया दिवो नरः ॥
verses.rom:
chitrairanjibhirvapushe vyanjate vakshassu rukman adhi yetire shubhe |
amseshvesham ni mimrikshurrishtayah sakam jajnire svadhaya divo narah ||
verses.en:
With glittering ornaments they deck them forth for show; for beauty on their breasts they bind their chains of gold.
The lances on their shoulders pound to pieces; they were born together, of themselves, the Men of Heaven.

verses.sa:
ईशानकृतो धुनयो रिशादसो वातान्विद्युतस्तविषीभिरक्रत ।
दुहन्त्यूधर्दिव्यानि धूतयो भूमिं पिन्वन्ति पयसा परिज्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
ishanakrito dhunayo rishadaso vatanvidyutastavishibhirakrata |
duhantyudhardivyani dhutayo bhumim pinvanti payasa parijrayah ||
verses.en:
Loud roarers, giving strength, devourers of the foe, they make the winds, they make the lightnings with their powers.
The restless shakers drain the udders of the sky, and ever wandering round fill the earth full with milk.

verses.sa:
पिन्वन्त्यपो मरुतः सुदानवः पयो घृतवद्विदथेष्वाभुवः ।
अत्यं न मिहे वि नयन्ति वाजिनमुत्सं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
pinvantyapo marutah sudanavah payo ghritavadvidatheshvabhuvah |
atyam na mihe vi nayanti vajinamutsam duhanti stanayantamakshitam ||
verses.en:
The bounteous Maruts with the fatness dropping milk fill full the waters which avail in solemn rites.
They lead, as 'twere, the Strong Horse forth, that it may rain: they milk the thundering, the never-failing spring.

verses.sa:
महिषासो मायिनश्चित्रभानवो गिरयो न स्वतवसो रघुष्यदः ।
मृगा इव हस्तिनः खादथा वना यदारुणीषु तविषीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahishaso mayinashchitrabhanavo girayo na svatavaso raghushyadah |
mriga iva hastinah khadatha vana yadarunishu tavishirayugdhvam ||
verses.en:
Mighty, with wondrous power and marvellously bright, selfstrong like mountains, ye glide swiftly on your way.
Like the wild elephants ye eat the forests up when ye assume your strength among the bright red flames.

verses.sa:
सिंहा इव नानदति प्रचेतसः पिशा इव सुपिशो विश्ववेदसः ।
क्षपो जिन्वन्तः पृषतीभिरृष्टिभिः समित्सबाधः शवसाहिमन्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
simha iva nanadati prachetasah pisha iva supisho vishvavedasah |
kshapo jinvantah prishatibhirrishtibhih samitsabadhah shavasahimanyavah ||
verses.en:
Exceeding wise they roar like lions mightily, they, all-possessing, are beauteous as antelopes;
Stirring the darkness with lances and spotted deer, combined as priests, with serpents' fury through their might.

verses.sa:
रोदसी आ वदता गणश्रियो नृषाचः शूराः शवसाहिमन्यवः ।
आ वन्धुरेष्वमतिर्न दर्शता विद्युन्न तस्थौ मरुतो रथेषु वः ॥
verses.rom:
rodasi a vadata ganashriyo nrishachah shurah shavasahimanyavah |
a vandhureshvamatirna darshata vidyunna tasthau maruto ratheshu vah ||
verses.en:
Heroes who march in companies, befriending man, with serpents' ire through strength, ye greet the earth and heaven.
Upon the seats, O Maruts, of your chariots, upon the cars stands lightning visible as light.

verses.sa:
विश्ववेदसो रयिभिः समोकसः सम्मिश्लासस्तविषीभिर्विरप्शिनः ।
अस्तार इषुं दधिरे गभस्त्योरनन्तशुष्मा वृषखादयो नरः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvavedaso rayibhih samokasah sammishlasastavishibhirvirapshinah |
astara ishum dadhire gabhastyoranantashushma vrishakhadayo narah ||
verses.en:
Lords of all riches, dwelling in the home of wealth, endowed with mighty vigour, singers loud of voice,
Heroes, of powers infinite, armed with strong men's rings, the archers, they have laid the arrow on their arms.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेभिः पविभिः पयोवृध उज्जिघ्नन्त आपथ्यो न पर्वतान् ।
मखा अयासः स्वसृतो ध्रुवच्युतो दुध्रकृतो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayebhih pavibhih payovridha ujjighnanta apathyo na parvatan |
makha ayasah svasrito dhruvachyuto dudhrakrito maruto bhrajadrishtayah ||
verses.en:
They who with golden fellies make the rain increase drive forward the big clouds like wanderers on the way.
Self-moving, brisk, unwearied, they o'erthrow the firm; the Maruts with bright lances make all things to reel.

verses.sa:
घृषुं पावकं वनिनं विचर्षणिं रुद्रस्य सूनुं हवसा गृणीमसि ।
रजस्तुरं तवसं मारुतं गणमृजीषिणं वृषणं सश्चत श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
ghrishum pavakam vaninam vicharshanim rudrasya sunum havasa grinimasi |
rajasturam tavasam marutam ganamrijishinam vrishanam sashchata shriye ||
verses.en:
The progeny of Rudra we invoke with prayer, the brisk, the bright, the worshipful, the active Ones
To the strong band of Maruts cleave for happiness, the chasers of the sky, impetuous, vigorous.

verses.sa:
प्र नू स मर्तः शवसा जनाँ अति तस्थौ व ऊती मरुतो यमावत ।
अर्वद्भिर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिरापृच्छ्यं क्रतुमा क्षेति पुष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
pra nu sa martah shavasa janan ati tasthau va uti maruto yamavata |
arvadbhirvajam bharate dhana nribhiraprichchhyam kratuma ksheti pushyati ||
verses.en:
Maruts, the man whom ye have guarded with your help, he verily in strength surpasseth all mankind.
Spoil with his steeds he gaineth, treasure with his men; he winneth honourable strength and prospereth.

verses.sa:
चर्कृत्यं मरुतः पृत्सु दुष्टरं द्युमन्तं शुष्मं मघवत्सु धत्तन ।
धनस्पृतमुक्थ्यं विश्वचर्षणिं तोकं पुष्येम तनयं शतं हिमाः ॥
verses.rom:
charkrityam marutah pritsu dushtaram dyumantam shushmam maghavatsu dhattana |
dhanaspritamukthyam vishvacharshanim tokam pushyema tanayam shatam himah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, to the worshippers give glorious strength invincible in battle, brilliant, bringing wealth,
Praiseworthy, known to all men. May we foster well, during a hundred winters, son and progeny.

verses.sa:
नू ष्ठिरं मरुतो वीरवन्तमृतीषाहं रयिमस्मासु धत्त ।
सहस्रिणं शतिनं शूशुवांसं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
nu shthiram maruto viravantamritishaham rayimasmasu dhatta |
sahasrinam shatinam shushuvamsam pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Will ye then, O ye Maruts, grant us riches, durable, rich in men, defying onslaught.
A hundred, thousandfold, ever increasing? May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa: पश्वा न तायुं गुहा चतन्तं नमो युजानं नमो वहन्तम् ॥
verses.rom: pashva na tayum guha chatantam namo yujanam namo vahantam ||

verses.sa: सजोषा धीराः पदैरनु ग्मन्नुप त्वा सीदन्विश्वे यजत्राः ॥
verses.rom: sajosha dhirah padairanu gmannupa tva sidanvishve yajatrah ||

verses.sa: ऋतस्य देवा अनु व्रता गुर्भुवत्परिष्टिर्द्यौर्न भूम ॥
verses.rom: ritasya deva anu vrata gurbhuvatparishtirdyaurna bhuma ||

verses.sa: वर्धन्तीमापः पन्वा सुशिश्विमृतस्य योना गर्भे सुजातम् ॥
verses.rom: vardhantimapah panva sushishvimritasya yona garbhe sujatam ||

verses.sa: पुष्टिर्न रण्वा क्षितिर्न पृथ्वी गिरिर्न भुज्म क्षोदो न शम्भु ॥
verses.rom: pushtirna ranva kshitirna prithvi girirna bhujma kshodo na shambhu ||

verses.sa: अत्यो नाज्मन्सर्गप्रतक्तः सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः क ईं वराते ॥
verses.rom: atyo najmansargaprataktah sindhurna kshodah ka im varate ||

verses.sa: जामिः सिन्धूनां भ्रातेव स्वस्रामिभ्यान्न राजा वनान्यत्ति ॥
verses.rom: jamih sindhunam bhrateva svasramibhyanna raja vananyatti ||

verses.sa: यद्वातजूतो वना व्यस्थादग्निर्ह दाति रोमा पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom: yadvatajuto vana vyasthadagnirha dati roma prithivyah ||

verses.sa: श्वसित्यप्सु हंसो न सीदन्क्रत्वा चेतिष्ठो विशामुषर्भुत् ॥
verses.rom: shvasityapsu hamso na sidankratva chetishtho vishamusharbhut ||

verses.sa: सोमो न वेधा ऋतप्रजातः पशुर्न शिश्वा विभुर्दूरेभाः ॥
verses.rom: somo na vedha ritaprajatah pashurna shishva vibhurdurebhah ||

prose.en:
1. ONE-MINDED, wise, they tracked thee like a thief lurking in dark cave with a stolen cow:
Thee claiming worship, bearing it to Gods: there nigh to thee sate all the Holy Ones.

2. The Gods approached the ways of holy Law; there was a gathering vast as heaven itself.
The waters feed with praise the growing Babe, born nobly in the womb, the seat of Law.

3. Like grateful food, like some wide dwelling place, like a fruit-bearing hill, a wholesome stream.
Like a steed urged to run in swift career, rushing like Sindhu, who may check his course?

4. Kin as a brother to his sister floods, he eats the woods as a King eats the rich.
When through the forest, urged by wind, he spreads, verily Agni shears the hair of earth.

5. Like a swan sitting in the floods he pants wisest in mind mid men he wakes at morn.
A Sage like Soma, sprung from Law, he grew like some young creature, mighty, shining far.

verses.sa: रयिर्न चित्रा सूरो न संदृगायुर्न प्राणो नित्यो न सूनुः ॥
verses.rom: rayirna chitra suro na samdrigayurna prano nityo na sunuh ||

verses.sa: तक्वा न भूर्णिर्वना सिषक्ति पयो न धेनुः शुचिर्विभावा ॥
verses.rom: takva na bhurnirvana sishakti payo na dhenuh shuchirvibhava ||

verses.sa: दाधार क्षेममोको न रण्वो यवो न पक्वो जेता जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom: dadhara kshemamoko na ranvo yavo na pakvo jeta jananam ||

verses.sa: ऋषिर्न स्तुभ्वा विक्षु प्रशस्तो वाजी न प्रीतो वयो दधाति ॥
verses.rom: rishirna stubhva vikshu prashasto vaji na prito vayo dadhati ||

verses.sa: दुरोकशोचिः क्रतुर्न नित्यो जायेव योनावरं विश्वस्मै ॥
verses.rom: durokashochih kraturna nityo jayeva yonavaram vishvasmai ||

verses.sa: चित्रो यदभ्राट् छ्वेतो न विक्षु रथो न रुक्मी त्वेषः समत्सु ॥
verses.rom: chitro yadabhrat chhveto na vikshu ratho na rukmi tveshah samatsu ||

verses.sa: सेनेव सृष्टामं दधात्यस्तुर्न दिद्युत्त्वेषप्रतीका ॥
verses.rom: seneva srishtamam dadhatyasturna didyuttveshapratika ||

verses.sa: यमो ह जातो यमो जनित्वं जारः कनीनां पतिर्जनीनाम् ॥
verses.rom: yamo ha jato yamo janitvam jarah kaninam patirjaninam ||

verses.sa: तं वश्चराथा वयं वसत्यास्तं न गावो नक्षन्त इद्धम् ॥
verses.rom: tam vashcharatha vayam vasatyastam na gavo nakshanta iddham ||

verses.sa: सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः प्र नीचीरैनोन्नवन्त गावः स्वर्दृशीके ॥
verses.rom: sindhurna kshodah pra nichirainonnavanta gavah svardrishike ||

prose.en:
1. LIKE the Sun's glance, like wealth of varied sort, like breath which is the life, like one's own son,
Like a swift bird, a cow who yields her milk, pure and refulgent to the wood he speeds.

2. He offers safety like a pleasant home, like ripened corn, the Conqueror of men.
Like a Seer lauding, famed among the folk; like a steed friendly he vouchsafes us power.

3. With flame insatiate, like eternal might; caring for each one like a dame at home;
Bright when he shines forth, whitish mid the folk, like a car, gold-decked, thundering to the fight.

4. He strikes with terror like a dart shot forth, e'en like an archer's arrow tipped with flame;
Master of present and of future life, the maidens' lover and the matrons' Lord.

5. To him lead all your ways: may we attain the kindled God as cows their home at eve.
He drives the flames below as floods their swell: the rays rise up to the fair place of heaven.

verses.sa: वनेषु जायुर्मर्तेषु मित्रो वृणीते श्रुष्टिं राजेवाजुर्यम् ॥
verses.rom: vaneshu jayurmarteshu mitro vrinite shrushtim rajevajuryam ||

verses.sa: क्षेमो न साधुः क्रतुर्न भद्रो भुवत्स्वाधीर्होता हव्यवाट् ॥
verses.rom: kshemo na sadhuh kraturna bhadro bhuvatsvadhirhota havyavat ||

verses.sa: हस्ते दधानो नृम्णा विश्वान्यमे देवान्धाद्गुहा निषीदन् ॥
verses.rom: haste dadhano nrimna vishvanyame devandhadguha nishidan ||

verses.sa: विदन्तीमत्र नरो धियंधा हृदा यत्तष्टान्मन्त्राँ अशंसन् ॥
verses.rom: vidantimatra naro dhiyamdha hrida yattashtanmantran ashamsan ||

verses.sa: अजो न क्षां दाधार पृथिवीं तस्तम्भ द्यां मन्त्रेभिः सत्यैः ॥
verses.rom: ajo na ksham dadhara prithivim tastambha dyam mantrebhih satyaih ||

verses.sa: प्रिया पदानि पश्वो नि पाहि विश्वायुरग्ने गुहा गुहं गाः ॥
verses.rom: priya padani pashvo ni pahi vishvayuragne guha guham gah ||

verses.sa: य ईं चिकेत गुहा भवन्तमा यः ससाद धारामृतस्य ॥
verses.rom: ya im chiketa guha bhavantama yah sasada dharamritasya ||

verses.sa: वि ये चृतन्त्यृता सपन्त आदिद्वसूनि प्र ववाचास्मै ॥
verses.rom: vi ye chritantyrita sapanta adidvasuni pra vavachasmai ||

verses.sa: वि यो वीरुत्सु रोधन्महित्वोत प्रजा उत प्रसूष्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom: vi yo virutsu rodhanmahitvota praja uta prasushvantah ||

verses.sa: चित्तिरपां दमे विश्वायुः सद्मेव धीराः सम्माय चक्रुः ॥
verses.rom: chittirapam dame vishvayuh sadmeva dhirah sammaya chakruh ||

prose.en:
1. VICTORIOUS in the wood, Friend among men, ever he claims obedience as a King.
Gracious like peace, blessing like mental power, Priest was he, offering-bearer, full of thought.

2. He, bearing in his hand all manly might, crouched in the cavern, struck the Gods with fear.
Men filled with understanding find him there, when they have sting prayers formed within their heart.

3. He, like the Unborn, holds the broad earth up; and with effective utterance fixed the sky.
O Agni, guard the spots which cattle love: thou, life of all, hast gone from lair to lair.

4. Whoso hath known him dwelling in his lair, and hath approached the stream of holy Law,--
They who release him, paying sacred rites,--truly to such doth he announce great wealth.

5. He who grows mightily in herbs, within each fruitful mother and each babe she bears,
Wise, life of all men, in the waters' home,--for him have sages built as 'twere a seat.

verses.sa: श्रीणन्नुप स्थाद्दिवं भुरण्यु स्थातुश्चरथमक्तून्व्यूर्णोत् ॥
verses.rom: shrinannupa sthaddivam bhuranyu sthatushcharathamaktunvyurnot ||

verses.sa: परि यदेषामेको विश्वेषां भुवद्देवो देवानां महित्वा ॥
verses.rom: pari yadeshameko vishvesham bhuvaddevo devanam mahitva ||

verses.sa: आदित्ते विश्वे क्रतुं जुषन्त शुष्काद्यद्देव जीवो जनिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom: aditte vishve kratum jushanta shushkadyaddeva jivo janishthah ||

verses.sa: भजन्त विश्वे देवत्वं नाम ऋतं सपन्तो अमृतमेवैः ॥
verses.rom: bhajanta vishve devatvam nama ritam sapanto amritamevaih ||

verses.sa: ऋतस्य प्रेषा ऋतस्य धीतिर्विश्वायुर्विश्वे अपांसि चक्रुः ॥
verses.rom: ritasya presha ritasya dhitirvishvayurvishve apamsi chakruh ||

verses.sa: यस्तुभ्यं दाशाद्यो वा ते शिक्षात्तस्मै चिकित्वान्रयिं दयस्व ॥
verses.rom: yastubhyam dashadyo va te shikshattasmai chikitvanrayim dayasva ||

verses.sa: होता निषत्तो मनोरपत्ये स चिन्न्वासां पती रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom: hota nishatto manorapatye sa chinnvasam pati rayinam ||

verses.sa: इच्छन्त रेतो मिथस्तनूषु सं जानत स्वैर्दक्षैरमूराः ॥
verses.rom: ichchhanta reto mithastanushu sam janata svairdakshairamurah ||

verses.sa: पितुर्न पुत्राः क्रतुं जुषन्त श्रोषन्ये अस्य शासं तुरासः ॥
verses.rom: piturna putrah kratum jushanta shroshanye asya shasam turasah ||

verses.sa: वि राय और्णोद्दुरः पुरुक्षुः पिपेश नाकं स्तृभिर्दमूनाः ॥
verses.rom: vi raya aurnoddurah purukshuh pipesha nakam stribhirdamunah ||

prose.en:
1. COMMINGLING, restless, he ascends the sky, unveiling nights and all that stands or moves,
As he the sole God is preeminent in greatness among all these other Gods.

2. All men are joyful in thy power, O God, that living from the dry wood thou art born.
All truly share thy Godhead while they keep, in their accustomed ways, eternal Law.

3. Strong is the thought of Law, the Law's behest; all works have they performed; he quickens all.
Whoso will bring oblation, gifts to thee, to him, bethinking thee, vouchsafe thou wealth.

4. Seated as Priest with Manu's progeny, of all these treasures he alone is Lord.
Men yearn for children to prolong their line, and are not disappointed in their hope.

5. Eagerly they who hear his word fulfil his wish as sons obey their sire's behest.
He, rich in food, unbars his wealth like doors: he, the House-Friend, hath decked heaven's vault with stars.

verses.sa: शुक्रः शुशुक्वाँ उषो न जारः पप्रा समीची दिवो न ज्योतिः ॥
verses.rom: shukrah shushukvan usho na jarah papra samichi divo na jyotih ||

verses.sa: परि प्रजातः क्रत्वा बभूथ भुवो देवानां पिता पुत्रः सन् ॥
verses.rom: pari prajatah kratva babhutha bhuvo devanam pita putrah san ||

verses.sa: वेधा अदृप्तो अग्निर्विजानन्नूधर्न गोनां स्वाद्मा पितूनाम् ॥
verses.rom: vedha adripto agnirvijanannudharna gonam svadma pitunam ||

verses.sa: जने न शेव आहूर्यः सन्मध्ये निषत्तो रण्वो दुरोणे ॥
verses.rom: jane na sheva ahuryah sanmadhye nishatto ranvo durone ||

verses.sa: पुत्रो न जातो रण्वो दुरोणे वाजी न प्रीतो विशो वि तारीत् ॥
verses.rom: putro na jato ranvo durone vaji na prito visho vi tarit ||

verses.sa: विशो यदह्वे नृभिः सनीळा अग्निर्देवत्वा विश्वान्यश्याः ॥
verses.rom: visho yadahve nribhih sanila agnirdevatva vishvanyashyah ||

verses.sa: नकिष्ट एता व्रता मिनन्ति नृभ्यो यदेभ्यः श्रुष्टिं चकर्थ ॥
verses.rom: nakishta eta vrata minanti nribhyo yadebhyah shrushtim chakartha ||

verses.sa: तत्तु ते दंसो यदहन्समानैर्नृभिर्यद्युक्तो विवे रपांसि ॥
verses.rom: tattu te damso yadahansamanairnribhiryadyukto vive rapamsi ||

verses.sa: उषो न जारो विभावोस्रः संज्ञातरूपश्चिकेतदस्मै ॥
verses.rom: usho na jaro vibhavosrah samjnatarupashchiketadasmai ||

verses.sa: त्मना वहन्तो दुरो व्यृण्वन्नवन्त विश्वे स्वर्दृशीके ॥
verses.rom: tmana vahanto duro vyrinvannavanta vishve svardrishike ||

prose.en:
1. BRIGHT, splendid, like Dawn's lover, he hath filled the two joined worlds as with the light of heaven.
When born, with might thou hast encompassed them: Father of Gods, and yet their Son wast thou.

2. Agni, the Sage, the humble, who discerns like the cow's udder, the sweet taste of food,
Like a bliss-giver to be drawn to men, sits gracious in the middle of the house.

3. Born in the dwelling like a lovely son, pleased, like a strong steed, he bears on the folk.
What time the men and I, with heroes, call, may Agni then gain all through Godlike power.

4. None breaks these holy laws of thine when thou hast granted audience to these chieftains here.
This is thy boast, thou smotest with thy peers, and joined with heroes dravest off disgrace.

5. Like the Dawn's lover, spreading light, well-known as hued like morn, may he remember me.
They, bearing of themselves, unbar the doors: they all ascend to the fair place of heaven.

verses.sa: वनेम पूर्वीरर्यो मनीषा अग्निः सुशोको विश्वान्यश्याः ॥
verses.rom: vanema purviraryo manisha agnih sushoko vishvanyashyah ||

verses.sa: आ दैव्यानि व्रता चिकित्वाना मानुषस्य जनस्य जन्म ॥
verses.rom: a daivyani vrata chikitvana manushasya janasya janma ||

verses.sa: गर्भो यो अपां गर्भो वनानां गर्भश्च स्थातां गर्भश्चरथाम् ॥
verses.rom: garbho yo apam garbho vananam garbhashcha sthatam garbhashcharatham ||

verses.sa: अद्रौ चिदस्मा अन्तर्दुरोणे विशां न विश्वो अमृतः स्वाधीः ॥
verses.rom: adrau chidasma antardurone visham na vishvo amritah svadhih ||

verses.sa: स हि क्षपावाँ अग्नी रयीणां दाशद्यो अस्मा अरं सूक्तैः ॥
verses.rom: sa hi kshapavan agni rayinam dashadyo asma aram suktaih ||

verses.sa: एता चिकित्वो भूमा नि पाहि देवानां जन्म मर्ताँश्च विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom: eta chikitvo bhuma ni pahi devanam janma martanshcha vidvan ||

verses.sa: वर्धान्यं पूर्वीः क्षपो विरूपा स्थातुश्च रथमृतप्रवीतम् ॥
verses.rom: vardhanyam purvih kshapo virupa sthatushcha rathamritapravitam ||

verses.sa: अराधि होता स्वर्निषत्तः कृण्वन्विश्वान्यपांसि सत्या ॥
verses.rom: aradhi hota svarnishattah krinvanvishvanyapamsi satya ||

verses.sa: गोषु प्रशस्तिं वनेषु धिषे भरन्त विश्वे बलिं स्वर्णः ॥
verses.rom: goshu prashastim vaneshu dhishe bharanta vishve balim svarnah ||

verses.sa: वि त्वा नरः पुरुत्रा सपर्यन्पितुर्न जिव्रेर्वि वेदो भरन्त ॥
verses.rom: vi tva narah purutra saparyanpiturna jivrervi vedo bharanta ||

verses.sa: साधुर्न गृध्नुरस्तेव शूरो यातेव भीमस्त्वेषः समत्सु ॥
verses.rom: sadhurna gridhnurasteva shuro yateva bhimastveshah samatsu ||

prose.en:
1. MAY we, the pious, win much food by prayer, may Agni with fair light pervade each act,--
He the observer of the heavenly laws of Gods, and of the race of mortal man.

2. He who is germ of waters, germ of woods, germ of all things that move not and that move,--
To him even in the rock and in the house: Immortal One, he cares for all mankind.

3. Agni is Lord of riches for the man who serves him readily with sacred songs.
Protect these beings thou with careful thought, knowing the races both of Gods and men.

4. Whom many dawns and nights, unlike, make strong, whom, born in Law, all things that move and stand,--
He hath been won, Herald who sits in light, making effectual all our holy works.

5. Thou settest value on our cows and woods: all shall bring tribute to us to the light.
Men have served thee in many and sundry spots, parting, as 'twere, an aged father's wealth.

6. Like a brave archer, like one skilled and bold, a fierce avenger, so he shines in fight.

verses.sa:
उप प्र जिन्वन्नुशतीरुशन्तं पतिं न नित्यं जनयः सनीळाः ।
स्वसारः श्यावीमरुषीमजुष्रञ्चित्रमुच्छन्तीमुषसं न गावः ॥
verses.rom:
upa pra jinvannushatirushantam patim na nityam janayah sanilah |
svasarah shyavimarushimajushranchitramuchchhantimushasam na gavah ||
verses.en:
LOVING the loving One, as wives their husband, the sisters of one home have urged him forward,
Bright-coloured, even, as the cows love morning, dark, breaking forth to view, and redly beaming.

verses.sa:
वीळु चिद्दृळ्हा पितरो न उक्थैरद्रिं रुजन्नङ्गिरसो रवेण ।
चक्रुर्दिवो बृहतो गातुमस्मे अहः स्वर्विविदुः केतुमुस्राः ॥
verses.rom:
vilu chiddrilha pitaro na ukthairadrim rujannangiraso ravena |
chakrurdivo brihato gatumasme ahah svarvividuh ketumusrah ||
verses.en:
Our sires with lauds burst e'en the firm-set fortress, yea, the Angirases, with roar, the mountain.
They made for us a way to reach high heaven, they found us day, light, day's sign, beams of morning.

verses.sa:
दधन्नृतं धनयन्नस्य धीतिमादिदर्यो दिधिष्वो विभृत्राः ।
अतृष्यन्तीरपसो यन्त्यच्छा देवाञ्जन्म प्रयसा वर्धयन्तीः ॥
verses.rom:
dadhannritam dhanayannasya dhitimadidaryo didhishvo vibhritrah |
atrishyantirapaso yantyachchha devanjanma prayasa vardhayantih ||
verses.en:
They stablished order, made his service fruitful; then parting them among the longing faithful,
Not thirsting after aught, they come, most active, while with sweet food the race of Gods they strengthen.

verses.sa:
मथीद्यदीं विभृतो मातरिश्वा गृहेगृहे श्येतो जेन्यो भूत् ।
आदीं राज्ञे न सहीयसे सचा सन्ना दूत्यं भृगवाणो विवाय ॥
verses.rom:
mathidyadim vibhrito matarishva grihegrihe shyeto jenyo bhut |
adim rajne na sahiyase sacha sanna dutyam bhrigavano vivaya ||
verses.en:
Since Matarisvan, far-diffused, hath stirred him, and he in every house grown bright and noble,
He, Bhrgu-like I hath gone as his companion, as on commission to a greater Sovran.

verses.sa:
महे यत्पित्र ईं रसं दिवे करव त्सरत्पृशन्यश्चिकित्वान् ।
सृजदस्ता धृषता दिद्युमस्मै स्वायां देवो दुहितरि त्विषिं धात् ॥
verses.rom:
mahe yatpitra im rasam dive karava tsaratprishanyashchikitvan |
srijadasta dhrishata didyumasmai svayam devo duhitari tvishim dhat ||
verses.en:
When man poured juice to Heaven, the mighty Father, he knew and freed himself from close embracement.
The archer boldly shot at him his arrow, and the God threw his splendour on his Daughter.

verses.sa:
स्व आ यस्तुभ्यं दम आ विभाति नमो वा दाशादुशतो अनु द्यून् ।
वर्धो अग्ने वयो अस्य द्विबर्हा यासद्राया सरथं यं जुनासि ॥
verses.rom:
sva a yastubhyam dama a vibhati namo va dashadushato anu dyun |
vardho agne vayo asya dvibarha yasadraya saratham yam junasi ||
verses.en:
Whoso, hath flames for thee within his dwelling, or brings the worship which thou lovest daily,
Do thou of double might increase his substance: may he whom thou incitest meet with riches.

verses.sa:
अग्निं विश्वा अभि पृक्षः सचन्ते समुद्रं न स्रवतः सप्त यह्वीः ।
न जामिभिर्वि चिकिते वयो नो विदा देवेषु प्रमतिं चिकित्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vishva abhi prikshah sachante samudram na sravatah sapta yahvih |
na jamibhirvi chikite vayo no vida deveshu pramatim chikitvan ||
verses.en:
All sacrificial viands wait on Agni as the Seven mighty Rivers seek the ocean.
Not by our brethren was our food discovered: find with the Gods care for us, thou who knowest.

verses.sa:
आ यदिषे नृपतिं तेज आनट् छुचि रेतो निषिक्तं द्यौरभीके ।
अग्निः शर्धमनवद्यं युवानं स्वाध्यं जनयत्सूदयच्च ॥
verses.rom:
a yadishe nripatim teja anat chhuchi reto nishiktam dyaurabhike |
agnih shardhamanavadyam yuvanam svadhyam janayatsudayachcha ||
verses.en:
When light hath filled the Lord of men for increase, straight from the heaven descends the limpid moisture.
Agni hath brought to light and filled with spirit the youthful host blameless and well providing.

verses.sa:
मनो न योऽध्वनः सद्य एत्येकः सत्रा सूरो वस्व ईशे ।
राजाना मित्रावरुणा सुपाणी गोषु प्रियममृतं रक्षमाणा ॥
verses.rom:
mano na yo'dhvanah sadya etyekah satra suro vasva ishe |
rajana mitravaruna supani goshu priyamamritam rakshamana ||
verses.en:
He who like thought goes swiftly on his journey, the Sun, alone is ever Lord of riches.
The Kings with fair hands, Varuna and Mitra, protect the precious nectar in our cattle.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्ने सख्या पित्र्याणि प्र मर्षिष्ठा अभि विदुष्कविः सन् ।
नभो न रूपं जरिमा मिनाति पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरधीहि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne sakhya pitryani pra marshishtha abhi vidushkavih san |
nabho na rupam jarima minati pura tasya abhishasteradhihi ||
verses.en:
O Agni, break not our ancestral friendship, Sage as thou art, endowed with deepest knowledge.
Old age, like gathering cloud, impairs the body: before that evil be come nigh protect me.

verses.sa:
नि काव्या वेधसः शश्वतस्कर्हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि ।
अग्निर्भुवद्रयिपती रयीणां सत्रा चक्राणो अमृतानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ni kavya vedhasah shashvataskarhaste dadhano narya puruni |
agnirbhuvadrayipati rayinam satra chakrano amritani vishva ||
verses.en:
THOUGH holding many gifts for men, he humbleth the higher powers of each wise ordainer.
Agni is now the treasure-lord of treasures, for ever granting all immortal bounties.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वत्सं परि षन्तं न विन्दन्निच्छन्तो विश्वे अमृता अमूराः ।
श्रमयुवः पदव्यो धियंधास्तस्थुः पदे परमे चार्वग्नेः ॥
verses.rom:
asme vatsam pari shantam na vindannichchhanto vishve amrita amurah |
shramayuvah padavyo dhiyamdhastasthuh pade parame charvagneh ||
verses.en:
The Gods infallible all searching found not him, the dear Babe who still is round about us.
Worn weary, following his track, devoted, they reached the lovely highest home of Agni.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो यदग्ने शरदस्त्वामिच्छुचिं घृतेन शुचयः सपर्यान् ।
नामानि चिद्दधिरे यज्ञियान्यसूदयन्त तन्वः सुजाताः ॥
verses.rom:
tisro yadagne sharadastvamichchhuchim ghritena shuchayah saparyan |
namani chiddadhire yajniyanyasudayanta tanvah sujatah ||
verses.en:
Because with holy oil the pure Ones, Agni, served thee the very pure three autumn seasons,
Therefore they won them holy names for worship, and nobly born they dignified their bodies.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी बृहती वेविदानाः प्र रुद्रिया जभ्रिरे यज्ञियासः ।
विदन्मर्तो नेमधिता चिकित्वानग्निं पदे परमे तस्थिवांसम् ॥
verses.rom:
a rodasi brihati vevidanah pra rudriya jabhrire yajniyasah |
vidanmarto nemadhita chikitvanagnim pade parame tasthivamsam ||
verses.en:
Making them known to spacious earth and heaven, the holy Ones revealed the powers of Rudra.
The mortal band, discerning in the distance, found Agni standing in the loftiest station.

verses.sa:
संजानाना उप सीदन्नभिज्ञु पत्नीवन्तो नमस्यं नमस्यन् ।
रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत स्वाः सखा सख्युर्निमिषि रक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
samjanana upa sidannabhijnu patnivanto namasyam namasyan |
ririkvamsastanvah krinvata svah sakha sakhyurnimishi rakshamanah ||
verses.en:
Nigh they approached, one-minded, with their spouses, kneeling to him adorable paid worship.
Friend finding in his own friend's eye protection, they made their own the bodies which they chastened.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त यद्गुह्यानि त्वे इत्पदाविदन्निहिता यज्ञियासः ।
तेभी रक्षन्ते अमृतं सजोषाः पशूञ्च स्थातॄञ्चरथं च पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
trih sapta yadguhyani tve itpadavidannihita yajniyasah |
tebhi rakshante amritam sajoshah pashuncha sthatrincharatham cha pahi ||
verses.en:
Soon as the holy beings had discovered the thrice-seven mystic things contained within thee,
With these, one-minded, they preserve the Amrta: guard thou the life of all their plants and cattle.

verses.sa:
विद्वाँ अग्ने वयुनानि क्षितीनां व्यानुषक्छुरुधो जीवसे धाः ।
अन्तर्विद्वाँ अध्वनो देवयानानतन्द्रो दूतो अभवो हविर्वाट् ॥
verses.rom:
vidvan agne vayunani kshitinam vyanushakchhurudho jivase dhah |
antarvidvan adhvano devayananatandro duto abhavo havirvat ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, knower of men's works, hast sent us good food in constant course for our subsistence:
Thou deeply skilled in paths of Gods becamest an envoy never wearied, offering-bearer.

verses.sa:
स्वाध्यो दिव आ सप्त यह्वी रायो दुरो व्यृतज्ञा अजानन् ।
विदद्गव्यं सरमा दृळ्हमूर्वं येना नु कं मानुषी भोजते विट् ॥
verses.rom:
svadhyo diva a sapta yahvi rayo duro vyritajna ajanan |
vidadgavyam sarama drilhamurvam yena nu kam manushi bhojate vit ||
verses.en:
Knowing the Law, the seven strong floods from heaven, full of good thought, discerned the doors of riches.
Sarama found the cattle's firm-built prison whereby the race of man is still supported.

verses.sa:
आ ये विश्वा स्वपत्यानि तस्थुः कृण्वानासो अमृतत्वाय गातुम् ।
मह्ना महद्भिः पृथिवी वि तस्थे माता पुत्रैरदितिर्धायसे वेः ॥
verses.rom:
a ye vishva svapatyani tasthuh krinvanaso amritatvaya gatum |
mahna mahadbhih prithivi vi tasthe mata putrairaditirdhayase veh ||
verses.en:
They who approached all noble operations making a path that leads to life immortal,
To be the Bird's support, the spacious mother, Aditi, and her great Sons stood in power.

verses.sa:
अधि श्रियं नि दधुश्चारुमस्मिन्दिवो यदक्षी अमृता अकृण्वन् ।
अध क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो न सृष्टाः प्र नीचीरग्ने अरुषीरजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
adhi shriyam ni dadhushcharumasmindivo yadakshi amrita akrinvan |
adha ksharanti sindhavo na srishtah pra nichiragne arushirajanan ||
verses.en:
When Gods immortal made both eyes of heaven, they gave to him the gift of beauteous glory.
Now they flow forth like rivers set in motion: they knew the Red Steeds coming down, O Agni.

verses.sa:
रयिर्न यः पितृवित्तो वयोधाः सुप्रणीतिश्चिकितुषो न शासुः ।
स्योनशीरतिथिर्न प्रीणानो होतेव सद्म विधतो वि तारीत् ॥
verses.rom:
rayirna yah pitrivitto vayodhah supranitishchikitusho na shasuh |
syonashiratithirna prinano hoteva sadma vidhato vi tarit ||
verses.en:
I. HE who gives food, like patrimonial riches and guides aright like some wise man's instruction,
Loved like a guest who lies in pleasant lodging,--may he, as Priest, prosper his servant's dwelling.

verses.sa:
देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा क्रत्वा निपाति वृजनानि विश्वा ।
पुरुप्रशस्तो अमतिर्न सत्य आत्मेव शेवो दिधिषाय्यो भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
devo na yah savita satyamanma kratva nipati vrijanani vishva |
puruprashasto amatirna satya atmeva shevo didhishayyo bhut ||
verses.en:
He who like Savitar the God, true-minded protecteth with his power. all acts of vigour,
Truthful, like splendour, glorified by many, like breath joy-giving,--all must strive to win him.

verses.sa:
देवो न यः पृथिवीं विश्वधाया उपक्षेति हितमित्रो न राजा ।
पुरःसदः शर्मसदो न वीरा अनवद्या पतिजुष्टेव नारी ॥
verses.rom:
devo na yah prithivim vishvadhaya upaksheti hitamitro na raja |
purahsadah sharmasado na vira anavadya patijushteva nari ||
verses.en:
He who on earth dwells like a king surrounded by faithful friends, like a God all-sustaining,
Like heroes who preside, who sit in safety: like as a blameless dame dear to her husband.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा नरो दम आ नित्यमिद्धमग्ने सचन्त क्षितिषु ध्रुवासु ।
अधि द्युम्नं नि दधुर्भूर्यस्मिन्भवा विश्वायुर्धरुणो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva naro dama a nityamiddhamagne sachanta kshitishu dhruvasu |
adhi dyumnam ni dadhurbhuryasminbhava vishvayurdharuno rayinam ||
verses.en:
Thee, such, in settlements secure, O Agni, our men serve ever kindled in each dwelling.
On him have they laid splendour in abundance: dear to all men, bearer be he of riches.

verses.sa:
वि पृक्षो अग्ने मघवानो अश्युर्वि सूरयो ददतो विश्वमायुः ।
सनेम वाजं समिथेष्वर्यो भागं देवेषु श्रवसे दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
vi priksho agne maghavano ashyurvi surayo dadato vishvamayuh |
sanema vajam samitheshvaryo bhagam deveshu shravase dadhanah ||
verses.en:
May thy rich worshippers win food, O Agni, and princes gain long life who bring oblation.
May we get booty from our foe in battle, presenting to the Gods their share for glory.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि धेनवो वावशानाः स्मदूध्नीः पीपयन्त द्युभक्ताः ।
परावतः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा वि सिन्धवः समया सस्रुरद्रिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya hi dhenavo vavashanah smadudhnih pipayanta dyubhaktah |
paravatah sumatim bhikshamana vi sindhavah samaya sasruradrim ||
verses.en:
The cows of holy law, sent us by Heaven, have swelled with laden udders, loudly lowing;
Soliciting his favour, from a distance the rivers to the rock have flowed together.

verses.sa:
त्वे अग्ने सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा दिवि श्रवो दधिरे यज्ञियासः ।
नक्ता च चक्रुरुषसा विरूपे कृष्णं च वर्णमरुणं च सं धुः ॥
verses.rom:
tve agne sumatim bhikshamana divi shravo dadhire yajniyasah |
nakta cha chakrurushasa virupe krishnam cha varnamarunam cha sam dhuh ||
verses.en:
Agni, with thee, soliciting thy favour, the holy Ones have gained glory in heaven.
They made the Night and Dawn of different colours, and set the black and purple hues together.

verses.sa:
यान्राये मर्तान्सुषूदो अग्ने ते स्याम मघवानो वयं च ।
छायेव विश्वं भुवनं सिसक्ष्यापप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
yanraye martansushudo agne te syama maghavano vayam cha |
chhayeva vishvam bhuvanam sisakshyapaprivanrodasi antariksham ||
verses.en:
May we and those who worship be the mortals whom thou, O Agni, leadest on to riches.
Thou hast filled earth and heaven and air's mid-region, and followest the whole world like a shadow.

verses.sa:
अर्वद्भिरग्ने अर्वतो नृभिर्नॄन्वीरैर्वीरान्वनुयामा त्वोताः ।
ईशानासः पितृवित्तस्य रायो वि सूरयः शतहिमा नो अश्युः ॥
verses.rom:
arvadbhiragne arvato nribhirnrinvirairviranvanuyama tvotah |
ishanasah pitrivittasya rayo vi surayah shatahima no ashyuh ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, O Agni, may we conquer steeds with steeds, men with men, heroes with heroes,
Lords of the wealth transmitted by our fathers: and may our princes live a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्न उचथानि वेधो जुष्टानि सन्तु मनसे हृदे च ।
शकेम रायः सुधुरो यमं तेऽधि श्रवो देवभक्तं दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
eta te agna uchathani vedho jushtani santu manase hride cha |
shakema rayah sudhuro yamam te'dhi shravo devabhaktam dadhanah ||
verses.en:
May these our hymns of praise, Agni, Ordainer, be pleasant to thee in thy heart and spirit.
May we have power to hold thy steeds of riches, laying on thee the God-sent gift of glory.

verses.sa:
उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये ।
आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते ॥
verses.rom:
upaprayanto adhvaram mantram vochemagnaye |
are asme cha shrinvate ||
verses.en:
As forth to sacrifice we go, a hymn to a hymn let us say,
Who hears us even when afar;

verses.sa:
यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु ।
अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yah snihitishu purvyah samjagmanasu krishtishu |
arakshaddashushe gayam ||
verses.en:
Who, from of old, in carnage, when the people gathered, hath preserved
His household for the worshipper.

verses.sa:
उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि ।
धनंजयो रणेरणे ॥
verses.rom:
uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvritrahajani |
dhanamjayo ranerane ||
verses.en:
And let men say, Agni is born, e'en he who slayeth Vrtra, he
Who winneth wealth in every fight.

verses.sa:
यस्य दूतो असि क्षये वेषि हव्यानि वीतये ।
दस्मत्कृणोष्यध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya duto asi kshaye veshi havyani vitaye |
dasmatkrinoshyadhvaram ||
verses.en:
Him in whose house an envoy thou lovest to taste his offered gifts,
And strengthenest his sacrifice,

verses.sa:
तमित्सुहव्यमङ्गिरः सुदेवं सहसो यहो ।
जना आहुः सुबर्हिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamitsuhavyamangirah sudevam sahaso yaho |
jana ahuh subarhisham ||
verses.en:
Him, Angiras, thou Son of Strength, all men call happy in his God,
His offerings, and his sacred grass.

verses.sa:
आ च वहासि ताँ इह देवाँ उप प्रशस्तये ।
हव्या सुश्चन्द्र वीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a cha vahasi tan iha devan upa prashastaye |
havya sushchandra vitaye ||
verses.en:
Hitherward shalt thou bring these Gods to our laudation and to taste.
These offered gifts, fair-shining One.

verses.sa:
न योरुपब्दिरश्व्यः शृण्वे रथस्य कच्चन ।
यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
na yorupabdirashvyah shrinve rathasya kachchana |
yadagne yasi dutyam ||
verses.en: When, Agni, on thine embassage thou goest not a sound is heard of steed or straining of thy car.

verses.sa:
त्वोतो वाज्यह्रयोऽभि पूर्वस्मादपरः ।
प्र दाश्वाँ अग्ने अस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
tvoto vajyahrayo'bhi purvasmadaparah |
pra dashvan agne asthat ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee uninjured, strong, one after other, goes he forth:
Agni, the offerer forward steps.

verses.sa:
उत द्युमत्सुवीर्यं बृहदग्ने विवाससि ।
देवेभ्यो देव दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
uta dyumatsuviryam brihadagne vivasasi |
devebhyo deva dashushe ||
verses.en:
And splendid strength, heroic, high, Agni, thou grantest from the Gods,
Thou God, to him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
जुषस्व सप्रथस्तमं वचो देवप्सरस्तमम् ।
हव्या जुह्वान आसनि ॥
verses.rom:
jushasva saprathastamam vacho devapsarastamam |
havya juhvana asani ||
verses.en:
ACCEPT our loudest-sounding hymn, food most delightful to the Gods,
Pouring our offerings in thy mouth.

verses.sa:
अथा ते अङ्गिरस्तमाग्ने वेधस्तम प्रियम् ।
वोचेम ब्रह्म सानसि ॥
verses.rom:
atha te angirastamagne vedhastama priyam |
vochema brahma sanasi ||
verses.en:
Now, Agni, will we say to thee, O wisest and best Angiras,
Our precious, much-availing prayer.

verses.sa:
कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः ।
को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
kaste jamirjananamagne ko dashvadhvarah |
ko ha kasminnasi shritah ||
verses.en:
Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who is thy worthy worshipper?
On whom dependent? who art thou?

verses.sa:
त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः ।
सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam jamirjananamagne mitro asi priyah |
sakha sakhibhya idyah ||
verses.en:
The kinsman, Agni, of mankind, their well beloved Friend art thou,
A Friend whom friends may supplicate.

verses.sa:
यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाँ ऋतं बृहत् ।
अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaja no mitravaruna yaja devan ritam brihat |
agne yakshi svam damam ||
verses.en:
Bring to us Mitra, Varuna, bring the Gods to mighty sacrifice.
Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

verses.sa:
का त उपेतिर्मनसो वराय भुवदग्ने शंतमा का मनीषा ।
को वा यज्ञैः परि दक्षं त आप केन वा ते मनसा दाशेम ॥
verses.rom:
ka ta upetirmanaso varaya bhuvadagne shamtama ka manisha |
ko va yajnaih pari daksham ta apa kena va te manasa dashema ||
verses.en:
How may the mind draw nigh to please thee, Agni? What hymn of praise shall bring us greatest blessing?
Or who hath gained thy power by sacrifices? or with what mind shall we bring thee oblations?

verses.sa:
एह्यग्न इह होता नि षीदादब्धः सु पुरएता भवा नः ।
अवतां त्वा रोदसी विश्वमिन्वे यजा महे सौमनसाय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
ehyagna iha hota ni shidadabdhah su puraeta bhava nah |
avatam tva rodasi vishvaminve yaja mahe saumanasaya devan ||
verses.en:
Come hither, Agni; sit thee down as Hotar; be thou who never wast deceived our leader.
May Heaven and Earth, the all-pervading, love thee: worship the Gods to win for us their favour.

verses.sa:
प्र सु विश्वान्रक्षसो धक्ष्यग्ने भवा यज्ञानामभिशस्तिपावा ।
अथा वह सोमपतिं हरिभ्यामातिथ्यमस्मै चकृमा सुदाव्ने ॥
verses.rom:
pra su vishvanrakshaso dhakshyagne bhava yajnanamabhishastipava |
atha vaha somapatim haribhyamatithyamasmai chakrima sudavne ||
verses.en:
Burn thou up all the Raksasas, O Agni; ward thou off curses from our sacrifices.
Bring hither with his Bays the Lord of Soma: here is glad welcome for the Bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
प्रजावता वचसा वह्निरासा च हुवे नि च सत्सीह देवैः ।
वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं यजत्र बोधि प्रयन्तर्जनितर्वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prajavata vachasa vahnirasa cha huve ni cha satsiha devaih |
veshi hotramuta potram yajatra bodhi prayantarjanitarvasunam ||
verses.en:
Thou Priest with lip and voice that bring us children hast been invoked. Here with the Gods be seated.
Thine is the task of Cleanser and Presenter: waken us, Wealth-bestower and Producer.

verses.sa:
यथा विप्रस्य मनुषो हविर्भिर्देवाँ अयजः कविभिः कविः सन् ।
एवा होतः सत्यतर त्वमद्याग्ने मन्द्रया जुह्वा यजस्व ॥
verses.rom:
yatha viprasya manusho havirbhirdevan ayajah kavibhih kavih san |
eva hotah satyatara tvamadyagne mandraya juhva yajasva ||
verses.en:
As with oblations of the priestly Manus thou worshippedst the Gods, a Sage with sages,
So now, O truthfullest Invoker Agni, worship this day with joy-bestowing ladle.

verses.sa:
कथा दाशेमाग्नये कास्मै देवजुष्टोच्यते भामिने गीः ।
यो मर्त्येष्वमृत ऋतावा होता यजिष्ठ इत्कृणोति देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
katha dashemagnaye kasmai devajushtochyate bhamine gih |
yo martyeshvamrita ritava hota yajishtha itkrinoti devan ||
verses.en:
How shall we pay oblation unto Agni? What hymn, Godloved, is said to him refulgent?
Who, deathless, true to Law, mid men a herald, bringeth the Gods as best of sacrificers?

verses.sa:
यो अध्वरेषु शंतम ऋतावा होता तमू नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् ।
अग्निर्यद्वेर्मर्ताय देवान्स चा बोधाति मनसा यजाति ॥
verses.rom:
yo adhvareshu shamtama ritava hota tamu namobhira krinudhvam |
agniryadvermartaya devansa cha bodhati manasa yajati ||
verses.en:
Bring him with reverence hither, most propitious in sacrifices, true to Law, the herald;
For Agni, when he seeks the Gods for mortals, knows them full well and worships them in spirit.

verses.sa:
स हि क्रतुः स मर्यः स साधुर्मित्रो न भूदद्भुतस्य रथीः ।
तं मेधेषु प्रथमं देवयन्तीर्विश उप ब्रुवते दस्ममारीः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi kratuh sa maryah sa sadhurmitro na bhudadbhutasya rathih |
tam medheshu prathamam devayantirvisha upa bruvate dasmamarih ||
verses.en:
For he is mental power, a man, and perfect; he is the bringer, friend-like, of the wondrous.
The pious Aryan tribes at sacrifices address them first to him who doeth marvels.

verses.sa:
स नो नृणां नृतमो रिशादा अग्निर्गिरोऽवसा वेतु धीतिम् ।
तना च ये मघवानः शविष्ठा वाजप्रसूता इषयन्त मन्म ॥
verses.rom:
sa no nrinam nritamo rishada agnirgiro'vasa vetu dhitim |
tana cha ye maghavanah shavishtha vajaprasuta ishayanta manma ||
verses.en:
May Agni, foe-destroyer, manliest Hero, accept with love our hymns and our devotion.
So may the liberal lords whose strength is strongest, urged by their riches, stir our thoughts with vigour.

verses.sa:
एवाग्निर्गोतमेभिरृतावा विप्रेभिरस्तोष्ट जातवेदाः ।
स एषु द्युम्नं पीपयत्स वाजं स पुष्टिं याति जोषमा चिकित्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
evagnirgotamebhirritava viprebhirastoshta jatavedah |
sa eshu dyumnam pipayatsa vajam sa pushtim yati joshama chikitvan ||
verses.en:
Thus Agni Jatavedas, true to Order, hath by the priestly Gotamas been lauded.
May he augment in them splendour and vigour: observant, as he lists, he gathers increase.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरा जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva gotama gira jatavedo vicharshane |
dyumnairabhi pra nonumah ||
verses.en: O JATAVEDAS, keen and swift, we Gotamas with sacred song exalt thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा गोतमो गिरा रायस्कामो दुवस्यति ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva gotamo gira rayaskamo duvasyati |
dyumnairabhi pra nonumah ||
verses.en:
Thee, as thou art, desiring wealth Gotama worships with his song:
We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा वाजसातममङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva vajasatamamangirasvaddhavamahe |
dyumnairabhi pra nonumah ||
verses.en:
As such, like Angiras we call on thee best winner of the spoil:
We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा वृत्रहन्तमं यो दस्यूँरवधूनुषे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva vritrahantamam yo dasyunravadhunushe |
dyumnairabhi pra nonumah ||
verses.en:
Thee, best of Vrtra-slayers, thee who shakest off our Dasyu foes:
We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम रहूगणा अग्नये मधुमद्वचः ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
avochama rahugana agnaye madhumadvachah |
dyumnairabhi pra nonumah ||
verses.en:
A pleasant song to Agni we, sons of Rahugana, have sung:
We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकेशो रजसो विसारेऽहिर्धुनिर्वात इव ध्रजीमान् ।
शुचिभ्राजा उषसो नवेदा यशस्वतीरपस्युवो न सत्याः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyakesho rajaso visare'hirdhunirvata iva dhrajiman |
shuchibhraja ushaso naveda yashasvatirapasyuvo na satyah ||
verses.en:
HE in mid-air's expanse hath golden tresses; a raging serpent, like the rushing tempest:
Purely refulgent, knowing well the morning; like honourable dames, true, active workers.

verses.sa:
आ ते सुपर्णा अमिनन्तँ एवैः कृष्णो नोनाव वृषभो यदीदम् ।
शिवाभिर्न स्मयमानाभिरागात्पतन्ति मिह स्तनयन्त्यभ्रा ॥
verses.rom:
a te suparna aminantan evaih krishno nonava vrishabho yadidam |
shivabhirna smayamanabhiragatpatanti miha stanayantyabhra ||
verses.en:
Thy well-winged flashes strengthen in their manner, when the black Bull hath bellowed round about us.
With drops that bless and seem to smile he cometh: the waters fall, the clouds utter their thunder.

verses.sa:
यदीमृतस्य पयसा पियानो नयन्नृतस्य पथिभी रजिष्ठैः ।
अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा त्वचं पृञ्चन्त्युपरस्य योनौ ॥
verses.rom:
yadimritasya payasa piyano nayannritasya pathibhi rajishthaih |
aryama mitro varunah parijma tvacham princhantyuparasya yonau ||
verses.en:
When he comes streaming with the milk of worship, conducting by directest paths of Order
Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, Parijman fill the hide full where lies the nether press-stone.

verses.sa:
अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो ।
अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vajasya gomata ishanah sahaso yaho |
asme dhehi jatavedo mahi shravah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength,
Vouchsafe to us, O Jatavedas, high renown.

verses.sa:
स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा ।
रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa idhano vasushkaviragnirilenyo gira |
revadasmabhyam purvanika didihi ||
verses.en:
He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song:
Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

verses.sa:
क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः ।
स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
kshapo rajannuta tmanagne vastorutoshasah |
sa tigmajambha rakshaso daha prati ||
verses.en:
O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks,
Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Raksasas.

verses.sa:
अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि ।
विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य ॥
verses.rom:
ava no agna utibhirgayatrasya prabharmani |
vishvasu dhishu vandya ||
verses.en:
Adorable in all our rites, favour us, Agni, with thine aid,
When the great hymn is chanted forth.

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् ।
विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne rayim bhara satrasaham varenyam |
vishvasu pritsu dushtaram ||
verses.en:
Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice,
In all our frays invincible.

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् ।
मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne suchetuna rayim vishvayuposhasam |
mardikam dhehi jivase ||
verses.en:
Give us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth that supporteth all our life,
Thy favour so that we may live.

verses.sa:
प्र पूतास्तिग्मशोचिषे वाचो गोतमाग्नये ।
भरस्व सुम्नयुर्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra putastigmashochishe vacho gotamagnaye |
bharasva sumnayurgirah ||
verses.en:
O Gotama, desiring bliss present thy songs composed with care
To Agni of the pointed flames.

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्नेऽभिदासत्यन्ति दूरे पदीष्ट सः ।
अस्माकमिद्वृधे भव ॥
verses.rom:
yo no agne'bhidasatyanti dure padishta sah |
asmakamidvridhe bhava ||
verses.en:
May the man fall, O Agni, who near or afar assaileth us:
Do thou increase and prosper us.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षो विचर्षणिरग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति ।
होता गृणीत उक्थ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasraksho vicharshaniragni rakshamsi sedhati |
hota grinita ukthyah ||
verses.en:
Keen and swift Agni, thousand-eyed, chaseth the Raksasas afar:
He singeth, herald meet for lauds.

verses.sa:
इत्था हि सोम इन्मदे ब्रह्मा चकार वर्धनम् ।
शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ittha hi soma inmade brahma chakara vardhanam |
shavishtha vajrinnojasa prithivya nih shasha ahimarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
THUS in the Soma, in wild joy the Brahman hath exalted thee:
Thou, mightiest thunder-armed, hast driven by force the Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
स त्वामदद्वृषा मदः सोमः श्येनाभृतः सुतः ।
येना वृत्रं निरद्भ्यो जघन्थ वज्रिन्नोजसार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvamadadvrisha madah somah shyenabhritah sutah |
yena vritram niradbhyo jaghantha vajrinnojasarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
The mighty flowing Soma-draught, brought by the Hawk, hath gladdened thee,
That in thy strength, O Thunderer, thou hast struck down Vrtra from the floods, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यंसते ।
इन्द्र नृम्णं हि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
prehyabhihi dhrishnuhi na te vajro ni yamsate |
indra nrimnam hi te shavo hano vritram jaya apo'rchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked.
Manliness, Indra, is thy might: stay Vrtra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
निरिन्द्र भूम्या अधि वृत्रं जघन्थ निर्दिवः ।
सृजा मरुत्वतीरव जीवधन्या इमा अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirindra bhumya adhi vritram jaghantha nirdivah |
srija marutvatirava jivadhanya ima apo'rchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Thou smotest Vrtra from the earth, smotest him, Indra, from the sky.
Let these life-fostering waters flow attended by the Marut host, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य दोधतः सानुं वज्रेण हीळितः ।
अभिक्रम्याव जिघ्नतेऽपः सर्माय चोदयन्नर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro vritrasya dodhatah sanum vajrena hilitah |
abhikramyava jighnate'pah sarmaya chodayannarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
The wrathful Indra with his bolt of thunder rushing on the foe,
Smote fierce on trembling Vrtra's back, and loosed the waters free to run, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
अधि सानौ नि जिघ्नते वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ।
मन्दान इन्द्रो अन्धसः सखिभ्यो गातुमिच्छत्यर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
adhi sanau ni jighnate vajrena shataparvana |
mandana indro andhasah sakhibhyo gatumichchhatyarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
With hundred-jointed thunderbolt Indra hath struck him on the back,
And, while rejoicing in the juice, seeketh prosperity for friends, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवोऽनुत्तं वज्रिन्वीर्यम् ।
यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तमु त्वं माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra tubhyamidadrivo'nuttam vajrinviryam |
yaddha tyam mayinam mrigam tamu tvam mayayavadhirarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Indra, unconquered might is thine, Thunderer, Caster of the Stone;
For thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death the guileful beast, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
वि ते वज्रासो अस्थिरन्नवतिं नाव्या अनु ।
महत्त इन्द्र वीर्यं बाह्वोस्ते बलं हितमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi te vajraso asthirannavatim navya anu |
mahatta indra viryam bahvoste balam hitamarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Far over ninety spacious floods thy thunderbolts were cast abroad:
Great, Indra, is thy hero might, and strength is seated in thine arms, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
सहस्रं साकमर्चत परि ष्टोभत विंशतिः ।
शतैनमन्वनोनवुरिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasram sakamarchata pari shtobhata vimshatih |
shatainamanvanonavurindraya brahmodyatamarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Laud him a thousand all at once, shout twenty forth the hymn of praise.
Hundreds have sung aloud to him, to Indra hath the prayer been raised, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य तविषीं निरहन्सहसा सहः ।
महत्तदस्य पौंस्यं वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजदर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro vritrasya tavishim nirahansahasa sahah |
mahattadasya paumsyam vritram jaghanvan asrijadarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Indra hath smitten down the power of Vrtra,--might with stronger might.
This was his manly exploit, he slew Vrtra and let loose the floods, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इमे चित्तव मन्यवे वेपेते भियसा मही ।
यदिन्द्र वज्रिन्नोजसा वृत्रं मरुत्वाँ अवधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ime chittava manyave vepete bhiyasa mahi |
yadindra vajrinnojasa vritram marutvan avadhirarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Yea, even this great Pair of Worlds trembled in terror at thy wrath,
When, Indra, Thunderer, Marut-girt, thou slewest Vrtra in thy strength, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
न वेपसा न तन्यतेन्द्रं वृत्रो वि बीभयत् ।
अभ्येनं वज्र आयसः सहस्रभृष्टिरायतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
na vepasa na tanyatendram vritro vi bibhayat |
abhyenam vajra ayasah sahasrabhrishtirayatarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
But Vrtra scared not Indra with his shaking or his thunder roar.
On him that iron thunderbolt fell fiercely with its thousand points, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
यद्वृत्रं तव चाशनिं वज्रेण समयोधयः ।
अहिमिन्द्र जिघांसतो दिवि ते बद्बधे शवोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadvritram tava chashanim vajrena samayodhayah |
ahimindra jighamsato divi te badbadhe shavo'rchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
When with the thunder thou didst make thy dart and Vrtra meet in war,
Thy might, O Indra, fain to slay the Dragon, was set firm in heaven, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
अभिष्टने ते अद्रिवो यत्स्था जगच्च रेजते ।
त्वष्टा चित्तव मन्यव इन्द्र वेविज्यते भियार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhishtane te adrivo yatstha jagachcha rejate |
tvashta chittava manyava indra vevijyate bhiyarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
When at thy shout, O Thunder-armed, each thing both fixed and moving shook,
E'en Tvastar trembled at thy wrath and quaked with fear because of thee, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
नहि नु यादधीमसीन्द्रं को वीर्या परः ।
तस्मिन्नृम्णमुत क्रतुं देवा ओजांसि सं दधुरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi nu yadadhimasindram ko virya parah |
tasminnrimnamuta kratum deva ojamsi sam dadhurarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
There is not, in our knowledge, one who passeth Indra in his strength:
In him the Deities have stored manliness, insight, power and might, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
यामथर्वा मनुष्पिता दध्यङ्धियमत्नत ।
तस्मिन्ब्रह्माणि पूर्वथेन्द्र उक्था समग्मतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamatharva manushpita dadhyandhiyamatnata |
tasminbrahmani purvathendra uktha samagmatarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Still as of old, whatever rite Atharvan, Manus sire of all,
Dadhyach performed, their prayer and praise united in that Indra meet, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः ।
तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतेमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥
verses.rom:
indro madaya vavridhe shavase vritraha nribhih |
taminmahatsvajishutemarbhe havamahe sa vajeshu pra no'vishat ||
verses.en:
THE men have lifted Indra up, the Vrtra slayer, to joy and strength:
Him, verily, we invocate in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might.

verses.sa:
असि हि वीर सेन्योऽसि भूरि पराददिः ।
असि दभ्रस्य चिद्वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
asi hi vira senyo'si bhuri paradadih |
asi dabhrasya chidvridho yajamanaya shikshasi sunvate bhuri te vasu ||
verses.en:
Thou, Hero, art a warrior, thou art giver of abundant spoil.
Strengthening e'en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest the offerer ample wealth.

verses.sa:
यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धना ।
युक्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्माँ इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥
verses.rom:
yadudirata ajayo dhrishnave dhiyate dhana |
yukshva madachyuta hari kam hanah kam vasau dadho'sman indra vasau dadhah ||
verses.en:
When war and battles are on foot, booty is laid before the bold.
Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing Bays. Whom wilt thou slay and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा महाँ अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृधे शवः ।
श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवान्दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसम् ॥
verses.rom:
kratva mahan anushvadham bhima a vavridhe shavah |
shriya rishva upakayorni shipri harivandadhe hastayorvajramayasam ||
verses.en:
Mighty through wisdom, as he lists, terrible, he hath waxed in strength.
Lord of Bay Steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory's sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
आ पप्रौ पार्थिवं रजो बद्बधे रोचना दिवि ।
न त्वावाँ इन्द्र कश्चन न जातो न जनिष्यतेऽति विश्वं ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
a paprau parthivam rajo badbadhe rochana divi |
na tvavan indra kashchana na jato na janishyate'ti vishvam vavakshitha ||
verses.en:
He filled the earthly atmosphere and pressed against the lights in heaven.
None like thee ever hath been born, none, Indra, will be born like thee. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.

verses.sa:
यो अर्यो मर्तभोजनं पराददाति दाशुषे ।
इन्द्रो अस्मभ्यं शिक्षतु वि भजा भूरि ते वसु भक्षीय तव राधसः ॥
verses.rom:
yo aryo martabhojanam paradadati dashushe |
indro asmabhyam shikshatu vi bhaja bhuri te vasu bhakshiya tava radhasah ||
verses.en:
May he who to the offerer gives the foeman's man-sustaining food,
May Indra lend his aid to us. Deal forth--abundant is thy wealth--that in thy bounty I may share.

verses.sa:
मदेमदे हि नो ददिर्यूथा गवामृजुक्रतुः ।
सं गृभाय पुरू शतोभयाहस्त्या वसु शिशीहि राय आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
mademade hi no dadiryutha gavamrijukratuh |
sam gribhaya puru shatobhayahastya vasu shishihi raya a bhara ||
verses.en:
He, righteous-hearted, at each time of rapture gives us herds of kine.
Gather in both thy hands for us treasures of many hundred sorts. Sharpen thou us, and bring us wealth.

verses.sa:
मादयस्व सुते सचा शवसे शूर राधसे ।
विद्मा हि त्वा पुरूवसुमुप कामान्ससृज्महेऽथा नोऽविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
madayasva sute sacha shavase shura radhase |
vidma hi tva puruvasumupa kamansasrijmahe'tha no'vita bhava ||
verses.en:
Refresh thee, Hero, with the juice outpoured for bounty and for strength.
We know thee Lord of ample store, to thee have sent our hearts' desires: be therefore our Protector thou.

verses.sa:
एते त इन्द्र जन्तवो विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम् ।
अन्तर्हि ख्यो जनानामर्यो वेदो अदाशुषां तेषां नो वेद आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
ete ta indra jantavo vishvam pushyanti varyam |
antarhi khyo jananamaryo vedo adashusham tesham no veda a bhara ||
verses.en:
These people, Indra, keep for thee all that is worthy of thy choice.
Discover thou, as Lord, the wealth of men who offer up no gifts: bring thou to us this wealth of theirs.

verses.sa:
उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन्मातथा इव ।
यदा नः सूनृतावतः कर आदर्थयास इद्योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
upo shu shrinuhi giro maghavanmatatha iva |
yada nah sunritavatah kara adarthayasa idyoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en:
GRACIOUSLY listen to our songs, Maghavan, be not negligent.
As thou hast made us full of joy and lettest us solicit thee, now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत ।
अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
akshannamimadanta hyava priya adhushata |
astoshata svabhanavo vipra navishthaya mati yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en:
Well have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away.
The sages luminous in themselves have. praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं मघवन्वन्दिषीमहि ।
प्र नूनं पूर्णवन्धुर स्तुतो याहि वशाँ अनु योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
susamdrisham tva vayam maghavanvandishimahi |
pra nunam purnavandhura stuto yahi vashan anu yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en:
Maghavan, we will reverence thee who art so fair to look upon.
Thus praised, according to our wish come now with richly laden car. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
स घा तं वृषणं रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदम् ।
यः पात्रं हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्र चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha tam vrishanam rathamadhi tishthati govidam |
yah patram hariyojanam purnamindra chiketati yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en:
He will in very truth ascend the powerful car that finds the kine,
Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the Tawny Coursers' harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
युक्तस्ते अस्तु दक्षिण उत सव्यः शतक्रतो ।
तेन जायामुप प्रियां मन्दानो याह्यन्धसो योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
yuktaste astu dakshina uta savyah shatakrato |
tena jayamupa priyam mandano yahyandhaso yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en:
Let, Lord of Hundred Powers, thy Steeds be harnessed on the right and left.
Therewith in rapture of the juice, draw near to thy beloved Spouse. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
युनज्मि ते ब्रह्मणा केशिना हरी उप प्र याहि दधिषे गभस्त्योः ।
उत्त्वा सुतासो रभसा अमन्दिषुः पूषण्वान्वज्रिन्समु पत्न्यामदः ॥
verses.rom:
yunajmi te brahmana keshina hari upa pra yahi dadhishe gabhastyoh |
uttva sutaso rabhasa amandishuh pushanvanvajrinsamu patnyamadah ||
verses.en:
With holy prayer I yoke thy long-maned pair of Bays: come hitherward; thou holdest them in both thy hands.
The stirring draughts of juice outpoured have made thee glad: thou, Thunderer, hast rejoiced with Pusan and thy Spouse.

verses.sa:
अश्वावति प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति सुप्रावीरिन्द्र मर्त्यस्तवोतिभिः ।
तमित्पृणक्षि वसुना भवीयसा सिन्धुमापो यथाभितो विचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavati prathamo goshu gachchhati supravirindra martyastavotibhih |
tamitprinakshi vasuna bhaviyasa sindhumapo yathabhito vichetasah ||
verses.en:
INDRA, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine.
With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.

verses.sa:
आपो न देवीरुप यन्ति होत्रियमवः पश्यन्ति विततं यथा रजः ।
प्राचैर्देवासः प्र णयन्ति देवयुं ब्रह्मप्रियं जोषयन्ते वरा इव ॥
verses.rom:
apo na devirupa yanti hotriyamavah pashyanti vitatam yatha rajah |
prachairdevasah pra nayanti devayum brahmapriyam joshayante vara iva ||
verses.en:
The heavenly Waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread:
The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer.

verses.sa:
अधि द्वयोरदधा उक्थ्यं वचो यतस्रुचा मिथुना या सपर्यतः ।
असंयत्तो व्रते ते क्षेति पुष्यति भद्रा शक्तिर्यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
adhi dvayoradadha ukthyam vacho yatasrucha mithuna ya saparyatah |
asamyatto vrate te ksheti pushyati bhadra shaktiryajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife.
Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.

verses.sa:
आदङ्गिराः प्रथमं दधिरे वय इद्धाग्नयः शम्या ये सुकृत्यया ।
सर्वं पणेः समविन्दन्त भोजनमश्वावन्तं गोमन्तमा पशुं नरः ॥
verses.rom:
adangirah prathamam dadhire vaya iddhagnayah shamya ye sukrityaya |
sarvam paneh samavindanta bhojanamashvavantam gomantama pashum narah ||
verses.en:
First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice.
The men together found the Pani's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमः पथस्तते ततः सूर्यो व्रतपा वेन आजनि ।
आ गा आजदुशना काव्यः सचा यमस्य जातममृतं यजामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairatharva prathamah pathastate tatah suryo vratapa vena ajani |
a ga ajadushana kavyah sacha yamasya jatamamritam yajamahe ||
verses.en:
Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the paths then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun.
Usana Kavya straightway hither drove the kine. Let us with offerings honour Yama's deathless birth.

verses.sa:
बर्हिर्वा यत्स्वपत्याय वृज्यतेऽर्को वा श्लोकमाघोषते दिवि ।
ग्रावा यत्र वदति कारुरुक्थ्यस्तस्येदिन्द्रो अभिपित्वेषु रण्यति ॥
verses.rom:
barhirva yatsvapatyaya vrijyate'rko va shlokamaghoshate divi |
grava yatra vadati karurukthyastasyedindro abhipitveshu ranyati ||
verses.en:
When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky.
Where the stone rings as 'twere a singer skilled in laud,--Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.

verses.sa:
असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि ।
आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियं रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asavi soma indra te shavishtha dhrishnava gahi |
a tva prinaktvindriyam rajah suryo na rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
The Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra; mightiest, bold One, come.
