May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as the Sun fills mid-air with rays.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतोऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम् ।
ऋषीणां च स्तुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramiddhari vahato'pratidhrishtashavasam |
rishinam cha stutirupa yajnam cha manushanam ||
verses.en:
His pair of Tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might
Hither to Rsis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी ।
अर्वाचीनं सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना ॥
verses.rom:
a tishtha vritrahanratham yukta te brahmana hari |
arvachinam su te mano grava krinotu vagnuna ||
verses.en:
Slayer of Vrtra, mount thy car; thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer.
May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् ।
शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥
verses.rom:
imamindra sutam piba jyeshthamamartyam madam |
shukrasya tvabhyaksharandhara ritasya sadane ||
verses.en:
This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent.
Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन ।
सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya nunamarchatokthani cha bravitana |
suta amatsurindavo jyeshtham namasyata sahah ||
verses.en:
Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies.
The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his might supreme.

verses.sa:
नकिष्ट्वद्रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे ।
नकिष्ट्वानु मज्मना नकिः स्वश्व आनशे ॥
verses.rom:
nakishtvadrathitaro hari yadindra yachchhase |
nakishtvanu majmana nakih svashva anashe ||
verses.en:
When, Indra, thou dost yoke thy Steeds, there is no better charioteer:
None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

verses.sa:
य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
ya eka idvidayate vasu martaya dashushe |
ishano apratishkuta indro anga ||
verses.en:
He who alone bestoweth on mortal man who offereth gifts,
The ruler of resistless power, is Indra, sure.

verses.sa:
कदा मर्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् ।
कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
kada martamaradhasam pada kshumpamiva sphurat |
kada nah shushravadgira indro anga ||
verses.en:
When will he trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him?
When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise?

verses.sa:
यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाँ आविवासति ।
उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
yashchiddhi tva bahubhya a sutavan avivasati |
ugram tatpatyate shava indro anga ||
verses.en:
He who with Soma juice prepared amid the many honours thee,--
Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous might.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः ।
या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
svadorittha vishuvato madhvah pibanti gauryah |
ya indrena sayavarirvrishna madanti shobhase vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink,
Who for the sake of splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः ।
प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रं हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya prishanayuvah somam shrinanti prishnayah |
priya indrasya dhenavo vajram hinvanti sayakam vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk.
The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death-dealing thunderbolt, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः ।
व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya namasa sahah saparyanti prachetasah |
vratanyasya sashchire puruni purvachittaye vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en:
With veneration, passing wise, honouring his victorious might,
They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their
own supremacy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः ।
जघान नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.rom:
indro dadhicho asthabhirvritranyapratishkutah |
jaghana navatirnava ||
verses.en:
With bones of Dadhyac for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack,
Struck nine-and-ninety Vrtras dead.

verses.sa:
इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् ।
तद्विदच्छर्यणावति ॥
verses.rom:
ichchhannashvasya yachchhirah parvateshvapashritam |
tadvidachchharyanavati ||
verses.en:
He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the mountains, found
At Saryanavan what he sought.

verses.sa:
अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् ।
इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
atraha goramanvata nama tvashturapichyam |
ittha chandramaso grihe ||
verses.en:
Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvastar's Bull,
Here in the mansion of the Moon.

verses.sa:
को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् ।
आसन्निषून्हृत्स्वसो मयोभून्य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात् ॥
verses.rom:
ko adya yunkte dhuri ga ritasya shimivato bhamino durhrinayun |
asannishunhritsvaso mayobhunya esham bhrityamrinadhatsa jivat ||
verses.en:
Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit,
With shaft-armed mouths, heart-piercing, health-bestowing?
Long shall he live who richly pays their service.

verses.sa:
क ईषते तुज्यते को बिभाय को मंसते सन्तमिन्द्रं को अन्ति ।
कस्तोकाय क इभायोत रायेऽधि ब्रवत्तन्वे को जनाय ॥
verses.rom:
ka ishate tujyate ko bibhaya ko mamsate santamindram ko anti |
kastokaya ka ibhayota raye'dhi bravattanve ko janaya ||
verses.en:
Who fleeth forth? who suffereth? who feareth? Who knoweth Indra present, Indra near us?
Who sendeth benediction on his offspring, his household, wealth and person, and the People?

verses.sa:
को अग्निमीट्टे हविषा घृतेन स्रुचा यजाता ऋतुभिर्ध्रुवेभिः ।
कस्मै देवा आ वहानाशु होम को मंसते वीतिहोत्रः सुदेवः ॥
verses.rom:
ko agnimitte havisha ghritena srucha yajata ritubhirdhruvebhih |
kasmai deva a vahanashu homa ko mamsate vitihotrah sudevah ||
verses.en:
Who with poured oil and offering honours Agni, with ladle worships at appointed seasons?
To whom to the Gods bring oblation quickly? What offerer, God-favoured, knows him thoroughly?

verses.sa:
त्वमङ्ग प्र शंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् ।
न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamanga pra shamsisho devah shavishtha martyam |
na tvadanyo maghavannasti marditendra bravimi te vachah ||
verses.en:
Thou as a God, O Mightiest, verily blessest mortal man.
O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

verses.sa:
मा ते राधांसि मा त ऊतयो वसोऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् ।
विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ ॥
verses.rom:
ma te radhamsi ma ta utayo vaso'smankada chana dabhan |
vishva cha na upamimihi manusha vasuni charshanibhya a ||
verses.en:
Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help fail us, good Lord, at any time;
And measure out to us, thou lover of mankind, all riches hitherward from men.

verses.sa:
प्र ये शुम्भन्ते जनयो न सप्तयो यामन्रुद्रस्य सूनवः सुदंससः ।
रोदसी हि मरुतश्चक्रिरे वृधे मदन्ति वीरा विदथेषु घृष्वयः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye shumbhante janayo na saptayo yamanrudrasya sunavah sudamsasah |
rodasi hi marutashchakrire vridhe madanti vira vidatheshu ghrishvayah ||
verses.en:
THEY who are glancing forth, like women, on their way, doers of mighty deeds, swift racers, Rudra's Sons,
The Maruts have made heaven and earth increase and grow: in sacrifices they delight, the strong and wild.

verses.sa:
त उक्षितासो महिमानमाशत दिवि रुद्रासो अधि चक्रिरे सदः ।
अर्चन्तो अर्कं जनयन्त इन्द्रियमधि श्रियो दधिरे पृश्निमातरः ॥
verses.rom:
ta ukshitaso mahimanamashata divi rudraso adhi chakrire sadah |
archanto arkam janayanta indriyamadhi shriyo dadhire prishnimatarah ||
verses.en:
Grown to their perfect strength greatness have they attained; the Rudras have established their abode in heaven.
Singing their song of praise and generating might, they have put glory on, the Sons whom Prsni bare.

verses.sa:
गोमातरो यच्छुभयन्ते अञ्जिभिस्तनूषु शुभ्रा दधिरे विरुक्मतः ।
बाधन्ते विश्वमभिमातिनमप वर्त्मान्येषामनु रीयते घृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
gomataro yachchhubhayante anjibhistanushu shubhra dadhire virukmatah |
badhante vishvamabhimatinamapa vartmanyeshamanu riyate ghritam ||
verses.en:
When, Children of the Cow, they shine in bright attire, and on their fair limbs lay their golden ornaments,
They drive away each adversary from their path, and, following their traces, fatness floweth down,

verses.sa:
वि ये भ्राजन्ते सुमखास ऋष्टिभिः प्रच्यावयन्तो अच्युता चिदोजसा ।
मनोजुवो यन्मरुतो रथेष्वा वृषव्रातासः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi ye bhrajante sumakhasa rishtibhih prachyavayanto achyuta chidojasa |
manojuvo yanmaruto ratheshva vrishavratasah prishatirayugdhvam ||
verses.en:
When, mighty Warriors, ye who glitter with your spears, o'erthrowing with your strength e'en what is ne'er o'erthrown,
When, O ye Maruts, ye the host that send the rain, had harnessed to your cars the thought-fleet spotted deer.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं वाजे अद्रिं मरुतो रंहयन्तः ।
उतारुषस्य वि ष्यन्ति धाराश्चर्मेवोदभिर्व्युन्दन्ति भूम ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadratheshu prishatirayugdhvam vaje adrim maruto ramhayantah |
utarushasya vi shyanti dharashcharmevodabhirvyundanti bhuma ||
verses.en:
When ye have harnessed to your cars the spotted deer, urging the thunderbolt, O Maruts, to the fray,
Forth rush the torrents of the dark red stormy cloud, and moisten, like a skin, the earth with water-floods.

verses.sa:
आ वो वहन्तु सप्तयो रघुष्यदो रघुपत्वानः प्र जिगात बाहुभिः ।
सीदता बर्हिरुरु वः सदस्कृतं मादयध्वं मरुतो मध्वो अन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
a vo vahantu saptayo raghushyado raghupatvanah pra jigata bahubhih |
sidata barhiruru vah sadaskritam madayadhvam maruto madhvo andhasah ||
verses.en:
Let your swift-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms.
Sit on the grass; a wide seat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.

verses.sa:
तेऽवर्धन्त स्वतवसो महित्वना नाकं तस्थुरुरु चक्रिरे सदः ।
विष्णुर्यद्धावद्वृषणं मदच्युतं वयो न सीदन्नधि बर्हिषि प्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
te'vardhanta svatavaso mahitvana nakam tasthururu chakrire sadah |
vishnuryaddhavadvrishanam madachyutam vayo na sidannadhi barhishi priye ||
verses.en:
Strong in their native strength to greatness have they grown, stepped to the firmament and made their dwelling wide.
When Visnu saved the Soma bringing wild delight, the Maruts sate like birds on their dear holy grass.

verses.sa:
शूरा इवेद्युयुधयो न जग्मयः श्रवस्यवो न पृतनासु येतिरे ।
भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना मरुद्भ्यो राजान इव त्वेषसंदृशो नरः ॥
verses.rom:
shura ivedyuyudhayo na jagmayah shravasyavo na pritanasu yetire |
bhayante vishva bhuvana marudbhyo rajana iva tveshasamdrisho narah ||
verses.en:
In sooth like heroes fain for fight they rush about, like combatants fame-seeking have they striven in war.
Before the Maruts every creature is afraid: the men are like to Kings, terrible to behold.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा यद्वज्रं सुकृतं हिरण्ययं सहस्रभृष्टिं स्वपा अवर्तयत् ।
धत्त इन्द्रो नर्यपांसि कर्तवेऽहन्वृत्रं निरपामौब्जदर्णवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta yadvajram sukritam hiranyayam sahasrabhrishtim svapa avartayat |
dhatta indro naryapamsi kartave'hanvritram nirapamaubjadarnavam ||
verses.en:
When Tvastar deft of hand had turned the thunderbolt, golden, with thousand edges, fashioned more skilfully,
Indra received it to perform heroic deeds. Vrtra he slew, and forced the flood of water forth.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं नुनुद्रेऽवतं त ओजसा दादृहाणं चिद्बिभिदुर्वि पर्वतम् ।
धमन्तो वाणं मरुतः सुदानवो मदे सोमस्य रण्यानि चक्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvam nunudre'vatam ta ojasa dadrihanam chidbibhidurvi parvatam |
dhamanto vanam marutah sudanavo made somasya ranyani chakrire ||
verses.en:
They with their vigorous strength pushed the well up on high, and clove the cloud in twain though it was passing strong.
The Maruts, bounteous Givers, sending forth their voice, in the wild joy of Soma wrought their glorious deeds.

verses.sa:
जिह्मं नुनुद्रेऽवतं तया दिशासिञ्चन्नुत्सं गोतमाय तृष्णजे ।
आ गच्छन्तीमवसा चित्रभानवः कामं विप्रस्य तर्पयन्त धामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
jihmam nunudre'vatam taya dishasinchannutsam gotamaya trishnaje |
a gachchhantimavasa chitrabhanavah kamam viprasya tarpayanta dhamabhih ||
verses.en:
They drave the cloud transverse directed hitherward, and poured the fountain forth for thirsting Gotama.
Shining with varied light they come to him with help: they with their might fulfilled the longing of the sage.

verses.sa:
या वः शर्म शशमानाय सन्ति त्रिधातूनि दाशुषे यच्छताधि ।
अस्मभ्यं तानि मरुतो वि यन्त रयिं नो धत्त वृषणः सुवीरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya vah sharma shashamanaya santi tridhatuni dashushe yachchhatadhi |
asmabhyam tani maruto vi yanta rayim no dhatta vrishanah suviram ||
verses.en:
The shelters which ye have for him who lauds you, bestow them threefold on the man who offers.
Extend the same boons unto us, ye Maruts. Give us, O Heroes, wealth with noble offspring.

verses.sa:
मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये पाथा दिवो विमहसः ।
स सुगोपातमो जनः ॥
verses.rom:
maruto yasya hi kshaye patha divo vimahasah |
sa sugopatamo janah ||
verses.en:
THE best of guardians hath that man within whose dwelling place ye drink,
O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैर्वा यज्ञवाहसो विप्रस्य वा मतीनाम् ।
मरुतः शृणुता हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairva yajnavahaso viprasya va matinam |
marutah shrinuta havam ||
verses.en:
Honoured with sacrifice or with the worship of the sages' hymns,
O Maruts, listen to the call.

verses.sa:
उत वा यस्य वाजिनोऽनु विप्रमतक्षत ।
स गन्ता गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.rom:
uta va yasya vajino'nu vipramatakshata |
sa ganta gomati vraje ||
verses.en:
Yea, the strong man to whom ye have vouchsafed to give a sage, shall move
Into a stable rich in kine.

verses.sa:
अस्य वीरस्य बर्हिषि सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु ।
उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
asya virasya barhishi sutah somo divishtishu |
uktham madashcha shasyate ||
verses.en:
Upon this hero's sacred grass Soma is poured in daily rites:
Praise and delight are sung aloud.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रोषन्त्वा भुवो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि ।
सूरं चित्सस्रुषीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
asya shroshantva bhuvo vishva yashcharshanirabhi |
suram chitsasrushirishah ||
verses.en:
Let the strong Maruts hear him, him surpassing all men: strength be his
That reaches even to the Sun.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीभिर्हि ददाशिम शरद्भिर्मरुतो वयम् ।
अवोभिश्चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvibhirhi dadashima sharadbhirmaruto vayam |
avobhishcharshaninam ||
verses.en:
For, through the swift Gods' loving help, in many an autumn, Maruts, we
Have offered up our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सुभगः स प्रयज्यवो मरुतो अस्तु मर्त्यः ।
यस्य प्रयांसि पर्षथ ॥
verses.rom:
subhagah sa prayajyavo maruto astu martyah |
yasya prayamsi parshatha ||
verses.en:
Fortunate shall that mortal be, O Maruts most adorable,
Whose offerings ye bear away.

verses.sa:
शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः ।
विदा कामस्य वेनतः ॥
verses.rom:
shashamanasya va narah svedasya satyashavasah |
vida kamasya venatah ||
verses.en:
O Heroes truly strong, ye know the toil of him who sings your praise,
The heart's desire of him who loves.

verses.sa:
यूयं तत्सत्यशवस आविष्कर्त महित्वना ।
विध्यता विद्युता रक्षः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam tatsatyashavasa avishkarta mahitvana |
vidhyata vidyuta rakshah ||
verses.en:
O ye of true strength, make this thing manifest by your greatness: strike
The demon with your thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
गूहता गुह्यं तमो वि यात विश्वमत्रिणम् ।
ज्योतिष्कर्ता यदुश्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
guhata guhyam tamo vi yata vishvamatrinam |
jyotishkarta yadushmasi ||
verses.en:
Conceal the horrid darkness, drive far from us each devouring fiend.
Create the light for which we long.

verses.sa:
प्रत्वक्षसः प्रतवसो विरप्शिनोऽनानता अविथुरा ऋजीषिणः ।
जुष्टतमासो नृतमासो अञ्जिभिर्व्यानज्रे के चिदुस्रा इव स्तृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pratvakshasah pratavaso virapshino'nanata avithura rijishinah |
jushtatamaso nritamaso anjibhirvyanajre ke chidusra iva stribhih ||
verses.en:
LOUD Singers, never humbled, active, full of strength, immovable, impetuous, manliest, best-beloved,
They have displayed themselves with glittering ornaments, a few in number only, like the heavens with stars.

verses.sa:
उपह्वरेषु यदचिध्वं ययिं वय इव मरुतः केन चित्पथा ।
श्चोतन्ति कोशा उप वो रथेष्वा घृतमुक्षता मधुवर्णमर्चते ॥
verses.rom:
upahvareshu yadachidhvam yayim vaya iva marutah kena chitpatha |
shchotanti kosha upa vo ratheshva ghritamukshata madhuvarnamarchate ||
verses.en:
When, Maruts, on the steeps ye pile the moving cloud, ye are like birds on whatsoever path it be.
Clouds everywhere shed forth the rain upon your cars. Drop fatness, honey-hued, for him who sings your praise.

verses.sa:
प्रैषामज्मेषु विथुरेव रेजते भूमिर्यामेषु यद्ध युञ्जते शुभे ।
ते क्रीळयो धुनयो भ्राजदृष्टयः स्वयं महित्वं पनयन्त धूतयः ॥
verses.rom:
praishamajmeshu vithureva rejate bhumiryameshu yaddha yunjate shubhe |
te krilayo dhunayo bhrajadrishtayah svayam mahitvam panayanta dhutayah ||
verses.en:
Earth at their racings trembles as if weak and worn, when on their ways they yoke their cars for victory.
They, sportive, loudly roaring, armed with glittering spears, shakers of all, themselves admire their mightiness.

verses.sa:
स हि स्वसृत्पृषदश्वो युवा गणोऽया ईशानस्तविषीभिरावृतः ।
असि सत्य ऋणयावानेद्योऽस्या धियः प्राविताथा वृषा गणः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi svasritprishadashvo yuva gano'ya ishanastavishibhiravritah |
asi satya rinayavanedyo'sya dhiyah pravitatha vrisha ganah ||
verses.en:
Self-moving is that youthful band, with spotted steeds; thus it hath lordly sway, endued with power and might.
Truthful art thou, and blameless, searcher out of sin: so thou, Strong Host, wilt be protector of this prayer.

verses.sa:
पितुः प्रत्नस्य जन्मना वदामसि सोमस्य जिह्वा प्र जिगाति चक्षसा ।
यदीमिन्द्रं शम्यृक्वाण आशतादिन्नामानि यज्ञियानि दधिरे ॥
verses.rom:
pituh pratnasya janmana vadamasi somasya jihva pra jigati chakshasa |
yadimindram shamyrikvana ashatadinnamani yajniyani dadhire ||
verses.en:
We speak by our descent from our primeval Sire; our tongue, when we behold the Soma, stirs itself.
When, shouting, they had joined Indra in toil of fight, then only they obtained their sacrificial names.

verses.sa:
श्रियसे कं भानुभिः सं मिमिक्षिरे ते रश्मिभिस्त ऋक्वभिः सुखादयः ।
ते वाशीमन्त इष्मिणो अभीरवो विद्रे प्रियस्य मारुतस्य धाम्नः ॥
verses.rom:
shriyase kam bhanubhih sam mimikshire te rashmibhista rikvabhih sukhadayah |
te vashimanta ishmino abhiravo vidre priyasya marutasya dhamnah ||
verses.en:
Splendours they gained for glory, they who wear bright rings; rays they obtained, and men to celebrate their praise.
Armed with their swords, impetuous and fearing naught, they have possessed the Maruts' own beloved home.

verses.sa:
आ विद्युन्मद्भिर्मरुतः स्वर्कै रथेभिर्यात ऋष्टिमद्भिरश्वपर्णैः ।
आ वर्षिष्ठया न इषा वयो न पप्तता सुमायाः ॥
verses.rom:
a vidyunmadbhirmarutah svarkai rathebhiryata rishtimadbhirashvaparnaih |
a varshishthaya na isha vayo na paptata sumayah ||
verses.en:
COME hither, Maruts, on your lightning laden cars, sounding with sweet songs, armed with lances, winged with steeds.
Fly unto us with noblest food, like birds, O ye of mighty power.

verses.sa:
तेऽरुणेभिर्वरमा पिशङ्गैः शुभे कं यान्ति रथतूर्भिरश्वैः ।
रुक्मो न चित्रः स्वधितीवान्पव्या रथस्य जङ्घनन्त भूम ॥
verses.rom:
te'runebhirvarama pishangaih shubhe kam yanti rathaturbhirashvaih |
rukmo na chitrah svadhitivanpavya rathasya janghananta bhuma ||
verses.en:
With their red-hued or, haply, tawny coursers which speed their chariots on, they come for glory.
Brilliant like gold is he who holds the thunder. Earth have they smitten with the chariot's felly.

verses.sa:
श्रिये कं वो अधि तनूषु वाशीर्मेधा वना न कृणवन्त ऊर्ध्वा ।
युष्मभ्यं कं मरुतः सुजातास्तुविद्युम्नासो धनयन्ते अद्रिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriye kam vo adhi tanushu vashirmedha vana na krinavanta urdhva |
yushmabhyam kam marutah sujatastuvidyumnaso dhanayante adrim ||
verses.en:
For beauty ye have swords upon your bodies. As they stir woods so may they stir our spirits.
For your sake, O ye Maruts very mighty and well-born, have they set the stone, in motion.

verses.sa:
अहानि गृध्राः पर्या व आगुरिमां धियं वार्कार्यां च देवीम् ।
ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो गोतमासो अर्कैरूर्ध्वं नुनुद्र उत्सधिं पिबध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
ahani gridhrah parya va agurimam dhiyam varkaryam cha devim |
brahma krinvanto gotamaso arkairurdhvam nunudra utsadhim pibadhyai ||
verses.en:
The days went round you and came back O yearners, back, to this prayer and to this solemn worship.
The Gotamas making their prayer with singing have pushed the well's lid up to drink the water.

verses.sa:
एतत्त्यन्न योजनमचेति सस्वर्ह यन्मरुतो गोतमो वः ।
पश्यन्हिरण्यचक्रानयोदंष्ट्रान्विधावतो वराहून् ॥
verses.rom:
etattyanna yojanamacheti sasvarha yanmaruto gotamo vah |
pashyanhiranyachakranayodamshtranvidhavato varahun ||
verses.en:
No hymn way ever known like this aforetime which Gotama sang forth for you, O Maruts,
What time upon your golden wheels he saw you, wild boars rushing about with tusks of iron.

verses.sa:
एषा स्या वो मरुतोऽनुभर्त्री प्रति ष्टोभति वाघतो न वाणी ।
अस्तोभयद्वृथासामनु स्वधां गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya vo maruto'nubhartri prati shtobhati vaghato na vani |
astobhayadvrithasamanu svadham gabhastyoh ||
verses.en:
To you this freshening draught of Soma rusheth, O Maruts, like the voice of one who prayeth.
It rusheth freely from our hands as these libations wont to flow.

verses.sa:
आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतोऽदब्धासो अपरीतास उद्भिदः ।
देवा नो यथा सदमिद्वृधे असन्नप्रायुवो रक्षितारो दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhadrah kratavo yantu vishvato'dabdhaso aparitasa udbhidah |
deva no yatha sadamidvridhe asannaprayuvo rakshitaro divedive ||
verses.en:
MAY powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered, and victorious,
That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day unceasing in their care.

verses.sa:
देवानां भद्रा सुमतिरृजूयतां देवानां रातिरभि नो नि वर्तताम् ।
देवानां सख्यमुप सेदिमा वयं देवा न आयुः प्र तिरन्तु जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
devanam bhadra sumatirrijuyatam devanam ratirabhi no ni vartatam |
devanam sakhyamupa sedima vayam deva na ayuh pra tirantu jivase ||
verses.en:
May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods.
The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

verses.sa:
तान्पूर्वया निविदा हूमहे वयं भगं मित्रमदितिं दक्षमस्रिधम् ।
अर्यमणं वरुणं सोममश्विना सरस्वती नः सुभगा मयस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
tanpurvaya nivida humahe vayam bhagam mitramaditim dakshamasridham |
aryamanam varunam somamashvina sarasvati nah subhaga mayaskarat ||
verses.en:
We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksa, Mitra, Aditi,
Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvati, auspicious, grant felicity.

verses.sa:
तन्नो वातो मयोभु वातु भेषजं तन्माता पृथिवी तत्पिता द्यौः ।
तद्ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवस्तदश्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या युवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tanno vato mayobhu vatu bheshajam tanmata prithivi tatpita dyauh |
tadgravanah somasuto mayobhuvastadashvina shrinutam dhishnya yuvam ||
verses.en:
May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven,
And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

verses.sa:
तमीशानं जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियंजिन्वमवसे हूमहे वयम् ।
पूषा नो यथा वेदसामसद्वृधे रक्षिता पायुरदब्धः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
tamishanam jagatastasthushaspatim dhiyamjinvamavase humahe vayam |
pusha no yatha vedasamasadvridhe rakshita payuradabdhah svastaye ||
verses.en:
Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul,
That Pusan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः ।
स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
svasti na indro vriddhashravah svasti nah pusha vishvavedah |
svasti nastarkshyo arishtanemih svasti no brihaspatirdadhatu ||
verses.en:
Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pusan prosper us, the Master of all wealth.
May Tarksya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brhaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

verses.sa:
पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः ।
अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसो विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्निह ॥
verses.rom:
prishadashva marutah prishnimatarah shubhamyavano vidatheshu jagmayah |
agnijihva manavah surachakshaso vishve no deva avasa gamanniha ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, Sons of Prsni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites,
Sages whose tongue is Agni, brilliant as the Sun,--hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

verses.sa:
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram karnebhih shrinuyama deva bhadram pashyemakshabhiryajatrah |
sthirairangaistushtuvamsastanubhirvyashema devahitam yadayuh ||
verses.en:
Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones.
With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

verses.sa:
शतमिन्नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् ।
पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर्गन्तोः ॥
verses.rom:
shataminnu sharado anti deva yatra nashchakra jarasam tanunam |
putraso yatra pitaro bhavanti ma no madhya ririshatayurgantoh ||
verses.en:
A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay;
Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः ।
विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
aditirdyauraditirantarikshamaditirmata sa pita sa putrah |
vishve deva aditih pancha jana aditirjatamaditirjanitvam ||
verses.en:
Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son.
Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.

verses.sa:
ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयतु विद्वान् ।
अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
rijuniti no varuno mitro nayatu vidvan |
aryama devaih sajoshah ||
verses.en:
MAY Varuna with guidance straight, and Mitra lead us, he who knows,
And Aryaman in accord with Gods.

verses.sa:
ते हि वस्वो वसवानास्ते अप्रमूरा महोभिः ।
व्रता रक्षन्ते विश्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
te hi vasvo vasavanaste apramura mahobhih |
vrata rakshante vishvaha ||
verses.en:
For they are dealers forth of wealth, and, not deluded, with their might
Guard evermore the holy laws.

verses.sa:
ते अस्मभ्यं शर्म यंसन्नमृता मर्त्येभ्यः ।
बाधमाना अप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
te asmabhyam sharma yamsannamrita martyebhyah |
badhamana apa dvishah ||
verses.en:
Shelter may they vouchsafe to us, Immortal Gods to mortal men,
Chasing our enemies away.

verses.sa:
वि नः पथः सुविताय चियन्त्विन्द्रो मरुतः ।
पूषा भगो वन्द्यासः ॥
verses.rom:
vi nah pathah suvitaya chiyantvindro marutah |
pusha bhago vandyasah ||
verses.en:
May they mark out our paths to bliss, Indra, the Maruts, Pusan,
and Bhaga, the Gods to be adored.

verses.sa:
उत नो धियो गोअग्राः पूषन्विष्णवेवयावः ।
कर्ता नः स्वस्तिमतः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no dhiyo goagrah pushanvishnavevayavah |
karta nah svastimatah ||
verses.en:
Yea, Pusan, Visnu, ye who run your course, enrich our hymns with kine;
Bless us with all prosperity.

verses.sa:
मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः ।
माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः ॥
verses.rom:
madhu vata ritayate madhu ksharanti sindhavah |
madhvirnah santvoshadhih ||
verses.en:
The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law
So may the plants be sweet for us.

verses.sa:
मधु नक्तमुतोषसो मधुमत्पार्थिवं रजः ।
मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता ॥
verses.rom:
madhu naktamutoshaso madhumatparthivam rajah |
madhu dyaurastu nah pita ||
verses.en:
Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere;
Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

verses.sa:
मधुमान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमाँ अस्तु सूर्यः ।
माध्वीर्गावो भवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
madhumanno vanaspatirmadhuman astu suryah |
madhvirgavo bhavantu nah ||
verses.en:
May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun:
May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

verses.sa:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा ।
शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no mitrah sham varunah sham no bhavatvaryama |
sham na indro brihaspatih sham no vishnururukramah ||
verses.en:
Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman:
Indra, Brhaspati be kind, and Visnu of the mighty stride.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वं रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पन्थाम् ।
तव प्रणीती पितरो न इन्दो देवेषु रत्नमभजन्त धीराः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma pra chikito manisha tvam rajishthamanu neshi pantham |
tava praniti pitaro na indo deveshu ratnamabhajanta dhirah ||

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः सुक्रतुर्भूस्त्वं दक्षैः सुदक्षो विश्ववेदाः ।
त्वं वृषा वृषत्वेभिर्महित्वा द्युम्नेभिर्द्युम्न्यभवो नृचक्षाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma kratubhih sukraturbhustvam dakshaih sudaksho vishvavedah |
tvam vrisha vrishatvebhirmahitva dyumnebhirdyumnyabhavo nrichakshah ||

verses.sa:
राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम ।
शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम ॥
verses.rom:
rajno nu te varunasya vratani brihadgabhiram tava soma dhama |
shuchishtvamasi priyo na mitro dakshayyo aryamevasi soma ||

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्यां या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु ।
तेभिर्नो विश्वैः सुमना अहेळन्राजन्सोम प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
verses.rom:
ya te dhamani divi ya prithivyam ya parvateshvoshadhishvapsu |
tebhirno vishvaih sumana ahelanrajansoma prati havya gribhaya ||

verses.sa:
त्वं सोमासि सत्पतिस्त्वं राजोत वृत्रहा ।
त्वं भद्रो असि क्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam somasi satpatistvam rajota vritraha |
tvam bhadro asi kratuh ||

verses.sa:
त्वं च सोम नो वशो जीवातुं न मरामहे ।
प्रियस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam cha soma no vasho jivatum na maramahe |
priyastotro vanaspatih ||

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम महे भगं त्वं यून ऋतायते ।
दक्षं दधासि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma mahe bhagam tvam yuna ritayate |
daksham dadhasi jivase ||

verses.sa:
त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो रक्षा राजन्नघायतः ।
न रिष्येत्त्वावतः सखा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah soma vishvato raksha rajannaghayatah |
na rishyettvavatah sakha ||

verses.sa:
सोम यास्ते मयोभुव ऊतयः सन्ति दाशुषे ।
ताभिर्नोऽविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
soma yaste mayobhuva utayah santi dashushe |
tabhirno'vita bhava ||

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि ।
सोम त्वं नो वृधे भव ॥
verses.rom:
imam yajnamidam vacho jujushana upagahi |
soma tvam no vridhe bhava ||

verses.sa:
सोम गीर्भिष्ट्वा वयं वर्धयामो वचोविदः ।
सुमृळीको न आ विश ॥
verses.rom:
soma girbhishtva vayam vardhayamo vachovidah |
sumriliko na a visha ||

verses.sa:
गयस्फानो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः ।
सुमित्रः सोम नो भव ॥
verses.rom:
gayasphano amivaha vasuvitpushtivardhanah |
sumitrah soma no bhava ||

verses.sa:
सोम रारन्धि नो हृदि गावो न यवसेष्वा ।
मर्य इव स्व ओक्ये ॥
verses.rom:
soma rarandhi no hridi gavo na yavaseshva |
marya iva sva okye ||

verses.sa:
यः सोम सख्ये तव रारणद्देव मर्त्यः ।
तं दक्षः सचते कविः ॥
verses.rom:
yah soma sakhye tava raranaddeva martyah |
tam dakshah sachate kavih ||

verses.sa:
उरुष्या णो अभिशस्तेः सोम नि पाह्यंहसः ।
सखा सुशेव एधि नः ॥
verses.rom:
urushya no abhishasteh soma ni pahyamhasah |
sakha susheva edhi nah ||

verses.sa:
आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् ।
भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
verses.rom:
a pyayasva sametu te vishvatah soma vrishnyam |
bhava vajasya samgathe ||

verses.sa:
आ प्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः ।
भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
a pyayasva madintama soma vishvebhiramshubhih |
bhava nah sushravastamah sakha vridhe ||

verses.sa:
सं ते पयांसि समु यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः ।
आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्युत्तमानि धिष्व ॥
verses.rom:
sam te payamsi samu yantu vajah sam vrishnyanyabhimatishahah |
apyayamano amritaya soma divi shravamsyuttamani dhishva ||

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति ता ते विश्वा परिभूरस्तु यज्ञम् ।
गयस्फानः प्रतरणः सुवीरोऽवीरहा प्र चरा सोम दुर्यान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya te dhamani havisha yajanti ta te vishva paribhurastu yajnam |
gayasphanah prataranah suviro'viraha pra chara soma duryan ||

verses.sa:
सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तमाशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति ।
सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
somo dhenum somo arvantamashum somo viram karmanyam dadati |
sadanyam vidathyam sabheyam pitrishravanam yo dadashadasmai ||

verses.sa:
अषाळ्हं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम् ।
भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम ॥
verses.rom:
ashalham yutsu pritanasu paprim svarshamapsam vrijanasya gopam |
bhareshujam sukshitim sushravasam jayantam tvamanu madema soma ||

verses.sa:
त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः ।
त्वमा ततन्थोर्वन्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ ॥
verses.rom:
tvamima oshadhih soma vishvastvamapo ajanayastvam gah |
tvama tatanthorvantariksham tvam jyotisha vi tamo vavartha ||

verses.sa:
देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागं सहसावन्नभि युध्य ।
मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टौ ॥
verses.rom:
devena no manasa deva soma rayo bhagam sahasavannabhi yudhya |
ma tva tanadishishe viryasyobhayebhyah pra chikitsa gavishtau ||

prose.en:
1. Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader.
Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

2. Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing,
Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals.

3. Thine are King Varuna's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory.
All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

4. With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,--
With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations.

5. Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vrtra-slayer thou:
Thou art auspicious energy.

6. And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die:
Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou.

7. To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness,
And energy that he may live.

8. Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never let
The friend of one like thee be harmed.

9. With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,--
Even with those protect thou us.

10. Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come,
And be thou nigh to prosper us.

11. Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs:
Come thou to us, most gracious One.

12. Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store,
Be, Soma, a good Friend to us.

13. Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads,
As a young man in his own house.

14. O Soma, God, the mortal man who in thy friendship hath delight,
Him doth the mighty Sage befriend.

15. Save us from slanderous reproach, keep us., O Soma, from distress:
Be unto us a gracious Friend.

16. Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:
Be in the gathering-place of strength.

17. Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy rays of light, and be
A Friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.
16. In thee be juicy nutriments united, and powers and mighty foe-subduing vigour,
Waxing to immortality, O Soma: win highest glories for thyself in heaven.

19. Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship.
Wealth-giver, furtherer with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses.

20. To him who worships Soma gives the milch-cow, a fleet steed and a man of active knowledge,
Skilled in home duties, meet for holy synod, for council meet, a glory to his father.

21. Invincible in fight, saver in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water,
Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee will we rejoice, O Soma.

22. These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated.
The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness.

23. Do thou, God Soma, with thy Godlike spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches.
Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for both sides in the fray for booty.

verses.sa:
एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते ।
निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
eta u tya ushasah ketumakrata purve ardhe rajaso bhanumanjate |
nishkrinvana ayudhaniva dhrishnavah prati gavo'rushiryanti matarah ||
verses.en:
THESE Dawns have raised their banner; in the eastern half of the mid-air they spread abroad their shining light.
Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the war, onward they come bright red in hue, the Mother Cows.

verses.sa:
उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत ।
अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
udapaptannaruna bhanavo vritha svayujo arushirga ayukshata |
akrannushaso vayunani purvatha rushantam bhanumarushirashishrayuh ||
verses.en:
Readily have the purple beams of light shot up; the Red Cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked.
The Dawns have brought distinct perception as before: red-hued, they have attained their fulgent brilliancy.

verses.sa:
अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः ।
इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
archanti narirapaso na vishtibhih samanena yojanena paravatah |
isham vahantih sukrite sudanave vishvedaha yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away,
Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.

verses.sa:
अधि पेशांसि वपते नृतूरिवापोर्णुते वक्ष उस्रेव बर्जहम् ।
ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वती गावो न व्रजं व्युषा आवर्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
adhi peshamsi vapate nriturivapornute vaksha usreva barjaham |
jyotirvishvasmai bhuvanaya krinvati gavo na vrajam vyusha avartamah ||
verses.en:
She, like a dancer, puts her broidered garments on: as a cow yields her udder so she bares her breast.
Creating light for all the world of life, the Dawn hath laid the darkness open as the cows their stall.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यर्ची रुशदस्या अदर्शि वि तिष्ठते बाधते कृष्णमभ्वम् ।
स्वरुं न पेशो विदथेष्वञ्जञ्चित्रं दिवो दुहिता भानुमश्रेत् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyarchi rushadasya adarshi vi tishthate badhate krishnamabhvam |
svarum na pesho vidatheshvanjanchitram divo duhita bhanumashret ||
verses.en:
We have beheld the brightness of her shining; it spreads and drives away the darksome monster.
Like tints that deck the Post at sacrifices, Heaven's Daughter hath attained her wondrous splendour.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्योषा उच्छन्ती वयुना कृणोति ।
श्रिये छन्दो न स्मयते विभाती सुप्रतीका सौमनसायाजीगः ॥
verses.rom:
atarishma tamasasparamasyosha uchchhanti vayuna krinoti |
shriye chhando na smayate vibhati supratika saumanasayajigah ||
verses.en:
We have o'erpast the limit of this darkness; Dawn breaking forth again brings clear perception.
She like a flatterer smiles in light for glory, and fair of face hath wakened to rejoice us.

verses.sa:
भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानां दिव स्तवे दुहिता गोतमेभिः ।
प्रजावतो नृवतो अश्वबुध्यानुषो गोअग्राँ उप मासि वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
bhasvati netri sunritanam diva stave duhita gotamebhih |
prajavato nrivato ashvabudhyanusho goagran upa masi vajan ||
verses.en:
The Gotamas have praised Heaven's radiant Daughter, the leader of the charm of pleasant voices.
Dawn, thou conferrest on us strength with offspring and men, conspicuous with kine and horses.

verses.sa:
उषस्तमश्यां यशसं सुवीरं दासप्रवर्गं रयिमश्वबुध्यम् ।
सुदंससा श्रवसा या विभासि वाजप्रसूता सुभगे बृहन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
ushastamashyam yashasam suviram dasapravargam rayimashvabudhyam |
sudamsasa shravasa ya vibhasi vajaprasuta subhage brihantam ||
verses.en:
O thou who shinest forth in wondrous glory, urged onward by thy strength, auspicious Lady,
Dawn, may I gain that wealth, renowned and ample, in brave sons, troops of slaves, far-famed for horses.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि देवी भुवनाभिचक्ष्या प्रतीची चक्षुरुर्विया वि भाति ।
विश्वं जीवं चरसे बोधयन्ती विश्वस्य वाचमविदन्मनायोः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani devi bhuvanabhichakshya pratichi chakshururviya vi bhati |
vishvam jivam charase bodhayanti vishvasya vachamavidanmanayoh ||
verses.en:
Bending her looks on all the world, the Goddess shines, widely spreading with her bright eye westward.
Waking to motion every living creature, she understands the voice of each adorer.

verses.sa:
पुनःपुनर्जायमाना पुराणी समानं वर्णमभि शुम्भमाना ।
श्वघ्नीव कृत्नुर्विज आमिनाना मर्तस्य देवी जरयन्त्यायुः ॥
verses.rom:
punahpunarjayamana purani samanam varnamabhi shumbhamana |
shvaghniva kritnurvija aminana martasya devi jarayantyayuh ||
verses.en:
Ancient of days, again again born newly, decking her beauty with the self-same raiment.
The Goddess wastes away the life of mortals, like a skilled hunter cutting birds in pieces.

verses.sa:
व्यूर्ण्वती दिवो अन्ताँ अबोध्यप स्वसारं सनुतर्युयोति ।
प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि योषा जारस्य चक्षसा वि भाति ॥
verses.rom:
vyurnvati divo antan abodhyapa svasaram sanutaryuyoti |
praminati manushya yugani yosha jarasya chakshasa vi bhati ||
verses.en:
She hath appeared discovering heaven's borders: to the far distance she drives off her Sister.
Diminishing the days of human creatures, the Lady shines with all her lover's splendour.

verses.sa:
पशून्न चित्रा सुभगा प्रथाना सिन्धुर्न क्षोद उर्विया व्यश्वैत् ।
अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि सूर्यस्य चेति रश्मिभिर्दृशाना ॥
verses.rom:
pashunna chitra subhaga prathana sindhurna kshoda urviya vyashvait |
aminati daivyani vratani suryasya cheti rashmibhirdrishana ||
verses.en:
The bright, the blessed One shines forth extending her rays like kine, as a flood rolls his waters.
Never transgressing the divine commandments, she is beheld visible with the sunbeams.

verses.sa:
उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति ।
येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ushastachchitrama bharasmabhyam vajinivati |
yena tokam cha tanayam cha dhamahe ||
verses.en:
O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us the wondrous gift
Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.

verses.sa:
उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि ।
रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति ॥
verses.rom:
usho adyeha gomatyashvavati vibhavari |
revadasme vyuchchha sunritavati ||
verses.en:
Thou radiant mover of sweet sounds, with wealth of horses and of kine
Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn auspiciously.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाँ अद्यारुणाँ उषः ।
अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hi vajinivatyashvan adyarunan ushah |
atha no vishva saubhaganya vaha ||
verses.en:
O Dawn enriched with holy rites, yoke to thy car thy purple steeds,
And then bring thou unto us all felicities.

verses.sa:
अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ।
अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina vartirasmada gomaddasra hiranyavat |
arvagratham samanasa ni yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
O Asvins wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct
Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold.

verses.sa:
यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः ।
आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavittha shlokama divo jyotirjanaya chakrathuh |
a na urjam vahatamashvina yuvam ||
verses.en:
Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to man,
Do ye, O Asvins, bring strength hither unto us.

verses.sa:
एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी ।
उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
eha deva mayobhuva dasra hiranyavartani |
usharbudho vahantu somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma both the Gods
Health-givers Wonder-Workers, borne on paths of gold.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमाविमं सु मे शृणुतं वृषणा हवम् ।
प्रति सूक्तानि हर्यतं भवतं दाशुषे मयः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishomavimam su me shrinutam vrishana havam |
prati suktani haryatam bhavatam dashushe mayah ||
verses.en:
AGNI and Soma, mighty Pair, graciously hearken to my call,
Accept in friendly wise my hymn, and prosper him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा यो अद्य वामिदं वचः सपर्यति ।
तस्मै धत्तं सुवीर्यं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma yo adya vamidam vachah saparyati |
tasmai dhattam suviryam gavam posham svashvyam ||
verses.en:
The man who honours you to-day, Agni and Soma, with this hymn,
Bestow on him heroic strength, increase of kine, and noble steeds.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा य आहुतिं यो वां दाशाद्धविष्कृतिम् ।
स प्रजया सुवीर्यं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma ya ahutim yo vam dashaddhavishkritim |
sa prajaya suviryam vishvamayurvyashnavat ||
verses.en:
The man who offers holy oil and burnt oblations unto you,
Agni and Soma, shall enjoy great strength, with offspring, all his life.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा चेति तद्वीर्यं वां यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गाः ।
अवातिरतं बृसयस्य शेषोऽविन्दतं ज्योतिरेकं बहुभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma cheti tadviryam vam yadamushnitamavasam panim gah |
avatiratam brisayasya shesho'vindatam jyotirekam bahubhyah ||
verses.en:
Agni and Soma, famed is that your. prowess wherewith ye stole the kine, his food, from Pani.
Ye caused the brood of Brsaya to perish; ye found the light, the single light for many.

verses.sa:
युवमेतानि दिवि रोचनान्यग्निश्च सोम सक्रतू अधत्तम् ।
युवं सिन्धूँरभिशस्तेरवद्यादग्नीषोमावमुञ्चतं गृभीतान् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvametani divi rochananyagnishcha soma sakratu adhattam |
yuvam sindhunrabhishasteravadyadagnishomavamunchatam gribhitan ||
verses.en:
Agni and Soma, joined in operation ye have set up the shining lights in heaven.
From curse and from reproach, Agni and Soma, ye freed the rivers that were bound in fetters.

verses.sa:
आन्यं दिवो मातरिश्वा जभारामथ्नादन्यं परि श्येनो अद्रेः ।
अग्नीषोमा ब्रह्मणा वावृधानोरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
anyam divo matarishva jabharamathnadanyam pari shyeno adreh |
agnishoma brahmana vavridhanorum yajnaya chakrathuru lokam ||
verses.en:
One of you Matarisvan brought from heaven, the Falcon rent the other from the mountain.
Strengthened by holy prayer Agni and Soma have made us ample room for sacrificing.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा हविषः प्रस्थितस्य वीतं हर्यतं वृषणा जुषेथाम् ।
सुशर्माणा स्ववसा हि भूतमथा धत्तं यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma havishah prasthitasya vitam haryatam vrishana jushetham |
susharmana svavasa hi bhutamatha dhattam yajamanaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
Taste, Agni, Soma, this prepared oblation; accept it, Mighty Ones, and let it please you.
Vouchsafe us good protection and kind favour: grant to the sacrificer health and riches.

verses.sa:
यो अग्नीषोमा हविषा सपर्याद्देवद्रीचा मनसा यो घृतेन ।
तस्य व्रतं रक्षतं पातमंहसो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnishoma havisha saparyaddevadricha manasa yo ghritena |
tasya vratam rakshatam patamamhaso vishe janaya mahi sharma yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Whoso with oil and poured oblation honours, with God-devoted heart, Agni and Soma,--
Protect his sacrifice, preserve him from distress, grant to the sacrificer great felicity.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा सवेदसा सहूती वनतं गिरः ।
सं देवत्रा बभूवथुः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma savedasa sahuti vanatam girah |
sam devatra babhuvathuh ||
verses.en:
Invoked together, mates in wealth, Agni-Soma, accept our hymns:
Together be among the Gods.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमावनेन वां यो वां घृतेन दाशति ।
तस्मै दीदयतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishomavanena vam yo vam ghritena dashati |
tasmai didayatam brihat ||
verses.en:
Agni and Soma, unto him who worships you with holy oil
Shine forth an ample recompense.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमाविमानि नो युवं हव्या जुजोषतम् ।
आ यातमुप नः सचा ॥
verses.rom:
agnishomavimani no yuvam havya jujoshatam |
a yatamupa nah sacha ||
verses.en:
Agni and Soma, be ye pleased with these oblations brought to you,
And come, together, nigh to us.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा पिपृतमर्वतो न आ प्यायन्तामुस्रिया हव्यसूदः ।
अस्मे बलानि मघवत्सु धत्तं कृणुतं नो अध्वरं श्रुष्टिमन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma pipritamarvato na a pyayantamusriya havyasudah |
asme balani maghavatsu dhattam krinutam no adhvaram shrushtimantam ||
verses.en:
Agni and Soma, cherish well our horses, and let our cows be fat who yield oblations.
Grant power to us and to our wealthy patrons, and cause our holy rites to be successful.

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया ।
भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
imam stomamarhate jatavedase rathamiva sam mahema manishaya |
bhadra hi nah pramatirasya samsadyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
FOR Jatavedas worthy of our praise will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car.
For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वमायजसे स साधत्यनर्वा क्षेति दधते सुवीर्यम् ।
स तूताव नैनमश्नोत्यंहतिरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvamayajase sa sadhatyanarva ksheti dadhate suviryam |
sa tutava nainamashnotyamhatiragne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
The man for whom thou sacrificest prospereth, dwelleth without a foe, gaineth heroic might.
He waxeth strong, distress never approacheth him. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
शकेम त्वा समिधं साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् ।
त्वमादित्याँ आ वह तान्ह्युश्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
shakema tva samidham sadhaya dhiyastve deva haviradantyahutam |
tvamadityan a vaha tanhyushmasyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
May we have power to kindle thee. Fulfil our thoughts. In thee the Gods eat the presented offering,
Bring hither the Adityas, for we long for them. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवींषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयम् ।
जीवातवे प्रतरं साधया धियोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
bharamedhmam krinavama havimshi te chitayantah parvanaparvana vayam |
jivatave prataram sadhaya dhiyo'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
We will bring fuel and prepare burnt offerings, reminding thee at each successive festival.
Fulfil our thought that so we may prolong our lives. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
विशां गोपा अस्य चरन्ति जन्तवो द्विपच्च यदुत चतुष्पदक्तुभिः ।
चित्रः प्रकेत उषसो महाँ अस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
visham gopa asya charanti jantavo dvipachcha yaduta chatushpadaktubhih |
chitrah praketa ushaso mahan asyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
His ministers move forth, the guardians of the folk, protecting quadruped and biped with their rays.
Mighty art thou, the wondrous herald of the Dawn. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
त्वमध्वर्युरुत होतासि पूर्व्यः प्रशास्ता पोता जनुषा पुरोहितः ।
विश्वा विद्वाँ आर्त्विज्या धीर पुष्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
tvamadhvaryuruta hotasi purvyah prashasta pota janusha purohitah |
vishva vidvan artvijya dhira pushyasyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Thou art Presenter and the chief Invoker, thou Director, Purifier, great High Priest by birth.
Knowing all priestly work thou perfectest it, Sage. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वतः सुप्रतीकः सदृङ्ङसि दूरे चित्सन्तळिदिवाति रोचसे ।
रात्र्याश्चिदन्धो अति देव पश्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvatah supratikah sadrinnasi dure chitsantalidivati rochase |
ratryashchidandho ati deva pashyasyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Lovely of form art thou, alike on every side; though far, thou shinest brightly as if close at hand.
O God, thou seest through even the dark of night. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो देवा भवतु सुन्वतो रथोऽस्माकं शंसो अभ्यस्तु दूढ्यः ।
तदा जानीतोत पुष्यता वचोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
purvo deva bhavatu sunvato ratho'smakam shamso abhyastu dudhyah |
tada janitota pushyata vacho'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Gods, foremost be his car who pours libations out, and let our hymn prevail o'er evil-hearted men.
Attend to this our speech and make it prosper well. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
वधैर्दुःशंसाँ अप दूढ्यो जहि दूरे वा ये अन्ति वा के चिदत्रिणः ।
अथा यज्ञाय गृणते सुगं कृध्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
vadhairduhshamsan apa dudhyo jahi dure va ye anti va ke chidatrinah |
atha yajnaya grinate sugam kridhyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Smite with thy weapons those of evil speech and thought, devouring demons, whether near or far away.
Then to the singer give free way for sacrifice. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यदयुक्था अरुषा रोहिता रथे वातजूता वृषभस्येव ते रवः ।
आदिन्वसि वनिनो धूमकेतुनाग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
yadayuktha arusha rohita rathe vatajuta vrishabhasyeva te ravah |
adinvasi vanino dhumaketunagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
When to thy chariot thou hadst yoked two red steeds and two ruddy steeds, wind-sped, thy roar was like a bull's.
Thou with smoke-bannered flame attackest forest trees. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अध स्वनादुत बिभ्युः पतत्रिणो द्रप्सा यत्ते यवसादो व्यस्थिरन् ।
सुगं तत्ते तावकेभ्यो रथेभ्योऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
adha svanaduta bibhyuh patatrino drapsa yatte yavasado vyasthiran |
sugam tatte tavakebhyo rathebhyo'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Then at thy roar the very birds are terrified, when, eating-up the grass, thy sparks fly forth abroad.
Then is it easy for thee and thy car to pass. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धायसेऽवयातां मरुतां हेळो अद्भुतः ।
मृळा सु नो भूत्वेषां मनः पुनरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
ayam mitrasya varunasya dhayase'vayatam marutam helo adbhutah |
mrila su no bhutvesham manah punaragne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
He hath the Power to soothe Mitra and Varuna: wonderful is the Maruts' wrath when they descend.
Be gracious; let their hearts he turned to us again. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
देवो देवानामसि मित्रो अद्भुतो वसुर्वसूनामसि चारुरध्वरे ।
शर्मन्स्याम तव सप्रथस्तमेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
devo devanamasi mitro adbhuto vasurvasunamasi charuradhvare |
sharmansyama tava saprathastame'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
Thou art a God, thou art the wondrous Friend of Gods, the Vasu of the Vasus, fair in sacrifice.
Under, thine own most wide protection may we dwell. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
तत्ते भद्रं यत्समिद्धः स्वे दमे सोमाहुतो जरसे मृळयत्तमः ।
दधासि रत्नं द्रविणं च दाशुषेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
tatte bhadram yatsamiddhah sve dame somahuto jarase mrilayattamah |
dadhasi ratnam dravinam cha dashushe'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en:
This is thy grace that, kindled in thine own abode, invoked with Soma thou soundest forth most benign,
Thou givest wealth and treasure to the worshipper. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं सुद्रविणो ददाशोऽनागास्त्वमदिते सर्वताता ।
यं भद्रेण शवसा चोदयासि प्रजावता राधसा ते स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvam sudravino dadasho'nagastvamadite sarvatata |
yam bhadrena shavasa chodayasi prajavata radhasa te syama ||
verses.en:
To whom thou, Lord of goodly riches, grantest freedom from every sin with perfect wholeness,
Whom with good strength thou quikenest, with children and wealth--may we be they, Eternal Being.

verses.sa:
स त्वमग्ने सौभगत्वस्य विद्वानस्माकमायुः प्र तिरेह देव ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvamagne saubhagatvasya vidvanasmakamayuh pra tireha deva |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Such, Agni, thou who knowest all good fortune, God, lengthen here the days of our existence.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
द्वे विरूपे चरतः स्वर्थे अन्यान्या वत्समुप धापयेते ।
हरिरन्यस्यां भवति स्वधावाञ्छुक्रो अन्यस्यां ददृशे सुवर्चाः ॥
verses.rom:
dve virupe charatah svarthe anyanya vatsamupa dhapayete |
hariranyasyam bhavati svadhavanchhukro anyasyam dadrishe suvarchah ||
verses.en:
To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant.
One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour; bright and fair-shining, is he with the other.

verses.sa:
दशेमं त्वष्टुर्जनयन्त गर्भमतन्द्रासो युवतयो विभृत्रम् ।
तिग्मानीकं स्वयशसं जनेषु विरोचमानं परि षीं नयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
dashemam tvashturjanayanta garbhamatandraso yuvatayo vibhritram |
tigmanikam svayashasam janeshu virochamanam pari shim nayanti ||
verses.en:
Tvastar's ten daughters, vigilant and youthful, produced this Infant borne to sundry quarters.
They bear around him whose long flames are pointed, fulgent among mankind with native splendour.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि जाना परि भूषन्त्यस्य समुद्र एकं दिव्येकमप्सु ।
पूर्वामनु प्र दिशं पार्थिवानामृतून्प्रशासद्वि दधावनुष्ठु ॥
verses.rom:
trini jana pari bhushantyasya samudra ekam divyekamapsu |
purvamanu pra disham parthivanamritunprashasadvi dadhavanushthu ||
verses.en:
Three several places of his birth they honour, in mid-air, in the heaven, and in the waters.
Governing in the east of earthly regions, the seasons hath he stablished in their order.

verses.sa:
क इमं वो निण्यमा चिकेत वत्सो मातॄर्जनयत स्वधाभिः ।
बह्वीनां गर्भो अपसामुपस्थान्महान्कविर्निश्चरति स्वधावान् ॥
verses.rom:
ka imam vo ninyama chiketa vatso matrirjanayata svadhabhih |
bahvinam garbho apasamupasthanmahankavirnishcharati svadhavan ||
verses.en:
Who of you knows this secret One? The Infant by his own nature hath brought forth his Mothers.
The germ of many, from the waters' bosom he goes forth, wise and great, of Godlike nature.

verses.sa:
आविष्ट्यो वर्धते चारुरासु जिह्मानामूर्ध्वः स्वयशा उपस्थे ।
उभे त्वष्टुर्बिभ्यतुर्जायमानात्प्रतीची सिंहं प्रति जोषयेते ॥
verses.rom:
avishtyo vardhate charurasu jihmanamurdhvah svayasha upasthe |
ubhe tvashturbibhyaturjayamanatpratichi simham prati joshayete ||
verses.en:
Visible, fair, he grows in native brightness uplifted in the lap of waving waters.
When he was born both Tvastar's worlds were frightened: they turn to him and reverence the Lion.

verses.sa:
उभे भद्रे जोषयेते न मेने गावो न वाश्रा उप तस्थुरेवैः ।
स दक्षाणां दक्षपतिर्बभूवाञ्जन्ति यं दक्षिणतो हविर्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe bhadre joshayete na mene gavo na vashra upa tasthurevaih |
sa dakshanam dakshapatirbabhuvanjanti yam dakshinato havirbhih ||
verses.en:
The Two auspicious Ones, like women, tend him: like lowing cows they seek him in their manner.
He is the Lord of Might among the mighty; him, on the right, they balm with their oblations.

verses.sa:
उद्यंयमीति सवितेव बाहू उभे सिचौ यतते भीम ऋञ्जन् ।
उच्छुक्रमत्कमजते सिमस्मान्नवा मातृभ्यो वसना जहाति ॥
verses.rom:
udyamyamiti saviteva bahu ubhe sichau yatate bhima rinjan |
uchchhukramatkamajate simasmannava matribhyo vasana jahati ||
verses.en:
Like Savitar his arms with might he stretches; awful, he strives grasping the world's two borders.
He forces out from all a brilliant vesture, yea, from his Mothers draws he forth new raiment.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं रूपं कृणुत उत्तरं यत्सम्पृञ्चानः सदने गोभिरद्भिः ।
कविर्बुध्नं परि मर्मृज्यते धीः सा देवताता समितिर्बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
tvesham rupam krinuta uttaram yatsamprinchanah sadane gobhiradbhih |
kavirbudhnam pari marmrijyate dhih sa devatata samitirbabhuva ||
verses.en:
He makes him a most noble form of splendour, decking him in his home with milk and waters.
The Sage adorns the depths of air with wisdom: this is the meeting where the Gods are worshipped.

verses.sa:
उरु ते ज्रयः पर्येति बुध्नं विरोचमानं महिषस्य धाम ।
विश्वेभिरग्ने स्वयशोभिरिद्धोऽदब्धेभिः पायुभिः पाह्यस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
uru te jrayah paryeti budhnam virochamanam mahishasya dhama |
vishvebhiragne svayashobhiriddho'dabdhebhih payubhih pahyasman ||
verses.en:
Wide through the firmament spreads forth triumphant the far-resplendent strength of thee the Mighty.
Kindled by us do thou preserve us, Agni, with all thy self-bright undiminished succours.

verses.sa:
धन्वन्स्रोतः कृणुते गातुमूर्मिं शुक्रैरूर्मिभिरभि नक्षति क्षाम् ।
विश्वा सनानि जठरेषु धत्तेऽन्तर्नवासु चरति प्रसूषु ॥
verses.rom:
dhanvansrotah krinute gatumurmim shukrairurmibhirabhi nakshati ksham |
vishva sanani jathareshu dhatte'ntarnavasu charati prasushu ||
verses.en:
In dry spots he makes stream, and course, and torrent, and inundates the earth with floods that glisten.
All ancient things within his maw he gathers, and moves among the new fresh-sprouting grasses.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत्पावक श्रवसे वि भाहि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
eva no agne samidha vridhano revatpavaka shravase vi bhahi |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Fed with our fuel, purifying Agni, so blaze to us auspiciously for glory.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
स प्रत्नथा सहसा जायमानः सद्यः काव्यानि बळधत्त विश्वा ।
आपश्च मित्रं धिषणा च साधन्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pratnatha sahasa jayamanah sadyah kavyani baladhatta vishva |
apashcha mitram dhishana cha sadhandeva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
HE in the ancient way by strength engendered, lo! straight hath taken to himself all wisdom.
The waters and the bowl have made him friendly. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
स पूर्वया निविदा कव्यतायोरिमाः प्रजा अजनयन्मनूनाम् ।
विवस्वता चक्षसा द्यामपश्च देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa purvaya nivida kavyatayorimah praja ajanayanmanunam |
vivasvata chakshasa dyamapashcha deva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
At Ayu's ancient call he by his wisdom gave all this progeny of men their being,
And, by refulgent light, heaven and the waters. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
तमीळत प्रथमं यज्ञसाधं विश आरीराहुतमृञ्जसानम् ।
ऊर्जः पुत्रं भरतं सृप्रदानुं देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamilata prathamam yajnasadham visha arirahutamrinjasanam |
urjah putram bharatam sripradanum deva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
Praise him, ye Aryan folk, as chief performer of sacrifice adored and ever toiling,
Well-tended, Son of Strength, the Constant Giver. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
स मातरिश्वा पुरुवारपुष्टिर्विदद्गातुं तनयाय स्वर्वित् ।
विशां गोपा जनिता रोदस्योर्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa matarishva puruvarapushtirvidadgatum tanayaya svarvit |
visham gopa janita rodasyordeva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
That Matarisvan rich in wealth and treasure, light-winner, finds a pathway for his offspring.
Guard of our folk, Father of earth and heaven. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
नक्तोषासा वर्णमामेम्याने धापयेते शिशुमेकं समीची ।
द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मो अन्तर्वि भाति देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
naktoshasa varnamamemyane dhapayete shishumekam samichi |
dyavakshama rukmo antarvi bhati deva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
Night and Dawn, changing each the other's colour, meeting together suckle one same Infant:
Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां यज्ञस्य केतुर्मन्मसाधनो वेः ।
अमृतत्वं रक्षमाणास एनं देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
rayo budhnah samgamano vasunam yajnasya keturmanmasadhano veh |
amritatvam rakshamanasa enam deva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
Root of wealth, gathering-place of treasures, banner of sacrifice, who grants the suppliant's wishes:
Preserving him as their own life immortal, the Gods possessed the wealth-bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
नू च पुरा च सदनं रयीणां जातस्य च जायमानस्य च क्षाम् ।
सतश्च गोपां भवतश्च भूरेर्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
verses.rom:
nu cha pura cha sadanam rayinam jatasya cha jayamanasya cha ksham |
satashcha gopam bhavatashcha bhurerdeva agnim dharayandravinodam ||
verses.en:
Now and of old the home of wealth, the mansion of what is born and what was born aforetime,
Guard of what is and what will be hereafter,--the Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
द्रविणोदा द्रविणसस्तुरस्य द्रविणोदाः सनरस्य प्र यंसत् ।
द्रविणोदा वीरवतीमिषं नो द्रविणोदा रासते दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
dravinoda dravinasasturasya dravinodah sanarasya pra yamsat |
dravinoda viravatimisham no dravinoda rasate dirghamayuh ||
verses.en:
May the Wealth-Giver grant us conquering riches; may the Wealth-Giver grant us wealth with heroes.
May the Wealth-Giver grant us food with offspring, and length of days may the Wealth-Giver send us.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत्पावक श्रवसे वि भाहि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
eva no agne samidha vridhano revatpavaka shravase vi bhahi |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Fed with our fuel, purifying Agni, so blaze to us auspiciously for glory.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुग्ध्या रयिम् ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
apa nah shoshuchadaghamagne shushugdhya rayim |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
Chasing with light our sin away, O Agni, shine thou wealth on us.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
sukshetriya sugatuya vasuya cha yajamahe |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
For goodly fields, for pleasant homes, for wealth we sacrifice to thee.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadbhandishtha esham prasmakasashcha surayah |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
Best praiser of all these be he; foremost, our chiefs who sacrifice.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
प्र यत्ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम् ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yatte agne surayo jayemahi pra te vayam |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
So that thy worshippers and we, thine, Agni, in our sons may live.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
प्र यदग्नेः सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति भानवः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadagneh sahasvato vishvato yanti bhanavah |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
As ever-conquering Agni's beams of splendour go to every side,
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi vishvatomukha vishvatah paribhurasi |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
To every side thy face is turned, thou art triumphant everywhere.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
द्विषो नो विश्वतोमुखाति नावेव पारय ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvisho no vishvatomukhati naveva paraya |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
O thou whose face looks every way, bear us past foes as in a ship.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
स नः सिन्धुमिव नावयाति पर्षा स्वस्तये ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah sindhumiva navayati parsha svastaye |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en:
As in a ship, convey thou us for our advantage o'er the flood.
May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य सुमतौ स्याम राजा हि कं भुवनानामभिश्रीः ।
इतो जातो विश्वमिदं वि चष्टे वैश्वानरो यतते सूर्येण ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarasya sumatau syama raja hi kam bhuvananamabhishrih |
ito jato vishvamidam vi chashte vaishvanaro yatate suryena ||
verses.en:
Still in Vaisvanara's grace may we continue: yea, he is King supreme o'er all things living.
Sprung hence to life upon this All he looketh. Vaisvanara hath rivalry with Surya.

verses.sa:
पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टो अग्निः पृथिव्यां पृष्टो विश्वा ओषधीरा विवेश ।
वैश्वानरः सहसा पृष्टो अग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
prishto divi prishto agnih prithivyam prishto vishva oshadhira vivesha |
vaishvanarah sahasa prishto agnih sa no diva sa rishah patu naktam ||
verses.en:
Present in heaven, in earth, all-present Agni,--all plants that grow on ground hath he pervaded.
May Agni, may Vaisvanara with vigour, present, preserve us day and night from foemen.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानर तव तत्सत्यमस्त्वस्मान्रायो मघवानः सचन्ताम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanara tava tatsatyamastvasmanrayo maghavanah sachantam |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Be this thy truth, Vaisvanara, to us-ward: let wealth in rich abundance gather round us.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो नि दहाति वेदः ।
स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरितात्यग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
jatavedase sunavama somamaratiyato ni dahati vedah |
sa nah parshadati durgani vishva naveva sindhum duritatyagnih ||
verses.en:
FOR Jatavedas let us press the Soma: may he consume the wealth of the malignant.
May Agni carry us through all our troubles, through grief as in a boat across the river.

verses.sa:
स यो वृषा वृष्ण्येभिः समोका महो दिवः पृथिव्याश्च सम्राट् ।
सतीनसत्वा हव्यो भरेषु मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa yo vrisha vrishnyebhih samoka maho divah prithivyashcha samrat |
satinasatva havyo bhareshu marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
MAY he who hath his home with strength, the Mighty, the King supreme of earth and spacious heaven,
Lord of true power, to he invoked in battles,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
यस्यानाप्तः सूर्यस्येव यामो भरेभरे वृत्रहा शुष्मो अस्ति ।
वृषन्तमः सखिभिः स्वेभिरेवैर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
yasyanaptah suryasyeva yamo bharebhare vritraha shushmo asti |
vrishantamah sakhibhih svebhirevairmarutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Whose way is unattainable like Surya's: he in each fight is the strong Vrtra-slayer,
Mightiest with his Friends in his own courses. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
दिवो न यस्य रेतसो दुघानाः पन्थासो यन्ति शवसापरीताः ।
तरद्द्वेषाः सासहिः पौंस्येभिर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
divo na yasya retaso dughanah panthaso yanti shavasaparitah |
taraddveshah sasahih paumsyebhirmarutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Whose paths go forth in their great might resistless, forth milking, as it were, heaven's genial moisture.
With manly strength triumphant, foe-subduer,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
सो अङ्गिरोभिरङ्गिरस्तमो भूद्वृषा वृषभिः सखिभिः सखा सन् ।
ऋग्मिभिरृग्मी गातुभिर्ज्येष्ठो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
so angirobhirangirastamo bhudvrisha vrishabhih sakhibhih sakha san |
rigmibhirrigmi gatubhirjyeshtho marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Among Angirases he was the chiefest, a Friend with friends, mighty amid the mighty.
Praiser mid praisers, honoured most of singers. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स सूनुभिर्न रुद्रेभिरृभ्वा नृषाह्ये सासह्वाँ अमित्रान् ।
सनीळेभिः श्रवस्यानि तूर्वन्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa sunubhirna rudrebhirribhva nrishahye sasahvan amitran |
sanilebhih shravasyani turvanmarutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Strong with the Rudras as with his own children, in manly battle conquering his foemen '
With his close comrades doing deeds of glory,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स मन्युमीः समदनस्य कर्तास्माकेभिर्नृभिः सूर्यं सनत् ।
अस्मिन्नहन्सत्पतिः पुरुहूतो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa manyumih samadanasya kartasmakebhirnribhih suryam sanat |
asminnahansatpatih puruhuto marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Humbler of pride, exciter of the conflict, the Lord of heroes, God invoked of many,
May he this day gain with our men the sunlight. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तमूतयो रणयञ्छूरसातौ तं क्षेमस्य क्षितयः कृण्वत त्राम् ।
स विश्वस्य करुणस्येश एको मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
tamutayo ranayanchhurasatau tam kshemasya kshitayah krinvata tram |
sa vishvasya karunasyesha eko marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
His help hath made him cheerer in the battle, the folk have made him guardian of their comfort.
Sole Lord is he of every holy service. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तमप्सन्त शवस उत्सवेषु नरो नरमवसे तं धनाय ।
सो अन्धे चित्तमसि ज्योतिर्विदन्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
tamapsanta shavasa utsaveshu naro naramavase tam dhanaya |
so andhe chittamasi jyotirvidanmarutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
To him the Hero, on high days of prowess, heroes for help and booty shall betake them.
He hath found light even in the blinding darkness. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स सव्येन यमति व्राधतश्चित्स दक्षिणे संगृभीता कृतानि ।
स कीरिणा चित्सनिता धनानि मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa savyena yamati vradhatashchitsa dakshine samgribhita kritani |
sa kirina chitsanita dhanani marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
He with his left hand checketh even the mighty, and with his right hand gathereth up the booty.
Even with the humble he acquireth riches. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स ग्रामेभिः सनिता स रथेभिर्विदे विश्वाभिः कृष्टिभिर्न्वद्य ।
स पौंस्येभिरभिभूरशस्तीर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa gramebhih sanita sa rathebhirvide vishvabhih krishtibhirnvadya |
sa paumsyebhirabhibhurashastirmarutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
With hosts on foot and cars he winneth treasures: well is he known this day by all the people.
With manly might he conquereth those who hate him. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स जामिभिर्यत्समजाति मीळ्हेऽजामिभिर्वा पुरुहूत एवैः ।
अपां तोकस्य तनयस्य जेषे मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa jamibhiryatsamajati milhe'jamibhirva puruhuta evaih |
apam tokasya tanayasya jeshe marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
When in his ways with kinsmen or with strangers he speedeth to the fight, invoked of many,
For gain of waters, and of sons and grandsons, may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स वज्रभृद्दस्युहा भीम उग्रः सहस्रचेताः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।
चम्रीषो न शवसा पाञ्चजन्यो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
sa vajrabhriddasyuha bhima ugrah sahasrachetah shatanitha ribhva |
chamrisho na shavasa panchajanyo marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Awful and fierce, fiend-slayer, thunder-wielder, with boundless knowledge, hymned by hundreds, mighty,
In strength like Soma, guard of the Five Peoples, may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तस्य वज्रः क्रन्दति स्मत्स्वर्षा दिवो न त्वेषो रवथः शिमीवान् ।
तं सचन्ते सनयस्तं धनानि मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vajrah krandati smatsvarsha divo na tvesho ravathah shimivan |
tam sachante sanayastam dhanani marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Winning the light, hitherward roars his thunder like the terrific mighty voice of Heaven.
Rich gifts and treasures evermore attend him. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
यस्याजस्रं शवसा मानमुक्थं परिभुजद्रोदसी विश्वतः सीम् ।
स पारिषत्क्रतुभिर्मन्दसानो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
yasyajasram shavasa manamuktham paribhujadrodasi vishvatah sim |
sa parishatkratubhirmandasano marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
Whose home eternal through his strength surrounds him on every side, his laud, the earth and heaven,
May he, delighted with our service, save us. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
न यस्य देवा देवता न मर्ता आपश्चन शवसो अन्तमापुः ।
स प्ररिक्वा त्वक्षसा क्ष्मो दिवश्च मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya deva devata na marta apashchana shavaso antamapuh |
sa prarikva tvakshasa kshmo divashcha marutvanno bhavatvindra uti ||
verses.en:
The limit of whose power not Gods by Godhead, nor mortal men have reached, nor yet the Waters.
Both Earth and Heaven in vigour he surpasseth. May Indra, girt by Maruts, he our succour.

verses.sa:
रोहिच्छ्यावा सुमदंशुर्ललामीर्द्युक्षा राय ऋज्राश्वस्य ।
वृषण्वन्तं बिभ्रती धूर्षु रथं मन्द्रा चिकेत नाहुषीषु विक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
rohichchhyava sumadamshurlalamirdyuksha raya rijrashvasya |
vrishanvantam bibhrati dhurshu ratham mandra chiketa nahushishu vikshu ||
verses.en:
The red and tawny mare, blaze-marked, high standing, celestial who, to bring Rjrasva riches,
Drew at the pole the chariot yoked with stallions, joyous, among the hosts of men was noted.

verses.sa:
एतत्त्यत्त इन्द्र वृष्ण उक्थं वार्षागिरा अभि गृणन्ति राधः ।
ऋज्राश्वः प्रष्टिभिरम्बरीषः सहदेवो भयमानः सुराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
etattyatta indra vrishna uktham varshagira abhi grinanti radhah |
rijrashvah prashtibhirambarishah sahadevo bhayamanah suradhah ||
verses.en:
The Varsagiras unto thee, O Indra, the Mighty One, sing forth this laud to please thee,
Rjrasva with his fellows, Ambarisa, Suradhas, Sahadeva, Bhayamana.

verses.sa:
दस्यूञ्छिम्यूँश्च पुरुहूत एवैर्हत्वा पृथिव्यां शर्वा नि बर्हीत् ।
सनत्क्षेत्रं सखिभिः श्वित्न्येभिः सनत्सूर्यं सनदपः सुवज्रः ॥
verses.rom:
dasyunchhimyunshcha puruhuta evairhatva prithivyam sharva ni barhit |
sanatkshetram sakhibhih shvitnyebhih sanatsuryam sanadapah suvajrah ||
verses.en:
He, much invoked, hath slain Dasyus and Simyus, after his wont, and laid them low with arrows.
The mighty Thunderer with his fair-complexioned friends won the land, the sunlight, and the waters.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvahendro adhivakta no astvaparihvritah sanuyama vajam |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
May Indra evermore be our protector, and unimperilled may we win the booty.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना ।
अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
pra mandine pitumadarchata vacho yah krishnagarbha nirahannrijishvana |
avasyavo vrishanam vajradakshinam marutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
SING, with oblation, praise to him who maketh glad, who with Rjisvan drove the dusky brood away.
Fain for help, him the strong whose right hand wields the bolt, him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो व्यंसं जाहृषाणेन मन्युना यः शम्बरं यो अहन्पिप्रुमव्रतम् ।
इन्द्रो यः शुष्णमशुषं न्यावृणङ्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo vyamsam jahrishanena manyuna yah shambaram yo ahanpiprumavratam |
indro yah shushnamashusham nyavrinanmarutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
Indra, who with triumphant wrath smote Vyamsa down, and Sambara, and Pipru the unrighteous one;
Who extirpated Susna the insatiate,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यस्य द्यावापृथिवी पौंस्यं महद्यस्य व्रते वरुणो यस्य सूर्यः ।
यस्येन्द्रस्य सिन्धवः सश्चति व्रतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya dyavaprithivi paumsyam mahadyasya vrate varuno yasya suryah |
yasyendrasya sindhavah sashchati vratam marutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
He whose great work of manly might is heaven and earth, and Varuna and Surya keep his holy law;
Indra, whose law the rivers follow as they flow,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वानां यो गवां गोपतिर्वशी य आरितः कर्मणिकर्मणि स्थिरः ।
वीळोश्चिदिन्द्रो यो असुन्वतो वधो मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo ashvanam yo gavam gopatirvashi ya aritah karmanikarmani sthirah |
viloshchidindro yo asunvato vadho marutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
He who is Lord and Master of the steeds and kine, honoured--the firm and sure--at every holy act;
Stayer even of the strong who pours no offering out,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वस्य जगतः प्राणतस्पतिर्यो ब्रह्मणे प्रथमो गा अविन्दत् ।
