इन्द्रो यो दस्यूँरधराँ अवातिरन्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvasya jagatah pranataspatiryo brahmane prathamo ga avindat |
indro yo dasyunradharan avatiranmarutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
He who is Lord of all the world that moves and breathes, who for the Brahman first before all found the Cows;
Indra who cast the Dasyus down beneath his feet,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यः शूरेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भीरुभिर्यो धावद्भिर्हूयते यश्च जिग्युभिः ।
इन्द्रं यं विश्वा भुवनाभि संदधुर्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yah shurebhirhavyo yashcha bhirubhiryo dhavadbhirhuyate yashcha jigyubhih |
indram yam vishva bhuvanabhi samdadhurmarutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
Whom cowards must invoke and valiant men of war, invoked by those who conquer and by those who flee;
Indra, to whom all beings turn their constant thought,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
रुद्राणामेति प्रदिशा विचक्षणो रुद्रेभिर्योषा तनुते पृथु ज्रयः ।
इन्द्रं मनीषा अभ्यर्चति श्रुतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
rudranameti pradisha vichakshano rudrebhiryosha tanute prithu jrayah |
indram manisha abhyarchati shrutam marutvantam sakhyaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
Refulgent in the Rudras' region he proceeds, and with the Rudras through the wide space speeds the Dame.
The hymn of praise extols Indra the far-renowned: him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यद्वा मरुत्वः परमे सधस्थे यद्वावमे वृजने मादयासे ।
अत आ याह्यध्वरं नो अच्छा त्वाया हविश्चकृमा सत्यराधः ॥
verses.rom:
yadva marutvah parame sadhasthe yadvavame vrijane madayase |
ata a yahyadhvaram no achchha tvaya havishchakrima satyaradhah ||
verses.en:
O girt by Maruts, whether thou delight thee in loftiest gathering-place or lowly dwelling,
Come thence unto our rite, true boon-best-ower: through love of thee have we prepared oblations.

verses.sa:
त्वायेन्द्र सोमं सुषुमा सुदक्ष त्वाया हविश्चकृमा ब्रह्मवाहः ।
अधा नियुत्वः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिषि मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
tvayendra somam sushuma sudaksha tvaya havishchakrima brahmavahah |
adha niyutvah sagano marudbhirasminyajne barhishi madayasva ||
verses.en:
We, fain for thee, strong Indra, have pressed Soma, and, O thou sought with prayer, have made oblations.
Now at this sacrifice, with all thy Maruts, on sacred grass, O team-borne God, rejoice thee.

verses.sa:
मादयस्व हरिभिर्ये त इन्द्र वि ष्यस्व शिप्रे वि सृजस्व धेने ।
आ त्वा सुशिप्र हरयो वहन्तूशन्हव्यानि प्रति नो जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
madayasva haribhirye ta indra vi shyasva shipre vi srijasva dhene |
a tva sushipra harayo vahantushanhavyani prati no jushasva ||
verses.en:
Rejoice thee with thine own Bay Steeds, O Indra, unclose thy jaws and let thy lips be open.
Thou with the fair cheek, let thy Bay Steeds bring thee: gracious to us, he pleased with our oblation.

verses.sa:
मरुत्स्तोत्रस्य वृजनस्य गोपा वयमिन्द्रेण सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
marutstotrasya vrijanasya gopa vayamindrena sanuyama vajam |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Guards of the camp whose praisers are the Maruts, may we through Indra, get ourselves the booty.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इमां ते धियं प्र भरे महो महीमस्य स्तोत्रे धिषणा यत्त आनजे ।
तमुत्सवे च प्रसवे च सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शवसामदन्ननु ॥
verses.rom:
imam te dhiyam pra bhare maho mahimasya stotre dhishana yatta anaje |
tamutsave cha prasave cha sasahimindram devasah shavasamadannanu ||
verses.en:
To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud.
In Indra, yea in him victorious through his strength, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रवो नद्यः सप्त बिभ्रति द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी दर्शतं वपुः ।
अस्मे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभिचक्षे श्रद्धे कमिन्द्र चरतो वितर्तुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya shravo nadyah sapta bibhrati dyavakshama prithivi darshatam vapuh |
asme suryachandramasabhichakshe shraddhe kamindra charato vitarturam ||
verses.en:
The Seven Rivers bear his glory far and wide, and heaven and sky and earth display his comely form.
The Sun and Moon in change alternate run their course, that we, O Indra, may behold and may have faith.

verses.sa:
तं स्मा रथं मघवन्प्राव सातये जैत्रं यं ते अनुमदाम संगमे ।
आजा न इन्द्र मनसा पुरुष्टुत त्वायद्भ्यो मघवञ्छर्म यच्छ नः ॥
verses.rom:
tam sma ratham maghavanprava sataye jaitram yam te anumadama samgame |
aja na indra manasa purushtuta tvayadbhyo maghavanchharma yachchha nah ||
verses.en:
Maghavan, grant us that same car to bring us spoil, thy conquering car in which we joy in shock of fight.
Thou, Indra, whom our hearts praise highly in the war, grant shelter, Maghavan, to us who love thee well.

verses.sa:
वयं जयेम त्वया युजा वृतमस्माकमंशमुदवा भरेभरे ।
अस्मभ्यमिन्द्र वरिवः सुगं कृधि प्र शत्रूणां मघवन्वृष्ण्या रुज ॥
verses.rom:
vayam jayema tvaya yuja vritamasmakamamshamudava bharebhare |
asmabhyamindra varivah sugam kridhi pra shatrunam maghavanvrishnya ruja ||
verses.en:
Encourage thou our side in every fight: may we, with thee for our ally, conquer the foeman's host.
Indra, bestow on us joy and felicity break down, O Maghavan, the vigour of our foes.

verses.sa:
नाना हि त्वा हवमाना जना इमे धनानां धर्तरवसा विपन्यवः ।
अस्माकं स्मा रथमा तिष्ठ सातये जैत्रं हीन्द्र निभृतं मनस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
nana hi tva havamana jana ime dhananam dhartaravasa vipanyavah |
asmakam sma rathama tishtha sataye jaitram hindra nibhritam manastava ||
verses.en:
For here in divers ways these men invoking thee, holder of treasures, sing hymns to win thine aid.
Ascend the car that thou mayest bring spoil to us, for, Indra, thy fixt winneth the victory.

verses.sa:
गोजिता बाहू अमितक्रतुः सिमः कर्मन्कर्मञ्छतमूतिः खजंकरः ।
अकल्प इन्द्रः प्रतिमानमोजसाथा जना वि ह्वयन्ते सिषासवः ॥
verses.rom:
gojita bahu amitakratuh simah karmankarmanchhatamutih khajamkarah |
akalpa indrah pratimanamojasatha jana vi hvayante sishasavah ||
verses.en:
His arms win kine, his power is boundless in each act best, with a hundred helps waker of battle's din
Is Indra: none may rival him in mighty strength. Hence, eager for the spoil the people call on him.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शतान्मघवन्नुच्च भूयस उत्सहस्राद्रिरिचे कृष्टिषु श्रवः ।
अमात्रं त्वा धिषणा तित्विषे मह्यधा वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे पुरंदर ॥
verses.rom:
utte shatanmaghavannuchcha bhuyasa utsahasradririche krishtishu shravah |
amatram tva dhishana titvishe mahyadha vritrani jighnase puramdara ||
verses.en:
Thy glory, Maghavan, exceeds a hundred yea, more than a hundred, than a thousand mid the folk,
The great bowl hath inspirited thee boundlessly: so mayst thou slay the Vrtras breaker-down of forts!

verses.sa:
त्रिविष्टिधातु प्रतिमानमोजसस्तिस्रो भूमीर्नृपते त्रीणि रोचना ।
अतीदं विश्वं भुवनं ववक्षिथाशत्रुरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि ॥
verses.rom:
trivishtidhatu pratimanamojasastisro bhumirnripate trini rochana |
atidam vishvam bhuvanam vavakshithashatrurindra janusha sanadasi ||
verses.en:
Of thy great might there is a three counterpart, the three earths, Lord men and the three realms of light.
Above this whole world, Indra, thou hast waxen great: without a foe art thou, nature, from of old.

verses.sa:
त्वां देवेषु प्रथमं हवामहे त्वं बभूथ पृतनासु सासहिः ।
सेमं नः कारुमुपमन्युमुद्भिदमिन्द्रः कृणोतु प्रसवे रथं पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam deveshu prathamam havamahe tvam babhutha pritanasu sasahih |
semam nah karumupamanyumudbhidamindrah krinotu prasave ratham purah ||
verses.en:
We invocate thee first among the Deities: thou hast become a mighty Conquer in fight.
May Indra fill with spirit this our singer's heart, and make our car impetuous, foremost in attack.

verses.sa:
त्वं जिगेथ न धना रुरोधिथार्भेष्वाजा मघवन्महत्सु च ।
त्वामुग्रमवसे सं शिशीमस्यथा न इन्द्र हवनेषु चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam jigetha na dhana rurodhitharbheshvaja maghavanmahatsu cha |
tvamugramavase sam shishimasyatha na indra havaneshu chodaya ||
verses.en:
Thou hast prevailed, and hast not kept the booty back, in trifling battles in those of great account.
We make thee keen, the Mighty One, succour us: inspire us, Maghavan, when we defy the foe.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvahendro adhivakta no astvaparihvritah sanuyama vajam |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
May Indra evermore be our Protector, and unimperilled may we win the booty.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
तत्त इन्द्रियं परमं पराचैरधारयन्त कवयः पुरेदम् ।
क्षमेदमन्यद्दिव्यन्यदस्य समी पृच्यते समनेव केतुः ॥
verses.rom:
tatta indriyam paramam parachairadharayanta kavayah puredam |
kshamedamanyaddivyanyadasya sami prichyate samaneva ketuh ||
verses.en:
THAT highest Indra-power of thine is distant: that which is here sages possessed aforetime.
This one is on the earth, in heaven the other, and both unite as flag with flag in battle.

verses.sa:
स धारयत्पृथिवीं पप्रथच्च वज्रेण हत्वा निरपः ससर्ज ।
अहन्नहिमभिनद्रौहिणं व्यहन्व्यंसं मघवा शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa dharayatprithivim paprathachcha vajrena hatva nirapah sasarja |
ahannahimabhinadrauhinam vyahanvyamsam maghava shachibhih ||
verses.en:
He spread the wide earth out and firmly fixed it, smote with his thunderbolt and loosed the waters.
Maghavan with his puissance struck down Ahi, rent Rauhina to death and slaughtered Vyamsa.

verses.sa:
स जातूभर्मा श्रद्दधान ओजः पुरो विभिन्दन्नचरद्वि दासीः ।
विद्वान्वज्रिन्दस्यवे हेतिमस्यार्यं सहो वर्धया द्युम्नमिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
sa jatubharma shraddadhana ojah puro vibhindannacharadvi dasih |
vidvanvajrindasyave hetimasyaryam saho vardhaya dyumnamindra ||
verses.en:
Armed with his bolt and trusting in his prowess he wandered shattering the forts of Dasas.
Cast thy dart, knowing, Thunderer, at the Dasyu; increase the Arya's might and glory, Indra.

verses.sa:
तदूचुषे मानुषेमा युगानि कीर्तेन्यं मघवा नाम बिभ्रत् ।
उपप्रयन्दस्युहत्याय वज्री यद्ध सूनुः श्रवसे नाम दधे ॥
verses.rom:
taduchushe manushema yugani kirtenyam maghava nama bibhrat |
upaprayandasyuhatyaya vajri yaddha sunuh shravase nama dadhe ||
verses.en:
For him who thus hath taught these human races, Maghavan, bearing a fame-worthy title,
Thunderer, drawing nigh to slay the Dasyus, hath given himself the name of Son for glory.

verses.sa:
तदस्येदं पश्यता भूरि पुष्टं श्रदिन्द्रस्य धत्तन वीर्याय ।
स गा अविन्दत्सो अविन्ददश्वान्स ओषधीः सो अपः स वनानि ॥
verses.rom:
tadasyedam pashyata bhuri pushtam shradindrasya dhattana viryaya |
sa ga avindatso avindadashvansa oshadhih so apah sa vanani ||
verses.en:
See this abundant wealth that he possesses, and put your trust in Indra's hero vigour.
He found the cattle, and he found the horses, he found the plants, the forests and the waters.

verses.sa:
भूरिकर्मणे वृषभाय वृष्णे सत्यशुष्माय सुनवाम सोमम् ।
य आदृत्या परिपन्थीव शूरोऽयज्वनो विभजन्नेति वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
bhurikarmane vrishabhaya vrishne satyashushmaya sunavama somam |
ya adritya paripanthiva shuro'yajvano vibhajanneti vedah ||
verses.en:
To him the truly strong, whose deeds are many, to him the strong Bull let us pour the Soma.
The Hero, watching like a thief in ambush, goes parting the possessions of the godless.

verses.sa:
तदिन्द्र प्रेव वीर्यं चकर्थ यत्ससन्तं वज्रेणाबोधयोऽहिम् ।
अनु त्वा पत्नीर्हृषितं वयश्च विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
tadindra preva viryam chakartha yatsasantam vajrenabodhayo'him |
anu tva patnirhrishitam vayashcha vishve devaso amadannanu tva ||
verses.en:
Well didst thou do that hero deed, O Indra, in waking with thy bolt the slumbering Ahi.
in thee, delighted, Dames divine rejoiced them, the flying Maruts and all Gods were joyful.

verses.sa:
शुष्णं पिप्रुं कुयवं वृत्रमिन्द्र यदावधीर्वि पुरः शम्बरस्य ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
shushnam piprum kuyavam vritramindra yadavadhirvi purah shambarasya |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
As thou hast smitten Susna, Pipru, Vrtra and Kuyava, and Sambara's forts O Indra.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
योनिष्ट इन्द्र निषदे अकारि तमा नि षीद स्वानो नार्वा ।
विमुच्या वयोऽवसायाश्वान्दोषा वस्तोर्वहीयसः प्रपित्वे ॥
verses.rom:
yonishta indra nishade akari tama ni shida svano narva |
vimuchya vayo'vasayashvandosha vastorvahiyasah prapitve ||
verses.en:
THE altar hath been made for thee to rest on: come like a panting courser and be seated.
Loosen thy flying Steeds, set free thy Horses who bear thee swiftly nigh at eve and morning.

verses.sa:
ओ त्ये नर इन्द्रमूतये गुर्नू चित्तान्सद्यो अध्वनो जगम्यात् ।
देवासो मन्युं दासस्य श्चम्नन्ते न आ वक्षन्सुविताय वर्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
o tye nara indramutaye gurnu chittansadyo adhvano jagamyat |
devaso manyum dasasya shchamnante na a vakshansuvitaya varnam ||
verses.en:
These men have come to Indra for assistance: shall he not quickly come upon these pathways?
May the Gods quell the fury of the Dasa, and may they lead our folk to happy fortune.

verses.sa:
अव त्मना भरते केतवेदा अव त्मना भरते फेनमुदन् ।
क्षीरेण स्नातः कुयवस्य योषे हते ते स्यातां प्रवणे शिफायाः ॥
verses.rom:
ava tmana bharate ketaveda ava tmana bharate phenamudan |
kshirena snatah kuyavasya yoshe hate te syatam pravane shiphayah ||
verses.en:
He who hath only wish as his possession casts on himself, casts foam amid the waters.
Both wives of Kuyava in milk have bathed them: may they be drowned within the depth of Sipha.

verses.sa:
युयोप नाभिरुपरस्यायोः प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते राष्टि शूरः ।
अञ्जसी कुलिशी वीरपत्नी पयो हिन्वाना उदभिर्भरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
yuyopa nabhiruparasyayoh pra purvabhistirate rashti shurah |
anjasi kulishi virapatni payo hinvana udabhirbharante ||
verses.en:
This hath his kinship checked who lives beside us: with ancient streams forth speeds and rules the Hero,
Añjasi, Kulisi, and Virapatni, delighting him, bear milk upon their waters.

verses.sa:
प्रति यत्स्या नीथादर्शि दस्योरोको नाच्छा सदनं जानती गात् ।
अध स्मा नो मघवञ्चर्कृतादिन्मा नो मघेव निष्षपी परा दाः ॥
verses.rom:
prati yatsya nithadarshi dasyoroko nachchha sadanam janati gat |
adha sma no maghavancharkritadinma no magheva nishshapi para dah ||
verses.en:
Soon as this Dasyu's traces were discovered, as she who knows her home, he sought the dwelling.
Now think thou of us, Maghavan, nor cast us away as doth a profligate his treasure.

verses.sa:
स त्वं न इन्द्र सूर्ये सो अप्स्वनागास्त्व आ भज जीवशंसे ।
मान्तरां भुजमा रीरिषो नः श्रद्धितं ते महत इन्द्रियाय ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam na indra surye so apsvanagastva a bhaja jivashamse |
mantaram bhujama ririsho nah shraddhitam te mahata indriyaya ||
verses.en:
Indra, as such, give us a share of sunlight, of waters, sinlessness, and reputation.
Do thou no harm to our yet unborn offspring: our trust is in thy mighty Indra-power.

verses.sa:
अधा मन्ये श्रत्ते अस्मा अधायि वृषा चोदस्व महते धनाय ।
मा नो अकृते पुरुहूत योनाविन्द्र क्षुध्यद्भ्यो वय आसुतिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
adha manye shratte asma adhayi vrisha chodasva mahate dhanaya |
ma no akrite puruhuta yonavindra kshudhyadbhyo vaya asutim dah ||
verses.en:
Now we, I think, in thee as such have trusted: lead us on, Mighty One, to ample riches.
In no unready house give us, O Indra invoked of many, food and drink when hungry.

verses.sa:
मा नो वधीरिन्द्र मा परा दा मा नः प्रिया भोजनानि प्र मोषीः ।
आण्डा मा नो मघवञ्छक्र निर्भेन्मा नः पात्रा भेत्सहजानुषाणि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no vadhirindra ma para da ma nah priya bhojanani pra moshih |
anda ma no maghavanchhakra nirbhenma nah patra bhetsahajanushani ||
verses.en:
Slay us not, Indra; do not thou forsake us: steal not away the joys which we delight in.
Rend not our unborn brood, strong Lord of Bounty! our vessels with the life that is within them.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङेहि सोमकामं त्वाहुरयं सुतस्तस्य पिबा मदाय ।
उरुव्यचा जठर आ वृषस्व पितेव नः शृणुहि हूयमानः ॥
verses.rom:
arvanehi somakamam tvahurayam sutastasya piba madaya |
uruvyacha jathara a vrishasva piteva nah shrinuhi huyamanah ||
verses.en:
Come to us; they have called thee Soma-lover: here is the pressed juice. Drink thereof for rapture.
Widely-capacious, pour it down within thee, and, invocated, hear us like a Father.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा अप्स्वन्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि ।
न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama apsvantara suparno dhavate divi |
na vo hiranyanemayah padam vindanti vidyuto vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
WITHIN the waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings in heaven.
Ye lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अर्थमिद्वा उ अर्थिन आ जाया युवते पतिम् ।
तुञ्जाते वृष्ण्यं पयः परिदाय रसं दुहे वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
arthamidva u arthina a jaya yuvate patim |
tunjate vrishnyam payah paridaya rasam duhe vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Surely men crave and gain their wish. Close to her husband clings the wife.
And, in embraces intertwined, both give and take the bliss of love. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
मो षु देवा अदः स्वरव पादि दिवस्परि ।
मा सोम्यस्य शम्भुवः शूने भूम कदा चन वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu deva adah svarava padi divaspari |
ma somyasya shambhuvah shune bhuma kada chana vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
O never may that light, ye Gods, fall from its station in the sky.
Ne'er fail us one like Soma sweet, the spring of our felicity. Mark this my woe ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्ञं पृच्छाम्यवमं स तद्दूतो वि वोचति ।
क्व ऋतं पूर्व्यं गतं कस्तद्बिभर्ति नूतनो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
yajnam prichchhamyavamam sa tadduto vi vochati |
kva ritam purvyam gatam kastadbibharti nutano vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
I ask the last of sacrifice. As envoy he shall tell it forth.
Where is the ancient law divine? Who is its new diffuser now? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये देवा स्थन त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ।
कद्व ऋतं कदनृतं क्व प्रत्ना व आहुतिर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ami ye deva sthana trishva rochane divah |
kadva ritam kadanritam kva pratna va ahutirvittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Ye Gods who yonder have your home in the three lucid realms of heaven,
What count ye truth and what untruth? Where is mine ancient call on you? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
कद्व ऋतस्य धर्णसि कद्वरुणस्य चक्षणम् ।
कदर्यम्णो महस्पथाति क्रामेम दूढ्यो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
kadva ritasya dharnasi kadvarunasya chakshanam |
kadaryamno mahaspathati kramema dudhyo vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
What is your firm support of Law? What Varuna's observant eye?
How may we pass the wicked on the path of mighty Aryaman? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अहं सो अस्मि यः पुरा सुते वदामि कानि चित् ।
तं मा व्यन्त्याध्यो वृको न तृष्णजं मृगं वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
aham so asmi yah pura sute vadami kani chit |
tam ma vyantyadhyo vriko na trishnajam mrigam vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
I am the man who sang of old full many a laud when Soma flowed.
Yet torturing cares consume me as the wolf assails the thirsty deer. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः ।
मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्य स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
sam ma tapantyabhitah sapatniriva parshavah |
musho na shishna vyadanti madhya stotaram te shatakrato vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Like rival wives on every side enclosing ribs oppress me sore.
O Satakratu, biting cares devour me, singer of thy praise, as rats devour the weaver's threads. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये सप्त रश्मयस्तत्रा मे नाभिरातता ।
त्रितस्तद्वेदाप्त्यः स जामित्वाय रेभति वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ami ye sapta rashmayastatra me nabhiratata |
tritastadvedaptyah sa jamitvaya rebhati vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Where those seven rays are shining, thence my home and family extend.
This Trta Aptya knoweth well, and speaketh out for brotherhood. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये पञ्चोक्षणो मध्ये तस्थुर्महो दिवः ।
देवत्रा नु प्रवाच्यं सध्रीचीना नि वावृतुर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ami ye panchokshano madhye tasthurmaho divah |
devatra nu pravachyam sadhrichina ni vavriturvittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
May those five Bulls which stand on high full in the midst of mighty heaven,
Having together swiftly borne my praises to the Gods, return. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा एत आसते मध्य आरोधने दिवः ।
ते सेधन्ति पथो वृकं तरन्तं यह्वतीरपो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
suparna eta asate madhya arodhane divah |
te sedhanti patho vrikam tarantam yahvatirapo vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
High in the mid ascent of heaven those Birds of beauteous pinion sit.
Back from his path they drive the wolf as he would cross the restless floods. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
नव्यं तदुक्थ्यं हितं देवासः सुप्रवाचनम् ।
ऋतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः सत्यं तातान सूर्यो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
navyam tadukthyam hitam devasah supravachanam |
ritamarshanti sindhavah satyam tatana suryo vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Firm is this new-wrought hymn of praise, and meet to be told forth, O Gods.
The flowing of the floods is Law, Truth is the Sun's extended light. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव त्यदुक्थ्यं देवेष्वस्त्याप्यम् ।
स नः सत्तो मनुष्वदा देवान्यक्षि विदुष्टरो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
agne tava tyadukthyam deveshvastyapyam |
sa nah satto manushvada devanyakshi vidushtaro vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Worthy of laud, O Agni, is that kinship which thou hast with Gods.
Here seat thee like a man: most wise, bring thou the Gods for sacrifice. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सत्तो होता मनुष्वदा देवाँ अच्छा विदुष्टरः ।
अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
satto hota manushvada devan achchha vidushtarah |
agnirhavya sushudati devo deveshu medhiro vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Here seated, man-like as a priest shall wisest Agni to the Gods
Speed onward our oblations, God among the Gods, intelligent. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा कृणोति वरुणो गातुविदं तमीमहे ।
व्यूर्णोति हृदा मतिं नव्यो जायतामृतं वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
brahma krinoti varuno gatuvidam tamimahe |
vyurnoti hrida matim navyo jayatamritam vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Varuna makes the holy prayer. To him who finds the path we pray.
He in the heart reveals his thought. Let sacred worship rise anew. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
असौ यः पन्था आदित्यो दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतः ।
न स देवा अतिक्रमे तं मर्तासो न पश्यथ वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
asau yah pantha adityo divi pravachyam kritah |
na sa deva atikrame tam martaso na pashyatha vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
That pathway of the Sun in heaven, made to be highly glorified,
Is not to be transgressed, O Gods. O mortals, ye behold it not. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
त्रितः कूपेऽवहितो देवान्हवत ऊतये ।
तच्छुश्राव बृहस्पतिः कृण्वन्नंहूरणादुरु वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
tritah kupe'vahito devanhavata utaye |
tachchhushrava brihaspatih krinvannamhuranaduru vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
Trita, when buried in the well, calls on the Gods to succour him.
That call of his Brhaspati heard and released him from distress. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अरुणो मा सकृद्वृकः पथा यन्तं ददर्श हि ।
उज्जिहीते निचाय्या तष्टेव पृष्ट्यामयी वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
aruno ma sakridvrikah patha yantam dadarsha hi |
ujjihite nichayya tashteva prishtyamayi vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en:
A ruddy wolf beheld me once, as I was faring on my path.
He, like a carpenter whose back is aching crouched and slunk away. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
एनाङ्गूषेण वयमिन्द्रवन्तोऽभि ष्याम वृजने सर्ववीराः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
enangushena vayamindravanto'bhi shyama vrijane sarvavirah |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Through this our song may we, allied with Indra, with all our heroes conquer in the battle.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमूतये मारुतं शर्धो अदितिं हवामहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
indram mitram varunamagnimutaye marutam shardho aditim havamahe |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
CALL we for aid on Indra, Mitra, Varuna and Agni and the Marut host and Aditi.
Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये भूत देवा वृत्रतूर्येषु शम्भुवः ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
ta aditya a gata sarvatataye bhuta deva vritraturyeshu shambhuvah |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
Come ye Adityas for our full prosperity, in conquests of the foe, ye Gods, bring joy to us.
Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
अवन्तु नः पितरः सुप्रवाचना उत देवी देवपुत्रे ऋतावृधा ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
avantu nah pitarah supravachana uta devi devaputre ritavridha |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
May the most glorious Fathers aid us, and the two Goddesses, Mothers of the Gods, who strengthen Law.
Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
नराशंसं वाजिनं वाजयन्निह क्षयद्वीरं पूषणं सुम्नैरीमहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsam vajinam vajayanniha kshayadviram pushanam sumnairimahe |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
To mighty Narasamsa, strengthening his might, to Pusan, ruler over men, we pray with hymns.
Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते सदमिन्नः सुगं कृधि शं योर्यत्ते मनुर्हितं तदीमहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate sadaminnah sugam kridhi sham yoryatte manurhitam tadimahe |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati, make us evermore an easy path: we crave what boon thou hast for men in rest and stir.
Like as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं कुत्सो वृत्रहणं शचीपतिं काटे निबाळ्ह ऋषिरह्वदूतये ।
रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
indram kutso vritrahanam shachipatim kate nibalha rishirahvadutaye |
ratham na durgadvasavah sudanavo vishvasmanno amhaso nishpipartana ||
verses.en:
Sunk in the pit the Rsi Kutsa called, to aid, Indra the Vrtra-slayer, Lord of power and might.
Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
devairno devyaditirni patu devastrata trayatamaprayuchchhan |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
May Aditi the Goddess guard us with the Gods: may the protecting God keep us with ceaseless care.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृळयन्तः ।
आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादंहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासत् ॥
verses.rom:
yajno devanam pratyeti sumnamadityaso bhavata mrilayantah |
a vo'rvachi sumatirvavrityadamhoshchidya varivovittarasat ||
verses.en:
THE sacrifice obtains the Gods' acceptance: be graciously inclined to us, Adityas.
Hitherward let your favour be directed, and be our best deliverer from trouble.

verses.sa:
उप नो देवा अवसा गमन्त्वङ्गिरसां सामभि स्तूयमानाः ।
इन्द्र इन्द्रियैर्मरुतो मरुद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
upa no deva avasa gamantvangirasam samabhi stuyamanah |
indra indriyairmaruto marudbhiradityairno aditih sharma yamsat ||
verses.en:
By praise-songs of Angirases exalted, may the Gods come to us with their protection.
May Indra with his powers, Maruts with Maruts, Aditi with Adityas grant us shelter.

verses.sa:
तन्न इन्द्रस्तद्वरुणस्तदग्निस्तदर्यमा तत्सविता चनो धात् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
tanna indrastadvarunastadagnistadaryama tatsavita chano dhat |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
This laud of ours may Varuna and Indra, Aryaman Agni, Savitar find pleasant.
This prayer' of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्राग्नी चित्रतमो रथो वामभि विश्वानि भुवनानि चष्टे ।
तेना यातं सरथं तस्थिवांसाथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
ya indragni chitratamo ratho vamabhi vishvani bhuvanani chashte |
tena yatam saratham tasthivamsatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
ON that most wondrous car of yours, O Indra and Agni, which looks round on all things living,
Take ye your stand and come to us together, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यावदिदं भुवनं विश्वमस्त्युरुव्यचा वरिमता गभीरम् ।
तावाँ अयं पातवे सोमो अस्त्वरमिन्द्राग्नी मनसे युवभ्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavadidam bhuvanam vishvamastyuruvyacha varimata gabhiram |
tavan ayam patave somo astvaramindragni manase yuvabhyam ||
verses.en:
As vast as all this world is in its compass, deep as it is, with its far-stretching surface,
So let this Soma be, Indra and Agni, made for your drinking till your soul be sated.

verses.sa:
चक्राथे हि सध्र्यङ्नाम भद्रं सध्रीचीना वृत्रहणा उत स्थः ।
ताविन्द्राग्नी सध्र्यञ्चा निषद्या वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakrathe hi sadhryannama bhadram sadhrichina vritrahana uta sthah |
tavindragni sadhryancha nishadya vrishnah somasya vrishana vrishetham ||
verses.en:
For ye have won a blessed name together: yea, with one aim ye strove, O Vrtra-slayers.
So Indra-Agni, seated here together, pour in, ye Mighty Ones, the mighty Soma.

verses.sa:
समिद्धेष्वग्निष्वानजाना यतस्रुचा बर्हिरु तिस्तिराणा ।
तीव्रैः सोमैः परिषिक्तेभिरर्वागेन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम् ॥
verses.rom:
samiddheshvagnishvanajana yatasrucha barhiru tistirana |
tivraih somaih parishiktebhirarvagendragni saumanasaya yatam ||
verses.en:
Both stand adorned, when fires are duly kindled, spreading the sacred grass, with lifted ladles.
Drawn by strong Soma juice poured forth around us, come, Indra-Agni, and display your favour.

verses.sa:
यानीन्द्राग्नी चक्रथुर्वीर्याणि यानि रूपाण्युत वृष्ण्यानि ।
या वां प्रत्नानि सख्या शिवानि तेभिः सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yanindragni chakrathurviryani yani rupanyuta vrishnyani |
ya vam pratnani sakhya shivani tebhih somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
The brave deeds ye have done, Indra and Agni, the forms ye have displayed and mighty exploits,
The ancient and auspicious bonds of friendship,--for sake of these drink of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदब्रवं प्रथमं वां वृणानोऽयं सोमो असुरैर्नो विहव्यः ।
तां सत्यां श्रद्धामभ्या हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadabravam prathamam vam vrinano'yam somo asurairno vihavyah |
tam satyam shraddhamabhya hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
As first I said when choosing you, in battle we must contend with Asuras for this Soma.
So came ye unto this my true conviction, and drank libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी मदथः स्वे दुरोणे यद्ब्रह्मणि राजनि वा यजत्रा ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni madathah sve durone yadbrahmani rajani va yajatra |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
If in your dwelling, or with prince or Brahman, ye, Indra-Agni, Holy Ones, rejoice you,
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libation of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी यदुषु तुर्वशेषु यद्द्रुह्युष्वनुषु पूरुषु स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni yadushu turvasheshu yaddruhyushvanushu purushu sthah |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
If with, the Yadus, Turvasas, ye sojourn, with Druhyus, Anus, Purus, Indra-Agni!
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी अवमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यां परमस्यामुत स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni avamasyam prithivyam madhyamasyam paramasyamuta sthah |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
Whether, O Indra-Agni, ye be dwelling in lowest earth, in central, or in highest.
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी परमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यामवमस्यामुत स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni paramasyam prithivyam madhyamasyamavamasyamuta sthah |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
Whether, O Indra-Agni, ye be dwelling in highest earth, in central, or in lowest,
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी दिवि ष्ठो यत्पृथिव्यां यत्पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni divi shtho yatprithivyam yatparvateshvoshadhishvapsu |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
Whether ye be in heaven, O Indra-Agni, on earth, on mountains, in the herbs, or waters,
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी उदिता सूर्यस्य मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयेथे ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni udita suryasya madhye divah svadhaya madayethe |
atah pari vrishanava hi yatamatha somasya pibatam sutasya ||
verses.en:
If, when the Sun to the mid-heaven hath mounted, ye take delight in food, O Indra-Agni,
Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्नी पपिवांसा सुतस्य विश्वास्मभ्यं सं जयतं धनानि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
evendragni papivamsa sutasya vishvasmabhyam sam jayatam dhanani |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Thus having drunk your fill of our libation, win us all kinds of wealth, Indra and Agni.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
वि ह्यख्यं मनसा वस्य इच्छन्निन्द्राग्नी ज्ञास उत वा सजातान् ।
नान्या युवत्प्रमतिरस्ति मह्यं स वां धियं वाजयन्तीमतक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi hyakhyam manasa vasya ichchhannindragni jnasa uta va sajatan |
nanya yuvatpramatirasti mahyam sa vam dhiyam vajayantimataksham ||
verses.en:
LONGING for weal I looked around, in spirit, for kinsmen, Indra-Agni, or for brothers.
No providence but yours alone is with me so have I wrought for you this hymn for succour.

verses.sa:
अश्रवं हि भूरिदावत्तरा वां विजामातुरुत वा घा स्यालात् ।
अथा सोमस्य प्रयती युवभ्यामिन्द्राग्नी स्तोमं जनयामि नव्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashravam hi bhuridavattara vam vijamaturuta va gha syalat |
atha somasya prayati yuvabhyamindragni stomam janayami navyam ||
verses.en:
For I have heard that ye give wealth more freely than worthless son-in-law or spouse's brother.
So offering to you this draught of Soma, I make you this new hymn, Indra and Agni,

verses.sa:
मा च्छेद्म रश्मीँरिति नाधमानाः पितॄणां शक्तीरनुयच्छमानाः ।
इन्द्राग्निभ्यां कं वृषणो मदन्ति ता ह्यद्री धिषणाया उपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
ma chchhedma rashminriti nadhamanah pitrinam shaktiranuyachchhamanah |
indragnibhyam kam vrishano madanti ta hyadri dhishanaya upasthe ||
verses.en:
Let us not break the cords: with this petition we strive to gain the powers of our forefathers.
For Indra-Agni the strong drops are joyful, for here in the bowl's lap are both the press-stones.

verses.sa:
युवाभ्यां देवी धिषणा मदायेन्द्राग्नी सोममुशती सुनोति ।
तावश्विना भद्रहस्ता सुपाणी आ धावतं मधुना पृङ्क्तमप्सु ॥
verses.rom:
yuvabhyam devi dhishana madayendragni somamushati sunoti |
tavashvina bhadrahasta supani a dhavatam madhuna prinktamapsu ||
verses.en:
For you the bowl divine, Indra and Agni, presses the Soma gladly to delight you.
With hands auspicious and fair arms, ye Asvins, haste, sprinkle it with sweetness in the waters.

verses.sa:
युवामिन्द्राग्नी वसुनो विभागे तवस्तमा शुश्रव वृत्रहत्ये ।
तावासद्या बर्हिषि यज्ञे अस्मिन्प्र चर्षणी मादयेथां सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yuvamindragni vasuno vibhage tavastama shushrava vritrahatye |
tavasadya barhishi yajne asminpra charshani madayetham sutasya ||
verses.en:
You, I have heard, were mightiest, Indra-Agni, when Vrtra fell and when the spoil was parted.
Sit at this sacrifice, ye ever active, on the strewn grass, and with the juice delight you.

verses.sa:
प्र चर्षणिभ्यः पृतनाहवेषु प्र पृथिव्या रिरिचाथे दिवश्च ।
प्र सिन्धुभ्यः प्र गिरिभ्यो महित्वा प्रेन्द्राग्नी विश्वा भुवनात्यन्या ॥
verses.rom:
pra charshanibhyah pritanahaveshu pra prithivya ririchathe divashcha |
pra sindhubhyah pra giribhyo mahitva prendragni vishva bhuvanatyanya ||
verses.en:
Surpassing all men where they shout for battle, ye Twain exceed the earth and heaven in greatness.
Greater are ye than rivers and than mountains, O Indra-Agni, and all things beside them.

verses.sa:
आ भरतं शिक्षतं वज्रबाहू अस्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं शचीभिः ।
इमे नु ते रश्मयः सूर्यस्य येभिः सपित्वं पितरो न आसन् ॥
verses.rom:
a bharatam shikshatam vajrabahu asman indragni avatam shachibhih |
ime nu te rashmayah suryasya yebhih sapitvam pitaro na asan ||
verses.en:
Bring wealth and give it, ye whose arms wield thunder: Indra and Agni, with your powers protect us.
Now of a truth these be the very sunbeams wherewith our fathers were of old united.

verses.sa:
पुरंदरा शिक्षतं वज्रहस्तास्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं भरेषु ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
puramdara shikshatam vajrahastasman indragni avatam bhareshu |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Give, ye who shatter forts, whose hands wield thunder: Indra and Agni, save us in our battles.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ततं मे अपस्तदु तायते पुनः स्वादिष्ठा धीतिरुचथाय शस्यते ।
अयं समुद्र इह विश्वदेव्यः स्वाहाकृतस्य समु तृप्णुत ऋभवः ॥
verses.rom:
tatam me apastadu tayate punah svadishtha dhitiruchathaya shasyate |
ayam samudra iha vishvadevyah svahakritasya samu tripnuta ribhavah ||
verses.en:
THE holy work I wrought before is wrought again: my sweetest hymn is sung to celebrate your praise.
Here, O ye Rbhus, is this sea for all the Gods: sate you with Soma offered with the hallowing word.

verses.sa:
आभोगयं प्र यदिच्छन्त ऐतनापाकाः प्राञ्चो मम के चिदापयः ।
सौधन्वनासश्चरितस्य भूमनागच्छत सवितुर्दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhogayam pra yadichchhanta aitanapakah prancho mama ke chidapayah |
saudhanvanasashcharitasya bhumanagachchhata saviturdashusho griham ||
verses.en:
When, seeking your enjoyment onward from afar, ye, certain of my kinsmen, wandered on your way,
Sons of Sudhanvan, after your long journeying, ye came unto the home of liberal Savitar.

verses.sa:
तत्सविता वोऽमृतत्वमासुवदगोह्यं यच्छ्रवयन्त ऐतन ।
त्यं चिच्चमसमसुरस्य भक्षणमेकं सन्तमकृणुता चतुर्वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatsavita vo'mritatvamasuvadagohyam yachchhravayanta aitana |
tyam chichchamasamasurasya bhakshanamekam santamakrinuta chaturvayam ||
verses.en:
Savitar therefore gave you immortality, because ye came proclaiming him whom naught can hide;
And this the drinking-chalice of the Asura, which till that time was one, ye made to be fourfold.

verses.sa:
विष्ट्वी शमी तरणित्वेन वाघतो मर्तासः सन्तो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।
सौधन्वना ऋभवः सूरचक्षसः संवत्सरे समपृच्यन्त धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishtvi shami taranitvena vaghato martasah santo amritatvamanashuh |
saudhanvana ribhavah surachakshasah samvatsare samaprichyanta dhitibhih ||
verses.en:
When they had served with zeal at sacrifice as priests, they, mortal as they were, gained immortality.
The Rbhus, children of Sudhanvan, bright as suns, were in a year's course made associate with prayers.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रमिव वि ममुस्तेजनेनँ एकं पात्रमृभवो जेहमानम् ।
उपस्तुता उपमं नाधमाना अमर्त्येषु श्रव इच्छमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
kshetramiva vi mamustejanenan ekam patramribhavo jehamanam |
upastuta upamam nadhamana amartyeshu shrava ichchhamanah ||
verses.en:
The Rbhus, with a rod measured, as 'twere a field, the single sacrificial chalice. wide of mouth,
Lauded of all who saw, praying for what is best, desiring glorious fame among Immortal Gods.

verses.sa:
आ मनीषामन्तरिक्षस्य नृभ्यः स्रुचेव घृतं जुहवाम विद्मना ।
तरणित्वा ये पितुरस्य सश्चिर ऋभवो वाजमरुहन्दिवो रजः ॥
verses.rom:
a manishamantarikshasya nribhyah srucheva ghritam juhavama vidmana |
taranitva ye piturasya sashchira ribhavo vajamaruhandivo rajah ||
verses.en:
As oil in ladles, we through knowledge will present unto the Heroes of the firmament our hymn,--
The Rbhus who came near with this great Father's speed, and rose to heaven's high sphere to eat the strengthening food.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्न इन्द्रः शवसा नवीयानृभुर्वाजेभिर्वसुभिर्वसुर्ददिः ।
युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रियेऽभि तिष्ठेम पृत्सुतीरसुन्वताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurna indrah shavasa naviyanribhurvajebhirvasubhirvasurdadih |
yushmakam deva avasahani priye'bhi tishthema pritsutirasunvatam ||
verses.en:
Rbhu to us is Indra freshest in his might, Rbhu with powers and wealth is giver of rich gifts.
Gods, through your favour may we on the happy day quell the attacks of those who pour no offerings forth.

verses.sa:
निश्चर्मण ऋभवो गामपिंशत सं वत्सेनासृजता मातरं पुनः ।
सौधन्वनासः स्वपस्यया नरो जिव्री युवाना पितराकृणोतन ॥
verses.rom:
nishcharmana ribhavo gamapimshata sam vatsenasrijata mataram punah |
saudhanvanasah svapasyaya naro jivri yuvana pitarakrinotana ||
verses.en:
Out of a skin, O Rbhus, once ye formed a cow, and brought the mother close unto her calf again.
Sons of Sudhanvan, Heroes, with surpassing skill ye made your aged Parents youthful as before.

verses.sa:
वाजेभिर्नो वाजसातावविड्ढ्यृभुमाँ इन्द्र चित्रमा दर्षि राधः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
vajebhirno vajasatavaviddhyribhuman indra chitrama darshi radhah |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Help us with strength where spoil is won, O Indra: joined with the Rbhus give us varied bounty.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
तक्षन्रथं सुवृतं विद्मनापसस्तक्षन्हरी इन्द्रवाहा वृषण्वसू ।
तक्षन्पितृभ्यामृभवो युवद्वयस्तक्षन्वत्साय मातरं सचाभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
takshanratham suvritam vidmanapasastakshanhari indravaha vrishanvasu |
takshanpitribhyamribhavo yuvadvayastakshanvatsaya mataram sachabhuvam ||
verses.en:
WORKING with skill they wrought the lightly rolling car: they wrought the Bays who bear Indra and bring great gifts.
The Rbhus for their Parents made life young again; and fashioned for the calf a mother by its side.

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञाय तक्षत ऋभुमद्वयः क्रत्वे दक्षाय सुप्रजावतीमिषम् ।
यथा क्षयाम सर्ववीरया विशा तन्नः शर्धाय धासथा स्विन्द्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no yajnaya takshata ribhumadvayah kratve dakshaya suprajavatimisham |
yatha kshayama sarvaviraya visha tannah shardhaya dhasatha svindriyam ||
verses.en:
For sacrifice make for us active vital power for skill and wisdom food with noble progeny.
Grant to our company this power most excellent, that with a family all-heroic we may dwell.

verses.sa:
आ तक्षत सातिमस्मभ्यमृभवः सातिं रथाय सातिमर्वते नरः ।
सातिं नो जैत्रीं सं महेत विश्वहा जामिमजामिं पृतनासु सक्षणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
a takshata satimasmabhyamribhavah satim rathaya satimarvate narah |
satim no jaitrim sam maheta vishvaha jamimajamim pritanasu sakshanim ||
verses.en:
Do ye, O Rbhus, make prosperity for us, prosperity for car, ye Heroes, and for steed.
Grant us prosperity victorious evermore,
conquering foes in battle, strangers or akin.

verses.sa:
ऋभुक्षणमिन्द्रमा हुव ऊतय ऋभून्वाजान्मरुतः सोमपीतये ।
उभा मित्रावरुणा नूनमश्विना ते नो हिन्वन्तु सातये धिये जिषे ॥
verses.rom:
ribhukshanamindrama huva utaya ribhunvajanmarutah somapitaye |
ubha mitravaruna nunamashvina te no hinvantu sataye dhiye jishe ||
verses.en:
Indra, the Rbhus' Lord, I invocate for aid, the Rbhus, Vajas, Maruts to the Soma draught.
Varuna, Mitra, both, yea, and the Asvins Twain: let them speed us to wealth, wisdom, and victory.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्भराय सं शिशातु सातिं समर्यजिद्वाजो अस्माँ अविष्टु ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurbharaya sam shishatu satim samaryajidvajo asman avishtu |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
May Rbhu send prosperity for battle, may Vaja conquering in the fight protect us.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ईळे द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वचित्तयेऽग्निं घर्मं सुरुचं यामन्निष्टये ।
याभिर्भरे कारमंशाय जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ile dyavaprithivi purvachittaye'gnim gharmam surucham yamannishtaye |
yabhirbhare karamamshaya jinvathastabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
To give first thought to them, I worship Heaven and Earth, and Agni, fair bright glow, to hasten their approach.
Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith in fight ye speed the war-cry to the spoil.

verses.sa:
युवोर्दानाय सुभरा असश्चतो रथमा तस्थुर्वचसं न मन्तवे ।
याभिर्धियोऽवथः कर्मन्निष्टये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvordanaya subhara asashchato rathama tasthurvachasam na mantave |
yabhirdhiyo'vathah karmannishtaye tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Ample, unfailing, they have mounted as it were an eloquent car that ye may think of us and give.
Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye help our thoughts to further holy acts.

verses.sa:
युवं तासां दिव्यस्य प्रशासने विशां क्षयथो अमृतस्य मज्मना ।
याभिर्धेनुमस्वं पिन्वथो नरा ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam tasam divyasya prashasane visham kshayatho amritasya majmana |
yabhirdhenumasvam pinvatho nara tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Ye by the might which heavenly nectar giveth you are in supreme dominion Lords of all these folk.
Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye, Heroes, made the barren cow give milk.

verses.sa:
याभिः परिज्मा तनयस्य मज्मना द्विमाता तूर्षु तरणिर्विभूषति ।
याभिस्त्रिमन्तुरभवद्विचक्षणस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih parijma tanayasya majmana dvimata turshu taranirvibhushati |
yabhistrimanturabhavadvichakshanastabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
The aids wherewith the Wanderer through his offspring's might, or the Two-Mothered Son shows swiftest mid the swift;
Wherewith the sapient one acquired his triple lore,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभी रेभं निवृतं सितमद्भ्य उद्वन्दनमैरयतं स्वर्दृशे ।
याभिः कण्वं प्र सिषासन्तमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhi rebham nivritam sitamadbhya udvandanamairayatam svardrishe |
yabhih kanvam pra sishasantamavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye raised from waters, prisoned and fast bound, Rebha, and Vandana to look upon the light;
Wherewith ye succoured Kanva as he strove to win,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिरन्तकं जसमानमारणे भुज्युं याभिरव्यथिभिर्जिजिन्वथुः ।
याभिः कर्कन्धुं वय्यं च जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirantakam jasamanamarane bhujyum yabhiravyathibhirjijinvathuh |
yabhih karkandhum vayyam cha jinvathastabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye rescued Antaka when languishing deep in the pit, and Bhujyu with unfailing help.
And comforted Karkandhu, Vayya, in their woe,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शुचन्तिं धनसां सुषंसदं तप्तं घर्ममोम्यावन्तमत्रये ।
याभिः पृश्निगुं पुरुकुत्समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih shuchantim dhanasam sushamsadam taptam gharmamomyavantamatraye |
yabhih prishnigum purukutsamavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye gave Sucanti wealth and happy home, and made the fiery pit friendly for Atri's sake;
Wherewith ye guarded Purukutsa, Prsnigu,--Come hither unto us, O Asvin;, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शचीभिर्वृषणा परावृजं प्रान्धं श्रोणं चक्षस एतवे कृथः ।
याभिर्वर्तिकां ग्रसिताममुञ्चतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih shachibhirvrishana paravrijam prandham shronam chakshasa etave krithah |
yabhirvartikam grasitamamunchatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Mighty Ones, with what powers ye gave Paravrj aid what time ye made the blind and lame to see and walk;
Wherewith ye set at liberty the swallowed quail,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सिन्धुं मधुमन्तमसश्चतं वसिष्ठं याभिरजरावजिन्वतम् ।
याभिः कुत्सं श्रुतर्यं नर्यमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih sindhum madhumantamasashchatam vasishtham yabhirajaravajinvatam |
yabhih kutsam shrutaryam naryamavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye quickened the most sweet exhaustless flood, and comforted Vasistha, ye who ne'er decay;
And to Srutarya, Kutsa, Narya gave your help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्विश्पलां धनसामथर्व्यं सहस्रमीळ्ह आजावजिन्वतम् ।
याभिर्वशमश्व्यं प्रेणिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirvishpalam dhanasamatharvyam sahasramilha ajavajinvatam |
yabhirvashamashvyam prenimavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye helped, in battle of a thousand spoils, Vispala seeking booty, powerless to move.
Wherewith ye guarded friendly Vasa, Asva's son,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सुदानू औशिजाय वणिजे दीर्घश्रवसे मधु कोशो अक्षरत् ।
कक्षीवन्तं स्तोतारं याभिरावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih sudanu aushijaya vanije dirghashravase madhu kosho aksharat |
kakshivantam stotaram yabhiravatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Whereby the cloud, ye Bounteous Givers, shed sweet rain for Dirghasravas, for the merchant Ausija,
Wherewith ye helped Kaksivan, singer of your praise,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभी रसां क्षोदसोद्नः पिपिन्वथुरनश्वं याभी रथमावतं जिषे ।
याभिस्त्रिशोक उस्रिया उदाजत ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhi rasam kshodasodnah pipinvathuranashvam yabhi rathamavatam jishe |
yabhistrishoka usriya udajata tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye made Rasa swell full with water-floods, and urged to victory the car without a horse;
Wherewith Trisoka drove forth his recovered cows,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सूर्यं परियाथः परावति मन्धातारं क्षैत्रपत्येष्वावतम् ।
याभिर्विप्रं प्र भरद्वाजमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih suryam pariyathah paravati mandhataram kshaitrapatyeshvavatam |
yabhirvipram pra bharadvajamavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye, compass round the Sun when far away, strengthened Mandhatar in his tasks as lord of lands,
And to sage Bharadvaja gave protecting help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्महामतिथिग्वं कशोजुवं दिवोदासं शम्बरहत्य आवतम् ।
याभिः पूर्भिद्ये त्रसदस्युमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirmahamatithigvam kashojuvam divodasam shambarahatya avatam |
yabhih purbhidye trasadasyumavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith, when Sambara was slain, ye guarded well great Atithigva, Divodisa, Kasoju,
And Trasadasyu when the forts were shattered down,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्वम्रं विपिपानमुपस्तुतं कलिं याभिर्वित्तजानिं दुवस्यथः ।
याभिर्व्यश्वमुत पृथिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirvamram vipipanamupastutam kalim yabhirvittajanim duvasyathah |
yabhirvyashvamuta prithimavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye honoured the great drinker Vamra, and Upastuta and Kali when he gained his wife,
And lent to Vyasva and to Prthi favouring help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्नरा शयवे याभिरत्रये याभिः पुरा मनवे गातुमीषथुः ।
याभिः शारीराजतं स्यूमरश्मये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirnara shayave yabhiratraye yabhih pura manave gatumishathuh |
yabhih sharirajatam syumarashmaye tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith, O Heroes, ye vouchsafed deliverance to Sayu, Atri, and to Manu long ago;
Wherewith ye shot your shafts in Syumarasmi's cause.--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः पठर्वा जठरस्य मज्मनाग्निर्नादीदेच्चित इद्धो अज्मन्ना ।
याभिः शर्यातमवथो महाधने ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih patharva jatharasya majmanagnirnadidechchita iddho ajmanna |
yabhih sharyatamavatho mahadhane tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith Patharva, in his majesty of form, shone in his course like to a gathered kindled fire;
Wherewith ye helped Saryata in the mighty fray,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिरङ्गिरो मनसा निरण्यथोऽग्रं गच्छथो विवरे गोअर्णसः ।
याभिर्मनुं शूरमिषा समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirangiro manasa niranyatho'gram gachchhatho vivare goarnasah |
yabhirmanum shuramisha samavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith, Angirases! ye triumphed in your heart, and onward went to liberate the flood of milk;
Wherewith ye helped the hero Manu with new strength,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः पत्नीर्विमदाय न्यूहथुरा घ वा याभिररुणीरशिक्षतम् ।
याभिः सुदास ऊहथुः सुदेव्यं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih patnirvimadaya nyuhathura gha va yabhirarunirashikshatam |
yabhih sudasa uhathuh sudevyam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye brought a wife for Vimada to wed, wherewith ye freely gave the ruddy cows away;
Wherewith ye brought the host of kind Gods to Sudas--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शंताती भवथो ददाशुषे भुज्युं याभिरवथो याभिरध्रिगुम् ।
ओम्यावतीं सुभरामृतस्तुभं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih shamtati bhavatho dadashushe bhujyum yabhiravatho yabhiradhrigum |
omyavatim subharamritastubham tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye bring great bliss to him who offers gifts, wherewith ye have protected Bhujyu, Adhrigu,
And good and gracious Subhara and Rtastup,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः कृशानुमसने दुवस्यथो जवे याभिर्यूनो अर्वन्तमावतम् ।
मधु प्रियं भरथो यत्सरड्भ्यस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih krishanumasane duvasyatho jave yabhiryuno arvantamavatam |
madhu priyam bharatho yatsaradbhyastabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye served Krsanu where the shafts were shot, and helped the young man's horse to swiftness in the race;
Wherewith ye bring delicious honey to the bees,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्नरं गोषुयुधं नृषाह्ये क्षेत्रस्य साता तनयस्य जिन्वथः ।
याभी रथाँ अवथो याभिरर्वतस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirnaram goshuyudham nrishahye kshetrasya sata tanayasya jinvathah |
yabhi rathan avatho yabhirarvatastabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye speed the hero as he fights for kine in hero battle, in the strife for land and sons,
Wherewith ye safely guard his horses and his car,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतू प्र तुर्वीतिं प्र च दभीतिमावतम् ।
याभिर्ध्वसन्तिं पुरुषन्तिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih kutsamarjuneyam shatakratu pra turvitim pra cha dabhitimavatam |
yabhirdhvasantim purushantimavatam tabhiru shu utibhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Wherewith ye, Lords of Hundred Powers, helped Kutsa, son of Arjuni, gave Turviti and Dabhiti strength,
Favoured Dhvasanti and lent Purusanti help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
अप्नस्वतीमश्विना वाचमस्मे कृतं नो दस्रा वृषणा मनीषाम् ।
अद्यूत्येऽवसे नि ह्वये वां वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
apnasvatimashvina vachamasme kritam no dasra vrishana manisham |
adyutye'vase ni hvaye vam vridhe cha no bhavatam vajasatau ||
verses.en:
Make ye our speech effectual, O ye Asvins, and this our hymn, ye mighty Wonder-Workers.
In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us also on the field of battle.

verses.sa:
द्युभिरक्तुभिः परि पातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
dyubhiraktubhih pari patamasmanarishtebhirashvina saubhagebhih |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
With, undiminished blessings, O ye Asvins, for evermore both night and day protect us.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा ।
यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायँ एवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक् ॥
verses.rom:
idam shreshtham jyotisham jyotiragachchitrah praketo ajanishta vibhva |
yatha prasuta savituh savayan eva ratryushase yonimaraik ||
verses.en:
This light is come, amid all lights the fairest; born is the brilliant, far-extending brightness.
Night, sent away for Savitar's uprising, hath yielded up a birth-place for the Morning.

verses.sa:
रुशद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः ।
समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने ॥
verses.rom:
rushadvatsa rushati shvetyagadaraigu krishna sadananyasyah |
samanabandhu amrite anuchi dyava varnam charata aminane ||
verses.en:
The Fair, the Bright is come with her white offspring; to her the Dark One hath resigned her dwelling.
Akin, immortal, following each other, changing their colours both the heavens move onward.

verses.sa:
समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे ।
न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे ॥
verses.rom:
samano adhva svasroranantastamanyanya charato devashishte |
na methete na tasthatuh sumeke naktoshasa samanasa virupe ||
verses.en:
Common, unending is the Sisters' pathway; taught by the Gods, alternately they travel.
Fair-formed, of different hues and yet one-minded, Night and Dawn clash not, neither do they travel.

verses.sa:
भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानामचेति चित्रा वि दुरो न आवः ।
प्रार्प्या जगद्व्यु नो रायो अख्यदुषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
bhasvati netri sunritanamacheti chitra vi duro na avah |
prarpya jagadvyu no rayo akhyadusha ajigarbhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
Bright leader of glad sounds, our eyes behold her; splendid in hue she hath unclosed the portals.
She, stirring up the world, hath shown us riches: Dawn hath awakened every living creature.

verses.sa:
जिह्मश्ये चरितवे मघोन्याभोगय इष्टये राय उ त्वम् ।
दभ्रं पश्यद्भ्य उर्विया विचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
jihmashye charitave maghonyabhogaya ishtaye raya u tvam |
dabhram pashyadbhya urviya vichaksha usha ajigarbhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
Rich Dawn, she sets afoot the coiled-up sleeper, one for enjoyment, one for wealth or worship,
Those who saw little for extended vision. All living creatures hath the Dawn awakened.

verses.sa:
क्षत्राय त्वं श्रवसे त्वं महीया इष्टये त्वमर्थमिव त्वमित्यै ।
विसदृशा जीविताभिप्रचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
kshatraya tvam shravase tvam mahiya ishtaye tvamarthamiva tvamityai |
visadrisha jivitabhiprachaksha usha ajigarbhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
One to high sway, one to exalted glory, one to pursue his gain, and one his labour:
All to regard their different vocations, all moving creatures hath the Dawn awakened.

verses.sa:
एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि व्युच्छन्ती युवतिः शुक्रवासाः ।
विश्वस्येशाना पार्थिवस्य वस्व उषो अद्येह सुभगे व्युच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
esha divo duhita pratyadarshi vyuchchhanti yuvatih shukravasah |
vishvasyeshana parthivasya vasva usho adyeha subhage vyuchchha ||
verses.en:
We see her there, the Child of Heaven apparent, the young Maid, flushing in her shining raiment.
Thou sovran Lady of all earthly treasure, flush on us here, auspicious Dawn, this morning.

verses.sa:
परायतीनामन्वेति पाथ आयतीनां प्रथमा शश्वतीनाम् ।
व्युच्छन्ती जीवमुदीरयन्त्युषा मृतं कं चन बोधयन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
parayatinamanveti patha ayatinam prathama shashvatinam |
vyuchchhanti jivamudirayantyusha mritam kam chana bodhayanti ||
verses.en:
She first of endless morns to come hereafter, follows the path of morns that have departed.
Dawn, at her rising, urges forth the living him who is dead she wakes not from his slumber.

verses.sa:
उषो यदग्निं समिधे चकर्थ वि यदावश्चक्षसा सूर्यस्य ।
यन्मानुषान्यक्ष्यमाणाँ अजीगस्तद्देवेषु चकृषे भद्रमप्नः ॥
verses.rom:
usho yadagnim samidhe chakartha vi yadavashchakshasa suryasya |
yanmanushanyakshyamanan ajigastaddeveshu chakrishe bhadramapnah ||
verses.en:
As thou, Dawn, hast caused Agni to be kindled, and with the Sun's eye hast revealed creation.
And hast awakened men to offer worship, thou hast performed, for Gods, a noble service.

verses.sa:
कियात्या यत्समया भवाति या व्यूषुर्याश्च नूनं व्युच्छान् ।
अनु पूर्वाः कृपते वावशाना प्रदीध्याना जोषमन्याभिरेति ॥
verses.rom:
kiyatya yatsamaya bhavati ya vyushuryashcha nunam vyuchchhan |
anu purvah kripate vavashana pradidhyana joshamanyabhireti ||
verses.en:
How long a time, and they shall be together,--Dawns that have shone and Dawns to shine hereafter?
She yearns for former Dawns with eager longing, and goes forth gladly shining with the others.

verses.sa:
ईयुष्टे ये पूर्वतरामपश्यन्व्युच्छन्तीमुषसं मर्त्यासः ।
अस्माभिरू नु प्रतिचक्ष्याभूदो ते यन्ति ये अपरीषु पश्यान् ॥
verses.rom:
iyushte ye purvataramapashyanvyuchchhantimushasam martyasah |
asmabhiru nu pratichakshyabhudo te yanti ye aparishu pashyan ||
verses.en:
Gone are the men who in the days before us looked on the rising of the earlier Morning.
We, we the living, now behold her brightness and they come nigh who shall hereafter see her.

verses.sa:
यावयद्द्वेषा ऋतपा ऋतेजाः सुम्नावरी सूनृता ईरयन्ती ।
सुमङ्गलीर्बिभ्रती देववीतिमिहाद्योषः श्रेष्ठतमा व्युच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
yavayaddvesha ritapa ritejah sumnavari sunrita irayanti |
sumangalirbibhrati devavitimihadyoshah shreshthatama vyuchchha ||
verses.en:
Foe-chaser, born of Law, the Law's protectress, joy-giver, waker of all pleasant voices,
Auspicious, bringing food for Gods' enjoyment, shine on us here, most bright, O Dawn, this morning.

verses.sa:
शश्वत्पुरोषा व्युवास देव्यथो अद्येदं व्यावो मघोनी ।
अथो व्युच्छादुत्तराँ अनु द्यूनजरामृता चरति स्वधाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shashvatpurosha vyuvasa devyatho adyedam vyavo maghoni |
atho vyuchchhaduttaran anu dyunajaramrita charati svadhabhih ||
verses.en:
From days eternal hath Dawn shone, the Goddess, and shows this light to-day, endowed with riches.
So will she shine on days to come immortal she moves on in her own strength, undecaying.

verses.sa:
व्यञ्जिभिर्दिव आतास्वद्यौदप कृष्णां निर्णिजं देव्यावः ।
प्रबोधयन्त्यरुणेभिरश्वैरोषा याति सुयुजा रथेन ॥
verses.rom:
vyanjibhirdiva atasvadyaudapa krishnam nirnijam devyavah |
prabodhayantyarunebhirashvairosha yati suyuja rathena ||
verses.en:
In the sky's borders hath she shone in splendour: the Goddess hath thrown off the veil of darkness.
Awakening the world with purple horses, on her well-harnessed chariot Dawn approaches.

verses.sa:
आवहन्ती पोष्या वार्याणि चित्रं केतुं कृणुते चेकिताना ।
ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनां विभातीनां प्रथमोषा व्यश्वैत् ॥
verses.rom:
avahanti poshya varyani chitram ketum krinute chekitana |
iyushinamupama shashvatinam vibhatinam prathamosha vyashvait ||
verses.en:
Bringing all life-sustaining blessings with her, showing herself she sends forth brilliant lustre.
Last of the countless mornings that have vanished, first of bright morns to come hath Dawn arisen.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ध्वं जीवो असुर्न आगादप प्रागात्तम आ ज्योतिरेति ।
आरैक्पन्थां यातवे सूर्यायागन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
udirdhvam jivo asurna agadapa pragattama a jyotireti |
araikpantham yatave suryayaganma yatra pratiranta ayuh ||
verses.en:
Arise! the breath, the life, again hath reached us: darkness hath passed away and light approacheth.
She for the Sun hath left a path to travel we have arrived where men prolong existence.

verses.sa:
स्यूमना वाच उदियर्ति वह्नि स्तवानो रेभ उषसो विभातीः ।
अद्या तदुच्छ गृणते मघोन्यस्मे आयुर्नि दिदीहि प्रजावत् ॥
verses.rom:
syumana vacha udiyarti vahni stavano rebha ushaso vibhatih |
adya taduchchha grinate maghonyasme ayurni didihi prajavat ||
verses.en:
Singing the praises of refulgent Mornings with his hymn's web the priest, the poet rises.
Shine then to-day, rich Maid, on him who lauds thee, shine down on us the gift of life and offspring.

verses.sa:
या गोमतीरुषसः सर्ववीरा व्युच्छन्ति दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
वायोरिव सूनृतानामुदर्के ता अश्वदा अश्नवत्सोमसुत्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ya gomatirushasah sarvavira vyuchchhanti dashushe martyaya |
vayoriva sunritanamudarke ta ashvada ashnavatsomasutva ||
verses.en:
Dawns giving sons all heroes, kine and horses, shining upon the man who brings oblations,--
These let the Soma-presser gain when ending his glad songs louder than the voice of Vayu.

verses.sa:
माता देवानामदितेरनीकं यज्ञस्य केतुर्बृहती वि भाहि ।
प्रशस्तिकृद्ब्रह्मणे नो व्युच्छा नो जने जनय विश्ववारे ॥
verses.rom:
mata devanamaditeranikam yajnasya keturbrihati vi bhahi |
prashastikridbrahmane no vyuchchha no jane janaya vishvavare ||
verses.en:
Mother of Gods, Aditi's form of glory, ensign of sacrifice, shine forth exalted.
Rise up, bestowing praise on our devotion all-bounteous, make us chief among the people.

verses.sa:
यच्चित्रमप्न उषसो वहन्तीजानाय शशमानाय भद्रम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchitramapna ushaso vahantijanaya shashamanaya bhadram |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Whatever splendid wealth the Dawns bring with them to bless the man who offers praise and worship,
Even that may Mitra, Varuna vouchsafe us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इमा रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतीः ।
यथा शमसद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वं पुष्टं ग्रामे अस्मिन्ननातुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ima rudraya tavase kapardine kshayadviraya pra bharamahe matih |
yatha shamasaddvipade chatushpade vishvam pushtam grame asminnanaturam ||
verses.en:
To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes with the braided hair,
That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.

verses.sa:
मृळा नो रुद्रोत नो मयस्कृधि क्षयद्वीराय नमसा विधेम ते ।
यच्छं च योश्च मनुरायेजे पिता तदश्याम तव रुद्र प्रणीतिषु ॥
verses.rom:
mrila no rudrota no mayaskridhi kshayadviraya namasa vidhema te |
yachchham cha yoshcha manurayeje pita tadashyama tava rudra pranitishu ||
verses.en:
Be gracious unto us, O Rudra, bring us joy: thee, Lord of Heroes, thee with reverence will we serve.
Whatever health and strength our father Manu won by sacrifice may we, under thy guidance, gain.

verses.sa:
अश्याम ते सुमतिं देवयज्यया क्षयद्वीरस्य तव रुद्र मीढ्वः ।
सुम्नायन्निद्विशो अस्माकमा चरारिष्टवीरा जुहवाम ते हविः ॥
verses.rom:
ashyama te sumatim devayajyaya kshayadvirasya tava rudra midhvah |
sumnayannidvisho asmakama chararishtavira juhavama te havih ||
verses.en:
By worship of the Gods may we, O Bounteous One, O Rudra, gain thy grace, Ruler of valiant men.
Come to our families, bringing them bliss: may we, whose heroes are uninjured, bring thee sacred gifts,

verses.sa:
त्वेषं वयं रुद्रं यज्ञसाधं वङ्कुं कविमवसे नि ह्वयामहे ।
आरे अस्मद्दैव्यं हेळो अस्यतु सुमतिमिद्वयमस्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvesham vayam rudram yajnasadham vankum kavimavase ni hvayamahe |
are asmaddaivyam helo asyatu sumatimidvayamasya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Hither we call for aid the wise, the wanderer, impetuous Rudra, perfecter of sacrifice.
May he repel from us the anger of the Gods: verily we desire his favourable grace.

verses.sa:
दिवो वराहमरुषं कपर्दिनं त्वेषं रूपं नमसा नि ह्वयामहे ।
हस्ते बिभ्रद्भेषजा वार्याणि शर्म वर्म च्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
divo varahamarusham kapardinam tvesham rupam namasa ni hvayamahe |
haste bibhradbheshaja varyani sharma varma chchhardirasmabhyam yamsat ||
verses.en:
Him with the braided hair we call with reverence down, the wild-boar of the sky, the red, the dazzling shape.
May he, his hand filled full of sovran medicines, grant us protection, shelter, and a home secure.

verses.sa:
इदं पित्रे मरुतामुच्यते वचः स्वादोः स्वादीयो रुद्राय वर्धनम् ।
रास्वा च नो अमृत मर्तभोजनं त्मने तोकाय तनयाय मृळ ॥
verses.rom:
idam pitre marutamuchyate vachah svadoh svadiyo rudraya vardhanam |
rasva cha no amrita martabhojanam tmane tokaya tanayaya mrila ||
verses.en:
To him the Maruts' Father is this hymn addressed, to strengthen Rudra's might, a song more sweet than sweet.
Grant us, Immortal One, the food which mortals eat: be gracious unto me, my seed, my progeny.

verses.sa:
मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम् ।
मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरं मा नः प्रियास्तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no mahantamuta ma no arbhakam ma na ukshantamuta ma na ukshitam |
ma no vadhih pitaram mota mataram ma nah priyastanvo rudra ririshah ||
verses.en:
O Rudra, harm not either great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full-grown man.
Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra, do not harm.

verses.sa:
मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयौ मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः ।
वीरान्मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर्हविष्मन्तः सदमित्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ma nastoke tanaye ma na ayau ma no goshu ma no ashveshu ririshah |
viranma no rudra bhamito vadhirhavishmantah sadamittva havamahe ||
verses.en:
Harm us not, Rudra, in our seed and progeny, harm us not in the living, nor in cows or steeds,
Slay not our heroes in the fury of thy wrath. Bringing oblations evermore we call to thee.

verses.sa:
उप ते स्तोमान्पशुपा इवाकरं रास्वा पितर्मरुतां सुम्नमस्मे ।
भद्रा हि ते सुमतिर्मृळयत्तमाथा वयमव इत्ते वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
upa te stomanpashupa ivakaram rasva pitarmarutam sumnamasme |
bhadra hi te sumatirmrilayattamatha vayamava itte vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Even as a herdsman I have brought thee hymns of praise: O Father of the Maruts, give us happiness,
Blessed is thy most favouring benevolence, so, verily, do we desire thy saving help.

verses.sa:
आरे ते गोघ्नमुत पूरुषघ्नं क्षयद्वीर सुम्नमस्मे ते अस्तु ।
मृळा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देवाधा च नः शर्म यच्छ द्विबर्हाः ॥
verses.rom:
are te goghnamuta purushaghnam kshayadvira sumnamasme te astu |
mrila cha no adhi cha bruhi devadha cha nah sharma yachchha dvibarhah ||
verses.en:
Far be thy dart that killeth men or cattle: thy bliss be with us, O thou Lord of Heroes.
Be gracious unto us, O God, and bless us, and then vouchsafe us doubly-strong protection.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम नमो अस्मा अवस्यवः शृणोतु नो हवं रुद्रो मरुत्वान् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
avochama namo asma avasyavah shrinotu no havam rudro marutvan |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
We, seeking help, have spoken and adored him: may Rudra, girt by Maruts, hear our calling.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः ।
आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ॥
verses.rom:
chitram devanamudagadanikam chakshurmitrasya varunasyagneh |
apra dyavaprithivi antariksham surya atma jagatastasthushashcha ||
verses.en:
THE brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna and Agni.
The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो देवीमुषसं रोचमानां मर्यो न योषामभ्येति पश्चात् ।
यत्रा नरो देवयन्तो युगानि वितन्वते प्रति भद्राय भद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
suryo devimushasam rochamanam maryo na yoshamabhyeti pashchat |
yatra naro devayanto yugani vitanvate prati bhadraya bhadram ||
verses.en:
Like as a young man followeth a maiden, so doth the Sun the Dawn, refulgent Goddess:
Where pious men extend their generations, before the Auspicious One for happy fortune.

verses.sa:
भद्रा अश्वा हरितः सूर्यस्य चित्रा एतग्वा अनुमाद्यासः ।
नमस्यन्तो दिव आ पृष्ठमस्थुः परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति सद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra ashva haritah suryasya chitra etagva anumadyasah |
namasyanto diva a prishthamasthuh pari dyavaprithivi yanti sadyah ||
verses.en:
Auspicious are the Sun's Bay-coloured Horses, bright, changing hues, meet for our shouts of triumph.
Bearing our prayers, the sky's ridge have they mounted, and in a moment speed round earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
तत्सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वं मध्या कर्तोर्विततं सं जभार ।
यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थादाद्रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
tatsuryasya devatvam tanmahitvam madhya kartorvitatam sam jabhara |
yadedayukta haritah sadhasthadadratri vasastanute simasmai ||
verses.en:
This is the Godhead, this might of Surya: he hath withdrawn what spread o'er work unfinished.
When he hath loosed his Horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

verses.sa:
तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे ।
अनन्तमन्यद्रुशदस्य पाजः कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः सं भरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tanmitrasya varunasyabhichakshe suryo rupam krinute dyorupasthe |
anantamanyadrushadasya pajah krishnamanyaddharitah sam bharanti ||
verses.en:
In the sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth that Varuna and Mitra may behold it.
His Bay Steeds well maintain his power eternal, at one time bright and darksome at another.

verses.sa:
अद्या देवा उदिता सूर्यस्य निरंहसः पिपृता निरवद्यात् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
adya deva udita suryasya niramhasah piprita niravadyat |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
This day, O Gods, while Surya is ascending, deliver us from trouble and dishonour.
This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
नासत्याभ्यां बर्हिरिव प्र वृञ्जे स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यभ्रियेव वातः ।
यावर्भगाय विमदाय जायां सेनाजुवा न्यूहतू रथेन ॥
verses.rom:
nasatyabhyam barhiriva pra vrinje stoman iyarmyabhriyeva vatah |
yavarbhagaya vimadaya jayam senajuva nyuhatu rathena ||
verses.en:
I TRIM like grass my song for the Nasatyas and send their lauds forth as the wind drives rain-clouds,
Who, in a chariot rapid as an arrow, brought to the youthful Vimada a consort.

verses.sa:
वीळुपत्मभिराशुहेमभिर्वा देवानां वा जूतिभिः शाशदाना ।
तद्रासभो नासत्या सहस्रमाजा यमस्य प्रधने जिगाय ॥
verses.rom:
vilupatmabhirashuhemabhirva devanam va jutibhih shashadana |
tadrasabho nasatya sahasramaja yamasya pradhane jigaya ||
verses.en:
Borne on by rapid steeds of mighty pinion, or proudly trusting in the Gods' incitements.
That stallion ass of yours won, O Nasatyas, that thousand in the race, in Yama's contest.

verses.sa:
तुग्रो ह भुज्युमश्विनोदमेघे रयिं न कश्चिन्ममृवाँ अवाहाः ।
तमूहथुर्नौभिरात्मन्वतीभिरन्तरिक्षप्रुद्भिरपोदकाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tugro ha bhujyumashvinodameghe rayim na kashchinmamrivan avahah |
tamuhathurnaubhiratmanvatibhirantarikshaprudbhirapodakabhih ||
verses.en:
Yea, Asvins, as a dead man leaves his riches, Tugra left Bhujyu in the cloud of waters.
Ye brought him back in animated vessels, traversing air, unwetted by the billows.

verses.sa:
तिस्रः क्षपस्त्रिरहातिव्रजद्भिर्नासत्या भुज्युमूहथुः पतंगैः ।
समुद्रस्य धन्वन्नार्द्रस्य पारे त्रिभी रथैः शतपद्भिः षळश्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
tisrah kshapastrirahativrajadbhirnasatya bhujyumuhathuh patamgaih |
samudrasya dhanvannardrasya pare tribhi rathaih shatapadbhih shalashvaih ||
verses.en:
Bhujyu ye bore with winged things, Nasatyas, which for three nights, three days full swiftly travelled,
To the sea's farther shore, the strand of ocean, in three cars, hundred-footed, with six horses.

verses.sa:
अनारम्भणे तदवीरयेथामनास्थाने अग्रभणे समुद्रे ।
यदश्विना ऊहथुर्भुज्युमस्तं शतारित्रां नावमातस्थिवांसम् ॥
verses.rom:
anarambhane tadavirayethamanasthane agrabhane samudre |
yadashvina uhathurbhujyumastam shataritram navamatasthivamsam ||
verses.en:
Ye wrought that hero exploit in the ocean which giveth no support, or hold or station,
What time ye carried Bhujyu to his dwelling, borne in a ship with hundred oars, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
यमश्विना ददथुः श्वेतमश्वमघाश्वाय शश्वदित्स्वस्ति ।
तद्वां दात्रं महि कीर्तेन्यं भूत्पैद्वो वाजी सदमिद्धव्यो अर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yamashvina dadathuh shvetamashvamaghashvaya shashvaditsvasti |
tadvam datram mahi kirtenyam bhutpaidvo vaji sadamiddhavyo aryah ||
verses.en:
The white horse which of old ye gave Aghasva, Asvins, a gift to be his wealth for ever,--
Still to be praised is that your glorious present, still to be famed is the brave horse of Pedu.

verses.sa:
युवं नरा स्तुवते पज्रियाय कक्षीवते अरदतं पुरंधिम् ।
कारोतराच्छफादश्वस्य वृष्णः शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं सुरायाः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam nara stuvate pajriyaya kakshivate aradatam puramdhim |
karotarachchhaphadashvasya vrishnah shatam kumbhan asinchatam surayah ||
verses.en:
O Heroes, ye gave wisdom to Kaksivan who sprang from Pajra's line, who sang your praises.
Ye poured forth from the hoof of your strong charger a hundred jars of wine as from a strainer.

verses.sa:
हिमेनाग्निं घ्रंसमवारयेथां पितुमतीमूर्जमस्मा अधत्तम् ।
ऋबीसे अत्रिमश्विनावनीतमुन्निन्यथुः सर्वगणं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
himenagnim ghramsamavarayetham pitumatimurjamasma adhattam |
ribise atrimashvinavanitamunninyathuh sarvaganam svasti ||
verses.en:
Ye warded off with cold the fire's fierce burning; food very rich in nourishment ye furnished.
Atri, cast downward in the cavern, Asvins ye brought, with all his people, forth to comfort.

verses.sa:
परावतं नासत्यानुदेथामुच्चाबुध्नं चक्रथुर्जिह्मबारम् ।
क्षरन्नापो न पायनाय राये सहस्राय तृष्यते गोतमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
paravatam nasatyanudethamuchchabudhnam chakrathurjihmabaram |
ksharannapo na payanaya raye sahasraya trishyate gotamasya ||
verses.en:
Ye lifted up the well, O ye Nasatyas, and set the base on high to open downward.
Streams flowed for folk of Gotama who thirsted, like rain to bring forth thousandfold abundance.

verses.sa:
जुजुरुषो नासत्योत वव्रिं प्रामुञ्चतं द्रापिमिव च्यवानात् ।
प्रातिरतं जहितस्यायुर्दस्रादित्पतिमकृणुतं कनीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
jujurusho nasatyota vavrim pramunchatam drapimiva chyavanat |
pratiratam jahitasyayurdasraditpatimakrinutam kaninam ||
verses.en:
Ye from the old Cyavana, O Nasatyas, stripped, as 'twere mail, the skin upon
his body,
Lengthened his life when all had left him helpless, Dasras! and made him lord of youthful maidens.

verses.sa:
तद्वां नरा शंस्यं राध्यं चाभिष्टिमन्नासत्या वरूथम् ।
यद्विद्वांसा निधिमिवापगूळ्हमुद्दर्शतादूपथुर्वन्दनाय ॥
verses.rom:
tadvam nara shamsyam radhyam chabhishtimannasatya varutham |
yadvidvamsa nidhimivapagulhamuddarshatadupathurvandanaya ||
verses.en:
Worthy of praise and worth the winning, Heroes, is that your favouring succour O Nasatyas,
What time ye, knowing well his case, delivered Vandana from the pit like hidden treasure.

verses.sa:
तद्वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रमाविष्कृणोमि तन्यतुर्न वृष्टिम् ।
दध्यङ्ह यन्मध्वाथर्वणो वामश्वस्य शीर्ष्णा प्र यदीमुवाच ॥
verses.rom:
tadvam nara sanaye damsa ugramavishkrinomi tanyaturna vrishtim |
dadhyanha yanmadhvatharvano vamashvasya shirshna pra yadimuvacha ||
verses.en:
That mighty deed of yours, for gain, O Heroes, as thunder heraldeth the rain, I publish,
