When, by the horse's head, Atharvan's offspring Dadhyac made known to you the Soma's sweetness.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीन्नासत्या करा वां महे यामन्पुरुभुजा पुरंधिः ।
श्रुतं तच्छासुरिव वध्रिमत्या हिरण्यहस्तमश्विनावदत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajohavinnasatya kara vam mahe yamanpurubhuja puramdhih |
shrutam tachchhasuriva vadhrimatya hiranyahastamashvinavadattam ||
verses.en:
In the great rite the wise dame called, Nasatyas, you, Lords of many treasures, to assist her.
Ye heard the weakling's wife, as 'twere an order, and gave to her a son Hiranyahasta.

verses.sa:
आस्नो वृकस्य वर्तिकामभीके युवं नरा नासत्यामुमुक्तम् ।
उतो कविं पुरुभुजा युवं ह कृपमाणमकृणुतं विचक्षे ॥
verses.rom:
asno vrikasya vartikamabhike yuvam nara nasatyamumuktam |
uto kavim purubhuja yuvam ha kripamanamakrinutam vichakshe ||
verses.en:
Ye from the wolf's jaws, as ye stood together, set free the quail, O Heroes, O Nasatyas.
Ye, Lords of many treasures, gave the poet his perfect vision as he mourned his trouble.

verses.sa:
चरित्रं हि वेरिवाच्छेदि पर्णमाजा खेलस्य परितक्म्यायाम् ।
सद्यो जङ्घामायसीं विश्पलायै धने हिते सर्तवे प्रत्यधत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
charitram hi verivachchhedi parnamaja khelasya paritakmyayam |
sadyo janghamayasim vishpalayai dhane hite sartave pratyadhattam ||
verses.en:
When in the time of night, in Khela's battle, a leg was severed like a wild bird's pinion,
Straight ye gave Vispala a leg of iron that she might move what time the conflict opened.

verses.sa:
शतं मेषान्वृक्ये चक्षदानमृज्राश्वं तं पितान्धं चकार ।
तस्मा अक्षी नासत्या विचक्ष आधत्तं दस्रा भिषजावनर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam meshanvrikye chakshadanamrijrashvam tam pitandham chakara |
tasma akshi nasatya vichaksha adhattam dasra bhishajavanarvan ||
verses.en:
His father robbed Rjrasva of his eyesight who for the she-wolf slew a hundred wethers.
Ye gave him eyes, Nasatyas, Wonder-Workers, Physicians, that he saw with sight uninjured.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य कार्ष्मेवातिष्ठदर्वता जयन्ती ।
विश्वे देवा अन्वमन्यन्त हृद्भिः समु श्रिया नासत्या सचेथे ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratham duhita suryasya karshmevatishthadarvata jayanti |
vishve deva anvamanyanta hridbhih samu shriya nasatya sachethe ||
verses.en:
The Daughter of the Sun your car ascended, first reaching as it were the goal with coursers.
All Deities within their hearts assented, and ye, Nasatyas, are close linked with glory.

verses.sa:
यदयातं दिवोदासाय वर्तिर्भरद्वाजायाश्विना हयन्ता ।
रेवदुवाह सचनो रथो वां वृषभश्च शिंशुमारश्च युक्ता ॥
verses.rom:
yadayatam divodasaya vartirbharadvajayashvina hayanta |
revaduvaha sachano ratho vam vrishabhashcha shimshumarashcha yukta ||
verses.en:
When to his house ye came, to Divodasa, hasting to Bharadvaja, O ye Asvins,
The car that came with you brought splendid riches: a porpoise and a bull were yoked together.

verses.sa:
रयिं सुक्षत्रं स्वपत्यमायुः सुवीर्यं नासत्या वहन्ता ।
आ जह्नावीं समनसोप वाजैस्त्रिरह्नो भागं दधतीमयातम् ॥
verses.rom:
rayim sukshatram svapatyamayuh suviryam nasatya vahanta |
a jahnavim samanasopa vajaistrirahno bhagam dadhatimayatam ||
verses.en:
Ye, bringing wealth with rule, and life with offspring, life rich in noble heroes; O Nasatyas,
Accordant came with strength to Jahnu's children who offered you thrice every day your portion.

verses.sa:
परिविष्टं जाहुषं विश्वतः सीं सुगेभिर्नक्तमूहथू रजोभिः ।
विभिन्दुना नासत्या रथेन वि पर्वताँ अजरयू अयातम् ॥
verses.rom:
parivishtam jahusham vishvatah sim sugebhirnaktamuhathu rajobhih |
vibhinduna nasatya rathena vi parvatan ajarayu ayatam ||
verses.en:
Ye bore away at night by easy pathways Jahusa compassed round on every quarter,
And, with your car that cleaves the toe asunder, Nasatyas never decaying! rent the mountains.

verses.sa:
एकस्या वस्तोरावतं रणाय वशमश्विना सनये सहस्रा ।
निरहतं दुच्छुना इन्द्रवन्ता पृथुश्रवसो वृषणावरातीः ॥
verses.rom:
ekasya vastoravatam ranaya vashamashvina sanaye sahasra |
nirahatam duchchhuna indravanta prithushravaso vrishanavaratih ||
verses.en:
One morn ye strengthened Vasa for the battle, to gather spoils that might be told in thousands.
With Indra joined ye drove away misfortunes, yea foes of Prthusravas, O ye mighty.

verses.sa:
शरस्य चिदार्चत्कस्यावतादा नीचादुच्चा चक्रथुः पातवे वाः ।
शयवे चिन्नासत्या शचीभिर्जसुरये स्तर्यं पिप्यथुर्गाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sharasya chidarchatkasyavatada nichaduchcha chakrathuh patave vah |
shayave chinnasatya shachibhirjasuraye staryam pipyathurgam ||
verses.en:
From the deep well ye raised on high the water, so that Rcatka's son, Sara, should drink it;
And with your might, to help the weary Sayu, ye made the barren cow yield milk, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
अवस्यते स्तुवते कृष्णियाय ऋजूयते नासत्या शचीभिः ।
पशुं न नष्टमिव दर्शनाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय ॥
verses.rom:
avasyate stuvate krishniyaya rijuyate nasatya shachibhih |
pashum na nashtamiva darshanaya vishnapvam dadathurvishvakaya ||
verses.en:
To Visvaka, Nasatyas! son of Krsna, the righteous man who sought your aid and praised you,
Ye with your powers restored, like some lost creature, his son Visnapu for his eyes to look on.

verses.sa:
दश रात्रीरशिवेना नव द्यूनवनद्धं श्नथितमप्स्वन्तः ।
विप्रुतं रेभमुदनि प्रवृक्तमुन्निन्यथुः सोममिव स्रुवेण ॥
verses.rom:
dasha ratrirashivena nava dyunavanaddham shnathitamapsvantah |
viprutam rebhamudani pravriktamunninyathuh somamiva sruvena ||
verses.en:
Asvins, ye raised, like Soma in a ladle Rebha, who for ten days and ten nights, fettered.
Had lain in cruel bonds, immersed and wounded, suffering sore affliction, in the waters.

verses.sa:
प्र वां दंसांस्यश्विनाववोचमस्य पतिः स्यां सुगवः सुवीरः ।
उत पश्यन्नश्नुवन्दीर्घमायुरस्तमिवेज्जरिमाणं जगम्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam damsamsyashvinavavochamasya patih syam sugavah suvirah |
uta pashyannashnuvandirghamayurastamivejjarimanam jagamyam ||
verses.en:
1 have declared your wondrous deeds, O Asvins: may this be mine, and many kine and heroes.
May I, enjoying lengthened life, still seeing, enter old age as 'twere the house I live in.

verses.sa:
मध्वः सोमस्याश्विना मदाय प्रत्नो होता विवासते वाम् ।
बर्हिष्मती रातिर्विश्रिता गीरिषा यातं नासत्योप वाजैः ॥
verses.rom:
madhvah somasyashvina madaya pratno hota vivasate vam |
barhishmati ratirvishrita girisha yatam nasatyopa vajaih ||
verses.en:
ASVINS, your ancient priest invites you hither to gladden you with draughts of meath of Soma.
Our gift is on the grass, our song apportioned: with food and strength come hither, O Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
यो वामश्विना मनसो जवीयान्रथः स्वश्वो विश आजिगाति ।
येन गच्छथः सुकृतो दुरोणं तेन नरा वर्तिरस्मभ्यं यातम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vamashvina manaso javiyanrathah svashvo visha ajigati |
yena gachchhathah sukrito duronam tena nara vartirasmabhyam yatam ||
verses.en:
That car of yours, swifter than thought, O Asvins, which drawn by brave steeds cometh to the people,
Whereon ye seek the dwelling of the pious,--come ye thereon to our abode, O Heroes.

verses.sa:
ऋषिं नरावंहसः पाञ्चजन्यमृबीसादत्रिं मुञ्चथो गणेन ।
मिनन्ता दस्योरशिवस्य माया अनुपूर्वं वृषणा चोदयन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
rishim naravamhasah panchajanyamribisadatrim munchatho ganena |
minanta dasyorashivasya maya anupurvam vrishana chodayanta ||
verses.en:
Ye freed sage Atri, whom the Five Tribes honoured, from the strait pit, ye Heroes with his people,
Baffling the guiles of the malignant Dasyu, repelling them, ye Mighty in succession.

verses.sa:
अश्वं न गूळ्हमश्विना दुरेवैरृषिं नरा वृषणा रेभमप्सु ।
सं तं रिणीथो विप्रुतं दंसोभिर्न वां जूर्यन्ति पूर्व्या कृतानि ॥
verses.rom:
ashvam na gulhamashvina durevairrishim nara vrishana rebhamapsu |
sam tam rinitho viprutam damsobhirna vam juryanti purvya kritani ||
verses.en:
Rebha the sage, ye mighty Heroes, Asvins! whom, like a horse, vile men had sunk in water,--
Him, wounded, with your wondrous power ye rescued: your exploits of old time endure for ever.

verses.sa:
सुषुप्वांसं न निरृतेरुपस्थे सूर्यं न दस्रा तमसि क्षियन्तम् ।
शुभे रुक्मं न दर्शतं निखातमुदूपथुरश्विना वन्दनाय ॥
verses.rom:
sushupvamsam na nirriterupasthe suryam na dasra tamasi kshiyantam |
shubhe rukmam na darshatam nikhatamudupathurashvina vandanaya ||
verses.en:
Ye brought forth Vandana, ye Wonder-Workers, for triumph, like fair gold that hath been buried,
Like one who slumbered in destruction's bosom, or like the Sun when dwelling in the darkness.

verses.sa:
तद्वां नरा शंस्यं पज्रियेण कक्षीवता नासत्या परिज्मन् ।
शफादश्वस्य वाजिनो जनाय शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं मधूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvam nara shamsyam pajriyena kakshivata nasatya parijman |
shaphadashvasya vajino janaya shatam kumbhan asinchatam madhunam ||
verses.en:
Kaksivan, Pajra's son, must laud that exploit of yours, Nasatyas, Heroes, ye who wander!
When from the hoof of your strong horse ye showered a hundred jars of honey for the people.

verses.sa:
युवं नरा स्तुवते कृष्णियाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय ।
घोषायै चित्पितृषदे दुरोणे पतिं जूर्यन्त्या अश्विनावदत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam nara stuvate krishniyaya vishnapvam dadathurvishvakaya |
ghoshayai chitpitrishade durone patim juryantya ashvinavadattam ||
verses.en:
To Krsna's son, to Visvaka who praised you, O Heroes, ye restored his son Visnapu.
To Ghosa, living in her father's dwelling, stricken in years, ye gave a husband, Asvins.

verses.sa:
युवं श्यावाय रुशतीमदत्तं महः क्षोणस्याश्विना कण्वाय ।
प्रवाच्यं तद्वृषणा कृतं वां यन्नार्षदाय श्रवो अध्यधत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam shyavaya rushatimadattam mahah kshonasyashvina kanvaya |
pravachyam tadvrishana kritam vam yannarshadaya shravo adhyadhattam ||
verses.en:
Rusati, of the mighty people, Asvins, ye gave to Syava of the line of Kanva.
This deed of yours, ye Strong Ones should be published, that ye gave glory to the son of Nrsad.

verses.sa:
पुरू वर्पांस्यश्विना दधाना नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वम् ।
सहस्रसां वाजिनमप्रतीतमहिहनं श्रवस्यं तरुत्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
puru varpamsyashvina dadhana ni pedava uhathurashumashvam |
sahasrasam vajinamapratitamahihanam shravasyam tarutram ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, wearing many forms at pleasure, on Pedu ye bestowed a fleet-foot courser,
Strong, winner of a thousand spoils, resistless the serpent slayer, glorious, triumphant.

verses.sa:
एतानि वां श्रवस्या सुदानू ब्रह्माङ्गूषं सदनं रोदस्योः ।
यद्वां पज्रासो अश्विना हवन्ते यातमिषा च विदुषे च वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
etani vam shravasya sudanu brahmangusham sadanam rodasyoh |
yadvam pajraso ashvina havante yatamisha cha vidushe cha vajam ||
verses.en:
These glorious things are yours, ye Bounteous Givers; prayer, praise in both worlds are your habitation.
O Asvins, when the sons of Pajra call you, send strength with nourishment to him who knoweth.

verses.sa:
सूनोर्मानेनाश्विना गृणाना वाजं विप्राय भुरणा रदन्ता ।
अगस्त्ये ब्रह्मणा वावृधाना सं विश्पलां नासत्यारिणीतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sunormanenashvina grinana vajam vipraya bhurana radanta |
agastye brahmana vavridhana sam vishpalam nasatyarinitam ||
verses.en:
Hymned with the reverence of a son, O Asvins ye Swift Ones giving booty to the singer,
Glorified by Agastya with devotion, established Vispala again, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
कुह यान्ता सुष्टुतिं काव्यस्य दिवो नपाता वृषणा शयुत्रा ।
हिरण्यस्येव कलशं निखातमुदूपथुर्दशमे अश्विनाहन् ॥
verses.rom:
kuha yanta sushtutim kavyasya divo napata vrishana shayutra |
hiranyasyeva kalasham nikhatamudupathurdashame ashvinahan ||
verses.en:
Ye Sons of Heaven, ye Mighty, whither went ye, sought ye, for his fair praise the home of Kavya.
When, like a pitcher full of gold, O Asvins, on the tenth day ye lifted up the buried?

verses.sa:
युवं च्यवानमश्विना जरन्तं पुनर्युवानं चक्रथुः शचीभिः ।
युवो रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य सह श्रिया नासत्यावृणीत ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam chyavanamashvina jarantam punaryuvanam chakrathuh shachibhih |
yuvo ratham duhita suryasya saha shriya nasatyavrinita ||
verses.en:
Ye with the aid of your great powers, O Asvins, restored to youth the ancient man Cyavana.
The Daughter of the Sun with all her glory, O ye Nasatyas, chose your car to bear her.

verses.sa:
युवं तुग्राय पूर्व्येभिरेवैः पुनर्मन्यावभवतं युवाना ।
युवं भुज्युमर्णसो निः समुद्राद्विभिरूहथुरृज्रेभिरश्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam tugraya purvyebhirevaih punarmanyavabhavatam yuvana |
yuvam bhujyumarnaso nih samudradvibhiruhathurrijrebhirashvaih ||
verses.en:
Ye, ever-youthful Ones, again remembered Tugra, according to your ancient manner:
With horses brown of hue that flew with swift wings ye brought back Bhujyu from the sea of billows.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीदश्विना तौग्र्यो वां प्रोळ्हः समुद्रमव्यथिर्जगन्वान् ।
निष्टमूहथुः सुयुजा रथेन मनोजवसा वृषणा स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ajohavidashvina taugryo vam prolhah samudramavyathirjaganvan |
nishtamuhathuh suyuja rathena manojavasa vrishana svasti ||
verses.en:
The son of Tugra had invoked you, Asvins; borne on he went uninjured through the ocean.
Ye with your chariot swift as thought, well-harnessed, carried him off, O Mighty Ones, to safety.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीदश्विना वर्तिका वामास्नो यत्सीममुञ्चतं वृकस्य ।
वि जयुषा ययथुः सान्वद्रेर्जातं विष्वाचो अहतं विषेण ॥
verses.rom:
ajohavidashvina vartika vamasno yatsimamunchatam vrikasya |
vi jayusha yayathuh sanvadrerjatam vishvacho ahatam vishena ||
verses.en:
The quail had invocated you, O Asvins, when from the wolf's devouring jaws ye freed her.
With conquering car ye cleft the mountain's ridges: the offspring of Visvac ye killed with poison.

verses.sa:
शतं मेषान्वृक्ये मामहानं तमः प्रणीतमशिवेन पित्रा ।
आक्षी ऋज्राश्वे अश्विनावधत्तं ज्योतिरन्धाय चक्रथुर्विचक्षे ॥
verses.rom:
shatam meshanvrikye mamahanam tamah pranitamashivena pitra |
akshi rijrashve ashvinavadhattam jyotirandhaya chakrathurvichakshe ||
verses.en:
He whom for furnishing a hundred wethers to the she-wolf, his wicked father blinded,--
To him, Rjrasva, gave ye eyes, O Asvins; light to the blind ye sent for perfect vision.

verses.sa:
शुनमन्धाय भरमह्वयत्सा वृकीरश्विना वृषणा नरेति ।
जारः कनीन इव चक्षदान ऋज्राश्वः शतमेकं च मेषान् ॥
verses.rom:
shunamandhaya bharamahvayatsa vrikirashvina vrishana nareti |
jarah kanina iva chakshadana rijrashvah shatamekam cha meshan ||
verses.en:
To bring the blind man joy thus cried the she-wolf: O Asvins, O ye Mighty Ones, O Heroes,
For me Rjrasva, like a youthful lover, hath. cut piecemeal one and a hundred wethers.

verses.sa:
मही वामूतिरश्विना मयोभूरुत स्रामं धिष्ण्या सं रिणीथः ।
अथा युवामिदह्वयत्पुरंधिरागच्छतं सीं वृषणाववोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi vamutirashvina mayobhuruta sramam dhishnya sam rinithah |
atha yuvamidahvayatpuramdhiragachchhatam sim vrishanavavobhih ||
verses.en:
Great and weal-giving is your aid, O Asvins, ye, objects of all thought, made whole the cripple.
Purandhi also for this cause invoked you, and ye, O mighty, came to her with succours.

verses.sa:
अधेनुं दस्रा स्तर्यं विषक्तामपिन्वतं शयवे अश्विना गाम् ।
युवं शचीभिर्विमदाय जायां न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
adhenum dasra staryam vishaktamapinvatam shayave ashvina gam |
yuvam shachibhirvimadaya jayam nyuhathuh purumitrasya yosham ||
verses.en:
Ye, Wonder-Workers, filled with milk for Sayu the milkless cow, emaciated, barren;
And by your powers the child of Purumitra ye brought to Vimada to be his consort.

verses.sa:
यवं वृकेणाश्विना वपन्तेषं दुहन्ता मनुषाय दस्रा ।
अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्तोरु ज्योतिश्चक्रथुरार्याय ॥
verses.rom:
yavam vrikenashvina vapantesham duhanta manushaya dasra |
abhi dasyum bakurena dhamantoru jyotishchakrathuraryaya ||
verses.en:
Ploughing and sowing barley, O ye Asvins, milking out food for men, ye Wonder-Workers,
Blasting away the Dasyu with your trumpet, ye gave far-spreading light unto the Arya.

verses.sa:
आथर्वणायाश्विना दधीचेऽश्व्यं शिरः प्रत्यैरयतम् ।
स वां मधु प्र वोचदृतायन्त्वाष्ट्रं यद्दस्रावपिकक्ष्यं वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
atharvanayashvina dadhiche'shvyam shirah pratyairayatam |
sa vam madhu pra vochadritayantvashtram yaddasravapikakshyam vam ||
verses.en:
Ye brought the horse's head, Asvins, and gave it unto Dadhyac the offspring of Atharvan.
True, he revealed to you, O Wonder-Workers, sweet Soma, Tvastar's secret, as your girdle.

verses.sa:
सदा कवी सुमतिमा चके वां विश्वा धियो अश्विना प्रावतं मे ।
अस्मे रयिं नासत्या बृहन्तमपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं रराथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sada kavi sumatima chake vam vishva dhiyo ashvina pravatam me |
asme rayim nasatya brihantamapatyasacham shrutyam raratham ||
verses.en:
O Sages, evermore I crave your favour: be gracious unto all my prayers, O Asvins.
Grant me, Nasatyas, riches in abundance, wealth famous and accompanied with children.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यहस्तमश्विना रराणा पुत्रं नरा वध्रिमत्या अदत्तम् ।
त्रिधा ह श्यावमश्विना विकस्तमुज्जीवस ऐरयतं सुदानू ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyahastamashvina rarana putram nara vadhrimatya adattam |
tridha ha shyavamashvina vikastamujjivasa airayatam sudanu ||
verses.en:
With liberal bounty to the weakling's consorts ye, Heroes, gave a son Hiranyahasta;
And Syava, cut into three several pieces, ye brought to life again, O bounteous Asvins.

verses.sa:
एतानि वामश्विना वीर्याणि प्र पूर्व्याण्यायवोऽवोचन् ।
ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो वृषणा युवभ्यां सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.rom:
etani vamashvina viryani pra purvyanyayavo'vochan |
brahma krinvanto vrishana yuvabhyam suviraso vidathama vadema ||
verses.en:
These your heroic exploits, O ye Asvins, done in the days. of old, have men related.
May we, addressing prayer to you, ye Mighty, speak with brave sons about us to the synod.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो अश्विना श्येनपत्वा सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् ।
यो मर्त्यस्य मनसो जवीयान्त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा वातरंहाः ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratho ashvina shyenapatva sumrilikah svavan yatvarvan |
yo martyasya manaso javiyantrivandhuro vrishana vataramhah ||
verses.en:
FLYING, with falcons, may your chariot, Asvins, most gracious, bringing friendly
help, come hither,--
Your chariot, swifter than the mind of mortal, fleet as the wind, three-seated O ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेन त्रिचक्रेण सुवृता यातमर्वाक् ।
पिन्वतं गा जिन्वतमर्वतो नो वर्धयतमश्विना वीरमस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
trivandhurena trivrita rathena trichakrena suvrita yatamarvak |
pinvatam ga jinvatamarvato no vardhayatamashvina viramasme ||
verses.en:
Come to us with your chariot triple seated, three-wheeled, of triple form, that rolleth lightly.
Fill full our cows, give mettle to our horses, and make each hero son grow strong, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
प्रवद्यामना सुवृता रथेन दस्राविमं शृणुतं श्लोकमद्रेः ।
किमङ्ग वां प्रत्यवर्तिं गमिष्ठाहुर्विप्रासो अश्विना पुराजाः ॥
verses.rom:
pravadyamana suvrita rathena dasravimam shrinutam shlokamadreh |
kimanga vam pratyavartim gamishthahurvipraso ashvina purajah ||
verses.en:
With your well-rolling car, descending swiftly, hear this the press-stone's song, ye Wonder-Workers.
How then have ancient sages said, O Asvins, that ye most swiftly come to stay affliction?

verses.sa:
आ वां श्येनासो अश्विना वहन्तु रथे युक्तास आशवः पतंगाः ।
ये अप्तुरो दिव्यासो न गृध्रा अभि प्रयो नासत्या वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
a vam shyenaso ashvina vahantu rathe yuktasa ashavah patamgah |
ye apturo divyaso na gridhra abhi prayo nasatya vahanti ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, let your falcons bear you hither, yoked to your chariot, swift, with flying pinions,
Which, ever active, like the airy eagles, carry you, O Nasatyas, to the banquet.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं युवतिस्तिष्ठदत्र जुष्ट्वी नरा दुहिता सूर्यस्य ।
परि वामश्वा वपुषः पतंगा वयो वहन्त्वरुषा अभीके ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratham yuvatistishthadatra jushtvi nara duhita suryasya |
pari vamashva vapushah patamga vayo vahantvarusha abhike ||
verses.en:
The youthful Daughter of the Sun, delighting in you, ascended there your chariot, Heroes.
Borne on their swift wings let your beauteous horses, your birds of ruddy hue, convey you near us.

verses.sa:
उद्वन्दनमैरतं दंसनाभिरुद्रेभं दस्रा वृषणा शचीभिः ।
निष्टौग्र्यं पारयथः समुद्रात्पुनश्च्यवानं चक्रथुर्युवानम् ॥
verses.rom:
udvandanamairatam damsanabhirudrebham dasra vrishana shachibhih |
nishtaugryam parayathah samudratpunashchyavanam chakrathuryuvanam ||
verses.en:
Ye raised up Vandana, strong Wonder-Workers! with great might, and with power ye rescued Rebha.
From out the sea ye saved the son of Tugra, and gave his youth again unto Cyavana.

verses.sa:
युवमत्रयेऽवनीताय तप्तमूर्जमोमानमश्विनावधत्तम् ।
युवं कण्वायापिरिप्ताय चक्षुः प्रत्यधत्तं सुष्टुतिं जुजुषाणा ॥
verses.rom:
yuvamatraye'vanitaya taptamurjamomanamashvinavadhattam |
yuvam kanvayapiriptaya chakshuh pratyadhattam sushtutim jujushana ||
verses.en:
To Atri, cast down to the fire that scorched him, ye gave, O Asvins, strengthening food and favour.
Accepting his fair praises with approval, ye gave his eyes again to blinded Kanva.

verses.sa:
युवं धेनुं शयवे नाधितायापिन्वतमश्विना पूर्व्याय ।
अमुञ्चतं वर्तिकामंहसो निः प्रति जङ्घां विश्पलाया अधत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam dhenum shayave nadhitayapinvatamashvina purvyaya |
amunchatam vartikamamhaso nih prati jangham vishpalaya adhattam ||
verses.en:
For ancient Sayu in his sore affliction ye caused his cow to swell with milk, O Asvins.
The quail from her great misery ye delivered, and a new leg for Vispala provided.

verses.sa:
युवं श्वेतं पेदव इन्द्रजूतमहिहनमश्विनादत्तमश्वम् ।
जोहूत्रमर्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रं सहस्रसां वृषणं वीड्वङ्गम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam shvetam pedava indrajutamahihanamashvinadattamashvam |
johutramaryo abhibhutimugram sahasrasam vrishanam vidvangam ||
verses.en:
A white horse, Asvins, ye bestowed on Pedu, a serpent-slaying steed sent down by Indra,
Loud-neighing, conquering the foe, high-mettled, firm-limbed and vigorous, winning thousand treasures.

verses.sa:
ता वां नरा स्ववसे सुजाता हवामहे अश्विना नाधमानाः ।
आ न उप वसुमता रथेन गिरो जुषाणा सुविताय यातम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam nara svavase sujata havamahe ashvina nadhamanah |
a na upa vasumata rathena giro jushana suvitaya yatam ||
verses.en:
Such as ye are, O nobly born, O Heroes, we in our trouble call on you for succour.
Accepting these our songs, for our wellbeing come to us on your chariot treasure-laden.

verses.sa:
आ श्येनस्य जवसा नूतनेनास्मे यातं नासत्या सजोषाः ।
हवे हि वामश्विना रातहव्यः शश्वत्तमाया उषसो व्युष्टौ ॥
verses.rom:
a shyenasya javasa nutanenasme yatam nasatya sajoshah |
have hi vamashvina ratahavyah shashvattamaya ushaso vyushtau ||
verses.en:
Come unto us combined in love, Nasatyas come with the fresh swift vigour of the falcon.
Bearing oblations I invoke you, Asvins, at the first break of everlasting morning.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं पुरुमायं मनोजुवं जीराश्वं यज्ञियं जीवसे हुवे ।
सहस्रकेतुं वनिनं शतद्वसुं श्रुष्टीवानं वरिवोधामभि प्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratham purumayam manojuvam jirashvam yajniyam jivase huve |
sahasraketum vaninam shatadvasum shrushtivanam varivodhamabhi prayah ||
verses.en:
HITHER, that I may live, I call unto the feast your wondrous car, thought-swift, borne on by rapid steeds.
With thousand banners, hundred treasures, pouring gifts, promptly obedient, bestowing ample room.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा धीतिः प्रत्यस्य प्रयामन्यधायि शस्मन्समयन्त आ दिशः ।
स्वदामि घर्मं प्रति यन्त्यूतय आ वामूर्जानी रथमश्विनारुहत् ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva dhitih pratyasya prayamanyadhayi shasmansamayanta a dishah |
svadami gharmam prati yantyutaya a vamurjani rathamashvinaruhat ||
verses.en:
Even as it moveth near my hymn is lifted up, and all the regions come together to sing praise.
I sweeten the oblations; now the helpers come. Urjani hath, O Asvins, mounted on your car.

verses.sa:
सं यन्मिथः पस्पृधानासो अग्मत शुभे मखा अमिता जायवो रणे ।
युवोरह प्रवणे चेकिते रथो यदश्विना वहथः सूरिमा वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam yanmithah paspridhanaso agmata shubhe makha amita jayavo rane |
yuvoraha pravane chekite ratho yadashvina vahathah surima varam ||
verses.en:
When striving man with man for glory they have met, brisk, measureless, eager for victory in fight,
Then verily your car is seen upon the slope when ye, O Asvins, bring some choice boon to the prince.

verses.sa:
युवं भुज्युं भुरमाणं विभिर्गतं स्वयुक्तिभिर्निवहन्ता पितृभ्य आ ।
यासिष्टं वर्तिर्वृषणा विजेन्यं दिवोदासाय महि चेति वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam bhujyum bhuramanam vibhirgatam svayuktibhirnivahanta pitribhya a |
yasishtam vartirvrishana vijenyam divodasaya mahi cheti vamavah ||
verses.en:
Ye came to Bhujyu while he struggled in the flood, with flying birds, self-yoked, ye bore him to his sires.
Ye went to the far-distant home, O Mighty Ones; and famed is your great aid to Divodisa given.

verses.sa:
युवोरश्विना वपुषे युवायुजं रथं वाणी येमतुरस्य शर्ध्यम् ।
आ वां पतित्वं सख्याय जग्मुषी योषावृणीत जेन्या युवां पती ॥
verses.rom:
yuvorashvina vapushe yuvayujam ratham vani yematurasya shardhyam |
a vam patitvam sakhyaya jagmushi yoshavrinita jenya yuvam pati ||
verses.en:
Asvins, the car which you had yoked for glorious show your own two voices urged directed to its goal.
Then she who came for friendship, Maid of noble birth, elected you as Husbands, you to be her Lords.

verses.sa:
युवं रेभं परिषूतेरुरुष्यथो हिमेन घर्मं परितप्तमत्रये ।
युवं शयोरवसं पिप्यथुर्गवि प्र दीर्घेण वन्दनस्तार्यायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam rebham parishuterurushyatho himena gharmam paritaptamatraye |
yuvam shayoravasam pipyathurgavi pra dirghena vandanastaryayusha ||
verses.en:
Rebha ye saved from tyranny; for Atri's sake ye quenched with cold the fiery pit that compassed him.
Ye made the cow of Sayu stream refreshing milk, and Vandana was holpen to extended life.

verses.sa:
युवं वन्दनं निरृतं जरण्यया रथं न दस्रा करणा समिन्वथः ।
क्षेत्रादा विप्रं जनथो विपन्यया प्र वामत्र विधते दंसना भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam vandanam nirritam jaranyaya ratham na dasra karana saminvathah |
kshetrada vipram janatho vipanyaya pra vamatra vidhate damsana bhuvat ||
verses.en:
Doers of marvels, skilful workers, ye restored Vandana, like a car, worn out with length of days.
From earth ye brought the sage to life in wondrous mode; be your great deeds done here for him who honours you.

verses.sa:
अगच्छतं कृपमाणं परावति पितुः स्वस्य त्यजसा निबाधितम् ।
स्वर्वतीरित ऊतीर्युवोरह चित्रा अभीके अभवन्नभिष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
agachchhatam kripamanam paravati pituh svasya tyajasa nibadhitam |
svarvatirita utiryuvoraha chitra abhike abhavannabhishtayah ||
verses.en:
Ye went to him who mourned in a far distant place, him who was left forlorn by treachery of his sire.
Rich with the light of heaven was then the help ye gave, and marvellous your succour when ye stood by him.

verses.sa:
उत स्या वां मधुमन्मक्षिकारपन्मदे सोमस्यौशिजो हुवन्यति ।
युवं दधीचो मन आ विवासथोऽथा शिरः प्रति वामश्व्यं वदत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya vam madhumanmakshikarapanmade somasyaushijo huvanyati |
yuvam dadhicho mana a vivasatho'tha shirah prati vamashvyam vadat ||
verses.en:
To you in praise of sweetness sang the honey-bee: Ausija calleth you in Soma's rapturous joy.
Ye drew unto yourselves the spirit of Dadhyac, and then the horse's head uttered his words to you.

verses.sa:
युवं पेदवे पुरुवारमश्विना स्पृधां श्वेतं तरुतारं दुवस्यथः ।
शर्यैरभिद्युं पृतनासु दुष्टरं चर्कृत्यमिन्द्रमिव चर्षणीसहम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam pedave puruvaramashvina spridham shvetam tarutaram duvasyathah |
sharyairabhidyum pritanasu dushtaram charkrityamindramiva charshanisaham ||
verses.en:
A horse did ye provide for Pedu, excellent, white, O ye Asvins, conqueror of combatants,
Invincible in war by arrows, seeking heaven worthy of fame, like Indra, vanquisher of men.

verses.sa:
का राधद्धोत्राश्विना वां को वां जोष उभयोः ।
कथा विधात्यप्रचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
ka radhaddhotrashvina vam ko vam josha ubhayoh |
katha vidhatyaprachetah ||
verses.en:
ASVINS, what praise may win your grace? Who may be pleasing to you both?
How shall the ignorant worship you?

verses.sa:
विद्वांसाविद्दुरः पृच्छेदविद्वानित्थापरो अचेताः ।
नू चिन्नु मर्ते अक्रौ ॥
verses.rom:
vidvamsaviddurah prichchhedavidvanitthaparo achetah |
nu chinnu marte akrau ||
verses.en:
Here let the ignorant ask the means of you who know--for none beside you knoweth aught--
Not of a spiritless mortal man.

verses.sa:
ता विद्वांसा हवामहे वां ता नो विद्वांसा मन्म वोचेतमद्य ।
प्रार्चद्दयमानो युवाकुः ॥
verses.rom:
ta vidvamsa havamahe vam ta no vidvamsa manma vochetamadya |
prarchaddayamano yuvakuh ||
verses.en:
Such as ye: are, all-wise, we call you. Ye wise, declare to us this day accepted prayer.
Loving you well your servant lauds you.

verses.sa:
वि पृच्छामि पाक्या न देवान्वषट्कृतस्याद्भुतस्य दस्रा ।
पातं च सह्यसो युवं च रभ्यसो नः ॥
verses.rom:
vi prichchhami pakya na devanvashatkritasyadbhutasya dasra |
patam cha sahyaso yuvam cha rabhyaso nah ||
verses.en:
Simply, ye Mighty Ones, I ask the Gods of that wondrous oblation hallowed by the mystic word.
Save us from what is stronger, fiercer than ourselves.

verses.sa:
प्र या घोषे भृगवाणे न शोभे यया वाचा यजति पज्रियो वाम् ।
प्रैषयुर्न विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ya ghoshe bhrigavane na shobhe yaya vacha yajati pajriyo vam |
praishayurna vidvan ||
verses.en:
Forth go the hymn that shone in Ghosa Bhrgu's like, the song wherewith the son of Pajra worships you,
Like some wise minister.

verses.sa:
श्रुतं गायत्रं तकवानस्याहं चिद्धि रिरेभाश्विना वाम् ।
आक्षी शुभस्पती दन् ॥
verses.rom:
shrutam gayatram takavanasyaham chiddhi rirebhashvina vam |
akshi shubhaspati dan ||
verses.en:
Hear ye the song of him who hastens speedily. O Asvins, I am he who sang your praise.
Hither, ye Lords of Splendour, hither turn your eyes.

verses.sa:
युवं ह्यास्तं महो रन्युवं वा यन्निरततंसतम् ।
ता नो वसू सुगोपा स्यातं पातं नो वृकादघायोः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam hyastam maho ranyuvam va yanniratatamsatam |
ta no vasu sugopa syatam patam no vrikadaghayoh ||
verses.en:
For ye were ever nigh to deal forth ample wealth, to give the wealth that ye had gathered up.
As such, ye Vasus, guard us well, and keep us safely from the wicked wolf.

verses.sa:
मा कस्मै धातमभ्यमित्रिणे नो माकुत्रा नो गृहेभ्यो धेनवो गुः ।
स्तनाभुजो अशिश्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
ma kasmai dhatamabhyamitrine no makutra no grihebhyo dhenavo guh |
stanabhujo ashishvih ||
verses.en:
Give us not up to any man who hateth us, nor let our milch-cows stray, whose udders give us food,
Far from our homes without their calves.

verses.sa:
दुहीयन्मित्रधितये युवाकु राये च नो मिमीतं वाजवत्यै ।
इषे च नो मिमीतं धेनुमत्यै ॥
verses.rom:
duhiyanmitradhitaye yuvaku raye cha no mimitam vajavatyai |
ishe cha no mimitam dhenumatyai ||
verses.en:
May they who love you gain you for their Friends. Prepare ye us for opulence with strengthening food,
Prepare us for the food that floweth from our cows

verses.sa:
अश्विनोरसनं रथमनश्वं वाजिनीवतोः ।
तेनाहं भूरि चाकन ॥
verses.rom:
ashvinorasanam rathamanashvam vajinivatoh |
tenaham bhuri chakana ||
verses.en:
I have obtained the horseless car of Asvins rich in sacrifice,
And I am well content therewith.

verses.sa:
अयं समह मा तनूह्याते जनाँ अनु ।
सोमपेयं सुखो रथः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam samaha ma tanuhyate janan anu |
somapeyam sukho rathah ||
verses.en:
May it convey me evermore: may the light chariot pass from men
To men unto the Soma draught.

verses.sa:
अध स्वप्नस्य निर्विदेऽभुञ्जतश्च रेवतः ।
उभा ता बस्रि नश्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
adha svapnasya nirvide'bhunjatashcha revatah |
ubha ta basri nashyatah ||
verses.en:
It holdeth slumber in contempt. and the rich who enjoyeth not:
Both vanish quickly and are lost.

verses.sa:
कदित्था नॄँः पात्रं देवयतां श्रवद्गिरो अङ्गिरसां तुरण्यन् ।
प्र यदानड्विश आ हर्म्यस्योरु क्रंसते अध्वरे यजत्रः ॥
verses.rom:
kadittha nrinh patram devayatam shravadgiro angirasam turanyan |
pra yadanadvisha a harmyasyoru kramsate adhvare yajatrah ||
verses.en:
WHEN Will men's guardians hasting hear with favour the song of Angiras's pious
children?
When to the people of the home he cometh he strideth to the sacrifice, the Holy.

verses.sa:
स्तम्भीद्ध द्यां स धरुणं प्रुषायदृभुर्वाजाय द्रविणं नरो गोः ।
अनु स्वजां महिषश्चक्षत व्रां मेनामश्वस्य परि मातरं गोः ॥
verses.rom:
stambhiddha dyam sa dharunam prushayadribhurvajaya dravinam naro goh |
anu svajam mahishashchakshata vram menamashvasya pari mataram goh ||
verses.en:
He stablished heaven; he poured forth, skilful worker, the wealth of kine, for strength, that nurtures heroes.
The Mighty One his self-born host regarded, the horse's mate, the mother of the heifer.

verses.sa:
नक्षद्धवमरुणीः पूर्व्यं राट् तुरो विशामङ्गिरसामनु द्यून् ।
तक्षद्वज्रं नियुतं तस्तम्भद्द्यां चतुष्पदे नर्याय द्विपादे ॥
verses.rom:
nakshaddhavamarunih purvyam rat turo vishamangirasamanu dyun |
takshadvajram niyutam tastambhaddyam chatushpade naryaya dvipade ||
verses.en:
Lord of red dawns, he came victorious, daily to the Angirases' former invocation.
His bolt and team hath he prepared, and stablished the heaven for quadrupeds and men two-footed.

verses.sa:
अस्य मदे स्वर्यं दा ऋतायापीवृतमुस्रियाणामनीकम् ।
यद्ध प्रसर्गे त्रिककुम्निवर्तदप द्रुहो मानुषस्य दुरो वः ॥
verses.rom:
asya made svaryam da ritayapivritamusriyanamanikam |
yaddha prasarge trikakumnivartadapa druho manushasya duro vah ||
verses.en:
In joy of this thou didst restore, for worship, the lowing company of hidden cattle.
When the three-pointed one descends with onslaught he opens wide the doors that cause man trouble.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं पयो यत्पितरावनीतां राधः सुरेतस्तुरणे भुरण्यू ।
शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam payo yatpitaravanitam radhah suretasturane bhuranyu |
shuchi yatte rekna ayajanta sabardughayah paya usriyayah ||
verses.en:
Thine is that milk which thy swift-moving Parents brought down, a strengthening genial gift for conquest;
When the pure treasure unto thee they offered, the milk shed from the cow who streameth nectar.

verses.sa:
अध प्र जज्ञे तरणिर्ममत्तु प्र रोच्यस्या उषसो न सूरः ।
इन्दुर्येभिराष्ट स्वेदुहव्यैः स्रुवेण सिञ्चञ्जरणाभि धाम ॥
verses.rom:
adha pra jajne taranirmamattu pra rochyasya ushaso na surah |
induryebhirashta sveduhavyaih sruvena sinchanjaranabhi dhama ||
verses.en:
There is he born. May the Swift give us rapture, and like the Sun shine forth from yonder dawning,
Indu, even us who drank, whose toils are offerings, poured from the spoon, with praise, upon the altar.

verses.sa:
स्विध्मा यद्वनधितिरपस्यात्सूरो अध्वरे परि रोधना गोः ।
यद्ध प्रभासि कृत्व्याँ अनु द्यूननर्विशे पश्विषे तुराय ॥
verses.rom:
svidhma yadvanadhitirapasyatsuro adhvare pari rodhana goh |
yaddha prabhasi kritvyan anu dyunanarvishe pashvishe turaya ||
verses.en:
When the wood-pile, made of good logs, is ready, at the Sun's worship to bind fast the Bullock,
Then when thou shinest forth through days of action for the Car-borne, the Swift, the Cattle-seeker.

verses.sa:
अष्टा महो दिव आदो हरी इह द्युम्नासाहमभि योधान उत्सम् ।
हरिं यत्ते मन्दिनं दुक्षन्वृधे गोरभसमद्रिभिर्वाताप्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashta maho diva ado hari iha dyumnasahamabhi yodhana utsam |
harim yatte mandinam dukshanvridhe gorabhasamadribhirvatapyam ||
verses.en:
Eight steeds thou broughtest down from mighty heaven, when fighting for the well that giveth splendour,
That men might press with stones the gladdening yellow, strengthened with milk, fermenting, to exalt thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमायसं प्रति वर्तयो गोर्दिवो अश्मानमुपनीतमृभ्वा ।
कुत्साय यत्र पुरुहूत वन्वञ्छुष्णमनन्तैः परियासि वधैः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamayasam prati vartayo gordivo ashmanamupanitamribhva |
kutsaya yatra puruhuta vanvanchhushnamanantaih pariyasi vadhaih ||
verses.en:
Thou hurledst forth from heaven the iron missile, brought by the Skilful, from the sling of leather,
When thou, O Much-invoked, assisting Kutsa with endless deadly darts didst compass Susna.

verses.sa:
पुरा यत्सूरस्तमसो अपीतेस्तमद्रिवः फलिगं हेतिमस्य ।
शुष्णस्य चित्परिहितं यदोजो दिवस्परि सुग्रथितं तदादः ॥
verses.rom:
pura yatsurastamaso apitestamadrivah phaligam hetimasya |
shushnasya chitparihitam yadojo divaspari sugrathitam tadadah ||
verses.en:
Bolt-armed, ere darkness overtook the sunlight, thou castest at the veiling cloud thy weapon,
Thou rentest, out of heaven, though firmly knotted, the might of Susna that was thrown around him.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा मही पाजसी अचक्रे द्यावाक्षामा मदतामिन्द्र कर्मन् ।
त्वं वृत्रमाशयानं सिरासु महो वज्रेण सिष्वपो वराहुम् ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva mahi pajasi achakre dyavakshama madatamindra karman |
tvam vritramashayanam sirasu maho vajrena sishvapo varahum ||
verses.en:
The mighty Heaven and Earth, those bright expanses that have no wheels, joyed, Indra, at thine exploit.
Vrtra, the boar who lay amid the waters, to sleep thou sentest with thy mighty thunder.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र नर्यो याँ अवो नॄन्तिष्ठा वातस्य सुयुजो वहिष्ठान् ।
यं ते काव्य उशना मन्दिनं दाद्वृत्रहणं पार्यं ततक्ष वज्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra naryo yan avo nrintishtha vatasya suyujo vahishthan |
yam te kavya ushana mandinam dadvritrahanam paryam tataksha vajram ||
verses.en:
Mount Indra, lover of the men thou guardest, the well-yoked horses of the wind, best bearers.
The bolt which Kavya Usana erst gave thee, strong, gladdening, Vrtra-slaying, hath he fashioned.

verses.sa:
त्वं सूरो हरितो रामयो नॄन्भरच्चक्रमेतशो नायमिन्द्र ।
प्रास्य पारं नवतिं नाव्यानामपि कर्तमवर्तयोऽयज्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam suro harito ramayo nrinbharachchakrametasho nayamindra |
prasya param navatim navyanamapi kartamavartayo'yajyun ||
verses.en:
The strong Bay Horses of the Sun thou stayedst: this Etasa drew not the wheel, O Indra.
Casting them forth beyond the ninety rivers thou dravest down into the pit the godless.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अस्या इन्द्र दुर्हणायाः पाहि वज्रिवो दुरितादभीके ।
प्र नो वाजान्रथ्यो अश्वबुध्यानिषे यन्धि श्रवसे सूनृतायै ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no asya indra durhanayah pahi vajrivo duritadabhike |
pra no vajanrathyo ashvabudhyanishe yandhi shravase sunritayai ||
verses.en:
Indra, preserve thou us from this affliction Thunder-armed, save us from the misery near us.
Vouchsafe us affluence in chariots, founded on horses, for our food and fame and gladness.

verses.sa:
मा सा ते अस्मत्सुमतिर्वि दसद्वाजप्रमहः समिषो वरन्त ।
आ नो भज मघवन्गोष्वर्यो मंहिष्ठास्ते सधमादः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ma sa te asmatsumatirvi dasadvajapramahah samisho varanta |
a no bhaja maghavangoshvaryo mamhishthaste sadhamadah syama ||
verses.en:
Never may this thy loving-kindness fail us; mighty in strength, may plenteous food surround us.
Maghavan, make us share the foeman's cattle: may we be thy most liberal feast companions.

verses.sa:
प्र वः पान्तं रघुमन्यवोऽन्धो यज्ञं रुद्राय मीळ्हुषे भरध्वम् ।
दिवो अस्तोष्यसुरस्य वीरैरिषुध्येव मरुतो रोदस्योः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vah pantam raghumanyavo'ndho yajnam rudraya milhushe bharadhvam |
divo astoshyasurasya virairishudhyeva maruto rodasyoh ||
verses.en:
SAY, bringing sacrifice to bounteous Rudra, This juice for drink to you whose wrath is fleeting!
With Dyaus the Asura's Heroes I have lauded the Maruts as with prayer to Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
पत्नीव पूर्वहूतिं वावृधध्या उषासानक्ता पुरुधा विदाने ।
स्तरीर्नात्कं व्युतं वसाना सूर्यस्य श्रिया सुदृशी हिरण्यैः ॥
verses.rom:
patniva purvahutim vavridhadhya ushasanakta purudha vidane |
starirnatkam vyutam vasana suryasya shriya sudrishi hiranyaih ||
verses.en:
Strong to exalt the early invocation are Night and Dawn who show with varied aspect.
The Barren clothes her in wide-woven raiment, and fair Morn shines with Surya's golden splendour.

verses.sa:
ममत्तु नः परिज्मा वसर्हा ममत्तु वातो अपां वृषण्वान् ।
शिशीतमिन्द्रापर्वता युवं नस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
mamattu nah parijma vasarha mamattu vato apam vrishanvan |
shishitamindraparvata yuvam nastanno vishve varivasyantu devah ||
verses.en:
Cheer us the Roamer round, who strikes at morning, the Wind delight us, pourer forth of waters!
Sharpen our wits, O Parvata and Indra. May all the Gods vouchsafe to us this favour.

verses.sa:
उत त्या मे यशसा श्वेतनायै व्यन्ता पान्तौशिजो हुवध्यै ।
प्र वो नपातमपां कृणुध्वं प्र मातरा रास्पिनस्यायोः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya me yashasa shvetanayai vyanta pantaushijo huvadhyai |
pra vo napatamapam krinudhvam pra matara raspinasyayoh ||
verses.en:
And Ausija shall call for me that famous Pair who enjoy and drink, who come to brighten.
Set ye the Offspring of the Floods before you; both Mothers of the Living One who beameth.

verses.sa:
आ वो रुवण्युमौशिजो हुवध्यै घोषेव शंसमर्जुनस्य नंशे ।
प्र वः पूष्णे दावन आँ अच्छा वोचेय वसुतातिमग्नेः ॥
verses.rom:
a vo ruvanyumaushijo huvadhyai ghosheva shamsamarjunasya namshe |
pra vah pushne davana an achchha vocheya vasutatimagneh ||
verses.en:
For you shall Ausija call him who thunders, as, to win Arjuna's assent, cried Ghosa.
I will invoke, that Pusan may be bounteous to you, the rich munificence of Agni.

verses.sa:
श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमोत श्रुतं सदने विश्वतः सीम् ।
श्रोतु नः श्रोतुरातिः सुश्रोतुः सुक्षेत्रा सिन्धुरद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
shrutam me mitravaruna havemota shrutam sadane vishvatah sim |
shrotu nah shroturatih sushrotuh sukshetra sindhuradbhih ||
verses.en:
Hear, Mitra-Varuna, these mine invocations, hear them from all men in the hall of worship.
Giver of famous gifts, kind hearer, Sindhu who gives fair fields, listen with all his waters!

verses.sa:
स्तुषे सा वां वरुण मित्र रातिर्गवां शता पृक्षयामेषु पज्रे ।
श्रुतरथे प्रियरथे दधानाः सद्यः पुष्टिं निरुन्धानासो अग्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
stushe sa vam varuna mitra ratirgavam shata prikshayameshu pajre |
shrutarathe priyarathe dadhanah sadyah pushtim nirundhanaso agman ||
verses.en:
Praised, Mitra, Varuna! is your gift, a hundred cows to the Prksayamas and the Pajra.
Presented by car-famous Priyaratha, supplying nourishment, they came directly.

verses.sa:
अस्य स्तुषे महिमघस्य राधः सचा सनेम नहुषः सुवीराः ।
जनो यः पज्रेभ्यो वाजिनीवानश्वावतो रथिनो मह्यं सूरिः ॥
verses.rom:
asya stushe mahimaghasya radhah sacha sanema nahushah suvirah |
jano yah pajrebhyo vajinivanashvavato rathino mahyam surih ||
verses.en:
Praised is the gift of him the very wealthy: may we enjoy it, men with hero children:
His who hath many gifts to give the Pajras, a chief who makes me rich in cars and horses.

verses.sa:
जनो यो मित्रावरुणावभिध्रुगपो न वां सुनोत्यक्ष्णयाध्रुक् ।
स्वयं स यक्ष्मं हृदये नि धत्त आप यदीं होत्राभिरृतावा ॥
verses.rom:
jano yo mitravarunavabhidhrugapo na vam sunotyakshnayadhruk |
svayam sa yakshmam hridaye ni dhatta apa yadim hotrabhirritava ||
verses.en:
The folk, O Mitra-Varuna, who hate you, who sinfully hating pour you no libations,
Lay in their hearts, themselves, a wasting sickness, whereas the righteous gaineth all by worship.

verses.sa:
स व्राधतो नहुषो दंसुजूतः शर्धस्तरो नरां गूर्तश्रवाः ।
विसृष्टरातिर्याति बाळ्हसृत्वा विश्वासु पृत्सु सदमिच्छूरः ॥
verses.rom:
sa vradhato nahusho damsujutah shardhastaro naram gurtashravah |
visrishtaratiryati balhasritva vishvasu pritsu sadamichchhurah ||
verses.en:
That man, most puissant, wondrously urged onward, famed among heroes, liberal in giving,
Moveth a warrior, evermore undaunted in all encounters even with the mighty.

verses.sa:
अध ग्मन्ता नहुषो हवं सूरेः श्रोता राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्राः ।
नभोजुवो यन्निरवस्य राधः प्रशस्तये महिना रथवते ॥
verses.rom:
adha gmanta nahusho havam sureh shrota rajano amritasya mandrah |
nabhojuvo yanniravasya radhah prashastaye mahina rathavate ||
verses.en:
Come to the man's, the sacrificer's calling: hear, Kings of Immortality, joy-givers!
While ye who speed through clouds decree your bounty largely, for fame, to him the chariot rider.

verses.sa:
एतं शर्धं धाम यस्य सूरेरित्यवोचन्दशतयस्य नंशे ।
द्युम्नानि येषु वसुताती रारन्विश्वे सन्वन्तु प्रभृथेषु वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
etam shardham dhama yasya surerityavochandashatayasya namshe |
dyumnani yeshu vasutati raranvishve sanvantu prabhritheshu vajam ||
verses.en:
Vigour will we bestow on that adorer whose tenfold draught we come to taste, so spake they.
May all in whom rest splendour and great riches obtain refreshment in these sacrifices.

verses.sa:
मन्दामहे दशतयस्य धासेर्द्विर्यत्पञ्च बिभ्रतो यन्त्यन्ना ।
किमिष्टाश्व इष्टरश्मिरेत ईशानासस्तरुष ऋञ्जते नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
mandamahe dashatayasya dhaserdviryatpancha bibhrato yantyanna |
kimishtashva ishtarashmireta ishanasastarusha rinjate nrin ||
verses.en:
We will rejoice to drink the tenfold present when the twicefive come bearing sacred viands.
What can he do whose steeds and reins are choicest? These, the all-potent, urge brave men to conquest.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकर्णं मणिग्रीवमर्णस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः ।
अर्यो गिरः सद्य आ जग्मुषीरोस्राश्चाकन्तूभयेष्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyakarnam manigrivamarnastanno vishve varivasyantu devah |
aryo girah sadya a jagmushirosrashchakantubhayeshvasme ||
verses.en:
The sea and all the Deities shall give us him with the golden ear and neck bejewelled.
Dawns, hasting to the praises of the pious, be pleased with us, both offerers and singers.

verses.sa:
चत्वारो मा मशर्शारस्य शिश्वस्त्रयो राज्ञ आयवसस्य जिष्णोः ।
रथो वां मित्रावरुणा दीर्घाप्साः स्यूमगभस्तिः सूरो नाद्यौत् ॥
verses.rom:
chatvaro ma masharsharasya shishvastrayo rajna ayavasasya jishnoh |
ratho vam mitravaruna dirghapsah syumagabhastih suro nadyaut ||
verses.en:
Four youthful sons of Masarsara vex me, three, of the king, the conquering Ayavasa.
Now like the Sun, O Varuna and Mitra, your car hath shone, long-shaped and reined with splendour.

verses.sa:
पृथू रथो दक्षिणाया अयोज्यैनं देवासो अमृतासो अस्थुः ।
कृष्णादुदस्थादर्या विहायाश्चिकित्सन्ती मानुषाय क्षयाय ॥
verses.rom:
prithu ratho dakshinaya ayojyainam devaso amritaso asthuh |
krishnadudasthadarya vihayashchikitsanti manushaya kshayaya ||
verses.en:
THE Daksina's broad chariot hath been harnessed: this car the Gods Immortal have ascended.
Fain to bring light to homes of men the noble and active Goddess hath emerged from darkness.

verses.sa:
पूर्वा विश्वस्माद्भुवनादबोधि जयन्ती वाजं बृहती सनुत्री ।
उच्चा व्यख्यद्युवतिः पुनर्भूरोषा अगन्प्रथमा पूर्वहूतौ ॥
verses.rom:
purva vishvasmadbhuvanadabodhi jayanti vajam brihati sanutri |
uchcha vyakhyadyuvatih punarbhurosha aganprathama purvahutau ||
verses.en:
She before all the living world hath wakened, the Lofty One who wins and gathers treasure.
Revived and ever young on high she glances. Dawn hath come first unto our morning worship.

verses.sa:
यदद्य भागं विभजासि नृभ्य उषो देवि मर्त्यत्रा सुजाते ।
देवो नो अत्र सविता दमूना अनागसो वोचति सूर्याय ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya bhagam vibhajasi nribhya usho devi martyatra sujate |
devo no atra savita damuna anagaso vochati suryaya ||
verses.en:
If, Dawn, thou Goddess nobly born, thou dealest fortune this day to all the race of mortals,
May Savitar the God, Friend of the homestead, declare before the Sun that we are sinless.

verses.sa:
गृहंगृहमहना यात्यच्छा दिवेदिवे अधि नामा दधाना ।
सिषासन्ती द्योतना शश्वदागादग्रमग्रमिद्भजते वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
grihamgrihamahana yatyachchha divedive adhi nama dadhana |
sishasanti dyotana shashvadagadagramagramidbhajate vasunam ||
verses.en:
Showing her wonted form each day that passeth, spreading the light she visiteth each dwelling.
Eager for conquest, with bright sheen she cometh. Her portion is the best of goodly treasures.

verses.sa:
भगस्य स्वसा वरुणस्य जामिरुषः सूनृते प्रथमा जरस्व ।
पश्चा स दघ्या यो अघस्य धाता जयेम तं दक्षिणया रथेन ॥
verses.rom:
bhagasya svasa varunasya jamirushah sunrite prathama jarasva |
pashcha sa daghya yo aghasya dhata jayema tam dakshinaya rathena ||
verses.en:
Sister of Varuna, sister of Bhaga, first among all sing forth, O joyous Morning.
Weak be the strength of him who worketh evil: may we subdue him with our car the guerdon.

verses.sa:
उदीरतां सूनृता उत्पुरंधीरुदग्नयः शुशुचानासो अस्थुः ।
स्पार्हा वसूनि तमसापगूळ्हाविष्कृण्वन्त्युषसो विभातीः ॥
verses.rom:
udiratam sunrita utpuramdhirudagnayah shushuchanaso asthuh |
sparha vasuni tamasapagulhavishkrinvantyushaso vibhatih ||
verses.en:
Let our glad hymns and holy thoughts rise upward, for the flames brightly burning have ascended.
The far-refulgent Mornings make apparent the lovely treasures which the darkness covered.

verses.sa:
अपान्यदेत्यभ्यन्यदेति विषुरूपे अहनी सं चरेते ।
परिक्षितोस्तमो अन्या गुहाकरद्यौदुषाः शोशुचता रथेन ॥
verses.rom:
apanyadetyabhyanyadeti vishurupe ahani sam charete |
parikshitostamo anya guhakaradyaudushah shoshuchata rathena ||
verses.en:
The one departeth and the other cometh: unlike in hue day's, halves march on successive.
One hides the gloom of the surrounding Parents. Dawn on her shining chariot is resplendent.

verses.sa:
सदृशीरद्य सदृशीरिदु श्वो दीर्घं सचन्ते वरुणस्य धाम ।
अनवद्यास्त्रिंशतं योजनान्येकैका क्रतुं परि यन्ति सद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sadrishiradya sadrishiridu shvo dirgham sachante varunasya dhama |
anavadyastrimshatam yojananyekaika kratum pari yanti sadyah ||
verses.en:
The same in form to-day, the same tomorrow, they still keep Varuna's eternal statute.
Blameless, in turn they traverse thirty regions, and dart across the spirit in a moment.

verses.sa:
जानत्यह्नः प्रथमस्य नाम शुक्रा कृष्णादजनिष्ट श्वितीची ।
ऋतस्य योषा न मिनाति धामाहरहर्निष्कृतमाचरन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
janatyahnah prathamasya nama shukra krishnadajanishta shvitichi |
ritasya yosha na minati dhamaharaharnishkritamacharanti ||
verses.en:
She who hath knowledge Of the first day's nature is born refulgent white from out the darkness.
The Maiden breaketh not the law of Order, day by day coming to the place appointed.

verses.sa:
कन्येव तन्वा शाशदानाँ एषि देवि देवमियक्षमाणम् ।
संस्मयमाना युवतिः पुरस्तादाविर्वक्षांसि कृणुषे विभाती ॥
verses.rom:
kanyeva tanva shashadanan eshi devi devamiyakshamanam |
samsmayamana yuvatih purastadavirvakshamsi krinushe vibhati ||
verses.en:
In pride of beauty like a maid thou goest, O Goddess, to the God who longs to win thee,
And smiling youthful, as thou shinest brightly, before him thou discoverest thy bosom.

verses.sa:
सुसंकाशा मातृमृष्टेव योषाविस्तन्वं कृणुषे दृशे कम् ।
भद्रा त्वमुषो वितरं व्युच्छ न तत्ते अन्या उषसो नशन्त ॥
verses.rom:
susamkasha matrimrishteva yoshavistanvam krinushe drishe kam |
bhadra tvamusho vitaram vyuchchha na tatte anya ushaso nashanta ||
verses.en:
Fair as a bride embellished by her mother thou showest forth thy form that all may see it.
Blessed art thou O Dawn. Shine yet more widely. No other Dawns have reached what thou attainest.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्ववारा यतमाना रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्य ।
परा च यन्ति पुनरा च यन्ति भद्रा नाम वहमाना उषासः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavatirgomatirvishvavara yatamana rashmibhih suryasya |
para cha yanti punara cha yanti bhadra nama vahamana ushasah ||
verses.en:
Rich in kine, horses, and all goodly treasures, in constant operation with the sunbeams,
The Dawns depart and come again assuming their wonted forms that promise happy fortune.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य रश्मिमनुयच्छमाना भद्रम्भद्रं क्रतुमस्मासु धेहि ।
उषो नो अद्य सुहवा व्युच्छास्मासु रायो मघवत्सु च स्युः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya rashmimanuyachchhamana bhadrambhadram kratumasmasu dhehi |
usho no adya suhava vyuchchhasmasu rayo maghavatsu cha syuh ||
verses.en:
Obedient to the rein of Law Eternal give us each thought that more and more shall bless us.
Shine thou on us to-day, Dawn, swift to listen. With us be riches and with chiefs who worship.

verses.sa:
उषा उच्छन्ती समिधाने अग्ना उद्यन्सूर्य उर्विया ज्योतिरश्रेत् ।
देवो नो अत्र सविता न्वर्थं प्रासावीद्द्विपत्प्र चतुष्पदित्यै ॥
verses.rom:
usha uchchhanti samidhane agna udyansurya urviya jyotirashret |
devo no atra savita nvartham prasaviddvipatpra chatushpadityai ||
verses.en:
THE Dawn refulgent when the fire is kindled, and the Sun rising, far diffuse their brightness.
Savitar, God, hath sent us forth to labour, each quadruped, each biped, to be active.

verses.sa:
अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि ।
ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनामायतीनां प्रथमोषा व्यद्यौत् ॥
verses.rom:
aminati daivyani vratani praminati manushya yugani |
iyushinamupama shashvatinamayatinam prathamosha vyadyaut ||
verses.en:
Not interrupting heavenly ordinances, although she minisheth human generations.
The last of endless morns that have departed, the first of those that come, Dawn brightly shineth.

verses.sa:
एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि ज्योतिर्वसाना समना पुरस्तात् ।
ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति ॥
verses.rom:
esha divo duhita pratyadarshi jyotirvasana samana purastat |
ritasya panthamanveti sadhu prajanativa na disho minati ||
verses.en:
There in the eastern region she, Heaven's Daughter, arrayed in garments all of light, appeareth.
Truly she followeth the path of Order, nor faileth, knowing well, the heavenly quarters.

verses.sa:
उपो अदर्शि शुन्ध्युवो न वक्षो नोधा इवाविरकृत प्रियाणि ।
अद्मसन्न ससतो बोधयन्ती शश्वत्तमागात्पुनरेयुषीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
upo adarshi shundhyuvo na vaksho nodha ivavirakrita priyani |
admasanna sasato bodhayanti shashvattamagatpunareyushinam ||
verses.en:
Near is she seen, as 'twere the Bright One's bosom: she showeth sweet things like a new song-singer.
She cometh like a fly awaking sleepers, of all returning dames most true and constant.

verses.sa:
पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो अप्त्यस्य गवां जनित्र्यकृत प्र केतुम् ।
व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीय ओभा पृणन्ती पित्रोरुपस्था ॥
verses.rom:
purve ardhe rajaso aptyasya gavam janitryakrita pra ketum |
vyu prathate vitaram variya obha prinanti pitrorupastha ||
verses.en:
There in the east half of the watery region the Mother of the Cows hath shown her ensign.
Wider and wider still she spreadeth onward, and filleth full the laps of both heir Parents.

verses.sa:
एवेदेषा पुरुतमा दृशे कं नाजामिं न परि वृणक्ति जामिम् ।
अरेपसा तन्वा शाशदाना नार्भादीषते न महो विभाती ॥
verses.rom:
evedesha purutama drishe kam najamim na pari vrinakti jamim |
arepasa tanva shashadana narbhadishate na maho vibhati ||
verses.en:
She, verily, exceeding vast to look on debarreth from her light nor kin nor stranger.
Proud of her spotless form she, brightly shining, turneth not from the high nor from the humble.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातेव पुंस एति प्रतीची गर्तारुगिव सनये धनानाम् ।
जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासा उषा हस्रेव नि रिणीते अप्सः ॥
verses.rom:
abhrateva pumsa eti pratichi gartarugiva sanaye dhananam |
jayeva patya ushati suvasa usha hasreva ni rinite apsah ||
verses.en:
She seeketh men, as she who hath no brother, mounting her car, as 'twere to gather riches.
Dawn, like a loving matron for her husband, smiling and well attired, unmasks her beauty.

verses.sa:
स्वसा स्वस्रे ज्यायस्यै योनिमारैगपैत्यस्याः प्रतिचक्ष्येव ।
व्युच्छन्ती रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्याञ्ज्यङ्क्ते समनगा इव व्राः ॥
verses.rom:
svasa svasre jyayasyai yonimaraigapaityasyah pratichakshyeva |
vyuchchhanti rashmibhih suryasyanjyankte samanaga iva vrah ||
verses.en:
The Sister quitteth, for the elder Sister, her place, and having looked on her departeth.
She decks her beauty, shining forth with sunbeams, like women trooping to the festal meeting.

verses.sa:
आसां पूर्वासामहसु स्वसॄणामपरा पूर्वामभ्येति पश्चात् ।
ताः प्रत्नवन्नव्यसीर्नूनमस्मे रेवदुच्छन्तु सुदिना उषासः ॥
verses.rom:
asam purvasamahasu svasrinamapara purvamabhyeti pashchat |
tah pratnavannavyasirnunamasme revaduchchhantu sudina ushasah ||
verses.en:
To all these Sisters who ere now have vanished a later one each day in course succeedeth.
So, like the past, with days of happy fortune, may the new Dawns shine forth on us with riches.

verses.sa:
प्र बोधयोषः पृणतो मघोन्यबुध्यमानाः पणयः ससन्तु ।
रेवदुच्छ मघवद्भ्यो मघोनि रेवत्स्तोत्रे सूनृते जारयन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
pra bodhayoshah prinato maghonyabudhyamanah panayah sasantu |
revaduchchha maghavadbhyo maghoni revatstotre sunrite jarayanti ||
verses.en:
Rouse up, O Wealthy One, the liberal givers; let niggard traffickers sleep on unwakened:
Shine richly, Wealthy One, on those who worship, richly, glad.
Dawn while wasting, on the singer.

verses.sa:
अवेयमश्वैद्युवतिः पुरस्ताद्युङ्क्ते गवामरुणानामनीकम् ।
वि नूनमुच्छादसति प्र केतुर्गृहंगृहमुप तिष्ठाते अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
aveyamashvaidyuvatih purastadyunkte gavamarunanamanikam |
vi nunamuchchhadasati pra keturgrihamgrihamupa tishthate agnih ||
verses.en:
This young Maid from the east hath shone upon us; she harnesseth her team of bright red oxen.
She will beam forth, the light will hasten hither, and Agni will be present in each dwelling.

verses.sa:
उत्ते वयश्चिद्वसतेरपप्तन्नरश्च ये पितुभाजो व्युष्टौ ।
अमा सते वहसि भूरि वाममुषो देवि दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
verses.rom:
utte vayashchidvasaterapaptannarashcha ye pitubhajo vyushtau |
ama sate vahasi bhuri vamamusho devi dashushe martyaya ||
verses.en:
As the birds fly forth from their resting places, so men with store of food rise at thy dawning.
Yea, to the liberal mortal who remaineth at home, O Goddess Dawn, much good thou bringest.

verses.sa:
अस्तोढ्वं स्तोम्या ब्रह्मणा मेऽवीवृधध्वमुशतीरुषासः ।
युष्माकं देवीरवसा सनेम सहस्रिणं च शतिनं च वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
astodhvam stomya brahmana me'vivridhadhvamushatirushasah |
yushmakam deviravasa sanema sahasrinam cha shatinam cha vajam ||
verses.en:
Praised through my prayer be ye who should be lauded. Ye have increased our wealth, ye Dawns who love us.
Goddesses, may we win by your good favour wealth to be told by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.sa:
प्राता रत्नं प्रातरित्वा दधाति तं चिकित्वान्प्रतिगृह्या नि धत्ते ।
तेन प्रजां वर्धयमान आयू रायस्पोषेण सचते सुवीरः ॥
verses.rom:
prata ratnam prataritva dadhati tam chikitvanpratigrihya ni dhatte |
tena prajam vardhayamana ayu rayasposhena sachate suvirah ||
verses.en:
COMING at early morn he gives his treasure; the prudent one receives and entertains him.
Thereby increasing still his life and offspring, he comes with brave sons to abundant riches.

verses.sa:
सुगुरसत्सुहिरण्यः स्वश्वो बृहदस्मै वय इन्द्रो दधाति ।
यस्त्वायन्तं वसुना प्रातरित्वो मुक्षीजयेव पदिमुत्सिनाति ॥
verses.rom:
sugurasatsuhiranyah svashvo brihadasmai vaya indro dadhati |
yastvayantam vasuna prataritvo mukshijayeva padimutsinati ||
verses.en:
Rich shall he be in gold and kine and horses. Indra bestows on him great vital power,
Who stays thee, as thou comest, with his treasure, like game caught in the net, O early comer.

verses.sa:
आयमद्य सुकृतं प्रातरिच्छन्निष्टेः पुत्रं वसुमता रथेन ।
अंशोः सुतं पायय मत्सरस्य क्षयद्वीरं वर्धय सूनृताभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamadya sukritam pratarichchhannishteh putram vasumata rathena |
amshoh sutam payaya matsarasya kshayadviram vardhaya sunritabhih ||
verses.en:
Longing, I came this morning to the pious, the son of sacrifice, with car wealth-laden.
Give him to drink juice of the stalk that gladdens; prosper with pleasant hymns the Lord of Heroes.

verses.sa:
उप क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो मयोभुव ईजानं च यक्ष्यमाणं च धेनवः ।
पृणन्तं च पपुरिं च श्रवस्यवो घृतस्य धारा उप यन्ति विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
upa ksharanti sindhavo mayobhuva ijanam cha yakshyamanam cha dhenavah |
prinantam cha papurim cha shravasyavo ghritasya dhara upa yanti vishvatah ||
verses.en:
Health-bringing streams, as milch-cows, flow to profit him who hath worshipped, him who now will worship.
To him who freely gives and fills on all sides full streams of fatness flow and make him famous.

verses.sa:
नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि तिष्ठति श्रितो यः पृणाति स ह देवेषु गच्छति ।
तस्मा आपो घृतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवस्तस्मा इयं दक्षिणा पिन्वते सदा ॥
verses.rom:
nakasya prishthe adhi tishthati shrito yah prinati sa ha deveshu gachchhati |
tasma apo ghritamarshanti sindhavastasma iyam dakshina pinvate sada ||
verses.en:
On the high ridge of heaven he stands exalted, yea, to the Gods he goes, the liberal giver.
The streams, the waters flow for him with fatness: to him this guerdon ever yields abundance.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणावतामिदिमानि चित्रा दक्षिणावतां दिवि सूर्यासः ।
दक्षिणावन्तो अमृतं भजन्ते दक्षिणावन्तः प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinavatamidimani chitra dakshinavatam divi suryasah |
dakshinavanto amritam bhajante dakshinavantah pra tiranta ayuh ||
verses.en:
For those who give rich meeds are all these splendours, for those who give rich meeds suns shine in heaven.
The givers of rich meeds are made immortal; the givers of rich fees prolong their lifetime.

verses.sa:
मा पृणन्तो दुरितमेन आरन्मा जारिषुः सूरयः सुव्रतासः ।
अन्यस्तेषां परिधिरस्तु कश्चिदपृणन्तमभि सं यन्तु शोकाः ॥
verses.rom:
ma prinanto duritamena aranma jarishuh surayah suvratasah |
anyastesham paridhirastu kashchidaprinantamabhi sam yantu shokah ||
verses.en:
Let not the liberal sink to sin and sorrow, never decay the pious chiefs who worship!
Let every man besides be their protection, and let affliction fall upon the niggard.

verses.sa:
अमन्दान्स्तोमान्प्र भरे मनीषा सिन्धावधि क्षियतो भाव्यस्य ।
यो मे सहस्रममिमीत सवानतूर्तो राजा श्रव इच्छमानः ॥
verses.rom:
amandanstomanpra bhare manisha sindhavadhi kshiyato bhavyasya |
yo me sahasramamimita savanaturto raja shrava ichchhamanah ||
verses.en:
WITH wisdom I present these lively praises of Bhavya dweller on the bank of Sindhu;
For he, unconquered King, desiring glory, hath furnished me a thousand sacrifices.

verses.sa:
शतं राज्ञो नाधमानस्य निष्काञ्छतमश्वान्प्रयतान्सद्य आदम् ।
शतं कक्षीवाँ असुरस्य गोनां दिवि श्रवोऽजरमा ततान ॥
verses.rom:
shatam rajno nadhamanasya nishkanchhatamashvanprayatansadya adam |
shatam kakshivan asurasya gonam divi shravo'jarama tatana ||
verses.en:
A hundred necklets from the King, beseeching, a hundred gift-steeds I at once accepted;
Of the lord's cows a thousand, I Kaksivan. His deathless glory hath he spread to heaven.

verses.sa:
उप मा श्यावाः स्वनयेन दत्ता वधूमन्तो दश रथासो अस्थुः ।
षष्टिः सहस्रमनु गव्यमागात्सनत्कक्षीवाँ अभिपित्वे अह्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa ma shyavah svanayena datta vadhumanto dasha rathaso asthuh |
shashtih sahasramanu gavyamagatsanatkakshivan abhipitve ahnam ||
verses.en:
Horses of dusky colour stood beside me, ten chariots, Svanaya's gift, with mares to draw them.
Kine numbering sixty thousand followed after. Kaksivan gained them when the days were closing.

verses.sa:
चत्वारिंशद्दशरथस्य शोणाः सहस्रस्याग्रे श्रेणिं नयन्ति ।
मदच्युतः कृशनावतो अत्यान्कक्षीवन्त उदमृक्षन्त पज्राः ॥
verses.rom:
chatvarimshaddasharathasya shonah sahasrasyagre shrenim nayanti |
madachyutah krishanavato atyankakshivanta udamrikshanta pajrah ||
verses.en:
Forty bay horses of the ten cars' master before a thousand lead the long procession.
Reeling in joy Kaksivan's sons and Pajra's have grounded the coursers decked with pearly trappings.

verses.sa:
पूर्वामनु प्रयतिमा ददे वस्त्रीन्युक्ताँ अष्टावरिधायसो गाः ।
सुबन्धवो ये विश्या इव व्रा अनस्वन्तः श्रव ऐषन्त पज्राः ॥
verses.rom:
purvamanu prayatima dade vastrinyuktan ashtavaridhayaso gah |
subandhavo ye vishya iva vra anasvantah shrava aishanta pajrah ||
verses.en:
An earlier gift for you have I accepted eight cows, good milkers, and three harnessed horses,
Pajras, who with your wains with your great kinsman, like troops of subjects, have been fain for glory.

verses.sa:
आगधिता परिगधिता या कशीकेव जङ्गहे ।
ददाति मह्यं यादुरी याशूनां भोज्या शता ॥
verses.rom:
agadhita parigadhita ya kashikeva jangahe |
dadati mahyam yaduri yashunam bhojya shata ||
verses.en: [Ille loquitur]. Adhaerens, arcte adhaerens, illa quae mustelae similis se abdidit, multum humorem effundens, dat mihi complexuum centum gaudia.

verses.sa:
उपोप मे परा मृश मा मे दभ्राणि मन्यथाः ।
सर्वाहमस्मि रोमशा गन्धारीणामिवाविका ॥
verses.rom:
upopa me para mrisha ma me dabhrani manyathah |
sarvahamasmi romasha gandharinamivavika ||
verses.en: [Ille loquitur]. Prope, prope accede; molliter me tange. Ne putes pilos corporis mei-paucos esse: tota sum villosa sicut Gandharium ovis.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसुं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् ।
य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा ।
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु वष्टि शोचिषाजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hotaram manye dasvantam vasum sunum sahaso jatavedasam vipram na jatavedasam |
ya urdhvaya svadhvaro devo devachya kripa |
ghritasya vibhrashtimanu vashti shochishajuhvanasya sarpishah ||
verses.en:
AGNI I hold as herald, the munificent, the gracious, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that live, as holy Singer, knowing all,
Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods,
He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः ।
परिज्मानमिव द्यां होतारं चर्षणीनाम् ।
शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः ॥
verses.rom:
yajishtham tva yajamana huvema jyeshthamangirasam vipra manmabhirviprebhih shukra manmabhih |
parijmanamiva dyam hotaram charshaninam |
shochishkesham vrishanam yamima vishah pravantu jutaye vishah ||

verses.sa:
स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहंतरः परशुर्न द्रुहंतरः ।
वीळु चिद्यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद्वनेव यत्स्थिरम् ।
निःषहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi puru chidojasa virukmata didyano bhavati druhamtarah parashurna druhamtarah |
vilu chidyasya samritau shruvadvaneva yatsthiram |
nihshahamano yamate nayate dhanvasaha nayate ||
verses.en:
He with his shining glory blazing far and wide, he verily it is who slayeth demon foes, slayeth the demons like an axe:
At whose close touch things solid shake, and what is stable yields like trees.
Subduing all, he keeps his ground and flinches not, from the skilled archer flinches not.

verses.sa:
दृळ्हा चिदस्मा अनु दुर्यथा विदे तेजिष्ठाभिररणिभिर्दाष्ट्यवसेऽग्नये दाष्ट्यवसे ।
प्र यः पुरूणि गाहते तक्षद्वनेव शोचिषा ।
स्थिरा चिदन्ना नि रिणात्योजसा नि स्थिराणि चिदोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
drilha chidasma anu duryatha vide tejishthabhiraranibhirdashtyavase'gnaye dashtyavase |
pra yah puruni gahate takshadvaneva shochisha |
sthira chidanna ni rinatyojasa ni sthirani chidojasa ||
verses.en:
To him, as one who knows, even things solid yield: unrough fire-sticks heated hot he gives his gifts to aid. Men offer Agni gifts for aid.
He deeply piercing many a thing hews it like wood with fervent glow.
Even hard and solid food he crunches with his might, yea, hard and solid food with might.

verses.sa:
तमस्य पृक्षमुपरासु धीमहि नक्तं यः सुदर्शतरो दिवातरादप्रायुषे दिवातरात् ।
आदस्यायुर्ग्रभणवद्वीळु शर्म न सूनवे ।
भक्तमभक्तमवो व्यन्तो अजरा अग्नयो व्यन्तो अजराः ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya prikshamuparasu dhimahi naktam yah sudarshataro divataradaprayushe divatarat |
adasyayurgrabhanavadvilu sharma na sunave |
bhaktamabhaktamavo vyanto ajara agnayo vyanto ajarah ||
verses.en:
Here near we place the sacrificial food for him who shines forth fairer in the night than in the day, with life then stronger than by day.
His life gives sure and firm defence as that one giveth to a son.
The during fires enjoy things given and things not given, the during fires enjoy as food.

verses.sa:
स हि शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वणिरप्नस्वतीषूर्वरास्विष्टनिरार्तनास्विष्टनिः ।
आदद्धव्यान्याददिर्यज्ञस्य केतुरर्हणा ।
अध स्मास्य हर्षतो हृषीवतो विश्वे जुषन्त पन्थां नरः शुभे न पन्थाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shardho na marutam tuvishvanirapnasvatishurvarasvishtanirartanasvishtanih |
adaddhavyanyadadiryajnasya keturarhana |
adha smasya harshato hrishivato vishve jushanta pantham narah shubhe na pantham ||

verses.sa:
द्विता यदीं कीस्तासो अभिद्यवो नमस्यन्त उपवोचन्त भृगवो मथ्नन्तो दाशा भृगवः ।
अग्निरीशे वसूनां शुचिर्यो धर्णिरेषाम् ।
प्रियाँ अपिधीँर्वनिषीष्ट मेधिर आ वनिषीष्ट मेधिरः ॥
verses.rom:
dvita yadim kistaso abhidyavo namasyanta upavochanta bhrigavo mathnanto dasha bhrigavah |
agnirishe vasunam shuchiryo dharniresham |
priyan apidhinrvanishishta medhira a vanishishta medhirah ||
verses.en:
Even as they who sang forth hymns, addressed to heaven, the Bhrgus with their prayer and praise invited him, the Bhrgus rubbing, offering gifts.
For radiant Agni, Lord of all these treasures, is exceeding strong.
May he, the wise, accept the grateful coverings, the wise accept the coverings.

verses.sa:
विश्वासां त्वा विशां पतिं हवामहे सर्वासां समानं दम्पतिं भुजे सत्यगिर्वाहसं भुजे ।
अतिथिं मानुषाणां पितुर्न यस्यासया ।
अमी च विश्वे अमृतास आ वयो हव्या देवेष्वा वयः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasam tva visham patim havamahe sarvasam samanam dampatim bhuje satyagirvahasam bhuje |
atithim manushanam piturna yasyasaya |
ami cha vishve amritasa a vayo havya deveshva vayah ||
verses.en:
Thee we invoke, the Lord of all our settled homes, common to all, the household's guardian, to enjoy, bearer of true hymns, to enjoy.
Thee we invoke, the guest of men, by whose mouth, even as a sire's,
All these Immortals come to gain their food of life, oblations come to Gods as food.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सहसा सहन्तमः शुष्मिन्तमो जायसे देवतातये रयिर्न देवतातये ।
शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः ।
अध स्मा ते परि चरन्त्यजर श्रुष्टीवानो नाजर ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne sahasa sahantamah shushmintamo jayase devatataye rayirna devatataye |
shushmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuh |
adha sma te pari charantyajara shrushtivano najara ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, most victorious with thy conquering strength, most Mighty One, art born for service of the Gods, like wealth for service of the Gods.
Most mighty is thine ecstasy, most splendid is thy mental power.
Therefore men wait upon thee, undecaying One, like vassals, undecaying One.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे सहसा सहस्वत उषर्बुधे पशुषे नाग्नये स्तोमो बभूत्वग्नये ।
प्रति यदीं हविष्मान्विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे ।
अग्रे रेभो न जरत ऋषूणां जूर्णिर्होत ऋषूणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe sahasa sahasvata usharbudhe pashushe nagnaye stomo babhutvagnaye |
prati yadim havishmanvishvasu kshasu joguve |
agre rebho na jarata rishunam jurnirhota rishunam ||

verses.sa:
स नो नेदिष्ठं ददृशान आ भराग्ने देवेभिः सचनाः सुचेतुना महो रायः सुचेतुना ।
महि शविष्ठ नस्कृधि संचक्षे भुजे अस्यै ।
महि स्तोतृभ्यो मघवन्सुवीर्यं मथीरुग्रो न शवसा ॥
verses.rom:
sa no nedishtham dadrishana a bharagne devebhih sachanah suchetuna maho rayah suchetuna |
mahi shavishtha naskridhi samchakshe bhuje asyai |
mahi stotribhyo maghavansuviryam mathirugro na shavasa ||
verses.en:
Agni, beheld by us in nearest neighbourhood, accordant with the Gods, bring us, with gracious love, great riches with thy gracious love.
Give us O Mightiest, what is great, to see and to enjoy the earth.
As one of awful power, stir up heroic might for those who praise thee, Bounteous Lord!

verses.sa:
अयं जायत मनुषो धरीमणि होता यजिष्ठ उशिजामनु व्रतमग्निः स्वमनु व्रतम् ।
विश्वश्रुष्टिः सखीयते रयिरिव श्रवस्यते ।
अदब्धो होता नि षददिळस्पदे परिवीत इळस्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam jayata manusho dharimani hota yajishtha ushijamanu vratamagnih svamanu vratam |
vishvashrushtih sakhiyate rayiriva shravasyate |
adabdho hota ni shadadilaspade parivita ilaspade ||
verses.en:
By Manu's law was born this Agni, Priest most skilled, born for the holy work of those who yearn therefore, yea, born for his own holy work.
All ear to him who seeks his love and wealth to him who strives for fame,
Priest ne'er deceived, he sits in Ila's holy place, girt round in Ila's holy place.

verses.sa:
तं यज्ञसाधमपि वातयामस्यृतस्य पथा नमसा हविष्मता देवताता हविष्मता ।
स न ऊर्जामुपाभृत्यया कृपा न जूर्यति ।
यं मातरिश्वा मनवे परावतो देवं भाः परावतः ॥
verses.rom:
tam yajnasadhamapi vatayamasyritasya patha namasa havishmata devatata havishmata |
sa na urjamupabhrityaya kripa na juryati |
yam matarishva manave paravato devam bhah paravatah ||

verses.sa:
एवेन सद्यः पर्येति पार्थिवं मुहुर्गी रेतो वृषभः कनिक्रदद्दधद्रेतः कनिक्रदत् ।
शतं चक्षाणो अक्षभिर्देवो वनेषु तुर्वणिः ।
सदो दधान उपरेषु सानुष्वग्निः परेषु सानुषु ॥
verses.rom:
evena sadyah paryeti parthivam muhurgi reto vrishabhah kanikradaddadhadretah kanikradat |
shatam chakshano akshabhirdevo vaneshu turvanih |
sado dadhana upareshu sanushvagnih pareshu sanushu ||
verses.en:
In ordered course forthwith he traverses the earth, swift-swallowing, bellowing Steer, bearing the genial seed, bearing the seed and bellowing.
Observant with a hundred eyes the God is conqueror in the wood:
Agni, who hath his seat in broad plains here below, and in the high lands far away.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतुः पुरोहितो दमेदमेऽग्निर्यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य चेतति क्रत्वा यज्ञस्य चेतति ।
क्रत्वा वेधा इषूयते विश्वा जातानि पस्पशे ।
यतो घृतश्रीरतिथिरजायत वह्निर्वेधा अजायत ॥
verses.rom:
sa sukratuh purohito damedame'gniryajnasyadhvarasya chetati kratva yajnasya chetati |
kratva vedha ishuyate vishva jatani paspashe |
yato ghritashriratithirajayata vahnirvedha ajayata ||

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा यदस्य तविषीषु पृञ्चतेऽग्नेरवेण मरुतां न भोज्येषिराय न भोज्या ।
स हि ष्मा दानमिन्वति वसूनां च मज्मना ।
स नस्त्रासते दुरितादभिह्रुतः शंसादघादभिह्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kratva yadasya tavishishu princhate'gneravena marutam na bhojyeshiraya na bhojya |
sa hi shma danaminvati vasunam cha majmana |
sa nastrasate duritadabhihrutah shamsadaghadabhihrutah ||
verses.en:
When through his power and in his strong prevailing flames the Maruts' gladdening boons mingle with Agni's roar, boons gladdening for the active One,
Then he accelerates the gift, and by the greatness of his wealth,
Shall rescue us from overwhelming misery, from curse and overwhelming woe.

verses.sa:
विश्वो विहाया अरतिर्वसुर्दधे हस्ते दक्षिणे तरणिर्न शिश्रथच्छ्रवस्यया न शिश्रथत् ।
विश्वस्मा इदिषुध्यते देवत्रा हव्यमोहिषे ।
विश्वस्मा इत्सुकृते वारमृण्वत्यग्निर्द्वारा व्यृण्वति ॥
verses.rom:
vishvo vihaya aratirvasurdadhe haste dakshine taranirna shishrathachchhravasyaya na shishrathat |
vishvasma idishudhyate devatra havyamohishe |
vishvasma itsukrite varamrinvatyagnirdvara vyrinvati ||
verses.en:
Vast, universal, good he was made messenger; the speeder with his right hand hath not loosed his hold, through love of fame not loosed his hold.
He bears oblations to the Gods for whosoever supplicates.
Agni bestows a blessing on each pious man, and opens wide the doors for him.

verses.sa:
स मानुषे वृजने शंतमो हितोऽग्निर्यज्ञेषु जेन्यो न विश्पतिः प्रियो यज्ञेषु विश्पतिः ।
स हव्या मानुषाणामिळा कृतानि पत्यते ।
स नस्त्रासते वरुणस्य धूर्तेर्महो देवस्य धूर्तेः ॥
verses.rom:
sa manushe vrijane shamtamo hito'gniryajneshu jenyo na vishpatih priyo yajneshu vishpatih |
sa havya manushanamila kritani patyate |
sa nastrasate varunasya dhurtermaho devasya dhurteh ||
verses.en:
That Agni hath been set most kind in camp of men, in sacrifice like a Lord victorious, like a dear Lord in sacred rites.
His are the oblations of mankind when offered up at Ila's place.
He shall preserve us from Varuna's chastisement, yea, from the great God's chastisement.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारमीळते वसुधितिं प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं न्येरिरे हव्यवाहं न्येरिरे ।
विश्वायुं विश्ववेदसं होतारं यजतं कविम् ।
देवासो रण्वमवसे वसूयवो गीर्भी रण्वं वसूयवः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hotaramilate vasudhitim priyam chetishthamaratim nyerire havyavaham nyerire |
vishvayum vishvavedasam hotaram yajatam kavim |
devaso ranvamavase vasuyavo girbhi ranvam vasuyavah ||
verses.en:
Agni the Priest they supplicate to grant them wealth: him, dear, most thoughtful, have they made their messenger, him, offering-bearer have they made,
Beloved of all, who knoweth all, the Priest, the Holy one, the Sage--
Him, Friend, for help, the Gods when they are fain for wealth, him, Friend, with hymns, when fain for wealth.

verses.sa:
यं त्वं रथमिन्द्र मेधसातयेऽपाका सन्तमिषिर प्रणयसि प्रानवद्य नयसि ।
सद्यश्चित्तमभिष्टये करो वशश्च वाजिनम् ।
सास्माकमनवद्य तूतुजान वेधसामिमां वाचं न वेधसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam tvam rathamindra medhasataye'paka santamishira pranayasi pranavadya nayasi |
sadyashchittamabhishtaye karo vashashcha vajinam |
sasmakamanavadya tutujana vedhasamimam vacham na vedhasam ||
verses.en:
THE car which Indra, thou, for service of the Gods though it be far away, O swift One, bringest near, which, Blameless One, thou bringest near,
Place swiftly nigh us for our help: be it thy will that it be strong.
Blameless and active, hear this speech of orderers, this speech of us like orderers.

verses.sa:
स श्रुधि यः स्मा पृतनासु कासु चिद्दक्षाय्य इन्द्र भरहूतये नृभिरसि प्रतूर्तये नृभिः ।
यः शूरैः स्वः सनिता यो विप्रैर्वाजं तरुता ।
तमीशानास इरधन्त वाजिनं पृक्षमत्यं न वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa shrudhi yah sma pritanasu kasu chiddakshayya indra bharahutaye nribhirasi praturtaye nribhih |
yah shuraih svah sanita yo viprairvajam taruta |
tamishanasa iradhanta vajinam prikshamatyam na vajinam ||
verses.en:
Hear, Indra, thou whom men in every fight must call to show thy strength, for cry of battle with the men, with men of war for victory.
He who with heroes wins the light, who with the singers gains the prize,
Him the rich seek to gain even as a swift strong steed, even as a courser fleet and strong.

verses.sa:
दस्मो हि ष्मा वृषणं पिन्वसि त्वचं कं चिद्यावीरररुं शूर मर्त्यं परिवृणक्षि मर्त्यम् ।
इन्द्रोत तुभ्यं तद्दिवे तद्रुद्राय स्वयशसे ।
मित्राय वोचं वरुणाय सप्रथः सुमृळीकाय सप्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
dasmo hi shma vrishanam pinvasi tvacham kam chidyavirararum shura martyam parivrinakshi martyam |
indrota tubhyam taddive tadrudraya svayashase |
mitraya vocham varunaya saprathah sumrilikaya saprathah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Mighty, pourest forth the hide that holds the rain, thou keepest far away, Hero, the wicked man, thou shuttest out the wicked man.
Indra, to thee I sing, to Dyaus, to Rudra glorious in himself,
To Mitra, Varuna I sing a far-famed hymn to the kind God a far-famed hymn.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं व इन्द्रमुश्मसीष्टये सखायं विश्वायुं प्रासहं युजं वाजेषु प्रासहं युजम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्मोतयेऽवा पृत्सुषु कासु चित् ।
नहि त्वा शत्रु स्तरते स्तृणोषि यं विश्वं शत्रुं स्तृणोषि यम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam va indramushmasishtaye sakhayam vishvayum prasaham yujam vajeshu prasaham yujam |
asmakam brahmotaye'va pritsushu kasu chit |
nahi tva shatru starate strinoshi yam vishvam shatrum strinoshi yam ||
verses.en:
We wish our Indra here that he may further you, the Friend, beloved of all, the very strong ally, in wars the very strong ally
In all encounters strengthen thou our prayer to be a help to us.
No enemy--whom thou smitest down--subdueth thee, no enemy, whom thou smitest down.

verses.sa:
नि षू नमातिमतिं कयस्य चित्तेजिष्ठाभिररणिभिर्नोतिभिरुग्राभिरुग्रोतिभिः ।
नेषि णो यथा पुरानेनाः शूर मन्यसे ।
विश्वानि पूरोरप पर्षि वह्निरासा वह्निर्नो अच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
ni shu namatimatim kayasya chittejishthabhiraranibhirnotibhirugrabhirugrotibhih |
neshi no yatha puranenah shura manyase |
vishvani purorapa parshi vahnirasa vahnirno achchha ||
verses.en:
Bow down the overweening pride of every foe with succour like to kindling-wood in fiercest flame, with mighty succour, Mighty One.
Guide us, thou Hero, as of old, so art thou counted blameless still.
Thou drivest, as a Priest, all sins of man away, as Priest, in person, seeking us.

verses.sa:
प्र तद्वोचेयं भव्यायेन्दवे हव्यो न य इषवान्मन्म रेजति रक्षोहा मन्म रेजति ।
स्वयं सो अस्मदा निदो वधैरजेत दुर्मतिम् ।
अव स्रवेदघशंसोऽवतरमव क्षुद्रमिव स्रवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra tadvocheyam bhavyayendave havyo na ya ishavanmanma rejati rakshoha manma rejati |
svayam so asmada nido vadhairajeta durmatim |
ava sravedaghashamso'vataramava kshudramiva sravet ||
verses.en:
This may I utter to the present Soma-drop, which, meet to be invoked, with power, awakes the prayer, awakes the demon-slaying prayer.
May he himself with darts of death drive far from us the scorner's hate.
Far let him flee away who speaketh wickedness and vanish like a mote of dust.

verses.sa:
वनेम तद्धोत्रया चितन्त्या वनेम रयिं रयिवः सुवीर्यं रण्वं सन्तं सुवीर्यम् ।
दुर्मन्मानं सुमन्तुभिरेमिषा पृचीमहि ।
आ सत्याभिरिन्द्रं द्युम्नहूतिभिर्यजत्रं द्युम्नहूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vanema taddhotraya chitantya vanema rayim rayivah suviryam ranvam santam suviryam |
durmanmanam sumantubhiremisha prichimahi |
a satyabhirindram dyumnahutibhiryajatram dyumnahutibhih ||
verses.en:
By thoughtful invocation this may we obtain, obtain great wealth, O Wealthy One, with Hero sons, wealth that is sweet with hero sons.
Him who is wroth we pacify with sacred food and eulogies,
Indra the Holy with our calls inspired and true, the Holy One with calls inspired.

verses.sa:
प्रप्रा वो अस्मे स्वयशोभिरूती परिवर्ग इन्द्रो दुर्मतीनां दरीमन्दुर्मतीनाम् ।
स्वयं सा रिषयध्यै या न उपेषे अत्रैः ।
हतेमसन्न वक्षति क्षिप्ता जूर्णिर्न वक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
prapra vo asme svayashobhiruti parivarga indro durmatinam darimandurmatinam |
svayam sa rishayadhyai ya na upeshe atraih |
hatemasanna vakshati kshipta jurnirna vakshati ||
verses.en:
On, for your good and ours, come Indra with the aid of his own lordliness to drive the wicked hence, to rend the evil-hearted ones!
The weapon which devouring fiends cast at us shall destroy themselves.
Struck down, it shall not reach the mark; hurled forth, the fire-brand shall not strike.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र राया परीणसा याहि पथाँ अनेहसा पुरो याह्यरक्षसा ।
सचस्व नः पराक आ सचस्वास्तमीक आ ।
पाहि नो दूरादारादभिष्टिभिः सदा पाह्यभिष्टिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra raya parinasa yahi pathan anehasa puro yahyarakshasa |
sachasva nah paraka a sachasvastamika a |
pahi no duradaradabhishtibhih sada pahyabhishtibhih ||
verses.en:
With riches in abundance, Indra, come to us, come by an unobstructed path, come by a path from demons free.
Be with us when we stray afar, be with us when our home is nigh.
Protect us with thy help both near and far away: protect us ever with thy help.

verses.sa:
