त्वं न इन्द्र राया तरूषसोग्रं चित्त्वा महिमा सक्षदवसे महे मित्रं नावसे ।
ओजिष्ठ त्रातरविता रथं कं चिदमर्त्य ।
अन्यमस्मद्रिरिषेः कं चिदद्रिवो रिरिक्षन्तं चिदद्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra raya tarushasogram chittva mahima sakshadavase mahe mitram navase |
ojishtha trataravita ratham kam chidamartya |
anyamasmadririsheh kam chidadrivo ririkshantam chidadrivah ||
verses.en:
Thou art our own, O Indra, with victorious wealth: let might accompany thee, the Strong, to give us aid, like Mitra, to give mighty aid.
O strongest saviour, helper thou, Immortal! of each warrior's car.
Hurt thou another and not us, O Thunder-armed, one who would hurt, O Thunder-armed!

verses.sa:
पाहि न इन्द्र सुष्टुत स्रिधोऽवयाता सदमिद्दुर्मतीनां देवः सन्दुर्मतीनाम् ।
हन्ता पापस्य रक्षसस्त्राता विप्रस्य मावतः ।
अधा हि त्वा जनिता जीजनद्वसो रक्षोहणं त्वा जीजनद्वसो ॥
verses.rom:
pahi na indra sushtuta sridho'vayata sadamiddurmatinam devah sandurmatinam |
hanta papasya rakshasastrata viprasya mavatah |
adha hi tva janita jijanadvaso rakshohanam tva jijanadvaso ||

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याह्युप नः परावतो नायमच्छा विदथानीव सत्पतिरस्तं राजेव सत्पतिः ।
हवामहे त्वा वयं प्रयस्वन्तः सुते सचा ।
पुत्रासो न पितरं वाजसातये मंहिष्ठं वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahyupa nah paravato nayamachchha vidathaniva satpatirastam rajeva satpatih |
havamahe tva vayam prayasvantah sute sacha |
putraso na pitaram vajasataye mamhishtham vajasataye ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Indra, from afar, conducting us even as a lord of heroes to the gatherings, home, like a King, his heroes' lord.
We come with gifts of pleasant food, with juice poured forth, invoking thee,
As sons invite a sire, that thou mayst get thee strength thee, bounteousest, to get thee strength.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र सुवानमद्रिभिः कोशेन सिक्तमवतं न वंसगस्तातृषाणो न वंसगः ।
मदाय हर्यताय ते तुविष्टमाय धायसे ।
आ त्वा यच्छन्तु हरितो न सूर्यमहा विश्वेव सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
piba somamindra suvanamadribhih koshena siktamavatam na vamsagastatrishano na vamsagah |
madaya haryataya te tuvishtamaya dhayase |
a tva yachchhantu harito na suryamaha vishveva suryam ||
verses.en:
O Indra, drink the Soma juice pressed out with stones. poured from the reservoir, as an ox drinks the spring, a very thirsty bull the spring.
For the sweet draught that gladdens thee, for mightiest freshening of thy strength.
Let thy Bay Horses bring thee hither as the Sun, as every day they bring the Sun.

verses.sa:
अविन्दद्दिवो निहितं गुहा निधिं वेर्न गर्भं परिवीतमश्मन्यनन्ते अन्तरश्मनि ।
व्रजं वज्री गवामिव सिषासन्नङ्गिरस्तमः ।
अपावृणोदिष इन्द्रः परीवृता द्वार इषः परीवृताः ॥
verses.rom:
avindaddivo nihitam guha nidhim verna garbham parivitamashmanyanante antarashmani |
vrajam vajri gavamiva sishasannangirastamah |
apavrinodisha indrah parivrita dvara ishah parivritah ||

verses.sa:
दादृहाणो वज्रमिन्द्रो गभस्त्योः क्षद्मेव तिग्ममसनाय सं श्यदहिहत्याय सं श्यत् ।
संविव्यान ओजसा शवोभिरिन्द्र मज्मना ।
तष्टेव वृक्षं वनिनो नि वृश्चसि परश्वेव नि वृश्चसि ॥
verses.rom:
dadrihano vajramindro gabhastyoh kshadmeva tigmamasanaya sam shyadahihatyaya sam shyat |
samvivyana ojasa shavobhirindra majmana |
tashteva vriksham vanino ni vrishchasi parashveva ni vrishchasi ||
verses.en:
Grasping his thunderbolt with both hands, Indra made its edge most keen, for hurling, like a carving-knife for Ahi's slaughter made it keen.
Endued with majesty and strength, O Indra, and with lordly might,
Thou crashest down the trees, as when a craftsman fells, crashest them down as with an axe.

verses.sa:
त्वं वृथा नद्य इन्द्र सर्तवेऽच्छा समुद्रमसृजो रथाँ इव वाजयतो रथाँ इव ।
इत ऊतीरयुञ्जत समानमर्थमक्षितम् ।
धेनूरिव मनवे विश्वदोहसो जनाय विश्वदोहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vritha nadya indra sartave'chchha samudramasrijo rathan iva vajayato rathan iva |
ita utirayunjata samanamarthamakshitam |
dhenuriva manave vishvadohaso janaya vishvadohasah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, without effort hast let loose the floods to run their free course down,
like chariots, to the sea, like chariots showing forth their strength.
They, reaching hence away, have joined their strength for one eternal end,
Even as the cows who poured forth every thing for man, Yea, poured forth all things for mankind.

verses.sa:
इमां ते वाचं वसूयन्त आयवो रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षिषुः सुम्नाय त्वामतक्षिषुः ।
शुम्भन्तो जेन्यं यथा वाजेषु विप्र वाजिनम् ।
अत्यमिव शवसे सातये धना विश्वा धनानि सातये ॥
verses.rom:
imam te vacham vasuyanta ayavo ratham na dhirah svapa atakshishuh sumnaya tvamatakshishuh |
shumbhanto jenyam yatha vajeshu vipra vajinam |
atyamiva shavase sataye dhana vishva dhanani sataye ||

verses.sa:
भिनत्पुरो नवतिमिन्द्र पूरवे दिवोदासाय महि दाशुषे नृतो वज्रेण दाशुषे नृतो ।
अतिथिग्वाय शम्बरं गिरेरुग्रो अवाभरत् ।
महो धनानि दयमान ओजसा विश्वा धनान्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
bhinatpuro navatimindra purave divodasaya mahi dashushe nrito vajrena dashushe nrito |
atithigvaya shambaram girerugro avabharat |
maho dhanani dayamana ojasa vishva dhananyojasa ||
verses.en:
For Puru thou hast shattered, Indra ninety forts, for Divodasa thy boon servant with thy bolt, O Dancer, for thy worshipper.
For Atithigva he, the Strong, brought Sambara. from the mountain down,
Distributing the mighty treasures with his strength, parting all treasures with his strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः समत्सु यजमानमार्यं प्रावद्विश्वेषु शतमूतिराजिषु स्वर्मीळ्हेष्वाजिषु ।
मनवे शासदव्रतान्त्वचं कृष्णामरन्धयत् ।
दक्षन्न विश्वं ततृषाणमोषति न्यर्शसानमोषति ॥
verses.rom:
indrah samatsu yajamanamaryam pravadvishveshu shatamutirajishu svarmilheshvajishu |
manave shasadavratantvacham krishnamarandhayat |
dakshanna vishvam tatrishanamoshati nyarshasanamoshati ||

verses.sa:
सूरश्चक्रं प्र वृहज्जात ओजसा प्रपित्वे वाचमरुणो मुषायतीऽशान आ मुषायति ।
उशना यत्परावतोऽजगन्नूतये कवे ।
सुम्नानि विश्वा मनुषेव तुर्वणिरहा विश्वेव तुर्वणिः ॥
verses.rom:
surashchakram pra vrihajjata ojasa prapitve vachamaruno mushayati'shana a mushayati |
ushana yatparavato'jagannutaye kave |
sumnani vishva manusheva turvaniraha vishveva turvanih ||
verses.en:
Waxed strong in might at dawn he tore the Sun's wheel off. Bright red, he steals away their speech, the Lord of Power, their speech he steals away from them,
As thou with eager speed, O Sage, hast come from far away to help,
As winning for thine own all happiness of men, winning all happiness each day.

verses.sa:
स नो नव्येभिर्वृषकर्मन्नुक्थैः पुरां दर्तः पायुभिः पाहि शग्मैः ।
दिवोदासेभिरिन्द्र स्तवानो वावृधीथा अहोभिरिव द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no navyebhirvrishakarmannukthaih puram dartah payubhih pahi shagmaih |
divodasebhirindra stavano vavridhitha ahobhiriva dyauh ||
verses.en:
Lauded with our new hymns, O vigorous in deed, save us with strengthening help, thou Shatterer of the Forts!
Thou, Indra, praised by Divodasa's clansmen, as heaven grows great with days, shalt wax in glory.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय हि द्यौरसुरो अनम्नतेन्द्राय मही पृथिवी वरीमभिर्द्युम्नसाता वरीमभिः ।
इन्द्रं विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो दधिरे पुरः ।
इन्द्राय विश्वा सवनानि मानुषा रातानि सन्तु मानुषा ॥
verses.rom:
indraya hi dyaurasuro anamnatendraya mahi prithivi varimabhirdyumnasata varimabhih |
indram vishve sajoshaso devaso dadhire purah |
indraya vishva savanani manusha ratani santu manusha ||
verses.en:
To Indra Dyaus the Asura hath bowed him down, to Indra mighty Earth with wide-extending tracts, to win the light, with wide-spread tracts.
All Gods of one accord have set Indra in front preeminent.
For Indra all libations must be set apart, all man's libations set apart.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषु हि त्वा सवनेषु तुञ्जते समानमेकं वृषमण्यवः पृथक्स्वः सनिष्यवः पृथक् ।
तं त्वा नावं न पर्षणिं शूषस्य धुरि धीमहि ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैश्चितयन्त आयव स्तोमेभिरिन्द्रमायवः ॥
verses.rom:
vishveshu hi tva savaneshu tunjate samanamekam vrishamanyavah prithaksvah sanishyavah prithak |
tam tva navam na parshanim shushasya dhuri dhimahi |
indram na yajnaishchitayanta ayava stomebhirindramayavah ||
verses.en:
In all libations men with hero spirit urge the Universal One, each seeking several light, each fain to win the light apart.
Thee, furthering like a ship, will we set to the chariot-pole of strength,
As men who win with sacrifices Indra's thought, men who win Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa:
वि त्वा ततस्रे मिथुना अवस्यवो व्रजस्य साता गव्यस्य निःसृजः सक्षन्त इन्द्र निःसृजः ।
यद्गव्यन्ता द्वा जना स्वर्यन्ता समूहसि ।
आविष्करिक्रद्वृषणं सचाभुवं वज्रमिन्द्र सचाभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi tva tatasre mithuna avasyavo vrajasya sata gavyasya nihsrijah sakshanta indra nihsrijah |
yadgavyanta dva jana svaryanta samuhasi |
avishkarikradvrishanam sachabhuvam vajramindra sachabhuvam ||
verses.en:
Couples desirous of thine aid are storming thee, pouring their presents forth to win a stall of kine, pouring gifts, Indra, seeking thee.
When two men seeking spoil or heaven thou bringest face to face in war,
Thou showest, Indra, then the bolt thy constant friend, the Bull that ever waits on thee.

verses.sa:
विदुष्टे अस्य वीर्यस्य पूरवः पुरो यदिन्द्र शारदीरवातिरः सासहानो अवातिरः ।
शासस्तमिन्द्र मर्त्यमयज्युं शवसस्पते ।
महीममुष्णाः पृथिवीमिमा अपो मन्दसान इमा अपः ॥
verses.rom:
vidushte asya viryasya puravah puro yadindra sharadiravatirah sasahano avatirah |
shasastamindra martyamayajyum shavasaspate |
mahimamushnah prithivimima apo mandasana ima apah ||
verses.en:
This thine heroic power men of old time have known, wherewith thou breakest down, Indra, autumnal forts, breakest them down with conquering might.
Thou hast chastised, O Indra, Lord of Strength, the man who worships not,
And made thine own this great earth and these water-floods; with joyous heart these water-floods.

verses.sa:
आदित्ते अस्य वीर्यस्य चर्किरन्मदेषु वृषन्नुशिजो यदाविथ सखीयतो यदाविथ ।
चकर्थ कारमेभ्यः पृतनासु प्रवन्तवे ।
ते अन्यामन्यां नद्यं सनिष्णत श्रवस्यन्तः सनिष्णत ॥
verses.rom:
aditte asya viryasya charkiranmadeshu vrishannushijo yadavitha sakhiyato yadavitha |
chakartha karamebhyah pritanasu pravantave |
te anyamanyam nadyam sanishnata shravasyantah sanishnata ||
verses.en:
And they have bruited far this hero-might when thou, O Strong One, in thy joy helpest thy suppliants, who sought to win thee for their Friend.
Their battle-cry thou madest sound victorious in the shocks of war.
One stream after another have they gained from thee, eager for glory have they gained.

verses.sa:
उतो नो अस्या उषसो जुषेत ह्यर्कस्य बोधि हविषो हवीमभिः स्वर्षाता हवीमभिः ।
यदिन्द्र हन्तवे मृधो वृषा वज्रिञ्चिकेतसि ।
आ मे अस्य वेधसो नवीयसो मन्म श्रुधि नवीयसः ॥
verses.rom:
uto no asya ushaso jusheta hyarkasya bodhi havisho havimabhih svarshata havimabhih |
yadindra hantave mridho vrisha vajrinchiketasi |
a me asya vedhaso naviyaso manma shrudhi naviyasah ||
verses.en:
Also this morn may he be well inclined to us, mark at our call our offerings and our song of praise, our call that we may win the light.
As thou, O Indra Thunder-armed, wilt, as the Strong One, slay the foe,
Listen thou to the prayer of me a later sage, hear thou a later sage's prayer.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र वावृधानो अस्मयुरमित्रयन्तं तुविजात मर्त्यं वज्रेण शूर मर्त्यम् ।
जहि यो नो अघायति शृणुष्व सुश्रवस्तमः ।
रिष्टं न यामन्नप भूतु दुर्मतिर्विश्वाप भूतु दुर्मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tamindra vavridhano asmayuramitrayantam tuvijata martyam vajrena shura martyam |
jahi yo no aghayati shrinushva sushravastamah |
rishtam na yamannapa bhutu durmatirvishvapa bhutu durmatih ||
verses.en:
O Indra, waxen strong and well-inclined to us, thou very mighty, slay the man that is our foe, slay the man, Hero! with thy bolt.
Slay thou the man who injures us: hear thou, as readiest, to hear.
Far be malignity, like mischief on the march, afar be all malignity.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं मघवन्पूर्व्ये धन इन्द्रत्वोताः सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतः ।
नेदिष्ठे अस्मिन्नहन्यधि वोचा नु सुन्वते ।
अस्मिन्यज्ञे वि चयेमा भरे कृतं वाजयन्तो भरे कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam maghavanpurvye dhana indratvotah sasahyama pritanyato vanuyama vanushyatah |
nedishthe asminnahanyadhi vocha nu sunvate |
asminyajne vi chayema bhare kritam vajayanto bhare kritam ||
verses.en:
HELPED, Indra Maghavan, by thee in war of old, may we subdue in fight the men who strive with us, conquer the men who war with us.
This day that now is close at hand bless him who pours the Soma juice.
In this our sacrifice may we divide the spoil, showing our strength, the spoil of war.

verses.sa:
स्वर्जेषे भर आप्रस्य वक्मन्युषर्बुधः स्वस्मिन्नञ्जसि क्राणस्य स्वस्मिन्नञ्जसि ।
अहन्निन्द्रो यथा विदे शीर्ष्णाशीर्ष्णोपवाच्यः ।
अस्मत्रा ते सध्र्यक्सन्तु रातयो भद्रा भद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
svarjeshe bhara aprasya vakmanyusharbudhah svasminnanjasi kranasya svasminnanjasi |
ahannindro yatha vide shirshnashirshnopavachyah |
asmatra te sadhryaksantu ratayo bhadra bhadrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
In war which wins the light, at the free-giver's call, at due oblation of the early-rising one, oblation of the active one,
Indra slew, even as we know--whom each bowed head must reverence.
May all thy bounteous gifts be gathered up for us, yea, the good gifts of thee the Good.

verses.sa:
तत्तु प्रयः प्रत्नथा ते शुशुक्वनं यस्मिन्यज्ञे वारमकृण्वत क्षयमृतस्य वारसि क्षयम् ।
वि तद्वोचेरध द्वितान्तः पश्यन्ति रश्मिभिः ।
स घा विदे अन्विन्द्रो गवेषणो बन्धुक्षिद्भ्यो गवेषणः ॥
verses.rom:
tattu prayah pratnatha te shushukvanam yasminyajne varamakrinvata kshayamritasya varasi kshayam |
vi tadvocheradha dvitantah pashyanti rashmibhih |
sa gha vide anvindro gaveshano bandhukshidbhyo gaveshanah ||
verses.en:
This food glows for thee as of old at sacrifice, wherein they made thee chooser of the place, for thou choosest the place of sacrifice.
Speak thou and make it known to us: they see within with beams of light.
Indra, indeed, is found a seeker after spoil, spoil-seeker for his own allies.

verses.sa:
नू इत्था ते पूर्वथा च प्रवाच्यं यदङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरप व्रजमिन्द्र शिक्षन्नप व्रजम् ।
ऐभ्यः समान्या दिशास्मभ्यं जेषि योत्सि च ।
सुन्वद्भ्यो रन्धया कं चिदव्रतं हृणायन्तं चिदव्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
nu ittha te purvatha cha pravachyam yadangirobhyo'vrinorapa vrajamindra shikshannapa vrajam |
aibhyah samanya dishasmabhyam jeshi yotsi cha |
sunvadbhyo randhaya kam chidavratam hrinayantam chidavratam ||
verses.en:
So now must thy great deed be lauded as of old, when for the Angirases thou openedst the stall, openedst, giving aid, the stall.
In the same manner for us here fight thou and be victorious:
To him who pours the juice give up the lawless man, the lawless who is wroth with us.

verses.sa:
सं यज्जनान्क्रतुभिः शूर ईक्षयद्धने हिते तरुषन्त श्रवस्यवः प्र यक्षन्त श्रवस्यवः ।
तस्मा आयुः प्रजावदिद्बाधे अर्चन्त्योजसा ।
इन्द्र ओक्यं दिधिषन्त धीतयो देवाँ अच्छा न धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
sam yajjanankratubhih shura ikshayaddhane hite tarushanta shravasyavah pra yakshanta shravasyavah |
tasma ayuh prajavadidbadhe archantyojasa |
indra okyam didhishanta dhitayo devan achchha na dhitayah ||
verses.en:
When with wise plan the Hero leads the people forth, they conquer in the ordered battle, seeking fame, press, eager, onward seeking fame.
To him in time of need they sing for life with offspring and with strength.
Their hymns with Indra find a welcome place of rest: the hymns go forward to the Gods.

verses.sa:
युवं तमिन्द्रापर्वता पुरोयुधा यो नः पृतन्यादप तंतमिद्धतं वज्रेण तंतमिद्धतम् ।
दूरे चत्ताय च्छन्त्सद्गहनं यदिनक्षत् ।
अस्माकं शत्रून्परि शूर विश्वतो दर्मा दर्षीष्ट विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam tamindraparvata puroyudha yo nah pritanyadapa tamtamiddhatam vajrena tamtamiddhatam |
dure chattaya chchhantsadgahanam yadinakshat |
asmakam shatrunpari shura vishvato darma darshishta vishvatah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Parvata, our champions in the fight, drive ye away each man who fain would war with us, drive him far from us with the bolt.
Welcome to him concealed afar shall he the lair that he hath found.
So may the Render rend our foes on every side, rend them, O Hero, everywhere.

verses.sa:
उभे पुनामि रोदसी ऋतेन द्रुहो दहामि सं महीरनिन्द्राः ।
अभिव्लग्य यत्र हता अमित्रा वैलस्थानं परि तृळ्हा अशेरन् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe punami rodasi ritena druho dahami sam mahiranindrah |
abhivlagya yatra hata amitra vailasthanam pari trilha asheran ||
verses.en:
WITH sacrifice I purge both earth and heaven: I burn up great she-fiends who serve not Indra,
Where throttled by thy hand the foes were slaughtered, and in the pit of death lay pierced and mangled.

verses.sa:
अभिव्लग्या चिदद्रिवः शीर्षा यातुमतीनाम् ।
छिन्धि वटूरिणा पदा महावटूरिणा पदा ॥
verses.rom:
abhivlagya chidadrivah shirsha yatumatinam |
chhindhi vaturina pada mahavaturina pada ||
verses.en:
O thou who castest forth the stones crushing the sorceresses' heads,
Break them with thy wide-spreading foot, with thy wide-spreading mighty foot.

verses.sa:
अवासां मघवञ्जहि शर्धो यातुमतीनाम् ।
वैलस्थानके अर्मके महावैलस्थे अर्मके ॥
verses.rom:
avasam maghavanjahi shardho yatumatinam |
vailasthanake armake mahavailasthe armake ||
verses.en:
Do thou, O Maghavan, beat off these sorceresses' daring strength.
Cast them within the narrow pit. within the deep and narrow pit.

verses.sa:
यासां तिस्रः पञ्चाशतोऽभिव्लङ्गैरपावपः ।
तत्सु ते मनायति तकत्सु ते मनायति ॥
verses.rom:
yasam tisrah panchashato'bhivlangairapavapah |
tatsu te manayati takatsu te manayati ||
verses.en:
Of whom thou hast ere now destroyed thrice-fifty with thy fierce attacks.
That deed they count a glorious deed, though small to thee, a glorious deed.

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गभृष्टिमम्भृणं पिशाचिमिन्द्र सं मृण ।
सर्वं रक्षो नि बर्हय ॥
verses.rom:
pishangabhrishtimambhrinam pishachimindra sam mrina |
sarvam raksho ni barhaya ||
verses.en:
O Indra, crush and bray to bits the fearful fiery-weaponed fiend:
Strike every demon to the ground.

verses.sa:
अवर्मह इन्द्र दादृहि श्रुधी नः शुशोच हि द्यौः क्षा न भीषाँ अद्रिवो घृणान्न भीषाँ अद्रिवः ।
शुष्मिन्तमो हि शुष्मिभिर्वधैरुग्रेभिरीयसे ।
अपूरुषघ्नो अप्रतीत शूर सत्वभिस्त्रिसप्तैः शूर सत्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
avarmaha indra dadrihi shrudhi nah shushocha hi dyauh ksha na bhishan adrivo ghrinanna bhishan adrivah |
shushmintamo hi shushmibhirvadhairugrebhiriyase |
apurushaghno apratita shura satvabhistrisaptaih shura satvabhih ||
verses.en:
Tear down the mighty ones. O Indra, hear thou us. For heaven hath glowed like earth in fear, O Thunder-armed, as dreading fierce heat, Thunder-armed!
Most Mighty mid the Mighty Ones thou speedest with strong bolts of death,
Not slaying men, unconquered Hero with the brave, O Hero, with the thrice-seven brave.

verses.sa:
वनोति हि सुन्वन्क्षयं परीणसः सुन्वानो हि ष्मा यजत्यव द्विषो देवानामव द्विषः ।
सुन्वान इत्सिषासति सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः ।
सुन्वानायेन्द्रो ददात्याभुवं रयिं ददात्याभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vanoti hi sunvankshayam parinasah sunvano hi shma yajatyava dvisho devanamava dvishah |
sunvana itsishasati sahasra vajyavritah |
sunvanayendro dadatyabhuvam rayim dadatyabhuvam ||
verses.en:
The pourer of libations gains the home of wealth, pouring his gift conciliates hostilities, yea, the hostilities of Gods.
Pouring, he strives, unchecked and strong, to win him riches thousandfold.
Indra gives lasting wealth to him who pours forth gifts, yea, wealth he gives that long shall last.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा जुवो रारहाणा अभि प्रयो वायो वहन्त्विह पूर्वपीतये सोमस्य पूर्वपीतये ।
ऊर्ध्वा ते अनु सूनृता मनस्तिष्ठतु जानती ।
नियुत्वता रथेना याहि दावने वायो मखस्य दावने ॥
verses.rom:
a tva juvo rarahana abhi prayo vayo vahantviha purvapitaye somasya purvapitaye |
urdhva te anu sunrita manastishthatu janati |
niyutvata rathena yahi davane vayo makhasya davane ||
verses.en:
Vayu, let fleet-foot coursers bring thee speedily to this our feast, to drink first of the juice we pour, to the first draught of Soma juice.
May our glad hymn, discerning well, uplifted, gratify thy mind.
Come with thy team-drawn car, O Vayu, to the gift, come to the sacrificer's gift.

verses.sa:
मन्दन्तु त्वा मन्दिनो वायविन्दवोऽस्मत्क्राणासः सुकृता अभिद्यवो गोभिः क्राणा अभिद्यवः ।
यद्ध क्राणा इरध्यै दक्षं सचन्त ऊतयः ।
सध्रीचीना नियुतो दावने धिय उप ब्रुवत ईं धियः ॥
verses.rom:
mandantu tva mandino vayavindavo'smatkranasah sukrita abhidyavo gobhih krana abhidyavah |
yaddha krana iradhyai daksham sachanta utayah |
sadhrichina niyuto davane dhiya upa bruvata im dhiyah ||

verses.sa:
वायुर्युङ्क्ते रोहिता वायुररुणा वायू रथे अजिरा धुरि वोळ्हवे वहिष्ठा धुरि वोळ्हवे ।
प्र बोधया पुरंधिं जार आ ससतीमिव ।
प्र चक्षय रोदसी वासयोषसः श्रवसे वासयोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
vayuryunkte rohita vayuraruna vayu rathe ajira dhuri volhave vahishtha dhuri volhave |
pra bodhaya puramdhim jara a sasatimiva |
pra chakshaya rodasi vasayoshasah shravase vasayoshasah ||
verses.en:
Two red steeds Vayu yokes, Vayu two purple steeds, swift-footed, to the chariot, to the pole to draw, most able, at the pole, to draw.
Wake up intelligence, as when a lover wakes his sleeping love.
Illumine heaven and earth, make thou the Dawns to shine, for glory make the Dawns to shine.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमुषासः शुचयः परावति भद्रा वस्त्रा तन्वते दंसु रश्मिषु चित्रा नव्येषु रश्मिषु ।
तुभ्यं धेनुः सबर्दुघा विश्वा वसूनि दोहते ।
अजनयो मरुतो वक्षणाभ्यो दिव आ वक्षणाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyamushasah shuchayah paravati bhadra vastra tanvate damsu rashmishu chitra navyeshu rashmishu |
tubhyam dhenuh sabardugha vishva vasuni dohate |
ajanayo maruto vakshanabhyo diva a vakshanabhyah ||
verses.en:
For thee the radiant Dawns in the far-distant sky broaden their lovely garments forth in wondrous beams, bright-coloured in their new-born beams.
For thee the nectar-yielding Cow pours all rich treasures forth as milk.
The Marut host hast thou engendered from the womb, the Maruts from the womb of heaven.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं शुक्रासः शुचयस्तुरण्यवो मदेषूग्रा इषणन्त भुर्वण्यपामिषन्त भुर्वणि ।
त्वां त्सारी दसमानो भगमीट्टे तक्ववीये ।
त्वं विश्वस्माद्भुवनात्पासि धर्मणासुर्यात्पासि धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam shukrasah shuchayasturanyavo madeshugra ishananta bhurvanyapamishanta bhurvani |
tvam tsari dasamano bhagamitte takvaviye |
tvam vishvasmadbhuvanatpasi dharmanasuryatpasi dharmana ||
verses.en:
For thee the pure bright quickly-flowing Soma-drops, strong in their heightening power, hasten to mix themselves, hasten to the water to be mixed.
To thee the weary coward prays for luck that he may speed away.
Thou by thy law protectest us from every world, yea, from the world of highest Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो वायवेषामपूर्व्यः सोमानां प्रथमः पीतिमर्हसि सुतानां पीतिमर्हसि ।
उतो विहुत्मतीनां विशां ववर्जुषीणाम् ।
विश्वा इत्ते धेनवो दुह्र आशिरं घृतं दुह्रत आशिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no vayaveshamapurvyah somanam prathamah pitimarhasi sutanam pitimarhasi |
uto vihutmatinam visham vavarjushinam |
vishva itte dhenavo duhra ashiram ghritam duhrata ashiram ||
verses.en:
Thou, Vayu, who hast none before thee, first of all hast right to drink these offerings of Soma juice, hast right to drink the juice out-poured,
Yea, poured by all invoking tribes who free themselves from taint of sin,
For thee all cows are milked to yield the Soma-milk, to yield the butter and the milk.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णं बर्हिरुप नो याहि वीतये सहस्रेण नियुता नियुत्वते शतिनीभिर्नियुत्वते ।
तुभ्यं हि पूर्वपीतये देवा देवाय येमिरे ।
प्र ते सुतासो मधुमन्तो अस्थिरन्मदाय क्रत्वे अस्थिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
stirnam barhirupa no yahi vitaye sahasrena niyuta niyutvate shatinibhirniyutvate |
tubhyam hi purvapitaye deva devaya yemire |
pra te sutaso madhumanto asthiranmadaya kratve asthiran ||
verses.en:
STREWN is the sacred grass; come Vayu, to our feast, with team of thousands, come, Lord of the harnessed team, with hundreds, Lord of harnessed steeds!
The drops divine are lifted up for thee, the God, to drink them first.
The juices rich in sweets have raised them for thy joy, have raised themselves to give thee strength.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यायं सोमः परिपूतो अद्रिभि स्पार्हा वसानः परि कोशमर्षति शुक्रा वसानो अर्षति ।
तवायं भाग आयुषु सोमो देवेषु हूयते ।
वह वायो नियुतो याह्यस्मयुर्जुषाणो याह्यस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyayam somah pariputo adribhi sparha vasanah pari koshamarshati shukra vasano arshati |
tavayam bhaga ayushu somo deveshu huyate |
vaha vayo niyuto yahyasmayurjushano yahyasmayuh ||
verses.en:
Purified by the stones the Soma flows for thee, clothed with its lovely splendours, to the reservoir, flows clad in its refulgent light.
For thee the Soma is poured forth, thy portioned share mid Gods and men.
Drive thou thy horses, Vayu, come to us with love, come well-inclined and loving us.

verses.sa:
आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि वीतये वायो हव्यानि वीतये ।
तवायं भाग ऋत्वियः सरश्मिः सूर्ये सचा ।
अध्वर्युभिर्भरमाणा अयंसत वायो शुक्रा अयंसत ॥
verses.rom:
a no niyudbhih shatinibhiradhvaram sahasrinibhirupa yahi vitaye vayo havyani vitaye |
tavayam bhaga ritviyah sarashmih surye sacha |
adhvaryubhirbharamana ayamsata vayo shukra ayamsata ||
verses.en:
Come thou with hundreds, come with thousands in thy team to this our solemn rite, to taste the sacred food, Vayu, to taste the offerings.
This is thy seasonable share, that comes co-radiant with the Sun.
Brought by attendant priests pure juice is offered up, Vayu, pure juice is offered up.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो नियुत्वान्वक्षदवसेऽभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि वीतये वायो हव्यानि वीतये ।
पिबतं मध्वो अन्धसः पूर्वपेयं हि वां हितम् ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण राधसा गतमिन्द्रश्च राधसा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratho niyutvanvakshadavase'bhi prayamsi sudhitani vitaye vayo havyani vitaye |
pibatam madhvo andhasah purvapeyam hi vam hitam |
vayava chandrena radhasa gatamindrashcha radhasa gatam ||
verses.en:
The chariot with its team of horses bring you both, to guard us and to taste the well-appointed food, Vayu, to taste the offerings!
Drink of the pleasant-flavoured juice: the first draught is assigned to you.
O Vayu, with your splendid bounty come ye both, Indra, with bounty come ye both.

verses.sa:
आ वां धियो ववृत्युरध्वराँ उपेममिन्दुं मर्मृजन्त वाजिनमाशुमत्यं न वाजिनम् ।
तेषां पिबतमस्मयू आ नो गन्तमिहोत्या ।
इन्द्रवायू सुतानामद्रिभिर्युवं मदाय वाजदा युवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vam dhiyo vavrityuradhvaran upemamindum marmrijanta vajinamashumatyam na vajinam |
tesham pibatamasmayu a no gantamihotya |
indravayu sutanamadribhiryuvam madaya vajada yuvam ||
verses.en:
May our songs bring you hither to our solemn rites: these drops of mighty vigour have they beautified, like a swift steed of mighty strength.
Drink of them well-inclined to us, come hitherward to be our help.
Drink, Indra-Vayu, of these Juices pressed with stones, Strength-givers! till they gladden you.

verses.sa:
इमे वां सोमा अप्स्वा सुता इहाध्वर्युभिर्भरमाणा अयंसत वायो शुक्रा अयंसत ।
एते वामभ्यसृक्षत तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।
युवायवोऽति रोमाण्यव्यया सोमासो अत्यव्यया ॥
verses.rom:
ime vam soma apsva suta ihadhvaryubhirbharamana ayamsata vayo shukra ayamsata |
ete vamabhyasrikshata tirah pavitramashavah |
yuvayavo'ti romanyavyaya somaso atyavyaya ||
verses.en:
These Soma juices pressed for you in waters here, borne by attendant priests, are offered up to you: bright, Vayu, are they offered up.
Swift through the strainer have they flowed, and here are shed for both of you,
Soma-drops, fain for you, over the wether's fleece, Somas over the wether's fleece.

verses.sa:
अति वायो ससतो याहि शश्वतो यत्र ग्रावा वदति तत्र गच्छतं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गच्छतम् ।
वि सूनृता ददृशे रीयते घृतमा पूर्णया नियुता याथो अध्वरमिन्द्रश्च याथो अध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ati vayo sasato yahi shashvato yatra grava vadati tatra gachchhatam grihamindrashcha gachchhatam |
vi sunrita dadrishe riyate ghritama purnaya niyuta yatho adhvaramindrashcha yatho adhvaram ||
verses.en:
O Vayu, pass thou over all the slumberers, and where the press-stone rings enter ye both that house, yea, Indra, go ye both within.
The joyous Maiden is beheld, the butter flows. With richly laden team come to our solemn rite, yea, Indra, come ye to the rite.

verses.sa:
अत्राह तद्वहेथे मध्व आहुतिं यमश्वत्थमुपतिष्ठन्त जायवोऽस्मे ते सन्तु जायवः ।
साकं गावः सुवते पच्यते यवो न ते वाय उप दस्यन्ति धेनवो नाप दस्यन्ति धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
atraha tadvahethe madhva ahutim yamashvatthamupatishthanta jayavo'sme te santu jayavah |
sakam gavah suvate pachyate yavo na te vaya upa dasyanti dhenavo napa dasyanti dhenavah ||
verses.en:
Ride hither to the offering of the pleasant juice, the holy Fig-tree which victorious priests surround: victorious be they still for us.
At once the cows yield milk, the barley-meal is dressed. For thee,
O Vayu, never shall the cows grow thin, never for thee shall they be dry.

verses.sa:
इमे ये ते सु वायो बाह्वोजसोऽन्तर्नदी ते पतयन्त्युक्षणो महि व्राधन्त उक्षणः ।
धन्वञ्चिद्ये अनाशवो जीराश्चिदगिरौकसः ।
सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो दुर्नियन्तवो हस्तयोर्दुर्नियन्तवः ॥
verses.rom:
ime ye te su vayo bahvojaso'ntarnadi te patayantyukshano mahi vradhanta ukshanah |
dhanvanchidye anashavo jirashchidagiraukasah |
suryasyeva rashmayo durniyantavo hastayordurniyantavah ||
verses.en:
These Bulls of thine, O Vayu with the arm of strength, who swiftly fly within the current of thy stream, the Bulls increasing in their might,
Horseless, yet even through the waste swift-moving, whom no shout can stay,
Hard to be checked are they, like sunbeams, in their course. hard to be checked by both the hands.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ज्येष्ठं निचिराभ्यां बृहन्नमो हव्यं मतिं भरता मृळयद्भ्यां स्वादिष्ठं मृळयद्भ्याम् ।
ता सम्राजा घृतासुती यज्ञेयज्ञ उपस्तुता ।
अथैनोः क्षत्रं न कुतश्चनाधृषे देवत्वं नू चिदाधृषे ॥
verses.rom:
pra su jyeshtham nichirabhyam brihannamo havyam matim bharata mrilayadbhyam svadishtham mrilayadbhyam |
ta samraja ghritasuti yajneyajna upastuta |
athainoh kshatram na kutashchanadhrishe devatvam nu chidadhrishe ||
verses.en:
BRING adoration ample and most excellent, hymn, offerings, to the watchful Twain, the bountiful, your sweetest to the bounteous Ones.
Sovrans adored with streams of oil and praised at every sacrifice.
Their high imperial might may nowhere be assailed, ne'er may their Godhead be assailed.

verses.sa:
अदर्शि गातुरुरवे वरीयसी पन्था ऋतस्य समयंस्त रश्मिभिश्चक्षुर्भगस्य रश्मिभिः ।
द्युक्षं मित्रस्य सादनमर्यम्णो वरुणस्य च ।
अथा दधाते बृहदुक्थ्यं वय उपस्तुत्यं बृहद्वयः ॥
verses.rom:
adarshi gatururave variyasi pantha ritasya samayamsta rashmibhishchakshurbhagasya rashmibhih |
dyuksham mitrasya sadanamaryamno varunasya cha |
atha dadhate brihadukthyam vaya upastutyam brihadvayah ||
verses.en:
For the broad Sun was seen a path more widely laid, the path of holy law hath been maintained with rays, the eye with Bhaga's rays of light.
Firm-set in heaven is Mitra's home, and Aryaman's and Varuna's.
Thence they give forth great vital strength which merits praise, high power of life that men shall praise.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिष्मतीमदितिं धारयत्क्षितिं स्वर्वतीमा सचेते दिवेदिवे जागृवांसा दिवेदिवे ।
ज्योतिष्मत्क्षत्रमाशाते आदित्या दानुनस्पती ।
मित्रस्तयोर्वरुणो यातयज्जनोऽर्यमा यातयज्जनः ॥
verses.rom:
jyotishmatimaditim dharayatkshitim svarvatima sachete divedive jagrivamsa divedive |
jyotishmatkshatramashate aditya danunaspati |
mitrastayorvaruno yatayajjano'ryama yatayajjanah ||
verses.en:
With Aditi the luminous, the celestial, upholder of the people, come ye day by day, ye who watch sleepless, day by day.
Resplendent might have ye obtained, Adityas, Lords of liberal gifts.
Movers of men, mild both, are Mitra, Varuna, mover of men is Aryaman.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः सोमो भूत्ववपानेष्वाभगो देवो देवेष्वाभगः ।
तं देवासो जुषेरत विश्वे अद्य सजोषसः ।
तथा राजाना करथो यदीमह ऋतावाना यदीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam mitraya varunaya shamtamah somo bhutvavapaneshvabhago devo deveshvabhagah |
tam devaso jusherata vishve adya sajoshasah |
tatha rajana karatho yadimaha ritavana yadimahe ||
verses.en:
This Soma be most sweet to Mitra, Varuna: he in the drinking-feasts, shall have a share thereof, sharing, a God, among the Gods.
May all the Gods of one accord accept it joyfully to-day.
Therefore do ye, O Kings, accomplish what we ask, ye Righteous Ones, whate'er we ask.

verses.sa:
यो मित्राय वरुणायाविधज्जनोऽनर्वाणं तं परि पातो अंहसो दाश्वांसं मर्तमंहसः ।
तमर्यमाभि रक्षत्यृजूयन्तमनु व्रतम् ।
उक्थैर्य एनोः परिभूषति व्रतं स्तोमैराभूषति व्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo mitraya varunayavidhajjano'narvanam tam pari pato amhaso dashvamsam martamamhasah |
tamaryamabhi rakshatyrijuyantamanu vratam |
ukthairya enoh paribhushati vratam stomairabhushati vratam ||
verses.en:
Whoso, with worship serves Mitra and Varuna, him guard ye carefully, uninjured, from distress, guard from distress the liberal man.
Aryaman guards him well who acts uprightly following his law,
Who beautifies their service with his lauds, who makes it beautiful with songs of praise.

verses.sa:
नमो दिवे बृहते रोदसीभ्यां मित्राय वोचं वरुणाय मीळ्हुषे सुमृळीकाय मीळ्हुषे ।
इन्द्रमग्निमुप स्तुहि द्युक्षमर्यमणं भगम् ।
ज्योग्जीवन्तः प्रजया सचेमहि सोमस्योती सचेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
namo dive brihate rodasibhyam mitraya vocham varunaya milhushe sumrilikaya milhushe |
indramagnimupa stuhi dyukshamaryamanam bhagam |
jyogjivantah prajaya sachemahi somasyoti sachemahi ||
verses.en:
Worship will I profess to lofty Dyaus, to Heaven and Earth, to Mitra and to bounteous Varuna, the Bounteous, the Compassionate.
Praise Indra, praise thou Agni, praise Bhaga and heavenly Aryaman.
Long may we live and have attendant progeny, have progeny with Soma's help.

verses.sa:
ऊती देवानां वयमिन्द्रवन्तो मंसीमहि स्वयशसो मरुद्भिः ।
अग्निर्मित्रो वरुणः शर्म यंसन्तदश्याम मघवानो वयं च ॥
verses.rom:
uti devanam vayamindravanto mamsimahi svayashaso marudbhih |
agnirmitro varunah sharma yamsantadashyama maghavano vayam cha ||
verses.en:
With the Gods' help, with Indra still beside us, may we be held self-splendid with the Maruts.
May Agni, Mitra, Varuna give us shelter this may we gain, we and our wealthy princes.

verses.sa:
सुषुमा यातमद्रिभिर्गोश्रीता मत्सरा इमे सोमासो मत्सरा इमे ।
आ राजाना दिविस्पृशास्मत्रा गन्तमुप नः ।
इमे वां मित्रावरुणा गवाशिरः सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
sushuma yatamadribhirgoshrita matsara ime somaso matsara ime |
a rajana divisprishasmatra gantamupa nah |
ime vam mitravaruna gavashirah somah shukra gavashirah ||
verses.en:
WITH stones have we pressed out: O come; these gladdening drops are blent with milk, these Soma-drops which gladden you.
Come to us, Kings who reach to heaven, approach us, coming hitherward.
These milky drops are yours, Mitra and Varuna, bright Soma juices blent with milk.

verses.sa:
इम आ यातमिन्दवः सोमासो दध्याशिरः सुतासो दध्याशिरः ।
उत वामुषसो बुधि साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ।
सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय पीतये चारुरृताय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ima a yatamindavah somaso dadhyashirah sutaso dadhyashirah |
uta vamushaso budhi sakam suryasya rashmibhih |
suto mitraya varunaya pitaye charurritaya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Here are the droppings; come ye nigh the Soma-droppings blent with curd, juices expressed and blent with curd.
Now for the wakening of your Dawn together with the Sun-God's rays,
juice waits for Mitra and for Varuna to drink, fair juice for drink, for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तां वां धेनुं न वासरीमंशुं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः सोमं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
अस्मत्रा गन्तमुप नोऽर्वाञ्चा सोमपीतये ।
अयं वां मित्रावरुणा नृभिः सुतः सोम आ पीतये सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vam dhenum na vasarimamshum duhantyadribhih somam duhantyadribhih |
asmatra gantamupa no'rvancha somapitaye |
ayam vam mitravaruna nribhih sutah soma a pitaye sutah ||
verses.en:
As 'twere a radiant-coloured cow, they milk with stones the stalk for you, with stones they milk the Soma-plant.
May ye come nigh us, may ye turn hither to drink the Soma juice.
The men pressed out this juice, Mitra and Varuna, pressed out this Soma for your drink.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र पूष्णस्तुविजातस्य शस्यते महित्वमस्य तवसो न तन्दते स्तोत्रमस्य न तन्दते ।
अर्चामि सुम्नयन्नहमन्त्यूतिं मयोभुवम् ।
विश्वस्य यो मन आयुयुवे मखो देव आयुयुवे मखः ॥
verses.rom:
prapra pushnastuvijatasya shasyate mahitvamasya tavaso na tandate stotramasya na tandate |
archami sumnayannahamantyutim mayobhuvam |
vishvasya yo mana ayuyuve makho deva ayuyuve makhah ||
verses.en:
STRONG Pusan's majesty is lauded evermore, the glory of his lordly might is never faint, his song of praise is never faint.
Seeking felicity I laud him nigh to help, the source, of bliss,
Who, Vigorous one, hath drawn to him the hearts of all, drawn them, the Vigorous One, the God.

verses.sa:
प्र हि त्वा पूषन्नजिरं न यामनि स्तोमेभिः कृण्व ऋणवो यथा मृध उष्ट्रो न पीपरो मृधः ।
हुवे यत्त्वा मयोभुवं देवं सख्याय मर्त्यः ।
अस्माकमाङ्गूषान्द्युम्निनस्कृधि वाजेषु द्युम्निनस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
pra hi tva pushannajiram na yamani stomebhih krinva rinavo yatha mridha ushtro na piparo mridhah |
huve yattva mayobhuvam devam sakhyaya martyah |
asmakamangushandyumninaskridhi vajeshu dyumninaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Thee, then, O Pusan, like a swift one on his way, I urge with lauds that thou mayst make the foemen flee, drive, camel-like, our foes afar.
As I, a man, call thee, a God, giver of bliss, to be my Friend,
So make our loudly-chanted praises glorious, in battles make them glorious.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते पूषन्सख्ये विपन्यवः क्रत्वा चित्सन्तोऽवसा बुभुज्रिर इति क्रत्वा बुभुज्रिरे ।
तामनु त्वा नवीयसीं नियुतं राय ईमहे ।
अहेळमान उरुशंस सरी भव वाजेवाजे सरी भव ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te pushansakhye vipanyavah kratva chitsanto'vasa bubhujrira iti kratva bubhujrire |
tamanu tva naviyasim niyutam raya imahe |
ahelamana urushamsa sari bhava vajevaje sari bhava ||
verses.en:
Thou, Pusan, in whose friendship they who sing forth praise enjoy advantage, even in wisdom, through thy grace, in wisdom even they are advanced.
So, after this most recent course, we come to thee with prayers for wealth.
Not stirred to anger, O Wide-Ruler, come to us, come thou to us in every fight.

verses.sa:
अस्या ऊ षु ण उप सातये भुवोऽहेळमानो ररिवाँ अजाश्व श्रवस्यतामजाश्व ।
ओ षु त्वा ववृतीमहि स्तोमेभिर्दस्म साधुभिः ।
नहि त्वा पूषन्नतिमन्य आघृणे न ते सख्यमपह्नुवे ॥
verses.rom:
asya u shu na upa sataye bhuvo'helamano rarivan ajashva shravasyatamajashva |
o shu tva vavritimahi stomebhirdasma sadhubhih |
nahi tva pushannatimanya aghrine na te sakhyamapahnuve ||
verses.en:
Not stirred to anger, come, Free-giver, nigh to us, to take this gift of ours, thou who hast goats for steeds, Goat-borne! their gift who long for fame.
So, Wonder-Worker! may we turn thee hither with effectual lauds.
I slight thee not, O Pusan, thou Resplendent One: thy friendship may not be despised.

verses.sa:
अस्तु श्रौषट् पुरो अग्निं धिया दध आ नु तच्छर्धो दिव्यं वृणीमह इन्द्रवायू वृणीमहे ।
यद्ध क्राणा विवस्वति नाभा संदायि नव्यसी ।
अध प्र सू न उप यन्तु धीतयो देवाँ अच्छा न धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
astu shraushat puro agnim dhiya dadha a nu tachchhardho divyam vrinimaha indravayu vrinimahe |
yaddha krana vivasvati nabha samdayi navyasi |
adha pra su na upa yantu dhitayo devan achchha na dhitayah ||
verses.en:
HEARD be our prayer! In thought I honour Agni first: now straightway we elect this heavenly company, Indra and Vayu we elect.
For when our latest thought is raised and on Vivasvan centred well,
Then may our holy songs go forward on their way, our songs as 'twere unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
यद्ध त्यन्मित्रावरुणावृतादध्याददाथे अनृतं स्वेन मन्युना दक्षस्य स्वेन मन्युना ।
युवोरित्थाधि सद्मस्वपश्याम हिरण्ययम् ।
धीभिश्चन मनसा स्वेभिरक्षभिः सोमस्य स्वेभिरक्षभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha tyanmitravarunavritadadhyadadathe anritam svena manyuna dakshasya svena manyuna |
yuvoritthadhi sadmasvapashyama hiranyayam |
dhibhishchana manasa svebhirakshabhih somasya svebhirakshabhih ||
verses.en:
As there ye, Mitra, Varuna, above the true have taken to yourselves the untrue with your mind, with wisdom's mental energy,
So in the seats wherein ye dwell have we beheld the Golden One,
Not with our thoughts or spirit, but with these our eyes, yea, with the eyes that Soma gives.

verses.sa:
युवां स्तोमेभिर्देवयन्तो अश्विनाश्रावयन्त इव श्लोकमायवो युवां हव्याभ्यायवः ।
युवोर्विश्वा अधि श्रियः पृक्षश्च विश्ववेदसा ।
प्रुषायन्ते वां पवयो हिरण्यये रथे दस्रा हिरण्यये ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam stomebhirdevayanto ashvinashravayanta iva shlokamayavo yuvam havyabhyayavah |
yuvorvishva adhi shriyah prikshashcha vishvavedasa |
prushayante vam pavayo hiranyaye rathe dasra hiranyaye ||
verses.en:
Asvins, the pious call you with their hymns of praise, sounding their loud song forth to you, these living men, to their oblations, living men.
All glories and all nourishment, Lords of all wealth! depend on you.
The fellies of your golden chariot scatter drops, Mighty Ones! of your golden car.

verses.sa:
अचेति दस्रा व्यु नाकमृण्वथो युञ्जते वां रथयुजो दिविष्टिष्वध्वस्मानो दिविष्टिषु ।
अधि वां स्थाम वन्धुरे रथे दस्रा हिरण्यये ।
पथेव यन्तावनुशासता रजोऽञ्जसा शासता रजः ॥
verses.rom:
acheti dasra vyu nakamrinvatho yunjate vam rathayujo divishtishvadhvasmano divishtishu |
adhi vam sthama vandhure rathe dasra hiranyaye |
patheva yantavanushasata rajo'njasa shasata rajah ||
verses.en:
Well is it known, O Mighty Ones: ye open heaven; for you the chariot-steeds are yoked for morning rites, unswerving steeds for morning rites,
We set you on the chariot-seat, ye Mighty, on the golden car.
Ye seek mid-air as by a path that leads aright, as by a path that leads direct.

verses.sa:
शचीभिर्नः शचीवसू दिवा नक्तं दशस्यतम् ।
मा वां रातिरुप दसत्कदा चनास्मद्रातिः कदा चन ॥
verses.rom:
shachibhirnah shachivasu diva naktam dashasyatam |
ma vam ratirupa dasatkada chanasmadratih kada chana ||
verses.en:
O Rich in Strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night.
The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail, gifts brought by us shall never fail.

verses.sa:
वृषन्निन्द्र वृषपाणास इन्दव इमे सुता अद्रिषुतास उद्भिदस्तुभ्यं सुतास उद्भिदः ।
ते त्वा मन्दन्तु दावने महे चित्राय राधसे ।
गीर्भिर्गिर्वाह स्तवमान आ गहि सुमृळीको न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
vrishannindra vrishapanasa indava ime suta adrishutasa udbhidastubhyam sutasa udbhidah |
te tva mandantu davane mahe chitraya radhase |
girbhirgirvaha stavamana a gahi sumriliko na a gahi ||
verses.en:
These Soma-drops, strong Indra! drink for heroes, poured, pressed out by pressing-stones, are welling forth for thee, for thee the drops are welling forth.
They shall make glad thy heart to give, to give wealth great and wonderful.
Thou who acceptest praise come glorified by hymns, come thou to us benevolent.

verses.sa:
ओ षू णो अग्ने शृणुहि त्वमीळितो देवेभ्यो ब्रवसि यज्ञियेभ्यो राजभ्यो यज्ञियेभ्यः ।
यद्ध त्यामङ्गिरोभ्यो धेनुं देवा अदत्तन ।
वि तां दुह्रे अर्यमा कर्तरी सचाँ एष तां वेद मे सचा ॥
verses.rom:
o shu no agne shrinuhi tvamilito devebhyo bravasi yajniyebhyo rajabhyo yajniyebhyah |
yaddha tyamangirobhyo dhenum deva adattana |
vi tam duhre aryama kartari sachan esha tam veda me sacha ||
verses.en:
Quickly, O Agni, hear us: magnified by us thou shalt speck for us to the Gods adorable yea, to the Kings adorable:
When, O ye Deities, ye gave that Milch-cow to the Angirases,
They milked her: Aryaman, joined with them, did the work: he knoweth her as well as I.

verses.sa:
मो षु वो अस्मदभि तानि पौंस्या सना भूवन्द्युम्नानि मोत जारिषुरस्मत्पुरोत जारिषुः ।
यद्वश्चित्रं युगेयुगे नव्यं घोषादमर्त्यम् ।
अस्मासु तन्मरुतो यच्च दुष्टरं दिधृता यच्च दुष्टरम् ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu vo asmadabhi tani paumsya sana bhuvandyumnani mota jarishurasmatpurota jarishuh |
yadvashchitram yugeyuge navyam ghoshadamartyam |
asmasu tanmaruto yachcha dushtaram didhrita yachcha dushtaram ||
verses.en:
Ne'er may these manly deeds of yours for us grow old, never may your bright glories fall into decay, never before our time decay.
What deed of yours, new every age, wondrous, surpassing man, rings forth,
Whatever, Maruts! may be difficult to gain, grant us, whate'er is hard to gain.

verses.sa:
दध्यङ्ह मे जनुषं पूर्वो अङ्गिराः प्रियमेधः कण्वो अत्रिर्मनुर्विदुस्ते मे पूर्वे मनुर्विदुः ।
तेषां देवेष्वायतिरस्माकं तेषु नाभयः ।
तेषां पदेन मह्या नमे गिरेन्द्राग्नी आ नमे गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
dadhyanha me janusham purvo angirah priyamedhah kanvo atrirmanurviduste me purve manurviduh |
tesham deveshvayatirasmakam teshu nabhayah |
tesham padena mahya name girendragni a name gira ||
verses.en:
Dadhyac of old, Angiras, Priyamedha these, and Kanva, Atri, Manu knew my birth, yea, those of ancient days and Manu knew.
Their long line stretcheth to the Gods, our birth-connexions are with them.
To these, for their high station, I bow down with song, to Indra, Agni, bow with song.

verses.sa:
होता यक्षद्वनिनो वन्त वार्यं बृहस्पतिर्यजति वेन उक्षभिः पुरुवारेभिरुक्षभिः ।
जगृभ्मा दूरआदिशं श्लोकमद्रेरध त्मना ।
अधारयदररिन्दानि सुक्रतुः पुरू सद्मानि सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
hota yakshadvanino vanta varyam brihaspatiryajati vena ukshabhih puruvarebhirukshabhih |
jagribhma duraadisham shlokamadreradha tmana |
adharayadararindani sukratuh puru sadmani sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Let the Invoker bless: let offerers bring choice gifts; Brhaspati the Friend doth sacrifice with Steers, Steers that have many an excellence.
Now with our ears we catch the sound of the press-stone that rings afar.
The very Strong hath gained the waters by himself, the strong gained many a resting-place.

verses.sa:
ये देवासो दिव्येकादश स्थ पृथिव्यामध्येकादश स्थ ।
अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश स्थ ते देवासो यज्ञमिमं जुषध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye devaso divyekadasha stha prithivyamadhyekadasha stha |
apsukshito mahinaikadasha stha te devaso yajnamimam jushadhvam ||
verses.en:
O ye Eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye Eleven who make earth your dwelling,
Ye who with might, Eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, O Gods, with pleasure.

verses.sa:
वेदिषदे प्रियधामाय सुद्युते धासिमिव प्र भरा योनिमग्नये ।
वस्त्रेणेव वासया मन्मना शुचिं ज्योतीरथं शुक्रवर्णं तमोहनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vedishade priyadhamaya sudyute dhasimiva pra bhara yonimagnaye |
vastreneva vasaya manmana shuchim jyotiratham shukravarnam tamohanam ||
verses.en:
To splendid Agni seated by the altar, loving well his home, I bring the food as 'twere his place of birth.
I clothe the bright One with my hymn as with a robe, him with the car of light, bright-hued, dispelling gloom.

verses.sa:
अभि द्विजन्मा त्रिवृदन्नमृज्यते संवत्सरे वावृधे जग्धमी पुनः ।
अन्यस्यासा जिह्वया जेन्यो वृषा न्यन्येन वनिनो मृष्ट वारणः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dvijanma trivridannamrijyate samvatsare vavridhe jagdhami punah |
anyasyasa jihvaya jenyo vrisha nyanyena vanino mrishta varanah ||
verses.en:
Child of a double birth he grasps at triple food; in the year's course what he hath swallowed grows anew.
He, by another's mouth and tongue a noble Bull, with other, as an elephant, consumes the trees.

verses.sa:
कृष्णप्रुतौ वेविजे अस्य सक्षिता उभा तरेते अभि मातरा शिशुम् ।
प्राचाजिह्वं ध्वसयन्तं तृषुच्युतमा साच्यं कुपयं वर्धनं पितुः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnaprutau vevije asya sakshita ubha tarete abhi matara shishum |
prachajihvam dhvasayantam trishuchyutama sachyam kupayam vardhanam pituh ||
verses.en:
The pair who dwell together, moving in the dark bestir themselves: both parents hasten to the babe,
Impetuous-tongued, destroying, springing swiftly forth, one to be watched and cherished, strengthener of his sire.

verses.sa:
मुमुक्ष्वो मनवे मानवस्यते रघुद्रुवः कृष्णसीतास ऊ जुवः ।
असमना अजिरासो रघुष्यदो वातजूता उप युज्यन्त आशवः ॥
verses.rom:
mumukshvo manave manavasyate raghudruvah krishnasitasa u juvah |
asamana ajiraso raghushyado vatajuta upa yujyanta ashavah ||
verses.en:
For man, thou Friend of men, these steeds of thine are yoked, impatient, lightly running, ploughing blackened lines,
Discordant-minded, fleet, gliding with easy speed, urged onward by the wind and rapid in their course.

verses.sa:
आदस्य ते ध्वसयन्तो वृथेरते कृष्णमभ्वं महि वर्पः करिक्रतः ।
यत्सीं महीमवनिं प्राभि मर्मृशदभिश्वसन्स्तनयन्नेति नानदत् ॥
verses.rom:
adasya te dhvasayanto vritherate krishnamabhvam mahi varpah karikratah |
yatsim mahimavanim prabhi marmrishadabhishvasanstanayanneti nanadat ||
verses.en:
Dispelling on their way the horror of black gloom, making a glorious show these flames of his fly forth,
When o'er the spacious tract he spreads himself abroad, and rushes panting on with thunder and with roar.

verses.sa:
भूषन्न योऽधि बभ्रूषु नम्नते वृषेव पत्नीरभ्येति रोरुवत् ।
ओजायमानस्तन्वश्च शुम्भते भीमो न शृङ्गा दविधाव दुर्गृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhushanna yo'dhi babhrushu namnate vrisheva patnirabhyeti roruvat |
ojayamanastanvashcha shumbhate bhimo na shringa davidhava durgribhih ||
verses.en:
Amid brown plants he stoops as if adorning them, and rushes bellowing like a bull upon his wives.
Proving his might, he decks the glory of his form, and shakes his horns like one terrific, hard to stay.

verses.sa:
स संस्तिरो विष्टिरः सं गृभायति जानन्नेव जानतीर्नित्य आ शये ।
पुनर्वर्धन्ते अपि यन्ति देव्यमन्यद्वर्पः पित्रोः कृण्वते सचा ॥
verses.rom:
sa samstiro vishtirah sam gribhayati jananneva janatirnitya a shaye |
punarvardhante api yanti devyamanyadvarpah pitroh krinvate sacha ||
verses.en:
Now covered, now displayed he grasps as one who knows his resting-place in those who know him well.
A second time they wax and gather Godlike power, and blending both together change their Parents' form.

verses.sa:
तमग्रुवः केशिनीः सं हि रेभिर ऊर्ध्वास्तस्थुर्मम्रुषीः प्रायवे पुनः ।
तासां जरां प्रमुञ्चन्नेति नानददसुं परं जनयञ्जीवमस्तृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamagruvah keshinih sam hi rebhira urdhvastasthurmamrushih prayave punah |
tasam jaram pramunchanneti nanadadasum param janayanjivamastritam ||
verses.en:
The maidens with long, tresses hold him in embrace; dead, they rise up again to meet the Living One.
Releasing them from age with a loud roar he comes, filling them with new spirit, living, unsubdued.

verses.sa:
अधीवासं परि मातू रिहन्नह तुविग्रेभिः सत्वभिर्याति वि ज्रयः ।
वयो दधत्पद्वते रेरिहत्सदानु श्येनी सचते वर्तनीरह ॥
verses.rom:
adhivasam pari matu rihannaha tuvigrebhih satvabhiryati vi jrayah |
vayo dadhatpadvate rerihatsadanu shyeni sachate vartaniraha ||
verses.en:
Licking the mantle of the Mother, far and wide he wanders over fields with beasts that flee apace.
Strengthening all that walk, licking up all around, a blackened path, forsooth, he leaves where'er he goes.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमग्ने मघवत्सु दीदिह्यध श्वसीवान्वृषभो दमूनाः ।
अवास्या शिशुमतीरदीदेर्वर्मेव युत्सु परिजर्भुराणः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamagne maghavatsu didihyadha shvasivanvrishabho damunah |
avasya shishumatiradidervarmeva yutsu parijarbhuranah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, shine resplendent with our wealthy chiefs, like a loud-snorting bull, accustomed to the house.
Thou casting off thine infant wrappings blazest forth as though thou hadst put on a coat of mail for war.

verses.sa:
इदमग्ने सुधितं दुर्धितादधि प्रियादु चिन्मन्मनः प्रेयो अस्तु ते ।
यत्ते शुक्रं तन्वो रोचते शुचि तेनास्मभ्यं वनसे रत्नमा त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
idamagne sudhitam durdhitadadhi priyadu chinmanmanah preyo astu te |
yatte shukram tanvo rochate shuchi tenasmabhyam vanase ratnama tvam ||
verses.en:
May this our perfect prayer be dearer unto thee than an imperfect prayer although it please thee well.
With the pure brilliancy that radiates from thy form, mayest thou grant to us abundant store of wealth.

verses.sa:
रथाय नावमुत नो गृहाय नित्यारित्रां पद्वतीं रास्यग्ने ।
अस्माकं वीराँ उत नो मघोनो जनाँश्च या पारयाच्छर्म या च ॥
verses.rom:
rathaya navamuta no grihaya nityaritram padvatim rasyagne |
asmakam viran uta no maghono jananshcha ya parayachchharma ya cha ||
verses.en:
Grant to our chariot, to our house, O Agni, a boat with moving feet and constant oarage,
One that may further well our wealthy princes and all the folk, and be our certain refuge.

verses.sa:
अभी नो अग्न उक्थमिज्जुगुर्या द्यावाक्षामा सिन्धवश्च स्वगूर्ताः ।
गव्यं यव्यं यन्तो दीर्घाहेषं वरमरुण्यो वरन्त ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no agna ukthamijjugurya dyavakshama sindhavashcha svagurtah |
gavyam yavyam yanto dirghahesham varamarunyo varanta ||
verses.en:
Welcome our laud with thine approval, Agni. May earth and heaven and freely flowing rivers
Yield us long life and food and corn and cattle, and may the red Dawns choose for us their choicest.

verses.sa:
बळित्था तद्वपुषे धायि दर्शतं देवस्य भर्गः सहसो यतो जनि ।
यदीमुप ह्वरते साधते मतिरृतस्य धेना अनयन्त सस्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
balittha tadvapushe dhayi darshatam devasya bhargah sahaso yato jani |
yadimupa hvarate sadhate matirritasya dhena anayanta sasrutah ||
verses.en:
YEA, verily, the fair effulgence of the God for glory was established, since he sprang from strength.
When he inclines thereto successful is the hymn: the songs of sacrifice have brought him as they flow

verses.sa:
पृक्षो वपुः पितुमान्नित्य आ शये द्वितीयमा सप्तशिवासु मातृषु ।
तृतीयमस्य वृषभस्य दोहसे दशप्रमतिं जनयन्त योषणः ॥
verses.rom:
priksho vapuh pitumannitya a shaye dvitiyama saptashivasu matrishu |
tritiyamasya vrishabhasya dohase dashapramatim janayanta yoshanah ||
verses.en:
Wonderful, rich in nourishment, he dwells in food; next, in the seven auspicious Mothers is his home.
Thirdly, that they might drain the treasures of the Bull, the maidens brought forth him for whom the ten provide.

verses.sa:
निर्यदीं बुध्नान्महिषस्य वर्पस ईशानासः शवसा क्रन्त सूरयः ।
यदीमनु प्रदिवो मध्व आधवे गुहा सन्तं मातरिश्वा मथायति ॥
verses.rom:
niryadim budhnanmahishasya varpasa ishanasah shavasa kranta surayah |
yadimanu pradivo madhva adhave guha santam matarishva mathayati ||
verses.en:
What time from out the deep, from the Steer's wondrous form, the Chiefs who had the power produced him with their strength;
When Matarisvan rubbed forth him who lay concealed, for mixture of the sweet drink, in the days of old.

verses.sa:
प्र यत्पितुः परमान्नीयते पर्या पृक्षुधो वीरुधो दंसु रोहति ।
उभा यदस्य जनुषं यदिन्वत आदिद्यविष्ठो अभवद्घृणा शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yatpituh paramanniyate parya prikshudho virudho damsu rohati |
ubha yadasya janusham yadinvata adidyavishtho abhavadghrina shuchih ||
verses.en:
When from the Highest Father he is brought to us, amid the plants he rises hungry, wondrously.
As both together join to expedite his birth, most youthful he is born resplendent in his light.

verses.sa:
आदिन्मातॄराविशद्यास्वा शुचिरहिंस्यमान उर्विया वि वावृधे ।
अनु यत्पूर्वा अरुहत्सनाजुवो नि नव्यसीष्ववरासु धावते ॥
verses.rom:
adinmatriravishadyasva shuchirahimsyamana urviya vi vavridhe |
anu yatpurva aruhatsanajuvo ni navyasishvavarasu dhavate ||
verses.en:
Then also entered he the Mothers, and in them pure and uninjured he increased in magnitude.
As to the first he rose, the vigorous from of old, so now he runs among the younger lowest ones.

verses.sa:
आदिद्धोतारं वृणते दिविष्टिषु भगमिव पपृचानास ऋञ्जते ।
देवान्यत्क्रत्वा मज्मना पुरुष्टुतो मर्तं शंसं विश्वधा वेति धायसे ॥
verses.rom:
adiddhotaram vrinate divishtishu bhagamiva paprichanasa rinjate |
devanyatkratva majmana purushtuto martam shamsam vishvadha veti dhayase ||
verses.en:
Therefore they choose him Herald at the morning rites, pressing to him as unto Bhaga, pouring gifts,
When, much-praised, by the power and will of Gods, he goes at all times to his mortal worshipper to drink.

verses.sa:
वि यदस्थाद्यजतो वातचोदितो ह्वारो न वक्वा जरणा अनाकृतः ।
तस्य पत्मन्दक्षुषः कृष्णजंहसः शुचिजन्मनो रज आ व्यध्वनः ॥
verses.rom:
vi yadasthadyajato vatachodito hvaro na vakva jarana anakritah |
tasya patmandakshushah krishnajamhasah shuchijanmano raja a vyadhvanah ||
verses.en:
What time the Holy One, wind-urged, hath risen up, serpent-like winding through the dry grass unrestrained,
Dust lies upon the way of him who burneth all, black-winged and pure of birth who follows sundry paths.

verses.sa:
रथो न यातः शिक्वभिः कृतो द्यामङ्गेभिररुषेभिरीयते ।
आदस्य ते कृष्णासो दक्षि सूरयः शूरस्येव त्वेषथादीषते वयः ॥
verses.rom:
ratho na yatah shikvabhih krito dyamangebhirarushebhiriyate |
adasya te krishnaso dakshi surayah shurasyeva tveshathadishate vayah ||
verses.en:
Like a swift chariot made by men who know their art, he with his red limbs lifts himself aloft to heaven.
Thy worshippers become by burning black of hue: their strength flies as before a hero's violence.

verses.sa:
त्वया ह्यग्ने वरुणो धृतव्रतो मित्रः शाशद्रे अर्यमा सुदानवः ।
यत्सीमनु क्रतुना विश्वथा विभुररान्न नेमिः परिभूरजायथाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya hyagne varuno dhritavrato mitrah shashadre aryama sudanavah |
yatsimanu kratuna vishvatha vibhuraranna nemih paribhurajayathah ||
verses.en:
By thee, O Agni, Varuna who guards the Law, Mitra and Aryaman, the Bounteous, are made strong;
For, as the felly holds the spokes, thou with thy might pervading hast been born encompassing them round.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने शशमानाय सुन्वते रत्नं यविष्ठ देवतातिमिन्वसि ।
तं त्वा नु नव्यं सहसो युवन्वयं भगं न कारे महिरत्न धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne shashamanaya sunvate ratnam yavishtha devatatiminvasi |
tam tva nu navyam sahaso yuvanvayam bhagam na kare mahiratna dhimahi ||
verses.en:
Agni, to him who toils and pours libations, thou, Most Youthful! sendest wealth and all the host of Gods.
Thee, therefore, even as Bhaga, will we set anew, young Child of Strength, most wealthy! in our battle-song.

verses.sa:
अस्मे रयिं न स्वर्थं दमूनसं भगं दक्षं न पपृचासि धर्णसिम् ।
रश्मीँरिव यो यमति जन्मनी उभे देवानां शंसमृत आ च सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
asme rayim na svartham damunasam bhagam daksham na paprichasi dharnasim |
rashminriva yo yamati janmani ubhe devanam shamsamrita a cha sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe us riches turned to worthy ends, good luck abiding in the house, and strong capacity,
Wealth that directs both worlds as they were guiding-reins, and, very Wise, the Gods' assent in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उत नः सुद्योत्मा जीराश्वो होता मन्द्रः शृणवच्चन्द्ररथः ।
स नो नेषन्नेषतमैरमूरोऽग्निर्वामं सुवितं वस्यो अच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah sudyotma jirashvo hota mandrah shrinavachchandrarathah |
sa no neshanneshatamairamuro'gnirvamam suvitam vasyo achchha ||
verses.en:
May he, the Priest resplendent, joyful, hear us, he with the radiant car and rapid horses.
May Agni, ever wise, with best directions to bliss and highest happiness conduct us.

verses.sa:
अस्ताव्यग्निः शिमीवद्भिरर्कैः साम्राज्याय प्रतरं दधानः ।
अमी च ये मघवानो वयं च मिहं न सूरो अति निष्टतन्युः ॥
verses.rom:
astavyagnih shimivadbhirarkaih samrajyaya prataram dadhanah |
ami cha ye maghavano vayam cha miham na suro ati nishtatanyuh ||
verses.en:
With hymns of might hath Agni now been lauded, advanced to height of universal kingship.
Now may these wealthy chiefs and we together spread forth as spreads the Sun above the rain-clouds.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्न आ वह देवाँ अद्य यतस्रुचे ।
तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं सुतसोमाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho agna a vaha devan adya yatasruche |
tantum tanushva purvyam sutasomaya dashushe ||
verses.en:
KINDLED, bring, Agni, Gods to-day for him who lifts the ladle up.
Spin out the ancient thread for him who sheds, with gifts, the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
घृतवन्तमुप मासि मधुमन्तं तनूनपात् ।
यज्ञं विप्रस्य मावतः शशमानस्य दाशुषः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritavantamupa masi madhumantam tanunapat |
yajnam viprasya mavatah shashamanasya dashushah ||
verses.en:
Thou dealest forth, Tanunapat, sweet sacrifice enriched with oil,
Brought by a singer such as I who offers gifts and toils for thee.

verses.sa:
शुचिः पावको अद्भुतो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षति ।
नराशंसस्त्रिरा दिवो देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः ॥
verses.rom:
shuchih pavako adbhuto madhva yajnam mimikshati |
narashamsastrira divo devo deveshu yajniyah ||
verses.en:
He wondrous, sanctifying, bright, sprinkles the sacrifice with mead,
Thrice, Narasamsa from the heavens, a God mid Gods adorable.

verses.sa:
ईळितो अग्न आ वहेन्द्रं चित्रमिह प्रियम् ।
इयं हि त्वा मतिर्ममाच्छा सुजिह्व वच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ilito agna a vahendram chitramiha priyam |
iyam hi tva matirmamachchha sujihva vachyate ||
verses.en:
Agni, besought, bring hitherward Indra the Friend, the Wonderful,
For this my hymn of praise, O sweet of tongue, is chanted forth to thee.

verses.sa:
स्तृणानासो यतस्रुचो बर्हिर्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ।
वृञ्जे देवव्यचस्तममिन्द्राय शर्म सप्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
strinanaso yatasrucho barhiryajne svadhvare |
vrinje devavyachastamamindraya sharma saprathah ||
verses.en:
The ladle-holders strew trimmed grass at this well-ordered sacrifice;
A home for Indra is adorned, wide, fittest to receive the Gods.

verses.sa:
वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधः प्रयै देवेभ्यो महीः ।
पावकासः पुरुस्पृहो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः ॥
verses.rom:
vi shrayantamritavridhah prayai devebhyo mahih |
pavakasah puruspriho dvaro devirasashchatah ||
verses.en:
Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite,
High, purifying, much-desired, so that the Gods may enter in.

verses.sa:
आ भन्दमाने उपाके नक्तोषासा सुपेशसा ।
यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा सीदतां बर्हिरा सुमत् ॥
verses.rom:
a bhandamane upake naktoshasa supeshasa |
yahvi ritasya matara sidatam barhira sumat ||
verses.en:
May Night and Morning, hymned with lauds, united, fair to look upon,
Strong Mothers of the sacrifice, seat them together on the grass.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रजिह्वा जुगुर्वणी होतारा दैव्या कवी ।
यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमं सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशम् ॥
verses.rom:
mandrajihva jugurvani hotara daivya kavi |
yajnam no yakshatamimam sidhramadya divisprisham ||
verses.en:
May the two Priests Divine, the sage, the sweet-voiced lovers of the hymn,
Complete this sacrifice of ours, effectual, reaching heaven to-day.

verses.sa:
शुचिर्देवेष्वर्पिता होत्रा मरुत्सु भारती ।
इळा सरस्वती मही बर्हिः सीदन्तु यज्ञियाः ॥
verses.rom:
shuchirdeveshvarpita hotra marutsu bharati |
ila sarasvati mahi barhih sidantu yajniyah ||
verses.en: Let Hotra pure, set among Gods, amid the Maruts Bharati, Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, rest on the grass, adorable.

verses.sa:
तन्नस्तुरीपमद्भुतं पुरु वारं पुरु त्मना ।
त्वष्टा पोषाय वि ष्यतु राये नाभा नो अस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
tannasturipamadbhutam puru varam puru tmana |
tvashta poshaya vi shyatu raye nabha no asmayuh ||
verses.en:
May Tvastar send us genial dew abundant, wondrous, rich in gifts,
For increase and for growth of wealth, Tvastar our kinsman and our Friend.

verses.sa:
अवसृजन्नुप त्मना देवान्यक्षि वनस्पते ।
अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
verses.rom:
avasrijannupa tmana devanyakshi vanaspate |
agnirhavya sushudati devo deveshu medhirah ||
verses.en:
Vanaspati, give forth, thyself, and call the Gods to sacrifice.
May Agni, God intelligent, speed our oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa:
पूषण्वते मरुत्वते विश्वदेवाय वायवे ।
स्वाहा गायत्रवेपसे हव्यमिन्द्राय कर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
pushanvate marutvate vishvadevaya vayave |
svaha gayatravepase havyamindraya kartana ||
verses.en:
To Vayu joined with Pusan, with the Maruts, and the host of Gods,
To Indra who inspires the hymn cry Glory! and present the gift.

verses.sa:
स्वाहाकृतान्या गह्युप हव्यानि वीतये ।
इन्द्रा गहि श्रुधी हवं त्वां हवन्ते अध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
svahakritanya gahyupa havyani vitaye |
indra gahi shrudhi havam tvam havante adhvare ||
verses.en:
Come hither to enjoy the gifts prepared with cry of Glory! Come,
O Indra, hear their calling; they invite thee to the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
प्र तव्यसीं नव्यसीं धीतिमग्नये वाचो मतिं सहसः सूनवे भरे ।
अपां नपाद्यो वसुभिः सह प्रियो होता पृथिव्यां न्यसीददृत्वियः ॥
verses.rom:
pra tavyasim navyasim dhitimagnaye vacho matim sahasah sunave bhare |
apam napadyo vasubhih saha priyo hota prithivyam nyasidadritviyah ||
verses.en:
To Agni I present a newer mightier hymn, I bring my words and song unto the Son of Strength,
Who, Offspring of the Waters, bearing precious things sits on the earth, in season, dear Invoking Priest.

verses.sa:
स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्याविरग्निरभवन्मातरिश्वने ।
अस्य क्रत्वा समिधानस्य मज्मना प्र द्यावा शोचिः पृथिवी अरोचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa jayamanah parame vyomanyaviragnirabhavanmatarishvane |
asya kratva samidhanasya majmana pra dyava shochih prithivi arochayat ||
verses.en:
Soon as he sprang to birth that Agni was shown forth to Matarisvan in the highest firmament.
When he was kindled, through his power and majesty his fiery splendour made the heavens and earth to shine.

verses.sa:
अस्य त्वेषा अजरा अस्य भानवः सुसंदृशः सुप्रतीकस्य सुद्युतः ।
भात्वक्षसो अत्यक्तुर्न सिन्धवोऽग्ने रेजन्ते अससन्तो अजराः ॥
verses.rom:
asya tvesha ajara asya bhanavah susamdrishah supratikasya sudyutah |
bhatvakshaso atyakturna sindhavo'gne rejante asasanto ajarah ||
verses.en:
His flames that wax not old, beams fair to look upon of him whose face is lovely, shine with beauteous sheen.
The rays of Agni, him whose active force is light, through the nights glimmer sleepless, ageless, like the floods.

verses.sa:
यमेरिरे भृगवो विश्ववेदसं नाभा पृथिव्या भुवनस्य मज्मना ।
अग्निं तं गीर्भिर्हिनुहि स्व आ दमे य एको वस्वो वरुणो न राजति ॥
verses.rom:
yamerire bhrigavo vishvavedasam nabha prithivya bhuvanasya majmana |
agnim tam girbhirhinuhi sva a dame ya eko vasvo varuno na rajati ||
verses.en:
Send thou with hymns that Agni to his own abode, who rules, one Sovran Lord of wealth, like Varuna,
Him, All-possessor, whom the Bhrgus with their might brought to earth's central point, the centre of the world.

verses.sa:
न यो वराय मरुतामिव स्वनः सेनेव सृष्टा दिव्या यथाशनिः ।
अग्निर्जम्भैस्तिगितैरत्ति भर्वति योधो न शत्रून्स वना न्यृञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
na yo varaya marutamiva svanah seneva srishta divya yathashanih |
agnirjambhaistigitairatti bharvati yodho na shatrunsa vana nyrinjate ||
verses.en:
He whom no force can stay, even as the Maruts' roar, like to a dart sent forth, even as the bolt from heaven,
Agni with sharpened jaws chews up and eats the trees, and conquers them as when the warrior smites his foes.

verses.sa:
कुविन्नो अग्निरुचथस्य वीरसद्वसुष्कुविद्वसुभिः काममावरत् ।
चोदः कुवित्तुतुज्यात्सातये धियः शुचिप्रतीकं तमया धिया गृणे ॥
verses.rom:
kuvinno agniruchathasya virasadvasushkuvidvasubhih kamamavarat |
chodah kuvittutujyatsataye dhiyah shuchipratikam tamaya dhiya grine ||
verses.en:
And will not Agni find enjoyment in our praise, will not the Vasu grant our wish with gifts of wealth?
Will not the Inspirer speed our prayers to gain their end? Him with the radiant glance I laud with this my song.

verses.sa:
घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदमग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते ।
इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यच्छुक्रवर्णामुदु नो यंसते धियम् ॥
verses.rom:
ghritapratikam va ritasya dhurshadamagnim mitram na samidhana rinjate |
indhano akro vidatheshu didyachchhukravarnamudu no yamsate dhiyam ||
verses.en:
The kindler of the flame wins Agni as a Friend, promoter of the Law, whose face is bright with oil.
Inflamed and keen, refulgent in our gatherings, he lifts our hymn on high clad in his radiant hues.

verses.sa:
अप्रयुच्छन्नप्रयुच्छद्भिरग्ने शिवेभिर्नः पायुभिः पाहि शग्मैः ।
अदब्धेभिरदृपितेभिरिष्टेऽनिमिषद्भिः परि पाहि नो जाः ॥
verses.rom:
aprayuchchhannaprayuchchhadbhiragne shivebhirnah payubhih pahi shagmaih |
adabdhebhiradripitebhirishte'nimishadbhih pari pahi no jah ||
verses.en:
Keep us incessantly with guards that cease not, Agni, with guards auspicious, very mighty.
With guards that never slumber, never heedless, never beguiled. O Helper, keep our children.

verses.sa:
एति प्र होता व्रतमस्य माययोर्ध्वां दधानः शुचिपेशसं धियम् ।
अभि स्रुचः क्रमते दक्षिणावृतो या अस्य धाम प्रथमं ह निंसते ॥
verses.rom:
eti pra hota vratamasya mayayordhvam dadhanah shuchipeshasam dhiyam |
abhi sruchah kramate dakshinavrito ya asya dhama prathamam ha nimsate ||
verses.en:
THE Priest goes forth to sacrifice, with wondrous power sending aloft the hymn of glorious brilliancy.
He moves to meet the ladles turning to the right, which are the first to kiss the place where he abides.

verses.sa:
अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषत योनौ देवस्य सदने परीवृताः ।
अपामुपस्थे विभृतो यदावसदध स्वधा अधयद्याभिरीयते ॥
verses.rom:
abhimritasya dohana anushata yonau devasya sadane parivritah |
apamupasthe vibhrito yadavasadadha svadha adhayadyabhiriyate ||
verses.en:
To him sang forth the flowing streams of Holy Law, encompassed in the home and birth-place of the God.
He, when he dwelt extended in the waters' lap, absorbed those Godlike powers for which he is adored.

verses.sa:
युयूषतः सवयसा तदिद्वपुः समानमर्थं वितरित्रता मिथः ।
आदीं भगो न हव्यः समस्मदा वोळ्हुर्न रश्मीन्समयंस्त सारथिः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyushatah savayasa tadidvapuh samanamartham vitaritrata mithah |
adim bhago na havyah samasmada volhurna rashminsamayamsta sarathih ||
verses.en:
Seeking in course altern to reach the selfsame end the two copartners strive to win this beauteous form.
Like Bhaga must he be duly invoked by us, as he who drives the car holds fast the horse's reins.

verses.sa:
यमीं द्वा सवयसा सपर्यतः समाने योना मिथुना समोकसा ।
दिवा न नक्तं पलितो युवाजनि पुरू चरन्नजरो मानुषा युगा ॥
verses.rom:
yamim dva savayasa saparyatah samane yona mithuna samokasa |
diva na naktam palito yuvajani puru charannajaro manusha yuga ||
verses.en:
He whom the two copartners with observance tend, the pair who dwell together in the same abode,
By night as in the day the grey one was born young, passing untouched by eld through many an age of man.

verses.sa:
तमीं हिन्वन्ति धीतयो दश व्रिशो देवं मर्तास ऊतये हवामहे ।
धनोरधि प्रवत आ स ऋण्वत्यभिव्रजद्भिर्वयुना नवाधित ॥
verses.rom:
tamim hinvanti dhitayo dasha vrisho devam martasa utaye havamahe |
dhanoradhi pravata a sa rinvatyabhivrajadbhirvayuna navadhita ||
verses.en:
Him the ten fingers, the devotions, animate: we mortals call on him a God to give us help.
He speeds over the sloping surface of the land: new deeds hath he performed with those who gird him round.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यग्ने दिव्यस्य राजसि त्वं पार्थिवस्य पशुपा इव त्मना ।
एनी त एते बृहती अभिश्रिया हिरण्ययी वक्वरी बर्हिराशाते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyagne divyasya rajasi tvam parthivasya pashupa iva tmana |
eni ta ete brihati abhishriya hiranyayi vakvari barhirashate ||
verses.en:
For, Agni, like a herdsman, thou by thine own might rulest o'er all that is in heaven and on the earth;
And these two Mighty Ones, bright, golden closely joined, rolling them round are come unto thy sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जुषस्व प्रति हर्य तद्वचो मन्द्र स्वधाव ऋतजात सुक्रतो ।
यो विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि दर्शतो रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
agne jushasva prati harya tadvacho mandra svadhava ritajata sukrato |
yo vishvatah pratyannasi darshato ranvah samdrishtau pituman iva kshayah ||
verses.en:
Agni, accept with joy, be glad in this our prayer, joy-giver, self-sustained, strong, born of Holy Law!
For fair to see art thou turning to every side, pleasant to look on as a dwelling filled with food.

verses.sa:
तं पृच्छता स जगामा स वेद स चिकित्वाँ ईयते सा न्वीयते ।
तस्मिन्सन्ति प्रशिषस्तस्मिन्निष्टयः स वाजस्य शवसः शुष्मिणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam prichchhata sa jagama sa veda sa chikitvan iyate sa nviyate |
tasminsanti prashishastasminnishtayah sa vajasya shavasah shushminaspatih ||
verses.en:
Ask ye of him for he is come, he knoweth it; he, full of wisdom, is implored, is now implored.
With him are admonitions and with him commands: he is the Lord of Strength, the Lord of Power and Might.

verses.sa:
तमित्पृच्छन्ति न सिमो वि पृच्छति स्वेनेव धीरो मनसा यदग्रभीत् ।
न मृष्यते प्रथमं नापरं वचोऽस्य क्रत्वा सचते अप्रदृपितः ॥
verses.rom:
tamitprichchhanti na simo vi prichchhati sveneva dhiro manasa yadagrabhit |
na mrishyate prathamam naparam vacho'sya kratva sachate apradripitah ||
verses.en:
They ask of him: not all learn by their questioning what he, the Sage, hath grasped, as 'twere, with his own mind.
Forgetting not the former nor the later word, he goeth on, not careless, in his mental power.

verses.sa:
तमिद्गच्छन्ति जुह्वस्तमर्वतीर्विश्वान्येकः शृणवद्वचांसि मे ।
पुरुप्रैषस्ततुरिर्यज्ञसाधनोऽच्छिद्रोतिः शिशुरादत्त सं रभः ॥
verses.rom:
tamidgachchhanti juhvastamarvatirvishvanyekah shrinavadvachamsi me |
purupraishastaturiryajnasadhano'chchhidrotih shishuradatta sam rabhah ||
verses.en:
To him these ladles go, to him these racing mares: he only will give ear to all the words I speak.
All-speeding, victor, perfecter of sacrifice, the Babe with flawless help hath mustered vigorous might.

verses.sa:
उपस्थायं चरति यत्समारत सद्यो जातस्तत्सार युज्येभिः ।
अभि श्वान्तं मृशते नान्द्ये मुदे यदीं गच्छन्त्युशतीरपिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
upasthayam charati yatsamarata sadyo jatastatsara yujyebhih |
abhi shvantam mrishate nandye mude yadim gachchhantyushatirapishthitam ||
verses.en:
Whate'er he meets he grasps and then runs farther on, and straightway, newly born, creeps forward with his kin.
He stirs the wearied man to pleasure and great joy what time the longing gifts approach him as he comes.

verses.sa:
स ईं मृगो अप्यो वनर्गुरुप त्वच्युपमस्यां नि धायि ।
व्यब्रवीद्वयुना मर्त्येभ्योऽग्निर्विद्वाँ ऋतचिद्धि सत्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa im mrigo apyo vanargurupa tvachyupamasyam ni dhayi |
vyabravidvayuna martyebhyo'gnirvidvan ritachiddhi satyah ||
verses.en:
He is a wild thing of the flood and forest: he hath been laid upon the highest surface.
He hath declared the lore of works to mortals, Agni the Wise, for he knows Law, the Truthful.

verses.sa:
त्रिमूर्धानं सप्तरश्मिं गृणीषेऽनूनमग्निं पित्रोरुपस्थे ।
निषत्तमस्य चरतो ध्रुवस्य विश्वा दिवो रोचनापप्रिवांसम् ॥
verses.rom:
trimurdhanam saptarashmim grinishe'nunamagnim pitrorupasthe |
nishattamasya charato dhruvasya vishva divo rochanapaprivamsam ||
verses.en:
I LAUD the seven-rayed, the triple-headed, Agni all-perfect in his Parents' bosom,
Sunk in the lap of all that moves and moves not, him who hath filled all luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sa:
उक्षा महाँ अभि ववक्ष एने अजरस्तस्थावितऊतिरृष्वः ।
उर्व्याः पदो नि दधाति सानौ रिहन्त्यूधो अरुषासो अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
uksha mahan abhi vavaksha ene ajarastasthavitautirrishvah |
urvyah pado ni dadhati sanau rihantyudho arushaso asya ||
verses.en:
As a great Steer he grew to these his Parents; sublime he stands, untouched by eld, far-reaching.
He plants his footsteps on the lofty ridges of the broad earth: his red flames lick the udder.

verses.sa:
समानं वत्समभि संचरन्ती विष्वग्धेनू वि चरतः सुमेके ।
अनपवृज्याँ अध्वनो मिमाने विश्वान्केताँ अधि महो दधाने ॥
verses.rom:
samanam vatsamabhi samcharanti vishvagdhenu vi charatah sumeke |
anapavrijyan adhvano mimane vishvanketan adhi maho dadhane ||
verses.en:
Coming together to their common youngling both Cows, fairshaped, spread forth in all directions,
Measuring out the paths that must be travelled, entrusting all desires to him the Mighty.

verses.sa:
धीरासः पदं कवयो नयन्ति नाना हृदा रक्षमाणा अजुर्यम् ।
सिषासन्तः पर्यपश्यन्त सिन्धुमाविरेभ्यो अभवत्सूर्यो नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
dhirasah padam kavayo nayanti nana hrida rakshamana ajuryam |
sishasantah paryapashyanta sindhumavirebhyo abhavatsuryo nrin ||
verses.en:
The prudent sages lead him to his dwelling, guarding with varied skill the Ever-Youthful.
Longing, they turned their eyes unto the River: to these the Sun of men was manifested.

verses.sa:
दिदृक्षेण्यः परि काष्ठासु जेन्य ईळेन्यो महो अर्भाय जीवसे ।
पुरुत्रा यदभवत्सूरहैभ्यो गर्भेभ्यो मघवा विश्वदर्शतः ॥
verses.rom:
didrikshenyah pari kashthasu jenya ilenyo maho arbhaya jivase |
purutra yadabhavatsurahaibhyo garbhebhyo maghava vishvadarshatah ||
verses.en:
Born noble in the regions, aim of all mens' eyes to be implored for life by great and small alike,
Far as the Wealthy One hath spread himself abroad, he is the Sire all-visible of this progeny.

verses.sa:
कथा ते अग्ने शुचयन्त आयोर्ददाशुर्वाजेभिराशुषाणाः ।
उभे यत्तोके तनये दधाना ऋतस्य सामन्रणयन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
katha te agne shuchayanta ayordadashurvajebhirashushanah |
ubhe yattoke tanaye dadhana ritasya samanranayanta devah ||
verses.en:
How, Agni, have the radiant ones, aspiring, endued thee with the vigour of the living,
So that on both sides fostering seed and offspring, the Gods may joy in Holy Law's fulfilment?

verses.sa:
बोधा मे अस्य वचसो यविष्ठ मंहिष्ठस्य प्रभृतस्य स्वधावः ।
पीयति त्वो अनु त्वो गृणाति वन्दारुस्ते तन्वं वन्दे अग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
bodha me asya vachaso yavishtha mamhishthasya prabhritasya svadhavah |
piyati tvo anu tvo grinati vandaruste tanvam vande agne ||
verses.en:
Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou, Most Youthful! offered to thee by him who gives most freely.
One hates thee, and another sings thy praises: I thine adorer laud thy form, O Agni.

verses.sa:
ये पायवो मामतेयं ते अग्ने पश्यन्तो अन्धं दुरितादरक्षन् ।
ररक्ष तान्सुकृतो विश्ववेदा दिप्सन्त इद्रिपवो नाह देभुः ॥
verses.rom:
ye payavo mamateyam te agne pashyanto andham duritadarakshan |
raraksha tansukrito vishvaveda dipsanta idripavo naha debhuh ||
verses.en:
Thy guardian rays, O Agni, when they saw him, preserved blind Mamateya from affliction.
Lord of all riches, he preserved the pious the foes who fain would harm them did no mischief.

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्ने अररिवाँ अघायुररातीवा मर्चयति द्वयेन ।
मन्त्रो गुरुः पुनरस्तु सो अस्मा अनु मृक्षीष्ट तन्वं दुरुक्तैः ॥
verses.rom:
yo no agne ararivan aghayurarativa marchayati dvayena |
mantro guruh punarastu so asma anu mrikshishta tanvam duruktaih ||
verses.en:
The sinful man who worships not, O Agni, who, offering not, harms us with double-dealing,--
Be this in turn to him a heavy sentence may he distress himself by his revilings.

verses.sa:
उत वा यः सहस्य प्रविद्वान्मर्तो मर्तं मर्चयति द्वयेन ।
अतः पाहि स्तवमान स्तुवन्तमग्ने माकिर्नो दुरिताय धायीः ॥
verses.rom:
uta va yah sahasya pravidvanmarto martam marchayati dvayena |
atah pahi stavamana stuvantamagne makirno duritaya dhayih ||
verses.en:
Yea, when a mortal knowingly, O Victor, injures with double tongue a fellow-mortal,
From him, praised Agni! save thou him that lauds thee: bring us not into trouble and affliction.

verses.sa:
मथीद्यदीं विष्टो मातरिश्वा होतारं विश्वाप्सुं विश्वदेव्यम् ।
नि यं दधुर्मनुष्यासु विक्षु स्वर्ण चित्रं वपुषे विभावम् ॥
verses.rom:
mathidyadim vishto matarishva hotaram vishvapsum vishvadevyam |
ni yam dadhurmanushyasu vikshu svarna chitram vapushe vibhavam ||
verses.en:
WHAT Matarisvan, piercing, formed by friction, Herald of all the Gods. in varied figure,
Is he whom they have set mid human houses, gay-hued as light and shining forth for beauty.

verses.sa:
ददानमिन्न ददभन्त मन्माग्निर्वरूथं मम तस्य चाकन् ।
जुषन्त विश्वान्यस्य कर्मोपस्तुतिं भरमाणस्य कारोः ॥
verses.rom:
dadanaminna dadabhanta manmagnirvarutham mama tasya chakan |
jushanta vishvanyasya karmopastutim bharamanasya karoh ||
verses.en:
They shall not harm the man who brings thee praises: such as I am, Agni my help approves me.
All acts of mine shall they accept with pleasure, laudation from the singer who presents it.

verses.sa:
नित्ये चिन्नु यं सदने जगृभ्रे प्रशस्तिभिर्दधिरे यज्ञियासः ।
प्र सू नयन्त गृभयन्त इष्टावश्वासो न रथ्यो रारहाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
nitye chinnu yam sadane jagribhre prashastibhirdadhire yajniyasah |
pra su nayanta gribhayanta ishtavashvaso na rathyo rarahanah ||
verses.en:
Him in his constant seat men skilled in worship have taken and with praises have established.
As, harnessed to a chariot fleet-foot horses, at his command let bearers lead him forward.

verses.sa:
पुरूणि दस्मो नि रिणाति जम्भैराद्रोचते वन आ विभावा ।
आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरस्तुर्न शर्यामसनामनु द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
puruni dasmo ni rinati jambhairadrochate vana a vibhava |
adasya vato anu vati shochirasturna sharyamasanamanu dyun ||
verses.en:
Wondrous, full many a thing he chews and crunches: he shines amid the wood with spreading brightness.
Upon his glowing flames the wind blows daily, driving them like the keen shaft of an archer.

verses.sa:
न यं रिपवो न रिषण्यवो गर्भे सन्तं रेषणा रेषयन्ति ।
अन्धा अपश्या न दभन्नभिख्या नित्यास ईं प्रेतारो अरक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
na yam ripavo na rishanyavo garbhe santam reshana reshayanti |
andha apashya na dabhannabhikhya nityasa im pretaro arakshan ||
verses.en:
Him, whom while yet in embryo the hostile, both skilled and fain to harm, may never injure,
Men blind and sightless through his splendour hurt not: his never-failing lovers have preserved him.

verses.sa:
महः स राय एषते पतिर्दन्निन इनस्य वसुनः पद आ ।
उप ध्रजन्तमद्रयो विधन्नित् ॥
verses.rom:
mahah sa raya eshate patirdannina inasya vasunah pada a |
upa dhrajantamadrayo vidhannit ||
verses.en:
HITHER he hastens to give, Lord of great riches, King of the mighty, to the place of treasure.
The pressing-stones shall serve him speeding near us.

verses.sa:
स यो वृषा नरां न रोदस्योः श्रवोभिरस्ति जीवपीतसर्गः ।
प्र यः सस्राणः शिश्रीत योनौ ॥
verses.rom:
sa yo vrisha naram na rodasyoh shravobhirasti jivapitasargah |
pra yah sasranah shishrita yonau ||
verses.en:
As Steer of men so Steer of earth and heaven by glory, he whose streams all life hath drunken,
Who hasting forward rests upon the altar.

verses.sa:
आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो नार्वा ।
सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा ॥
verses.rom:
a yah puram narminimadidedatyah kavirnabhanyo narva |
suro na rurukvanchhatatma ||
verses.en:
He who hath lighted up the joyous castle, wise Courser like the Steed of cloudy heaven,
Bright like the Sun, with hundredfold existence.

verses.sa:
अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजांसि शुशुचानो अस्थात् ।
होता यजिष्ठो अपां सधस्थे ॥
