verses.rom:
abhi dvijanma tri rochanani vishva rajamsi shushuchano asthat |
hota yajishtho apam sadhasthe ||
verses.en:
He, doubly born, hath spread in his effulgence through the three luminous realms, through all the regions,
Best sacrificing Priest where waters gather.

verses.sa:
अयं स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या ।
मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa hota yo dvijanma vishva dadhe varyani shravasya |
marto yo asmai sutuko dadasha ||
verses.en:
Priest doubly born, he through his love of glory hath in his keeping all things worth the choosing,
The man who brings him gifts hath noble offspring.

verses.sa:
पुरु त्वा दाश्वान्वोचेऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा ।
तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य ॥
verses.rom:
puru tva dashvanvoche'riragne tava svida |
todasyeva sharana a mahasya ||
verses.en:
AGNI, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift,
As in the keeping of the great inciting God;

verses.sa:
व्यनिनस्य धनिनः प्रहोषे चिदररुषः ।
कदा चन प्रजिगतो अदेवयोः ॥
verses.rom:
vyaninasya dhaninah prahoshe chidararushah |
kada chana prajigato adevayoh ||
verses.en:
Thou who ne'er movest thee to aid the indolent, the godless man,
Him who though wealthy never brings an offering.

verses.sa:
स चन्द्रो विप्र मर्त्यो महो व्राधन्तमो दिवि ।
प्रप्रेत्ते अग्ने वनुषः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
sa chandro vipra martyo maho vradhantamo divi |
praprette agne vanushah syama ||
verses.en:
Splendid, O Singer, is that man, mightiest of the great in heaven.
Agni, may we be foremost, we thy worshippers.

verses.sa:
मित्रं न यं शिम्या गोषु गव्यवः स्वाध्यो विदथे अप्सु जीजनन् ।
अरेजेतां रोदसी पाजसा गिरा प्रति प्रियं यजतं जनुषामवः ॥
verses.rom:
mitram na yam shimya goshu gavyavah svadhyo vidathe apsu jijanan |
arejetam rodasi pajasa gira prati priyam yajatam janushamavah ||
verses.en:
HEAVEN and earth trembled at the might and voice of him, whom, loved and Holy One, helper of all mankind,
The wise who longed for spoil in fight for kine brought forth with power, a Friend, mid waters, at the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यद्ध त्यद्वां पुरुमीळ्हस्य सोमिनः प्र मित्रासो न दधिरे स्वाभुवः ।
अध क्रतुं विदतं गातुमर्चत उत श्रुतं वृषणा पस्त्यावतः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha tyadvam purumilhasya sominah pra mitraso na dadhire svabhuvah |
adha kratum vidatam gatumarchata uta shrutam vrishana pastyavatah ||
verses.en:
As these, like friends, have done this work for you, these prompt servants of Purumilha Soma-offerer,
Give mental power to him who sings the sacred song, and hearken, Strong Ones, to the master of the house.

verses.sa:
आ वां भूषन्क्षितयो जन्म रोदस्योः प्रवाच्यं वृषणा दक्षसे महे ।
यदीमृताय भरथो यदर्वते प्र होत्रया शिम्या वीथो अध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vam bhushankshitayo janma rodasyoh pravachyam vrishana dakshase mahe |
yadimritaya bharatho yadarvate pra hotraya shimya vitho adhvaram ||
verses.en:
The folk have glorified your birth from Earth and Heaven, to be extolled, ye Strong Ones, for your mighty power.
Ye, when ye bring to singer and the rite, enjoy the sacrifice performed with holy praise and strength.

verses.sa:
प्र सा क्षितिरसुर या महि प्रिय ऋतावानावृतमा घोषथो बृहत् ।
युवं दिवो बृहतो दक्षमाभुवं गां न धुर्युप युञ्जाथे अपः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sa kshitirasura ya mahi priya ritavanavritama ghoshatho brihat |
yuvam divo brihato dakshamabhuvam gam na dhuryupa yunjathe apah ||
verses.en:
The people prospers, Asuras! whom ye dearly love: ye, Righteous Ones, proclaim aloud the Holy Law.
That efficacious power that comes from lofty heaven, ye bind unto the work, as to the pole an ox.

verses.sa:
मही अत्र महिना वारमृण्वथोऽरेणवस्तुज आ सद्मन्धेनवः ।
स्वरन्ति ता उपरताति सूर्यमा निम्रुच उषसस्तक्ववीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
mahi atra mahina varamrinvatho'renavastuja a sadmandhenavah |
svaranti ta uparatati suryama nimrucha ushasastakvaviriva ||
verses.en:
On this great earth ye send your treasure down with might: unstained by dust, the crowding kine are in the stalls.
Here in the neighbourhood they cry unto the Sun at morning and at evening, like swift birds of prey.

verses.sa:
आ वामृताय केशिनीरनूषत मित्र यत्र वरुण गातुमर्चथः ।
अव त्मना सृजतं पिन्वतं धियो युवं विप्रस्य मन्मनामिरज्यथः ॥
verses.rom:
a vamritaya keshiniranushata mitra yatra varuna gatumarchathah |
ava tmana srijatam pinvatam dhiyo yuvam viprasya manmanamirajyathah ||
verses.en:
The flames with curling tresses serve your sacrifice, whereto ye sing the song, Mitra and Varuna.
Send down of your free will, prosper our holy songs: ye are sole Masters of the singer's hymn of praise.

verses.sa:
यो वां यज्ञैः शशमानो ह दाशति कविर्होता यजति मन्मसाधनः ।
उपाह तं गच्छथो वीथो अध्वरमच्छा गिरः सुमतिं गन्तमस्मयू ॥
verses.rom:
yo vam yajnaih shashamano ha dashati kavirhota yajati manmasadhanah |
upaha tam gachchhatho vitho adhvaramachchha girah sumatim gantamasmayu ||
verses.en:
Whoso with sacrifices toiling brings you gifts, and worships, sage and priest, fulfilling your desire,--
To him do ye draw nigh and taste his sacrifice. Come well-inclined to us unto our songs and prayer.

verses.sa:
युवां यज्ञैः प्रथमा गोभिरञ्जत ऋतावाना मनसो न प्रयुक्तिषु ।
भरन्ति वां मन्मना संयता गिरोऽदृप्यता मनसा रेवदाशाथे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam yajnaih prathama gobhiranjata ritavana manaso na prayuktishu |
bharanti vam manmana samyata giro'dripyata manasa revadashathe ||
verses.en:
With sacrifices and with milk they deck you first, ye Righteous Ones, as if through stirrings of the mind.
To you they bring their hymns with their collected thought, while ye with earnest soul come to us gloriously.

verses.sa:
रेवद्वयो दधाथे रेवदाशाथे नरा मायाभिरितऊति माहिनम् ।
न वां द्यावोऽहभिर्नोत सिन्धवो न देवत्वं पणयो नानशुर्मघम् ॥
verses.rom:
revadvayo dadhathe revadashathe nara mayabhiritauti mahinam |
na vam dyavo'habhirnota sindhavo na devatvam panayo nanashurmagham ||
verses.en:
Rich strength of life is yours: ye, Heroes, have obtained through your surpassing powers rich far-extending might.
Not the past days conjoined with nights, not rivers, not the Panis have attained your Godhead and your wealth.

verses.sa:
युवं वस्त्राणि पीवसा वसाथे युवोरच्छिद्रा मन्तवो ह सर्गाः ।
अवातिरतमनृतानि विश्व ऋतेन मित्रावरुणा सचेथे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam vastrani pivasa vasathe yuvorachchhidra mantavo ha sargah |
avatiratamanritani vishva ritena mitravaruna sachethe ||
verses.en:
THE robes which ye put on abound with fatness: uninterrupted courses are your counsels.
All falsehood, Mitra-Varuna! ye conquer, and closely cleave unto the Law Eternal.

verses.sa:
एतच्चन त्वो वि चिकेतदेषां सत्यो मन्त्रः कविशस्त ऋघावान् ।
त्रिरश्रिं हन्ति चतुरश्रिरुग्रो देवनिदो ह प्रथमा अजूर्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
etachchana tvo vi chiketadesham satyo mantrah kavishasta righavan |
trirashrim hanti chaturashrirugro devanido ha prathama ajuryan ||
verses.en:
This might of theirs hath no one comprehended. True is the crushing word the sage hath uttered,
The fearful four-edged bolt smites down the three-edged, and those who hate the Gods first fall and perish.

verses.sa:
अपादेति प्रथमा पद्वतीनां कस्तद्वां मित्रावरुणा चिकेत ।
गर्भो भारं भरत्या चिदस्य ऋतं पिपर्त्यनृतं नि तारीत् ॥
verses.rom:
apadeti prathama padvatinam kastadvam mitravaruna chiketa |
garbho bharam bharatya chidasya ritam pipartyanritam ni tarit ||
verses.en:
The Footless Maid precedeth footed creatures. Who marketh, Mitra-Varuna, this your doing?
The Babe Unborn supporteth this world's burthen, fulfilleth Law and overcometh falsehood.

verses.sa:
प्रयन्तमित्परि जारं कनीनां पश्यामसि नोपनिपद्यमानम् ।
अनवपृग्णा वितता वसानं प्रियं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम ॥
verses.rom:
prayantamitpari jaram kaninam pashyamasi nopanipadyamanam |
anavaprigna vitata vasanam priyam mitrasya varunasya dhama ||
verses.en:
We look on him the darling of the Maidens, always advancing, never falling downward,
Wearing inseparable, wide-spread raiment, Mitra's and Varuna's delightful glory.

verses.sa:
अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरर्वा कनिक्रदत्पतयदूर्ध्वसानुः ।
अचित्तं ब्रह्म जुजुषुर्युवानः प्र मित्रे धाम वरुणे गृणन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
anashvo jato anabhishurarva kanikradatpatayadurdhvasanuh |
achittam brahma jujushuryuvanah pra mitre dhama varune grinantah ||
verses.en:
Unbridled Courser, born but not of horses, neighing he flieth on with back uplifted.
The youthful love mystery thought-surpassing, praising in Mitra-Varuna, its glory.

verses.sa:
आ धेनवो मामतेयमवन्तीर्ब्रह्मप्रियं पीपयन्सस्मिन्नूधन् ।
पित्वो भिक्षेत वयुनानि विद्वानासाविवासन्नदितिमुरुष्येत् ॥
verses.rom:
a dhenavo mamateyamavantirbrahmapriyam pipayansasminnudhan |
pitvo bhiksheta vayunani vidvanasavivasannaditimurushyet ||
verses.en:
May the milch-kine who favour Mamateya prosper in this world him who loves devotion.
May he, well skilled in rites, be food, and calling Aditi with his lips give us assistance.

verses.sa:
आ वां मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं नमसा देवाववसा ववृत्याम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु सह्या अस्माकं वृष्टिर्दिव्या सुपारा ॥
verses.rom:
a vam mitravaruna havyajushtim namasa devavavasa vavrityam |
asmakam brahma pritanasu sahya asmakam vrishtirdivya supara ||
verses.en:
Gods, Mitra-Varuna, with love and worship, let me make you delight in this oblation.
May our prayer be victorious in battles, may we have rain from heaven to make us prosper.

verses.sa:
यजामहे वां महः सजोषा हव्येभिर्मित्रावरुणा नमोभिः ।
घृतैर्घृतस्नू अध यद्वामस्मे अध्वर्यवो न धीतिभिर्भरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yajamahe vam mahah sajosha havyebhirmitravaruna namobhih |
ghritairghritasnu adha yadvamasme adhvaryavo na dhitibhirbharanti ||
verses.en:
WE worship with our reverence and oblations you, Mitra Varuna, accordant, mighty,
So that with us, ye Twain whose backs are sprinkled with oil, the priests with oil and hymns support you.

verses.sa:
प्रस्तुतिर्वां धाम न प्रयुक्तिरयामि मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिः ।
अनक्ति यद्वां विदथेषु होता सुम्नं वां सूरिर्वृषणावियक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
prastutirvam dhama na prayuktirayami mitravaruna suvriktih |
anakti yadvam vidatheshu hota sumnam vam surirvrishanaviyakshan ||
verses.en:
Your praise is like a mighty power, an impulse: to you, Twain Gods, a well-formed hymn is offered,
As the priest decks yon, Strong Ones, in assemblies, and the prince fain to worship you for blessings.

verses.sa:
पीपाय धेनुरदितिरृताय जनाय मित्रावरुणा हविर्दे ।
हिनोति यद्वां विदथे सपर्यन्स रातहव्यो मानुषो न होता ॥
verses.rom:
pipaya dhenuraditirritaya janaya mitravaruna havirde |
hinoti yadvam vidathe saparyansa ratahavyo manusho na hota ||
verses.en:
O Mitra-Varuna, Aditi the Milch-cow streams for the rite, for folk who bring oblation,
When in the assembly he who worships moves you, like to a human priest, with gifts presented.

verses.sa:
उत वां विक्षु मद्यास्वन्धो गाव आपश्च पीपयन्त देवीः ।
उतो नो अस्य पूर्व्यः पतिर्दन्वीतं पातं पयस उस्रियायाः ॥
verses.rom:
uta vam vikshu madyasvandho gava apashcha pipayanta devih |
uto no asya purvyah patirdanvitam patam payasa usriyayah ||
verses.en:
So may the kine and heavenly Waters pour you sweet drink in families that make you joyful.
Of this may he, the ancient House-Lord, give us. Enjoy, drink of the milk the cow provideth.

verses.sa:
विष्णोर्नु कं वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि ।
यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणस्त्रेधोरुगायः ॥
verses.rom:
vishnornu kam viryani pra vocham yah parthivani vimame rajamsi |
yo askabhayaduttaram sadhastham vichakramanastredhorugayah ||
verses.en:
I WILL declare the mighty deeds of Visnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions,
Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his footstep, widely striding.

verses.sa:
प्र तद्विष्णु स्तवते वीर्येण मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः ।
यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमणेष्वधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
pra tadvishnu stavate viryena mrigo na bhimah kucharo girishthah |
yasyorushu trishu vikramaneshvadhikshiyanti bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
For this his mighty deed is Visnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming;
He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation.

verses.sa:
प्र विष्णवे शूषमेतु मन्म गिरिक्षित उरुगायाय वृष्णे ।
य इदं दीर्घं प्रयतं सधस्थमेको विममे त्रिभिरित्पदेभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vishnave shushametu manma girikshita urugayaya vrishne |
ya idam dirgham prayatam sadhasthameko vimame tribhiritpadebhih ||
verses.en:
Let the hymn lift itself as strength to Visnu, the Bull far-striding, dwelling on the mountains,
Him who alone with triple step hath measured this common dwelling-place, long, far extended.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्री पूर्णा मधुना पदान्यक्षीयमाणा स्वधया मदन्ति ।
य उ त्रिधातु पृथिवीमुत द्यामेको दाधार भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tri purna madhuna padanyakshiyamana svadhaya madanti |
ya u tridhatu prithivimuta dyameko dadhara bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
Him whose three places that are filled with sweetness, imperishable, joy as it may list them,
Who verily alone upholds the threefold, the earth, the heaven, and all living creatures.

verses.sa:
तदस्य प्रियमभि पाथो अश्यां नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति ।
उरुक्रमस्य स हि बन्धुरित्था विष्णोः पदे परमे मध्व उत्सः ॥
verses.rom:
tadasya priyamabhi patho ashyam naro yatra devayavo madanti |
urukramasya sa hi bandhurittha vishnoh pade parame madhva utsah ||
verses.en:
May I attain to that his well-loved mansion where men devoted to the Gods are happy.
For there springs, close akin to the Wide-Strider, the well of meath in Visnu's highest footstep.

verses.sa:
ता वां वास्तून्युश्मसि गमध्यै यत्र गावो भूरिशृङ्गा अयासः ।
अत्राह तदुरुगायस्य वृष्णः परमं पदमव भाति भूरि ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam vastunyushmasi gamadhyai yatra gavo bhurishringa ayasah |
atraha tadurugayasya vrishnah paramam padamava bhati bhuri ||
verses.en:
Fain would we go unto your dwelling-places where there are many-horned and nimble oxen,
For mightily, there, shineth down upon us the widely-striding Bull's sublimest mansion.

verses.sa:
प्र वः पान्तमन्धसो धियायते महे शूराय विष्णवे चार्चत ।
या सानुनि पर्वतानामदाभ्या महस्तस्थतुरर्वतेव साधुना ॥
verses.rom:
pra vah pantamandhaso dhiyayate mahe shuraya vishnave charchata |
ya sanuni parvatanamadabhya mahastasthaturarvateva sadhuna ||
verses.en:
To the great Hero, him who sets his mind thereon, and Visnu, praise aloud in song your draught of juice,--
Gods ne'er beguiled, who borne as 'twere by noble steed, have stood upon the lofty ridges of the hills.

verses.sa:
त्वेषमित्था समरणं शिमीवतोरिन्द्राविष्णू सुतपा वामुरुष्यति ।
या मर्त्याय प्रतिधीयमानमित्कृशानोरस्तुरसनामुरुष्यथः ॥
verses.rom:
tveshamittha samaranam shimivatorindravishnu sutapa vamurushyati |
ya martyaya pratidhiyamanamitkrishanorasturasanamurushyathah ||
verses.en:
Your Soma-drinker keeps afar your furious rush, Indra and Visnu, when ye come with all your might.
That which hath been directed well at mortal man, bow-armed Krsanu's arrow, ye turn far aside.

verses.sa:
ता ईं वर्धन्ति मह्यस्य पौंस्यं नि मातरा नयति रेतसे भुजे ।
दधाति पुत्रोऽवरं परं पितुर्नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ta im vardhanti mahyasya paumsyam ni matara nayati retase bhuje |
dadhati putro'varam param piturnama tritiyamadhi rochane divah ||
verses.en:
These offerings increase his mighty manly strength: he brings both Parents down to share the genial flow.
He lowers, though a son, the Father's highest name; the third is that which is high in the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसीनस्य त्रातुरवृकस्य मीळ्हुषः ।
यः पार्थिवानि त्रिभिरिद्विगामभिरुरु क्रमिष्टोरुगायाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tattadidasya paumsyam grinimasinasya traturavrikasya milhushah |
yah parthivani tribhiridvigamabhiruru kramishtorugayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
We laud this manly power of him the Mighty One, preserver, inoffensive, bounteous and benign;
His who strode, widely pacing, with three steppings forth over the realms of earth for freedom and for life.

verses.sa:
द्वे इदस्य क्रमणे स्वर्दृशोऽभिख्याय मर्त्यो भुरण्यति ।
तृतीयमस्य नकिरा दधर्षति वयश्चन पतयन्तः पतत्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
dve idasya kramane svardrisho'bhikhyaya martyo bhuranyati |
tritiyamasya nakira dadharshati vayashchana patayantah patatrinah ||
verses.en:
A mortal man, when he beholds two steps of him who looks upon the light, is restless with amaze.
But his third step doth no one venture to approach, no, nor the feathered birds of air who fly with wings.

verses.sa:
चतुर्भिः साकं नवतिं च नामभिश्चक्रं न वृत्तं व्यतीँरवीविपत् ।
बृहच्छरीरो विमिमान ऋक्वभिर्युवाकुमारः प्रत्येत्याहवम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturbhih sakam navatim cha namabhishchakram na vrittam vyatinravivipat |
brihachchhariro vimimana rikvabhiryuvakumarah pratyetyahavam ||
verses.en:
He, like a rounded wheel, hath in swift motion set his ninety racing steeds together with the four.
Developed, vast in form, with those who sing forth praise, a youth, no more a child, he cometh to our call.

verses.sa:
भवा मित्रो न शेव्यो घृतासुतिर्विभूतद्युम्न एवया उ सप्रथाः ।
अधा ते विष्णो विदुषा चिदर्ध्य स्तोमो यज्ञश्च राध्यो हविष्मता ॥
verses.rom:
bhava mitro na shevyo ghritasutirvibhutadyumna evaya u saprathah |
adha te vishno vidusha chidardhya stomo yajnashcha radhyo havishmata ||
verses.en:
FAR-SHINING, widely famed, going thy wonted way, fed with the oil, be helpful. Mitra-like, to us.
So, Visnu, e'en the wise must swell thy song of praise, and he who hath oblations pay thee solemn rites.

verses.sa:
यः पूर्व्याय वेधसे नवीयसे सुमज्जानये विष्णवे ददाशति ।
यो जातमस्य महतो महि ब्रवत्सेदु श्रवोभिर्युज्यं चिदभ्यसत् ॥
verses.rom:
yah purvyaya vedhase naviyase sumajjanaye vishnave dadashati |
yo jatamasya mahato mahi bravatsedu shravobhiryujyam chidabhyasat ||
verses.en:
He who brings gifts to him the Ancient and the Last, to Visnu who ordains, together with his Spouse,
Who tells the lofty birth of him the Lofty One, shall verily surpass in glory e'en his peer.

verses.sa:
तमु स्तोतारः पूर्व्यं यथा विद ऋतस्य गर्भं जनुषा पिपर्तन ।
आस्य जानन्तो नाम चिद्विवक्तन महस्ते विष्णो सुमतिं भजामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tamu stotarah purvyam yatha vida ritasya garbham janusha pipartana |
asya jananto nama chidvivaktana mahaste vishno sumatim bhajamahe ||
verses.en:
Him have ye satisfied, singers, as well as ye know, primeval gem of Order even from his birth.
Ye, knowing e'en his name, have told it forth: may we, Visnu, enjoy the grace of thee the Mighty One.

verses.sa:
तमस्य राजा वरुणस्तमश्विना क्रतुं सचन्त मारुतस्य वेधसः ।
दाधार दक्षमुत्तममहर्विदं व्रजं च विष्णुः सखिवाँ अपोर्णुते ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya raja varunastamashvina kratum sachanta marutasya vedhasah |
dadhara dakshamuttamamaharvidam vrajam cha vishnuh sakhivan apornute ||
verses.en:
The Sovran Varuna and both the Asvins wait on this the will of him who guides the Marut host.
Visnu hath power supreme and might that finds the day, and with his Friend unbars the stable of the kine.

verses.sa:
आ यो विवाय सचथाय दैव्य इन्द्राय विष्णुः सुकृते सुकृत्तरः ।
वेधा अजिन्वत्त्रिषधस्थ आर्यमृतस्य भागे यजमानमाभजत् ॥
verses.rom:
a yo vivaya sachathaya daivya indraya vishnuh sukrite sukrittarah |
vedha ajinvattrishadhastha aryamritasya bhage yajamanamabhajat ||
verses.en:
Even he the Heavenly One who came for fellowship, Visnu to Indra, godly to the godlier,
Who Maker, throned in three worlds, helps the Aryan man, and gives the worshipper his share of Holy Law.

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्युषाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा ।
आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक् ॥
verses.rom:
abodhyagnirjma udeti suryo vyushashchandra mahyavo archisha |
ayukshatamashvina yatave ratham prasaviddevah savita jagatprithak ||
verses.en:
AGNI is wakened: Surya riseth from the earth. Mighty, refulgent Dawn hath shone with all her light.
The Asvins have equipped their chariot for the course. God Savitar hath moved the folk in sundry ways.

verses.sa:
यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadyunjathe vrishanamashvina ratham ghritena no madhuna kshatramukshatam |
asmakam brahma pritanasu jinvatam vayam dhana shurasata bhajemahi ||
verses.en:
When, Asvins, ye equip your very mighty car, bedew, ye Twain, our power with honey and with oil.
To our devotion give victorious strength in war: may we win riches in the heroes' strife for spoil.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः ।
त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
arvantrichakro madhuvahano ratho jirashvo ashvinoryatu sushtutah |
trivandhuro maghava vishvasaubhagah sham na a vakshaddvipade chatushpade ||
verses.en:
Nigh to us come the Asvins' lauded three-wheeled car, the car laden with meath and drawn by fleet-foot steeds,
Three-seated, opulent, bestowing all delight. may it bring weal to us, to cattle and to men.

verses.sa:
आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवं मधुमत्या नः कशया मिमिक्षतम् ।
प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा ॥
verses.rom:
a na urjam vahatamashvina yuvam madhumatya nah kashaya mimikshatam |
prayustarishtam ni rapamsi mrikshatam sedhatam dvesho bhavatam sachabhuva ||
verses.en:
Bring hither nourishment for us, ye Asvins Twain; sprinkle us with your whip that drops with honey-dew.
Prolong our days of life, wipe out our trespasses; destroy our foes, be our companions and our Friends.

verses.sa:
युवं ह गर्भं जगतीषु धत्थो युवं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः ।
युवमग्निं च वृषणावपश्च वनस्पतीँरश्विनावैरयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha garbham jagatishu dhattho yuvam vishveshu bhuvaneshvantah |
yuvamagnim cha vrishanavapashcha vanaspatinrashvinavairayetham ||
verses.en:
Ye store the germ of life in female creatures, ye lay it up within all living beings.
Ye have sent forth, O Asvins passing mighty, the fire, the sovrans of the wood, the waters,

verses.sa:
युवं ह स्थो भिषजा भेषजेभिरथो ह स्थो रथ्या राथ्येभिः ।
अथो ह क्षत्रमधि धत्थ उग्रा यो वां हविष्मान्मनसा ददाश ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha stho bhishaja bheshajebhiratho ha stho rathya rathyebhih |
atho ha kshatramadhi dhattha ugra yo vam havishmanmanasa dadasha ||
verses.en:
Leeches are ye with medicines to heal us, and charioteers are ye with skill in driving.
Ye Strong, give sway to him who brings oblation and with his heart pours out his gift before you.

verses.sa:
वसू रुद्रा पुरुमन्तू वृधन्ता दशस्यतं नो वृषणावभिष्टौ ।
दस्रा ह यद्रेक्ण औचथ्यो वां प्र यत्सस्राथे अकवाभिरूती ॥
verses.rom:
vasu rudra purumantu vridhanta dashasyatam no vrishanavabhishtau |
dasra ha yadrekna auchathyo vam pra yatsasrathe akavabhiruti ||
verses.en:
YE Vasus Twain, ye Rudras full of counsel, grant us, Strong Strengtheners, when ye stand beside us,
What wealth Aucathya craves of you, great Helpers when ye come forward with no niggard succour.

verses.sa:
को वां दाशत्सुमतये चिदस्यै वसू यद्धेथे नमसा पदे गोः ।
जिगृतमस्मे रेवतीः पुरंधीः कामप्रेणेव मनसा चरन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
ko vam dashatsumataye chidasyai vasu yaddhethe namasa pade goh |
jigritamasme revatih puramdhih kamapreneva manasa charanta ||
verses.en:
Who may give you aught, Vasus, for your favour, for what, at the Cow's place, ye grant through worship?
Wake for us understanding full of riches, come with a heart that will fulfil our longing.

verses.sa:
युक्तो ह यद्वां तौग्र्याय पेरुर्वि मध्ये अर्णसो धायि पज्रः ।
उप वामवः शरणं गमेयं शूरो नाज्म पतयद्भिरेवैः ॥
verses.rom:
yukto ha yadvam taugryaya perurvi madhye arnaso dhayi pajrah |
upa vamavah sharanam gameyam shuro najma patayadbhirevaih ||
verses.en:
As erst for Tugra's son your car, sea-crossing, strong, was equipped and set amid the waters,
So may I gain your shelter and protection as with winged course a hero seeks his army.

verses.sa:
उपस्तुतिरौचथ्यमुरुष्येन्मा मामिमे पतत्रिणी वि दुग्धाम् ।
मा मामेधो दशतयश्चितो धाक्प्र यद्वां बद्धस्त्मनि खादति क्षाम् ॥
verses.rom:
upastutirauchathyamurushyenma mamime patatrini vi dugdham |
ma mamedho dashatayashchito dhakpra yadvam baddhastmani khadati ksham ||
verses.en:
May this my praise preserve Ucathya's offspring: let not these Twain who fly with wings exhaust me.
Let not the wood ten times up-piled consume me, when fixed for you it bites the ground it stands on.

verses.sa:
न मा गरन्नद्यो मातृतमा दासा यदीं सुसमुब्धमवाधुः ।
शिरो यदस्य त्रैतनो वितक्षत्स्वयं दास उरो अंसावपि ग्ध ॥
verses.rom:
na ma garannadyo matritama dasa yadim susamubdhamavadhuh |
shiro yadasya traitano vitakshatsvayam dasa uro amsavapi gdha ||
verses.en:
The most maternal streams, wherein the Dasas cast me securely bound, have not devoured me.
When Traitana would cleave my head asunder, the Dasa wounded his own breast and shoulders.

verses.sa:
दीर्घतमा मामतेयो जुजुर्वान्दशमे युगे ।
अपामर्थं यतीनां ब्रह्मा भवति सारथिः ॥
verses.rom:
dirghatama mamateyo jujurvandashame yuge |
apamartham yatinam brahma bhavati sarathih ||
verses.en:
Dirghatamas the son of Mamata hath come to length of days in the tenth age of human kind.
He is the Brahman of the waters as they strive to reach their end and aim: their charioteer is he.

verses.sa:
प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा मही स्तुषे विदथेषु प्रचेतसा ।
देवेभिर्ये देवपुत्रे सुदंससेत्था धिया वार्याणि प्रभूषतः ॥
verses.rom:
pra dyava yajnaih prithivi ritavridha mahi stushe vidatheshu prachetasa |
devebhirye devaputre sudamsasettha dhiya varyani prabhushatah ||
verses.en:
I PRAISE with sacrifices mighty Heaven and Earth at festivals, the wise, the Strengtheners of Law.
Who, having Gods for progeny, conjoined with Gods, through wonder-working wisdom bring forth choicest boons.

verses.sa:
उत मन्ये पितुरद्रुहो मनो मातुर्महि स्वतवस्तद्धवीमभिः ।
सुरेतसा पितरा भूम चक्रतुरुरु प्रजाया अमृतं वरीमभिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta manye pituradruho mano maturmahi svatavastaddhavimabhih |
suretasa pitara bhuma chakratururu prajaya amritam varimabhih ||
verses.en:
With invocations, on the gracious Father's mind, and on the Mother's great inherent power I muse.
Prolific Parents, they have made the world of life, and for their brood all round wide immortality.

verses.sa:
ते सूनवः स्वपसः सुदंससो मही जज्ञुर्मातरा पूर्वचित्तये ।
स्थातुश्च सत्यं जगतश्च धर्मणि पुत्रस्य पाथः पदमद्वयाविनः ॥
verses.rom:
te sunavah svapasah sudamsaso mahi jajnurmatara purvachittaye |
sthatushcha satyam jagatashcha dharmani putrasya pathah padamadvayavinah ||
verses.en:
These Sons of yours well skilled in work, of wondrous power, brought forth to life the two great Mothers first of all.
To keep the truth of all that stands and all that moves, ye guard the station of your Son who knows no guile.

verses.sa:
ते मायिनो ममिरे सुप्रचेतसो जामी सयोनी मिथुना समोकसा ।
नव्यंनव्यं तन्तुमा तन्वते दिवि समुद्रे अन्तः कवयः सुदीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
te mayino mamire suprachetaso jami sayoni mithuna samokasa |
navyamnavyam tantuma tanvate divi samudre antah kavayah suditayah ||
verses.en:
They with surpassing skill, most wise, have measured out the Twins united in their birth and in their home.
They, the refulgent Sages, weave within the sky, yea, in the depths of sea, a web for ever new.

verses.sa:
तद्राधो अद्य सवितुर्वरेण्यं वयं देवस्य प्रसवे मनामहे ।
अस्मभ्यं द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं शतग्विनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadradho adya saviturvarenyam vayam devasya prasave manamahe |
asmabhyam dyavaprithivi suchetuna rayim dhattam vasumantam shatagvinam ||
verses.en:
This is to-day the goodliest gift of Savitar: this thought we have when now the God is furthering us.
On us with loving-kindness Heaven and Earth bestow riches and various wealth and treasure hundredfold!

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी विश्वशम्भुव ऋतावरी रजसो धारयत्कवी ।
सुजन्मनी धिषणे अन्तरीयते देवो देवी धर्मणा सूर्यः शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi dyavaprithivi vishvashambhuva ritavari rajaso dharayatkavi |
sujanmani dhishane antariyate devo devi dharmana suryah shuchih ||
verses.en:
THESE, Heaven and Earth, bestow prosperity on all, sustainers of the region, Holy Ones and wise,
Two Bowls of noble kind: between these Goddesses the God, the fulgent Sun, travels by fixed decree.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचसा महिनी असश्चता पिता माता च भुवनानि रक्षतः ।
सुधृष्टमे वपुष्ये न रोदसी पिता यत्सीमभि रूपैरवासयत् ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyachasa mahini asashchata pita mata cha bhuvanani rakshatah |
sudhrishtame vapushye na rodasi pita yatsimabhi rupairavasayat ||
verses.en:
Widely-capacious Pair, mighty, that never fail, the Father and the Mother keep all creatures safe:
The two world-halves, the spirited, the beautiful, because the Father hath clothed them in goodly forms.

verses.sa:
स वह्निः पुत्रः पित्रोः पवित्रवान्पुनाति धीरो भुवनानि मायया ।
धेनुं च पृश्निं वृषभं सुरेतसं विश्वाहा शुक्रं पयो अस्य दुक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
sa vahnih putrah pitroh pavitravanpunati dhiro bhuvanani mayaya |
dhenum cha prishnim vrishabham suretasam vishvaha shukram payo asya dukshata ||
verses.en:
Son of these Parents, he the Priest with power to cleanse, Sage, sanctifies the worlds with his surpassing power.
Thereto for his bright milk he milked through all the days the party-coloured Cow and the prolific Bull.

verses.sa:
अयं देवानामपसामपस्तमो यो जजान रोदसी विश्वशम्भुवा ।
वि यो ममे रजसी सुक्रतूययाजरेभि स्कम्भनेभिः समानृचे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam devanamapasamapastamo yo jajana rodasi vishvashambhuva |
vi yo mame rajasi sukratuyayajarebhi skambhanebhih samanriche ||
verses.en:
Among the skilful Gods most skilled is he, who made the two world-halves which bring prosperity to all;
Who with great wisdom measured both the regions out, and stablished them with pillars that shall ne'er decay.

verses.sa:
ते नो गृणाने महिनी महि श्रवः क्षत्रं द्यावापृथिवी धासथो बृहत् ।
येनाभि कृष्टीस्ततनाम विश्वहा पनाय्यमोजो अस्मे समिन्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
te no grinane mahini mahi shravah kshatram dyavaprithivi dhasatho brihat |
yenabhi krishtistatanama vishvaha panayyamojo asme saminvatam ||
verses.en:
Extolled in song, O Heaven and Earth, bestow on us, ye mighty Pair, great glory and high lordly sway,
Whereby we may extend ourselves ever over the folk; and send us strength that shall deserve the praise of men.

verses.sa:
किमु श्रेष्ठः किं यविष्ठो न आजगन्किमीयते दूत्यं कद्यदूचिम ।
न निन्दिम चमसं यो महाकुलोऽग्ने भ्रातर्द्रुण इद्भूतिमूदिम ॥
verses.rom:
kimu shreshthah kim yavishtho na ajagankimiyate dutyam kadyaduchima |
na nindima chamasam yo mahakulo'gne bhratardruna idbhutimudima ||
verses.en:
WHY hath the Best, why hath the Youngest come to us? Upon what embassy comes he? What have we said?
We have not blamed the chalice of illustrious birth. We, Brother Agni, praised the goodness of the wood.

verses.sa:
एकं चमसं चतुरः कृणोतन तद्वो देवा अब्रुवन्तद्व आगमम् ।
सौधन्वना यद्येवा करिष्यथ साकं देवैर्यज्ञियासो भविष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
ekam chamasam chaturah krinotana tadvo deva abruvantadva agamam |
saudhanvana yadyeva karishyatha sakam devairyajniyaso bhavishyatha ||
verses.en:
The chalice that is single make ye into four: thus have the Gods commanded; therefore am I come.
If, O Sudhanvan's Children, ye will do this thing ye shall participate in sacrifice with Gods.

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं प्रति यदब्रवीतनाश्वः कर्त्वो रथ उतेह कर्त्वः ।
धेनुः कर्त्वा युवशा कर्त्वा द्वा तानि भ्रातरनु वः कृत्व्येमसि ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dutam prati yadabravitanashvah kartvo ratha uteha kartvah |
dhenuh kartva yuvasha kartva dva tani bhrataranu vah kritvyemasi ||
verses.en:
What to the envoy Agni in reply ye spake, A courser must be made, a chariot fashioned here,
A cow must be created, and the Twain made young. When we have done these things, Brother, we turn to you.

verses.sa:
चकृवांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छत क्वेदभूद्यः स्य दूतो न आजगन् ।
यदावाख्यच्चमसाञ्चतुरः कृतानादित्त्वष्टा ग्नास्वन्तर्न्यानजे ॥
verses.rom:
chakrivamsa ribhavastadaprichchhata kvedabhudyah sya duto na ajagan |
yadavakhyachchamasanchaturah kritanadittvashta gnasvantarnyanaje ||
verses.en:
When thus, O Rbhus, ye had done ye questioned thus, Whither went he who came to us a messenger?
Then Tvastar, when he viewed the four wrought chalices, concealed himself among the Consorts of the Gods.

verses.sa:
हनामैनाँ इति त्वष्टा यदब्रवीच्चमसं ये देवपानमनिन्दिषुः ।
अन्या नामानि कृण्वते सुते सचाँ अन्यैरेनान्कन्या नामभि स्परत् ॥
verses.rom:
hanamainan iti tvashta yadabravichchamasam ye devapanamanindishuh |
anya namani krinvate sute sachan anyairenankanya namabhi sparat ||
verses.en:
As Tvastar thus had spoken, Let us slay these men who have reviled the chalice, drinking-cup of Gods,
They gave themselves new names when Soma juice was shed, and under these new names the Maiden welcomed them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो हरी युयुजे अश्विना रथं बृहस्पतिर्विश्वरूपामुपाजत ।
ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाजो देवाँ अगच्छत स्वपसो यज्ञियं भागमैतन ॥
verses.rom:
indro hari yuyuje ashvina ratham brihaspatirvishvarupamupajata |
ribhurvibhva vajo devan agachchhata svapaso yajniyam bhagamaitana ||
verses.en:
Indra hath yoked his Bays, the Asvins' car is horsed, Brhaspati hath brought the Cow of every hue.
Ye went as Rbhus, Vibhvan, Vaja to the Gods, and skilled in war, obtained your share in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिर्या जरन्ता युवशा ताकृणोतन ।
सौधन्वना अश्वादश्वमतक्षत युक्त्वा रथमुप देवाँ अयातन ॥
verses.rom:
nishcharmano gamarinita dhitibhirya jaranta yuvasha takrinotana |
saudhanvana ashvadashvamatakshata yuktva rathamupa devan ayatana ||
verses.en:
Ye by your wisdom brought a cow from out a hide; unto that ancient Pair ye gave again their youth.
Out of a horse, Sudhanvan's Sons, ye formed a horse: a chariot ye equipped, and went unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
इदमुदकं पिबतेत्यब्रवीतनेदं वा घा पिबता मुञ्जनेजनम् ।
सौधन्वना यदि तन्नेव हर्यथ तृतीये घा सवने मादयाध्वै ॥
verses.rom:
idamudakam pibatetyabravitanedam va gha pibata munjanejanam |
saudhanvana yadi tanneva haryatha tritiye gha savane madayadhvai ||
verses.en:
Drink ye this water, were the words ye spake to them; or drink ye this, the rinsing of the Muñja-grass.
If ye approve not even this, Sudhanvan's Sons, then at the third libation gladden ye yourselves.

verses.sa:
आपो भूयिष्ठा इत्येको अब्रवीदग्निर्भूयिष्ठ इत्यन्यो अब्रवीत् ।
वधर्यन्तीं बहुभ्यः प्रैको अब्रवीदृता वदन्तश्चमसाँ अपिंशत ॥
verses.rom:
apo bhuyishtha ityeko abravidagnirbhuyishtha ityanyo abravit |
vadharyantim bahubhyah praiko abravidrita vadantashchamasan apimshata ||
verses.en:
Most excellent are waters, thus said one of you; most excellent is Agni, thus another said.
Another praised to many a one the lightning cloud. Then did ye shape the cups, speaking the words of truth.

verses.sa:
श्रोणामेक उदकं गामवाजति मांसमेकः पिंशति सूनयाभृतम् ।
आ निम्रुचः शकृदेको अपाभरत्किं स्वित्पुत्रेभ्यः पितरा उपावतुः ॥
verses.rom:
shronameka udakam gamavajati mamsamekah pimshati sunayabhritam |
a nimruchah shakrideko apabharatkim svitputrebhyah pitara upavatuh ||
verses.en:
One downward to the water drives the crippled cow, another trims the flesh brought on the carving-board.
One carries off the refuse at the set of sun. How did the Parents aid their children in their task!

verses.sa:
उद्वत्स्वस्मा अकृणोतना तृणं निवत्स्वपः स्वपस्यया नरः ।
अगोह्यस्य यदसस्तना गृहे तदद्येदमृभवो नानु गच्छथ ॥
verses.rom:
udvatsvasma akrinotana trinam nivatsvapah svapasyaya narah |
agohyasya yadasastana grihe tadadyedamribhavo nanu gachchhatha ||
verses.en:
On the high places ye have made the grass for man, and water in the valleys, by your skill, O Men.
Rbhus, ye iterate not to-day that act of yours, your sleeping in the house of him whom naught can hide.

verses.sa:
सम्मील्य यद्भुवना पर्यसर्पत क्व स्वित्तात्या पितरा व आसतुः ।
अशपत यः करस्नं व आददे यः प्राब्रवीत्प्रो तस्मा अब्रवीतन ॥
verses.rom:
sammilya yadbhuvana paryasarpata kva svittatya pitara va asatuh |
ashapata yah karasnam va adade yah prabravitpro tasma abravitana ||
verses.en:
As, compassing them round, ye glided through the worlds, where had the venerable Parents their abode?
Ye laid a curse on him who raised his arm at you: to him who spake aloud to you ye spake again.

verses.sa:
सुषुप्वांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छतागोह्य क इदं नो अबूबुधत् ।
श्वानं बस्तो बोधयितारमब्रवीत्संवत्सर इदमद्या व्यख्यत ॥
verses.rom:
sushupvamsa ribhavastadaprichchhatagohya ka idam no abubudhat |
shvanam basto bodhayitaramabravitsamvatsara idamadya vyakhyata ||
verses.en:
When ye had slept your fill, ye Rbhus, thus ye asked, O thou whom naught may hide, who now hath wakened us?
The goat declared the hound to be your wakener. That day, in a full year, ye first unclosed our eyes.

verses.sa:
दिवा यान्ति मरुतो भूम्याग्निरयं वातो अन्तरिक्षेण याति ।
अद्भिर्याति वरुणः समुद्रैर्युष्माँ इच्छन्तः शवसो नपातः ॥
verses.rom:
diva yanti maruto bhumyagnirayam vato antarikshena yati |
adbhiryati varunah samudrairyushman ichchhantah shavaso napatah ||
verses.en:
The Maruts move in heaven, on earth this Agni; through the mid-firmament the Wind approaches.
Varuna comes in the sea's gathered waters, O Sons of Strength, desirous of your presence.

verses.sa:
मा नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतः परि ख्यन् ।
यद्वाजिनो देवजातस्य सप्तेः प्रवक्ष्यामो विदथे वीर्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no mitro varuno aryamayurindra ribhuksha marutah pari khyan |
yadvajino devajatasya sapteh pravakshyamo vidathe viryani ||
verses.en:
SLIGHT us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Rbhuksan, Indra, Ayu, or the Maruts,
When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the strong Steed, God-descended.

verses.sa:
यन्निर्णिजा रेक्णसा प्रावृतस्य रातिं गृभीतां मुखतो नयन्ति ।
सुप्राङजो मेम्यद्विश्वरूप इन्द्रापूष्णोः प्रियमप्येति पाथः ॥
verses.rom:
yannirnija reknasa pravritasya ratim gribhitam mukhato nayanti |
supranajo memyadvishvarupa indrapushnoh priyamapyeti pathah ||
verses.en:
What time they bear before the Courser, covered with trappings and with wealth, the grasped oblation,
The dappled goat goeth straightforward, bleating, to the place dear to Indra and to Pusan.

verses.sa:
एष च्छागः पुरो अश्वेन वाजिना पूष्णो भागो नीयते विश्वदेव्यः ।
अभिप्रियं यत्पुरोळाशमर्वता त्वष्टेदेनं सौश्रवसाय जिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
esha chchhagah puro ashvena vajina pushno bhago niyate vishvadevyah |
abhipriyam yatpurolashamarvata tvashtedenam saushravasaya jinvati ||
verses.en:
Dear to all Gods, this goat, the share of Pusan, is first led forward with the vigorous Courser,
While Tvastar sends him forward with the Charger, acceptable for sacrifice, to glory.

verses.sa:
यद्धविष्यमृतुशो देवयानं त्रिर्मानुषाः पर्यश्वं नयन्ति ।
अत्रा पूष्णः प्रथमो भाग एति यज्ञं देवेभ्यः प्रतिवेदयन्नजः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddhavishyamritusho devayanam trirmanushah paryashvam nayanti |
atra pushnah prathamo bhaga eti yajnam devebhyah prativedayannajah ||
verses.en:
When thrice the men lead round the Steed, in order, who goeth to the Gods as meet oblation,
The goat precedeth him, the share of Pusan, and to the Gods the sacrifice announceth.

verses.sa:
होताध्वर्युरावया अग्निमिन्धो ग्रावग्राभ उत शंस्ता सुविप्रः ।
तेन यज्ञेन स्वरंकृतेन स्विष्टेन वक्षणा आ पृणध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
hotadhvaryuravaya agnimindho gravagrabha uta shamsta suviprah |
tena yajnena svaramkritena svishtena vakshana a prinadhvam ||
verses.en:
Invoker, ministering priest, atoner, fire-kindler Soma-presser, sage, reciter,
With this well ordered sacrifice, well finished, do ye fill full the channels of the rivers.

verses.sa:
यूपव्रस्का उत ये यूपवाहाश्चषालं ये अश्वयूपाय तक्षति ।
ये चार्वते पचनं सम्भरन्त्युतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
yupavraska uta ye yupavahashchashalam ye ashvayupaya takshati |
ye charvate pachanam sambharantyuto teshamabhigurtirna invatu ||
verses.en:
The hewers of the post and those who carry it, and those who carve the knob to deck the Horse's stake;
Those who prepare the cooking-vessels for the Steed,--may the approving help of these promote our work.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात्सुमन्मेऽधायि मन्म देवानामाशा उप वीतपृष्ठः ।
अन्वेनं विप्रा ऋषयो मदन्ति देवानां पुष्टे चकृमा सुबन्धुम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa pragatsumanme'dhayi manma devanamasha upa vitaprishthah |
anvenam vipra rishayo madanti devanam pushte chakrima subandhum ||
verses.en:
Forth, for the regions of the Gods, the Charger with his smooth back is come my prayer attends him.
In him rejoice the singers and the sages. A good friend have we won for the Gods' banquet.

verses.sa:
यद्वाजिनो दाम संदानमर्वतो या शीर्षण्या रशना रज्जुरस्य ।
यद्वा घास्य प्रभृतमास्ये तृणं सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yadvajino dama samdanamarvato ya shirshanya rashana rajjurasya |
yadva ghasya prabhritamasye trinam sarva ta te api deveshvastu ||
verses.en:
May the fleet Courser's halter and his heel-ropes, the head-stall and the girths and cords about him.
And the grass put within his mouth to bait him,--among the Gods, too, let all these be with thee.

verses.sa:
यदश्वस्य क्रविषो मक्षिकाश यद्वा स्वरौ स्वधितौ रिप्तमस्ति ।
यद्धस्तयोः शमितुर्यन्नखेषु सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yadashvasya kravisho makshikasha yadva svarau svadhitau riptamasti |
yaddhastayoh shamituryannakheshu sarva ta te api deveshvastu ||
verses.en:
What part of the Steed's flesh the fly hath eaten, or is left sticking to the post or hatchet,
Or to the slayer's hands and nails adhereth,--among the Gods, too, may all this be with thee.

verses.sa:
यदूवध्यमुदरस्यापवाति य आमस्य क्रविषो गन्धो अस्ति ।
सुकृता तच्छमितारः कृण्वन्तूत मेधं शृतपाकं पचन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yaduvadhyamudarasyapavati ya amasya kravisho gandho asti |
sukrita tachchhamitarah krinvantuta medham shritapakam pachantu ||
verses.en:
Food undigested steaming from his belly, and any odour of raw flesh remaining,
This let the immolators set in order and dress the sacrifice with perfect cooking.

verses.sa:
यत्ते गात्रादग्निना पच्यमानादभि शूलं निहतस्यावधावति ।
मा तद्भूम्यामा श्रिषन्मा तृणेषु देवेभ्यस्तदुशद्भ्यो रातमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte gatradagnina pachyamanadabhi shulam nihatasyavadhavati |
ma tadbhumyama shrishanma trineshu devebhyastadushadbhyo ratamastu ||
verses.en:
What from thy body which with fire is roasted, when thou art set upon the spit, distilleth,
Let not that lie on earth or grass neglected, but to the longing Gods let all be offered.

verses.sa:
ये वाजिनं परिपश्यन्ति पक्वं य ईमाहुः सुरभिर्निर्हरेति ।
ये चार्वतो मांसभिक्षामुपासत उतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
ye vajinam paripashyanti pakvam ya imahuh surabhirnirhareti |
ye charvato mamsabhikshamupasata uto teshamabhigurtirna invatu ||
verses.en:
They who observing that the Horse is ready call out and say, the smell is good; remove it;
And, craving meat, await the distribution,--may their approving help promote labour.

verses.sa:
यन्नीक्षणं माँस्पचन्या उखाया या पात्राणि यूष्ण आसेचनानि ।
ऊष्मण्यापिधाना चरूणामङ्काः सूनाः परि भूषन्त्यश्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yannikshanam manspachanya ukhaya ya patrani yushna asechanani |
ushmanyapidhana charunamankah sunah pari bhushantyashvam ||
verses.en:
The trial-fork of the flesh-cooking caldron, the vessels out of which the broth is sprinkled,
The warming-pots, the covers of the dishes, hooks, carving-boards,--all these attend the Charger.

verses.sa:
निक्रमणं निषदनं विवर्तनं यच्च पड्बीशमर्वतः ।
यच्च पपौ यच्च घासिं जघास सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
nikramanam nishadanam vivartanam yachcha padbishamarvatah |
yachcha papau yachcha ghasim jaghasa sarva ta te api deveshvastu ||
verses.en:
The starting-place, his place of rest and rolling, the ropes wherewith the Charger's feet were fastened,
The water that he drank, the food he tasted,--among the Gods, too, may all these attend thee.

verses.sa:
मा त्वाग्निर्ध्वनयीद्धूमगन्धिर्मोखा भ्राजन्त्यभि विक्त जघ्रिः ।
इष्टं वीतमभिगूर्तं वषट्कृतं तं देवासः प्रति गृभ्णन्त्यश्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma tvagnirdhvanayiddhumagandhirmokha bhrajantyabhi vikta jaghrih |
ishtam vitamabhigurtam vashatkritam tam devasah prati gribhnantyashvam ||
verses.en:
Let not the fire, smoke-scented, make thee crackle, nor glowing caldron smell and break to pieces.
Offered, beloved, approved, and consecrated,--such Charger do the Gods accept with favour.

verses.sa:
यदश्वाय वास उपस्तृणन्त्यधीवासं या हिरण्यान्यस्मै ।
संदानमर्वन्तं पड्बीशं प्रिया देवेष्वा यामयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yadashvaya vasa upastrinantyadhivasam ya hiranyanyasmai |
samdanamarvantam padbisham priya deveshva yamayanti ||
verses.en:
The robe they spread upon the Horse to clothe him, the upper covering and the golden trappings,
The halters which restrain the Steed, the heel-ropes,--all these, as grateful to the Gods, they offer.

verses.sa:
यत्ते सादे महसा शूकृतस्य पार्ष्ण्या वा कशया वा तुतोद ।
स्रुचेव ता हविषो अध्वरेषु सर्वा ता ते ब्रह्मणा सूदयामि ॥
verses.rom:
yatte sade mahasa shukritasya parshnya va kashaya va tutoda |
srucheva ta havisho adhvareshu sarva ta te brahmana sudayami ||
verses.en:
If one, when seated, with excessive urging hath with his heel or with his whip distressed thee,
All these thy woes, as with the oblations' ladle at sacrifices, with my prayer I banish.

verses.sa:
चतुस्त्रिंशद्वाजिनो देवबन्धोर्वङ्क्रीरश्वस्य स्वधितिः समेति ।
अच्छिद्रा गात्रा वयुना कृणोत परुष्परुरनुघुष्या वि शस्त ॥
verses.rom:
chatustrimshadvajino devabandhorvankrirashvasya svadhitih sameti |
achchhidra gatra vayuna krinota parushparuranughushya vi shasta ||
verses.en:
The four-and-thirty ribs of the. Swift Charger, kin to the Gods, the slayer's hatchet pierces.
Cut ye with skill, so that the parts be flawless, and piece by piece declaring them dissect them.

verses.sa:
एकस्त्वष्टुरश्वस्या विशस्ता द्वा यन्तारा भवतस्तथ ऋतुः ।
या ते गात्राणामृतुथा कृणोमि ताता पिण्डानां प्र जुहोम्यग्नौ ॥
verses.rom:
ekastvashturashvasya vishasta dva yantara bhavatastatha rituh |
ya te gatranamritutha krinomi tata pindanam pra juhomyagnau ||
verses.en:
Of Tvastar's Charger there is one dissector,--this is the custom-two there are who guide him.
Such of his limbs as I divide in order, these, amid the balls, in fire I offer.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा तपत्प्रिय आत्मापियन्तं मा स्वधितिस्तन्व आ तिष्ठिपत्ते ।
मा ते गृध्नुरविशस्तातिहाय छिद्रा गात्राण्यसिना मिथू कः ॥
verses.rom:
ma tva tapatpriya atmapiyantam ma svadhitistanva a tishthipatte |
ma te gridhnuravishastatihaya chhidra gatranyasina mithu kah ||
verses.en:
Let not thy dear soul burn thee as thou comest, let not the hatchet linger in thy body.
Let not a greedy clumsy immolator, missing the joints, mangle thy limbs unduly.

verses.sa:
न वा उ एतन्म्रियसे न रिष्यसि देवाँ इदेषि पथिभिः सुगेभिः ।
हरी ते युञ्जा पृषती अभूतामुपास्थाद्वाजी धुरि रासभस्य ॥
verses.rom:
na va u etanmriyase na rishyasi devan ideshi pathibhih sugebhih |
hari te yunja prishati abhutamupasthadvaji dhuri rasabhasya ||
verses.en:
No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured: by easy paths unto the Gods thou goest.
Both Bays, both spotted mares are now thy fellows, and to the ass's pole is yoked the Charger.

verses.sa:
सुगव्यं नो वाजी स्वश्व्यं पुंसः पुत्राँ उत विश्वापुषं रयिम् ।
अनागास्त्वं नो अदितिः कृणोतु क्षत्रं नो अश्वो वनतां हविष्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
sugavyam no vaji svashvyam pumsah putran uta vishvapusham rayim |
anagastvam no aditih krinotu kshatram no ashvo vanatam havishman ||
verses.en:
May this Steed bring us all-sustaining riches, wealth in good kine, good horses, manly offspring.
Freedom from sin may Aditi vouchsafe us: the Steed with our oblations gain us lordship!

verses.sa:
यदक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान उद्यन्समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात् ।
श्येनस्य पक्षा हरिणस्य बाहू उपस्तुत्यं महि जातं ते अर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadakrandah prathamam jayamana udyansamudraduta va purishat |
shyenasya paksha harinasya bahu upastutyam mahi jatam te arvan ||
verses.en:
WHAT time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or upper waters,
Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is nigh and must be lauded.

verses.sa:
यमेन दत्तं त्रित एनमायुनगिन्द्र एणं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत् ।
गन्धर्वो अस्य रशनामगृभ्णात्सूरादश्वं वसवो निरतष्ट ॥
verses.rom:
yamena dattam trita enamayunagindra enam prathamo adhyatishthat |
gandharvo asya rashanamagribhnatsuradashvam vasavo niratashta ||
verses.en:
This Steed which Yama gave hath Trita harnessed, and him, the first of all, hath Indra mounted.
His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.

verses.sa:
असि यमो अस्यादित्यो अर्वन्नसि त्रितो गुह्येन व्रतेन ।
असि सोमेन समया विपृक्त आहुस्ते त्रीणि दिवि बन्धनानि ॥
verses.rom:
asi yamo asyadityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena |
asi somena samaya viprikta ahuste trini divi bandhanani ||
verses.en:
Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Aditya; Trita art thou by secret operation.
Thou art divided thoroughly from Soma. They say thou hast three bonds in heaven
that hold thee.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि त आहुर्दिवि बन्धनानि त्रीण्यप्सु त्रीण्यन्तः समुद्रे ।
उतेव मे वरुणश्छन्त्स्यर्वन्यत्रा त आहुः परमं जनित्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
trini ta ahurdivi bandhanani trinyapsu trinyantah samudre |
uteva me varunashchhantsyarvanyatra ta ahuh paramam janitram ||
verses.en:
Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven that bind thee, three in the waters,
three within the ocean.
To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birth-place.

verses.sa:
इमा ते वाजिन्नवमार्जनानीमा शफानां सनितुर्निधाना ।
अत्रा ते भद्रा रशना अपश्यमृतस्य या अभिरक्षन्ति गोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
ima te vajinnavamarjananima shaphanam saniturnidhana |
atra te bhadra rashana apashyamritasya ya abhirakshanti gopah ||
verses.en:
Here-, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee, here are the traces of thy hoofs as winner.
Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.

verses.sa:
आत्मानं ते मनसारादजानामवो दिवा पतयन्तं पतंगम् ।
शिरो अपश्यं पथिभिः सुगेभिररेणुभिर्जेहमानं पतत्रि ॥
verses.rom:
atmanam te manasaradajanamavo diva patayantam patamgam |
shiro apashyam pathibhih sugebhirarenubhirjehamanam patatri ||
verses.en:
Thyself from far I recognized in spirit,--a Bird that from below flew through the heaven.
I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.

verses.sa:
अत्रा ते रूपमुत्तममपश्यं जिगीषमाणमिष आ पदे गोः ।
यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानळादिद्ग्रसिष्ठ ओषधीरजीगः ॥
verses.rom:
atra te rupamuttamamapashyam jigishamanamisha a pade goh |
yada te marto anu bhogamanaladidgrasishtha oshadhirajigah ||
verses.en:
Here I beheld thy form, matchless in glory, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station.
Whene'er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the plants most greedy eater.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा रथो अनु मर्यो अर्वन्ननु गावोऽनु भगः कनीनाम् ।
अनु व्रातासस्तव सख्यमीयुरनु देवा ममिरे वीर्यं ते ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva ratho anu maryo arvannanu gavo'nu bhagah kaninam |
anu vratasastava sakhyamiyuranu deva mamire viryam te ||
verses.en:
After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens.
Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have copied.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यशृङ्गोऽयो अस्य पादा मनोजवा अवर इन्द्र आसीत् ।
देवा इदस्य हविरद्यमायन्यो अर्वन्तं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyashringo'yo asya pada manojava avara indra asit |
deva idasya haviradyamayanyo arvantam prathamo adhyatishthat ||
verses.en:
Horns made of gold hath he: his feet are iron: less fleet than he, though swift as thought, is Indra.
The Gods have come that they may taste the oblation of him who mounted, first of all, the Courser.

verses.sa:
ईर्मान्तासः सिलिकमध्यमासः सं शूरणासो दिव्यासो अत्याः ।
हंसा इव श्रेणिशो यतन्ते यदाक्षिषुर्दिव्यमज्ममश्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
irmantasah silikamadhyamasah sam shuranaso divyaso atyah |
hamsa iva shrenisho yatante yadakshishurdivyamajmamashvah ||
verses.en:
Symmetrical in flank, with rounded haunches, mettled like heroes, the Celestial Coursers
Put forth their strength, like swans in lengthened order, when they, the Steeds, have reached the heavenly causeway.

verses.sa:
तव शरीरं पतयिष्ण्वर्वन्तव चित्तं वात इव ध्रजीमान् ।
तव शृङ्गाणि विष्ठिता पुरुत्रारण्येषु जर्भुराणा चरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tava shariram patayishnvarvantava chittam vata iva dhrajiman |
tava shringani vishthita purutraranyeshu jarbhurana charanti ||
verses.en:
A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit.
Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions: they move with restless beat in wildernesses.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागाच्छसनं वाज्यर्वा देवद्रीचा मनसा दीध्यानः ।
अजः पुरो नीयते नाभिरस्यानु पश्चात्कवयो यन्ति रेभाः ॥
verses.rom:
upa pragachchhasanam vajyarva devadricha manasa didhyanah |
ajah puro niyate nabhirasyanu pashchatkavayo yanti rebhah ||
verses.en:
The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward.
The goat who is his kin is led before him the sages and the singers follow after.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात्परमं यत्सधस्थमर्वाँ अच्छा पितरं मातरं च ।
अद्या देवाञ्जुष्टतमो हि गम्या अथा शास्ते दाशुषे वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
upa pragatparamam yatsadhasthamarvan achchha pitaram mataram cha |
adya devanjushtatamo hi gamya atha shaste dashushe varyani ||
verses.en:
The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother.
This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who offers.

verses.sa:
अस्य वामस्य पलितस्य होतुस्तस्य भ्राता मध्यमो अस्त्यश्नः ।
तृतीयो भ्राता घृतपृष्ठो अस्यात्रापश्यं विश्पतिं सप्तपुत्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya vamasya palitasya hotustasya bhrata madhyamo astyashnah |
tritiyo bhrata ghritaprishtho asyatrapashyam vishpatim saptaputram ||
verses.en:
OF this benignant Priest, with eld grey-coloured, the brother midmost of the three is lightning.
The third is he whose back with oil is sprinkled. Here I behold the Chief with seven male children.

verses.sa:
सप्त युञ्जन्ति रथमेकचक्रमेको अश्वो वहति सप्तनामा ।
त्रिनाभि चक्रमजरमनर्वं यत्रेमा विश्वा भुवनाधि तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta yunjanti rathamekachakrameko ashvo vahati saptanama |
trinabhi chakramajaramanarvam yatrema vishva bhuvanadhi tasthuh ||
verses.en:
Seven to the one-wheeled chariot yoke the Courser; bearing seven names the single Courser draws it.
Three-naved the wheel is, sound and undecaying, whereon are resting all these worlds of being.

verses.sa:
इमं रथमधि ये सप्त तस्थुः सप्तचक्रं सप्त वहन्त्यश्वाः ।
सप्त स्वसारो अभि सं नवन्ते यत्र गवां निहिता सप्त नाम ॥
verses.rom:
imam rathamadhi ye sapta tasthuh saptachakram sapta vahantyashvah |
sapta svasaro abhi sam navante yatra gavam nihita sapta nama ||
verses.en:
The seven who on the seven-wheeled car are mounted have horses, seven in tale, who draw them onward.
Seven Sisters utter songs of praise together, in whom the names of the seven Cows are treasured.

verses.sa:
को ददर्श प्रथमं जायमानमस्थन्वन्तं यदनस्था बिभर्ति ।
भूम्या असुरसृगात्मा क्व स्वित्को विद्वांसमुप गात्प्रष्टुमेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
ko dadarsha prathamam jayamanamasthanvantam yadanastha bibharti |
bhumya asurasrigatma kva svitko vidvamsamupa gatprashtumetat ||
verses.en:
Who hath beheld him as he sprang to being, seen how the boneless One supports the bony?
Where is the blood of earth, the life, the spirit? Who may approach the man who knows, to ask it?

verses.sa:
पाकः पृच्छामि मनसाविजानन्देवानामेना निहिता पदानि ।
वत्से बष्कयेऽधि सप्त तन्तून्वि तत्निरे कवय ओतवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
pakah prichchhami manasavijanandevanamena nihita padani |
vatse bashkaye'dhi sapta tantunvi tatnire kavaya otava u ||
verses.en:
Unripe in mind, in spirit undiscerning, I ask of these the Gods' established places;
For up above the yearling Calf the sages, to form a web, their own seven threads have woven.

verses.sa:
अचिकित्वाञ्चिकितुषश्चिदत्र कवीन्पृच्छामि विद्मने न विद्वान् ।
वि यस्तस्तम्भ षळिमा रजांस्यजस्य रूपे किमपि स्विदेकम् ॥
verses.rom:
achikitvanchikitushashchidatra kavinprichchhami vidmane na vidvan |
vi yastastambha shalima rajamsyajasya rupe kimapi svidekam ||
verses.en:
I ask, unknowing, those who know, the sages, as one all ignorant for sake of knowledge,
What was that ONE who in the Unborn's image hath stablished and fixed firm these worlds' six regions.

verses.sa:
इह ब्रवीतु य ईमङ्ग वेदास्य वामस्य निहितं पदं वेः ।
शीर्ष्णः क्षीरं दुह्रते गावो अस्य वव्रिं वसाना उदकं पदापुः ॥
verses.rom:
iha bravitu ya imanga vedasya vamasya nihitam padam veh |
shirshnah kshiram duhrate gavo asya vavrim vasana udakam padapuh ||
verses.en:
Let him who knoweth presently declare it, this lovely Bird's securely founded station.
Forth from his head the Cows draw milk, and, wearing his vesture, with their foot have drunk the water.

verses.sa:
माता पितरमृत आ बभाज धीत्यग्रे मनसा सं हि जग्मे ।
सा बीभत्सुर्गर्भरसा निविद्धा नमस्वन्त इदुपवाकमीयुः ॥
verses.rom:
mata pitaramrita a babhaja dhityagre manasa sam hi jagme |
sa bibhatsurgarbharasa nividdha namasvanta idupavakamiyuh ||
verses.en:
The Mother gave the Sire his share of Order: with thought, at first, she wedded him in spirit.
She, the coy Dame, was filled with dew prolific: with adoration men approached to praise her.

verses.sa:
युक्ता मातासीद्धुरि दक्षिणाया अतिष्ठद्गर्भो वृजनीष्वन्तः ।
अमीमेद्वत्सो अनु गामपश्यद्विश्वरूप्यं त्रिषु योजनेषु ॥
verses.rom:
yukta matasiddhuri dakshinaya atishthadgarbho vrijanishvantah |
amimedvatso anu gamapashyadvishvarupyam trishu yojaneshu ||
verses.en:
Yoked was the Mother to the boon Cow's car-pole: in the dank rows of cloud the Infant rested.
Then the Calf lowed, and looked upon the Mother, the Cow who wears all shapes in three directions.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो मातॄस्त्रीन्पितॄन्बिभ्रदेक ऊर्ध्वस्तस्थौ नेमव ग्लापयन्ति ।
मन्त्रयन्ते दिवो अमुष्य पृष्ठे विश्वविदं वाचमविश्वमिन्वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro matristrinpitrinbibhradeka urdhvastasthau nemava glapayanti |
mantrayante divo amushya prishthe vishvavidam vachamavishvaminvam ||
verses.en:
Bearing three Mothers and three Fathers, single he stood erect: they never make him weary.
There on the pitch of heaven they speak together in speech all-knowing but not all-impelling.

verses.sa:
द्वादशारं नहि तज्जराय वर्वर्ति चक्रं परि द्यामृतस्य ।
आ पुत्रा अग्ने मिथुनासो अत्र सप्त शतानि विंशतिश्च तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
dvadasharam nahi tajjaraya varvarti chakram pari dyamritasya |
a putra agne mithunaso atra sapta shatani vimshatishcha tasthuh ||
verses.en:
Formed with twelve spokes, by length of time, unweakened, rolls round the heaven this wheel of during Order.
Herein established, joined in pairs together, seven hundred Sons and twenty stand, O Agni.

verses.sa:
पञ्चपादं पितरं द्वादशाकृतिं दिव आहुः परे अर्धे पुरीषिणम् ।
अथेमे अन्य उपरे विचक्षणं सप्तचक्रे षळर आहुरर्पितम् ॥
verses.rom:
panchapadam pitaram dvadashakritim diva ahuh pare ardhe purishinam |
atheme anya upare vichakshanam saptachakre shalara ahurarpitam ||
verses.en:
They call him in the farther half of heaven the Sire five-footed, of twelve forms, wealthy in watery store.
These others say that he, God with far-seeing eyes, is mounted on the lower seven-wheeled, six-spoked car.

verses.sa:
पञ्चारे चक्रे परिवर्तमाने तस्मिन्ना तस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तस्य नाक्षस्तप्यते भूरिभारः सनादेव न शीर्यते सनाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
panchare chakre parivartamane tasminna tasthurbhuvanani vishva |
tasya nakshastapyate bhuribharah sanadeva na shiryate sanabhih ||
verses.en:
Upon this five-spoked wheel revolving ever all living creatures rest and are dependent.
Its axle, heavy-laden, is not heated: the nave from ancient time remains unbroken.

verses.sa:
सनेमि चक्रमजरं वि वावृत उत्तानायां दश युक्ता वहन्ति ।
सूर्यस्य चक्षू रजसैत्यावृतं तस्मिन्नार्पिता भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sanemi chakramajaram vi vavrita uttanayam dasha yukta vahanti |
suryasya chakshu rajasaityavritam tasminnarpita bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
The wheel revolves, unwasting, with its felly: ten draw it, yoked to the far-stretching car-pole.
The Sun's eye moves encompassed by the region: on him dependent rest all living creatures.

verses.sa:
साकंजानां सप्तथमाहुरेकजं षळिद्यमा ऋषयो देवजा इति ।
तेषामिष्टानि विहितानि धामश स्थात्रे रेजन्ते विकृतानि रूपशः ॥
verses.rom:
sakamjanam saptathamahurekajam shalidyama rishayo devaja iti |
teshamishtani vihitani dhamasha sthatre rejante vikritani rupashah ||
verses.en:
Of the co-born they call the seventh single-born; the six twin pairs are called Rsis, Children of Gods.
Their good gifts sought of men are ranged in order due, and various in their form move for the Lord who guides.

verses.sa:
स्त्रियः सतीस्ताँ उ मे पुंस आहुः पश्यदक्षण्वान्न वि चेतदन्धः ।
कविर्यः पुत्रः स ईमा चिकेत यस्ता विजानात्स पितुष्पितासत् ॥
verses.rom:
striyah satistan u me pumsa ahuh pashyadakshanvanna vi chetadandhah |
kaviryah putrah sa ima chiketa yasta vijanatsa pitushpitasat ||
verses.en:
They told me these were males, though truly females: he who hath eyes sees this, the blind discerns not.
The son who is a sage hath comprehended: who knows this rightly is his father's father.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पर एनावरेण पदा वत्सं बिभ्रती गौरुदस्थात् ।
सा कद्रीची कं स्विदर्धं परागात्क्व स्वित्सूते नहि यूथे अन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
avah parena para enavarena pada vatsam bibhrati gaurudasthat |
sa kadrichi kam svidardham paragatkva svitsute nahi yuthe antah ||
verses.en:
Beneath the upper realm, above this lower, bearing her calf at foot the Cow hath risen.
Witherward, to what place hath she departed? Where calves she? Not amid this herd of cattle.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पितरं यो अस्यानुवेद पर एनावरेण ।
कवीयमानः क इह प्र वोचद्देवं मनः कुतो अधि प्रजातम् ॥
verses.rom:
avah parena pitaram yo asyanuveda para enavarena |
kaviyamanah ka iha pra vochaddevam manah kuto adhi prajatam ||
verses.en:
Who, that the father of this Calf discerneth beneath the upper realm, above the lower,
Showing himself a sage, may here declare it? Whence hath the Godlike spirit had its rising?

verses.sa:
ये अर्वाञ्चस्ताँ उ पराच आहुर्ये पराञ्चस्ताँ उ अर्वाच आहुः ।
इन्द्रश्च या चक्रथुः सोम तानि धुरा न युक्ता रजसो वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ye arvanchastan u paracha ahurye paranchastan u arvacha ahuh |
indrashcha ya chakrathuh soma tani dhura na yukta rajaso vahanti ||
verses.en:
Those that come hitherward they call departing, those that depart they call directed hither.
And what so ye have made, Indra and Soma, steeds bear as 'twere yoked to the region's car-pole.

verses.sa:
द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परि षस्वजाते ।
तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्यो अभि चाकशीति ॥
verses.rom:
dva suparna sayuja sakhaya samanam vriksham pari shasvajate |
tayoranyah pippalam svadvattyanashnannanyo abhi chakashiti ||
verses.en:
Two Birds with fair wings, knit with bonds of friendship, in the same sheltering tree have found a refuge.
One of the twain eats the sweet Fig-tree's fruitage; the other eating not regardeth only.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुपर्णा अमृतस्य भागमनिमेषं विदथाभिस्वरन्ति ।
इनो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः स मा धीरः पाकमत्रा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
yatra suparna amritasya bhagamanimesham vidathabhisvaranti |
ino vishvasya bhuvanasya gopah sa ma dhirah pakamatra vivesha ||
verses.en:
Where those fine Birds hymn ceaselessly their portion of life eternal, and the sacred synods,
There is the Universe's mighty Keeper, who, wise, hath entered into me the simple.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्वृक्षे मध्वदः सुपर्णा निविशन्ते सुवते चाधि विश्वे ।
तस्येदाहुः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वग्रे तन्नोन्नशद्यः पितरं न वेद ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvrikshe madhvadah suparna nivishante suvate chadhi vishve |
tasyedahuh pippalam svadvagre tannonnashadyah pitaram na veda ||
verses.en:
The, tree whereon the fine Birds eat the sweetness, where they all rest and procreate their offspring,--
Upon its top they say the fig is luscious none gaineth it who knoweth not the Father.

verses.sa:
यद्गायत्रे अधि गायत्रमाहितं त्रैष्टुभाद्वा त्रैष्टुभं निरतक्षत ।
यद्वा जगज्जगत्याहितं पदं य इत्तद्विदुस्ते अमृतत्वमानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadgayatre adhi gayatramahitam traishtubhadva traishtubham niratakshata |
yadva jagajjagatyahitam padam ya ittadviduste amritatvamanashuh ||
verses.en:
How on the Gayatri the Gayatri was based, how from the Tristup they fashioned the Tristup forth,
How on the Jagati was based the Jagati,--they who know this have won themselves immortal life.

verses.sa:
गायत्रेण प्रति मिमीते अर्कमर्केण साम त्रैष्टुभेन वाकम् ।
वाकेन वाकं द्विपदा चतुष्पदाक्षरेण मिमते सप्त वाणीः ॥
verses.rom:
gayatrena prati mimite arkamarkena sama traishtubhena vakam |
vakena vakam dvipada chatushpadaksharena mimate sapta vanih ||
verses.en:
With Gayatri he measures out the praise-song, Sama with praise-song, triplet with the Tristup.
The triplet with the two or four-foot measure, and with the syllable they form seven metres.

verses.sa:
जगता सिन्धुं दिव्यस्तभायद्रथंतरे सूर्यं पर्यपश्यत् ।
गायत्रस्य समिधस्तिस्र आहुस्ततो मह्ना प्र रिरिचे महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
jagata sindhum divyastabhayadrathamtare suryam paryapashyat |
gayatrasya samidhastisra ahustato mahna pra ririche mahitva ||
verses.en:
With Jagati the flood in heaven he stablished, and saw the Sun in the Rathantara Saman.
Gayatri hath, they say, three brands for kindling: hence it excels in majesty and vigour.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुदुघां धेनुमेतां सुहस्तो गोधुगुत दोहदेनाम् ।
श्रेष्ठं सवं सविता साविषन्नोऽभीद्धो घर्मस्तदु षु प्र वोचम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa hvaye sudugham dhenumetam suhasto godhuguta dohadenam |
shreshtham savam savita savishanno'bhiddho gharmastadu shu pra vocham ||
verses.en:
I invocate the milch-cow good for milking so that the milker, deft of hand, may drain her.
May Savitar give goodliest stimulation. The caldron is made hot; I will proclaim it.

verses.sa:
हिङ्कृण्वती वसुपत्नी वसूनां वत्समिच्छन्ती मनसाभ्यागात् ।
दुहामश्विभ्यां पयो अघ्न्येयं सा वर्धतां महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
hinkrinvati vasupatni vasunam vatsamichchhanti manasabhyagat |
duhamashvibhyam payo aghnyeyam sa vardhatam mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en:
She, lady of all treasure, is come hither yearning in spirit for her calf and lowing.
May this cow yield her milk for both the Asvins, and may she prosper to our high advantage.

verses.sa:
गौरमीमेदनु वत्सं मिषन्तं मूर्धानं हिङ्ङकृणोन्मातवा उ ।
सृक्वाणं घर्ममभि वावशाना मिमाति मायुं पयते पयोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
gauramimedanu vatsam mishantam murdhanam hinnakrinonmatava u |
srikvanam gharmamabhi vavashana mimati mayum payate payobhih ||
verses.en:
The cow hath lowed after her blinking youngling; she licks his forehead, as she lows, to form it.
His mouth she fondly calls to her warm udder, and suckles him with milk while gently lowing.

verses.sa:
अयं स शिङ्क्ते येन गौरभीवृता मिमाति मायुं ध्वसनावधि श्रिता ।
सा चित्तिभिर्नि हि चकार मर्त्यं विद्युद्भवन्ती प्रति वव्रिमौहत ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa shinkte yena gaurabhivrita mimati mayum dhvasanavadhi shrita |
sa chittibhirni hi chakara martyam vidyudbhavanti prati vavrimauhata ||
verses.en:
He also snorts, by whom encompassed round the Cow laws as she clings unto the shedder of the rain.
She with her shrilling cries hath humbled mortal man, and, turned to lightning, hath stripped off her covering robe.

verses.sa:
अनच्छये तुरगातु जीवमेजद्ध्रुवं मध्य आ पस्त्यानाम् ।
जीवो मृतस्य चरति स्वधाभिरमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः ॥
verses.rom:
anachchhaye turagatu jivamejaddhruvam madhya a pastyanam |
jivo mritasya charati svadhabhiramartyo martyena sayonih ||
verses.en:
That which hath breath and speed and life and motion lies firmly stablished in the midst of houses.
Living, by offerings to the Dead he moveth Immortal One, the brother of the mortal.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् ।
स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam gopamanipadyamanama cha para cha pathibhishcharantam |
sa sadhrichih sa vishuchirvasana a varivarti bhuvaneshvantah ||
verses.en:
I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing.
He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa:
य ईं चकार न सो अस्य वेद य ईं ददर्श हिरुगिन्नु तस्मात् ।
स मातुर्योना परिवीतो अन्तर्बहुप्रजा निरृतिमा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
ya im chakara na so asya veda ya im dadarsha hiruginnu tasmat |
sa maturyona parivito antarbahupraja nirritima vivesha ||
verses.en:
He who hath made him cloth not comprehend him: from him who saw him surely is he hidden.
He, yet enveloped in his Mother's bosom, source of much life, hath sunk into destruction.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्मे पिता जनिता नाभिरत्र बन्धुर्मे माता पृथिवी महीयम् ।
उत्तानयोश्चम्वोर्योनिरन्तरत्रा पिता दुहितुर्गर्भमाधात् ॥
verses.rom:
dyaurme pita janita nabhiratra bandhurme mata prithivi mahiyam |
uttanayoshchamvoryonirantaratra pita duhiturgarbhamadhat ||
verses.en:
Dyaus is my Father, my begetter: kinship is here. This great earth is my kin and Mother.
Between the wide-spread world-halves is the birth-place: the Father laid the Daughter's germ within it.

verses.sa:
पृच्छामि त्वा परमन्तं पृथिव्याः पृच्छामि यत्र भुवनस्य नाभिः ।
पृच्छामि त्वा वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योम ॥
verses.rom:
prichchhami tva paramantam prithivyah prichchhami yatra bhuvanasya nabhih |
prichchhami tva vrishno ashvasya retah prichchhami vachah paramam vyoma ||
verses.en:
I ask thee of the earth's extremest limit, where is the centre of the world, I ask thee.
I ask thee of the Stallion's seed prolific, I ask of highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
इयं वेदिः परो अन्तः पृथिव्या अयं यज्ञो भुवनस्य नाभिः ।
अयं सोमो वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतो ब्रह्मायं वाचः परमं व्योम ॥
verses.rom:
iyam vedih paro antah prithivya ayam yajno bhuvanasya nabhih |
ayam somo vrishno ashvasya reto brahmayam vachah paramam vyoma ||
verses.en:
This altar is the earth's extremest limit; this sacrifice of ours is the world's centre.
The Stallion's seed prolific is the Soma; this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
सप्तार्धगर्भा भुवनस्य रेतो विष्णोस्तिष्ठन्ति प्रदिशा विधर्मणि ।
ते धीतिभिर्मनसा ते विपश्चितः परिभुवः परि भवन्ति विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
saptardhagarbha bhuvanasya reto vishnostishthanti pradisha vidharmani |
te dhitibhirmanasa te vipashchitah paribhuvah pari bhavanti vishvatah ||
verses.en:
Seven germs unripened yet are heaven's prolific seed: their functions they maintain by Visnu's ordinance.
Endued with wisdom through intelligence and thought, they compass us about present on every side.

verses.sa:
न वि जानामि यदिवेदमस्मि निण्यः संनद्धो मनसा चरामि ।
यदा मागन्प्रथमजा ऋतस्यादिद्वाचो अश्नुवे भागमस्याः ॥
verses.rom:
na vi janami yadivedamasmi ninyah samnaddho manasa charami |
yada maganprathamaja ritasyadidvacho ashnuve bhagamasyah ||
verses.en:
What thing I truly am I know not clearly: mysterious, fettered in my mind I wander.
When the first-born of holy Law approached me, then of this speech I first obtain a portion.

verses.sa:
अपाङ्प्राङेति स्वधया गृभीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः ।
ता शश्वन्ता विषूचीना वियन्ता न्यन्यं चिक्युर्न नि चिक्युरन्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
apanpraneti svadhaya gribhito'martyo martyena sayonih |
ta shashvanta vishuchina viyanta nyanyam chikyurna ni chikyuranyam ||
verses.en:
Back, forward goes he, grasped by strength inherent, the Immortal born the brother of the mortal
Ceaseless they move in opposite directions: men mark the one, and fail to mark the other.

verses.sa:
ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन्यस्मिन्देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः ।
यस्तन्न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति य इत्तद्विदुस्त इमे समासते ॥
verses.rom:
richo akshare parame vyomanyasmindeva adhi vishve nisheduh |
yastanna veda kimricha karishyati ya ittadvidusta ime samasate ||
verses.en:
Upon what syllable of holy praise-song, as twere their highest heaven, the Gods repose them,--
Who knows not this, what will he do with praise-song? But they who know it well sit here assembled.

verses.sa:
सूयवसाद्भगवती हि भूया अथो वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
अद्धि तृणमघ्न्ये विश्वदानीं पिब शुद्धमुदकमाचरन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
suyavasadbhagavati hi bhuya atho vayam bhagavantah syama |
addhi trinamaghnye vishvadanim piba shuddhamudakamacharanti ||
verses.en:
Fortunate mayst thou be with goodly pasture, and may we also be exceeding wealthy.
Feed on the grass, O Cow, at every season, and coming hitherward drink limpid water.

verses.sa:
गौरीर्मिमाय सलिलानि तक्षत्येकपदी द्विपदी सा चतुष्पदी ।
अष्टापदी नवपदी बभूवुषी सहस्राक्षरा परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
gaurirmimaya salilani takshatyekapadi dvipadi sa chatushpadi |
ashtapadi navapadi babhuvushi sahasrakshara parame vyoman ||
verses.en:
Forming the water-floods, the buffalo hath lowed, one-footed or two-footed or four-footed, she,
Who hath become eight-footed or hath got nine feet, the thousand-syllabled in the sublimest heaven.

verses.sa:
तस्याः समुद्रा अधि वि क्षरन्ति तेन जीवन्ति प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
ततः क्षरत्यक्षरं तद्विश्वमुप जीवति ॥
verses.rom:
tasyah samudra adhi vi ksharanti tena jivanti pradishashchatasrah |
tatah ksharatyaksharam tadvishvamupa jivati ||
verses.en:
From her descend in streams the seas of water; thereby the world's four regions have their being,
Thence flows the imperishable flood and thence the universe hath life.

verses.sa:
शकमयं धूममारादपश्यं विषूवता पर एनावरेण ।
उक्षाणं पृश्निमपचन्त वीरास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ॥
verses.rom:
shakamayam dhumamaradapashyam vishuvata para enavarena |
ukshanam prishnimapachanta virastani dharmani prathamanyasan ||
verses.en:
I saw from far away the smoke of fuel with spires that rose on high o'er that beneath it.
The Mighty Men have dressed the spotted bullock. These were the customs in the days aforetime,

verses.sa:
त्रयः केशिन ऋतुथा वि चक्षते संवत्सरे वपत एक एषाम् ।
विश्वमेको अभि चष्टे शचीभिर्ध्राजिरेकस्य ददृशे न रूपम् ॥
verses.rom:
trayah keshina ritutha vi chakshate samvatsare vapata eka esham |
vishvameko abhi chashte shachibhirdhrajirekasya dadrishe na rupam ||
verses.en:
Three with long tresses show in ordered season. One of them sheareth when the year is ended.
One with his powers the universe regardeth: Of one, the sweep is seen, but his figure.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि वाक्परिमिता पदानि तानि विदुर्ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः ।
गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्ति तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्या वदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
chatvari vakparimita padani tani vidurbrahmana ye manishinah |
guha trini nihita nengayanti turiyam vacho manushya vadanti ||
verses.en:
Speech hath been measured out in four divisions, the Brahmans who have understanding know them.
Three kept in close concealment cause no motion; of speech, men speak only the fourth division.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमाहुरथो दिव्यः स सुपर्णो गरुत्मान् ।
एकं सद्विप्रा बहुधा वदन्त्यग्निं यमं मातरिश्वानमाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
indram mitram varunamagnimahuratho divyah sa suparno garutman |
ekam sadvipra bahudha vadantyagnim yamam matarishvanamahuh ||
verses.en:
They call him Indra, Mitra, Varuna, Agni, and he is heavenly nobly-winged Garutman.
To what is One, sages give many a title they call it Agni, Yama, Matarisvan.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत्पतन्ति ।
त आववृत्रन्सदनादृतस्यादिद्घृतेन पृथिवी व्युद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
krishnam niyanam harayah suparna apo vasana divamutpatanti |
ta avavritransadanadritasyadidghritena prithivi vyudyate ||
verses.en:
Dark the descent: the birds are golden-coloured; up to the heaven they fly robed in the waters.
Again descend they from the seat of Order, and all the earth is moistened with their fatness.

verses.sa:
द्वादश प्रधयश्चक्रमेकं त्रीणि नभ्यानि क उ तच्चिकेत ।
तस्मिन्साकं त्रिशता न शङ्कवोऽर्पिताः षष्टिर्न चलाचलासः ॥
verses.rom:
dvadasha pradhayashchakramekam trini nabhyani ka u tachchiketa |
tasminsakam trishata na shankavo'rpitah shashtirna chalachalasah ||
verses.en:
Twelve are the fellies, and the wheel is single; three are the naves. What man hath understood it?
Therein are set together spokes three hundred and sixty, which in nowise can be loosened.

verses.sa:
यस्ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूर्येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि ।
यो रत्नधा वसुविद्यः सुदत्रः सरस्वति तमिह धातवे कः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste stanah shashayo yo mayobhuryena vishva pushyasi varyani |
yo ratnadha vasuvidyah sudatrah sarasvati tamiha dhatave kah ||
verses.en:
That breast of thine exhaustless, spring of pleasure, wherewith thou feedest all things that are choicest,
Wealth-giver, treasure. finder, free bestower,--bring that, Sarasvati, that we may drain it.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnena yajnamayajanta devastani dharmani prathamanyasan |
te ha nakam mahimanah sachanta yatra purve sadhyah santi devah ||
verses.en:
By means of sacrifice the Gods accomplished their sacrifice: these were the earliest ordinances.
These Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sadhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa:
समानमेतदुदकमुच्चैत्यव चाहभिः ।
भूमिं पर्जन्या जिन्वन्ति दिवं जिन्वन्त्यग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
samanametadudakamuchchaityava chahabhih |
bhumim parjanya jinvanti divam jinvantyagnayah ||
verses.en:
Uniform, with the passing days, this water mounts and fails again.
The tempest-clouds give life to earth, and fires re-animate the heaven.

verses.sa:
दिव्यं सुपर्णं वायसं बृहन्तमपां गर्भं दर्शतमोषधीनाम् ।
अभीपतो वृष्टिभिस्तर्पयन्तं सरस्वन्तमवसे जोहवीमि ॥
verses.rom:
divyam suparnam vayasam brihantamapam garbham darshatamoshadhinam |
abhipato vrishtibhistarpayantam sarasvantamavase johavimi ||
verses.en:
The Bird Celestial, vast with noble pinion, the lovely germ of plants, the germ of waters,
Him who delighteth us with rain in season, Sarasvan I invoke that he may help us.

verses.sa:
कया शुभा सवयसः सनीळाः समान्या मरुतः सं मिमिक्षुः ।
कया मती कुत एतास एतेऽर्चन्ति शुष्मं वृषणो वसूया ॥
verses.rom:
kaya shubha savayasah sanilah samanya marutah sam mimikshuh |
kaya mati kuta etasa ete'rchanti shushmam vrishano vasuya ||
verses.en:
WITH what bright beauty are the Maruts jointly invested, peers in age, who dwell together?
From what place have they come? With what intention? Sing they their strength through love of wealth, these Heroes?

verses.sa:
कस्य ब्रह्माणि जुजुषुर्युवानः को अध्वरे मरुत आ ववर्त ।
श्येनाँ इव ध्रजतो अन्तरिक्षे केन महा मनसा रीरमाम ॥
verses.rom:
kasya brahmani jujushuryuvanah ko adhvare maruta a vavarta |
shyenan iva dhrajato antarikshe kena maha manasa riramama ||
verses.en:
Whose prayers have they, the Youthful Ones, accepted? Who to his sacrifice hath turned the Maruts?
We will delay them on their journey sweeping--with what high spirit!--through the air like eagles.

verses.sa:
कुतस्त्वमिन्द्र माहिनः सन्नेको यासि सत्पते किं त इत्था ।
सं पृच्छसे समराणः शुभानैर्वोचेस्तन्नो हरिवो यत्ते अस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
kutastvamindra mahinah sanneko yasi satpate kim ta ittha |
sam prichchhase samaranah shubhanairvochestanno harivo yatte asme ||
verses.en:
Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose?
Thou greetest us when meeting us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माणि मे मतयः शं सुतासः शुष्म इयर्ति प्रभृतो मे अद्रिः ।
आ शासते प्रति हर्यन्त्युक्थेमा हरी वहतस्ता नो अच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
brahmani me matayah sham sutasah shushma iyarti prabhrito me adrih |
a shasate prati haryantyukthema hari vahatasta no achchha ||
verses.en:
Mine are devotions, hymns; sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my bolt of thunder.
They call for me, their lauds are longing for me. These my Bay Steeds bear me to these oblations.

verses.sa:
अतो वयमन्तमेभिर्युजानाः स्वक्षत्रेभिस्तन्वः शुम्भमानाः ।
महोभिरेताँ उप युज्महे न्विन्द्र स्वधामनु हि नो बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
ato vayamantamebhiryujanah svakshatrebhistanvah shumbhamanah |
mahobhiretan upa yujmahe nvindra svadhamanu hi no babhutha ||
verses.en:
Therefore together with our strong companions, having adorned our bodies, now we harness,
Our spotted deer with might, for thou, O Indra, hast learnt and understood our Godlike nature.

verses.sa:
क्व स्या वो मरुतः स्वधासीद्यन्मामेकं समधत्ताहिहत्ये ।
अहं ह्युग्रस्तविषस्तुविष्मान्विश्वस्य शत्रोरनमं वधस्नैः ॥
verses.rom:
kva sya vo marutah svadhasidyanmamekam samadhattahihatye |
aham hyugrastavishastuvishmanvishvasya shatroranamam vadhasnaih ||
verses.en:
Where was that nature then of yours, O Maruts, that ye charged me alone to slay the Dragon?
For I in truth am fierce and strong and mighty. I bent away from every foeman's weapons.

verses.sa:
भूरि चकर्थ युज्येभिरस्मे समानेभिर्वृषभ पौंस्येभिः ।
भूरीणि हि कृणवामा शविष्ठेन्द्र क्रत्वा मरुतो यद्वशाम ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri chakartha yujyebhirasme samanebhirvrishabha paumsyebhih |
bhurini hi krinavama shavishthendra kratva maruto yadvashama ||
verses.en:
Yea, much hast thou achieved with us for comrades, with manly valour like thine own, thou Hero.
Much may we too achieve, O mightiest Indra, with our great power, we Maruts, when we will it.

verses.sa:
वधीं वृत्रं मरुत इन्द्रियेण स्वेन भामेन तविषो बभूवान् ।
अहमेता मनवे विश्वश्चन्द्राः सुगा अपश्चकर वज्रबाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
vadhim vritram maruta indriyena svena bhamena tavisho babhuvan |
ahameta manave vishvashchandrah suga apashchakara vajrabahuh ||
verses.en:
Vrtra I slew by mine own strength, O Maruts, having waxed mighty in mine indignation.
