I with the thunder in my hand created for man these lucid softly flowing waters.

verses.sa:
अनुत्तमा ते मघवन्नकिर्नु न त्वावाँ अस्ति देवता विदानः ।
न जायमानो नशते न जातो यानि करिष्या कृणुहि प्रवृद्ध ॥
verses.rom:
anuttama te maghavannakirnu na tvavan asti devata vidanah |
na jayamano nashate na jato yani karishya krinuhi pravriddha ||
verses.en:
Nothing, O Maghavan, stands firm before thee; among the Gods not one is found thine equal.
None born or springing into life comes nigh thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty?

verses.sa:
एकस्य चिन्मे विभ्वस्त्वोजो या नु दधृष्वान्कृणवै मनीषा ।
अहं ह्युग्रो मरुतो विदानो यानि च्यवमिन्द्र इदीश एषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekasya chinme vibhvastvojo ya nu dadhrishvankrinavai manisha |
aham hyugro maruto vidano yani chyavamindra idisha esham ||
verses.en:
Mine only be transcendent power, whatever I, daring in my spirit, may accomplish.
For I am known as terrible, O Maruts I, Indra, am the Lord of what I ruined.

verses.sa:
अमन्दन्मा मरुत स्तोमो अत्र यन्मे नरः श्रुत्यं ब्रह्म चक्र ।
इन्द्राय वृष्णे सुमखाय मह्यं सख्ये सखायस्तन्वे तनूभिः ॥
verses.rom:
amandanma maruta stomo atra yanme narah shrutyam brahma chakra |
indraya vrishne sumakhaya mahyam sakhye sakhayastanve tanubhih ||
verses.en:
Now, O ye Maruts, hath your praise rejoiced me, the glorious hymn which ye have made me, Heroes!
For me, for Indra, champion strong in battle, for me, yourselves, as lovers for a lover.

verses.sa:
एवेदेते प्रति मा रोचमाना अनेद्यः श्रव एषो दधानाः ।
संचक्ष्या मरुतश्चन्द्रवर्णा अच्छान्त मे छदयाथा च नूनम् ॥
verses.rom:
evedete prati ma rochamana anedyah shrava esho dadhanah |
samchakshya marutashchandravarna achchhanta me chhadayatha cha nunam ||
verses.en:
Here, truly, they send forth their sheen to meet me, wearing their blameless glory and their vigour.
When I have seen you, Maruts, in gay splendour, ye have delighted me, so now delight me.

verses.sa:
को न्वत्र मरुतो मामहे वः प्र यातन सखीँरच्छा सखायः ।
मन्मानि चित्रा अपिवातयन्त एषां भूत नवेदा म ऋतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko nvatra maruto mamahe vah pra yatana sakhinrachchha sakhayah |
manmani chitra apivatayanta esham bhuta naveda ma ritanam ||
verses.en:
Who here hath magnified you, O ye Maruts? speed forward, O ye lovers, to your lovers.
Ye Radiant Ones, assisting their devotions, of these my holy rites he ye regardful.

verses.sa:
आ यद्दुवस्याद्दुवसे न कारुरस्माञ्चक्रे मान्यस्य मेधा ।
ओ षु वर्त्त मरुतो विप्रमच्छेमा ब्रह्माणि जरिता वो अर्चत् ॥
verses.rom:
a yadduvasyadduvase na karurasmanchakre manyasya medha |
o shu vartta maruto vipramachchhema brahmani jarita vo archat ||
verses.en:
To this hath Manya's wisdom brought us, so as to aid, as aids the poet him who worships.
Bring hither quick! On to the sage, ye Maruts! These prayers for you the singer hath recited.

verses.sa:
एष व स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha va stomo maruta iyam girmandaryasya manyasya karoh |
esha yasishta tanve vayam vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's son, Mandarya,
Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance!

verses.sa:
तन्नु वोचाम रभसाय जन्मने पूर्वं महित्वं वृषभस्य केतवे ।
ऐधेव यामन्मरुतस्तुविष्वणो युधेव शक्रास्तविषाणि कर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
tannu vochama rabhasaya janmane purvam mahitvam vrishabhasya ketave |
aidheva yamanmarutastuvishvano yudheva shakrastavishani kartana ||
verses.en:
Now let us publish, for the vigorous company the herald of the Strong One, their primeval might.
With fire upon your way, O Maruts loud of voice, with battle, Mighty Ones, achieve your deeds of strength.

verses.sa:
नित्यं न सूनुं मधु बिभ्रत उप क्रीळन्ति क्रीळा विदथेषु घृष्वयः ।
नक्षन्ति रुद्रा अवसा नमस्विनं न मर्धन्ति स्वतवसो हविष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
nityam na sunum madhu bibhrata upa krilanti krila vidatheshu ghrishvayah |
nakshanti rudra avasa namasvinam na mardhanti svatavaso havishkritam ||
verses.en:
Bringing the pleasant meath as 'twere their own dear son, they sport in sportive wise gay at their gatherings.
The Rudras come with succour to the worshipper; self-strong they fail not him who offers sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यस्मा ऊमासो अमृता अरासत रायस्पोषं च हविषा ददाशुषे ।
उक्षन्त्यस्मै मरुतो हिता इव पुरू रजांसि पयसा मयोभुवः ॥
verses.rom:
yasma umaso amrita arasata rayasposham cha havisha dadashushe |
ukshantyasmai maruto hita iva puru rajamsi payasa mayobhuvah ||
verses.en:
To whomsoever, bringer of oblations, they immortal guardians, have given plenteous wealth,
For him, like loving friends, the Maruts bringing bliss bedew the regions round with milk abundantly.

verses.sa:
आ ये रजांसि तविषीभिरव्यत प्र व एवासः स्वयतासो अध्रजन् ।
भयन्ते विश्वा भुवनानि हर्म्या चित्रो वो यामः प्रयतास्वृष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
a ye rajamsi tavishibhiravyata pra va evasah svayataso adhrajan |
bhayante vishva bhuvanani harmya chitro vo yamah prayatasvrishtishu ||
verses.en:
Ye who with mighty powers have stirred the regions up, your coursers have sped forth directed by themselves.
All creatures of the earth, all dwellings are afraid, for brilliant is your coming with your spears advanced.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वेषयामा नदयन्त पर्वतान्दिवो वा पृष्ठं नर्या अचुच्यवुः ।
विश्वो वो अज्मन्भयते वनस्पती रथीयन्तीव प्र जिहीत ओषधिः ॥
verses.rom:
yattveshayama nadayanta parvatandivo va prishtham narya achuchyavuh |
vishvo vo ajmanbhayate vanaspati rathiyantiva pra jihita oshadhih ||
verses.en:
When they in dazzling rush have made the mountains roar, and shaken heaven's high back in their heroic strength,
Each sovran of the forest fears as ye drive near, aid the shrubs fly before you swift as whirling wheels.

verses.sa:
यूयं न उग्रा मरुतः सुचेतुनारिष्टग्रामाः सुमतिं पिपर्तन ।
यत्रा वो दिद्युद्रदति क्रिविर्दती रिणाति पश्वः सुधितेव बर्हणा ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam na ugra marutah suchetunarishtagramah sumatim pipartana |
yatra vo didyudradati krivirdati rinati pashvah sudhiteva barhana ||
verses.en:
Terrible Maruts, ye with ne'er-diminished host, with great benevolence fulfil our heart's desire.
Where'er your lightning bites armed with its gory teeth it crunches up the cattle like a well-aimed dart.

verses.sa:
प्र स्कम्भदेष्णा अनवभ्रराधसोऽलातृणासो विदथेषु सुष्टुताः ।
अर्चन्त्यर्कं मदिरस्य पीतये विदुर्वीरस्य प्रथमानि पौंस्या ॥
verses.rom:
pra skambhadeshna anavabhraradhaso'latrinaso vidatheshu sushtutah |
archantyarkam madirasya pitaye vidurvirasya prathamani paumsya ||
verses.en:
Givers of during gifts whose bounties never fail, free from ill-will, at sacrifices glorified,
They sing their song aloud that they may drink sweet juice: well do they know the Hero's first heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
शतभुजिभिस्तमभिह्रुतेरघात्पूर्भी रक्षता मरुतो यमावत ।
जनं यमुग्रास्तवसो विरप्शिनः पाथना शंसात्तनयस्य पुष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
shatabhujibhistamabhihruteraghatpurbhi rakshata maruto yamavata |
janam yamugrastavaso virapshinah pathana shamsattanayasya pushtishu ||
verses.en:
With castles hundredfold, O Maruts, guard ye well the man whom ye have loved from ruin and from sin,--
The man whom ye the fierce, the Mighty ones who roar, preserve from calumny by cherishing his seed.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि भद्रा मरुतो रथेषु वो मिथस्पृध्येव तविषाण्याहिता ।
अंसेष्वा वः प्रपथेषु खादयोऽक्षो वश्चक्रा समया वि वावृते ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani bhadra maruto ratheshu vo mithaspridhyeva tavishanyahita |
amseshva vah prapatheshu khadayo'ksho vashchakra samaya vi vavrite ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, in your cars are all things that are good: great powers are set as 'twere in rivalry therein.
Rings are upon your shoulders when ye journey forth: your axle turns together both the chariot wheels.

verses.sa:
भूरीणि भद्रा नर्येषु बाहुषु वक्षस्सु रुक्मा रभसासो अञ्जयः ।
अंसेष्वेताः पविषु क्षुरा अधि वयो न पक्षान्व्यनु श्रियो धिरे ॥
verses.rom:
bhurini bhadra naryeshu bahushu vakshassu rukma rabhasaso anjayah |
amseshvetah pavishu kshura adhi vayo na pakshanvyanu shriyo dhire ||
verses.en:
Held in your manly arms are many goodly things, gold chains are on your chests, and glistering ornaments,
Deer-skins are on their shoulders, on their fellies knives: they spread their glory out as birds spread out their wings.

verses.sa:
महान्तो मह्ना विभ्वो विभूतयो दूरेदृशो ये दिव्या इव स्तृभिः ।
मन्द्राः सुजिह्वाः स्वरितार आसभिः सम्मिश्ला इन्द्रे मरुतः परिष्टुभः ॥
verses.rom:
mahanto mahna vibhvo vibhutayo duredrisho ye divya iva stribhih |
mandrah sujihvah svaritara asabhih sammishla indre marutah parishtubhah ||
verses.en:
Mighty in mightiness, pervading, passing strong, visible from afar as 'twere with stars of heaven,
Lovely with pleasant tongues, sweet singers with their mouths, the Maruts, joined with Indra, shout forth all around.

verses.sa:
तद्वः सुजाता मरुतो महित्वनं दीर्घं वो दात्रमदितेरिव व्रतम् ।
इन्द्रश्चन त्यजसा वि ह्रुणाति तज्जनाय यस्मै सुकृते अराध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvah sujata maruto mahitvanam dirgham vo datramaditeriva vratam |
indrashchana tyajasa vi hrunati tajjanaya yasmai sukrite aradhvam ||
verses.en:
This is your majesty, ye Maruts nobly born, far as the sway of Aditi your bounty spreads.
Even Indra by desertion never disannuls the boon bestowed by you upon the pious man.

verses.sa:
तद्वो जामित्वं मरुतः परे युगे पुरू यच्छंसममृतास आवत ।
अया धिया मनवे श्रुष्टिमाव्या साकं नरो दंसनैरा चिकित्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo jamitvam marutah pare yuge puru yachchhamsamamritasa avata |
aya dhiya manave shrushtimavya sakam naro damsanaira chikitrire ||
verses.en:
This is your kinship, Maruts, that, Immortals, ye were oft in olden time regardful of our call,
Having vouchsafed to man a hearing through this prayer, by wondrous deeds the Heroes have displayed their might.

verses.sa:
येन दीर्घं मरुतः शूशवाम युष्माकेन परीणसा तुरासः ।
आ यत्ततनन्वृजने जनास एभिर्यज्ञेभिस्तदभीष्टिमश्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
yena dirgham marutah shushavama yushmakena parinasa turasah |
a yattatananvrijane janasa ebhiryajnebhistadabhishtimashyam ||
verses.en:
That, O ye Maruts, we may long time flourish through your abundant riches, O swift movers,
And that our men may spread in the encampment, let me complete the rite with these oblations.

verses.sa:
एष व स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha va stomo maruta iyam girmandaryasya manyasya karoh |
esha yasishta tanve vayam vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
May this your laud, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's son, Mandarya,
Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
सहस्रं त इन्द्रोतयो नः सहस्रमिषो हरिवो गूर्ततमाः ।
सहस्रं रायो मादयध्यै सहस्रिण उप नो यन्तु वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasram ta indrotayo nah sahasramisho harivo gurtatamah |
sahasram rayo madayadhyai sahasrina upa no yantu vajah ||
verses.en:
A THOUSAND are thy helps for us, O Indra: a thousand, Lord of Bays, thy choice refreshments.
Wealth of a thousand sorts hast thou to cheer us: may precious goods come nigh to us in thousands.

verses.sa:
आ नोऽवोभिर्मरुतो यान्त्वच्छा ज्येष्ठेभिर्वा बृहद्दिवैः सुमायाः ।
अध यदेषां नियुतः परमाः समुद्रस्य चिद्धनयन्त पारे ॥
verses.rom:
a no'vobhirmaruto yantvachchha jyeshthebhirva brihaddivaih sumayah |
adha yadesham niyutah paramah samudrasya chiddhanayanta pare ||
verses.en:
May the most sapient Maruts, with protection, with best boons brought from lofty heaven, approach us,
Now when their team of the most noble horses speeds even on the sea's extremest limit.

verses.sa:
मिम्यक्ष येषु सुधिता घृताची हिरण्यनिर्णिगुपरा न ऋष्टिः ।
गुहा चरन्ती मनुषो न योषा सभावती विदथ्येव सं वाक् ॥
verses.rom:
mimyaksha yeshu sudhita ghritachi hiranyanirnigupara na rishtih |
guha charanti manusho na yosha sabhavati vidathyeva sam vak ||
verses.en:
Close to them clings one moving in seclusion, like a man's wife, like a spear carried rearward,
Well grasped, bright, decked with gold there is Vak also, like to a courtly, eloquent dame, among them.

verses.sa:
परा शुभ्रा अयासो यव्या साधारण्येव मरुतो मिमिक्षुः ।
न रोदसी अप नुदन्त घोरा जुषन्त वृधं सख्याय देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
para shubhra ayaso yavya sadharanyeva maruto mimikshuh |
na rodasi apa nudanta ghora jushanta vridham sakhyaya devah ||
verses.en:
Far off the brilliant, never-weary Maruts cling to the young Maid as a joint possession.
The fierce Gods drave not Rodasi before them, but wished for her to grow their friend and fellow.

verses.sa:
जोषद्यदीमसुर्या सचध्यै विषितस्तुका रोदसी नृमणाः ।
आ सूर्येव विधतो रथं गात्त्वेषप्रतीका नभसो नेत्या ॥
verses.rom:
joshadyadimasurya sachadhyai vishitastuka rodasi nrimanah |
a suryeva vidhato ratham gattveshapratika nabhaso netya ||
verses.en:
When chose immortal Rodasi to follow--she with loose tresses and heroic spirit--
She climbed her servant's chariot, she like Surya with cloud-like motion and refulgent aspect.

verses.sa:
आस्थापयन्त युवतिं युवानः शुभे निमिश्लां विदथेषु पज्राम् ।
अर्को यद्वो मरुतो हविष्मान्गायद्गाथं सुतसोमो दुवस्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
asthapayanta yuvatim yuvanah shubhe nimishlam vidatheshu pajram |
arko yadvo maruto havishmangayadgatham sutasomo duvasyan ||
verses.en:
Upon their car the young men set the Maiden wedded to glory, mighty in assemblies,
When your song, Maruts, rose, and, with oblation, the Soma-pourer sang his hymn in worship.

verses.sa:
प्र तं विवक्मि वक्म्यो य एषां मरुतां महिमा सत्यो अस्ति ।
सचा यदीं वृषमणा अहंयु स्थिरा चिज्जनीर्वहते सुभागाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra tam vivakmi vakmyo ya esham marutam mahima satyo asti |
sacha yadim vrishamana ahamyu sthira chijjanirvahate subhagah ||
verses.en:
I will declare the greatness of these Maruts, their real greatness, worthy to be lauded,
How, with them, she though firm, strong-minded, haughty, travels to women happy in their fortune.

verses.sa:
पान्ति मित्रावरुणाववद्याच्चयत ईमर्यमो अप्रशस्तान् ।
उत च्यवन्ते अच्युता ध्रुवाणि वावृध ईं मरुतो दातिवारः ॥
verses.rom:
panti mitravarunavavadyachchayata imaryamo aprashastan |
uta chyavante achyuta dhruvani vavridha im maruto dativarah ||
verses.en:
Mitra and Varuna they guard from censure: Aryaman too, discovers worthless sinners
Firm things are overthrown that ne'er were shaken: he prospers, Maruts, who gives choice oblations.

verses.sa:
नही नु वो मरुतो अन्त्यस्मे आरात्ताच्चिच्छवसो अन्तमापुः ।
ते धृष्णुना शवसा शूशुवांसोऽर्णो न द्वेषो धृषता परि ष्ठुः ॥
verses.rom:
nahi nu vo maruto antyasme arattachchichchhavaso antamapuh |
te dhrishnuna shavasa shushuvamso'rno na dvesho dhrishata pari shthuh ||
verses.en:
None of us, Maruts, near or at a distance, hath ever reached the limit of your vigour.
They in courageous might still waxing boldly have compassed round their foemen like an ocean.

verses.sa:
वयमद्येन्द्रस्य प्रेष्ठा वयं श्वो वोचेमहि समर्ये ।
वयं पुरा महि च नो अनु द्यून्तन्न ऋभुक्षा नरामनु ष्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
vayamadyendrasya preshtha vayam shvo vochemahi samarye |
vayam pura mahi cha no anu dyuntanna ribhuksha naramanu shyat ||
verses.en:
May we this day be dearest friends of Indra, and let us call on him in fight to-morrow.
So were we erst. New might attend us daily! So be with us! Rbhuksan of the Heroes!

verses.sa:
एष व स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha va stomo maruta iyam girmandaryasya manyasya karoh |
esha yasishta tanve vayam vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
May this your laud, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's
son, Mandarya,
Bring offspring for ourselves with. food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
यज्ञायज्ञा वः समना तुतुर्वणिर्धियंधियं वो देवया उ दधिध्वे ।
आ वोऽर्वाचः सुविताय रोदस्योर्महे ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnayajna vah samana tuturvanirdhiyamdhiyam vo devaya u dadhidhve |
a vo'rvachah suvitaya rodasyormahe vavrityamavase suvriktibhih ||
verses.en:
SWIFT gain is his who hath you near at every rite: ye welcome every song of him who serves the Gods.
So may I turn you hither with fair hymns of praise to give great succour for the weal of both the worlds.

verses.sa:
वव्रासो न ये स्वजाः स्वतवस इषं स्वरभिजायन्त धूतयः ।
सहस्रियासो अपां नोर्मय आसा गावो वन्द्यासो नोक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
vavraso na ye svajah svatavasa isham svarabhijayanta dhutayah |
sahasriyaso apam normaya asa gavo vandyaso nokshanah ||
verses.en:
Surrounding, as it were, self-born, self-powerful, they spring to life the shakers-down of food and light;
Like as the countess undulations of the floods, worthy of praise when near, like bullocks and like kine.

verses.sa:
सोमासो न ये सुतास्तृप्तांशवो हृत्सु पीतासो दुवसो नासते ।
ऐषामंसेषु रम्भिणीव रारभे हस्तेषु खादिश्च कृतिश्च सं दधे ॥
verses.rom:
somaso na ye sutastriptamshavo hritsu pitaso duvaso nasate |
aishamamseshu rambhiniva rarabhe hasteshu khadishcha kritishcha sam dadhe ||
verses.en:
They who, like Somas with their well-grown stalks pressed out, imbibed within the heart, dwell there in friendly wise.
Upon their shoulders rests as 'twere a warrior's spear and in their hand they hold a dagger and a ring.

verses.sa:
अव स्वयुक्ता दिव आ वृथा ययुरमर्त्याः कशया चोदत त्मना ।
अरेणवस्तुविजाता अचुच्यवुर्दृळ्हानि चिन्मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ava svayukta diva a vritha yayuramartyah kashaya chodata tmana |
arenavastuvijata achuchyavurdrilhani chinmaruto bhrajadrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Self-yoked they have descended lightly from the sky. With your own lash, Immortals, urge yourselves to speed.
Unstained by dust the Maruts, mighty in their strength, have cast down e'en firm things, armed with their shining spears.

verses.sa:
को वोऽन्तर्मरुत ऋष्टिविद्युतो रेजति त्मना हन्वेव जिह्वया ।
धन्वच्युत इषां न यामनि पुरुप्रैषा अहन्यो नैतशः ॥
verses.rom:
ko vo'ntarmaruta rishtividyuto rejati tmana hanveva jihvaya |
dhanvachyuta isham na yamani purupraisha ahanyo naitashah ||
verses.en:
Who among you, O Maruts armed with lightning-spears, moveth you by himself, as with the tongue his jaws?
Ye rush from heaven's floor as though ye sought for food, on many errands like the Sun's diurnal Steed.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदस्य रजसो महस्परं क्वावरं मरुतो यस्मिन्नायय ।
यच्च्यावयथ विथुरेव संहितं व्यद्रिणा पतथ त्वेषमर्णवम् ॥
verses.rom:
kva svidasya rajaso mahasparam kvavaram maruto yasminnayaya |
yachchyavayatha vithureva samhitam vyadrina patatha tveshamarnavam ||
verses.en:
Say where, then, is this mighty region's farthest bound, where, Maruts, is the lowest depth that ye have reached,
When ye cast down like chaff the firmly stablished pile, and from the mountain send the glittering water-flood?

verses.sa:
सातिर्न वोऽमवती स्वर्वती त्वेषा विपाका मरुतः पिपिष्वती ।
भद्रा वो रातिः पृणतो न दक्षिणा पृथुज्रयी असुर्येव जञ्जती ॥
verses.rom:
satirna vo'mavati svarvati tvesha vipaka marutah pipishvati |
bhadra vo ratih prinato na dakshina prithujrayi asuryeva janjati ||
verses.en:
Your winning is with strength, dazzling, with heavenly light, with fruit mature, O Maruts, fall of plenteousness.
Auspicious is your gift like a free giver's meed, victorious, spreading far, as of immortal Gods.

verses.sa:
प्रति ष्टोभन्ति सिन्धवः पविभ्यो यदभ्रियां वाचमुदीरयन्ति ।
अव स्मयन्त विद्युतः पृथिव्यां यदी घृतं मरुतः प्रुष्णुवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
prati shtobhanti sindhavah pavibhyo yadabhriyam vachamudirayanti |
ava smayanta vidyutah prithivyam yadi ghritam marutah prushnuvanti ||
verses.en:
The rivers roar before your chariot fellies when they are uttering the voice of rain-clouds.
The lightnings laugh upon the earth beneath them, what time the Maruts scatter forth their fatness.

verses.sa:
असूत पृश्निर्महते रणाय त्वेषमयासां मरुतामनीकम् ।
ते सप्सरासोऽजनयन्ताभ्वमादित्स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
asuta prishnirmahate ranaya tveshamayasam marutamanikam |
te sapsaraso'janayantabhvamaditsvadhamishiram paryapashyan ||
verses.en:
Prsni brought forth, to fight the mighty battle, the glittering army of the restless Maruts.
Nurtured together they begat the monster, and then looked round them for the food that strengthens.

verses.sa:
एष व स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha va stomo maruta iyam girmandaryasya manyasya karoh |
esha yasishta tanve vayam vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
May this your laud, may this your song O Maruts, sung by the poet Mana's son, Mandarya,
Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
महश्चित्त्वमिन्द्र यत एतान्महश्चिदसि त्यजसो वरूता ।
स नो वेधो मरुतां चिकित्वान्सुम्ना वनुष्व तव हि प्रेष्ठा ॥
verses.rom:
mahashchittvamindra yata etanmahashchidasi tyajaso varuta |
sa no vedho marutam chikitvansumna vanushva tava hi preshtha ||
verses.en:
As, Indra, from great treason thou protectest, yea, from great treachery these who approach us,
So, marking well, Controller of the Maruts grant us their blessings, for they are thy dearest.

verses.sa:
अयुज्रन्त इन्द्र विश्वकृष्टीर्विदानासो निष्षिधो मर्त्यत्रा ।
मरुतां पृत्सुतिर्हासमाना स्वर्मीळ्हस्य प्रधनस्य सातौ ॥
verses.rom:
ayujranta indra vishvakrishtirvidanaso nishshidho martyatra |
marutam pritsutirhasamana svarmilhasya pradhanasya satau ||
verses.en:
The various doings of all mortal people by thee are ordered, in thy wisdom, Indra.
The host of Maruts goeth forth exulting to win the light-bestowing spoil of battle.

verses.sa:
अम्यक्सा त इन्द्र ऋष्टिरस्मे सनेम्यभ्वं मरुतो जुनन्ति ।
अग्निश्चिद्धि ष्मातसे शुशुक्वानापो न द्वीपं दधति प्रयांसि ॥
verses.rom:
amyaksa ta indra rishtirasme sanemyabhvam maruto junanti |
agnishchiddhi shmatase shushukvanapo na dvipam dadhati prayamsi ||
verses.en:
That spear of thine sat firm for us, O Indra: the Maruts set their whole dread power in motion.
E'en Agni shines resplendent in the brush-wood: the viands hold him as floods hold an island.

verses.sa:
त्वं तू न इन्द्र तं रयिं दा ओजिष्ठया दक्षिणयेव रातिम् ।
स्तुतश्च यास्ते चकनन्त वायो स्तनं न मध्वः पीपयन्त वाजैः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tu na indra tam rayim da ojishthaya dakshinayeva ratim |
stutashcha yaste chakananta vayo stanam na madhvah pipayanta vajaih ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe us now that opulence, O Indra, as guerdon won by mightiest donation.
May hymns that please thee cause the breast of Vayu to swell as with the mead's refreshing sweetness.

verses.sa:
त्वे राय इन्द्र तोशतमाः प्रणेतारः कस्य चिदृतायोः ।
ते षु णो मरुतो मृळयन्तु ये स्मा पुरा गातूयन्तीव देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
tve raya indra toshatamah pranetarah kasya chidritayoh |
te shu no maruto mrilayantu ye sma pura gatuyantiva devah ||
verses.en:
With thee, O Indra, are most bounteous riches that further every one who lives uprightly.
Now may these Maruts show us loving-kindness, Gods who of old were ever prompt to help us.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्र याहीन्द्र मीळ्हुषो नॄन्महः पार्थिवे सदने यतस्व ।
अध यदेषां पृथुबुध्नास एतास्तीर्थे नार्यः पौंस्यानि तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
prati pra yahindra milhusho nrinmahah parthive sadane yatasva |
adha yadesham prithubudhnasa etastirthe naryah paumsyani tasthuh ||
verses.en:
Bring forth the Men who rain down boons, O Indra: exert thee in the great terrestrial region;
For their broad-chested speckled deer are standing like a King's armies on the field of battle.

verses.sa:
प्रति घोराणामेतानामयासां मरुतां शृण्व आयतामुपब्दिः ।
ये मर्त्यं पृतनायन्तमूमैरृणावानं न पतयन्त सर्गैः ॥
verses.rom:
prati ghoranametanamayasam marutam shrinva ayatamupabdih |
ye martyam pritanayantamumairrinavanam na patayanta sargaih ||
verses.en:
Heard is the roar of the advancing Maruts, terrific, glittering, and swiftly moving,
Who with their rush o'erthrow as 'twere a sinner the mortal who would fight with those who love him

verses.sa:
त्वं मानेभ्य इन्द्र विश्वजन्या रदा मरुद्भिः शुरुधो गोअग्राः ।
स्तवानेभि स्तवसे देव देवैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam manebhya indra vishvajanya rada marudbhih shurudho goagrah |
stavanebhi stavase deva devairvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Give to the Manas, Indra with Maruts, gifts universal, gifts of cattle foremost.
Thou, God, art praised with Gods who must be lauded. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
न नूनमस्ति नो श्वः कस्तद्वेद यदद्भुतम् ।
अन्यस्य चित्तमभि संचरेण्यमुताधीतं वि नश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
na nunamasti no shvah kastadveda yadadbhutam |
anyasya chittamabhi samcharenyamutadhitam vi nashyati ||
verses.en:
NAUGHT is to-day, to-morrow naught. Who comprehends the mystery?
We must address ourselves unto another's thought, and lost is then the hope we formed.

verses.sa:
किं न इन्द्र जिघांससि भ्रातरो मरुतस्तव ।
तेभिः कल्पस्व साधुया मा नः समरणे वधीः ॥
verses.rom:
kim na indra jighamsasi bhrataro marutastava |
tebhih kalpasva sadhuya ma nah samarane vadhih ||
verses.en:
The Maruts are thy brothers. Why, O Indra, wouldst thou take our lives?
Agree with them in friendly wise, and do not slay us in the fight.

verses.sa:
किं नो भ्रातरगस्त्य सखा सन्नति मन्यसे ।
विद्मा हि ते यथा मनोऽस्मभ्यमिन्न दित्ससि ॥
verses.rom:
kim no bhrataragastya sakha sannati manyase |
vidma hi te yatha mano'smabhyaminna ditsasi ||
verses.en:
Agastya, brother, why dost thou neglect us, thou who art our friend?
We know the nature of thy mind. Verity thou wilt give us naught.

verses.sa:
अरं कृण्वन्तु वेदिं समग्निमिन्धतां पुरः ।
तत्रामृतस्य चेतनं यज्ञं ते तनवावहै ॥
verses.rom:
aram krinvantu vedim samagnimindhatam purah |
tatramritasya chetanam yajnam te tanavavahai ||
verses.en:
Let them prepare the altar, let them kindle fire in front: we two
Here will spread sacrifice for thee, that the Immortal may observe.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे वसुपते वसूनां त्वं मित्राणां मित्रपते धेष्ठः ।
इन्द्र त्वं मरुद्भिः सं वदस्वाध प्राशान ऋतुथा हवींषि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamishishe vasupate vasunam tvam mitranam mitrapate dheshthah |
indra tvam marudbhih sam vadasvadha prashana ritutha havimshi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Lord of Wealth, art Master of all treasures, thou, Lord of friends, art thy friends' best supporter.
O Indra, speak thou kindly with the Maruts, and taste oblations in their proper season.

verses.sa:
प्रति व एना नमसाहमेमि सूक्तेन भिक्षे सुमतिं तुराणाम् ।
रराणता मरुतो वेद्याभिर्नि हेळो धत्त वि मुचध्वमश्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
prati va ena namasahamemi suktena bhikshe sumatim turanam |
raranata maruto vedyabhirni helo dhatta vi muchadhvamashvan ||
verses.en:
To you I come with this mine adoration, and with a hymn I crave the Strong Ones' favour
A hymn that truly makes you joyful, Maruts. Suppress your anger and unyoke your horses.

verses.sa:
एष व स्तोमो मरुतो नमस्वान्हृदा तष्टो मनसा धायि देवाः ।
उपेमा यात मनसा जुषाणा यूयं हि ष्ठा नमस इद्वृधासः ॥
verses.rom:
esha va stomo maruto namasvanhrida tashto manasa dhayi devah |
upema yata manasa jushana yuyam hi shtha namasa idvridhasah ||
verses.en:
Maruts, to you this laud with prayer and worship, formed in the mind and heart, ye Gods, is offered.
Come ye to us, rejoicing in your spirit, for ye are they who make our prayer effective.

verses.sa:
स्तुतासो नो मरुतो मृळयन्तूत स्तुतो मघवा शम्भविष्ठः ।
ऊर्ध्वा नः सन्तु कोम्या वनान्यहानि विश्वा मरुतो जिगीषा ॥
verses.rom:
stutaso no maruto mrilayantuta stuto maghava shambhavishthah |
urdhva nah santu komya vananyahani vishva maruto jigisha ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, praised by us, shall show us favour; Maghavan, lauded, shall be most propitious.
Maruts,, may all our days that are to follow be very pleasant, lovely and triumphant.

verses.sa:
अस्मादहं तविषादीषमाण इन्द्राद्भिया मरुतो रेजमानः ।
युष्मभ्यं हव्या निशितान्यासन्तान्यारे चकृमा मृळता नः ॥
verses.rom:
asmadaham tavishadishamana indradbhiya maruto rejamanah |
yushmabhyam havya nishitanyasantanyare chakrima mrilata nah ||
verses.en:
I fled in terror from this mighty Indra, my body trembling in alarm, O Maruts.
Oblations meant for you had been made ready; these have we set aside: for this forgive us.

verses.sa:
येन मानासश्चितयन्त उस्रा व्युष्टिषु शवसा शश्वतीनाम् ।
स नो मरुद्भिर्वृषभ श्रवो धा उग्र उग्रेभि स्थविरः सहोदाः ॥
verses.rom:
yena manasashchitayanta usra vyushtishu shavasa shashvatinam |
sa no marudbhirvrishabha shravo dha ugra ugrebhi sthavirah sahodah ||
verses.en:
By whom the Manas recognize the day-springs, by whose strength at the dawn of endless mornings,
Give us, thou Mighty, glory with Maruts. fierce with the fierce, the Strong who givest triumph.

verses.sa:
त्वं पाहीन्द्र सहीयसो नॄन्भवा मरुद्भिरवयातहेळाः ।
सुप्रकेतेभिः सासहिर्दधानो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam pahindra sahiyaso nrinbhava marudbhiravayatahelah |
supraketebhih sasahirdadhano vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Do thou, O Indra, guard the conquering Heroes, and rid thee of thy wrath against the Maruts,
With them, the wise, victorious and bestowing. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
चित्रो वोऽस्तु यामश्चित्र ऊती सुदानवः ।
मरुतो अहिभानवः ॥
verses.rom:
chitro vo'stu yamashchitra uti sudanavah |
maruto ahibhanavah ||
verses.en:
WONDERFUL let your coming be, wondrous with help, ye Bounteous Ones,
Maruts, who gleam as serpents gleam.

verses.sa:
आरे सा वः सुदानवो मरुत ऋञ्जती शरुः ।
आरे अश्मा यमस्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
are sa vah sudanavo maruta rinjati sharuh |
are ashma yamasyatha ||
verses.en:
Far be from us, O Maruts, ye free givers, your impetuous shaft;
Far from us be the stone ye hurl.

verses.sa:
तृणस्कन्दस्य नु विशः परि वृङ्क्त सुदानवः ।
ऊर्ध्वान्नः कर्त जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
trinaskandasya nu vishah pari vrinkta sudanavah |
urdhvannah karta jivase ||
verses.en:
O Bounteous Givers, touch ye not, O Maruts, Trnskanda's folk;
Lift ye us up that we may live.

verses.sa:
गायत्साम नभन्यं यथा वेरर्चाम तद्वावृधानं स्वर्वत् ।
गावो धेनवो बर्हिष्यदब्धा आ यत्सद्मानं दिव्यं विवासान् ॥
verses.rom:
gayatsama nabhanyam yatha verarchama tadvavridhanam svarvat |
gavo dhenavo barhishyadabdha a yatsadmanam divyam vivasan ||
verses.en:
THE praise-song let him sing forth bursting bird-like: sing we that hymn which like heaven's light expandeth,
That the milk-giving cows may, unimpeded call to the sacred grass the Gods' assembly.

verses.sa:
अर्चद्वृषा वृषभिः स्वेदुहव्यैर्मृगो नाश्नो अति यज्जुगुर्यात् ।
प्र मन्दयुर्मनां गूर्त होता भरते मर्यो मिथुना यजत्रः ॥
verses.rom:
archadvrisha vrishabhih sveduhavyairmrigo nashno ati yajjuguryat |
pra mandayurmanam gurta hota bharate maryo mithuna yajatrah ||
verses.en:
Let the Bull sing with Bulls whose toil is worship, with a loud roar like some wild beast that hungers.
Praised God! the glad priest brings his heart's devotion; the holy youth presents twofold oblation.

verses.sa:
नक्षद्धोता परि सद्म मिता यन्भरद्गर्भमा शरदः पृथिव्याः ।
क्रन्ददश्वो नयमानो रुवद्गौरन्तर्दूतो न रोदसी चरद्वाक् ॥
verses.rom:
nakshaddhota pari sadma mita yanbharadgarbhama sharadah prithivyah |
krandadashvo nayamano ruvadgaurantarduto na rodasi charadvak ||
verses.en:
May the Priest come circling the measured stations, and with him bring the earth's autumnal fruitage.
Let the Horse neigh led near, let the Steer bellow: let the Voice go between both worlds as herald,

verses.sa:
ता कर्माषतरास्मै प्र च्यौत्नानि देवयन्तो भरन्ते ।
जुजोषदिन्द्रो दस्मवर्चा नासत्येव सुग्म्यो रथेष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
ta karmashatarasmai pra chyautnani devayanto bharante |
jujoshadindro dasmavarcha nasatyeva sugmyo ratheshthah ||
verses.en:
To him we offer welcomest oblations, the pious bring their strength-inspiring praises.
May Indra, wondrous in his might, accept them, car-borne and swift to move like the Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहीन्द्रं यो ह सत्वा यः शूरो मघवा यो रथेष्ठाः ।
प्रतीचश्चिद्योधीयान्वृषण्वान्ववव्रुषश्चित्तमसो विहन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shtuhindram yo ha satva yah shuro maghava yo ratheshthah |
pratichashchidyodhiyanvrishanvanvavavrushashchittamaso vihanta ||
verses.en:
Praise thou that Indra who is truly mighty, the car-borne Warrior, Maghavan the Hero;
Stronger in war than those who fight against him, borne by strong steeds, who kills enclosing darkness;

verses.sa:
प्र यदित्था महिना नृभ्यो अस्त्यरं रोदसी कक्ष्ये नास्मै ।
सं विव्य इन्द्रो वृजनं न भूमा भर्ति स्वधावाँ ओपशमिव द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadittha mahina nribhyo astyaram rodasi kakshye nasmai |
sam vivya indro vrijanam na bhuma bharti svadhavan opashamiva dyam ||
verses.en:
Him who surpasses heroes in his greatness: the earth and heavens suffice not for his girdles.
Indra endues the earth to be his garment, and, God-like, wears the heaven as 'twere a frontlet,

verses.sa:
समत्सु त्वा शूर सतामुराणं प्रपथिन्तमं परितंसयध्यै ।
सजोषस इन्द्रं मदे क्षोणीः सूरिं चिद्ये अनुमदन्ति वाजैः ॥
verses.rom:
samatsu tva shura satamuranam prapathintamam paritamsayadhyai |
sajoshasa indram made kshonih surim chidye anumadanti vajaih ||
verses.en:
Thee, Hero, guardian of the brave in battles, who roamest in the van,--to draw thee hither,
Indra, the hosts agree beside the Soma, and joy, for his great actions, in the Chieftain.

verses.sa:
एवा हि ते शं सवना समुद्र आपो यत्त आसु मदन्ति देवीः ।
विश्वा ते अनु जोष्या भूद्गौः सूरीँश्चिद्यदि धिषा वेषि जनान् ॥
verses.rom:
eva hi te sham savana samudra apo yatta asu madanti devih |
vishva te anu joshya bhudgauh surinshchidyadi dhisha veshi janan ||
verses.en:
Libations in the sea to thee are pleasant, when thy divine Floods come to cheer these people.
To thee the Cow is sum of all things grateful when with the wish thou seekest men and princes.

verses.sa:
असाम यथा सुषखाय एन स्वभिष्टयो नरां न शंसैः ।
असद्यथा न इन्द्रो वन्दनेष्ठास्तुरो न कर्म नयमान उक्था ॥
verses.rom:
asama yatha sushakhaya ena svabhishtayo naram na shamsaih |
asadyatha na indro vandaneshthasturo na karma nayamana uktha ||
verses.en:
So may we in this One be well befriended, well aided as it were through praise of chieftains,
That Indra still may linger at our worship, as one led swift to work, to hear our praises.

verses.sa:
विष्पर्धसो नरां न शंसैरस्माकासदिन्द्रो वज्रहस्तः ।
मित्रायुवो न पूर्पतिं सुशिष्टौ मध्यायुव उप शिक्षन्ति यज्ञैः ॥
verses.rom:
vishpardhaso naram na shamsairasmakasadindro vajrahastah |
mitrayuvo na purpatim sushishtau madhyayuva upa shikshanti yajnaih ||
verses.en:
Like men in rivalry extolling princes, our Friend be Indra, wielder of the thunder.
Like true friends of some city's lord within them held in good rule with sacrifice they help him.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो हि ष्मेन्द्रं कश्चिदृन्धञ्जुहुराणश्चिन्मनसा परियन् ।
तीर्थे नाच्छा तातृषाणमोको दीर्घो न सिध्रमा कृणोत्यध्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yajno hi shmendram kashchidrindhanjuhuranashchinmanasa pariyan |
tirthe nachchha tatrishanamoko dirgho na sidhrama krinotyadhva ||
verses.en:
For every sacrifice makes Indra stronger, yea, when he goes around angry in spirit;
As pleasure at the ford invites the thirsty, as the long way brings him who gains his object.

verses.sa:
मो षू ण इन्द्रात्र पृत्सु देवैरस्ति हि ष्मा ते शुष्मिन्नवयाः ।
महश्चिद्यस्य मीळ्हुषो यव्या हविष्मतो मरुतो वन्दते गीः ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu na indratra pritsu devairasti hi shma te shushminnavayah |
mahashchidyasya milhusho yavya havishmato maruto vandate gih ||
verses.en:
Let us not here contend with Gods, O Indra, for here, O Mighty One, is thine own portion,
The Great, whose Friends the bounteous Maruts honour, as with a stream, his song who pours oblations.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोम इन्द्र तुभ्यमस्मे एतेन गातुं हरिवो विदो नः ।
आ नो ववृत्याः सुविताय देव विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha stoma indra tubhyamasme etena gatum harivo vido nah |
a no vavrityah suvitaya deva vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Addressed to thee is this our praise, O Indra: Lord of Bay Steeds, find us hereby advancement.
So mayst thou lead us on, O God, to comfort. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
त्वं राजेन्द्र ये च देवा रक्षा नॄन्पाह्यसुर त्वमस्मान् ।
त्वं सत्पतिर्मघवा नस्तरुत्रस्त्वं सत्यो वसवानः सहोदाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rajendra ye cha deva raksha nrinpahyasura tvamasman |
tvam satpatirmaghava nastarutrastvam satyo vasavanah sahodah ||
verses.en:
THOU art the King of all the Gods, O Indra: protect the men, O Asura, preserve us.
Thou Lord of Heroes, Maghavan, our saver, art faithful, very rich, the victory-giver.

verses.sa:
दनो विश इन्द्र मृध्रवाचः सप्त यत्पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्त् ।
ऋणोरपो अनवद्यार्णा यूने वृत्रं पुरुकुत्साय रन्धीः ॥
verses.rom:
dano visha indra mridhravachah sapta yatpurah sharma sharadirdart |
rinorapo anavadyarna yune vritram purukutsaya randhih ||
verses.en:
Indra, thou humbledst tribes that spake with insult by breaking down seven autumn forts, their refuge.
Thou stirredst, Blameless! billowy floods, and gavest his foe a prey to youthful Purukutsa.

verses.sa:
अजा वृत इन्द्र शूरपत्नीर्द्यां च येभिः पुरुहूत नूनम् ।
रक्षो अग्निमशुषं तूर्वयाणं सिंहो न दमे अपांसि वस्तोः ॥
verses.rom:
aja vrita indra shurapatnirdyam cha yebhih puruhuta nunam |
raksho agnimashusham turvayanam simho na dame apamsi vastoh ||
verses.en:
With whom thou drivest troops whose lords are heroes, and bringest daylight now, much worshipped Indra,
With them guard lion-like wasting active Agni to dwell in our tilled fields and in our homestead.

verses.sa:
शेषन्नु त इन्द्र सस्मिन्योनौ प्रशस्तये पवीरवस्य मह्ना ।
सृजदर्णांस्यव यद्युधा गास्तिष्ठद्धरी धृषता मृष्ट वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
sheshannu ta indra sasminyonau prashastaye paviravasya mahna |
srijadarnamsyava yadyudha gastishthaddhari dhrishata mrishta vajan ||
verses.en:
They through the greatness of thy spear, O Indra, shall, to thy praise, rest in this earthly station.
To loose the floods, to seek, for kine, the battle, his Bays he mounted boldly seized the booty.

verses.sa:
वह कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन्स्यूमन्यू ऋज्रा वातस्याश्वा ।
प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीकेऽभि स्पृधो यासिषद्वज्रबाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
vaha kutsamindra yasminchakansyumanyu rijra vatasyashva |
pra surashchakram vrihatadabhike'bhi spridho yasishadvajrabahuh ||
verses.en:
Indra, bear Kutsa, him in whom thou joyest: the dark-red horses of the Wind are docile.
Let the Sun roll his chariot wheel anear us, and let the Thunderer go to meet the foemen.

verses.sa:
जघन्वाँ इन्द्र मित्रेरूञ्चोदप्रवृद्धो हरिवो अदाशून् ।
प्र ये पश्यन्नर्यमणं सचायोस्त्वया शूर्ता वहमाना अपत्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
jaghanvan indra mitrerunchodapravriddho harivo adashun |
pra ye pashyannaryamanam sachayostvaya shurta vahamana apatyam ||
verses.en:
Thou Indra, Lord of Bays, made strong by impulse, hast slain the vexers of thy friends, who give not.
They who beheld the Friend beside the living were cast aside by thee as they rode onward.

verses.sa:
रपत्कविरिन्द्रार्कसातौ क्षां दासायोपबर्हणीं कः ।
करत्तिस्रो मघवा दानुचित्रा नि दुर्योणे कुयवाचं मृधि श्रेत् ॥
verses.rom:
rapatkavirindrarkasatau ksham dasayopabarhanim kah |
karattisro maghava danuchitra ni duryone kuyavacham mridhi shret ||
verses.en:
Indra, the bard sang forth in inspiration: thou madest earth a covering for the Dasa.
Maghavan made the three that gleam with moisture, and to his home brought Kuyavac to slay him.

verses.sa:
सना ता त इन्द्र नव्या आगुः सहो नभोऽविरणाय पूर्वीः ।
भिनत्पुरो न भिदो अदेवीर्ननमो वधरदेवस्य पीयोः ॥
verses.rom:
sana ta ta indra navya aguh saho nabho'viranaya purvih |
bhinatpuro na bhido adevirnanamo vadharadevasya piyoh ||
verses.en:
These thine old deeds new bards have sung, O Indra. Thou conqueredst, boundest many tribes for ever.
Like castles thou hast crushed the godless races, and bowed the godless scorner's deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
त्वं धुनिरिन्द्र धुनिमतीरृणोरपः सीरा न स्रवन्तीः ।
प्र यत्समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dhunirindra dhunimatirrinorapah sira na sravantih |
pra yatsamudramati shura parshi paraya turvasham yadum svasti ||
verses.en:
A Stormer thou hast made the stormy waters flow down, O Indra, like the running rivers.
When o'er the flood thou broughtest them, O Hero, thou keptest Turvasa and Yadu safely.

verses.sa:
त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र विश्वध स्या अवृकतमो नरां नृपाता ।
स नो विश्वासां स्पृधां सहोदा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasmakamindra vishvadha sya avrikatamo naram nripata |
sa no vishvasam spridham sahoda vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Indra, mayst thou be ours in all occasions, protector of the men, most gentle-hearted,
Giving us victory over all our rivals. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः ।
वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः ॥
verses.rom:
matsyapayi te mahah patrasyeva harivo matsaro madah |
vrisha te vrishna indurvaji sahasrasatamah ||
verses.en:
GLAD thee: thy glory hath been quaffed, Lord of Bay Steeds, as 'twere the bowl's enlivening mead.
For thee the Strong there is strong drink, mighty, omnipotent to win.

verses.sa:
आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः ।
सहावाँ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनाषाळमर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a naste gantu matsaro vrisha mado varenyah |
sahavan indra sanasih pritanashalamartyah ||
verses.en:
Let our strong drink, most excellent, exhilarating, come to thee,
Victorious, Indra! bringing gain, immortal conquering in fight,

verses.sa:
त्वं हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् ।
सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi shurah sanita chodayo manusho ratham |
sahavandasyumavratamoshah patram na shochisha ||
verses.en:
Thou, Hero, winner of the spoil, urgest to speed the car of man.
Burn, like a vessel with the flame, the lawless Dasyu, Conqueror!

verses.sa:
मुषाय सूर्यं कवे चक्रमीशान ओजसा ।
वह शुष्णाय वधं कुत्सं वातस्याश्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
mushaya suryam kave chakramishana ojasa |
vaha shushnaya vadham kutsam vatasyashvaih ||
verses.en:
Empowered by thine own might, O Sage, thou stolest Surya's chariot wheel.
Thou barest Kutsa with the steeds of Wind to Susna as his death.

verses.sa:
शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः ।
वृत्रघ्ना वरिवोविदा मंसीष्ठा अश्वसातमः ॥
verses.rom:
shushmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuh |
vritraghna varivovida mamsishtha ashvasatamah ||
verses.en:
Most mighty is thy rapturous joy, most splendid is thine active power,
Wherewith, foe-slaying, sending bliss, thou art supreme in gaining steeds.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ ।
तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha purvebhyo jaritribhya indra maya ivapo na trishyate babhutha |
tamanu tva nividam johavimi vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
As thou, O Indra, to the ancient singers wast ever joy, as water to the thirsty,
So unto thee I sing this invocation. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
मत्सि नो वस्यइष्टय इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ।
ऋघायमाण इन्वसि शत्रुमन्ति न विन्दसि ॥
verses.rom:
matsi no vasyaishtaya indramindo vrisha visha |
righayamana invasi shatrumanti na vindasi ||
verses.en:
CHEER thee with draughts to win us bliss: Soma, pierce Indra in thy strength.
Thou stormest trembling in thy rage, and findest not a foeman nigh.

verses.sa:
तस्मिन्ना वेशया गिरो य एकश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
अनु स्वधा यमुप्यते यवं न चर्कृषद्वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
tasminna veshaya giro ya ekashcharshaninam |
anu svadha yamupyate yavam na charkrishadvrisha ||
verses.en:
Make our songs penetrate to him who is the Only One of men;
For whom the sacred food is spread, as the steer ploughs the barley in.

verses.sa:
यस्य विश्वानि हस्तयोः पञ्च क्षितीनां वसु ।
स्पाशयस्व यो अस्मध्रुग्दिव्येवाशनिर्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yasya vishvani hastayoh pancha kshitinam vasu |
spashayasva yo asmadhrugdivyevashanirjahi ||
verses.en:
Within whose hands deposited all the Five Peoples' treasures rest.
Mark thou the man who injures us and kill him like the heavenly bolt.

verses.sa:
असुन्वन्तं समं जहि दूणाशं यो न ते मयः ।
अस्मभ्यमस्य वेदनं दद्धि सूरिश्चिदोहते ॥
verses.rom:
asunvantam samam jahi dunasham yo na te mayah |
asmabhyamasya vedanam daddhi surishchidohate ||
verses.en:
Slay everyone who pours no gift, who, hard to reach, delights thee not.
Bestow on us what wealth he hath: this even the worshipper awaits.

verses.sa:
आवो यस्य द्विबर्हसोऽर्केषु सानुषगसत् ।
आजाविन्द्रस्येन्दो प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
avo yasya dvibarhaso'rkeshu sanushagasat |
ajavindrasyendo pravo vajeshu vajinam ||
verses.en:
Thou helpest him the doubly strong whose hymns were sung unceasingly.
When Indra fought, O Soma, thou helpest the mighty in the fray.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ ।
तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha purvebhyo jaritribhya indra maya ivapo na trishyate babhutha |
tamanu tva nividam johavimi vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
As thou, O Indra, to the ancient singers wast ever joy, like water to the thirsty,
So unto thee I sing this invocation. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
आ चर्षणिप्रा वृषभो जनानां राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः ।
स्तुतः श्रवस्यन्नवसोप मद्रिग्युक्त्वा हरी वृषणा याह्यर्वाङ् ॥
verses.rom:
a charshanipra vrishabho jananam raja krishtinam puruhuta indrah |
stutah shravasyannavasopa madrigyuktva hari vrishana yahyarvan ||
verses.en:
THE Bull of men, who cherishes all people, King of the Races, Indra, called of many,
Fame-loving, praised, hither to me with succour turn having yoked both vigorous Bay Horses!

verses.sa:
ये ते वृषणो वृषभास इन्द्र ब्रह्मयुजो वृषरथासो अत्याः ।
ताँ आ तिष्ठ तेभिरा याह्यर्वाङ्हवामहे त्वा सुत इन्द्र सोमे ॥
verses.rom:
ye te vrishano vrishabhasa indra brahmayujo vrisharathaso atyah |
tan a tishtha tebhira yahyarvanhavamahe tva suta indra some ||
verses.en:
Thy mighty Stallions, yoked by prayer, O Indra, thy. Coursers to thy mighty chariot harnessed,--
Ascend thou these, and borne by them come hither: with Soma juice out. poured, Indra, we call thee.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठ रथं वृषणं वृषा ते सुतः सोमः परिषिक्ता मधूनि ।
युक्त्वा वृषभ्यां वृषभ क्षितीनां हरिभ्यां याहि प्रवतोप मद्रिक् ॥
verses.rom:
a tishtha ratham vrishanam vrisha te sutah somah parishikta madhuni |
yuktva vrishabhyam vrishabha kshitinam haribhyam yahi pravatopa madrik ||
verses.en:
Ascend thy mighty car: the mighty Soma is poured for thee and sweets are sprinkled round us.
Come down to us-ward, Bull of human races, come, having harnessed them, with strong Bay Horses.

verses.sa:
अयं यज्ञो देवया अयं मियेध इमा ब्रह्माण्ययमिन्द्र सोमः ।
स्तीर्णं बर्हिरा तु शक्र प्र याहि पिबा निषद्य वि मुचा हरी इह ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yajno devaya ayam miyedha ima brahmanyayamindra somah |
stirnam barhira tu shakra pra yahi piba nishadya vi mucha hari iha ||
verses.en:
Here is God-reaching sacrifice, here the victim; here, Indra, are the prayers, here is the Soma.
Strewn is the sacred grass: come hither, Sakra; seat thee and drink: unyoke thy two Bay Coursers.

verses.sa:
ओ सुष्टुत इन्द्र याह्यर्वाङुप ब्रह्माणि मान्यस्य कारोः ।
विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
o sushtuta indra yahyarvanupa brahmani manyasya karoh |
vidyama vastoravasa grinanto vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Indra, come thou highly lauded to the devotions of the singer Mana.
Singing, may we find early through thy succour, may we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
यद्ध स्या त इन्द्र श्रुष्टिरस्ति यया बभूथ जरितृभ्य ऊती ।
मा नः कामं महयन्तमा धग्विश्वा ते अश्यां पर्याप आयोः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha sya ta indra shrushtirasti yaya babhutha jaritribhya uti |
ma nah kamam mahayantama dhagvishva te ashyam paryapa ayoh ||
verses.en:
IF, Indra, thou hast given that gracious hearing where with thou helpest those who sang thy praises.
Blast not the wish that would exalt us may I gain all from thee, and pay all man's devotions.

verses.sa:
न घा राजेन्द्र आ दभन्नो या नु स्वसारा कृणवन्त योनौ ।
आपश्चिदस्मै सुतुका अवेषन्गमन्न इन्द्रः सख्या वयश्च ॥
verses.rom:
na gha rajendra a dabhanno ya nu svasara krinavanta yonau |
apashchidasmai sutuka aveshangamanna indrah sakhya vayashcha ||
verses.en:
Let not the Sovran Indra disappoint us in what shall bring both Sisters to our dwelling.
To him have run the quickly flowing waters. May Indra come to us with life and friendship.

verses.sa:
जेता नृभिरिन्द्रः पृत्सु शूरः श्रोता हवं नाधमानस्य कारोः ।
प्रभर्ता रथं दाशुष उपाक उद्यन्ता गिरो यदि च त्मना भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
jeta nribhirindrah pritsu shurah shrota havam nadhamanasya karoh |
prabharta ratham dashusha upaka udyanta giro yadi cha tmana bhut ||
verses.en:
Victorious with the men, Hero in battles, Indra, who hears the singer's supplication,
Will bring his car nigh to the man who offers, if he himself upholds the songs that praise him.

verses.sa:
एवा नृभिरिन्द्रः सुश्रवस्या प्रखादः पृक्षो अभि मित्रिणो भूत् ।
समर्य इष स्तवते विवाचि सत्राकरो यजमानस्य शंसः ॥
verses.rom:
eva nribhirindrah sushravasya prakhadah priksho abhi mitrino bhut |
samarya isha stavate vivachi satrakaro yajamanasya shamsah ||
verses.en:
Yea, Indra, with the men, through love of glory consumes the sacred food which friends have offered.
The ever-strengthening song of him who worships is sung in fight amid the clash of voices.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं मघवन्निन्द्र शत्रूनभि ष्याम महतो मन्यमानान् ।
त्वं त्राता त्वमु नो वृधे भूर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam maghavannindra shatrunabhi shyama mahato manyamanan |
tvam trata tvamu no vridhe bhurvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, O Maghavan, O Indra, may we subdue our foes who count them mighty.
Be our protector, strengthen and increase us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरहं शरदः शश्रमाणा दोषा वस्तोरुषसो जरयन्तीः ।
मिनाति श्रियं जरिमा तनूनामप्यू नु पत्नीर्वृषणो जगम्युः ॥
verses.rom:
purviraham sharadah shashramana dosha vastorushaso jarayantih |
minati shriyam jarima tanunamapyu nu patnirvrishano jagamyuh ||

verses.sa:
ये चिद्धि पूर्व ऋतसाप आसन्साकं देवेभिरवदन्नृतानि ।
ते चिदवासुर्नह्यन्तमापुः समू नु पत्नीर्वृषभिर्जगम्युः ॥
verses.rom:
ye chiddhi purva ritasapa asansakam devebhiravadannritani |
te chidavasurnahyantamapuh samu nu patnirvrishabhirjagamyuh ||

verses.sa:
न मृषा श्रान्तं यदवन्ति देवा विश्वा इत्स्पृधो अभ्यश्नवाव ।
जयावेदत्र शतनीथमाजिं यत्सम्यञ्चा मिथुनावभ्यजाव ॥
verses.rom:
na mrisha shrantam yadavanti deva vishva itspridho abhyashnavava |
jayavedatra shatanithamajim yatsamyancha mithunavabhyajava ||

verses.sa:
नदस्य मा रुधतः काम आगन्नित आजातो अमुतः कुतश्चित् ।
लोपामुद्रा वृषणं नी रिणाति धीरमधीरा धयति श्वसन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
nadasya ma rudhatah kama agannita ajato amutah kutashchit |
lopamudra vrishanam ni rinati dhiramadhira dhayati shvasantam ||

verses.sa:
इमं नु सोममन्तितो हृत्सु पीतमुप ब्रुवे ।
यत्सीमागश्चकृमा तत्सु मृळतु पुलुकामो हि मर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
imam nu somamantito hritsu pitamupa bruve |
yatsimagashchakrima tatsu mrilatu pulukamo hi martyah ||

verses.sa:
अगस्त्यः खनमानः खनित्रैः प्रजामपत्यं बलमिच्छमानः ।
उभौ वर्णावृषिरुग्रः पुपोष सत्या देवेष्वाशिषो जगाम ॥
verses.rom:
agastyah khanamanah khanitraih prajamapatyam balamichchhamanah |
ubhau varnavrishirugrah puposha satya deveshvashisho jagama ||

verses.sa:
युवो रजांसि सुयमासो अश्वा रथो यद्वां पर्यर्णांसि दीयत् ।
हिरण्यया वां पवयः प्रुषायन्मध्वः पिबन्ता उषसः सचेथे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvo rajamsi suyamaso ashva ratho yadvam paryarnamsi diyat |
hiranyaya vam pavayah prushayanmadhvah pibanta ushasah sachethe ||
verses.en:
LIGHTLY your coursers travel through the regions when round the sea of air your car is flying.
Your golden fellies scatter drops of moisture: drinking the sweetness ye attend the Mornings.

verses.sa:
युवमत्यस्याव नक्षथो यद्विपत्मनो नर्यस्य प्रयज्योः ।
स्वसा यद्वां विश्वगूर्ती भराति वाजायेट्टे मधुपाविषे च ॥
verses.rom:
yuvamatyasyava nakshatho yadvipatmano naryasya prayajyoh |
svasa yadvam vishvagurti bharati vajayette madhupavishe cha ||
verses.en:
Ye as ye travel overtake the Courser who flies apart, the Friend of man, most holy.
The prayer is that the Sister may convey you, all praised, meath-drinkers! to support and strengthen.

verses.sa:
युवं पय उस्रियायामधत्तं पक्वमामायामव पूर्व्यं गोः ।
अन्तर्यद्वनिनो वामृतप्सू ह्वारो न शुचिर्यजते हविष्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam paya usriyayamadhattam pakvamamayamava purvyam goh |
antaryadvanino vamritapsu hvaro na shuchiryajate havishman ||
verses.en:
Ye have deposited, matured within her, in the raw cow the first milk of the milch-cow,
Which the bright offerer, shining like a serpent mid trees, presents to you whose form is perfect.

verses.sa:
युवं ह घर्मं मधुमन्तमत्रयेऽपो न क्षोदोऽवृणीतमेषे ।
तद्वां नरावश्विना पश्वइष्टी रथ्येव चक्रा प्रति यन्ति मध्वः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha gharmam madhumantamatraye'po na kshodo'vrinitameshe |
tadvam naravashvina pashvaishti rathyeva chakra prati yanti madhvah ||
verses.en:
Ye made the fierce heat to be full of sweetness for Atri at his wish, like streaming water.
Fire-offering thence is yours, O Asvins, Heroes: your car-wheels speed to us like springs of honey.

verses.sa:
आ वां दानाय ववृतीय दस्रा गोरोहेण तौग्र्यो न जिव्रिः ।
अपः क्षोणी सचते माहिना वां जूर्णो वामक्षुरंहसो यजत्रा ॥
verses.rom:
a vam danaya vavritiya dasra gorohena taugryo na jivrih |
apah kshoni sachate mahina vam jurno vamakshuramhaso yajatra ||
verses.en:
Like Tugra's ancient son may I, ye Mighty, bring you to give your gifts with milk-oblations.
Your greatness compasseth Earth, Heaven, and Waters: decayed for you is sorrow's net, ye Holy.

verses.sa:
नि यद्युवेथे नियुतः सुदानू उप स्वधाभिः सृजथः पुरंधिम् ।
प्रेषद्वेषद्वातो न सूरिरा महे ददे सुव्रतो न वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni yadyuvethe niyutah sudanu upa svadhabhih srijathah puramdhim |
preshadveshadvato na surira mahe dade suvrato na vajam ||
verses.en:
When, Bounteous Ones, ye drive your yoked team downward, ye send, by your own natures, understanding.
Swift as the wind let the prince please and feast you: he, like a pious man, gains strength for increase.

verses.sa:
वयं चिद्धि वां जरितारः सत्या विपन्यामहे वि पणिर्हितावान् ।
अधा चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनिन्द्या पाथो हि ष्मा वृषणावन्तिदेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam chiddhi vam jaritarah satya vipanyamahe vi panirhitavan |
adha chiddhi shmashvinavanindya patho hi shma vrishanavantidevam ||
verses.en:
For verily we truthful singers praise you the niggard trafficker is here excluded.
Now, even now do ye O blameless Asvins, ye Mighty, guard the man whose God is near him.

verses.sa:
युवां चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनु द्यून्विरुद्रस्य प्रस्रवणस्य सातौ ।
अगस्त्यो नरां नृषु प्रशस्तः काराधुनीव चितयत्सहस्रैः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam chiddhi shmashvinavanu dyunvirudrasya prasravanasya satau |
agastyo naram nrishu prashastah karadhuniva chitayatsahasraih ||
verses.en:
You of a truth day after day, O Asvins, that he might win the very plenteous torrent,
Agastya, famous among mortal heroes, roused with a thousand lauds like sounds of music.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्वहेथे महिना रथस्य प्र स्यन्द्रा याथो मनुषो न होता ।
धत्तं सूरिभ्य उत वा स्वश्व्यं नासत्या रयिषाचः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadvahethe mahina rathasya pra syandra yatho manusho na hota |
dhattam suribhya uta va svashvyam nasatya rayishachah syama ||
verses.en:
When with the glory of your car ye travel, when we go speeding like the priest of mortals,
And give good horses to sacrificers, may we, Nasatyas! gain our share of riches.

verses.sa:
तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम स्तोमैरश्विना सुविताय नव्यम् ।
अरिष्टनेमिं परि द्यामियानं विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vam ratham vayamadya huvema stomairashvina suvitaya navyam |
arishtanemim pari dyamiyanam vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
With songs of praise we call to-day, O Asvins, that your new chariot, for our own well-being,
That circles heaven with never-injured fellies. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
कदु प्रेष्ठाविषां रयीणामध्वर्यन्ता यदुन्निनीथो अपाम् ।
अयं वां यज्ञो अकृत प्रशस्तिं वसुधिती अवितारा जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kadu preshthavisham rayinamadhvaryanta yadunninitho apam |
ayam vam yajno akrita prashastim vasudhiti avitara jananam ||
verses.en:
WHAT, dearest Pair, is this in strength and riches that ye as Priests are bring from the waters?
This sacrifice is your glorification, ye who protect mankind and give them treasures.

verses.sa:
आ वामश्वासः शुचयः पयस्पा वातरंहसो दिव्यासो अत्याः ।
मनोजुवो वृषणो वीतपृष्ठा एह स्वराजो अश्विना वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a vamashvasah shuchayah payaspa vataramhaso divyaso atyah |
manojuvo vrishano vitaprishtha eha svarajo ashvina vahantu ||
verses.en:
May your pure steeds, rain-drinkers, bring you hither, swift as the tempest, your celestial coursers,
Rapid as thought, with fair backs, full of vigour, resplendent in their native light, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथोऽवनिर्न प्रवत्वान्सृप्रवन्धुरः सुविताय गम्याः ।
वृष्ण स्थातारा मनसो जवीयानहम्पूर्वो यजतो धिष्ण्या यः ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratho'vanirna pravatvansripravandhurah suvitaya gamyah |
vrishna sthatara manaso javiyanahampurvo yajato dhishnya yah ||
verses.en:
Your car is like a torrent rushing downward: may it come nigh, broad-seated, for our welfare,--
Car holy, strong, that ever would be foremost, thought-swift, which ye, for whom we long, have mounted.

verses.sa:
इहेह जाता समवावशीतामरेपसा तन्वा नामभिः स्वैः ।
जिष्णुर्वामन्यः सुमखस्य सूरिर्दिवो अन्यः सुभगः पुत्र ऊहे ॥
verses.rom:
iheha jata samavavashitamarepasa tanva namabhih svaih |
jishnurvamanyah sumakhasya surirdivo anyah subhagah putra uhe ||
verses.en:
Here sprung to life, they both have sung together, with bodies free from stain, with signs that mark them;
One of you Prince of Sacrifice, the Victor, the other counts as Heaven's auspicious offspring.

verses.sa:
प्र वां निचेरुः ककुहो वशाँ अनु पिशङ्गरूपः सदनानि गम्याः ।
हरी अन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्मथ्रा रजांस्यश्विना वि घोषैः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam nicheruh kakuho vashan anu pishangarupah sadanani gamyah |
hari anyasya pipayanta vajairmathra rajamsyashvina vi ghoshaih ||
verses.en:
May your car-seat, down-gliding, golden-coloured, according to your wish approach our dwellings.
Men shall feed full the bay steeds of the other, and, Asvins they with roars shall stir the regions.

verses.sa:
प्र वां शरद्वान्वृषभो न निष्षाट् पूर्वीरिषश्चरति मध्व इष्णन् ।
एवैरन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्वेषन्तीरूर्ध्वा नद्यो न आगुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam sharadvanvrishabho na nishshat purvirishashcharati madhva ishnan |
evairanyasya pipayanta vajairveshantirurdhva nadyo na aguh ||
verses.en:
Forth comes your strong Bull like a cloud of autumn, sending abundant food of liquid sweetness.
Let them feed with the other's ways and vigour: the upper streams have come and do us service.

verses.sa:
असर्जि वां स्थविरा वेधसा गीर्बाळ्हे अश्विना त्रेधा क्षरन्ती ।
उपस्तुताववतं नाधमानं यामन्नयामञ्छृणुतं हवं मे ॥
verses.rom:
asarji vam sthavira vedhasa girbalhe ashvina tredha ksharanti |
upastutavavatam nadhamanam yamannayamanchhrinutam havam me ||
verses.en:
Your constant song hath been sent forth, Disposers! that flows threefold in mighty strength, O Asvins.
Thus lauded, give the suppliant protection moving or resting hear mine invocation.

verses.sa:
उत स्या वां रुशतो वप्ससो गीस्त्रिबर्हिषि सदसि पिन्वते नॄन् ।
वृषा वां मेघो वृषणा पीपाय गोर्न सेके मनुषो दशस्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya vam rushato vapsaso gistribarhishi sadasi pinvate nrin |
vrisha vam megho vrishana pipaya gorna seke manusho dashasyan ||
verses.en:
This song of bright contents for you is swelling in the men's hall where three-fold grass is ready.
Your strong rain-cloud, ye Mighty Ones, hath swollen, honouring men as 'twere with milk's outpouring.

verses.sa:
युवां पूषेवाश्विना पुरंधिरग्निमुषां न जरते हविष्मान् ।
हुवे यद्वां वरिवस्या गृणानो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam pushevashvina puramdhiragnimusham na jarate havishman |
huve yadvam varivasya grinano vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
The prudent worshipper, like Pusan, Asvins! praises you as he praises Dawn and Agni,
When, singing with devotion, he invokes you. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
अभूदिदं वयुनमो षु भूषता रथो वृषण्वान्मदता मनीषिणः ।
धियंजिन्वा धिष्ण्या विश्पलावसू दिवो नपाता सुकृते शुचिव्रता ॥
verses.rom:
abhudidam vayunamo shu bhushata ratho vrishanvanmadata manishinah |
dhiyamjinva dhishnya vishpalavasu divo napata sukrite shuchivrata ||
verses.en:
THIS was the task. Appear promptly, ye prudent Ones. Here is the chariot drawn by strong steeds: be ye glad.
Heart-stirring, longed for, succourers of Vispala, here are Heaven's Sons whose sway blesses the pious man.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रतमा हि धिष्ण्या मरुत्तमा दस्रा दंसिष्ठा रथ्या रथीतमा ।
पूर्णं रथं वहेथे मध्व आचितं तेन दाश्वांसमुप याथो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
indratama hi dhishnya maruttama dasra damsishtha rathya rathitama |
purnam ratham vahethe madhva achitam tena dashvamsamupa yatho ashvina ||
verses.en:
Longed for, most Indra-like, mighty, most Marut-like, most wonderful in deed, car-borne, best charioteers,
Bring your full chariot hither heaped with liquid sweet: thereon, ye Asvins, come to him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
किमत्र दस्रा कृणुथः किमासाथे जनो यः कश्चिदहविर्महीयते ।
अति क्रमिष्टं जुरतं पणेरसुं ज्योतिर्विप्राय कृणुतं वचस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
kimatra dasra krinuthah kimasathe jano yah kashchidahavirmahiyate |
ati kramishtam juratam panerasum jyotirvipraya krinutam vachasyave ||
verses.en:
What make ye there, ye Mighty? Wherefore linger ye with folk who, offering not, are held in high esteem?
Pass over them; make ye the niggard's life decay: give light unto the singer eloquent in praise.

verses.sa:
जम्भयतमभितो रायतः शुनो हतं मृधो विदथुस्तान्यश्विना ।
वाचंवाचं जरितू रत्निनीं कृतमुभा शंसं नासत्यावतं मम ॥
verses.rom:
jambhayatamabhito rayatah shuno hatam mridho vidathustanyashvina |
vachamvacham jaritu ratninim kritamubha shamsam nasatyavatam mama ||
verses.en:
Crunch up on. every side the dogs who bark at us: slay ye our foes, O Asvins this ye understand.
Make wealthy every word of him who praises you: accept with favour, both Nasatyas, this my laud.

verses.sa:
युवमेतं चक्रथुः सिन्धुषु प्लवमात्मन्वन्तं पक्षिणं तौग्र्याय कम् ।
येन देवत्रा मनसा निरूहथुः सुपप्तनी पेतथुः क्षोदसो महः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvametam chakrathuh sindhushu plavamatmanvantam pakshinam taugryaya kam |
yena devatra manasa niruhathuh supaptani petathuh kshodaso mahah ||
verses.en:
Ye made for Tugra's son amid the water-floods that animated ship with wings to fly withal,
Whereon with God-devoted mind ye brought him forth, and fled with easy flight from out the mighty surge.

verses.sa:
अवविद्धं तौग्र्यमप्स्वन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्रविद्धम् ।
चतस्रो नावो जठलस्य जुष्टा उदश्विभ्यामिषिताः पारयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
avaviddham taugryamapsvantaranarambhane tamasi praviddham |
chatasro navo jathalasya jushta udashvibhyamishitah parayanti ||
verses.en:
Four ships most welcome in the midst of ocean, urged by the Asvins, save the son of Tugra,
Him who was cast down headlong in the waters, plunged in the thick inevitable darkness.

verses.sa:
कः स्विद्वृक्षो निष्ठितो मध्ये अर्णसो यं तौग्र्यो नाधितः पर्यषस्वजत् ।
पर्णा मृगस्य पतरोरिवारभ उदश्विना ऊहथुः श्रोमताय कम् ॥
verses.rom:
kah svidvriksho nishthito madhye arnaso yam taugryo nadhitah paryashasvajat |
parna mrigasya patarorivarabha udashvina uhathuh shromataya kam ||
verses.en:
What tree was that which stood fixed in surrounding sea to which the son of Tugra supplicating clung?
Like twigs, of which some winged creature may take hold, ye, Asvins, bore him off safely to your renown.

verses.sa:
तद्वां नरा नासत्यावनु ष्याद्यद्वां मानास उचथमवोचन् ।
अस्मादद्य सदसः सोम्यादा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvam nara nasatyavanu shyadyadvam manasa uchathamavochan |
asmadadya sadasah somyada vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Welcome to you be this the hymn of praises uttered by Manas, O Nasatyas, Heroes,
From this our gathering where we offer Soma. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
तं युञ्जाथां मनसो यो जवीयान्त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा यस्त्रिचक्रः ।
येनोपयाथः सुकृतो दुरोणं त्रिधातुना पतथो विर्न पर्णैः ॥
verses.rom:
tam yunjatham manaso yo javiyantrivandhuro vrishana yastrichakrah |
yenopayathah sukrito duronam tridhatuna patatho virna parnaih ||
verses.en:
MAKE ready that which passes thought in swiftness, that hath three wheels and triple seat, ye Mighty,
Whereon ye seek the dwelling of the pious, whereon, threefold, ye fly like birds with pinions.

verses.sa:
सुवृद्रथो वर्तते यन्नभि क्षां यत्तिष्ठथः क्रतुमन्तानु पृक्षे ।
वपुर्वपुष्या सचतामियं गीर्दिवो दुहित्रोषसा सचेथे ॥
verses.rom:
suvridratho vartate yannabhi ksham yattishthathah kratumantanu prikshe |
vapurvapushya sachatamiyam girdivo duhitroshasa sachethe ||
verses.en:
Light rolls your easy chariot faring earthward, what time, for food, ye, full of wisdom, mount it.
May this song, wondrous fair, attend your glory: ye, as ye travel, wait on Dawn Heaven's Daughter.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठतं सुवृतं यो रथो वामनु व्रतानि वर्तते हविष्मान् ।
येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च ॥
verses.rom:
a tishthatam suvritam yo ratho vamanu vratani vartate havishman |
yena nara nasatyeshayadhyai vartiryathastanayaya tmane cha ||
verses.en:
Ascend your lightly rolling car, approaching the worshipper who turns him to his duties,--
Whereon ye come unto the house to quicken man and his offspring, O Nasatyas, Heroes.

verses.sa:
मा वां वृको मा वृकीरा दधर्षीन्मा परि वर्क्तमुत माति धक्तम् ।
अयं वां भागो निहित इयं गीर्दस्राविमे वां निधयो मधूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma vam vriko ma vrikira dadharshinma pari varktamuta mati dhaktam |
ayam vam bhago nihita iyam girdasravime vam nidhayo madhunam ||
verses.en:
Let not the wolf, let not the she-wolf harm you. Forsake me not, nor pass me by or others.
Here stands your share, here is your hymn, ye Mighty: yours are these vessels, full of pleasant juices.

verses.sa:
युवां गोतमः पुरुमीळ्हो अत्रिर्दस्रा हवतेऽवसे हविष्मान् ।
दिशं न दिष्टामृजूयेव यन्ता मे हवं नासत्योप यातम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam gotamah purumilho atrirdasra havate'vase havishman |
disham na dishtamrijuyeva yanta me havam nasatyopa yatam ||
verses.en:
Gotama, Purumilha, Atri bringing oblations all invoke you for protection.
Like one who goes straight to the point directed, ye Nasatyas, to mine invocation.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि ।
एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
atarishma tamasasparamasya prati vam stomo ashvinavadhayi |
eha yatam pathibhirdevayanairvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
We have passed o'er the limit of this darkness: our praise hath been bestowed on you, O Asvins.
Come hitherward by paths which Gods have travelled. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
ता वामद्य तावपरं हुवेमोच्छन्त्यामुषसि वह्निरुक्थैः ।
नासत्या कुह चित्सन्तावर्यो दिवो नपाता सुदास्तराय ॥
verses.rom:
ta vamadya tavaparam huvemochchhantyamushasi vahnirukthaih |
nasatya kuha chitsantavaryo divo napata sudastaraya ||
verses.en:
LET us invoke you both this day and after the priest is here with lauds when morn is breaking:
Nasatyas, wheresoe'er ye be, Heaven's Children, for him who is more liberal than the godless.

verses.sa:
अस्मे ऊ षु वृषणा मादयेथामुत्पणीँर्हतमूर्म्या मदन्ता ।
श्रुतं मे अच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनामेष्टा नरा निचेतारा च कर्णैः ॥
verses.rom:
asme u shu vrishana madayethamutpaninrhatamurmya madanta |
shrutam me achchhoktibhirmatinameshta nara nichetara cha karnaih ||
verses.en:
With us, ye Mighty, let yourselves be joyful, glad in our stream of Soma slay the niggards.
Graciously hear my hymns and invitations, marking, O Heroes, with your cars my longing.

verses.sa:
श्रिये पूषन्निषुकृतेव देवा नासत्या वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
वच्यन्ते वां ककुहा अप्सु जाता युगा जूर्णेव वरुणस्य भूरेः ॥
verses.rom:
shriye pushannishukriteva deva nasatya vahatum suryayah |
vachyante vam kakuha apsu jata yuga jurneva varunasya bhureh ||
verses.en:
Nasatyas, Pusans, ye as Gods for glory arranged and set in order Surya's bridal.
Your giant steeds move on, sprung from the waters, like ancient times of Varuna the Mighty.

verses.sa:
अस्मे सा वां माध्वी रातिरस्तु स्तोमं हिनोतं मान्यस्य कारोः ।
अनु यद्वां श्रवस्या सुदानू सुवीर्याय चर्षणयो मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
asme sa vam madhvi ratirastu stomam hinotam manyasya karoh |
anu yadvam shravasya sudanu suviryaya charshanayo madanti ||
verses.en:
Your grace be with us, ye who love sweet juices: further the hymn sung by the poet Mana,
When men are joyful in your glorious actions, to win heroic strength, ye Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
एष वां स्तोमो अश्विनावकारि मानेभिर्मघवाना सुवृक्ति ।
यातं वर्तिस्तनयाय त्मने चागस्त्ये नासत्या मदन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
esha vam stomo ashvinavakari manebhirmaghavana suvrikti |
yatam vartistanayaya tmane chagastye nasatya madanta ||
verses.en:
This praise was made, O liberal Lords, O Asvins, for you with fair adornment by the Manas.
Come to our house for us and for our children, rejoicing, O Nasatyas, in Agastya.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि ।
एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
atarishma tamasasparamasya prati vam stomo ashvinavadhayi |
eha yatam pathibhirdevayanairvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
We have passed o'er the limit of this darkness: our praise hath been bestowed on you, O Asvins.
Come hitherward by paths which Gods have travelled. may we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
कतरा पूर्वा कतरापरायोः कथा जाते कवयः को वि वेद ।
विश्वं त्मना बिभृतो यद्ध नाम वि वर्तेते अहनी चक्रियेव ॥
verses.rom:
katara purva kataraparayoh katha jate kavayah ko vi veda |
vishvam tmana bibhrito yaddha nama vi vartete ahani chakriyeva ||
verses.en:
WHETHER of these is elder, whether later? How were they born? Who knoweth it, ye sages?
These of themselves support all things existing: as on a car the Day and Night roll onward.

verses.sa:
भूरिं द्वे अचरन्ती चरन्तं पद्वन्तं गर्भमपदी दधाते ।
नित्यं न सूनुं पित्रोरुपस्थे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
bhurim dve acharanti charantam padvantam garbhamapadi dadhate |
nityam na sunum pitrorupasthe dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
The Twain uphold, though motionless and footless, a widespread offspring having feet and moving.
Like your own son upon his parents' bosom, protect us, Heaven and earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
अनेहो दात्रमदितेरनर्वं हुवे स्वर्वदवधं नमस्वत् ।
तद्रोदसी जनयतं जरित्रे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
aneho datramaditeranarvam huve svarvadavadham namasvat |
tadrodasi janayatam jaritre dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
I call for Aditi's unrivalled bounty, perfect, celestial, deathless, meet for worship.
Produce this, ye Twain Worlds, for him who lauds you. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
अतप्यमाने अवसावन्ती अनु ष्याम रोदसी देवपुत्रे ।
उभे देवानामुभयेभिरह्नां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
atapyamane avasavanti anu shyama rodasi devaputre |
ubhe devanamubhayebhirahnam dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
May we be close to both the Worlds who suffer no pain, Parents of Gods, who aid with favour,
Both mid the Gods, with Day and Night alternate. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
संगच्छमाने युवती समन्ते स्वसारा जामी पित्रोरुपस्थे ।
अभिजिघ्रन्ती भुवनस्य नाभिं द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
samgachchhamane yuvati samante svasara jami pitrorupasthe |
abhijighranti bhuvanasya nabhim dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
Faring together, young, with meeting limits, Twin Sisters lying in their Parents' bosom,
Kissing the centre of the world together. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उर्वी सद्मनी बृहती ऋतेन हुवे देवानामवसा जनित्री ।
दधाते ये अमृतं सुप्रतीके द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
urvi sadmani brihati ritena huve devanamavasa janitri |
dadhate ye amritam supratike dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
Duly I call the two wide seats, the mighty, the general Parents, with the God's protection.
Who, beautiful to look on, make the nectar. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उर्वी पृथ्वी बहुले दूरेअन्ते उप ब्रुवे नमसा यज्ञे अस्मिन् ।
दधाते ये सुभगे सुप्रतूर्ती द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
urvi prithvi bahule dureante upa bruve namasa yajne asmin |
dadhate ye subhage supraturti dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
Wide, vast, and manifold, whose bounds are distant,--these, reverent, I address at this our worship,
The blessed Pair, victorious, all-sustaining. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
देवान्वा यच्चकृमा कच्चिदागः सखायं वा सदमिज्जास्पतिं वा ।
इयं धीर्भूया अवयानमेषां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
verses.rom:
devanva yachchakrima kachchidagah sakhayam va sadamijjaspatim va |
iyam dhirbhuya avayanamesham dyava rakshatam prithivi no abhvat ||
verses.en:
What sin we have at any time committed against the Gods, our friend, our house's chieftain,
Thereof may this our hymn be expiation. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उभा शंसा नर्या मामविष्टामुभे मामूती अवसा सचेताम् ।
भूरि चिदर्यः सुदास्तरायेषा मदन्त इषयेम देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
ubha shamsa narya mamavishtamubhe mamuti avasa sachetam |
bhuri chidaryah sudastarayesha madanta ishayema devah ||
verses.en:
May both these Friends of man, who bless, preserve me, may they attend me with their help and favour.
Enrich the man more liberal than the godless. May we, ye Gods, be strong with food rejoicing.

verses.sa:
ऋतं दिवे तदवोचं पृथिव्या अभिश्रावाय प्रथमं सुमेधाः ।
पातामवद्याद्दुरितादभीके पिता माता च रक्षतामवोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ritam dive tadavocham prithivya abhishravaya prathamam sumedhah |
patamavadyadduritadabhike pita mata cha rakshatamavobhih ||
verses.en:
Endowed with understanding, I have uttered this truth, for all to hear, to Earth and Heaven.
Be near us, keep us from reproach and trouble. Father and Mother, with your help preserve us.

verses.sa:
इदं द्यावापृथिवी सत्यमस्तु पितर्मातर्यदिहोपब्रुवे वाम् ।
भूतं देवानामवमे अवोभिर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam dyavaprithivi satyamastu pitarmataryadihopabruve vam |
bhutam devanamavame avobhirvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
Be this my prayer fulfilled, O Earth and Heaven, wherewith, Father and Mother, I address you.
Nearest of Gods be ye with your protection. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
आ न इळाभिर्विदथे सुशस्ति विश्वानरः सविता देव एतु ।
अपि यथा युवानो मत्सथा नो विश्वं जगदभिपित्वे मनीषा ॥
verses.rom:
a na ilabhirvidathe sushasti vishvanarah savita deva etu |
api yatha yuvano matsatha no vishvam jagadabhipitve manisha ||
verses.en:
LOVED of all men, may Savitar, through praises offered as sacred food, come to our synod,
That you too, through-our hymn, ye ever-youthful, may gladden, at your visit, all our people.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्व आस्क्रा गमन्तु देवा मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः ।
भुवन्यथा नो विश्वे वृधासः करन्सुषाहा विथुरं न शवः ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishva askra gamantu deva mitro aryama varunah sajoshah |
bhuvanyatha no vishve vridhasah karansushaha vithuram na shavah ||
verses.en:
To us may all the Gods come trooped together, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna concordant,
That all may be promoters of our welfare, and with great might preserve our strength from slackness.

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं गृणीषेऽग्निं शस्तिभिस्तुर्वणिः सजोषाः ।
असद्यथा नो वरुणः सुकीर्तिरिषश्च पर्षदरिगूर्तः सूरिः ॥
verses.rom:
preshtham vo atithim grinishe'gnim shastibhisturvanih sajoshah |
asadyatha no varunah sukirtirishashcha parshadarigurtah surih ||
verses.en:
Agni I sing, the guest you love most dearly: the Conqueror through our lauds is friendly-minded.
That he may be our Varuna rich in glory and send food like a prince praised by the godly.

verses.sa:
उप व एषे नमसा जिगीषोषासानक्ता सुदुघेव धेनुः ।
समाने अहन्विमिमानो अर्कं विषुरूपे पयसि सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
verses.rom:
upa va eshe namasa jigishoshasanakta sudugheva dhenuh |
samane ahanvimimano arkam vishurupe payasi sasminnudhan ||
verses.en:
To you I seek with reverence, Night and Morning, like a cow good to milk, with hope to conquer,
Preparing on a common day the praise. song with milk of various hues within this udder.

verses.sa:
उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो मयस्कः शिशुं न पिप्युषीव वेति सिन्धुः ।
येन नपातमपां जुनाम मनोजुवो वृषणो यं वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
uta no'hirbudhnyo mayaskah shishum na pipyushiva veti sindhuh |
yena napatamapam junama manojuvo vrishano yam vahanti ||
verses.en:
May the great Dragon of the Deep rejoice us: as one who nourishes her young comes Sindhu,
With whom we will incite the Child of Waters whom vigorous course swift as thought bring hither.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं त्वष्टा गन्त्वच्छा स्मत्सूरिभिरभिपित्वे सजोषाः ।
आ वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणिप्रास्तुविष्टमो नरां न इह गम्याः ॥
verses.rom:
uta na im tvashta gantvachchha smatsuribhirabhipitve sajoshah |
a vritrahendrashcharshaniprastuvishtamo naram na iha gamyah ||
verses.en:
Moreover Tvastar also shall approach us, one-minded with the princes at his visit.
Hither shall come the Vrtra-slayer Indra, Ruler of men, as strongest of the Heroes.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं मतयोऽश्वयोगाः शिशुं न गावस्तरुणं रिहन्ति ।
तमीं गिरो जनयो न पत्नीः सुरभिष्टमं नरां नसन्त ॥
verses.rom:
uta na im matayo'shvayogah shishum na gavastarunam rihanti |
tamim giro janayo na patnih surabhishtamam naram nasanta ||
verses.en:
Him too our hymns delight, that yoke swift horses, like mother cows who lick their tender youngling.
To him our songs shall yield themselves like spouses, to him the most delightful of the Heroes.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं मरुतो वृद्धसेनाः स्मद्रोदसी समनसः सदन्तु ।
पृषदश्वासोऽवनयो न रथा रिशादसो मित्रयुजो न देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
uta na im maruto vriddhasenah smadrodasi samanasah sadantu |
prishadashvaso'vanayo na ratha rishadaso mitrayujo na devah ||
verses.en:
So may the Maruts, armed with mighty weapons, rest here on heaven and earth with hearts in concord,
As Gods whose cars have dappled steeds like torrents, destroyers of the foe allies of Mitra.

verses.sa:
प्र नु यदेषां महिना चिकित्रे प्र युञ्जते प्रयुजस्ते सुवृक्ति ।
अध यदेषां सुदिने न शरुर्विश्वमेरिणं प्रुषायन्त सेनाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra nu yadesham mahina chikitre pra yunjate prayujaste suvrikti |
adha yadesham sudine na sharurvishvamerinam prushayanta senah ||
verses.en:
They hasten on to happy termination their orders when they are made known by glory.
As on a fair bright day the arrow flieth o'er all the barren soil their missiles sparkle.

verses.sa:
प्रो अश्विनाववसे कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं स्वतवसो हि सन्ति ।
अद्वेषो विष्णुर्वात ऋभुक्षा अच्छा सुम्नाय ववृतीय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
pro ashvinavavase krinudhvam pra pushanam svatavaso hi santi |
advesho vishnurvata ribhuksha achchha sumnaya vavritiya devan ||
verses.en:
Incline the Asvins to show grace, and Pusan, for power and might have they, their own possession.
Friendly are Visnu, Vata, and Rbhuksan so may I bring the Gods to make us happy.

verses.sa:
इयं सा वो अस्मे दीधितिर्यजत्रा अपिप्राणी च सदनी च भूयाः ।
नि या देवेषु यतते वसूयुर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam sa vo asme didhitiryajatra apiprani cha sadani cha bhuyah |
ni ya deveshu yatate vasuyurvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
This is my reverent thought of you, ye Holy; may it inspire you, make you dwell among us,--
Thought, toiling for the Gods and seeking treasure. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम् ।
यस्य त्रितो व्योजसा वृत्रं विपर्वमर्दयत् ॥
verses.rom:
pitum nu stosham maho dharmanam tavishim |
yasya trito vyojasa vritram viparvamardayat ||
verses.en:
Now will I glorify Food that upholds great strength,
By whose invigorating power Trita rent Vrtra limb from limb.

verses.sa:
स्वादो पितो मधो पितो वयं त्वा ववृमहे ।
अस्माकमविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
svado pito madho pito vayam tva vavrimahe |
asmakamavita bhava ||
verses.en:
O pleasant Food, O Food of meath, thee have we chosen for our own,
So be our kind protector thou.

verses.sa:
उप नः पितवा चर शिवः शिवाभिरूतिभिः ।
मयोभुरद्विषेण्यः सखा सुशेवो अद्वयाः ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah pitava chara shivah shivabhirutibhih |
mayobhuradvishenyah sakha sushevo advayah ||
verses.en:
Come hitherward to us, O Food, auspicious with auspicious help,
Health-bringing, not unkind, a dear and guileless friend.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये पितो रसा रजांस्यनु विष्ठिताः ।
दिवि वाता इव श्रिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye pito rasa rajamsyanu vishthitah |
divi vata iva shritah ||
verses.en:
These juices which, O Food, are thine throughout the regions are diffused.
like winds they have their place in heaven.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये पितो ददतस्तव स्वादिष्ठ ते पितो ।
प्र स्वाद्मानो रसानां तुविग्रीवा इवेरते ॥
