verses.rom:
tava tye pito dadatastava svadishtha te pito |
pra svadmano rasanam tuvigriva iverate ||
verses.en:
These gifts of thine, O Food, O Food most sweet to taste,
These savours of thy juices work like creatures that have mighty necks.

verses.sa:
त्वे पितो महानां देवानां मनो हितम् ।
अकारि चारु केतुना तवाहिमवसावधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
tve pito mahanam devanam mano hitam |
akari charu ketuna tavahimavasavadhit ||
verses.en:
In thee, O Food, is set the spirit of great Gods.
Under thy flag brave deeds were done he slew the Dragon with thy help.

verses.sa:
यददो पितो अजगन्विवस्व पर्वतानाम् ।
अत्रा चिन्नो मधो पितोऽरं भक्षाय गम्याः ॥
verses.rom:
yadado pito ajaganvivasva parvatanam |
atra chinno madho pito'ram bhakshaya gamyah ||
verses.en:
If thou be gone unto the splendour of the clouds,
Even from thence, O Food of meath, prepared for our enjoyment, come.

verses.sa:
यदपामोषधीनां परिंशमारिशामहे ।
वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
verses.rom:
yadapamoshadhinam parimshamarishamahe |
vatape piva idbhava ||
verses.en:
Whatever morsel we consume from waters or from plants of earth,
O Soma, wax thou fat thereby.

verses.sa:
यत्ते सोम गवाशिरो यवाशिरो भजामहे ।
वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
verses.rom:
yatte soma gavashiro yavashiro bhajamahe |
vatape piva idbhava ||
verses.en:
What Soma, we enjoy from thee in milky food or barley-brew,
Vatapi, grow thou fat thereby.

verses.sa:
करम्भ ओषधे भव पीवो वृक्क उदारथिः ।
वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
verses.rom:
karambha oshadhe bhava pivo vrikka udarathih |
vatape piva idbhava ||
verses.en:
O Vegetable, Cake of meal, he wholesome, firm, and strengthening:
Vatapi, grow thou fat thereby.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं पितो वचोभिर्गावो न हव्या सुषूदिम ।
देवेभ्यस्त्वा सधमादमस्मभ्यं त्वा सधमादम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vayam pito vachobhirgavo na havya sushudima |
devebhyastva sadhamadamasmabhyam tva sadhamadam ||
verses.en:
O Food, from thee as such have we drawn forth with lauds, like cows, our sacrificial gifts,
From thee who banquetest with Gods, from thee who banquetest with us.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अद्य राजसि देवो देवैः सहस्रजित् ।
दूतो हव्या कविर्वह ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho adya rajasi devo devaih sahasrajit |
duto havya kavirvaha ||
verses.en:
WINNER of thousands, kindled, thou shinest a God with Gods to-day.
Bear out oblations, envoy, Sage.

verses.sa:
तनूनपादृतं यते मध्वा यज्ञः समज्यते ।
दधत्सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
tanunapadritam yate madhva yajnah samajyate |
dadhatsahasrinirishah ||
verses.en:
Child of Thyself the sacrifice is for the righteous blent with meath,
Presenting viands thousandfold.

verses.sa:
आजुह्वानो न ईड्यो देवाँ आ वक्षि यज्ञियान् ।
अग्ने सहस्रसा असि ॥
verses.rom:
ajuhvano na idyo devan a vakshi yajniyan |
agne sahasrasa asi ||
verses.en:
Invoked and worthy of our praise bring Gods whose due is sacrifice:
Thou, Agni, givest countless gifts.

verses.sa:
प्राचीनं बर्हिरोजसा सहस्रवीरमस्तृणन् ।
यत्रादित्या विराजथ ॥
verses.rom:
prachinam barhirojasa sahasraviramastrinan |
yatraditya virajatha ||
verses.en:
To seat a thousand Heroes they eastward have strewn the grass with might,
Whereon, Adityas, ye shine forth.

verses.sa:
विराट् सम्राड्विभ्वीः प्रभ्वीर्बह्वीश्च भूयसीश्च याः ।
दुरो घृतान्यक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
virat samradvibhvih prabhvirbahvishcha bhuyasishcha yah |
duro ghritanyaksharan ||
verses.en:
The sovran all-imperial Doors, wide, good, many and manifold,
Have poured their streams of holy oil.

verses.sa:
सुरुक्मे हि सुपेशसाधि श्रिया विराजतः ।
उषासावेह सीदताम् ॥
verses.rom:
surukme hi supeshasadhi shriya virajatah |
ushasaveha sidatam ||
verses.en:
With gay adornment, fair to see, in glorious beauty shine they forth:
Let Night and Morning rest them here.

verses.sa:
प्रथमा हि सुवाचसा होतारा दैव्या कवी ।
यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम् ॥
verses.rom:
prathama hi suvachasa hotara daivya kavi |
yajnam no yakshatamimam ||
verses.en:
Let these two Sages first of all, heralds divine and eloquent,
Perform for us this sacrifice.

verses.sa:
भारतीळे सरस्वति या वः सर्वा उपब्रुवे ।
ता नश्चोदयत श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
bharatile sarasvati ya vah sarva upabruve |
ta nashchodayata shriye ||
verses.en:
You I address, Sarasvati, and Bharati, and Ila, all:
Urge ye us on to glorious fame.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा रूपाणि हि प्रभुः पशून्विश्वान्समानजे ।
तेषां न स्फातिमा यज ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta rupani hi prabhuh pashunvishvansamanaje |
tesham na sphatima yaja ||
verses.en:
Tvastar the Lord hath made all forms and all the cattle of the field
Cause them to multiply for us.

verses.sa:
उप त्मन्या वनस्पते पाथो देवेभ्यः सृज ।
अग्निर्हव्यानि सिष्वदत् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tmanya vanaspate patho devebhyah srija |
agnirhavyani sishvadat ||
verses.en:
Send to the Gods, Vanaspati, thyself, the sacrificial draught:
Let Agni make the oblations sweet.

verses.sa:
पुरोगा अग्निर्देवानां गायत्रेण समज्यते ।
स्वाहाकृतीषु रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
puroga agnirdevanam gayatrena samajyate |
svahakritishu rochate ||
verses.en:
Agni, preceder of the Gods, is honoured with the sacred song:
He glows at offerings blest with Hail!

verses.sa:
अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमउक्तिं विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
agne naya supatha raye asmanvishvani deva vayunani vidvan |
yuyodhyasmajjuhuranameno bhuyishtham te namauktim vidhema ||
verses.en:
BY goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, God who knowest every sacred duty.
Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander. most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वं पारया नव्यो अस्मान्स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा ।
पूश्च पृथ्वी बहुला न उर्वी भवा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
agne tvam paraya navyo asmansvastibhirati durgani vishva |
pushcha prithvi bahula na urvi bhava tokaya tanayaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
Lead us anew to happiness, O Agni; lead us beyond all danger and affliction.
Be unto us a wide broad ample castle bless, prosper on their way our sons and offspring.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वमस्मद्युयोध्यमीवा अनग्नित्रा अभ्यमन्त कृष्टीः ।
पुनरस्मभ्यं सुविताय देव क्षां विश्वेभिरमृतेभिर्यजत्र ॥
verses.rom:
agne tvamasmadyuyodhyamiva anagnitra abhyamanta krishtih |
punarasmabhyam suvitaya deva ksham vishvebhiramritebhiryajatra ||
verses.en:
Far from us, Agni, put thou all diseases let them strike lauds that have no saving Agni.
God, make our home again to be a blessing, with all the Immortal Deities, O Holy.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्ने पायुभिरजस्रैरुत प्रिये सदन आ शुशुक्वान् ।
मा ते भयं जरितारं यविष्ठ नूनं विदन्मापरं सहस्वः ॥
verses.rom:
pahi no agne payubhirajasrairuta priye sadana a shushukvan |
ma te bhayam jaritaram yavishtha nunam vidanmaparam sahasvah ||
verses.en:
Preserve us, Agni, with perpetual succour, refulgent in the dwelling which thou lovest.
O Conqueror, most youthful, let no danger touch him who praises thee to-day or after.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्नेऽव सृजो अघायाविष्यवे रिपवे दुच्छुनायै ।
मा दत्वते दशते मादते नो मा रीषते सहसावन्परा दाः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne'va srijo aghayavishyave ripave duchchhunayai |
ma datvate dashate madate no ma rishate sahasavanpara dah ||
verses.en:
Give not us up a prey to sin, O Agni, the greedy enemy that brings us trouble;
Not to the fanged that bites, not to the toothless: give not us up, thou Conqueror, to the spoiler.

verses.sa:
वि घ त्वावाँ ऋतजात यंसद्गृणानो अग्ने तन्वे वरूथम् ।
विश्वाद्रिरिक्षोरुत वा निनित्सोरभिह्रुतामसि हि देव विष्पट् ॥
verses.rom:
vi gha tvavan ritajata yamsadgrinano agne tanve varutham |
vishvadririkshoruta va ninitsorabhihrutamasi hi deva vishpat ||
verses.en:
Such as thou art, born after Law, O Agni when lauded give protection to our bodies,
From whosoever would reproach or injure: for thou, God, rescuest from all oppression.

verses.sa:
त्वं ताँ अग्न उभयान्वि विद्वान्वेषि प्रपित्वे मनुषो यजत्र ।
अभिपित्वे मनवे शास्यो भूर्मर्मृजेन्य उशिग्भिर्नाक्रः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tan agna ubhayanvi vidvanveshi prapitve manusho yajatra |
abhipitve manave shasyo bhurmarmrijenya ushigbhirnakrah ||
verses.en:
Thou, well discerning both these classes, comest to men at early morn, O holy Agni.
Be thou obedient unto man at evening, to be adorned, as keen, by eager suitors.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम निवचनान्यस्मिन्मानस्य सूनुः सहसाने अग्नौ ।
वयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सनेम विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
avochama nivachananyasminmanasya sunuh sahasane agnau |
vayam sahasramrishibhih sanema vidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
To him have we addressed our pious speeches, I, Mana's son, to him victorious Agni.
May we gain countless riches with the sages. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
अनर्वाणं वृषभं मन्द्रजिह्वं बृहस्पतिं वर्धया नव्यमर्कैः ।
गाथान्यः सुरुचो यस्य देवा आशृण्वन्ति नवमानस्य मर्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
anarvanam vrishabham mandrajihvam brihaspatim vardhaya navyamarkaih |
gathanyah surucho yasya deva ashrinvanti navamanasya martah ||
verses.en:
GLORIFY thou Brhaspati, the scatheless, who must be praised with hymns, sweet-tongued and mighty,
To whom as leader of the song, resplendent, worthy of lauds, both Gods and mortals listen.

verses.sa:
तमृत्विया उप वाचः सचन्ते सर्गो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ।
बृहस्पतिः स ह्यञ्जो वरांसि विभ्वाभवत्समृते मातरिश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
tamritviya upa vachah sachante sargo na yo devayatamasarji |
brihaspatih sa hyanjo varamsi vibhvabhavatsamrite matarishva ||
verses.en:
On him wait songs according to the season even as a stream of pious men set moving.
Brhaspati--for he laid out the expanses--was, at the sacrifice, vast Matarisvan.

verses.sa:
उपस्तुतिं नमस उद्यतिं च श्लोकं यंसत्सवितेव प्र बाहू ।
अस्य क्रत्वाहन्यो यो अस्ति मृगो न भीमो अरक्षसस्तुविष्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
upastutim namasa udyatim cha shlokam yamsatsaviteva pra bahu |
asya kratvahanyo yo asti mrigo na bhimo arakshasastuvishman ||
verses.en:
The praise, the verse that offers adoration, may he bring forth, as the Sun sends his arms out,
He who gives daily light through this God's wisdom, strong as a dread wild beast, and inoffensive.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्लोको दिवीयते पृथिव्यामत्यो न यंसद्यक्षभृद्विचेताः ।
मृगाणां न हेतयो यन्ति चेमा बृहस्पतेरहिमायाँ अभि द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
asya shloko diviyate prithivyamatyo na yamsadyakshabhridvichetah |
mriganam na hetayo yanti chema brihaspaterahimayan abhi dyun ||
verses.en:
His song of praise pervades the earth and heaven: let the wise worshipper draw it, like a courser.
These of Brhaspati, like hunters' arrows, go to the skies that change their hue like serpents.

verses.sa:
ये त्वा देवोस्रिकं मन्यमानाः पापा भद्रमुपजीवन्ति पज्राः ।
न दूढ्ये अनु ददासि वामं बृहस्पते चयस इत्पियारुम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye tva devosrikam manyamanah papa bhadramupajivanti pajrah |
na dudhye anu dadasi vamam brihaspate chayasa itpiyarum ||
verses.en:
Those, God, who count thee as a worthless bullock, and, wealthy sinners, live on thee the Bounteous,--
On fools like these no blessing thou bestowest: Brhaspati, thou punishest the spiteful.

verses.sa:
सुप्रैतुः सूयवसो न पन्था दुर्नियन्तुः परिप्रीतो न मित्रः ।
अनर्वाणो अभि ये चक्षते नोऽपीवृता अपोर्णुवन्तो अस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
supraituh suyavaso na pantha durniyantuh pariprito na mitrah |
anarvano abhi ye chakshate no'pivrita apornuvanto asthuh ||
verses.en:
Like a fair path is he, where grass is pleasant, though hard to win, a Friend beloved most early.
Those who unharmed by enemies behold us, while they would make them bare, stood closely compassed.

verses.sa:
सं यं स्तुभोऽवनयो न यन्ति समुद्रं न स्रवतो रोधचक्राः ।
स विद्वाँ उभयं चष्टे अन्तर्बृहस्पतिस्तर आपश्च गृध्रः ॥
verses.rom:
sam yam stubho'vanayo na yanti samudram na sravato rodhachakrah |
sa vidvan ubhayam chashte antarbrihaspatistara apashcha gridhrah ||
verses.en:
He to whom songs of praise go forth like torrents, as rivers eddying under banks flow sea-ward--
Brhaspati the wise, the eager, closely looks upon both, the waters and the vessel.

verses.sa:
एवा महस्तुविजातस्तुविष्मान्बृहस्पतिर्वृषभो धायि देवः ।
स न स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva mahastuvijatastuvishmanbrihaspatirvrishabho dhayi devah |
sa na stuto viravaddhatu gomadvidyamesham vrijanam jiradanum ||
verses.en:
So hath Brhaspati, great, strong and mighty, the God exceeding powerful, been brought hither.
May he thus lauded give us kine and horses. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
कङ्कतो न कङ्कतोऽथो सतीनकङ्कतः ।
द्वाविति प्लुषी इति न्यदृष्टा अलिप्सत ॥
verses.rom:
kankato na kankato'tho satinakankatah |
dvaviti plushi iti nyadrishta alipsata ||
verses.en:
VENOMOUS, slightly venomous, or venomous aquatic worm,--
Both creatures, stinging, unobserved, with poison have infected me.

verses.sa:
अदृष्टान्हन्त्यायत्यथो हन्ति परायती ।
अथो अवघ्नती हन्त्यथो पिनष्टि पिंषती ॥
verses.rom:
adrishtanhantyayatyatho hanti parayati |
atho avaghnati hantyatho pinashti pimshati ||
verses.en:
Coming, it kills the unobserved; it kills them as it goes away,
It kills them as it drives them off, and bruising bruises them to death.

verses.sa:
शरासः कुशरासो दर्भासः सैर्या उत ।
मौञ्जा अदृष्टा वैरिणाः सर्वे साकं न्यलिप्सत ॥
verses.rom:
sharasah kusharaso darbhasah sairya uta |
maunja adrishta vairinah sarve sakam nyalipsata ||
verses.en:
Sara grass, Darbha, Kusara, and Sairya, Muñja, Virana,
Where all these creatures dwell unseen, with poison have infected me.

verses.sa:
नि गावो गोष्ठे असदन्नि मृगासो अविक्षत ।
नि केतवो जनानां न्यदृष्टा अलिप्सत ॥
verses.rom:
ni gavo goshthe asadanni mrigaso avikshata |
ni ketavo jananam nyadrishta alipsata ||
verses.en:
The cows had settled in their stalls, the beasts of prey had sought their lairs,
Extinguished were the lights of men, when things unseen infected me.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये प्रत्यदृश्रन्प्रदोषं तस्करा इव ।
अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टाः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.rom:
eta u tye pratyadrishranpradosham taskara iva |
adrishta vishvadrishtah pratibuddha abhutana ||
verses.en:
Or these, these reptiles, are observed, like lurking thieves at evening time.
Seers of all, themselves unseen: be therefore very vigilant.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्वः पिता पृथिवी माता सोमो भ्रातादितिः स्वसा ।
अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टास्तिष्ठतेलयता सु कम् ॥
verses.rom:
dyaurvah pita prithivi mata somo bhrataditih svasa |
adrishta vishvadrishtastishthatelayata su kam ||
verses.en:
Heaven is your Sire, your Mother Earth, Soma your Brother, Aditi
Your Sister: seeing all, unseen, keep still and dwell ye happily.

verses.sa:
ये अंस्या ये अङ्ग्याः सूचीका ये प्रकङ्कताः ।
अदृष्टाः किं चनेह वः सर्वे साकं नि जस्यत ॥
verses.rom:
ye amsya ye angyah suchika ye prakankatah |
adrishtah kim chaneha vah sarve sakam ni jasyata ||
verses.en:
Biters of shoulder or of limb, with needle-stings, most venomous,
Unseen, whatever ye may be, vanish together and be gone.

verses.sa:
उत्पुरस्तात्सूर्य एति विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ।
अदृष्टान्सर्वाञ्जम्भयन्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ॥
verses.rom:
utpurastatsurya eti vishvadrishto adrishtaha |
adrishtansarvanjambhayansarvashcha yatudhanyah ||
verses.en:
Slayer of things unseen, the Sun, beheld of all, mounts, eastward, up,
Consuming all that are not seen, and evil spirits of the night.

verses.sa:
उदपप्तदसौ सूर्यः पुरु विश्वानि जूर्वन् ।
आदित्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ॥
verses.rom:
udapaptadasau suryah puru vishvani jurvan |
adityah parvatebhyo vishvadrishto adrishtaha ||
verses.en:
There hath the Sun-God mounted up, who scorches much and everything.
Even the Aditya from the hills, all-seen, destroying things unseen.

verses.sa:
सूर्ये विषमा सजामि दृतिं सुरावतो गृहे ।
सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
verses.rom:
surye vishama sajami dritim suravato grihe |
so chinnu na marati no vayam maramare asya yojanam harishtha madhu tva madhula chakara ||
verses.en:
I hang the poison in the Sun, a wine-skin in a vintner's house,
He will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
इयत्तिका शकुन्तिका सका जघास ते विषम् ।
सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
verses.rom:
iyattika shakuntika saka jaghasa te visham |
so chinnu na marati no vayam maramare asya yojanam harishtha madhu tva madhula chakara ||
verses.en:
This little bird, so very small, hath swallowed all thy poison up.
She will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त विष्पुलिङ्गका विषस्य पुष्यमक्षन् ।
ताश्चिन्नु न मरन्ति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
verses.rom:
trih sapta vishpulingaka vishasya pushyamakshan |
tashchinnu na maranti no vayam maramare asya yojanam harishtha madhu tva madhula chakara ||
verses.en:
The three-times-seven bright sparks of fire have swallowed up the poison's strength.
They will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
नवानां नवतीनां विषस्य रोपुषीणाम् ।
सर्वासामग्रभं नामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
verses.rom:
navanam navatinam vishasya ropushinam |
sarvasamagrabham namare asya yojanam harishtha madhu tva madhula chakara ||
verses.en:
Of ninety rivers and of nine with power to stay the venom's course,--
The names of all I have secured: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त मयूर्यः सप्त स्वसारो अग्रुवः ।
तास्ते विषं वि जभ्रिर उदकं कुम्भिनीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
trih sapta mayuryah sapta svasaro agruvah |
taste visham vi jabhrira udakam kumbhiniriva ||
verses.en:
So have the peahens three-times-seven, so have the maiden Sisters Seven
Carried thy venom far away, as girls bear water in their jars.

verses.sa:
इयत्तकः कुषुम्भकस्तकं भिनद्म्यश्मना ।
ततो विषं प्र वावृते पराचीरनु संवतः ॥
verses.rom:
iyattakah kushumbhakastakam bhinadmyashmana |
tato visham pra vavrite parachiranu samvatah ||
verses.en:
The poison-insect is so small; I crush the creature with a stone.
I turn the poison hence away, departed unto distant lands.

verses.sa:
कुषुम्भकस्तदब्रवीद्गिरेः प्रवर्तमानकः ।
वृश्चिकस्यारसं विषमरसं वृश्चिक ते विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
kushumbhakastadabravidgireh pravartamanakah |
vrishchikasyarasam vishamarasam vrishchika te visham ||
verses.en:
Forth issuing from the mountain's side the poison-insect spake and said:
Scorpion, they venom is but weak.
